You are special correspondent of the famous journal. Disaster! What will happen to the earth in the future? Psychological human dilemmas.

title: Family Farm 2023
description: Welcome to Family Farm 2023, the ultimate farming stimulation game where you own an entire island and can crop, breed, and build to your heart's content. With over 22 crops and a variety of animals, factories, and decorations, the possibilities are endless. Play now and build your dream farm!

title: Brave Adventurer
description: Brave Adventurer - The story of a vagabond who travels through Middle-earth and is the victim of an attack by bandits, resulting in serious injury. You enter the world of demons through the use of dark magic.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Hidden Paradise
description:
A perfect place for a weekend getaway with friends. This DLC includes:
- Roller coaster map: Hidden Paradise.
- One roller coaster cart.

title: Intervallic
description: In this 2D sidescrolling rhythm game use your MIDI instrument or computer keyboard to guide a robot alien cat through space!

title: Cities of the World Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 30, 42, 117, or 285 pieces.

title: Derpy Dino
description: Derpy Dino is a game where you are the last dinosaur alive. You try your best to survive and keep the dinosaurs from becoming extinct but be aware... meteors are crashing down.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Return of Rome
description:
Welcome to Return of Rome, a completely new type of expansion pack which brings Age of Empires, the title that started it all, into Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition as a brand new self-contained experience. This new expansion will allow you to challenge friends with the original sixteen Age of Empires civilizations - plus one brand-new Return of Rome exclusive civilization, the Lac Viet- and relive the triumph and trials of antiquity. Battle your way across the ancient world with three new campaigns featuring conquerors, empire-builders, and gifted tacticians fighting desperately against fate! As an additional bonus, the Romans will no longer be bound by time as they become a new playable civilization within Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, ready to battle in the new Age.

Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Return of Rome is the fourth expansion of Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition. It was announced on 25 October 2022, on the 25th Anniversary of Age of Empires. It ports Age of Empires content into the Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition client.

title: DungeonSmash
description: A simple and addictive game where you break blocks in medieval dungeons.

title: I Made Myself an AI
description: Build circuits and manage heat as you complete tasks in this surprisingly intuitive puzzle game unlike anything you've ever played before.

title: Abscission
description:
Abscission is a dark and moody 32-map vanilla megawad with an original ambient/noise soundtrack composed by me.
Each map loosely follows the style of the original iwad levels, but with distinct and new layouts rather than being a remake. Visuals are classic since I stuck to stock textures other than custom skies.
The difficulty is slightly above average - expect difficult fights that don't become tedious or frustrating.

title: Snakedate
description: Welcome to Charmr, the premier dating app for snakes! Looking for love? Cruise around the club and wrap around your dates to show your affection!

title: Antbassador
description: Take control of The Antbassador, a giant human finger with a tophat, as he makes his way through a bustling ant colony. You must use your prodigious digit to help the citizens of Antopia without causing an international incident!

title: IndependAnt
description: Explore the vast Living Room to find food for your struggling ant colony in this cute and casual collectathon!

title: Bale Out
description: Bale Out is a short, relaxing puzzle game with a unique puzzle mechanic: AI prediction. Save barnyard animals by learning their movement patterns and manipulating the environment!

title: Celestial Crowns
description: The King is dead! Take the throne in this choice-rich fantasy game and save your Kingdom by reviving ancient magic that's been lost to your family for generations. Customize your character and play through three different romantic routes!

title: The Oregon Trail: Cowboys and Critters
description: Embark on new journeys, cook for real cowboys, and discover the legends of fearsome critters.

title: Grant of God
description: This is a synchronous turn-based card battle game where you build your card deck through the combination of characters, weapons and equipment to meet any challenge. welcome to my world:the land of godgrant.

title: Medusa VR
description: Medusa, the Croatian word for jellyfish. Medusa VR is 10 minute solo-developed VR film. Join Russel and Zlatan - two Croatian actors in Califonia for a coffee by the canal as they discuss grief, change and loss. When on strange shores, would you swim with Medusas?

title: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo II: Minako
description: The sequel to "Tenshi-tachi no Gogo"; instead of playing as the obnoxious male protagonist of the previous game, the player takes control of Minako, a female Japanese high-school student with a strong interest towards sexuality. The story mainly depicts Minako's sexual encounters with men and women, which take place on school grounds, in various locations of the city, etc.

title: Otoko Cross: Naked Remix
description: The Naked Remix is a bundle that includes Pretty Boys Klondike Solitaire + Pretty Boys Mahjong Solitaire!

title: Company of Heroes 3: Console Launch Edition
Inspector Gadget: Mad Time Party
description: Go Go Gadget! Become the famous Inspector Gadget and have fun with your friends in this brand-new adventure!

title: PlateUp!: Collector's Edition
description:
PlateUp!: Collector's Edition includes:
- Game: PlateUp!
- 4 Mini Figurines

title: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo: Fantabulous Edition
description: Includes exclusive cover and keyring.

title: Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten - Deluxe Edition
Under the Witch's Trial
description:
What happens when you transmigrate into a story… where everyone's a villain?

After leaving a critical review of a tropey and grimdark RPG where the main character experiences and perpetuates nothing but tragedy, you… accidentally reincarnate into that very game.

Unfortunately for you, your role is that of a cannon fodder two-bit villain, who exists only for the protagonist to murder in his first act of vengeance against those who've wronged him.

To make matters worse, an alluring villainess offers to help you out—At a price, of course. With both the protagonist's and villainess's eye on you, you must find a way to obtain power and ensure your survival—before it’s too late.

title: Car Cops
description: It is up to you to make sure everyone has no contraband!

title: Night of Horror
description: You are on the night shift at the bank. You hear noises all the time. You need to find out what they are and find your partner. As you pass, you will need to find the keys and open locked rooms.

title: Trainz 2022: Ferrovia Appennino Centrale 1899
description: Drive through the Italian countryside in 1899 with this 133km long 950mm narrow gauge route with steep grades and 32 stations. Featuring a Couillet 0-6-0T steam locomotive, this route will present the challenges faced by pioneering steam locomotive crews!

title: Trainz Plus: Ferrovia Appennino Centrale 1899
description: Drive through the Italian countryside in 1899 with this 133km long 950mm narrow gauge route with steep grades and 32 stations. Featuring a Couillet 0-6-0T steam locomotive, this route will present the challenges faced by pioneering steam locomotive crews!

title: Rescue Team: Magnetic Storm
description: You find your world in danger once again, but this time by unprecedented natural disasters caused by intense solar activity. As you navigate a city in chaos, you'll act as the head of a team of rescuers tasked with helping people in need.

title: Green New Deal Simulator
description: Achieve zero emissions and full employment in this casual card-driven game.

title: Just Find It
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Just Find the Difference!

title: Hell of a Racket
description:
Play as a fallen angel seeking redemption by punishing satanic worshipers who don't play the holiest of sports....tennis! Use your blessed racket to wreak havoc and show these satanic practices have no standing in God's land!

Hell of a Racket is a unique twist on an old-school genre: First-Person Shooter? No. First-Person Swinger! Engage with enemies in a unique way by reflecting projectiles at them with your racket or simply smacking them! Jump, dash, run, or wall-climb your way around the arena and kill your enemies as you work your way to the final boss: Pickle Ball Satan!

title: Idle Dragon Clicker
description: The land has been overrun by evil dragons It needs a leader to bring peace to the land. Start by clicking on the dragon to kill them, and collect coins. Spend that coin on your power and allied Heroes to get more damage. The more damage you deal, the more coins you will get.

title: Infected Backrooms
description: Enter the surreal world of Backrooms in our multiplayer 2-8 players Co-Op & PvP game. Become monsters or survivors, where players must infect others or use their guns to stay alive. With fast-paced gameplay and a creepy atmosphere, it's perfect for Backrooms fans for having fun with friends

title: Stellaris: Galactic Paragons
description: Add Galactic Paragons to your empires and experience a new level of character and story as great leaders follow your lead to the stars. With exclusive additions to the all-new Council mechanic, leaders who you can shape to amplify the vision for your empire, new civics and more.

title: Mais qui est le vrai Roro?
description:
Enter the wacky and crazy world of "Mais qui est le vrai Roro?" - an exciting game of hide-and-seek that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very last second! But beware, this time you're facing off against your Twitch community in a fierce battle to uncover the true Roro.

Take on the role of the famous streamer and podcaster Roro, who must complete his daily tasks in his apartment invaded by fake Roros. Among them, you'll find racing Roros, an adorable cat named Fluffy, and even the expert in decoration, Marc-Emmanuel!

At the end of each round, your audience must vote to determine who the real Roro is. Each completed or failed task will eliminate fake Roros or unlock powers to muddy the waters!

So, are you ready to take on the challenge and prove to your community that you're the master of the game? Play "Mais qui est le vrai Roro?" now and find out if you're the best Twitch detective!

title: RoboSquad Revolution
description: Welcome to the Revolution, where you are an insurgent robot marching to the beat of your own motherboard in the name of rebellion. Level up your components and rewrite the future of AI, one Hologram Throwdown at a time. Well what are you waiting for, metalhead? Join a squad for free today!

title: Muzzle Run
description:
Greyhounds are running on the Polygon Blockchain!
Breed, train, and race to win money on your way to podium glory with your NFT Greyhound collection.

title: Mind Over Magnet
description: An attractive puzzle platformer where you use magnetism to escape a factory. Meet a cast of magnet characters and work together to solve logical conundrums.

title: A Good Place To Die
description: Kill as many zombies as possible, collect points by hitting them, upgrade your weapons and reach the final boss!

title: Mini Taoism
description: "Mini Taoism" is a realistic Taoism simulation game based on match-3. You'll need to collect resources, use skills, refine elixirs, unlock talents, slay demons, constantly improve yourself, and finally become immortal.

title: Pixel Tank
description: Pixel Tank is a really simple game. It's a pixelated fish tank! Use it to relax or as ambiance in the background of your work day or even while you sleep! Every minute in game you gain a coin. You can use those coins to unlock any fish you want in the game. It's like Pixelated ASMR!

title: The Adventures of LinShanHai: Chapter 4 - Vanishing Masterpiece
description: A famous painting called 'The Rhapsody of the Goddess' worth over 100M has been stolen from the Treasure Chamber on the top floor of the Central Art Museum in City F. The municipal bureau has ordered that the case must be solved within three days due to the involvement of this national treasure.

title: Charged: RC Racing - Starter Edition
description: Charged: RC Racing is all about speed and making use of random items. Drive RC Cars in different locations and use items to defeat your opponents.

title: The Unfallens: Awakening
description: Returning from exile underground, a shattered world awaits you. The once-thriving civilization of Unfallens now lies in ruins. The ruthless guardian wait to attack. Journey through remains, use your skills to overcome intense boss battles. Awaken your true power. Reclaim what was lost.

title: Re:Curse
description: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

title: Hookscrap
description: Fight as the owner of Hookscrap in a thrilling 2D rogue-like. Unleash the power of your Harpoon, by launching ships & asteroids at enemies. Upgrade your ship with loot from your foes, and become even stronger. Explore 5 unique levels in a randomly generated map & take down the fearsome SC Judgement!

title: Gate Zero
description: Travel through time to ancient Israel in this compelling story-rich adventure. Explore a rich historical world as you engage with familiar events from the 1st century. Gather resources to help the locals, use stealth to avoid danger, and unlock riddles to unravel an age-old secret.

title: Chamberbound
description: Chamberbound is an atmospheric 3D ball roller puzzle game where you maneuver your way through chambers while solving puzzles with a brilliantly engineered ball which functions in unknown ways.

title: KartMania
description: "KartMania" is a real-oriented racing kart game. Changing settings such as seat position and sprocket diameter, Let's capture the circuit course with driving technique!

title: Holmes Sherlock & Mycroft
description: Play and get the most clues, ask witnesses for help and manage to solve the case by the end of the week before your opponent with your clues.

title: The Great War 3032
description: We are in the year 3032. For some time now, there has been a war between the Northern and Southern nations. Choose a side and enter the battle as an advanced combat robot. Play against friends in multiplayer deathmatch or team up with up to three others in co-op mode.

title: The Enemy Weapons Are Better
description: Goofy Ahh stories that take place in the world of data. The game simply has to press the move button to run around and kill enemies with their weapons.

title: Half-Life: Enriched
description: Half-Life: Enriched aims to update the look and feel of Half-Life with reworked maps and artwork.

title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
description:
Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes is a unique mix of puzzle, strategy and RPG: Plan your every move and combine your attacks to defeat your enemies in matching puzzle inspired battle scenarios, upgrade your heroes and creatures to unleash increasingly devastating attacks onto your opponents, and let the strategic thinker in you lead your troops to victory.

Originally developed by Capybara Games, Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes is getting a Definitive Edition including its DLC, refreshed character portraits, many quality-of-life improvements and an expanded, fully reworked and re-balanced online mode!

title: Faith of Danschant: Hereafter
description: Faith of Danschant: Hereafter is an Action RPG inspired by Chinese mythology. Developed by Beijing Joyfun, it is a sequel to the 2017 RPG Faith of Danschant, featuring Chinese martial arts and sword fighting, but now with a realtime action-RPG combat system for even more thrilling and complex battles.

title: Caona
description: In Caona, you take part in an Action Adventure Game set in a fictional world based on South American mythology.

title: F1 Manager 2023
description: F1 Manager 2023 gives you unparalleled control of your chosen F1 team, with rich and detailed management features, refined racing spectacle, deeper authenticity and a brand-new mode that allows you to rewrite the season on your terms.Drive every decision and become the best team on the grid across the official 2023 F1 season and beyond.

title: Like a Dragon: Ishin! - Ryoma Growth Support
description:
The Ryoma Growth Support Kit contains consumable items that will increase Sakamoto Ryoma's Experience Points, as well as a battle revival item.

It contains:
- Red Daifuku X3
- Yellow Daifuku x3
- Blue Daifuku x3
- Green Daifuku x3
- Training Daifuku x3
- Sacrifice Stone x1

title: Golden Idol Mysteries: The Spider of Lanka
description: The Spider of Lanka begins in 1741, one year before the first scenario in The Case of the Golden Idol, and uncovers the awful origins of this five-decade tale of betrayal, greed, ambition and death. Set in the fictional Kingdom of Lanka, this DLC offers three brand new scenarios that will demand the utmost of your deduction powers to unravel.

title: Commander: World War II
description: Commander: World War II is a turn-based tactical game where you lead either the Allies or the Axis to victory. Deploy infantry, tanks, planes, and naval units, capture locations, use the terrain, and counter specialized units in intense battles. Design your own maps and dominate the battlefield.

title: Enid
description: Help Enid stay aflame while exploring the forest and playing minigames with woodland creatures!

title: Cursed Fables: Twisted Tower
description: Can you stop a soul-stealing monster from terrorizing the kingdom?

title: Everlasting Abundance
description: A greedy AAA game company rules the world with an iron fist. You must join a faction of independent rebels and defeat the tyranny of Everlasting Abundance. Can you succeed? Is it all just a pointless dream?

title: Arcade Archives: Galaga '88
description:
Win the decisive battle in a massive galactic war!

"GALAGA'88" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
The GALAGA forces have returned, and you have to cross dimensions and fight your way to Planet Galaga to end the war.
This title lets you power up with 3 linked FIGHTERS for a TRIPLE FIGHTER. Use its massive firepower to mow down enemies!

title: Eukarion Tales 2
description: Embark on a dangerous adventure and do battle against the forces of Kaos. Complete quests to gain experience, learn new spells and abilities, and equip yourself with powerful weapons and armor. Relive this Flash Classic Today!

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Supernova
description: You are the leader of a space-faring civilization at the dawn of the 24th century whose choices for domination are endless: planetary conquest, cultural domination, political alliances, technological supremacy. Your mission is to spread your civilization across the known universe.

title: Top PUA
description: This is an LVG, a GALGAME, a visual novel, a super hilarious game. This story happend in Mainland China. In this game, our protagonist Willie dated a top pick-up artist Lilie. Although she is pretty young, but she know everything about dating with a man.

title: Doppa
description: Guide the lost Doppas to the spirit world by controlling their path in this endless journey.

title: Flora Domina
description: In this unique take on turn-based 4X strategy, play as a nature goddess that defends her island by playing cards to use nature as your ally.

title: Eternal Survivor
description: A fast paced twin stick shooter with roguelite elements. Trapped inside a dungeon room you must endure and survive.

title: Ink Neko Maid
description: A relaxing puzzle game with cat-girls.

title: Digital Exorcist Case_(0);
description: Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-Agency operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.

title: Nox Archaist: Lord of Storms
description: An expansion pack for Nox Archaist, containing the original story plus a new scenario and new features. Puzzles and powerful magic items await, along with dangerous traps and monsters. Those foolhardy enough to brave these perils will come face to face with the Lord of Storms! 15+ hours gameplay.

title: Piano at 5 am
description: "Piano at 5 am." is a short text adventure game. A girl who is the main character wanders in a fog forest while adjusting the four factors of "drowsiness," "thirst," "madness," and "recharge," which increase or decrease depending on the choices she makes.

title: Unalive 010
description: Welcome to the captivating world of Unalive - a game where the hero must battle fierce monsters using their shooting skills. You will navigate randomly generated room labyrinths and face challenging bosses, while mysterious events unfold throughout the game. Be prepared for unpredictable challenges and tests at every turn, creating an immersive atmosphere that draws the player deeper into the world's mysteries and enigmas. Will you be able to unravel all the secrets of Unalive? Only time will tell...

title: Xenon Runner
description: Xenon Runner is a fast paced speedrunning parkour FPS where you compete against yourself, your friends, and the world. Utilize grappling, power sliding, recoil knockback, and wallrunning to complete the levels as fast as possible.

title: Paws of Coal
description:
Paws of Coal is a cozy, slow-paced detective adventure with gameplay influenced by the scientific method – quests are solved by connecting evidence. If you get it right, the mystery is solved. If you get it wrong, everyone could be in danger. So, tread carefully.

In the game, you play as Charles, a scholar on a mission sent by His Majesty (the lion king Lav) to help the critters of The Burrows where the outbreak is on the rise. Is it dangerous, or just a mere nuisance? It is up to Charles to find out what is going on.

But there would be problems on his path, both scientific and social.

The Burrows is a mining town, and miners are on a strike
There is no cure for the outbreak, and productivity is suffering. The miners won't tolerate the current scenario and are on strike. The problem? The foreman of The Burrows isn't having any of it and wants to shut down the strike. Unless Charles finds a creative solution.

Paws of Coal is a short, stand-alone game set in the larger Trip the Ark Fantastic universe that is currently in development in Gamechuck. Paws of Coal offers around 3 to 4 hours of gameplay (depending on your play style), and even multiple endings.

The investigation is solved by talking to each resident of The Burrows, finding the clues in the environment, making a lot of notes, and connecting the dots (literally) using the interface in Charles' journal.

When you're sure you got it right - submit the report, and... hope for the best. Good luck!

title: Sol: Last Light
description: Sol: Last Light is a third-person, action-adventure RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world. Learn to control your newly discovered power to harness energy from the sun and battle against robots on your journey up the mountain to find your captured sister.

title: I Read a Post Online about Monarch Butterflies
description:
Made with bitsy for the pollinators bitsy jam,
very, very, very last minute

title: Cafe Venus Flytrap
description: You're a fly. A fly whose hobbies consist of writing novels and eating sweets. One day you decide to check out a new cute cafe that promises an abundance of pastries, sweets and drinks. A cafe that is run by adorable froggos.

title: Yuka: Scattered Shards of the Yokai
description:
Due to a kappa's careless mistake, Yuuka's common sense and sexual reasoning broke out of her mind into fragments and were scattered all around the world... but by strange coincidence, a mortal from the nearby village just happened to be there and as consequence, he was forced to explain what happened...
The pieces could not be seen with the naked eye and yet the mortal could... so he was forced by Yuuka to help collect the pieces in order to regain the fragments of her mental mind but there was one slight problem...
The fragments were very delicate and easy to break, and if they did then Yuuka's common sense and sexual reasoning will be lost meaning her plump body will be for anyones taking...​

title: Fossil Sweeper
description: Fossil Sweeper is a game about excavating fossils and building skeletons of prehistoric animals.

title: Raimodula
description: Raimodula is a dynamic arcade platformer, featuring customizable characters and randomized progression. Unlock habilities, fight modular enemies and navigate surreal environments with polished controls and intense gameplay!

title: Coffee Dates
description: Coffee Dates is a fun and lighthearted visual novel about hanging out with your crazy co-workers and the comedic shenanigans that unfold. There's even a few bits of game play that aren't just reading. Isn't that cool!

title: Neptunia GameMaker R:Evolution
description: Hyperdimension Neptunia GameMaker R:Evolution is set during an era where game makers are competing with each other. There were three goddesses of game makers who were defeated in the race to win "market share" of game sales and perished. Will they be branded as "goddesses of failure" and disappear? However, Adult Neptune who travels many dimensions suddenly appears in their world, asked by the three goddesses to become their president in order to revive the fallen game maker.

title: I Spy School Days
description: I Spy is the fourth game in an educational game series based on the series of children's hidden object books. It is the same as the first game, I Spy, with the addition of Craft Project levels.

title: Ducklyte
description: Ducklyte is a top-down shooter with roguelite elements where you play as a constipated little duck trying to stay alive as long as possible in a randomly generated farm with progressively stronger enemies.

title: The Stoevi Curse
description: Unravel the mystery of The Stoevi Curse, a first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria. Protect your farm, save your family.

title: Wandering Skies
description: Navigate through the Sky Lands and uncover its secrets to restore their lost harmony. In this first person platformer, use your abilities to reach the end of each level. Observation and skill are the keys to success !

title: Magic Toenail
description: Magic Toenail is a strategic wizarding roguelite where every step you take is a tactical maneuver! You shoot when you move and move when you shoot, so even the simplest enemy encounters will quickly become high-stakes puzzles!

title: Hatsune no Naisho!!
description: Hatsune no Naishou is a collection of Leaf's mini games that any Leaf's fan should not miss. The CD contains several cute mini software including some mini games, screen saver, wallpaper, and CD player. The mini games packed in the CD include a mini action game called Heart By Heart with characters from To Heart, a mini RPG game called Leaf Fighting 97, To Heart Omake, and of course the adventure game Hastune no Naishou.

title: Syd of Valis
description: Wait a minute! When did Valis become so cutesy?!

title: Matches Puzzle: Classic Logic Arcade
description: The classic matchstick puzzle is a real training of logic and brain!

title: Menseki: Area Maze Search
description: Menseki is back, but with a new brain-boggling twist!

title: Japanese Escape Games: The Prison Underground
description: Solve riddles and break out from a huge underground facility!

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Ninja Otedama R
description:
Slice and dice but don't drop!?
The definitive version of the deranged party game!

title: Galaxy Revo: Remake
description: Destroy enemy spaceships and reach new incredible records with Galaxy Revo: Remake!

title: Ultimate Shot: 3D Real Strike Shouter Counter
description: Are you ready for the ultimate challenge? Take aim and test your skills in The Ultimate Shot – the action-packed game that will put your precision and strategy to the test.

title: Coloring Pixels: Collection 3
description: A relaxing colouring by numbers game. Enjoy completing a variety of images with differing themes, complexity, and sizes.

title: Fortress S
description: The lastest installment in the beloved Fortress series, a fresh take on the artillery shooter genre.

title: Harvest Life + Castaway Paradise
description: The Ultimate Bundle for Adventure Seekers: Harvest Life and Castaway Paradise!

title: Love on Leave
description: You have some paid time off and decide to use it to return to your roots in the countryside.

title: Criminal Archives: Alphabetic Murders - Collector's Edition
description: Are the murders of three different people connected? Or are we dealing with three different incidents? Cunning and logic are your best weapons in solving this case!

title: Monster Memory
description: A stylized card matching memory game based on icons of horror with atmospheric music Relive your childhood with this simple yet fun puzzle game by matching the cards as fast as you can

title: Catch The Fox
description: It's a massive game of tag, who will win?

title: Two Portals: A Gemstone Puzzle Game
description: Open locks, activate gemstones, join passages to the grid and advance to the next level! Two Portals - A Gemstone Puzzle Game is a grid-based movement minimalist puzzle game.

title: DR2 Night Janki
description: DR² Night Janki is a mahjong game with adult scenes. The game has two modes: "Story" and "Regular". The story mode is set in a medieval castle, which is said to be ancient grounds for sorcery, but is currently controlled by the mysterious Rumira, who runs a mahjong club. The hero, a man named Ryuuji, decides to investigate the castle, and therefore has to defeat its inhabitants in mahjong matches.

title: Filsnown: Hikari to Toki
description:
Long time ago, seven gods who were guarding the Earth defeated the evil god Gadim. But time has passed, and the seven benevolent gods have vanished one by one. Evil has awaken from its slumber. It's time for somebody else - a human - to become a hero and to defeat it once and for all. This chosen one is a young girl named Thiria Fray. She must find other girls with supernatural powers to aid her on her quest to defeat the evil.

Filsnown plays like a standard top-down Japanese RPG: the party of heroines roams the world map, descend into dungeons, fight random enemies in first-person perspective combat using regular attacks or magic, and visit towns and villages to buy supplies and to rest. It contains cut-scenes with nudity and explicit sexual situations.

title: Yume Utsutsu Dreamy
description: One day Naoki picks up a mysterious pendant hanging on a telephone pole on the way back from school. On that night two fairies came to his dream saying that an angel could return to the original world if Naoki could make some girls happy during the next ten days. He decides to sleep as much as possible during next ten days and girls start to come to his dreams...

title: Looking for Aliens: Collector's Edition
description:
Aliens are among us! Can you find traces of them on Earth, the moon, and the edges of the galaxy? Find all the clues to prove the existence of alien civilizations and discover how making fried eggs can end up in a monster attack!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:
• Blast-off with five exciting bonus levels!
• Explore the galaxy with a downloadable soundtrack and wallpapers!
• Tons of hidden cards to collect!

title: Into the Breach: Advanced Edition
description:
Nearly every aspect of the game will be expanded with new content, including:

New Mechs and Weapons: Five new mech squads and nearly forty new weapons.

New Challenges: More enemies, more bosses, and more mission objectives that add additional challenge and variety to any run.

New Pilot Abilities: The expanded roster includes four new pilots and triple the amount of skills any pilot can earn through promotions.We’ll be elaborating on all of this new content over the coming weeks before launch and can’t wait for everyone to check it out.

title: Voltorometer Recharged+
description:
A remake of the game Voltorometer, released in 2009, with improved graphics, sound, controller support and more than 3 times the amount of content.

A simple platformer, run and jump to reach the end of each stage and progress through all the worlds to destroy the factories that trapped you and tried to harvest your electrical energy, unlock new modes and challenges by collecting all the power orbs in each level.

title: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows
description:
Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms. The game is based on the popular internet creepypasta about a mysterious place that exists between the walls and floors of buildings, a place where people can become trapped and lost for days, weeks, or even years.

In the game, you play as a person who has become trapped in the Backrooms, and your goal is to find a way out before the endless maze drives you insane. The Backrooms are a surreal and unsettling place, filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and mysterious creatures that seem to be watching you from the shadows.

As you explore the Backrooms, you'll need to find keys, solve puzzles, and avoid dangerous traps and obstacles. You'll also encounter other lost souls who are trying to escape, but not all of them can be trusted. The deeper you go, the more unsettling the Backrooms become, and the harder it is to tell what's real and what's just a figment of your imagination.

Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is designed to be a tense and atmospheric horror experience, with a focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival. It's a game that will keep you on edge from start to finish, as you try to find your way out of this terrifying and otherworldly place.

title: Erobos Heaven
description:
This is a short, very uncanny horror game, focusing on darkness..
Answering to your prayers, you get teleported into Salvation's land.

But, what answered your prayers?

title: Dig2China
description:
Dig through the center of the Earth in your backyard!
Upgrade your digger and plunge through 13 layers of the Earth to prove that if you dig deep enough, you really will make it to the other side. And make it back in time for dinner!

title: Sketch Doom
description: A mod which turns a classic Doom game into a pencil sketches on paper list.

title: Paper Angel
description:
Paper Angel is a short visual novel made in RPG Maker VX Ace. You have become conscious and find yourself taking care of “Spinwhim”. Why? Who know! It is just great that you are here!

Content Warning: Eyestrain, Clusters, Reality Distortion…

title: Student Council Leader Auriel
description: A simulation-management type eroge game where the protagonist, student council president Adam, kidnaps his classmate Auriel to make her his personal sexual slave.

title: Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer
description: Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer is a mystery visual novel where you enter the remote and sparsely populated island of Shikinejima and attempt to solve the strangely recurring mystery found there.

title: Town of Salem 2
description:
Town of Salem 2 is the sequel to BlankMediaGames' hit Murder Mystery game, Town of Salem. With a revitalized 3d world, new and reworked roles, improved chat features and much more you can't help but join the Witch Hunt!

Town of Salem 2 pits the Town vs the Coven, Serial Killers, Arsonist, Werewolves, and even the Horsemen of the Apocalypse themselves. Can you survive the Town of Salem again? Use your wits, abilities of deduction, and your role's special abilities to help, or hurt, the Town and lead your side to victory!

title: Super Mario Odyssey: 2D Mario in 3D!
description: Super Mario Odyssey: 2D Mario in 3D! is a mod for Super Mario Odyssey which changes Mario's 3D state into his 2D state while still existing in a 3D plain.

title: Octavio Camacho
description:
Based on the online graphic novel. This story takes place in a world filled with science gone mad, old society class revived, and a secret contest to possess
the chalice of Exon. To set the world right Octavio Camacho and his covert task- force named W.A.R.C.O.M are ready to take on the mission.

title: Not Meow Purroblem
description: Iris is tired of studying and working and just wants to be a cat. Her wish comes true. While she's discovering the joy and downsides of her new form, her girlfriend Maggie is bothered by absence of her partner.

title: Concert
description: You become the leader of a rock band of five girls. Will you make a name for yourself?

title: Reflectile
description: Reflectile is a minimal precision-puzzle game that yearns for the early 2000's era of video games. It will test your ability to cut corners, squeeze through tight corridors, and make split-second inputs to reach the goal of each stage. You’ll encounter stages of varying difficulty, all with unique challenges and stylish designs to boot.

title: Sex, Drugs, and Beer Can
description: A Coop Based team mod based around the story of Beercan the Jamaican beer can! The mod sees you completing objectives and slaughter all the monsters in sight.

title: Half-Life: Shift-Two
description: You are Otis, a security guard at the Black Mesa facility. After surviving the Resonance Cascade you attempt to escape the facility with your colleagues.

title: Bootleg Squadrog
description:
“Bootleg Squadrog, sir. It is not about individualism. It is not about cowboy heroism. It is about being one cohesive unit. The only identity I have is that of a group identity.”

Bootleg Squadrog is a singler player map pack for Half-Life: Opposing Force, with squad-based and teamwork tactical scenarios.

title: Bleach: Zanpakutou Senshi
description: The mod features a technical hack 'n' slash combat style, where you can fight in a team deathmatch as Ichigo or Grimmjow.

title: Half-Life: Case Closed
description:
You are Bob Dewey, Black Mesa janitor. You arrive at the research facility for another day at work: cleaning up the mess those smart ass scientists leave behind, refilling the soapboxes in the toilets, listening to Barney's stupid jokes and reading Penthouse Magazine. It's not the most exciting job in the world, but it pays good and you get lot's off free donuts. As usual, those scientists create black holes and open gates to other alien worlds filled with creatures who eat human flesh for lunch.

Nothing special, but this time, they really messed it up and those aliens found a way to our planet. And guess what, you are in the middle of all this. While Gorden Freeman kicks alien arse, Corporal Adrian Shephard fights Freeman and Barney Calhoun tries to save some scientists, you just try to save you own butt and get the hell out of Black Mesa.

It's a bigger mess you have to clean up this time...

title: Apico 2.0: I Can’t Beelieve it’s Not Butter(flies)!
description:
The new update is buzzing with an un-bee-lievable amount of new content, including new pollinators, new characters to meet, and more:

New NPCs: New friends from the mainland, Cody and Sto, have come to the APICO Islands to further their research.
Butterflies: Discover, collect and breed a variety of brand-new pollinators.
Solitary Bees: These new pollinators prefer to do things on their own – build new solitary bee hotels and help them along!
New Flowers: Now, there are more ways to keep the pollinator population happy – each new flower has its own new effect on the environment.
Incense: Through the magic of alchemy, make your own incense and candles!
Bee-Sides: New tracks have been added to the chill soundtrack
And More: New books, decorations, and a host of quality-of-life improvements have been added.

title: Half-Life: Crossfire
description:
Return and relive the Black Mesa incident through the eyes of Sgt. Jordan Foster, a security guard battling for survivfal through the Xen invasion in search of Dr. Cross.

Find Dr. Cross, protect her at all cost, and maybe you'll have a chance to get out of this whole mess alive.

title: Land of Legends: Heroes of Loria
description: Land of Legends: Heroes of Loria takes place in the fantasy world of Loria, a Human kingdom besieged by conflict with the Orcs. A group of heroes, which includes you, is being cast down by the All-Seeing-Eye to save humanity once again. Travel alone or with your friends in co-operative mode through the rich and colourful world of Loria and end the Orcs' evil reign.

title: Deep Hunters
description: Deep Hunters is a 2 player multiplayer game that focuses on hacking and deep web. You and your friend signed up for a deep web game, but you didn't expect that the you'll end up fighting with each other for your life. Will you win the game or will you sacrifice your life to save your friend?

title: Outer Colony
description: Outer Colony is an open ended, real time strategy game with a focus on artificial intelligence and simulation-derived mechanics. Set in a sci-fi universe, players command expeditions of spacefaring colonists in an effort to establish settlements on remote worlds. Much of the core gameplay revolves around providing for your expedition’s NPCs, managing its fledgling society, freeform building, and tactical combat. Whatever you do in OC affects the persistent game world, so everything from driving species to extinction to terraforming whole regions is possible.

title: Funko Fusion
description: Funko Fusion is a third-person action game that’s all about celebrating fandom. Play with some of your favorite characters from across TV, movies, games, and comics, and explore handcrafted worlds inspired by Jurassic World, Back to the Future, JAWS, The Thing, Chucky, Battlestar Galactica, Hot Fuzz, The Umbrella Academy, Five Nights at Freddy’s, Masters of the Universe, Invincible, and many more!

title: Crystal Colors

Created for Winter VN Jam 2020.

Crystal Colors is a game about two girls trying to live normally in a world that is slowly fading away into pure nothingness.

Will you be brave enough to saved your loved one, or will you be erased too?

As a young chief of the shop, a hero will experience various tales with a regular customer etc. Since girls are the players of a network game, respectively, after closing can also meet them on on-line. And the tale which becomes entangled in both of the worlds, the tale which is not involved. Is a hero how to make it put the body on which world?

title: Kao the Kangaroo: Bend the Roo'les
description: “Bend the Roo'les” features 5 new levels, each with their own unique twist on the formula of Kao the Kangaroo: new perspectives, a retro-inspired design, and the continuation of Kao versus the Eternal World!

title: The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood
description: Immerse yourself in an enchanting narrative experience as Fortuna, a fortune-teller Witch condemned to exile on her asteroid home. Craft your own Tarot deck, regain your freedom, and shape the fate of the cosmic Witch society.

title: Tiny Dragon Story
description: Jump right into an epic adventure set in a 1-bit world. This Tiny Dragon is no pushover and will do anything in his quest to find the Wizard who stole his stuff.

title: True Disc Golf
description: Realistic disc golf simulation with authentic flight physics. Build your bag from 300+ real discs and play challenging courses locally, or online with cross-platform online multiplayer. Train, compete, and improve your rating in ranked matches or play against your friends.

title: Star Gagnant
description: This new Shmup with its unique rapid fire system will blow you away! !

title: Dessert DIY
description:
Make sweet ice cream, popsicles, and waffles using your creativity in one of the best dessert decorating games!

Experience the satisfaction of preparing your customers' orders with your own hands, meeting their expectations, and witnessing their delightful reactions! Explore a variety of delicious molds, creams, syrups, and sweet ingredients to create mouthwatering works of art!

Does your customer want to take revenge on someone? Prepare yucky desserts with surprise bugs or chili peppers! Such a taste is definitely something no one will ever forget!

Every dessert sold brings you coins, a delightful reward that you can invest in enhancing the appearance of your store. Change the colors of your walls or floor, and add new furniture. Transform your store into a cozy and professional haven, all while having fun!

Ready to get your hands dirty and make unique, colorful desserts?

title: Draw and Color: Kawaii - Platinum Edition

title: Food Truck Tycoon: Co-op Edition

Jump into your food truck and business will bump up!
Test your skills and talent as owner of a busy food truck!

Your only job is to take orders, prepare food and serve to as many customers as possible.

It all takes place in a dark fantasy cyber world, where ancient cultures' wisdom and futuristic technological power combine. Manage a party of warriors from bygone times. And start a campaign in one of the distinctive locations, where mutated offspring of the disgusting Aspid, cyber-jianshi, mummy-troopers, and other dangerous enemies.

Chef is a fun, easy to play tycoon cooking game with 48 levels to complete.

The aim of the game is to prepare and serve the customers their orders. You will need to be quick , efficient and most importantly accurate, wrongly created orders go into the bin, losing you money and serving a customer too slow will lose you much needed income.

description: Play as Domino, a stray cat in love with food, in this heartwarming adventure where you help an old man overcome his grief after his wife passed away. Use your feline skills to explore and solve puzzles as you strive to bring joy into the old man's life and build an unbreakable bond with him.

description: This Is a simple, casual, relax and fluency action game. You can jump and challenge 100 floors to arrive the top. Each floor's postion generates randomly. You can collect the coin on each floor. The length of floors will change to add difficulty.

description: You can't remember anything, and all you can see is HER. Delve into your story and uncover the truth behind what happened to you and your parents.

description: The young alchemist Meti from the village, along with her boyfriend Nero, begins a quest to find their missing master. Meti's ability to synthesize magical creatures helps the couple overcome various challenges they encounter on the way, and they discover a secret that changes their lives.

title: Tinker Tanks
description: "Tinker Tanks" is an action-packed 1v1 multiplayer tank game on Steam that offers fast-paced, strategic gameplay with power-ups to supercharge your tank. Experience thrilling, high-octane tank warfare in 2-3 minute skirmishes and defeat your opponents with quick reflexes and strategic gameplay.

description: Relive iconic scenes from the movies in Indiana Jones: The Pinball Adventure, the 1993 Williams classic. Escape Castle Brunwald, feed your pinballs to the mysterious Idol, and brave the Path of Adventure.

title: Daemonium
description: Daemonium is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror. Demonic possessions are running rampant. Grab your equipment and your team and get to work locating and removing the source of the demonic presence. Enter the portal to the demons home and stop the possession once and for all.

title: The Scrap
description: The Scrap is an independent third-person shooter that takes place in a futuristic world inhabited by robots.

title: Alpaca Sprint
description: Run, dodge trees, and see how far you can get in this retro arcade inspired runner!

title: Towns of Yore
description: A dungeon building game which gives you the freedom to create stories and adventures to share.

title: San Fernando
description: Your assignment: a distant island town named San Fernando. As an anthropologist, you’re tasked to gather notes about the town’s culture, and to find out if there is more to this community than meets the eye. How much of this town’s secrets will you discover?

title: Daahrien's A.P.H.R.O.D.I.T.E.
description: Daahrien's A.P.H.R.O.D.I.T.E. is a Scifi Horror game set in an abandoned space ship. After activating the dormant A.I. there, escaping it has become your top priority. Fix the ship corrupt systems, adapt to extreme life-or-death situations, hide from them.. shh.. hide. Get back to your ship. Are you there?

description: Rocket Jump Frenzy is a punishing game where you need to climb a mountain using a rocket launcher.

Bounce around a tropical metropolis, gather fruit and recyclables, craft juicy drinks, and splash the people of Grape Juice City!

In the game, you need to continuously use wisdom and strategy to build your own cards, fight against various powerful enemies. Get ready to embark on your adventure journey!

description: Zen Studios presents the Carnivals and Legends two-table pack featuring original designs, "Adventure Land" and "Son of Zeus."

title: Pinball FX: Borderlands - Vault Hunter Pinball

description: "Summon a Vengeance Demon," they said. "What could go wrong?" they said. Our main character is in over his head! Fortunately, the demon Balasque has taken a liking to him. Wait...is that actually fortunate? A NSFW Visual Novel Dating Sim with a Truly Monstrous Monster!

description: "ReLinked" is a pixelated Sovietpunk action/PRG in which you have to fight back against extraterrestrial intelligence and uncover the mysterious secrets of faraway space.

This time, Ayase confronts a nest of monster in an abandoned village near the old palace of the king. Follow Ayase and see how far you can go.

description: Discover the secrets of the Great Waterfall as you fight your way back home in this A 2D pixel-art combat platforming adventure.

description: A game about Strategy, not Gems. Tower Defense game focused on strategy with well-balanced levels and a variety of game modes.

title: Imprisoned Hyperion 2
description: Imprisoned Hyperion 2 is an imersive sim, first-person rpg. Explore the dark and dangerous dungeon. Survive by finding safe resting places and cooking food. Help different creatures and learn the dark history of this world.

title: Last Day of Zombies
description: The indie-casual game of Last Day of Zombies comes to confirm this principle once again.

title: Dreieck
description: Play as a lowly triangle in this fast-paced top-down shooter on a dystopian polygon-based universe. Defeat your oppressors, claim glory!

description: Easy-to-use bomb action! Throw bombs and mine Bomcoin! Aim! Bomberhead Champion!

description: Kill the zombies and take on challenges by helping the last survivors in the city. The Last Survivors is a fun roguelite action game with an infinite power-up experience that is repeatable every time you play. Never stop, collect as much XP and Boosters to get stronger by choosing your upgrades.

title: Bridgebourn
description: Explore a hand-painted dynamic open world in this immersive ARPG. Create custom spells and trigger countless reactions. Plunder treasure and secrets with your party of adventurers. Upgrade your party with magic loot. Fight what lurks in the depths of dungeons. Discover mysteries of the Fadelands.

title: Plungeroo
description: Plungeroo is a colorful puzzle game about tinkering with mini pinball cabinets, no quick reflexes or quarters required! Maneuver your ball through Pop Bumpers, Flippers, and more until you become a pinball wizard!

title: As One We Survive
description: As One We Survive is a top down survival game set in a post-apocalyptic America. Step into the shoes of a father as he tries to find help for his sick daughter during a grid down post-pandemic event. Fight, scavenge, craft, and gather resources for your family's survival.

title: Costly Adventure
description: Costly Adventure is a Match-3 game with RPG elements. Exciting talent trees and itemization will quickly change the way you play. Will your party withstand the ever increasing tolls of the bridge troll?

title: Grim Tales: Dual Disposition - Collector's Edition
description: When a souvenir shop dealing in oddities is ransacked, you’re shocked when you’re the prime suspect! Your double has come from another reality to disrupt the flow of magic, taking your abilities in the process. Can you save the sources of magic and clear your name in time?

title: Midline '85
description: Midline ‘85 is an interactive psychological thriller about working as an emergency call-taker in the murky past of 1985. Protect your hometown of Midline from death and destruction, and protect your protagonist from succumbing to the stress of her job…

title: Machine Love 2069
description: Machine Love 2069 is a visual novel for adults with clicker elements and mini-gamesAlex has always been a skilled hacker. One day he received an unusual job offer from a girl named Maya. Maya was a hacker herself, but she needed Alex's help to handle a big task.

title: Chronicles Of Errodean
description: Embark on an epic adventure to collect three powerful relics in this medieval RPG. Explore ancient ruins, fight mythical beasts, and master magic to save the kingdom from an evil sorcerer.

title: Weak Soul
description: Get up. There is no place in this world for those who are weak. I must free the continent from the demons before they get rid of me. Any choice can change someone's fate. But I will fight as long as the flame of my soul burns.

title: Crash Cars: Driven to Destruction
description: Dive into a car crushing simulator that feeds your hunger for speed. Customize your ramp height, slam down the accelerator, and send your car careening into a stunning landscape of time-worn clunkers. Experience the adrenaline rush and embrace the thrill of vehicular destruction.

title: Cattle Hyperdrive
description: Cattle Hyperdrive is a space trucking open world game that takes place across the solar system.

title: Aldro
description: You play as Aldro, a cute slime lost in an unexplored world full of magic and mystery. Explore procedurally generated levels full of strange creatures and resources unique to the area. Cultivate anywhere you choose and gather resources to build and defend your civilization from the dangers outside.

title: Love Love Diary
description: Complete the puzzle challenges to win the hearts of 15 different girls with various professions. Apply the patch and dive deeper into their lives!

title: Crab Raid Tactics
description: Crab Raid Tactics is an Action Strategy Roguelike game where you command a squad of crabs to overcome swarms of monsters and challenging bosses by collecting upgrades, triggering powerful elemental reactions and avoiding threats of a constantly changing environment.

title: Postfrost
description: Welcome to the frozen wasteland of our post-apocalyptic world! In this multiplayer game, you and your friends will have to work together to brave the harsh winter conditions and fight off dangerous enemies to survive.

title: Shrommzzz
description: Fung around and find out! A cozy mushroom foraging and farming game. Plant shromspores on 6 different islands to unlock all combinations. Can you make all 100 of 'em pop up? Challenge accepted!

title: Boreal Tenebrae: Deluxe Ultimate Edition
description: Boreal Tenebrae will take you on a retro-style adventure, with a mysterious atmosphere and horror elements. The game is inspired by 90s classics and the best TV series.

title: Run Sausage Run: Coins, Bugs and Chicken
description:
Three new sausages: Fly, Cockroach and Plucked Chicken
and 15,000 coins to unlock your favorites sausages with powerups.

description: Unravel the mystery of a cryptic box in this 2-player co-op puzzle game. Join forces as two detectives, solve cooperative puzzles, communicate effectively, crack the codes and outsmart the killer.

title: Little Postman
description: Puzzle game where you rotate islands to find your way around different archipelagos.

description: Here, you will start from scratch and meet like-minded comrades. With wisdom and courage, you set out on a journey to conquer and unite the lands. Use the Strategy system and deploy Frontline, Center, and Rearguard units to fight your opponents in small-scale skirmishes.

description: Raise a new organization from the ashes of the SRT and guide Silver Cross Incorporated to protect the innocent from the darker side of humanity.

description: Fat Sheep Town has monsters! Use skills to defeat them. Plugins help warriors survive. Many maps have risks and rewards. Pick an occupation and weapons. Level up weapons. Combine skills, plugins and weapons. Defeat the villain!

description: One fateful night, while Penguin P.I. Giuseppe Squawks is out to dinner with his dearest girlfriend, a seemingly random explosion takes his loved one from him. Now, aided by an octopus named Tony the Tickler, he must hunt down the Mafioso who orchestrated the accident and bring him to justice.

title: Winter Stealth
description: Winter Stealth - You have to play as a hired agent who is able to get where the rest can not. Take orders and go on an adventure! Dodge enemies, complete missions and find secret items. Risk everything and go with the hero on a wonderful journey!

title: Camelot II: The Holy Grail
description: A terrible disease has struck Queen Guinevere! The only thing that can save her is the Holy Grail. But the ancient artefact has long been lost somewhere in the expanses of Avalon. Can you manage to overcome all obstacles, find the Grail, and save the queen?

title: The Flying Feathers
description: Nia accidentally goes into her best friend—Alice's past, the only way to escape and go back to the real world is to help Alice to solve all her problems. When you can go back to the past, do you want to do everything you can to save what you've lost?

title: The Murder Hotel
description: Interrogate suspects, search for clues, & uncover a dastardly plot, as you solve a string of mystifying murders to help reluctant detective Ilmarinen escape the foreboding Fafnir Hotel. From the maker of The Donnerwald Experiment comes a detective adventure with a twist.

title: Forced Sacrifice: Hejled
description: This game provides a fun and challenging experience for gamers who enjoy fast, skill-based arcade-style games with immersive audiovisuals and a focus on high scores.

description: Solve otherworldly puzzles, rescue quirky monster girls and uncover the secrets of the kingdom together in this light-hearted isekai visual novel.

description: A fan visual novel where you join Nana at Japari Park as new caretaker. Fun and food await in adventures with an energetic serval cat and an always hungry fox!

description: Experience high-speed, multiplayer battles across various environments in this action-packed game. Use rockets to take down enemy UFOs and conquer multiple challenging levels. Upgrade your ship and unlock powerful weapons to dominate the skies and emerge victorious in this epic war.

title: Space Engineers: Automatons
description: Space Engineers: Automatons pack includes Automaton Programmable Block, Automaton Timer Block, Automaton Sensor, Top Mounted Camera, Saddle Cockpit, Emotion Controller, Warning Signs, Angled Interior Wall, Inset Light Block, Pipework Block, Access panels, Air Vent Fan, Robot Helmet Skin, Plastic Armor Skin.

description: Berry Hunt Survivors is a Reverse-Bullet-Hell Game with Rouge-lite elements. Choose your character, defeat enemies, learn new abilities and destroy the big bosses!

title: Portabellows
description: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

title: Hyper Hentai Devil Hell
description: Hyper Hentai Devil Hell is a relaxing puzzle game. With the theme of hell of devil and multiple unique sexy girls. Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

description: Are you prepared to set sail on a culinary adventure? Get ready to cook on the open sea, with mouth-watering new meals for the guests.

Use the iconic Japanese and American WWII weaponry, and prepare your defenses with mines, explosives and bonuses!

title: Victoria 3: Voice of the People
description: Relive the dramatic political events of the 19th century! Drawing from the historical struggles between reformists, reactionaries and revolutionaries, Voice of the People puts you in the middle of political crises as charismatic characters from history vigorously push their agendas.

description: "ShudderStep" is a terrifying first-person horror game that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Step into the shoes of a survivor who must navigate a dark and foreboding world filled with unspeakable horrors. Can you survive the darkness and uncover the secrets that lie hidden within?

title: Autarkis
description: A hard to master survival strategy game. Build an balance up to three colonies at once, mine ressources, manage energy and survive until you build up a 6 stage rocket to flee with your 100 settlers.This game is hard to master, prepare to fail!

description: Play Abathor Atlantis Landing and relive the glory of arcades in this action platformer for up to 4 players.

description: An auto-biographical, narrative game, based on real diary entries kept as a teenager. The Quiet Things seeks to explore mental health issues with a raw but brave look at childhood abuse and trauma. With a deep focus on storytelling through audio, set foot in Alice’s world and hear her story.

title: The Rusty Longsword
description: Join Rana, a cute gnome, on a whimsical adventure up a magical island in this enchanting 3D pixel art game. Meet new friends, collect treasures, and unlock secrets along the way!

title: Taoism
description: Taoism is a Roguelike card game with unique playing methods. Use the cards embodied in faith to explore the foggy Luonan country, and use the unique rules "Hunyuan" and "Qixiang" to uncover the truth behind the undercurrent with the protagonists in a huge conspiracy about people, Taoism and ghosts.

title: Venice After Dark
description: A visual novel adventure alongside young Japanese engineer Aiko and her AI friend. Solve the mysterious case around the Stucky family and unravel what it means to be human through the eyes of an AI programmer.

title: Frenemies
description: Frenemies is a cute multiplayer game that strands players on a deserted island in the ultimate test of survival and betrayal. Build a town, form alliances and battle to become the last player standing in a game of social deception inspired by the hit TV show Survivor.

title: Buntasy
description: Let your imagination loose in this Lego-like physics-based sandbox game of your dreams! Create any kind of game you want using the map editor or pick from a vast array of sample mini-games that you can play offline or online with your friends!

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Toys
description: Puzzles of toys!

description: Build a bond with your horse and gain its trust. Develop yours and the horse’s skills. Discover the surrounding open world. Complete tasks and take part in competitions. Rebuild a run-down stud farm!

title: SimpliCity
description: A sandbox game about building a city without all those hassle from complicated systems.

title: Trans Neuronica
description: Link nodes; Untangle paths; Rebuild memory; Assess humans; A puzzle where logic goes hand in hand with surgical precision and humans ask artificial intelligence for help. But only if you trust them enough.

description: An adult, survival game where hunky men battle hordes of lusty monsters! The more monsters you kill, the more sticky, sweaty, muscle-packed story you'll unlock. Better start whackin'.

title: ArchiHexago
description: ArchiHexago is a casual puzzle game which takes inspiration from match-3 genre and takes it one step further. Each tile type has unique pattern which you need to match in order to gain points. And each level has different tile sets and obstacles to give you a variety of challenges.

title: Level Up: The Gamer Girls
description: The gamer girls have picked up some goodies, made themselves comfortable and are ready for a good game!

title: Shroom Siege
description:
Welcome to Shroom Siege, a fast-paced multiplayer game that balances strategy and fun. In a 4 vs 4 setting, you'll embody a shroom character, coordinating with your teammates and using quick thinking to outsmart your opponents.

Shroom Siege brings together the best aspects of local and online multiplayer games, making it a versatile choice for any gaming session. Whether you're sharing a couch with friends or playing with others from around the globe, this game ensures a dynamic experience tailored to your setup.
What's more, Shroom Siege supports cross-play across Steam and Nintendo Switch platforms, bringing together an even larger community of players. This means you can compete with friends and others regardless of their chosen platform. And don't worry if you're short of human players - AI steps in to balance the 4v4 gameplay.

title: Crying Booth
description: Sacrifice, survive, trick or treat, and go home. Experience four first-person scenarios with stealth, survival, and puzzle elements along with one side scroller platformer.

title: Champion's Chalice
description: Champion’s Chalice is a single player Roguelike Auto Battler. Choose your champion, buy units and items, roll the shop, and battle enemy parties. Discover unique and powerful synergies as you traverse varied environments in search of prized treasure. Can you find the chalice?

Take control of a group of 4 special forces units with unique abilities, infiltrate the enemy base and complete the mission objectives. Use the in-game level editor to create your own missions and upload them to the Steam Workshop.

title: Slice and Bite
description: You are a pizza delivering vampire in demon infested medieval Italy. Choose your delivery routes and upgrade your magical carriage. Save your family pizzeria from certain doom by slicing your way through levels, defeating challenging boss fights, uncovering secrets and exploring the world.

description: Wandering into the uncanny concept of liminality, captured in DV tape format you explore what seems to be another dimension, lost in an endless space that looks human-made but isn't.

description: Engage with the townsfolk and native people to make decisions and choices, your actions will decide the fate of New Albans. With multiple endings, solve puzzles, speak to NPCs and explore the land in this story adventure.

description: Card drama adventure game. With the epidemic, no one can be left alone. You will play as Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing and Dong Feng, with the help of surgery, potions, and even the power of the gods, to end this tragic chaos, uncover the truth of the world and destroy the culprits of it all.

description: You play as Danny, who is assigned by his sister to run her home, and he has to live with a beautiful girl named Mary. You have 7 days to impress her to get the ending you want.

description: Reverse minesweeper with inventory management roguelike. Collect items, organize inventory, mine for energy and vanquish your foes!

title: Venox: The Alien Survivors
description: You are a Venox who invades planets to explore and mine for mech parts to merge with. You must repair and protect your ship from enemy waves while doing so. Venox is half alien and half mecha, but stronger than both!

title: Super Power Racing
description:
Get ready to experience a thrilling top-down arcade racing game that's inspired by the classic 90s racing games you know and love.

Super Power Racing League is the prestigious racing competition where ruthless competitors from around the world come together to tear up the track and power their way to victory.

Get ready to feel the adrenaline rush of Super Power Racing League, where the competition is fierce and the stakes are high. Start your engines and let the race begin!

title: Starri
description: Starri is a body-controlled rhythm game you can play with just a webcam, no VR required. Feel your heart pumping as you slash or catch the beat, dodge obstacles, and turn the wheel. Engage your body with music from Indie classics, Global Top Hits and Asian lineups.

title: Gather
description: Harvest crop, pick fruit, collect bales, chop down trees, plant seeds all while investigating and exploring a series of tiny islands along the way. Discover the secrets hidden in the lands while relaxing and solving mysterious puzzle of the land.

title: Guild Keeper
description: Lead a Guild of Heroes in this party-based RPG with realistic battle mechanics and strategic elements. Explore challenging dungeons. Build your base. Trade, craft and enchant items. The fate of your Guild is in your hands.

description: Kingdom Incremental is a satirical city builder and incremental game. To be the wealthiest ruler, you must build a fortified settlement and balanced economy, strategically invest in upgrades, and expand your kingdom across the globe! Then burn everything down to start again with even more power!

title: Dreamy Trail
description: Welcome to Dreamy Trail, a captivating walking simulator that takes you on a peaceful journey through a mystical forest. Immerse yourself in the serene atmosphere as you explore the forest, collect items, and uncover hidden secrets.

title: Foresia: The Cursed Oath
description: Foresia is a rare High Elf living in the Spirit Tree Forest. Suddenly, monsters set fire to her village and Foresia is captured and enslaved. With the help of the spirit, she manages to escape but is plagued by a curse she cannot resist.

title: VoxSys
description: Step into the future with VoxSys, the exhilarating arena shooter that combines cooperative PvP combat with innovative building mechanics. Strategize and use your cover to your advantage! Destroy your opponents and earn the title of Intergalactic Champion.

title: Lone King: Expansion
description: Expansion Content:2 new abilities per maniple2 new story chaptersUnlocks Team ModeMore content based on player demand

description: Welcome Potion Crafter! Lets Make A Potion is a casual puzzle like experience where you have to collect the correct potion ingredients and avoid collecting the wrong ingredients.

description: Apprentice Maid Clara's Maid Job! This game feature a journey of maid girl's work performing various tasks.

title: Magic City Detective: Rage Under Moon DLC
description: Explore additional locations and achieve new goals! Could you become a werewolves' true friend? Let’s find out what you’re capable of!

title: Seven Nights Ghost
description: "Peaceful days full of curses" Heartwarming FPS horror exploration game about 7 days of strange communal living with ghosts

title: Origin Unknown
description: Investigate the recently condemned High Rock Hotel in this mystery horror expedition. Solve the disappearance of your father as Lin Wei as she evades parasitic monsters and discovers clues to the truth of what truly transpired in this 1970's hotel.

title: The Crimson Kingdom

title: Don't Die, Collect Loot
description: Don't Die, Collect Loot is an arcade roguelite where you guide your hero through a series of infinite retro worlds, attempting to stay alive, collect loot, and grow in power. Grow in power and live the ultimate Action RPG fantasy!

title: On the Wind's Breath
description: In On the Wind's Breath, play as a dandelion seed, navigate obstacles, find fertile soil, take control of the wind, grow into a flower. Simple graphics, intuitive controls, meditative experience. Beware of unsuitable surfaces. Soothing soundtrack, a journey through various regions.

description: Endless flight in space. Letters fly past you. Your goal is to destroy them with mouse clicks. But with difficult clicks. Before clicking the mouse, you must hold down the key with the corresponding keyboard letter. The game will be over as soon as the letters fly past you.

title: The Red Selene
description: The new genre of sci-fi horror survival and all-out action is now with your beloved pixel-art classic games. Grab the top weapons, and resources and use them in the modern combat system with a traditional and retro vibe, Immerse yourself in the huge hand-drawn environments with massive details.

title: House of Lies
description: Explore the House of Lies in this first-person survival horror game. Solve puzzles and scavenge for resources as you use your survival skills to navigate through terrifying environments and enemies to unravel the truth behind the mystery.

title: Violent Selection
description: Is Mr. Venturi just a subject of study, or is he something else? Violent Selection is a bloody top-down shooter where you may find this out by surviving a series of challenging levels from the T.R.A.U.M.A. Unnatural Selection Case Study #9.

title: Van Hellswing
description: In Van Hellswing, we combine explosive movement with a retro look to bring you a shooter straight out of hell! Keep moving to show those leeches not to mess with Van Hellswing!

title: Brave Bubble Heart
description: In Brave Bubble Heart, you'll face strange creatures and solve puzzles while saving as many souls as you can that are lost in the abyss. Your life is your ammunition. Do not die!

title: Mix the Forgotten
description: A narrative puzzle crafting adventure set in a world where everyone and everything is something. Through Mix the Forgotten's surreal adventure you'll befriend everyone you can with the power of crafting and help them find meaning and move on to an unknown destination.

title: Vivian Carmine
description: In an average town somewhere in America, a disturbance has been felt. Vivian Carmine and her badge, Nicholas, have come from the Gap Between Worlds to investigate.

title: Iterazers
description: Battle against enemy AI in a shooter battle! Adjust the parameters through customization and aim for victory with your own ultimate bullet!

title: Nature Escapes 3
description: Nature Escapes 3 is fun, relaxing, and beautiful hidden object game!

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Malaysia
description: Puzzles of Malaysia!
