description: A short visual novel about queer love and art. Follow Maya, a once-celebrated painter now paralyzed, as she struggles to accept her new reality and its effects on her relationship. Argue with your Prefrontal Cortex, insult an art critic, befriend the elderly.

title: Arcane Revolt
description: Arcane Revolt is an action role-playing game with pixel graphics. Lead a revolution as a powerful mage against tyrants in a fantasy medieval world. Customize your spells and make decisions that will benefit your cause in battle. Improve your spells, start the rebellion, and bring down the order!

title: D-World Gate
description: A roguelite game where the player controls the actions and the character automatically attacks. Control the brave with different talents, survive the fight with monsters and enrich their own profession composition, become a master of all profession, defeat the Kings of the undead in this world.

title: Spiritless Ltd.
description: Do you sometimes hear scratching, scraping or rumbling noises? Then you might have a poltergeist in your home. But don’t panic. Spiritless Ltd. is here to help you and expel the ghost from your home.

title: I Commissioned Some Dogs 2
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many dogs and bones as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: The Abandoned Presence
description: The Abandoned Presence is a gritty and challenging Metroidvania set in a world heavily inspired by India's urban heritage and industrial core. Search for answers as Zoe; wield industrial weapons, traverse city skylines, and take on elite enemies to uncover the secrets of The Abandoned Presence.

title: Otherworld Legends: Anibella
description: This content requires the base game Otherworld Legends on Steam in order to play.

title: Kessler Syndrome
description: Alone in orbit with a corpse and no way to reach Earth, play as an astronaut who must keep a defunct space station aloft. Maintain the onboard systems, deal with the constant threat of space junk, and navigate the dark halls in zero-gravity. Day by day more systems fail, and the void draws closer.

title: Metal Ape Demo
description:
Metal Ape is a 2D souls-like metroidvania game where you play as a cyborg exploring a treacherous world filled with deadly enemies and dark secrets. Master brutal combat, wield powerful abilities, and journey deep into the abyss in search of the truth.

This demo later turned into an Oddworld-like platformer with the same name.

title: Run Tank Run
description: Drive your tank, blast everything blocking your way, and rush forward with exhilaration.

title: Delusion Out of Space
description: Delusion Out of Space is an atmospheric first-person science fiction adventure game with an unforgettable story, a unique world, and supernatural alien technologies.

title: WarBots
description: This is a platformer, 2D MOBA game with shooting robots.An 5v5 PvP arena where the goal is to destroy the enemy team's core. You can customize your equipment, which you can acquire by reaching higher levels.While you're dead, you control a small but deadly drone.

title: The Chef's Shift
description: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.

title: Mystery Case Files: The Last Resort
description: A ski resort high in the mountains hides a dark past!

title: Steel Republic: Rail Defender
description: SRRD is a hybrid of Strategy Railroad Logistics, Resource gathering, Base building, and Tower Defense

title: Town of Ancient Tea
description: Live in the town of Ancient Tea and enjoy a Tang Dynasty-style country life—live off the land, handcraft teas, make delicacies like Mapo Tofu. When Yin and Yang are in balance, even the fairies will celebrate traditional Chinese festivals with you! The hidden wonders of Yin-Yang Market is revealing.

title: Gatekeeper: Infinity
description: Prologue version of the game Gatekeeper. Gatekeeper: Infinity is a fast-paced rogue-lite shooter where you'll search for the stolen Heart of the Universe and battle machine enemies! Play solo or join forces with friends in co-op mode.

title: In Freedom Rest Ideal Tomorrows
description: Lead your group of warriors in a unique country (procedurally generated), where looting cities and facing guards is just the beginning. With each victory, increase your power, preparing to face the king and take control of the area. Are you ready to go for the victory?

title: Rich Dad Simulator
description: Run your own chain of markets. Start from a small shop to the biggest business in town. Manage staff, control inventory, set prices, and keep customers happy. Build new locations and expand your retail empire. Can you succeed and become the king of retail?

title: Homicipher
description: Homicipher is an adventure horror game where you’ll decipher a language, fall in love and escape. Players will face various horrifying men in this strange world. Your aim is to decipher their language and eventually find a way to escape. Meanwhile, a peculiar feeling also starts to bloom.

title: Labophobia
description: Labophobia is a 2D horror game where you play as a scientist trying to escape from a laboratory while avoiding a monster. Navigate through 50 rooms with unique mechanics to continue your escape. Face three bosses in a unique horror gaming experience.

title: Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic
description: Join Clicky on a new, enchanted adventure in Hidden Through Time 2: Myths & Magic! Search for hidden objects scattered around hand-drawn worlds, and unlock more as you go. With both a single player campaign and an online mode where you can create your own dreamworld, the adventure never ends!

title: Exclusion
description: One day, the protagonist happens to be on a train that has a train accident. The accident, which made national headlines, set off a chain of tragedies for those who were also present. Who is the victim and who is the perpetrator?

title: The Paper Arcade
description: The Paper Arcade is a collection of classic arcade-style games with a unique drawing and sketchbook aesthetic. Enjoy fast-paced, high-score chasing action, challenging puzzles, and casual games. Each game is brought to life with stunning hand-drawn graphics. Addictive, retro-style gaming fun!

title: Madhouse Madness
description: A journalist decides to explore an abandoned mental hospital with a dark history of housing some of the most notorious patients in history. As the journalist explores, they encounter the unique and terrifying stories of each ghost, driven by their own individual mental illnesses.

title: Nocturia The Game
description: From a child's perspective, we will dare to cross in solitude the dark and vast spaces of a house haunted by an entity of ambivalent intentions that we will discover during our mission: to go to the bathroom in the middle of the night.

title: Rebound Gun
description: "Rebound Gun" is an indie game with shooting and bullet rebound as its main theme. In the game, players will play as the protagonist Hyakka, exploring the imaginative world during sleepless nights.

title: Into Samomor
description: A psychological horror action RPG where everyone can be eliminated and your choices change the entire plot.

title: Chrono Crystal
description: Chrono Crystal is a tower defense game. Spanning across 5 major regions with the Prince and facing numerous challenges, an unprecedented great war is about to break out. Build your towers, upgrade your heroes, and defend your crystal against waves of enemies—until the countdown timer runs out!

title: Alien Boom Boom
description: Join the fight against an alien invasion in this fast-paced, old-school FPS. Battle in your hometown, around the world, and even in space. Take on unique enemies and wield powerful weapons, all with a touch of classic fps sensibility. Can you save humanity from the brink of destruction? Boom boom.

title: Behold Battle
description: Guess which army will win, and watch them fight for your amusement. Behold Battle is a simple auto battler, where you see heroes and monsters fight to the death in randomly generated battles.

title: Own the Throne
description: Own the Throne is an open-world, action-adventure RPG that combines your Nightmares with your ordinary city life. The strong minded will gain special power nightmare use and succeed in the City. Get rich in the city and live with the curse of the Sword by Owning the throne in your Nightmares.

title: Project Bonsai
description: Complete objectives in a fast paced roguelite game, where you must escape the island and find the mysterious Bonsai Tree.

title: Laser Tanks
description: Laser Tanks is a fast-paced Top Down RPG shooter game where you battle hordes of alien monsters and bosses in various environments using advanced weapons and laser tanks. The game features unique monsters, numerous weapons, and different laser tanks to operate.

title: Trepidation
description: An open world looter shooter. Shoot, loot, and defend yourself against others in a post catastrophic mountain environment!

title: Danger is Near
description: Danger is Near - sessional hardcore multiplayer shooter that includes several genres: FPS, survival, weapon and combat simulator, RPG with MMO phenomena. The game will immerse you in a realistic gaming environment imbued with a gloomy post-apocalyptic atmosphere...

title: RC Revolution
description: Get ready for RC Revolution, the remote control racing game with intense action, realistic physics, and a variety of customization options. Compete in real-time PvP races, join tournaments, and climb online leaderboards. Customize your vehicles and create your own tracks. Are you ready to race?

title: Dating Izzie
description: Dating Izzie is a charming adult-only puzzle game that follows the story of Izzie, an intelligent and curious woman with a love for all things geeky.

title: Solo Hunt: Ten Floor
description: Solo Hunt: Ten Floor is a rogue-like action rpg dungeon crawler with ten treacherous levels filled with fearsome monsters, deadly traps, and puzzles to be solved.

title: On the Other Side
description: Take on the role of a modern exorcist in this realistic ghost hunting horror. You have to fulfill contracts related to paranormal phenomena. Your main weapon is an old camera that can shoot what is not visible to the human eye.

title: Deco Deck
description: Deco Deck is a new logic puzzle from the creator of Semantle. Your goal is to link the cards on the board in connected groups of five, such that each group makes a valid "hand".

title: The Last Golden Fox
description: Protect the last golden fox at all costs! Fight against hordes of monsters and prevent them from taking the precious fox through the portal. Be quick and strategic with your slingshot in this epic battle for the survival of the Golden Fox. Will you be able to defend it or will it become extinct?

title: Alnico Smithery
description: Alnico Smithery is a hand-drawn, physics-based forging simulator. Mine for ore, smelt ingots, discover alloys, forge tools, and rebuild the smithery your grandfather left behind.

title: Perfect Dice
description: A card-based roguelike game where all decisions are made through dice rolls. Assemble a deck of special cards and dice, skillfully manipulate randomness, defeat enemies, and find the Perfect Dice to help you regain your free will.

title: Tuttle: Star Flower Harvest
description: Tuttle: Star Flower Harvest: become a space flower farmer, fight off pests, learn new skills, and find out the secrets of the Starflowers! Your actions shape the Galaxies. Dig in now!

title: OnlyUp!
description: Have a fun and remember, the path in this game is only up.

title: Mad Aliens: Seeking the Soul
description: A wacky and humorous 2D platform game that takes you on an intergalactic adventure! Inspired by classic 80's cartoons, this game is sure to delight players of all ages with its charming visuals and original soundtrack.

title: Candlelight: Lament
description: Ed broke the curfew to visit his friends in order to find out the truth of his granddaughter's disappearance, but the truth was far more terrible than he thought.

title: Aniwars
description: Join one of the three warring factions and utilize their unique commanders, units and abilities to dominate the battlefield! Aniwars is a turn-based PvP strategy game with high impact moves and fast-paced gameplay!

title: Clawed Cult
description: Clawed Cult is a roguelite bullet heaven with cute cultist animals invoking their elder god, Catchulhu. Guide them through challenging battles with powerful abilities and strategy to emerge victorious. With intense action and stunning art, it's a must-play for fans of games who love a challenge!

title: Hentai Beach Memories
description: Hentai Beach Memories is a relaxing puzzle game. Flip tiles and find their match to reveal the sexy maid art beneath. 20 beautiful girls are waiting for you.

title: WhiteClothes
description: WhiteClothes is a RPG in which you play cute monsters on their mission to uphold peace!

title: Internull
description: After waking up in the facilities of a once-successful tech company, you must find your way out and uncover the mysteries of Internull with your only tool being a Virtual Reality Headset.

title: Hyper HitBoxing
description: Enter the boxing ring and become a Champion! With strategic bobbing and weaving, you can dodge incoming attacks and land knockout punches that will leave your opponents reeling. Make sure to manage your stamina levels wisely to ensure victory. Are you ready to punch your way to the top?

title: Blue Maiden
description: A slow-burning, psychological horror walking sim set in a haunted Japanese neighborhood.

title: Tamas Awakening
description: Tamas Awakening is a 2D visual novel where you play as a young psychologist who obtains a mysterious power to hypnotize people. You use this power to fuck all the girls around you, especially those who live with you. This game features lots and lots of impregnation and breeding dirty talk.

title: Xon
description: Create and control your own world in Xon, a real-time god game. Use powerful miracles to shape the land, guide your people, and build structures. Play with or against other players to compete for victory and gain points for your accomplishments. Will you be the one to lead your people to glory?

title: SpikerMan X
description: The evil alien lizard Kromatone has returned to try and take over the galaxy! And he’s brought several of his former partners in crime to help him succeed! It’s up to SpikerMan to defeat all the crime bosses and defeat Kromatone himself before he takes over everything!

title: Amber's Tale
description: Embark on a thrilling journey of self-discovery in a world where magic reigns and humanity has crumbled, as you traverse through challenging environments and uncover the truth behind your lost memories in this dynamic metroidvania game.

title: Seonbi: Scholar of Joseon
description: Seonbi: Scholar of Joseon is a side-scrolling action rogue-lite game that features an unnamed scholar who want to correct the chaos in the Joseon Dynasty after the end of the Imjin War.

title: That Potato Game
description: Explore life as a potato and roll your way through the cozy, mystical home of Hilbert. Complete puzzles, gain abilities, and find hidden secrets within!

title: Vampire Memories
description: Introduction: In STG's game, recall one story after another with simple descriptions;

title: Lab.Ar
description: Narrative sci-fi horror quest. Travel to the mysterious research center as a Dr. Robert O`Neil on his mission to reveal old secrets of Howard Deus, the renowned researcher of cancer who died by mystical circumstances.

title: CargoSpace
description: Deliver packages in a world torn by goddesses. Working for Cargon they guarantee your package will arrive no matter what hazards!

title: Zoid Zoid Tetsoidea
description: Zoid Zoid Tetsoidea is a recreation of "Defenders of Tetsoidea", with new and improved visuals. Join Leira and Tens as they fight against a corporation intent on destroying the world by making a commodity out of the sacred "fateholder crystals".

title: Cast Out Colony
description: Cast Out Colony combines roguelite and bullet-heaven action with robust town-building elements. Choose from various characters, fight hordes of foes, and grow your colony, which in return grows your stats, offering a unique twist on the survival genre.

title: Profi Girls
description: We, girls of different professions, are looking for a boss. A boss should be tough but gentle, decisive and firm... Among us there is a brave firefighter, a sweet cook, a dreamy stewardess and others. Keep in mind that we need a real boss whom we would like to obey!

title: Elena's Journal: To Atlantis
description: Discover the lost secrets of Atlantis in this Time Management Adventure!

title: Furry Femboys
description: Furry Femboys... Your dream coming true...

title: Falling Into Dreams
description: Can you uncover the secrets of Dreams?...Platform your way in the wildest nightmares imaginable to the bosses that remind you something about your past...But, to end it all you need to fight with s̷̉ŏ̸̤m̸̖̓ẽ̸̯ṱ̶̓h̴̗͝i̷̻͆ng that has been stuck in your brain for long, long time...

title: Awita: Journey of Hope
description: Awita: journey of hope is side-scroller metroidvania about a girl who saves her village from a terrible epidemic. She has to explore the big dangerous world, meet new friends and enemies and find out the secrets of the kingdom.

title: Foxnox
description: Explore the world as a little fox. Be careful, this adventure will not be easy!

title: HatLand
description: HatLand is a game where you need to see GAME OVER many times to complete a level. But each time, passing further along the inner corridors of the Empire's spaceships, you will become stronger ...

title: Real Nightmares
description: Real Nightmares is a mystery and puzzle game, where the protagonist wakes up in a dream that soon becomes a nightmare, and your goal is to find out what is happening and unravel the protagonist's past, Can you? There are many scenarios that change as the player delights in the history of the game.

title: Goblin Down
description: An adult visual novel with a fantasy, goblin, and NTR/netorare (cheating) theme.

title: Destroy All Zombies
description: Zombies again......

title: Bifröst: Through the Realms
description: Bifröst: Through the Realms is a fast-paced multidimensional platformer with Norse and Sci-Fi themes. Use the power of the Bifröst to save the realms from Ragnarök.

title: Brain Show
description: Compete with your friends in brand new quiz game. Take part in crazy TV Show. Dynamite explosions, sobbing mates, ruined friendships! Sounds like fun? It will be – with Brain Show!

title: Wild Americas
description: Chisel away a destructible landscape gathering minerals to craft bigger and better explosives in search of a priceless geological oddity.

title: Eraser Advent
description: It's a simple little game, but this eraser can drive you crazy. Just give it a try.

title: Crystal of Atlantis
description: Years ago, a visitor from another world foresaw doom for a certain civilization on Earth. To save its people, he gave them a child to be raised among them, hoping his knowledge and insight would be enough to save them from their fate. Play a thrilling Match-3 game and help to save the earth!

title: Danger in Body
description: With vivid and exciting graphics, a pulsating soundtrack, and addictive gameplay, "Danger in Body" is a game that will keep you entertained and hooked for hours on end. You are the last hope of the human body - so get ready to fight for your right to live!

title: Rustil: Eternal Labyrinth Castle
description: In a randomly changing labyrinth castle, Rustil aims for the top floor. An exhilarating roguelike action game in which players aim to reach the top floor while efficiently strengthening the main character by acquiring abilities from the souls of heroes.

title: Explorer: Golden Empire
description: A group of young people form an adventurer team from their hometown, exploring the world while meeting new companions, learning various skills, and ultimately finding the legendary story of the Golden Empire.

title: Pixel Survivor
description: A pixel survivor rogue-lite that will give you a hypnotic addiction! You do all the usual "Survivor" stuff, but this time you'll have to hire a therapist in order to stop playing!

title: As Crônicas de Mar Céu
description: Game inspired by the book "As Crônicas de Mar Céu". It is turn-based, adventure and fantasy, played by different characters in a vast world with magic, wars and animations. It has from its comic and humorous side, to its more serious and emotional side. A game made for everyone!

title: Life Saver
description: Earth is on the verge of World War 3. All life as we know it will be gone tomorrow. Take control of "Super Star Dan" to build a super SSD that can store every DNA on earth before the world goes up in flames. "Life Saver" is a twin stick shooter that you don't want to miss out on!

title: Rainbow Rendezvous
description: Rainbow Rendezvous is a delightful and colorful cartoon-style endless runner game

title: Wings of Angels
description: Fun, romance, drama, and sexy moments with the beautiful babes of "Wings of Angels", a science fiction Visual Novel featuring some of the hottest co-pilots you'll ever fly with.

title: Squid Grid
description: A squid-squirting, tentacle-bending puzzle game in a steampunk ocean.

title: Bullet Time Battle
description: Bullet Time Battle is a FPS that adds precision to combat against enemy forces with bullet time. Experience an explosive gameplay as you plant/defuse bomb or capture/defend flags while battling enemies. Are you ready?

title: Idle Catfarmia
description: Help the cat fairies to arrange resources, produce and harvest crops, and manage the farm. The more efficiently the farm grows, the richer your pockets become. Show some clicking skills to unwelcome visitors who occasionally appear on the farm.

title: D.O.R.F. Real-Time Strategic Conflict
description: Take command of one of three unique factions and conquer your enemies in a twisted vision of the future. Construct sprawling bases, scour the land for resources to mine and refine, and assemble powerful armies of land, air and sea units to smash your adversaries with.

title: Ignistone
description: Ignistone is a roguelike game in which players must devise a combination of weapons and amulets to progress through a dungeon. Whether you prefer attack power, durability, or special moves, find the combination that suits you best.

title: Gladiators Tale
description: Welcome to the brutal world of Gladiator's Tale, where you must fight tooth and nail to earn your freedom. In this immersive game, you'll encounter a wide range of characters - some will become your allies, while others will try to sabotage you. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Adventures of Ben: Rabbit Run
description: World of Valentardia will not let you get bored for a second! Adventures will require the hero to be not only determined but also to be faithfully accepted.

title: The Tenants: Pets
description: Experience the joy of bringing people and pets together in this delightful expansion for The Tenants. Build your property empire with a pet-friendly approach, and watch your business thrive as you satisfy animal lovers in Wondersville!

title: Cabin Rush
description: Explore and gather resources to build traps, towers, and walls to protect your cabin from increasingly difficult waves of monsters.

title: Castlewatch
description: Castlewatch is a classical Tower Defense Game

title: The Moonflower
description: The Moonflower is a cooperative horror-survival video game the game is set in an abandoned forest island, where there is the known demon "Moonflower" and the players will have to block it as much as possible / hunt it via an underground laboratory.

title: NeverHome: Hall of Apathy
description: Use your wits to solve puzzles and escape from an abstract world in this hand-drawn atmospheric horror game

title: Mort's Dream Jump
description: Join Mort in a dreamlike adventure through challenging levels, using a variety of movement-based powerups to help him overcome each obstacle!

title: Unfortunate Tales of Violet
description: Help the incompetent witch Violet save her homeland in this unfortunate, fast-paced, action adventure title. Draw runes to orchestrate your magic, expand your arsenal of spells, and travel a strange land full of whimsical characters. Oh and also don't mind the owl's jokes, he's always like this.

title: Argumentum Ad Culpam
description: Argumentum Ad Culpam is a gothic visual novel about the world of eternal agony. Capricious dance of principles and death. Take part in twisted battles of wits where morality is only an instrument to survive and decide what future that world will have.

title: Hungry Adventurer
description: Help hungry ninjas survive their starvation and face various enemies in this foodnastic platformer! Are you ready to collect some food? Be careful food is very addictive!

title: Infested Lands
description: Infested Lands is an addictive game that takes players to a dangerous world where monsters rule. The player takes on the role of a military man who has been sent to a territory known as the "Infested Lands"

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 2 - Episode 04
description: Season 2 Episode 4: Carcaptors! Mini, having spent all night pacing the streets of Hella City, embarks on a half-baked while half-asleep plan for revenge.

title: Materialization of Memories
description: Materialization of Memories is a Survival Horror game where you can never be sure you are in control of the situation. The materialisation zone has many surprises in store for you.

title: Inferno Quest: Journey Through the Lava Cavern
description: Inferno Quest is an old-school single-player action-style obstacle/puzzle game. Can your drone make it through the four levels of the lava caves and make it to the Tomb Shade to bargain for your freedom?

title: Dolven
description:
Dolven is a fantasy turn-based strategy RPG with a deep card-based battle system. Following the events of The Necromancer’s scourge upon the northern townsfolk, guide a band of mercenaries through the Decaying Isles in order to rid the land of evil. Use the Pillars to create a variety of combos to earn mana and gain advantage over the recent evil plaguing the land of Dolven.

Card battles include hand-to-hand combat, where the cards provide characters with additional skills. The Pillars allow you to create various hand combinations that range from matching cards and suits, playing a pivotal role in your quest to accumulate more Mana, Gear, Cards, Skills and even exerting influence over the game's environment. Strategic planning is of utmost importance.

title: Nine-Tailed Okitsune Tale
description: Fluffy x Kawaii! A Japanese-style action RPG where the character changes into various forms to solve anomalies that occur in the capital!

title: Rise of Jericho
description: Lead hunter-gatherers and give rise to human civilization in Jericho, the oldest city in the world. Gather resources, craft tools and build structures to protect villagers and make your city thrive.

title: Cyber Strider
description: Blast your enemies! Create the ultimate build! Travel to the edge of space, in this epic rogue-lite action packed bundle of chaos inspired by slay the spire & FTL.

title: Mystic Mischief
description: Fly as Mammon the chaotic thieving bird as he attempts to achieve the biggest heist of his life. Poop, caw, and steal your way through his adventures. Avoid the dangerous dragons as they try to keep you from stealing their treasures.

title: Ants in Space!
description: Create new, unique species of Space Ants and repel much stronger invaders! Explore vast procedurally generated micro-universes, conquer planets, and mess with nature itself in this mix of Roguelike and Strategy.

title: Bike Offroad Simulator
description: The Bike Offroad Simulator is a racing-simulation game that puts you to the test again.

title: Polygeddon: Survive
description: You are on an island where everyone wants to kill you, ranging from weather conditions to dangerous enemies, your goal is to survive. Survive alone or together. Build, craft, grow, explore, fight!

title: Aliens Tower Defense
description: Sometimes it's better to prevent something that might happen...

title: Gaia Trek
description: In "Gaia Trek", you will play as Gaia, the shattered will of a planet, and command your spaceship to explore new worlds, collect and refine various resources, build a home on the damaged spacecraft, summon a wide range of monsters, and ultimately, devour other shattered wills to repair yourself.

title: Lunar Legacy
description: Romantic Visual Novel. Unjustly accused of a terrible crime, Soyeon finds herself in the Kingdom of Spirits. How will she survive in a strange and incomprehensible world? How much can one trust the suspiciously friendly spirits?

title: Spriters, Hopes Blooming Dawn
description: Spriters: Hopes Blooming Dawn is an RPG-style game that takes you on an epic adventure through a world filled with magic, mystery, and danger. Battle dangerous creatures, collect Gems with unique powers, and uncover the mysteries of your past in this engaging and innovative game.

title: Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors
description: Youkai have overrun Gensokyo! There's no resolving this incident, just try to survive! Touhou: Gensokyo Survivors is the latest take on the survivor genre, this time with the unique twist of a grid-based inventory system. Hoard as many items as possible if you want to survive!

title: Time Limit Harvest
description: This is a farming game where you compete to see how much money you can make within a time limit. You can get seeds and videos for each level.

title: Year 500
description: Year 500 is a third-person, hack-n-slash adventure game featuring swordplay, magic casting, and an engaging story set in a fantasy world. Reclaim your memory, oppose and defeat evil, and save the kingdom by any means necessary.

title: Medieval Simulators: Baker
description: A relaxing simulator for lovers of the Middle Ages and nature. You take on the role of a medieval baker who has to earn coins, improve his own farm, harvest wheat, grind grain, chop wood and bake...

title: Our Life: Beginnings & Always - Baxter's Story
description: Enjoy exciting summer days in the company of Baxter Ward during Steps 3 and 4! This is an optional DLC for the free game Our Life: Beginnings & Always.

title: Wayward Rose
description: An indie thriller that will test your navigational skills as you find your way out of darkness and into light.

title: Nifa's First Mission
description: Nifa is a young elven knight. While out patrolling, her village is attacked by orcs, leaving her the only knight still in fighting shape. To make matters worse, the brutish orcs took a great number of prisoners, including the elven princess! Fight and platform your way through a variety of stages filled with dangerous foes of all kinds. Use your sword to challenge them directly or your bow to snipe them from afar.

title: Sausage Wars: Deadly Levels
description:
Trigger the trapdoors and watch the suckers fall into the toxic soup!
Wait for the right moment, push the sausage homies in the fire and watch them cook well!
Escape from imminent death, find the safe spot and push other sausages into the laser beam!

With this DLC pack you will get access to 3 new stages in each local multiplayer mode.

description:
Complete Edition includes:
- base game with 150 deadly levels, over 80 jucy skins and tasty powerups,
- three new skins: Fly, Cockroach and Plucked Chicken,
- extra 15,000 coins to spend on outfits, powerups, or whatever.

title: Sausage Wars: Trapdoor Hell
description:
Battle other sausages on a new, unstable ground. Trigger the trapdoors and watch the suckers fall into the toxic soup!
With this DLC you will get access to a new Trapdoor stage in each local multiplayer mode.

title: Sausage Wars: Laser Massacre
description:
This is no place to make friends. Escape from imminent death, find the safe spot and push other sausages into the deadly beam!
With this DLC you will get access to a new Laser stage in each local multiplayer mode.

title: Mines of Moria
description: Choose one of six playable classes with a randomly selected race. New players are recommended to play as a Warrior.

title: I Commissioned Some Mice
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many mice and cheese as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Savage Turret
description: Tactical turret placing game with gore, gardening and massive battles. You build the routes for the enemies to facilitate that sweet killzone. And take a break to do some gardening afterwards. Plant on!

title: Fortress of the Undead
description: "Fortress of the Undead" is an intense zombie survival game. Scavenge for weapons and ammo, fight off hundreds or thousands of zombies with up to 4 players, and try to survive as long as possible.

title: Highland Panic
description: Highland Panic is a fast-paced, Scottish/Highland-themed card game with solitaire mechanics for 2-4 players. Race to be the first player to play all the cards from you "panic" pile to the common "clan" piles. It's a thrilling game of strategy and skill, perfect for game nights and parties.

title: Therapy Simulator 2023
description: Top-down fast paced game. Find the right person, make the therapist happy

title: The Hero's Way
description: Get ready for battle, hero! Your bravery and strength will be a bulwark in this world of the risen dead, and you will defeat them all!

title: Enemies Defender
description: Attention, attention! Enemies are approaching.

title: Mai and the Legendary Treasure
description: Mai finds a hidden map that brings her to another world. With some newfound friends, Mai sets off to hunt for the legendary treasure! But with rivals in her way, will she finally get her hands on the legendary treasure...?

title: Nightmare: Worlds Collide
description: Nightmare: Worlds Collide is a unique horror experience that follows Jessica Redford as she recalls her memories after a horrific event causes her to lose touch with reality. Throughout the experience you will be unravelling the mystery as she tries to escape her dark inner secrets.

title: Munchy Mammals
description: A puzzle game where you move herbivores and carnivores on a grid to fulfill multiple animal requirements using moving, biting, eating and more.

title: Highrise Guardian
description: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is an Arena FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, dominate your enemies with map control, and make an art-like battle style to become the Anime gunslinger.

title: Castle of Blackwater
description: Castle of Blackwater is a multiplayer social deduction game where 10 players navigate a magical 2D castle while completing tasks and uncovering hidden allegiances. Players are assigned to three different factions, each equipped with unique abilities that support their role in the game. While alive, participants use various tools to gather information and identify threats, while eliminated players can influence the outcome by collecting souls to purchase power-ups for their team. Through alliance-building, deception, and strategic ability usage, players work to ensure their faction's survival and ultimate control of the castle.

title: Save King
description: Carefully adjust the force so that the princess does not fall down from the maze to reach the 11th floor. Traps installed throughout the maze interfere with the princess, so it is easy to go to the beginning floor if you do something wrong.

title: Eclectic Expansion Enterprise
description: Expand among the stars! It is 72k years in the future, and a new wave of Human expansion abounds. Join the ranks of the Ecxos, prep star systems for habitation, and develop your tools and ships to enterprise ever faster and further.

description: Aphelion Headhunters is a Third-Person PVE Hero Shooter featuring two unique player characters, each with their own distinct playstyle, abilities and suite of selectable upgrades.

title: Pigblue
description: A stranger arrives at a quiet and isolated town... Pigblue.

title: Disco Elysium: The Final Cut - Collage Mode
description: Collage Mode is a creative screenshot and scene-building mode for Disco Elysium. It allows players to place characters in locations from Martinaise, adjust their poses, add custom dialogue, apply visual filters and weather effects, and decorate scenes with items, clothing stickers, and frames. The mode also includes hidden scenes related to Martinaise’s history and additional narration from the game’s narrator.

title: Meet Your Maker: Scorched Necropolis
description: Meet Your Maker's Scorched Necropolis Collection invites players to build and raid Outposts worthy of the Pharaohs themselves. Use ancient-Egyptian-inspired blocks, props, weapons, and Custodian Suits to create and infiltrate monumental tombs unlike any in the wasteland.

title: Infernax: Deux or Die
description:
The update will bring a new playable character into the fray: Cervul the Squire, a well-rounded lad who sports deadly talents in both axe throwing and tool-assisted combat.

It also incorporates co-op play in Infernax‘s fan-favorite gun mode, perfect for players keen on wielding maximum firepower against the game’s monstrous beasts.

title: Arrow War
description:
Collect, Upgrade, Dominate
Defend your castle from endless enemies

title: Kounai Shasei Vol.1: Yonimo H na Monogatari
description: "Kounai Shasei 1" opens with a text introduction that describes a miraculous Girls' High School that can be accessed by sailing through the Indian Ocean or walking along the Silk Road - a school that even the famous Marco Polo allegedly describes in his memoirs. This establishes the humorous tone of subsequent narrative, which has little to do with history and a lot to do with pretty high school girls. The game has no real story, being instead composed of five unrelated vignettes, short episodes that feature a sexy high school girl, a male protagonist (named "God" by default), and various comical and erotic situations under different circumstances: meeting in a school, haunted house, crowded train station, etc.

title: VT Harmony
description: Play as VT a lonely TV-boy that want to be alone until the unexpected message from an stranger bunny named IV. Discover the different endings of this visual novel game.

title: The Witch of Sherdorne Forest
description: The Lord's son has vanished and you decide to venture out in search of the boy.

title: Mushroom Mountain
description: Mushroom Mountain is a puzzle game for the PICO-8 console where players plant, destroy, grow, and spread mushrooms to control doors along a branching mountain trail.

title: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Song for Prism
description: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Song for Prism is a free-to-play rhythm game based on The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors.

title: Cube Experimental
description: Cube Experimental is a single player modification for Fallout 3, set in a long deserted, underground scientific facility right below the post-nuclear Washington D.C.

title: Chef Ramsay
description:
Gordon Ramsay likes you very much. You are his top chef and you never disappoint.

But do you have what it takes to be a master chef? I certainly doubt it! Complete objectives to try and impress him. Who knows? You may even make it out alive.

title: Across The Void
description: Across The Void is an exciting new roguelike video game that will take you on a journey through a universe of endless possibilities. Featuring randomly generated maps and side maps, the game offers a new adventure every time you play. With a unique skill system, players can create their own playstyle by investing in three different trees, each with its own set of skills tailored to different playstyles. With over 50 skills to unlock, you can customize your character to your liking and take on the universe on your own terms.

title: Salthe
description:
“Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.”

At the end of a journey of blood, despair, regret, and madness— a stage perched on the razor's edge dividing life and death. With no audience to cheer, at a jester's direction, Salthe performs her past. To learn the reason for her death. To return to the world of life.

Each scene is full of scorn and mockery, she writhes and struggles, through to the end
of the tale of Salthe's life—a comedy——

title: Shooting Survival
description: This is the 2d shooting game with building and crafting that features extremely easy play styles. Its super cool and enjoyable gameplay, mixed with rogue-like, crafting, and farming elements will get you hooked from the very first shooting run!

title: Cards, Universe & Everything
description: Cards, the Universe and Everything (CUE) is the ultimate CCG where you collect and trade thousands of cards and battle them in epic games.

title: Miner Gun Builder
description: You are the captain of a space ship and fly through missions to earn money. With the money you can buy parts to build your weapon in your space ship. You can also buy bigger and better ships which can fit more parts. Building a small weapon is straight forward, but later you can build extremely strong weapons if you use the available space wisely.

title: Idle Dice 2
description:
The sequel for Idle Dice is here!
Idle Dice 2 expands on the gameplay of its predecessor and adds more things

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.1 Onikakushi-hen
description: On a certain day in June, someone dies, and someone else goes missing. The series of deaths is connected to the upheaval surrounding the dam construction project. A murder case that was covered up is being reenacted. Is it a conspiracy? A coincidence? Or perhaps a curse?

title: Kemono Friends: Kingdom
description: Welcome to "Kingdom", an abandoned large-scale theme park where you will meet a diverse cast of animal friends and embark on a miraculous adventure with them. But beware of the azure monsters scattered throughout the Kingdom! With the help of your animal friends' unique characteristics and the landform organs' mechanisms, you can overcome these mysterious enemies and save the Kingdom together.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.2 Watanagashi-hen
description: Keiichi wins a game tournament and gives his prize, a doll, to Rena stating that Mion will not be interested in such girly things, though Mion is actually rather hurt that Keiichi thinks about her that way, though she pretends not to mind.

title: The Jungle Book
description:
IBM produced FMV game starring uncredited chimpanzee and Gary Schwartz.

Deep within India's Black Jungle, a scandalous crime has taken place. Someone has stolen the jeweled crown of King Louie, the orangutan who rules Monkey City. Now he's hoppin' mad and there will be no peace until his crown is returned. Mowgli and his friends are counting on you to help recover this sacred treasure and restore calm to the jungle world.

title: F1 23: Champions Edition
description: F1 23 Champions Edition and receive 3 days Early Access, Max Verstappen designed racing in-game items, 4 New My Team Racing Icons, 4 Braking Point 2 My Team Icons and much more!

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.3 Tatarigoroshi-hen
description: Satoko's uncle Teppei returns to Hinamizawa to take custody of Satoko and resume an abusive relationship with her, where he treats her like a slave while demanding money from her. Keiichi cannot accept this stalemate, and he makes it his personal mission to rescue Satoko.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.4 Himatsubushi-hen
description: Akasaka Mamoru, a detective is sent to Hinamizawa to rescue Inukai Toshiki, the grandson of a government official, who is taken hostage. While waiting for Makino, he meets a younger Furude Rika at the bus stop.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.5 Meakashi-hen
description: Sonozaki Shion escapes from her private school to return to Hinamizawa. During her time there, she meets Satoshi, who protected her from a group of thugs.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.6 Tsumihoroboshi-hen
description: Is the curse really real? This chapter presents the events from another view, which reveals additional information about Rena's past and Keiichi's reasons for moving to Hinamizawa from Tokyo.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.7 Minagoroshi-hen
description: Furude Rika is in an altered state of reality. Around her, various prisms float and circulate her. As she examines them, she mentions that they are "fragments" from the various Junes of 1983.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Ch.8 Matsuribayashi-hen
description: The final arc in the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Kai series. It is mostly told from the viewpoint of Rika Furude, as well as her other friends.

title: Randal's Tuesday
description: Everything begins on a Wednesday, early in the morning. Our three protagonists are testifying in front of the Student Council leaded by no other than the Dean himself. They have been accused of committing a horrendous act (players don’t know about it just yet) and this is the only chance they have to try and clean their names.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei
description: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei is a collection of short stories that features the characters of the previous chapters.

title: D.W.'s Nightmare
description: D.W. 's Nightmare is a short horror game in which you are playing as D.W. Read. Your doll has been cursed. It's up to you to survive 3 minutes by constantly finding where the doll spawns. Don't get too comfortable. If you take too long, the doll will kill you. Will you step up to the challenge or be the doll's first victim?

title: Soak 'Em Out
description: Soak ‘Em Out is an endless score attack game that takes heavy influence from the Game & Watch Gallery series. You play as Tina, a cat trying to catch a bus that unfortunately is taking an unusually long time to arrive. To make matters worse, a big storm is brewing! With no true shelter nearby and only an umbrella to take cover with, how long are you able to delay the inevitable before getting soaked out?

title: Nazi Zombies: Portable
description:
A Call of Duty: Zombies "de-make" made in the 1996 Quake engine, in development since 2009.

The game itself is feature-equivalent with Call of Duty: World at War on a generic level. Gameplay components are implemented with minor parity differences. Most World at War maps and their unique features are not yet represented. Various small additions and changes from Call of Duty: Black Ops are present as a means of gameplay smoothing, but not on a wide scale. NZ:P is, first and foremost, a Call of Duty: World at War remake.

title: The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness
description:
Deep underground, nestled in the remains of a post-apocalyptic American South, rests a cryogenic facility called Intermine Laboratories. In this miniscule piece of frost-stricken hell rests a collective of eclectic individuals who are inexplicably awoken from their restless dreams long before their assigned time.

But, the facility has changed in the time since they've gone to sleep. It's become a fascistic nightmare in the wake of a gruesome civil war, and everywhere they go ... it feels like they're being watched. To add insult to injury, some of them have started acting ... funny ...

title: Teacher Certification Hell
description: This producer wants you to study on Steam again!! This is a game about Teacher Certification Knowledge. Depending on your strategy (ability), choose the right item at the beginning, and then use the answer to break through each Layers! After 100 layers, waiting for you may be......

title: Eddie's Arcade
description: Uniquely satisfying puzzle game spread out over different graphical themes. The puzzles get harder as you advance, giving you the pleasing sense of accomplishment. Collect arcade tokens to unlock new machines. Over 125 levels for hours of play.

title: Not In My Cave
description: Defend Yourself! Not in my cave is the last line of defense to protect your magical spells from unrelenting attacks from the undead and goblin hordes. In this action based tower defense style game protect your spell books from being looted and leaving yourself defenseless!

title: Eliminator: The Encapsuled Nemesis
description: Eliminator: The Encapsuled Nemesis is an tactical single-player shooter for everyone. Sneak to hostile fortifications, destroy your foes, capture flags, collect new weapons and fight your way through enemy lines to crush their evil plans.

title: Neon Fantasy: Animals
description: Neon Fantasy: Animals is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Space Spectacular
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Space themed tables that will take you on a journey through time!

title: Spooky Men
description: Spooky Men is a online 2-4 player cooperative survival-horror game. Retrieve forgotten items and complete tasks while avoiding a ghost. Use your wits to distract the ghost and survive its attacks as you explore the spooky house. Can you and your friends make it out alive?

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 15
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 20 art pieces to choose from, and 2000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Ash of Gods: The Way - Deluxe Edition
description: Get the turn-based story-driven tactical card game with hand crafted battles, plus digital extras including soundtrack and art book!

title: Damn Zombies
description: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus

title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
description: Welcome to Japan, the drift capital of the world! Compete, drift, and race on miles of varied roads and winding mountain trails. Drive through towns nestled at the scenic Haikama Lake. Spend your savings on new cars and get a taste of Japanese tuning style.

title: Tuk Tuk Race
description: "Tuk Tuk Race" is a game in which you race in a tuk-tuk. Ride a tuk-tuk and try to win the race! Let's drive in the nature of beautiful graphics in a tuk-tuk. Now, please enjoy this funny racing game.

title: Everholm
description: Lilly was spirited away to a mysterious island. As her memories fade, everyone seems to know about her quest for her missing sister. It's time to establish a homestead, meet the islanders, learn their secrets and solve the mystery of Everholm in this open-ended minimalist RPG!

title: Kao the Kangaroo: Anniversary Edition
description: A year after the world premiere of the newest adventures of Kao the Kangaroo, the Anniversary Edition is finally here!

title: Railway Empire 2: Deluxe Edition
description: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the full Railway Empire 2 game, the original soundtrack, exclusive skins for each of the three sizes of your railway stations, an exclusive skin for your company HQ, and an exclusive skin for two locomotives.

title: Sphere 3
description: Some roads lead to salvation, others - to eternal damnation. What will you choose?

title: I Swear this Hentai Game was a Gift
description: A relaxing puzzle game with cute anime girls. You didn't buy this game; it was a gift. We believe you.

title: Married Woman Cosplay Life
description: Masataka and Misuzu are newlyweds. Masataka proposes costume play sex for Misuzu, who is new to sex, and Misuzu gradually learns to enjoy it.

title: The Voyager
description: After working all your life you have finally managed to build a device that allows you to travel between parallel worlds. will you be able to return home?

title: Goonya Monster: Additional Character (Buster) - Orca
description: Additional Character for "Goonya Monster". Purchasing this item adds the following Buster as a character that can be used in gameplay. - Orca (Buster)

title: Goonya Monster: Additional Character (Buster) - Anemone
description: Additional Character for "Goonya Monster". Purchasing this item adds the following Buster as a character that can be used in gameplay. - Anemone (Buster)

title: Xenosis
description: Xenosis is a thrilling metroidvania where you traverse an ancient temple that has been overrun by alien creatures. Armed with your blaster, you must combat a variety of challenging enemies and upgrade your weapon to escape

title: Zombie Dead Smasher
description: Grab your gun and get ready to defeat the hideous zombies in this thrilling game.

title: Stroke The Beaver
description:
Beavers are interesting creatures, they are both wet and furry, due to being in the water so much. Many of us have never stroked one before, but now if your chance to touch one for the first time.

Well, you can't really touch one, but you can at least make it look like you have a beaver in your very own home.

title: Arcade Archives: Tecmo Knight
description: Kick the beastman away!

title: He@rtstrings
description: When your red string of fate connects to three guys, what will you do?

title: Bomber-Mario
description:
The classic Nintendo game meets bombs and castles in this fun Mario adventure.

This is a strategy game compared to the original Mario versions that you have likely played or seen. The goal of the game is to blow up the enemies that you see in each level. As Mario, you have access to several types of bombs. You can upgrade your bombs in the game as you gain experience. You'll start with smaller bombs that are used for the mediocre enemies before seeing the larger bombs that are meant to do significant damage to the larger enemies, especially those that come toward the end of the game.

title: Criminal Archives: Alphabetic Murders DLC
description: Are the murders of three different people connected? Or are we dealing with three different incidents? Cunning and logic are your best weapons in solving this case!

title: Blobi Sprint
description: One button fast tapping game for 2-4 players. Tap the button as fast as you can to stay on screen and win!

title: Half-Life: Pulse
description:
Pulse is a MOD for Half-Life 1. Pulse takes place in Black Mesa after the incident. You are famous scientist Gordon Freeman. In the beginning of Pulse, you are in Surface Lab A Security Complex, a lab and security station on the absolute surface of the Black Mesa Research Facility. You are working with your scientist pals when one scientist working with a hazardous radiation meter detects high radiation amounts coming from all over. They radio into the Administrator's office, the office of Dr. Wallace Breen. Instead of Breen answering, they pick up a remote conversation between Breen and an unknown voice. "It's done," Breen said. "The Xenian crystal triggered a dimensional rift between Earth and the boarderworld Xen. Now let's get to the surface!" "I'm sure my employers will be pleased," says the unknown voice, and then silence fills the room followed by an explosion. The other scientists are amazed that the Administrator of Black Mesa himself would work with someone to trigger such a disaster and are trying to turn Breen in to the Special Projects Executive, the overseers of the Black Mesa Research Facility. The only way to get the S.P.E. to believe them is to get Dr. Breen's special operations profile from his office and hand it over to the S.P.E. as evidence. The scientists, however, are terrified of entering Black Mesa after a resonance cascade saying it is too dangerous. Gordon Freeman volunteers to go into Black Mesa, retrieve Breen's Administrative profile and bring him to justice.

This MOD suggests that Gina Cross was the one to push the xenian crystal into the anti-mass spectrometer and Gordon was not near Sector C at the time. Surface Lab A Security Complex is located on the surface of Sector D.

The scientists detect that Breen's Administrative profile is located in the Lambda Complex so your goal as Gordon Freeman is to get the Lambda Complex and retrieve Breen's profile and make it back to Surface Lab A alive.

title: Public Enemy: The Dark Future
description:
Public Enemy: The Dark Future is a story-focused sci-fi multiplayer Half-Life modification.

Two teams (The Security Corps and the Syndicate) play the basic role in this game and they will fight against each other in front of this futuristic scenery.

The visual aspects, gameplay features and the design offer you new and interesting possibilities to explore the whole world of Public-Enemy.

title: Loop Hero: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- The physical Nintendo Switch game
- An exclusive 104-page “Loop Hero Bestiary” Artbook
- The game´s Official Soundtrack download voucher
- A Collectible tuck-in box housing all the contents.

title: Pretty Princess: Magical Garden Island
description:
Create the farm of your dreams!

Cultivate crops and raise livestock while exploring the island to collect resources and create goods in this fun fantasy farming simulation game where you are free to play as you like. Set in a cute European fantasy world, this next installment to the Pretty Princess series will delight all princesses – young or young at heart.

The residents of your magical island are depending on you to keep them thriving and content. Roam the island to collect ingredients and materials to craft the goods they need. Back on your farm, plant seeds to raise crops that will grow over time, and collect milk and eggs from your animals. Use the money and goodwill you earn from your hard work to decorate the island and make it your perfectly cute fantasy home.

title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon - Launch Edition
description: In Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon, players will assemble their mech from a wide variety of parts and weaponry to soar freely through mission locales that redefine three-dimensional mobility. Face down overwhelming opposition by outgunning and overrunning your enemies with dynamic movement that makes full use of ranged and melee combat. Players can experience frenetic and fast-paced action that can only be truly achieved with mechs.

title: Mon-Yu: Defeat Monsters And Gain Strong Weapons And Armor. You May Be Defeated, But Don’t Give Up. Become Stronger. I Believe There Will Be A Day When The Heroes Defeat The Devil King.
description: A first-person, turn-based dungeon crawler from Experience Inc. in the tradition of the original Wizardry. Create your own characters to defeat the seven demon kings. Form your team, clear the dungeons, defeat the monsters, and claim victory.

title: Scientist Hunt
description: Scientist Hunt is a Half-Life modification which makes murdering scientists the objective of the game. There are two teams, and each team must compete to murder more scientists than the other team in one of three separate modes of play. SH also features two non-team-based modes of play with entirely different player scenarios, named Live In Fear and Madness. New features include enhanced scientist physics, completely new scientist AI, and much more.

title: Half-Life: Mission of Mercy
description: It seems the G-Man and his government forces cannot keep Xen under their control. We all know how the government responds to something it can't be in charge of....blow it up ! Here's where you come in. The aliens, recognizing your impressive abilities, turn to you for help. If anyone can beat the G-Man at his own game it's you, and the aliens know this to be true. So begins your mission of mercy to save the alien world...... Hiding in the back of a big-rig, you slip into the compound. The science team has prepared the way for you, and Barney will help you when necessary. Not all areas are under heavy guard, but watch your back! Prepare to take on the G-Man's best troops.

title: Citizen Conflict
description: Citizen Conflict is a free-to-play hero shooter designed to merge the best of both worlds - to deliver the competitive heat symptomatic of the esports game modes as well as the Battle Royale frenzy to the masses. The game doesn’t fall short on an immersive storyline, which finds three antagonistic syndicates and captivating heroes waging an endless war for dominance. To scale its futuristic dystopian design to the top, Citizen Conflict will brim over with tons of futuristic maps, guns, and uncanny equipment. Citizen Conflict is now available on Epic Store.

title: Grace Online
description: Grace Online is a captivating 3D fantasy MMORPG (massively-multiplayer online role-playing game) that offers players an immersive experience, allowing them to explore a rich, expansive world filled with secrets and unique creatures. In Grace Online, we believe in player autonomy, which means we guide you through the basics, but there's no hand-holding beyond that. As a result, countless hidden treasures and mysteries await your discovery.

title: Senran Kagura Burst Re:Newal - Yumi Character and Campaign
description:
This Downloadable Content Senran Kagura Burst Re:Newal contains:

Yumi as a new playable character, a mission pack (Exclusive “Ice Queen” Prequel Campaign - 10 Missions), 2 new costumes, multiple accessories and lingerie, 3D diorama scenery, pics, BGMs, new visuals and voices + 2 secret files.

title: Morbid Catastrophe
description: A game based on a recurring nightmare.

title: EvoGene
description: EvoGene is a 3D Hack and Slash game where you need to survive against powerful creatures.

title: Senran Kagura Burst Re:Newal - Miyabi Character and Campaign
description:
This Downloadable Content Contains:
A new playable character (Miyabi), A mission pack (Exclusive “Abyssal” Prequel Campaign - 10 Missions), New hairstyles & outfits, 2D + 3D diorama scenery, pics, BGMs, visuals, voices + 2 new top secret files.

title: Times & Galaxy
description: Embark on an interplanetary adventure as the first robo reporter for the Times & Galaxy, the solar system's most trusted holopaper. You're just an intern, but if you can get the scoop, write great stories, and impress your colleagues, maybe you'll get to keep your job!

title: Dying Light: Enhanced Edition
description: Dying Light: Enhanced Edition is all you need to start your adventure in the post-apocalyptic world ruled by zombies. Featuring an expansion with the buggy—your new ride, an additional game mode, two extra quarantine zones, and two bundles.

title: 1B Spells
description: 1000000000 Spells is an Arena Survival game where you fight off hordes of enemies by making your own spells on the go, using a complex and intricate programming-adjacent system. No more leveling up fireball from level 7 to level 8! Magic should be expressive, free, intense and chaotic.

title: Talents
description: Write your way to success with your talented yet rowdy co-founders in this game development-themed romance visual novel! Do you have what it takes?

title: Bat Blitz
description: Bat Blitz is a top down arcade shooter where you shoot bats to get gold to buy upgrades to kill more bats.

title: Goldheart
description:
A small bullet-hell type game.

The greedy mage Lavka steals a mythical golden sphere from the village and it's up to the villager Skully to retrieve it by directing a wandering spirit's powers.

title: Just Keep Running
description: Just Keep Running is a parkour puzzle-platformer that combines freerunning with quick puzzles and problem-solving. Gameplay is said to be inspired by Mirror's Edge, Portal and Ultrakill, with voxel graphics inspired by Teardown, The Touryst, and Cloudpunk.

title: Hexa Puzzle Saga
description: Help your kingdom survive crises, and grow your wealth through managing your ruler's powers and solving hex puzzles.

title: Deadblast
description: Arrange the warriors correctly to defeat the enemy!

title: Absurdika
description: It's time for you to overcome the fear of conflicts. Every time someone blamed you you stood quiet and kept your anger inside. The demon you are about to face impersonates this fear.

title: Mercury
description: Mercury is postmodern sci-fi first-person shooter set in the year 2052 where you take the role of Mercury agent of the Special Operations Command Center undergoing tremendous missions in an effort to stop the development of a super weapon by the Soviets.

title: Welcome To... Chichester OVN: Omnibus Edition
description: Welcome To... Chichester OVN: Omnibus Edition contains OVN 1, 2 and 3 in one program, with updated in-game GUI, full stops added and slight story enhancements.

title: Slyme Breaker
description: Slyme Breaker is the RPG that hates the genre. SLYME BREAKER has a focus on proactive combat, involved exploration, and meaningful deconstruction of RPG standards. Play as the bandit Gryme after his attack on a lowly Slime monster for some XP goes wrong and he is devoured by the Slime!

title: Detectives United: Origins - Collector's Edition
description: Join Mystery Trackers' Agent Brown, Haunted Hotel's James Blackthorne, and Grim Tales' Anna Gray as they join forces to stop The Collector's evil scheme.

title: Super Mega Baseball 4: Ballpark Edition
description: Super Mega Baseball 4 is where the Legends play. The signature mix of arcade-inspired style and immersive gameplay returns with 200+ baseball Legends and a grand slam of presentation upgrades.

title: Truck Climb Racing
description: This is no place for the weak. Only true truck drivers manage to overcome their limits in the most adverse conditions on roads that defy physics and their skills.

description: This cute little disaster is bursting with big fun and challenge

This Downloadable Content Contains:
4 new playable characters (Murakumo, Yozakura, Shiki, Minori) and new outfits

Released in May 2023, this DLC introduces the character Storm from the X-Men as a fully playable hero. The expansion adds new story missions centred around Storm's abilities to control the weather and her role in the fight against Lilith's demonic forces.

title: Anno 1602: Creation of a New World - Gold Edition
Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons
description:
Prepare to throw down the Double Dragon way in this fresh addition to the iconic beat ‘em up franchise.

Explore the early beginnings of the young Double Dragon brothers as they take on both new and familiar enemies in this alternate story. In this fresh roguelite take, every playthrough is brand new chance at new action. Featuring a unique and dynamic level structure, the difficulty of the missions you take on will change depending on the order you have selected them.

Tag in and out as the classic duo Billy and Jimmy, switch it up with Marian and Uncle Matin, or experiment with 9 additional unlockable characters, each with their own special moves and unique playstyles. With 2 player local co-op, the action quadruples as you and a friend clean up the mean streets.

title: EmyLiveShow: S&M Story
description: Discover the depths of your fetishes and kinks with EmyLiveShow stars Emy and Nia! Spend amazing hours in the company of beautiful v-tubers and find out their secrets!

title: Dream of Echo
description: In Dream of Echo your first goal is to find the only real portal that will allow Echo to wake up and get out of his dream. Be careful, however your shadow will not let you any respite

title: Traveler of Wuxia
description: Traveler of Wuxia is a deck-buiding rogue-lite game that combine the plot twist from the Wuxia novel and the variety of martial arts. This game allows you to explore a Wuxia world that you never experience.

title: AceSpeeder!
description: 2000, the year AceSpeeder! was released on Windows. Made and self published by Takahiro Nakatani, this racing / driving game is available for free on this page.

title: Galeao's Dreams
description:
Galeão's Dreams takes players on an exciting adventure through a series of dreamscapes, where they'll have to navigate various obstacles and defeat enemies to save the villagers of DreamsLand. As Galeão, players will face off against a range of enemies.

The game's retro-inspired graphics and music will transport players back to the golden age of platformers in the 80s and 90s. The visuals are rendered in 16-bits, giving the game a classic, pixelated look that pays homage to the NES games of old. The music is upbeat and catchy, with chiptune-style melodies that will keep players engaged and motivated as they progress through the levels.

Galeão's abilities are relatively simple, but players will need to master them to make it through the levels unscathed. He can jump to avoid obstacles and he can also turn into a Tornado when jumping to attack enemies. Peter's motivation for attacking DreamsLand is simple: he wants to take over the world and plunge it into darkness. We have made a lot changes to the base Source engine and have added countless new mechanics in the mod such as the objective indicator, portable medkit, donator based extras, pickup animations, failed reloads, new picture based GUI elements and much, much more!

To those who survive the horror the first time around we have an extra ‘hardcore mode’ which gives an even greater challenge to the player. This hardcore mode is not only just about more enemy hitpoints and higher damage.

description: Panic House is a horror game that is sure to give players a thrilling and heart-pumping experience. As the player enters the game, they are immediately transported to an eerie and foreboding atmosphere. The visuals are dark and gloomy, with shadows lurking in every corner, and the sound effects are designed to keep the player on edge.

title: Sync Adventure
description: One button to sync with Slime. See if you can control him.

title: Magic Bubble Shooter: Classic Bubbles Arcade
description: A classic puzzle game in which you have to clear the game field by shooting coloured bubbles, candies and lollipops!

title: Tobe's Hookshot Escape
description:
Tobe Hookshot Escape is a spin off of the original Tobe's Vertical Adventure.

Climb as high as you can in this endless platformer, collecting diamonds, treasure chest and power ups along the way. Fight monsters and overcome the traps in your way. Tobe Hookshot Escape is an addictive platformer you won't put down.

title: Novus Conquest
description: Enter the realm of The Plate, where the twin gods of Novus pose a challenge: conquer or vanish. Assemble a force of 100+ unique commanders, capture 28 lands, and unlock the secrets buried in a cryptic dungeon.

title: Fungus Reaper
description: Mushrooms are your friends ... until you turn them into delicious soup! A "disturbing" turn-based tower defence rougelite!

title: AutoHeroes
description: AutoHeroes is a ‘one hero’ autobattler with elements of roguelike and the ability to play in multiplayer. Control one of the four heroes who fight each other for the throne on random maps - both as each for themselves and as part of teams. Study your enemies and counter them with your plan!

title: Mana's Manual
description: This is a strategy game that utilizes limited resources to pass levels.

title: Rise Again
description: An action RPG where a wizard hack and slash enemies, transforming into a roguelike dungeon crawler.

title: UFO: The Ranch
description: Somewhere in South America, aliens have made contact. Visitors have not come in peace to Planet Earth... Open world third person shooter (TPS) game. Single player video game, compatible with Windows 8 / 8.1 / 10 / 11 The game locations are inspired by real places in South America.

title: James is Bananas
description: A double game mechanic, classic platformer and runner, free the banana village from the evil king gorilla by punching and breaking stuff but halfway each level, gear up, it's time to shoot some gummy bears!

title: Blindsight: War of the Wardens
description: Blindsight: War of the Wardens, a story-driven action-adventure game where you play as Iggy, a martial arts master with echolocation abilities, as he retrieves a stolen family heirloom that may bring unintended consequences to the universe.

title: Toilet Paper Simulator
description: Try to survive in the role of toilet paper and try to escape from the house of a crazy old man with diarrhea.

title: Get Out Joey!
description: In a dark and stunning world, swing from platform to platform and try to rise to the surface. Thanks to his spear and your agility, make Joey a free man...

title: Arobynn: Below The Surface
description: Finally, the multiplayer VR dungeon crawler we've all been waiting for! Complete with floor bosses, traps, and a glowing immersive environment. Dive into the depths, upgrade your gear, and work your way farther into the unknown dark below the surface!

title: My Klutzy Cupid
description: In the midst of leading an ordinary life, I began to feel the urge to find myself a girlfriend. Yet somehow, I couldn't bring myself to take the first step. But one day... "What's this...?" A single notebook had fallen right in front of me. "Hey, you! Yes, you! Why aren't you picking it up?"

title: Panzer Corps 2: Axis Operations - 1945
description: Panzer Corps 2’s Axis Operations at long last approaches the end of the Second World War in Europe... one way or another.

title: Machine Heart
description: Delve into the captivating cross-timeline puzzles of Machine Heart, and unravel the conspiracy behind a mass mind-uploading scheme.

title: Cassette Boy
description: All you see is all there is - Cassette Boy: an RPG where what exists depends on you.

title: Bomb Bomb Bomb
description: In this game, you control the Kitty to operate a cannon to fire various pellets to eliminate bricks that keep appearing. Sometimes, a big boss will spawn in the map, and it will spit out a lot of bricks, please try to defeat it. Gain new abilities by leveling up against enemies.

title: Uprising: Humanum
description: Uprising: Humanum is a knowledge based metroidvania. Follow Aurora in her quest to save the last bastion of Humanity.

title: Forest of Deceit
description: Forest of Deceit is a 4-8 player social deduction game where you use your phones to play!

title: Flavor Favor
description: Flavor Favor is a slice-of-life click-through mini-game where you'll interact with customers recommending snacks. Satisfy the customers' taste buds while getting to know the locals and becoming their trusted friend.

title: Pet Shop Simulator
description: Run your own pet shop in Pet Shop Simulator! Find new homes for pets, thus fulfilling the dreams of your customers. Take care of the needs of animals by selling the right items and get involved in matters related to the pets' home life!

title: First Christmas
description: Christmas Eve 1987 and Betty travels up to the family cabin to prepare the original perfect Christmas for Frankie. Discover the events leading up to Last Christmas.

title: Cy: Cyberpunk Survivors
description: Cy is a psionic superheroine battling to save humanity against hordes of zombies, mutants, and killer robots with only her ever-evolving mental powers to protect her. Will she survive the sinister onslaught or is she destined to become just another victim of an evil, unfathomable intelligence?

title: Future Racer 2000
description: Only You Can Be The Future Racer 2000

title: Pandash
description: Pandash is a rogue-lite platformer with different perks to discover and balance their powers. On your search for peace for your world, you wander through different areas, which will change every run. You need to get strong enough and unlock everything to survive and reach your destination.

title: VISK
description: Face your fears in VISK, an open-world online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. Escape from a strange village, uncover the dark secrets of this place and solve puzzles to discover new areas. But beware, deadly creatures are after you and your friend!

title: Survival EXtreme
description: Enter a world devastated by the 2050 apocalypse. Fifty years later, humanity has returned… The war to reclaim Earth has begun, and only the bravest will be able to face the demons that now rule it. The world has fallen. Now it's your turn to rise.

title: Weyrdlets
description: Weyrdlets is a relaxing desktop pet game where you can collect cute items, decorate your home and bring a virtual pet onto your desktop when you need a loving companion!

title: Gaslamp Cases 5: The Dreadful City
description: Play the 5th part of the Match3 saga! Morgan, Jack, and Eleanor have solved numerous mystical casesin and out London, but their return to London greets them with terror. London is quarantined, caught in the grip of a mysterious illness, with no cure in sight - can they save thousands of lifes?

title: Carrot: The First Seed
description: A tiny visual novel about a tiny coastal town.

title: You Are Peter Shorts
description: You are Peter Shorts! You have been captured and taken to a secret cloning facility. Can you escape with your newly-cloned brethren?

title: Hangman II
description: A grim sequel to the puzzle of guessing words. The rules are the same - you need to guess the word, and you have the right to make a mistake 6 times, otherwise the man will be in the noose. And be careful - the game contains many secrets...

title: Easy puzzle: Bridges
description: Easy puzzle: Bridges is a logic game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture.

title: Game Of Puzzles: Dragons
description: A puzzle game in which you have to assemble a single image from individual pieces.

title: Asura Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Who Wants to Strip this Babe? Streamer Girl
description: The combination of the well-known TV show with the best genre of games on earth.

title: My Strange Girlfriends
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Easy puzzle: Landscape
description: This is a logic game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture.

title: Wizard Lady
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Glasses and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Bikes and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Cars and Girls
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Car Dealer Simulator
