description: Uncover a goldmine in the used car market! Sniff out deals, buy low, modify, and sell high. Your journey from amateur grease monkey to car dealer magnate awaits. How fast will you rise in this lucrative venture?

title: Heliborne Collection
description: Heliborne Collection offers two games through a launcher. Choose to play Heliborne or Heliborne Enhanced Edition.

title: Chris: The Element Runner
description: In Chris: The Element Runner, race through an endless 2D stage filled with elemental particles as you dodge stones, flames, water, and air. Simple graphics and gameplay make it easy to pick up and play for quick sessions. Test your skills and see how far you can survive in this thrilling adventure.

title: Drunken FC
description: Ever wanted to get drunk, play football (soccer), and not worry about the medical bill later? Do you hate animation and love physics? Then here's some physics-based sports action for you and your friends. Play locally or remotely. Move your feet, but don't break the sticks on your controller.

title: Temple of Revi
description: Travel through devastated lands solving color-matching sokoban puzzles to bring Nature back to life.

title: Orb Flight
description: Fly and collect all of the glowing orbs. Meditative Flight & exploration game with relaxing music.

title: Sinking Simulator: Legacy
description: The original Sinking Simulator from 2013 A fun lightweight Sandbox game focused on creating ships and wrecking them using soft body physics!

title: Tokyo Psychodemic
description: Through forensic investigation, confront paranormal phenomenas! 2D × Cinematic・Realistic forensics investigation simulation game.

title: Spectra Echo VR
description: Immerse yourself in this surreal world of Spectra Echo VR, and embark on a unique music visualization journey. Play your own music within the game and watch as the environment and particles dance to the rhythm of your tunes. Unwind and revel in this captivating audiovisual extravaganza!

title: Pillars
description: Pillars is a 3D platformer where the environments are put first and foremost to provide a fun, relaxing experience climbing all six levels.

title: Hex Strikers
description: High Striker, the classic funfair strongman game, is now a roguelike deckbuilder. Strategically place hex tiles with strikers, gain tokens and unlock upgrades from the shop to rack up the highest possible score from 1000 strikes.

title: Shale
description: Discover the abandoned world of Shale in this 1-3 player action adventure. Shoot, craft and loot through cities of possessed creatures, industrial parks of corrupted bodies and fields of forgotten souls.

title: Witch's House Beginning
description: Alexei will have to choose several ways to escape from the witch's house. You will have to look for: batteries to keep the flashlight on, keys to open the doors, fuel to fill up the car, etc.

title: Spellfield
description: Spellfield is a relaxing farming RPG set in an idyllic town. You can build up your farm, hone your skills, and explore a vibrant, mysterious world.

title: Chess Graphy
description: Aren't you tired of looking at only one board, while reviewing your opening lines? Chess Graphy will graph out your openings and allow you to easily glider over the endless possibilities of a chess game.

title: Knight Trail
description: A silly little micro RPG. You are Sir Knight, trying to save the kingdom without dying from general incompetence. You're free to explore the expansive world any way you'd like, but beware of what you might encounter.

title: Goblin Conqueror
description: Kanami, a former Dragon Slayer who lost her job due to the extinction of dragons. Now, she has embraced her new job as a Monster Hunter, wholeheartedly committed to vanquishing goblins.

title: Bright Tracer
description: Bright Tracer is a high-speed running game, dash through a cyberspace world being invaded by a virus. You stylishly advance through the stages stylishly using various actions such as wall-run and wire-hook. Run, jump, dodge enemies and obstacles through the world to get to the virus's boss.

title: International Secret Agent
description: Save the world from a mad scientist's evil plan and cure the population from an infectuous disease. International Secret Agent puts you in the shoes of the very best spy in the business with the mission to safeguard humanity from certain doom!

title: War of the Fourteen Dynasties
description: Battle against thirteen rival dynasties across twenty war torn provinces in this challenging strategy fighter hybrid. Command your troops on the battlefield, or fight along side them as a soldier. Crush your enemies and lead your dynasty to total victory!

title: OnlySociety Midgard Imperial
description: Recruit hero's and defeat the opponents in Medieval environment. Equip different weapons and perform combo to turn down your enemies. The platform is huge enough and avoid jumping down the cliff.

title: Blast Attack
description: A short top-down game about dodging bullets and shooting a variety of enemies. Your arsenal evolves as you collect power-ups. Use a charged blast attack to destroy magenta shields and dashes to destroy cyan shields while fighting 6 different enemy types that can make use of shields and dashes.

title: Bog Roll
description: The year's 2020 and during the peak of Australia's lockdown there's a toilet roll (or bog roll) shortage. You play as Jim, who of course always leaves things to the last minute and forgot to stock up on bog rolls. Collect as many bog rolls as you on this whirlwind adventure!

title: Shorkie Software presents: Proto
description: An all ages top-down 2D musical adventure for lifting the spirits.

title: Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe
description:
A relaxing bullet heaven, farming adventure. Play as a powerful Warlock with a side hustle harvesting plants in space.

Build the ultimate space farm as you explore the galaxy and stumble onto the mystery of a dead planet. Cultivate exotic plant life, trade your harvests for credits, and customize your runs with unique powers in this roguelite adventure.

title: Warped
description: Sci-fi space horror survival.

title: Ceiba
description: Ein, a simple-hearted member of an expedition sent by mankind to distant planets, tries to get romantic with a pretty but cold co-worker girl. Unfortunately, he is not the only one trying to make contact as from the abandoned and desolate alien ruins, the girl receives a message in human language.

title: Forastero
description: A town without a sheriff is the least of your problems when you have a bounty on your head. Forastero is a third-person beat 'em up game.

title: FFFL: Brutalball Manager
description: FFFL: Brutalball Manager is a Franchise Management Simulation game, based mostly on American Football in a Fantasy setting. Take full control of the entire league. Tons of customization, deep stat tracking and unique rules.

title: Veggie Quest: The Puzzle Game
description: Become a Game Designer in this open-ended puzzle game. Design game dungeons and watch AI-controlled players beat them. Explore how simple movement rules result in mind-bending dungeon layouts.

title: Bang Average Football
description: Experience the thrill of the beautiful game in Bang Average Football - the fast-paced, addictive, easy-to-learn football game for 1-4 players! Play against your friends for footballing glory in multiplayer, or turn a hopeless club into national champions as player-manager in Story mode!

title: Blaster Arcade
description: Wanna Arcade?

title: Calmed by the Dark: Shin Neon
description:
Calmed by the Dark Shin Neon is an action RPG set in a future where creatures, known as Biomorphics, live between humans. Being a danger to mankind, an organization of hunters was created to terminate them...

In this action-packed game, you'll take on the role of Tommy, a hunter tasked with protecting the city and stopping the Biomorphic threat. With a mission-based structure, you'll embark on thrilling missions to uncover the truth behind the Biomorphics.

title: Mossasis
description: Exploring the vast unknown world from a microscopic perspective of moss, embarking on a journey to find an oasis.

title: Consortium Remastered
description: Become Consortium Bishop Six, a global peacekeeper in the year 2042. Speak and form friendships or enemies with a full cast of characters using your own voice. Take an active role in a murder mystery, on a plane, in the future. Every choice counts.

title: Brick Exorcist
description: "Brick Exorcist" is a casual bishojo brick break game! You accidentally crossed into another world and became an exorcist. With the help of the goddess, you exorcised the beautiful girl who was possessed by the devil!

title: Great Ambition of the Slimes
description: A tactical simulation game where you make slimes take over humans to fight your battles! You have weak, weak slimes under your command. But what if they have the ability to occupy human bodies? Lend your wisdom to the slimes and help them take over the world!

title: Trash Bunny House
description: Trash Bunny House is a first-person exploration horror action game. You work as a writer on the edge working at a publishing company and you are heading towards an abandoned factory deep within the mountains. The abandoned factory was an old manufacturing site for animatronics meant for an amusement park. However, during manufacturing many unexplained fatal incidents occurred and it closed down. Then, after it was supposed to have been shut down, a tip-off came from someone who reported witnessing the animatronics often inside the factory. Take as many photos for the scoop as you can and come back alive.

title: Autopista
description: Autopista is a car racing game inspired by 80s toys.

title: Morningstar: Book of the Fallen
description: Morningstar: Book of the Fallen is an Urban Fantasy Adult Visual Novel/RPG. Discover your Destiny, and a cast full of gorgeous and funny girls.

title: Piyomori DX
description: Piyomori DX is an independent puzzle game released by GameBB, on SP in 2021.

title: Null District
description: A puzzle-adventure game set in a gritty Cyberpunk themed world. Unravel the stories hidden within the city!

title: Aggregator Elevator System
description: A logical puzzle system about arranging boxes to make the numbers add up correctly within a grid. The boxes react to each other in mathematical and logical ways, and you manipulate them within the constraints of a machine that comes with an elevator attached!

title: Little Devils
description: After centuries of being misjudged for being "devils", a young Tasmanian devil agrees to descend to the depths of hell to restore his ancestors honor. Challenge yourself with hundreds of hand-crafted screens and uncover what secrets lie with Satan at the depths of hell... you know... for fun!

title: Bodycam
description: Bodycam is an ultra-realistic multiplayer, first-person shooter game made using the latest technologies of the next-gen game engine Unreal Engine 5. Get ready to dive into fast-paced Bodycam actions, where every bullet counts and every choice can decide over the victory or loss of your team.

title: Blaster Panic
description: Blaster Panic is a 2D space shooter where you defend your home base against an onslaught of enemies. Fight through ongoing boss battles. Last as long as you can to dominate the leaderboard.

title: Sweet Forest Guardian
description: Sweet Forest Guardian－Is a card + real-time tactics game. Players have to combine their own decks to defeat the enemy, and after winning the battle, they can save their lovely elf companions.

title: Deviko TD
description: Raise chicks and intercept enemies! Easy tower defense game.

title: Nudomatic
description: Nudomatic is a game in which you go around Megacity to photograph and undress the pretty girls who cross your path.

title: Hotel Manibella
description: Get ready for the ultimate horror puzzle game! Check into Hotel Manibella for a spine-chilling experience. With a unique art style and secret storyline, journey through the floors of a haunted hotel, with each level becoming scarier and more intense.

title: The Night Market
description: Welcome to the Night Market. Survive your journey while navigating a foreign land, rife with political intrigue, arbitrary rules and secrets designed to keep you distracted. Fall in love, explore a world with rich characters, and try to save the realm.

title: BeaureCard
description: Your deck is your health in BeaureCard, an easy to learn fast-paced roguelike deckbuilder. Strive to deplete your opponents' deck, cleverly using traps, powers, blessings, and curses. Embark on an epic adventure, with exciting events to explore, new cards to acquire, and dangerous demons.

title: Checkmate Showdown
description: Chess meets Fighting games. Crush your opponents in the arena and on the chessboard in this online multiplayer competitive tactical fighting game that mixes the strategical elegance of Chess with the fast-paced execution of fighting games.

title: Deckmate!
description: Deckmate is a fresh take on the classic game of Chess. Using your cards, you can influence the board itself, make pieces explode, and more!

title: AnimalKingdom: Cats
description: Have fun with our cats.

title: Holidays in Khrushchevsk
description: Do you like spontaneous purchases? Do all your purchases bring you happiness? Everything is not as simple as it seems at first glance.

title: Necromancers' Arena
description: Enter the Necromancers' Arena with up to three other players in this cute, dystopian, twin-stick shooter!

title: Crab Rhapsody: Vol.1
description: Crabby will never cry, and Rock n’ Roll will never die! Crab Rhapsody vol.1 is a musical action-roguelite with fast-paced combat and original soundtracks.

title: No Ghost in Sky Elevator
description: It is a strange high-rise elevator. The objects that appear and the people you board are all strange. Depending on your actions, you will face a variety of consequences.

title: The Precinct
description: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

title: April's Diary
description: Help April, a young housekeeper in England during the Victorian era to clean up the many rooms in Lord Ashford's manor. Challenging and fun 3D puzzles with a match-3 element embedded.

title: GateTail
description: GateTail is a colorful action-adventure strategy RPG with a comedic story-rich basis and multiple endings based on your choices to boot! Explore an alternate dimension to your own in the search for a lost friend while avoiding its UNIQUE inhabitants and solving the mystery of your being!

title: Yerba Buena
description: Dive into a surreal 1970s gameworld and save San Francisco from a sinister threat. Play as Barb, and use the Oscillator to capture and reapply the physical traits of objects to solve mind-bending environmental platforming puzzles.

title: E3pdr
description: In puppet control, find the largest amount of Easter Eggs as you fight for survival.

title: The Nameless: Slay Dragon
description: The Nameless: Slay Dragon is a gamebook-adventure flavored turn-based RPG In short - how to slay the immensely powerful and cunning evil dragon? You will play as a young man having a bloody feud with a dragon, and face powerful, sinister and tricky enemies with friends....

title: Bricks Crusher Breaker Ball
description: Break all the bricks in this awesome arcade!

title: Shepherd Dog
description: Shepherd dog havhav starts looking for the sheep that have escaped from the farm to catch them. If he finds it in the fastest time, he writes the name on the leaderboard. Competes with other players.

title: Ominous Stew
description: Ominous Stew is a chaotic 1v1 action-cooking game! Duel in both Story and Versus modes with various cooking legends: Serve your guests with self-created dishes and ruthlessly corner your rivals with destructive Foodji attacks!

title: Beat the Machine: Rebooted - Invasion
description: T.O.M is back and his Invasion of Sector IV has begun. With a new arsenal of enemies, T.O.M is ready to take over a different part of the Origin Sectors. In this pack experience 15 new levels, a new survival map, new enemy types and more.

title: White Night Dream
description: White Night Dream is a card-based strategy rogue-lite game where a girl chases after a runaway cat on the streets at midnight. The game cleverly simulates the short yet long night through a simple card-flipping gameplay and a variety of interesting build combinations.

title: Fossilfuel 2
description: Navigate the open-world underground base of the Sierra Research Facility, now flooded, while being relentlessly pursued by towering dinosaurs. With 12 hours of heart-pounding FPS survival horror gameplay and a full cast of prehistoric enemies, can you outwit the dangers and make your escape?

title: Fairy Hunter
description: Long ago, In this world kind of intelligent life -- fairy. At first humans and fairy lived in peace. I do not know when to start, part of the evil fairy began to hurt people. Human mages began to imprison and train fairy to cleanse their minds. This part of mages are called the Fairy Hunter.

title: Avenger Sharks
description: Avenger Sharks is a retro twin-stick shooter. Featuring sharks. Out for Vengeance. Save your fishy friends! Destroy the evils of the deep! Collect power-ups, health potions and upgrades! Invoke the sheer fury of fish frenzy or your dinosaur friends to even the odds!

title: Land of the Survivors
description: Roguelike-style survival game, enhance your character through upgrades. Survive as long as possible and fight against thousands of zombies.

title: Abandoned Souls
description: Abandoned Souls is a horror game, shown through a GoPro lens. You play as a vlogger who specializes in urban exploration.

title: The Red
description: Debt-ridden and desperate? Get out of the red and into The Red! Join the Red Horizons on Mars as an Extraction Security Associate and pay off your debts by defending your way to wealth in this ironic first-person/tower-defense/comedy-horror adventure!

title: Inukari: Fateful Detour
description: The standalone addon for Inkuari - Chase of Desception with two new world and local multiplayer duel mode. Its a fast and smooth action jump & run game like in the good old days.

title: Cosmic Pebble
description: Jump, double jump, and throw your boomerang to navigate a mysterious, alien planet called Pebble. Fight bosses, find collectables, and uncover secrets, while enjoying an atmospheric sci-fi story about family, disability, and perseverance.

title: Overwhelmed
description: A game made during Game Jam Madrid Crea. You can skip any level in the game (just check the help menu).

title: Moonbriar
description: Delve into a dark fantasy visual novel where evil isn't always as it seems. Make your choices and grow your skills to help determine who survives the Great Culling. Featuring the voice talents of Ralph Ineson, Simon Callow, Savannah Steyn, and more.

title: Martin
description: Martin is a block-pushing, grid-based puzzle game. Use items, push blocks and navigate your way around various game mechanics to retrieve Martin's crown.

title: Vexlands
description: Vexlands is a realm of surprises. Every newly opened space brings a surprise: loot, resources, dungeons, monsters and disasters! Build your village where you craft new equipment before you explore uncharted areas, and find relics that explain who came before and why these lands are cursed.

title: Citizens: On Mars
description: Experience the ultimate turn-based colony building game in Citizens: On Mars! As the leader of a fledgling Martian settlement, your mission is to develop a thriving colony amidst the harsh and unforgiving environment of the Red Planet.

title: Timeless Rain
description: Explore this foreign world and use manipulate time to defeat any creature who dares to stand between you and your goal! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

title: Grapple League
description: Utilize skill to swing yourself through multiple jaw-dropping levels in this time-trial, swinging, physics based platformer. From oceans to canyons to mountains and beyond take your swinging prowess across the world in obstacle filled levels. Swing into the finish. Set new records.

title: I am your President: Prove Yourself Scenario
description: Immerse yourself in a serious political story and experience how you became president of the USA.

title: Cargo Truck Racer
description: Race through challenging tracks with automatic movement and fragile cargo management. Collect stars, climb the leaderboards, and unlock achievements in this fast-paced, truck racing game with an energetic drum n bass soundtrack and low-poly graphics.

title: Fritz&Chesster: learn to play chess Vol. 1 - Edition 2023
description: Strategic thinking, tricky brain-training, exciting competitive situations, lots of fun and a good serving of chess knowledge - all this and more in this unique, international award-winning chess adventure game.

title: Little Army
description: Little Army is an auto battle game in which powerful insect rulers clash for power. Each faction has its own specific abilities and effects in battle, and the Tyrants provide different aids to their armies. Expand your ranks and crush your enemies.

title: The Dream Labyrinth
description: The Dream Labyrinth is a single-player game that combines tower defense with roguelike elements. Gather companions in the form of souls and use artifacts and structures to aim for the deepest part of the dream, where the key to the contract lies!

title: Michijiro no Lucent: Maou Fukkatsu
description: 千年の時を経て復活した魔王とその娘達は 魔力を取り戻すために不思議な塔へと足を踏み入れます。 しかし そこで魔王軍一行を待っていたものとは…

title: B-B0 The Delivery Bot
description: A 2D puzzle platformer where you play as a cute lil robot whose sole purpose is delivering packages (on time)!

title: Arcticide
description: Explore dangerous procedural cities and landscapes in this gritty survival FPS with roguelike elements. Face harsh environments, hostile mercenaries, and mutant horrors as you navigate a dying near-future Arctic.

title: Banana Yetti
description: Banana Yetti is an addictive and fast paced arcade game that will keep you on your toes. The game features a cute and adorable yeti character that the player takes control of.

title: Steam Engine Simulator
description: On January 21, 2023, AngeTheGreat released a video called "Simulating a Steam Engine with C++" which documented the creation of a simple steam engine simulation. This is that simulation now made into a simple game! Enjoy operating and listening to your own miniature virtual steam engine.

title: Old Coin Pusher Friends 2
description: "Old Coin Pusher Friends 2" is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Edo period. Players work together to defeat yokai, repel skulls, and aim for the jackpot. As the game progresses, players can upgrade their abilities and equipment to become stronger.

title: Paranormal Records
description: Paranormal Records is a next-generation horror game made on Unreal Engine 5. A unique narrative experience from the perspective of a video camera. The protagonist, the host of a TV show about the paranormal, is filming a report about a missing patient, in an abandoned hospital.

title: The Groom of Gallagher Mansion
description: Hunt down a beheaded ghost to save your college club from losing funding! It'll be a piece of cake— wait, what do you mean he wants to marry you!? The Groom of Gallagher Mansion is spooky comedic romantic visual novel full of laughs and scares all around!

title: Winterland
description: This is a short peaceful RPG. Your only commands are "joke", "dance", "stare", "run away", and "hug".

title: Just Another Night Shift
description: Just Another Night Shift is a casual competitive PvP stealth strategy game. Join us for hours of fun gameplay with your friends!

title: Axecutioners
description: A minimal-input fighting game to determine who is the greatest Axecutioner of them all! Your huge, unwieldy axe ensures that each of your attacks are slow yet powerful, meaning you need to think and strategize before your next attack to claim victory over your opponent!

title: Roxy Raccoon's Mancala Madness
description: When a Voodoo Priestess seeks vengeance upon the world, it is up to one Raccoon to stop her! Learn the basics & master the tactics of the classic board game as you prove, once and for all, that you are the true Mancala champion!

title: A Special Place In Hell
description: Scavenge for weapons, ambush your friends, die trying. A Special Place In Hell is an 8-man fast-paced top-down battle royale-lite inspired by 4-bit games of the Atari 2600 era.

title: Fantasy Craft
description: Craft all day and night long full steam in Fantasy Craft. Craft alone or with your friends. You can craft and sell to buy more stuff so you can craft even more sophisticated things to sell. You can become the Master of Craft.

title: Play With Me
description: Use whatever you can think of to destroy al the different objects that are keeping you away from playing with your human, but you will have to be fast because you have twenty minutes before he gets back home. Will you be able to make it?

title: Bit the Apple, So What?
description: A short musical theater play set in dystopian Eastern Europe, based on a biblical story.

title: MailPop
description: A Clicker where you will try to send an email while getting rid of annoying pop-ups that will flood your screen. The perfect warm-up to hone your aim between games! Have you ever wanted to punch those annoying ads in the face? NOW YOU CAN!

title: Detective: Stella Porta case
description: Detective: Stella Porta Case, puts you in the shoes of a detective who investigates three strange disappearances. In all cases there is a contract signed by the disappeared, that contract is from an organization called "Stella Porta".

title: Zero Grounds
description: Zero Grounds is a dynamic free-to-play online multiplayer FPS with a unique feature: no gravity areas! Team up with your friends, customize the loadout, and float (not pay) to win!

title: C.B.T
description: C.B.T (Crazy Ball Time) is a ball-rolling platformer, with crazy tough action, and even crazier Balls.

title: Cell Wars
description: Cell Wars is a classic arcade shooter where your goal is to consume all enemy cells by shooting and eating them. Inspired by NES graphics, gameplay from arcade 80s cabinets, and early 2000s skill tree systems. Unlock abilities and skills to survive waves of regular, elite and boss cells.

title: The Paradell
description: The Paradell is a third person, country-side adventure rpg where you harness elemental magic to farm, fight and explore the isolated and deceivingly cozy world of the Paradell. Explore the deepest catacombs and soar above the tree tops, gaining magical knowledge and helping shape the world.

title: Camping Park Simulator
description: Become a campsite owner to bring people joy and unforgettable experiences! Be the first who dared to buy an abandoned park near Route 66. You're not afraid to get in the spirit of the story and decide to make sure the campsite is filled with lively, unusual tourists.

title: Streamer Girl Simulator
description: Streamer Girl Simulator is a fun and exciting simulation game where players can create their own streaming career for their custom streamer girl character.

title: The Dark Tower
description: Complete the Trials of Kornath and learn the location of the dark evil behind the events that unfurled in The Curse of Feldar Vale and Mystery at Morgoth. An adventure for 4-6 characters of Level 6-12, loosely based on D&D Open Game License (1e/2e).

title: Hodgepodge Hunch
description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...

title: Anomaly Agent
description: Anomaly Agent is a cyberpunk action-platformer featuring fluid combat, a time-bending story, quirky characters and a catchy synthwave soundtrack! Punch or shoot through mobs of enemies, impact the story with your choices and stop the anomalies before the world plunges into chaos!

title: Dead On Arrival
description: Dead On Arrival is a horror game set on trains. In the heart of an eternal night, a seemingly endless train barrels through a desolate, otherworldly landscape. Each carriage unfolds as a unique nightmare.

title: Masonic Mysteries: Secrets Unveiled
description: Unravel the secrets of the Masons and survive FBI's pursuit in The Cult Of Masons. High stakes and hidden dangers await.

title: The Lawn Zapper
description: A game about mowing the lawn.

title: Menma's TERA
description: Menma's TERA is an unofficial fork of the popular 2011 MMORPG game TERA, brought to you by the players.

title: MrClean.exe
description: Rise and shine, I can't believe you slept in so late hahahaha don't you know that we have so much to do, so much to clean?

title: Nakadashi Banzai
description: Today, he's off to the big city, and on the hunt for girls! Once a target girl has been selected, you'll need to sweet talk her into letting her guard down, ram it inside, and don't forget the creampie! Welcome to the world of Nakadashi Banzai.

title: Nakadashi Banzai 5
description: Summer! The Beach!! Flirting, F*cking, and Finishing Inside!!! He's the guy who loves nothing more than hitting on a chick, having raw sex, and ending with a creampie...Our hero is back once again!! This time, the hunting grounds are the shining sands of a midsummer beach!! Beautiful women in stunning swimsuit as far as the eye can see. Your targets are a blonde foreigner with a slamming body, a sexy, tanned, and flat chick, and a glamorous, mature wife in her 40s! Get their guard down with some flirting, enjoy sex under the summer sun or bathed in pale moonlight, and finish it off with a creampie! The world of Nakadashi Banzai is waiting for you!

title: Lust of the Apartment Wives
description: A small apartment complex...The type that might exist anywhere... Our main character is a grocery deliveryman who's polite demeanor and pleasant smile. But his smile is not as innocent as it seems... He has an ulterior motive...Sampling some of these finely aged apartment wives!

title: I am Rolling
description: A rage platformer game in which you need to control a ball and avoid obstacles on a mission to... I'm not sure... what is your mission... where are you?

title: House Party: Detective Liz Katz in a Gritty Kitty Murder Mystery
description:
Your favorite house party flirts with a bit of blood and darkness in its second-ever guest expansion pack — featuring famous cosplayer, streamer, actress, and model Liz Katz!

Enjoy a thrilling new branching Original Story addition focused around and fully voice-acted by Liz Katz herself! Be prepared for the lights to go out, fear to reign, and unsolved mysteries to come to light in this wild new comedy-noir DLC!

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

title: Rule the Waves 3
description:
Build Your Navy, from pre-Dreadnoughts to Aircraft Carriers and Missile Cruisers!
Rule the Waves 3 is a simulation of naval ship design and construction, fleet management and naval warfare from 1890 to 1970 and will place you in the role of 'Grand Admiral' of a navy from the time when steam and iron dominated warship design up to the missile age. Rule the Waves 3 will let you design and build the ships of your navy, and lead them into battle when war erupts.

You will guide your navy's deployment, construction and operations during a period of great technological innovation and political tensions. While the game derives much of its technology and events from 'actual' history, you will find that you forge your own new history each and every time you play!

title: CraftCraft: Fantasy Merchant Simulator
description: CraftCraft is an RPG merchant sim with actual. Crafting. Create a tiara for a mermaid princess or a sword made of dragon blood - you choose! Express your creativity in your very own cozy crafting studio and change the lives of quirky locals in the mysterious port town of Windspell.

title: Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters
description: Hunt cybercriminals in a brutal action roguelite where enemies adapt to your fighting style. Play as Angel or Lea and choose your path through revenge and redemption in a dystopian society.

title: Hard Minus Forever Standalone DLC
description: Hard Minus is coming back, if you hadn't enough adrenaline action in your gaming life.

title: College Bowl
description: College Bowl is a beautifully pixelated on-field simulation of American Football! Challenge college rivals on your way to winning a National title! Take on various game modes, including a deep Dynasty mode with in-depth recruiting, scouting, stat tracking, ranking, bowl games, yearly goals and more!

title: Medieval Idle: Quest
description: Medieval Idle: Quest is a captivating game that will transport you back to the middle ages. This idle game combines the elements of simulation and strategy to create a truly engaging experience for gamers of all ages.

title: Cube Airport
description: Cube Airport is a puzzle game where your objective is to construct a runway to enable the airplane to take off safely. To do this, you need to correctly fit the runway cubes into the indicated positions on the platform and proceed to the next level.

title: Eye of Saccharine
description: A girl suffering from hallucinations tries her best to live a normal life in the megapolis. She sees an advertisement for a certain doctor presenting a revolutionary technology for diagnosing and treating the psyche, "G.L.A.Z.A".

title: Cities: Skylines - Hotels & Retreats
description: Spruce up your City with the finest hôtellerie with “Hotels & Retreats”! Start with a small hotel chain and unlock more luxurious and specialized hotels as you make your way to a successful hotel business.

title: The Squeal of the Pig
description: The CEO of the biggest meat producing corporation is kidnapped by a cannibalistic serial killer that exclusively eats human flesh. The former fears being eaten, but the latter assures him he has other plans for him, including a special surprise.

title: Flappy Souls
description: A mix of Flappy Bird and Dark Souls

title: Doomsday Derby
description: Play this indie derby game! destroy the cars that want to destroy you with a powerful gun and missiles in a battle arena. Avoid the chickens and destroy the giant worm from the aliens! loot the destroyed cars and more in this fun mini game for windows

title: Soulash 2
description: In a realm where gods have perished, a new era of strife has dawned. Seize power, forge legendary artifacts, conquer the world, and ascend to the divine throne in Soulash 2!

title: Rogue Labyrinth
description: Fight through the ranks in a monster-filled labyrinth created by an egocentric billionaire colonist. Make friends (or enemies) with rivals, employees, fans, and monsters to improve your abilities. The crowd wants a show, so hype them up in this rogue-lite narrative adventure!

title: Holy Ship
description: Get ready to battle other pirate ships on the high seas with Holy Ship - the ultimate local multiplayer party game!

title: Chef: Cocktails & Drinks
description: Tired of serving soda to your customers? It’s time to reach a whole new dimension of beverages with Chef: Cocktails & Drinks! Ranging from fruity booze to overpriced creamy coffee, you will have a new wide array of options at your disposal to gently decrease your customers’ bank account!

title: Dead Mire
description: An action packed endless wave zombie shooter with elements of tactics and resource management.

title: Darkblade Ascent
description: Darkblade Ascent is a fast paced First-Person Melee Roguelike RPG with randomly generated weapons and upgrades, unlockable new classes and persistent leveling. Hack and slash your way through atmospheric dark fantasy locations, unique monsters and bosses.

title: Dimraeth
description: A 1-8 player fantasy RPG set in a handcrafted pixel world. Build your hero across 8 races and 6 classes. Explore ancient lands, master elemental combat, forge relationships, and shape a stronghold to call home. Fight for the fate of Dimraeth—together or alone.

title: Paint by Pixel 2
description: Create your pixel masterpiece today!

title: Costa Verde Transport Department
description: In Costa Verde you play as the Transport Department of a city slowly growing on a vibrant picturesque landscape. Build roads on a map of hexagonal tiles, plan road intersections, place roundabouts, plan out bus routes, and watch your whole city turn into one single massive traffic jam!

title: Ginsha
description: Ginsha is a unique atmospheric pixelart Action Adventure Platformer with special Gravity Shield and Dash Mechanics. It combines a versatile Platformer core with RPG, Souls and Crafting Elements to an Anomaly among Metroidvania games.

title: Milites Fortunae
description: Welcome to Milites Fortunae, a stategy game where you control a team of warriors! Take turns with your opponent as your warriors perform attacks known as Abilities, to deplete enemy units health and claim victory!

title: Azure Orphanage
description: One day, while secretly searching for the Empire's heritage, orphan Niina encounters a "demon," believed to be a survivor of the war, in an unexplored cave. At the same time, various incidents unfold, gradually devouring the orphans’ daily lives...

title: Horror Amusement Park
description: "Horror Amusement Park" is a thrilling game that puts you in charge of creating your very own horror-themed amusement park.

title: Legion: Dead Metal
description: A secret government installation on a tropical island in international waters has gone dark LEGION has been sent in to investigate ,the installation was experimenting with a new power source and a mayday was received moments before contact was lost "Save yourself" was all that was heard

title: I'm In Charge
description: As "person in charge" in this game, you will travel to the scenes of classic negotiation events and become that crucial negotiator. Use your rhetoric to persuade the stubborn AI to give up their ideas.

title: Inflorescences
description: A visual novel strategy game where your floral fragrances determine the fate of your mysterious shop and its patrons. Make choices, talk to customers, and shape the story. Get ready for a journey of heartfelt connections and strategic decision-making.

title: Imperial Storm
description: Imperial Storm is a new style card strategy game. Recruit trustworthy followers to counter conspiracy and become a strong power in the court!

title: Gene Rain Wind Tower: Ultimate Edition
description: Gene Rain Wind Tower is a next-gen third person shooter game. The story is set in a futuristic world, with a linear narrative structure, and uses shocking visual effects to present a brand new world for the players ' enjoyment. ‘ULTIMATE EDITION' integrates all DLC content, you can experience new stories, you can get rare weapons, and the complete game experience will make you immersed in it.

title: Thunderday
description: Thunderday is a twin stick shooter following a group of friends and family fighting their way and traveling through multiple worlds after their home got destroyed. Choose your hero and start your journey to find and destroy the one responsible for it.

title: Atomograd
description: A linguistic detective game. Decrypt the Soviet computer to prevent total nuclear annihilation.

title: Sainthood
description: Sainthood is a cozy strategy game about serving your community and growing your faith. Explore a miniature world and help the islanders by constructing buildings, delivering resources, and volunteering. Pray and attend to other spiritual activities as you rise to become a Saint!

title: Goremon
description: Explore and collect the powerful Goremons in a world where the energy of these creatures is everything. Make important decisions, and face dangers in a world full of mysteries and challenges. Goremon will take you on an epic adventure. Begin your journey in the world of Goremon!

title: Rusty's Day Off: Episode One - Janitor on Duty
description: Rusty's Day Off is a stylized FPS metroidvania in which you play as a janitor caught up in a wild adventure on his day off. Armed with your gadgets, you must navigate through complex facilities, solve puzzles, defeat rogue robots and jump & run your way through this day.

title: Binding of Elements
description: In this action-rougelike game you'll have to survive waves of monsters and fight against bosses. You'll be able to combine different elements to get unique abilities and arm yourself against the challenges. Choose from a variety of upgrades and improve your character or abilities.

title: Mr. Stretch and the Stolen Fortune
description: Stretch from platform to treasure in this unique, supernatural puzzle-platformer game.

title: Need for Drifting
description: "Need for Drifting" is an adrenaline-fueled game that is perfect for anyone who loves the thrill of drifting and the excitement of competition.

title: Cyber Citizen Shockman
description: Slash and shoot your way through robots rampaging in Shockman's town!

title: King Jister 3
description: A classic medieval point & click first person adventure game.

title: The Blood Mage by Daniel da Silva
description: The Blood Mage is a fast-paced Puzzle/RPG hybrid. Reach the powerful blood crystal!

title: MalViolence: Definitive Edition
description: Caution: Escape from this supervillain at your own risk...A sci-fi visual novel packed with brain-teasing puzzles.

title: Knock & Run
description: Grab an orb and prepare to fight - It's about to go down. Compete your friends and knock down everyone!

title: Peraglees: The Ooloufian Resistance
description: Peraglees - The Ooloufian Resistance is the first furry fandom video game to kick-ass and chew fur! With retro inspired visuals and authentic FM music to keep the action pumping while you blast through hordes of enemies. Peraglees is an Action Arcade shooter with RPG elements in Story mode.

title: Endless Apocalypse
description: Endless Apocalypse is a thrilling shooter game that takes you on a never-ending journey through different levels. Unlike zombie games, it features a unique set of enemies and bosses that require your quick reflexes and careful planning to defeat.

title: Rainbow High: Runway Rush
description: Play as the Rainbow High girls, explore the school and use their unique talents to complete your first art assignment. #LetYourTrueColorsShine

title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon - Collector's Edition
description:
Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon - Collector's Edition, exclusive to Bandai Namco Store, comes with the full game, plus the following items:

Armored Core Figurine - Size 19 cm
Steelbook - Original art Steelbook case
Pin Badges - A set of 4 pin badges featuring in-game emblem patterns
Stickers - A set of 45 stickers to personalize your computer, mobile phone, etc.
Artbook - An exclusive 40-page hardcover artbook. Dive deep into the world of the game with never-before-seen visuals
Digital Soundtrack - The complete original soundtrack

title: Jagged Alliance 3: Tactical Edition
description:
Introducing the Jagged Alliance 3 Tactical Edition!
This comprehensive kit is housed in a sturdy and waterproof case, ensuring your gear remains safe and dry. The Tactical Belt with a Belt Pouch provides quick and easy access to your essential items, while the A.I.M. pin showcases your allegiance to the cause.

Get to know the characters of Jagged Alliance with a set of 36 character cards, each showcasing their professions and personalities. As you strategize and plan your next move, immerse yourself in the game's atmosphere with the official soundtrack on CD. With the Jagged Alliance 3 Tactical Edition, you'll be fully prepared to take on whatever challenges come your way!

Here's the full overview:
- The Game on disc in a limited Media Book
- Outdoor case, 100% water- and dustproof & IP67 certified
-- Outer dimensions: 258 x 243 x 118 mm
-- Inner dimensions: 235 x 180 x 106 mm
- Heavy Duty Tactical Belt for your pants
- Tactical Belt Pouch for your gadgets
- A.I.M. Pin
- Set of 36 Character Cards
- Original Soundtrack on disc

This item is worldwide limited to 750 orders.

title: Zapling Bygone: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Zapling Bygone Deluxe Edition will include:
- Physical Game
- Original Soundtrack
- Zapling Pin
- Mini Cómics
- Collector's Box

title: Anicon: Animal Complex
description:
Clena, your average everyday girl, finds herself in front of a circus filled with lovely animals. However, she quickly discovers that they are not ordinary animals — they are actually human boys who can transform into animals!

To ensure her silence, she has no choice but to work under them - cleaning, sweeping, and keeping things in order - or at least, that is how it appears on the surface. Their underlying goal, however, is for her to fall in love with one of the boys!

title: Oxygen Cocktail
description: Embark on a captivating adventure in Oxygen Cocktail, an open-world visual novel game. Solve puzzles, make friends, and uncover secrets in a charming rural village. Immerse yourself in a unique aesthetic that blends isometric pixel art and other styles.

title: Cup of Ethanol
description: A free platformer game with a bunch of unique enemies and landscapes. Jump your way through 24 different levels to find that delicious pint.

title: Apex Legends: Arsenal
description:
Before the Apex Games, a more brutal competition held sway: the Thunderdome Games! Here, sibling fighters Sok Leng and Kit Siang Phua reigned supreme. They were joined by August Brinkman, Sok Leng’s eventual husband. But when August’s selfish playstyle led to Kit Siang’s death, August would retreat from the Games, from Sok Leng, and from their young son, Nate.

August spent decades as a recluse. When Nate decides to follow his family’s legacy into the arena, August returns to strike a deal to reenter the Games in his son’s place.

title: Anicon: Animal Complex - Party
description:
The final chapter of Anicon: Animal Complex.

Summer is coming. The entire crew is having a three-day camp together where they meet someone unexpected. Will the truth behind the family be uncovered? What future awaits them? Follow Clena and the animal boys in this fun and heartwarming finale!

title: Farhoud Farmand's The Mountaineer
description:
Farhoud Farmand's The Mountaineer (کوهنورد in Persian) is a 2D platformer that tells the story of Faad, an up-and-coming climber that enters a mountaineering competition known as "The Excellent Climber" with the goal of glory and receiving the certification necessary to be a mountain ranger.

When faced with the unfortunate news that three wanted criminals have fled custody and are causing chaos in the same mountain range as the competition, Faad has to use his natural gifts and wit to overcome his competitive obstacles also bring the fugitives to justice.

title: Gobliiins5
description: A great adventure in 2d for all ages. 16 big levels full of puzzles.

title: Omega Genesis
description:
Ever since May 2022, a file named "Omega Genesis" has been spread in small forums, imageboards and communities throughout the internet. What seems like a cute puzzle game at first hides a variety of mysterious secrets around every corner. There is nothing known about the original creator "Samuel Lazarus", who (besides putting their name in the game) seems to have no digital footprint and is not interested in the discourse around the game. The earliest someone we contacted aquired the game was in early May, where they downloaded it from a link, posted in a thread on a popular imageboard. Up until now the only way to get the game was to get in contact with one of the few, who downloaded it. Now the game is finally available for everyone to explore for themselves.

Please proceed with caution as the game features frightening visuals and hasn't been fully explored by the community yet! We cannot tell you what you might encounter. Play the game at your own risk!

title: Mr.T Survival
description: Mr.T Survival is a survival game set in the wild jungle of nature. Players take on the role of Mr.T, a backpacker on his travel journey who encounters an accident that leaves him stranded on a remote and unfamiliar island. Gather resources to craft items and structures that match your survival style

title: Overdrive Escape
description: Enter the neon-lit world of Overdrive Escape, 3D first-person shooter game that will test your skills. Explore randomly generated levels, fight against waves of enemies, and choose your weapons wisely. Play now and see if you have what it takes to make it out of the city alive!

title: Cities of the World Jigsaw Puzzles: Venice
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 30, 42, 117, or 285 pieces.

title: Cities of the World Jigsaw Puzzles: Sao Paulo
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 30, 42, 117, or 285 pieces.

title: Serial Cleaners: Dino Park
description: Clean up the crime scenes on a mysterious island inhabited by dinosaurs, in Serial Cleaners - Dino Park DLC.

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Floral Nostalgia Set
description: Flowers are a timeless Mother's Day classic.

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Orchid Dreams Set
description: Passionate purple decorations for moms!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Vintage Sunshine Set
description: Walk into the cozy sunshine with these decors!

title: Robolt
description: Run fast and shoot faster as a little robot with a ton of firepower!

title: Laserpitium
description: Blast off on a critical mission to free the galaxy from artificial governance in this side-scrolling 2D shoot’em up!

title: Zoo and Wild Animals Mod: Rebuilt
description: The Zoo and Wild Animals Mod: Rebuilt Mod was made to improve on the original ZAWA mod by adding better animations, behaviors, models and tons of special features! We are planning on adding a total of 100 new species to minecraft over the course of 3 major releases! We are working towards adding the full variety and wonder of the Earth's wildlife to minecraft, from the smallest tree frogs to the massive humpback whale to the intelligent chimpanzee! Alongside the animals is a variety of blocks, plants, items and weapons to help the player survive in the wild, capture animals, and build the best zoo possible! Explore the Wild, Educate yourself on the Animals, and Engineer the world's coolest Zoo!

title: Aaaaxy
description: A nonlinear 2D puzzle platformer taking place in impossible spaces.

title: Let's Bully Nash
description: Let's Bully Nash is a short adventure game about an ex-magicalgirl trying to rescue her fish girlfriend despite the world's refusal to take her seriously. It has a single dungeon, where the boss has vore animations and a "bad end" visual novel segment.

title: Goodnight Tea
description: Goodnight Tea is a small game about a small fairy wanting to go to bed, but needing her girlfriends to snuggle!

title: Dead Girl's Notebook
description:
Dead Girl's Notebook is a visual novel about love, personal growth, self-acceptance, masochism, etc. haphazardly assembled across 15 days for Variety Megajam 2021.

It has 10 chapters, and a little over 20,000 words of narration and dialogue. It is probably around 1 to 2 hours long, depending on how quickly you read. (If you use "auto mode", which advances text automatically at a relaxed pace, it is about 2 hours and 15 minutes long.)

title: Mouse: P.I. For Hire
description: Join private investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. MOUSE combines the charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1930’s with the adrenaline and action of an explosive first person shooter.

title: Zombie Apocalypse: Survival Stories
description: Experience a zombie apocalypse in a visual novel packed with excitement, action, and shocking decisions as you fight to survive in a world infested with the undead.

title: Multiplayer Military
description: Multiplayer Military - Aliens are invading the Military Base. The World needs Your Help. You and Your team of Elite Soldiers must take out all Aliens and Save the Planet.

title: Grand Tanks: WW2 Tank Games
description: Play Grand Tanks for free, unlock new war machines, explore realistic arenas, enjoy the amazing graphics. Constantly updated content that includes techniques, maps, missions, events, and much more. Everything for free and was created to let you enjoy fast and furious blitz battles.

title: Saint Hell
description: Saint Hell is a 2D RPG in which you will need to choose the side of angels or demons and lead them to victory.

title: Multiplayer Turtles
description: Multiplayer Turtles - Evil Frogs are attacking the Turtle Temple. You and Your elite team must Hack & Slash Your way to get rid of the invaders.

title: DriftCE
description:
DriftCE is the definitive drifting simulation videogame.

Take the car to your garage, where you can make major modifications to it. Customising the car, swapping various parts and performing crucial changes tangibly affects car’s performances and behaviours on the track. Replace engine, suspension and exhaust parts yourself to achieve the right performance for your driving style! Create a one of a kind car with visual tuning - change body kits, paint color and decals.

A simulative experience, carefully recreated to deliver the same feeling real drifters get. A fully immersive drifting simulation - with real licensed cars and tracks - featuring different drifting styles: power drift, handbrake and clutch kick.

title: Dread Weight
description: You are being hunted by the ancient witch Baba Yaga. Can you make the right decisions to survive? Or will spirits overtake the mansion?

title: Valeria the Pagan Priestess
description: Valeria the Pagan Priestess is a savage and sexy celebration of old-school dark fantasy themes, modernized with visceral hack-and-slash combat!

title: Super Video Golf
description: Super Video Golf is a turn based 90s themed golf game, with up to 8 players locally or 4 computers online allowing a total of 16 players in a single game. Offline modes include a tutorial, CPU opponents and a driving range.

title: Bloompunk
description: Set in a lush world of living plants, in Bloompunk you must use steampunk technology, harness the power of the sun, grow your living arsenal of weapons and abilities, and fight back against an invasive ravenous force to reset the world's natural balance. Enhance your body with deadly weaponry that's a merge of plant and machine in this fast-paced, chaotic frenzy of bullets and thorns.

title: Birds Aren't Real
description: A short story-driven psychological horror game. No visual jumpscares; only mentally disturbing.

title: Eye 4 Eye
description: Embark on a mission to unveil the truth behind a missing daughter case. Utilize the search engine to gather clues and uncover the dark secrets of TempleTech. Experience a suspenseful journey through the eyes of Hazel.

title: Manas
description: Manas is an action-adventure game set in medieval Central Asia that immerses you in a land of mountains, valleys, and nomadic culture. Inspired by the Kyrgyz epic of the legendary hero, Manas, you'll defend your village against ruthless invaders with the aid of your faithful steed, Akkula. Through engaging visuals and innovative mounted combat, witness the beginning of Manas' epic journey!

title: Convergence: A League of Legends Story - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of Convergence: A League of Legends Story includes:
- Star Guardian Ekko Skin Pack
- Ruined Ekko Skin Pack
- Convergence Digital Comic and Art Book

Rewind the Past, Control the Future

Traverse the sprawling city of Zaun as Ekko, a young inventor with a device to rewind time. He and his friends must work together to keep their city safe, but as danger looms and secrets come to light, Ekko realizes he can't trust anyone—not even himself.

title: Bounda Forever
description: A lovely style of painting rogue-like games. In the game you face a tide of enemies, defeat them, and survive. The game offers many weapons to help you win. No long story, no ending, any time you can be reckless to a game.

title: Shopping Clutter 7: Food Detectives
description: Shopping Clutter 7 - Food Detectives unwraps a shocking investigation. The Walker family restaurant has been targeted by a criminal, and now all their recipes are gone! Follow the clues and find hidden objects to locate the recipes and save their cooking dreams.

title: Shopping Clutter 8: From Gloom to Bloom
description: Shopping Clutter 8 - From Gloom to Bloom surrounds you with a floral Puzzle festival. When Auntie Sheep decides to search for rare flowers, she leaves her beautiful shop in hands of Sloth Walker. Yet trouble ensues! Can you clean up the shop before Auntie Sheep returns?

title: Camelot: Wrath of the Green Knight - Collector's Edition
description: Camelot: Home of King Arthur’s court… and intrigue! When the Lady of the Lake goes missing, her husband the Green Knight blames King Arthur, threatening the peace of Camelot for all…

title: No Legs? No Problem!
description: Be the first to reach the goal in this intense 4 player racing game. Challenge your friends to a free for all or team up in an epic 2v2 race battle. Use your abilities to grief your enemies, or boost yourself to the finish line.

title: The Wailer
description: A highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. With torch in hand, explore and find a way to escape before falling prey to the unspeakable horror that lurks within.

title: Spook Bowl
description: In Spook Bowl, lead your team of monstrous college athletes in a turn-based ball game like no other. Assemble a winning team with the unique abilities and stories of each character. Find your own way to score and unravel the enigmatic secrets of this university tournament.

title: Goonya Monster: Additional Character (Buster) - Jingiskan's Jinkun/Mascot Character
description: Additional Character for "Goonya Monster". Purchasing this item adds the following Buster as a character that can be used in gameplay. - Jingiskan's Jinkun/Mascot Character (Buster)

title: Goonya Monster: Additional Character (Buster) - Puimo/Mascot Character
description: Additional Character for "Goonya Monster". Purchasing this item adds the following Buster as a character that can be used in gameplay. - Puimo/Mascot Character (Buster)

title: Goonya Monster: Additional Character (Buster) - Nagomi Shibakko/Mascot Character
description: Additional Character for "Goonya Monster". Purchasing this item adds the following Buster as a character that can be used in gameplay. - Nagomi Shibakko/Mascot Character (Buster)

title: Unicyclist
description: A toy platformer that's easy to learn, hard to master.

title: VR Tribes: Non-VR Edition
description: VR vs PC. Show which player is stronger. VR TRIBES is an action-packed online multiplayer battle. One in VR and up to three as PC players. As VR player you have to conquer the island. The PC players have to join together to attack and defeat the VR player.

title: The Seven Awakenings: I Randall
description: Run your own shop in the Middle Ages. Manage your economy and serve your customers well. Collect the elements to discover who you were in your previous life and fight off bandits if necessary. Unveil the veil of prophecies and discover your own secret.

title: Zoo Park Story
description:
Ready to build the zoo of your dreams? Depart on wild adventures to find exotic fauna, exploring all manner of environments from savanna to tundra, jungle and beyond! Give your new animal friends a home and take your zoo to the top of the industry!
Savor the thrill of opening day. Feed the animals in your burgeoning lineup—even give them the occasional treat to show you care! From apples to acorns, meat, and more, tailor your critters' diet according to their natural habitat. On that note, do the same with the surrounding flora too!

title: Indagator
description: A visual novel fangame.

title: Go! Go! Hamster Chef!
description: Help Hamster Chef cook yummy dishes and deliver them to his animal pals in this short, colorful, and definitely-not-spooky adventure.

title: Sybil is Haunted
description: Sybil has a very scrambled mind. Some days she just needs you to push her along. Help Sybil navigate the horrors of her bedroom and see what adventures await. Find every ending to see what lays in her future. HYIPHYOP

title: A Bouquet of My Beloveds
description: Sekai Project will release Cosmillica's "A Bouquet of My Beloveds" (Subete no Koi ni, Hanabata wo.), a yuri visual novel, in English for PC via Steam.

title: Water Wheel
description: Water Wheel is a short adventure game where you must escape a strange apartment. The machine that delivers food to the residents has stopped working. Now your only choice is to find a way out.

title: Stellata Waterway
description: An endless runner heavily inspired by the hoverboard levels from Klonoa 2 and retro PlayStation graphics.

title: Beyond the Veil: A Kitty Cat Mystery Adventure
description: Beyond the Veil: A Kitty Cat Mystery Adventure is a 2D puzzle platformer where you and your trusty assistant switch between charming detective and adorable kitty cat to solve the case of your missing coworker.

title: Cervus Blade
description: Cervus Blade is a 3rd person action adventure game set in a deer-worshiping desert world with challenging hardcore combat.

title: A Game Called Paako
description: A Game Called Paako is a pixel-art 2D platformer metagame that tells the story of a game major grad student named Chaoran making his thesis game project A Game Called Paako.

title: Wild Thaw
description: Wild Thaw is a third-person platformer about a fireball facing down a mountain of ice.

title: Ghost Writer
description: A whimsical desktop idle focus game. The perfect desktop work companion if you require a little tired ghost typing away at a typewriter.

title: Gradually Jojo ni
description: A game where you play as a runner who is rushing to the goal. As you constantly speed up towards your goals, you may wonder to yourself, ‘what am I missing along my path?’ Slow down by pressing the button and you may see something you didn’t realize was there. Enjoy the environment and have a rest with simple interactions. Remember, the goal will always be there, and you can take your time.

title: Healing Beat
description: In Healing Beat, you are challenged to listen and learn the music of the plant, and match your movement to the rhythm.

title: A Hero's Journey
description: The story of the prince and the dragon is a common RPG story type. In the real world, aren't we also in the process of hunting the dragon and then gradually realizing the operating rules of the world around us? Therefore, this game slightly adapts the story and aims to explore the relationship between life and the world, especially in the context of Chinese-style education.

title: In the Nick of Tie-m
description: Join Nick in his getaway chase and escape the scene of the crime by stealthily making your way through the city back to his hideout. Traverse rooftops, sneak past searchlights, hurtle through windows into apartments, and climb up fire escapes in order to escape. Avoid making too much noise or standing in the light for too long because the police will detect you!

title: Starweave
description: Starweave is a narrative game that uses tactical RPG mechanics to tell an allegorical story about constricting roles within a cycle of oppression. Dramatic and bittersweet, you endeavor to make the world just a little bit kinder through your actions.

title: Killer Bunny
description: Killer Bunny is an action-based platformer where players will traverse wild lands as a bunny protagonist, hunting the wretched spiders and snakes that killed their parents. At the end of the game, the bunny will face “Daddy Snake” and “Mommy Spider” — the primordial beings responsible for all spider and snake spawn.

title: Last Broadcast
description: Last Broadcast is a 3D narrative game set in a small radio station at the end of the world. Players assume the role of D-Jay, a charismatic radio host who is giving their last show as the sun turns red and the world burns down.

title: Love Next Door
description: Have you ever looked at a door and thought, “Wow, I’d love to go on a date with that?” Well now you can, in Love Next Door! Swipe on a door you want to date and talk your way into their hearts! Don't worry about how unhinged they may be…

title: MOON: Metagalactic Observer - OmNipotent
description:
Welcome to MOON.

Extraterrestrial life has been detected, along with valuable resources. Gather Moonium Ores and MOON Artifacts, attack your opponent and defend yourself to ensure survival.

Caution: If you lose all your MOON Artifacts, you’re as good as dead.

Good luck, Player.

title: The Mountain Calls
description: The Mountain Calls is a 2D puzzle platformer where the player takes on the role of a Feng Shui priest who uses elements from nature to repair broken incantations, preventing a disaster from befalling the village.

title: Radio Exurbia
description: Radio Exurbia is a driving game about music and discovery as you explore a surreal landscape of twisted suburbs and sentient muscle cars. Use your Reality-Modulating radio to swap between worlds as you experience the stability of suburbia and the sublime excitement of the unknown, all set to a high-octane original soundtrack. Turn the key, tune in and swap worlds.

title: Valiant: Or, Val's guide to having a broken vag
description: (val)iant is a single-player, browser-based narrative game about pelvic pain. Play as Val, a nonbinary college student struggling with their relationship to their body, as well as their relationship with sex. This game is fundamentally about how we as a society learn (or don't learn) about sex.

title: Little Duty 1
description: Little Duty is a Multiplayer Game , with simple game mode for now team death match and ffa death match , it is curently simple, because i wanted to try to make it like that , you don 't need to buy guns to make experience for unlocking guns , just lets get some fun each other that's all .

title: Enderal: The Shards of Order
description:
Enderal is a total conversion for TES V: Skyrim: a game modification that is set in its own world with its own landscape, lore and story. It offers an immersive open world, all for the player to explore, overhauled skill systems and gameplay mechanics and a dark, psychological storyline with believable characters.

Enderal is free and can be played by anyone owning a legal copy of TES V: Skyrim. (No DLCs are necessary.) It is developed non-commercially by SureAI, the team behind the renowned Oblivion mod "Nehrim: At Fate´s Edge" (and various other projects).

title: Paperquarium
description: Paperquarium is the result of magic and the desire of your doodly fishes becoming alive. It gives you the chance to take care of your own virtual, doodly fish pets, to see them grow and interact on real timescale!

title: The Dawn is Inevitable
description: The Dawn is Inevitable is an interactive crime drama/neo-western novel inspired by classic RPG games. A mysterious stranger is forced to hide in a village called Rassvet. This place is isolated from the outside world for the whole winter and keeps many dark secrets.

title: BrasFoot 2003
description: BrasFoot 2003 is the first iteration of the soccer management simulator focused on Brazilian teams where you can buy and view players from other teams at any time during the game, manually select players for each match, change the ticket prices of the game at any time, and much more.

title: Last Remains
description: Last Remains is a 50-player zombie battle royale game where survivors compete in a PvPvE world and take risks on their journey to the extraction point by searching buildings to find food, water, and digital collectible skins such as equipment and weapons.

title: Hot Cocoa Magic!
description: "Hot Cocoa Magic!" is a kinetic visual novel about a socially anxious witch and the power of hot cocoa!

title: Ravenhaul
description:
Queen Isadora III needs a high performing avian delivery service, and you are the right one to make her happy!

Get birds, get patrons, get contracts - Work hard, peck hard, enjoy your hard earned kernels, that's how we roll in bird county.

title: The Empress of Mahjong
description: The Empress invites you to play! Immerse yourself in the amazingly beautiful locations of Asia and complete mahjong levels approved by the Empress herself!

title: Hime's Blossom
description: Spring rain, sakura petals are slowly falling off... You can feel the sweet scent of flowers in the air. Each of the princesses is looking for her own special petal...

title: Saints Row: The Heist & The Hazardous
description: When an obnoxious movie star double-crosses the Boss, the Saints take revenge with a swaggering, black-tie heist.

title: Return to Grace
description: A daring space archaeologist has just unearthed the ancient resting place of a long lost A.I. god known as Grace. Adventure with various fractured A.I. personalities as you uncover the great mystery of why she was shut down all those years ago.

title: After You: Level Escape
description: "After You: Level Escape" is a narrative game with puzzles, but it is not an easy game, here you will not have indicators or tutorials, nor can you save when you want. In "After You - Level Escape" you need to put all your attention and use paper and pencil to move forward, if you're looking for an easy game, this is not your game.

title: Pegafuerte el Terrible
description: You are a man with a mission: shoot all the aliens that are trying to take over the world and rescue your little town "the powerful candle" Side scrolling platform game, similar to "Metal Slug", single player, offline, many checkpoints and varied levels!

title: Anima Flux
description: Anima Flux is a couch co-op metroidvania with two genetically enhanced soldiers, special agents of a theocratic dictatorial regime. Fight your way through swarms of mutants through a desolate, dystopian space city and save humanity's last stronghold, if, of course, anyone is still alive

title: Quiz Thiz Croatia: Bronze Edition
description: Are you the new quiz master and can you beat your friends on this quiz? Answer questions about this country and collect valuable points! Also, learn new facts about this country while playing!

title: Cubic Figures 2
description: Make up figures from shaped blocks!

title: Zenful Journey
description: Step into a world of serenity and tranquility with Zenful Journey, the ultimate walking simulator for those seeking a moment of calm in their day. This zen-themed game invites you to explore a beautiful forest at your own pace, ticking off items on your list as you go.

title: Arcade Archives: Mazinger Z
description:
"Mazinger Z" is a shooter released by Banpresto (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Take control of Mazinger Z, Great Mazinger, and Grendizer, and use shooting, punches, and super weapons to take on Dr. Hell's Underground Empire! Supports up to two players at once.

title: Super Kids Racing: Snow Edition
description:
Super Kids Racing: Snow Edition offers wide variety of challenges with many different types of vehicles to choose from. Players will love to complete these challenges with their friends in split-screen multiplayer mode.

Get ready for ultimate racing adventure with your friends and family.

title: Ever Maiden: Daraku no Sono no Otome-tachi
description: This story is about “Puellarium", a school isolated from the outside world by fog and thorns. Here strict discipline is always in effect, where the air always tense and time never disturbed. However, one morning a girl was found unconscious in front of the school gate. This gate is always closed and should only open on special occasions. The guards, on alert, asked her to name herself to which she replied "Alouette." At that moment, the bell of the clock tower, which was rusty and always silent, rang out. "When the bell of the clock tower rings, the end of this school will come soon."

title: Jinki: Infinity
description: JINKI Infinity is an action-packed video game set in a futuristic world where players take on the role of a skilled pilot controlling a powerful mecha. With fast-paced gameplay and an immersive storyline, players will battle against a wide range of enemy mechas, each with their unique strengths and weaknesses.

title: Gronk Want Rock
description: You play as Gronk. Gronk likes to collect rocks, the best rocks are at the bottom of deep caverns. You have to bring Gronk's favorite rock up to his house by carefully throwing the rock onto flat platforms on the walls of the cavern.

title: Pogglewash
description: A 3D platformer in which you play as a robot on an alien planet cleaning up polluted goop while interacting with cute creatures named Pogglewonks.

title: SystemCrash92
description: Face the machines of the evil hacker in this action roguelite. Your avatar will assist you in battle as you improve your skills with items and level up to build a powerful strategy. An unforgettable adventure for survival fans!

title: Gun and Girl
description: Experience the combination of shooting and puzzle elements

title: Parallel Paths
description: Run, Jump, & Swing your way to the top. Beat the clock and collect Upgrades. Find your dimension before time runs out.

title: Angel Legion: Lil Lily - Purple
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Heartbeat Hospital: Love, Lies, and Betrayal
description: A visual novel where decisions matter. Love, lies, and betrayal await in this gripping interactive story. Multiple endings!

title: Japanese Escape Games: The House
description: The owner of a house gave a warm welcome to me who got lost. I fell asleep and woke up.

title: Apploval
description: New sensation! Real-time roguelike! Automatically generated random dungeon! The level is reset every time, so you can enjoy it again.

title: Kam Thunder
description: Kam Thunder is a 2D platformer action-adventure game. It is a fast-paced project with a hack and slash style that requires constant movement, and a shallow story that focuses more on gameplay and effects.

title: Retro Rocket Raiders
description: An old school fast action twin stick shmup, featuring more than 20 weapons that you can equip your ship with and 30 different enemies

title: V Rising: Secrets of Gloomrot
description:
A FRESH CHAPTER ON YOUR VAMPIRE JOURNEY!
Behold new footage of the coming update, just one week away on May the 17th. For those of you who have missed it, here's a quick catch-up on some of the features you can expect to revamp your blood-sucking experience.

With this update comes multi-level castles, the new territory system, and sweeping improvements to building and decorating your lair! Finally, you have the tools to make a mighty citadel worthy of your power.

Vardoran has been reimagined! From beautiful new vistas that house terrifying and mystifying new threats to the cursed, choking mist that completely warps the Cursed Forest experience, you can discover the human-infested lands as if it's your first time again.

A massive new zone with two unique areas twisted in the pursuit of cruel science. Navigate polluted valleys and lightning-scorched highlands to face the mutated experiments and mechanical wonder spawned from the maddened imaginations of the Trancendum.

title: Blind Jump
description: A brutally difficult platformer where all the platforms are invisible. Use your slime to unveil the platforms and carefully jump your way to the top.

title: Tim Climpy's Warfair
description: Indie Multiplayer FPS game in Early Access. Low Poly graphics, multiple gamemodes

title: SnowDropRock
description: An action Match-3 puzzler taking place on a seesaw.

title: Fallen Fallen
description: "The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding." - Proverbs 9:10

title: A Change of Heart: A Magical Girl Adventure
description:
June Mejos is a regular high school student by day... but at night, she's a Magical Girl! With her friends, she fights Nightmares that threaten to cloud our world using the magic of Dreams.

Today is a special day for June but her friends have forgotten and ditched her! She's always been there for them. June's had enough... if they can't remember a simple day, she doesn't need them anyway. She'll prove she's strong enough to fight by herself.

And yet... something is happening inside her.

title: GhostVac
description: Your own ghost-sucking electromechanical arcade machine at home!

title: Remote Bot
description:
Beholding the future is not the way the greats do. The greats don’t watch, they make! Seize your chance! Take control of a robot via ssh. Command your robot with a brand new command line interface and make them walk, climb, or maybe even make a cup of coffee!

Platformer games, annoying as never before.
Connect numbers together while diving deeper and deeper into the machinery called 0 = 0 = 0.

title: Suburban Basketball
description: Play as John Basketball, rising the ranks of Basketball City's social hierarchy and becoming boss.

title: Station-8
description: Explore a research station in this short platformer.

title: Indiepocalypse #5
description: Issue #5 of a monthly indie game anthology collecting games from 10 developers.

title: Editor-dle
description: A 5-letter word based guessing game based around video editing terms.

title: Mr. Run and Jump
description: Mr Run and Jump draws you in with precise level design, free-flowing gameplay, and formidable challenge. Silky controls encourage players to run, jump, dash, double jump, and roll to clear levels with style, making it a speedrunner’s dream. Collectibles hidden in tough-to-reach spots demand players use their wits as well as their dexterity. Dynamic Assistance options allow players to set the level of difficulty they want. No matter how you play, Mr Run and Jump offers engaging gameplay options to players of varying skill levels and approaches.

title: MurmAllmaus
description: MurmALLmaus is a point-and-click adventure about the Murmous Mouse and your crazy journey through space on the way to your mice. Accompany them on their way and click through spaceships, department stores and alleys, but be careful: it gets cringe!
