title: Haunted Horror Stories: Gone With The Wind
description:
HHS: Gone With The Wind is a single player game with psx era aesthetics.
An authentic retro horror with music, fixed cameras, environment, graphics, filters, and gameplay faithful to its aesthetics.

title: Forbidden
description: Forbidden is a mystery and romance visual novel where the player has the opportunity to choose their own adventure. The player will have to choose a subject for their thesis: History, Mathematics or Literature. You'll unlock different scenes and illustrations with each characters, in addition to have the opportunity to create a bond, learn more about them and their own secrets. Maybe even fall for one of them? Or have a platonic and friendly relationship? The choice is yours!

title: Mojito the Cat: Premium Edition
description: Jump into action in this quirky puzzle game. Travel the world along with an adorable cat named Mojito (or one of his friends).

title: League of Enthusiastic Losers: Complete Edition
description: Just because others call you a loser, doesn't mean you are one. Make the journey to the 90s Moscow and experience an adventure about friendship and finding your true self.

title: Family Chess: Superb Edition
description: Prepare for loads of fun with this cartoon version of the most popular board game in the world.

title: Clumsy Rush: Ultimate Guys - Happy Edition
description: Clumsy Rush: Ultimate Guys Happy Edition is a fun-centric party game which throws you (along with your friends) into a series of challenges and races throughout randomly generated tracks. Enjoy new decorations and get ready for loads of fun.

title: Catgotchi: Virtual Pet - Deluxe Edition
description: Welcome to Catgotchi: Virtual Pet, the ultimate game for all cat lovers! Raise and care for your virtual pet. These adorable pixel-art cats are sure to steal your heart!

title: Brain Memory: Legendary Edition
description:
Help your child harness the hidden potential of their mind. Use these colorfull cards to improve their memory skills.
Brain Memory improves on the classic formula of memory games. It lets you increase the difficulty level at your own pace, and customize challenges to one's taste.

Our brains are the most important tools of the XXI century. Do your child a favor, and give thema gift that will help them reach their full potential.

title: Bit Orchard: Animal Valley - GOTY Edition
description: Pull out weeds, plant new apple trees and gather the literal fruits of your labour. With time, you'll discover ways to make your life easier and explore this charming 2D world.

title: Loud: RockStar Edition
description: Get ready to rock & roll with this bundle in a heartwarming music arcade rhythm game!

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 2 - Episode 06
description: Season 2 Episode 6: Crescent High School Friend Club! To make up for becoming a Loser again, Pizza Boy helps throw a housewarming party for Holden's new roommate.

title: Greed and Grind
description: Hello guys I am bringing you this time around a small cozy little game about greed and grinding!! If you played my prevous games you should know what to expect! If you didnt... This is a small Idle game where the character battles autommatically while everything you do is drink a coffee.

title: Butterflies
description: Butterflies is a video game about inline skating and graffiti. Apparently some people did that before, but they don't seem like they'll be doing it anymore.

title: Kortstrid
description: Kortstrid: a captivating TCG in a vast fantasy world. Battle with unique heroes, foes, and companions in strategic, ever-evolving gameplay. Dive into an enthralling adventure filled with camaraderie!

title: Star Defence
description: Star Defence is a unit-placement real-time tower defense game in which you can place any unit you like on a 2D free-form plane. All units in the game, including enemies, are composed of units you place. Place your units in a balance between enemies and allies to develop your civilization.

title: Kingmaker Academy: Warrior's Duels
description: Dear warriors of the Kingmaker Academy! Face your talented colleagues in challenging duels at our school's most important tournament! Improve your skills with each duel, become the king of warriors and rule the school. But beware, remember it's a roguelike! You dont want to be eliminated, do you?!

title: Galactic Conquest Battle Infinity
description: In the year 3200. The Ethernal ore used as fuel for spaceships was beginning to run out, a galactic war broke out for control of the Ethernal, the galactic emperor Erick V issued a challenge to achieve peace, "the faction that can produce the most Ethernal will control the entire galaxy".

title: War Tank Machine Battle Vehicle Simulator
description: War Tank Machine is an action-packed game that puts players in the driver's seat of a powerful military tank, ready to take on enemy forces on the battlefield. With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, players will experience the adrenaline rush of warfare as they engage in explosive tank battles across different terrains and landscapes.

title: Move the Pin: Classic Logic Puzzle
description: Classic ball puzzle - color each ball, pull the pin and fill the glass with colored balls!

title: BlackJack Waifu Tour
description: Feel like in Las Vegas, gamble without spending money at our real blackjack!

title: Find the Pairs: Classic Memory Puzzle
description: The classic memory training puzzle for the whole family - find a matching pairs!

title: Dig Deep: Complete Edition
description:
Grab a shovel and let's get digging! Join the adventure, hire miners and dig for a treasure.
Shovel your way to success: go underground and dig for treasure like a mole on a mission. But don't worry, you won't get stuck in a hole - unless you forget to hire workers to boost your digging empire.

title: Dying Light: Definitive Edition & Call of Juarez: Gunslinger
description:
The ultimate Zombie and Wild West experiences are now in one bundle!
Includes Dying Light: Definitive Edition + Call of Juarez: Gunslinger!

title: Sport & Fun: Swimming - Special Edition
description: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.

title: Isle of Jura Fishing Trip: Deluxe Edition
description: Visit the remarkable Isle of Jura and catch some delicious fish!

title: Rainbow Runner
description: Play as THE Rainbow Runner

title: Piczle Lines 2: Flora & Fauna
description:
"Flora & Fauna”adds the following puzzle packs to Puzzle Mode:
- Flora 20 puzzles
- Baby Animals 20 puzzles
- Safari 20 puzzles
- Venemous Critters 20 puzzles

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Castles and Palaces 4
description: Majestic buildings and architecture from different eras. Assemble puzzles and enjoy great pictures.

title: Situation Tarfu
description: Situation Tarfu is a simple get to the top arcade game with multiple playable characters each with their own stats!

title: Zombiax Evil
description: Survive as long as possible against the zombie horde of Zombiax Evil ! Alone or in coop mode, play as an elite soldier, arm yourself to the teeth and try to rid the whole of humanity of zombie vermin ! Become a Legend of the Resistance !

title: 3D Puzzle: Last of City
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: Cities of the World Jigsaw Puzzles: Rio de Janeiro
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 30, 42, 117, or 285 pieces.

title: Cities of the World Jigsaw Puzzles: Mexico City
description: Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 30, 42, 117, or 285 pieces.

title: Haunted Legends: The Call of Despair - Collector's Edition
description: People in Nulver Town are turning into crystal and more appear on the streets each day! Can you find out who's behind these strange transformations and save the town before it's too late?

title: The House 2
description: The sequel to The House. Explore a haunted house that nobody has entered for decades. The family who lived there before committed suicide, but nobody knows why.

title: Tikrace
description:
Parkour, cyberpunk, neon are what you get in the Tikrace. Run for your life and set new time records on various maps.
Tikrace brings unique and skill based movement to the table, highly inspired by classic FPS titles, set in a SCI-FI setting

title: The Elephant Collection
description: The Elephant Collection remasters ten of jmtb02’s classic blue elephant games into one mammoth-sized package! From puzzle platformers to rapid-fire arcade games, this collection of ten Armor Games classics is tied together by a new overarching metanarrative.

title: Dontforget Connected
description: Dontforget Connected is an online multiplayer Undertale/Deltarune fan-game with MMORPG-style gameplay. It features a new underground to explore, over 50 playable characters, new battle mechanics, and much more!

title: Classmates
description:
June goes over to her classmate, Ian's house, to hand him some study notes. Soon enough, she finds herself unable to leave...

Help June escape by solving puzzles, and hiding from her kidnapper.

title: Söldner: Secret Wars Remastered
description: Söldner! Enjoy third-person combat, make use of a fully destructible environment. Customize your character and start combat on the huge worldmap (6500*3500 km), selecting your gear from over 100 firearms. Get into battle the way you want by employing over 120 vehicles. Take your tour now!

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 6
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Idiot Maiden
description:
Rana, a girl who had came back from a Halloween party, was abducted by three mysterious talking dolls who wanted to use her body for a ritual to summon the vampire prince.

Not wanting to be part of any of it, Rana runs out and locks the dolls in their own ritual room. Now she must find a way out of a spooky house!

title: Mountain of Ape
description: This game was created using the engine "Cheetah-man 3 Tsukuuru" by the game development circle "AlphaSecretBase（あるふぁ～秘密基地）."

title: Rose From The Depths
description: A visual novel about the recovery of a woman traumatized by an abusive relationship.

title: Hayaku! Island of Darkness
description: Explore a mysterious island full of dangers and uncover the secrets behind the anomalous creatures that inhabit it in this retro-style metroidvania.

title: Harlem Blade II: Dark Angel
description: Our guy left his childhood girl and went to war against a monster after his father got killed in it. When he came back a year later, he was just in time to see his childhood girl taken away by the monster's army. He joined the resistance and started to find her. Within 30 days, he can help girls who will join him in the fight.

title: FPS1
description: A short game about using an explosive bolt gun. Pin enemies with the bolt gun, then when the time is right, explode them!

title: Level 22
description: Gary is an office worker who overslept after a drunken night out in town. Here's where it gets tricky, because this isn't the first time Gary's been late for work, and he could be fired if he's spotted arriving at his desk after everyone else yet again. So he’ll have to prove his smartness and slyness to make his way up the 22 floors standing between him and his office without being caught.

title: A Conscious Decision
description: You are a wisp of consciousness in Jane's mind. Uncover the details of her past, make choices in the present and play until you attain a happy future.

title: Vagrant.exe
description: There is strange feedback from this derelict office. Its wall full of faint echoes that whisper a sedated memory of normalcy. Articles artifacts and relics of slaves in white collars now lost to a stasis in time. There are other things to discover, if one is brave enough to see it through... you are the Vagrant.exe.

title: The Secret Life of Probes Prologue
description: Converse with the unlikely inhabitants of our galaxy. Use tools, applications, and learned information to discover your place in the cosmos.

title: Niatang
description: A short visual novel taking place in a cyberpunk setting affected by global warming, discussing the topic of waste management.

title: Indiepocalypse #6
description: Issue #6 of a monthly indie game anthology collecting games from 10 developers.

title: Yunoia
description: Iris, a light spirit, tends to the color of her world with a prismatic mask. One day, darkness envelops the skies and it begins to vacuum away the colors of her beloved Eden. Set out on a journey together to restore this world by dispersing the iridescence that can be found within.

title: Mythical Agent
description: Mythical Agent: a thrilling SRPG set in Diyu, the realm of the dead. You are Agent Urassik, a secret agent who must lead Unit 7, an anti-terrorist squad against demonic forces. Spend time with your crew and every choice will shape your destiny and the fate of the underworld in this epic adventure!

title: Veriscape
description: Veriscape is a 2D side-scroller where the map tiles are generated using music

title: Thunder
description:
Thunder is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are running in the middle of a thunderstorm. Collect the stars that form when lightning strikes the ground to score points. But avoid getting hit by lightning. Reverse your direction by pressing a button or by hitting the sides of the screen.

The game is over when you get struck.

title: Succubus: Red Goddess
description: A huge expansion for Succubus, which expands the plot of the game and allows you to play as the Red Goddess!

title: Wolf Souls
description: Dark and unforgiving world of Wolf Souls, a Souls-like RPG where you play as a strong woman battling challenging bosses with magic and a variety of weapons.

title: Kongming's Fiendish Maze
description: When you enter Kongming's fiendish maze you have 15 minutes to escape. Pick up a weapon to kill enemies. Find the health crate to restore your health. Use the mini map to guide you. Follow the clues to freedom. It's just you against the maze. Good luck!

title: Final Project
description:
A single player mod with 10 large SP maps that will give you about 10 hours of gameplay.

A story of a modder making a mod sounds a little strange, but that’s what this mod is. However, you spend 95% of your time playing, so don’t worry it’s not just narration or a tutorial.

Play the scenarios you are given and see if you can make it into the sunset.

title: Apple Knight 2
description:
Become the Ultimate Hero!

Dive into intense hack-and-slash action as you battle through hordes of enemies in this action platformer! Explore treacherous dungeons, and unlock a vast arsenal of weapons, skins, abilities, and pets!

title: Barro F22
description: Barro F22 is the new generation for the fast version of Barro, now with a new style of race tracks but, with the good old toy car/ go kart arcade style!

title: Barro GT
description: Barro GT is the new generation of Barro, now with a new style of race tracks but, with the good old toy car/ go kart arcade style!

title: Nothing Bad Ever Happens to Me
description:
Nothing Bad Ever Happens to me, is a short, 5 ~ 10min. story about a few girls who don't really get along.

Katrina, our heroine, is a popular girl who has had great luck in her life thus far. She's at the top of her class, her family is happy... she probably couldn't ask for a more perfect life!

One day, a few of her classmates suggest they walk home together. Might not be a bad idea to humor the lower-class.

What could go wrong?

title: Tenet of the Spark
description: Tenet of the Spark is a cinematic action game where you seamlessly switch between 3 timelines — modern day, Viking age, and Aztec world — to get the edge in battle. Crush enemies, solve time-bending puzzles, and explore 3 distinct worlds full of rich history and unique characters.

title: Detective Chirpums: Private Investigator
description:
They say the city's a roost for every bird.

Detective Chirpums is more than happy to disagree with that. Almost as much as he is downing a bottle of Grackle's Finest in one sitting.

He's the city's best detective. He's the city's only detective. Because someone had to.

And he's got a new case. It's his only chance at paying rent for the month. And not unlike too many of his cases, this one comes with a dame in sheep's clothing.”

title: Giselle
description:
"I tend to sit alone... and talk to myself, and in the emptiness of my room... I hear my thoughts."

Giselle is a short, creepy puzzle RPG maker game, where you play as a young girl, trying to leave her room without getting consumed by her own thoughts.

title: Hawken Reborn
description:
Return to the world of high-octane mech combat in Hawken Reborn. Construct your ultimate war machine and shoot your way through hordes of enemies to uncover the mysteries of Ilall in this brand-new Free-to-Play PVE mech game.

Hawken Reborn is a PvE first person shooter, whilst the original Hawken was an exclusively PvP experience. Pilots may not be going head-to-head in Hawken Reborn against each other, but they can expect just as much combat and high-octane mech fighting as you explore the new world of Illal.

title: Isha no Mahou Toshoshitsu
description: Isha's Magical Library is an indie roguelike game in Japanese, published in 2023. It is free to play.

title: Tricky Tracks 2010
description: Drive a four-wheel drive buggy over complicated, aerial tracks as quickly as possible while trying not to fall off. Includes a track editor.

title: Vikings Hnefatafl: Kings of the Dark Age
description: In the late 8th century, Anglo-Saxon Britain faces a threat like none before: northmen from across the seas, also called Vikings. In Vikings Hnefatafl: Kings of the Dark Age, you will be leading either the Vikings or the Saxons into battle by means of turn-based strategy.

title: Dream Job: Delivery Simulator
description: Delivery simulator in pre-solar punk world.

title: Picket Line
description: Picket Line is a casual single-player tower defense game that tells the story of a factory strike in 20th century Europe. Players act as the Union by controlling the workers who form a picket line. The goal of the game is to block any potential workers who want to enter the factory to keep it working (popularly known as Scabs), and to hold the strike long enough until the factory gives up and accepts the Union's terms.

title: 98xx
description: The 98xx software was dug up with only a few working files remaining. You must navigate through each item and see what they do. Perhaps something might happen.

title: Demon Scrolls
description: Stop the Primagen before he can find the Demon Scrolls to usher in an Age of Darkness in this Single Player RPG

title: Clicks Of Courage
description: Clicks of Courage is an action RPG. You must guide your hero in a medieval fantasy world and destroy other factions to win the competition for domination.

title: Edemn: Cyborg Skeleton
description: A metallic cyborg designed to destroy everything in its path.

title: Agatha Christie: Murder on the Orient Express - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of Agatha Christie: Murder on the Orient Express includes:
- The Game Original Soundtrack
- Detective Avatars (Hercule Poirot & Joanna Locke)
- The Art of: Murder on the Orient Express - HD Digital Artbook
- 3 HD Wallpapers

title: Wheelie Life
description: Welcome to Wheelie Life 2, the best online wheelie game yet. Enjoy the online mode, where you can create or join rooms to play with your friends and more players.

title: Thea 2: Rat Tales & More
description: The long-awaited DLC for Thea 2: The Shattering containing new stories, characters, classes, and pets.

title: Naval Action: Rotterdam
description: "Rotterdam" is a beautiful and heavily armed West Indiaman built for the Rotterdam chamber of the Geoctrooieerde Westindische Compagnie.

title: Byakuya Museum
description: “I should have...died...”Opened eyes again, he found himself in a bustling museum!Players need to take on the role of a raven specimen boy "Gregorio" to explore the Byakuya Museum. Your mission is to plumb the secrets of Time Town, uncover your own past, and escape from the museum.

title: Powerstar Golf: Rocky Ridge
description: This item expands your Powerstar Golf experience with a new course, a new character, new career events, and more!

title: Last Labyrinth: Lucidity Lost
description: An escape adventure game in which you work with "Katia," a girl who speaks a mysterious language, to escape from a hall where death traps are set.

title: Powerstar Golf: Emperor's Garden
description: This item expands your Powerstar Golf experience with a new course, a new character, new career events, and more!

title: Midnight Cycle in Muxi Town
description: What kind of work is this? This is an experimental multi storyline game. The work tells a science fiction story about consciousness implantation and simulated biological experiments. The work consists of a mixture of 22 storylines, 3 types of reincarnation endings, and 1 main ending.

title: Norn9: Last Era - Limited Edition
description:
Fandisc for Norn9.
Limited Edition Includes:
15" x 25" Cloth Poster
Collectible Artbook
Set of 11 vinyl Hiyoko Stickers
3" Acrylic Keychain w/ chibi artwork
All in a collectible box

title: Remember to Remember
description: Remember to Remember is a Yume Nikki fangame by emrbt. You play as Pale, a boy with amnesia who is staying in a hospital.

title: Taito Milestones 2
description: On the heels of last year’s first Taito Milestones comes a new collection with more of Taito’s arcade classics.

title: Shape Shipper
description:
Welcome to shape shipper!

You have been tasked to construct items out of raw materials to be shipped off to customers! Try to keep up with the demand!

title: Apple Quest Monsters DX
description: Over 100 pages containing 85 lovingly crafted sprites and descriptions of monsters, a map, photos and more; all from a non existant RPG, inspired by my childhood love of reading strategy guides for games I never played.

title: Diablo IV: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Diablo IV is the next-gen action RPG experience with endless evil to slaughter, countless abilities to master, nightmarish Dungeons, and legendary loot.

This is only the beginning for Diablo IV, with new events, stories, seasons, rewards, and more looming on the horizon.

title: Diablo IV: Ultimate Edition
description: Endless demons to slaughter. Deep customization through Talents, Skill Points, Runes, and Legendary loot. Randomized dungeons contained in a dynamic open world. Survive and conquer darkness—or succumb to the shadows.

title: Beep Boop
description: Beep is back, and this time he has a sidekick, Boop! Blast your way through 100 challenging levels and 5 boss fights, in this classic elimination platformer, modelled on the legendary Bubble Bobble series.

title: Atomic Survivors
description: Atomic Survivors is an arena shooter with minimalistic gameplay and simplistic roguelike elements in which you have to fend off many waves of opponents. Collect Resin every run to buy one of several upgrades of your choice. And remember: for best results, choose wisely.

title: Wheat Fairy of Daya
description: Play as a wheat fairy, using the magical energy of the wheat field to dispel the threats of wheat! Combine different skills to make your own attack style! And let the wheat grow and harvest smoothly under the test of other nature fairies.

title: Long
description: Enter a mystical temple, overcome treacherous obstacles, and rescue your precious dragon baby!

title: Gathering Our Childhoods
description: The story of the game is about the player traveling back to the childhood campus. Players are required to complete all kinds of tasks, so as to collect the memory points to be able to return to the original world. Let's have a childhood journey together!

title: Eclipse Survivors
description: Experience the ultimate challenge in Eclipse Survivors, a bullet-hell / area shooter game featuring epic bosses inspired by classic 16-bit titles. Collect XP gems, master unique skills, and dodge countless enemy bullets as you face off against hordes of foes. Will you survive the eclipse?

title: Cute Puzzles!!!
description: Cute Puzzles!!! The game is very simple, you have to collect a picture, which consists of 20 elements.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Character "Sylvie Paula Paula"
description: This character is also bundled together in the available The King of Fighters XV Fighter Pass DLC character set.

title: Apartament 1406
description: Apartment 1406 is a horror game that will give you an amazing experience in a dark horror world. The game introduces psychological elements such as ever-changing environments and two alternate worlds, which makes it very interesting and mysterious. The player must face various unknown phenomena, ghosts and demons, which combined with the dark and gloomy atmosphere will give you great emotions.

title: The Closure
description:
The Closure (also known as Half-Life 2 Episode 3: The Closure) is a Mod for Half-Life 2, developed and published by SPY Interactive. This Mod acts as an unofficial sequel to Half-Life 2: Episode Two, starting after the death of Eli Vance.

The Mod received negative feedback due to the gameplay and design having very little to do with Half-Life and its extensive use of cutscenes.

title: Robot Dir
description: Little Robot DIR had been on standby for years when a loving family of hedgehogs adopted him, but now his family has been captured and he needs your help to rescue them!

title: Silfade Gensoutan
description: Set in a fictional world named Silfade, from a long, long time ago. The protagonist was incarnate of Rikureru, a goddess-like figure, by means of gathering a spirit from the Sea of Perception, when she witnessed a coming disaster which will wreak havoc upon many lives. Upon incarnation, the protagonist is asked by Rikureru to prevent the disaster, which should occur after fifteen days.

title: Architecture Zeitgeist
description: Architecture Zeitgeist is a project that aims to popularize and make architecture education accessible. The game consists of 3D tours where the player will be able to visit and interact in real time with iconic architecture projects.

title: Paris-Marseille Racing
description:
Take control of your DeLorian, police car, Mini or Beetle and race through some of France's most famous (and busiest) roads and cities. With tournament, time attack and single race modes, the game allows you to race within three classes, in each of which you must place first. Your reward is cash to upgrade the numerous cars available with enhanced engines, tires and even a nitro boost.

Paris-Marseille is France's entry in Davilex's "Racer" series, alongside Autobahn Raser II in Germany, A2 Racer in Holland and London Racer in the UK.

title: Paris-Marseille Racing II
description:
Almost two years after the first Paris-Marseille Racing, Davilex Games decided to continue the story and make a series.

In this follow-up, the player can choose between six drivers (one female) with unique driving skills, and two game modes, one or two players. In the single player mode, you will have to choose between the three classic sub-modes : tournament, time attack and single race. New with this release are the two 2-players modes : Duel and Driver Vs Police. In the Duel mode, race head to head against a friend. In the Driver Vs Police mode, one choose to play a police man, the other must try to drive as fast as possible to escape.

The game also features three skill levels, repairing and fine-tuning options in the tournament mode, and of course new and enhanced graphics to race through France and its famous cities such as Marseilles, Paris or Lyon. Three bonus races can also be played in London, Edinburgh or Las Vegas!

title: Kimono Cats
description: Kimono Cats is a charming, easy to play game for all ages. Select your main-character cat and a companion-cat, and walk through a Japanese "matsuri" Festival, making your companion happy. Throw darts at moving bubbles to give your companion a gift from a stall, play a mini-game, or encounter characters. Earn coins, to progress along the road to new areas that have new things to discover. Coins also allow you to purchase houses, shops, and decorative objects to design and build your own unique village. You can take care of your village and visit other players' villages, earning bonus coins, leaving gifts, messages, and stamps in their guest books. Play online or offline. Kimono Cats is designed to help you smile a bit more every day.

title: Comet Culling
description:
Comet Culling is a retro inspired, pixel art farming simulator set in space.

Join PR1NC3, a little helper android, as they travel through space in a plant-powered ship. Their battery is running low and the only way to charge it is to stop on a deserted planet and farm their fuel.

Discover alien species of plants, talk to a mysterious merchant that decided to stop by, read the logs saved on the ship and reveal what happened to PR1NC3 and their crew!

title: Hypersomnia
description: Hypersomnia is a comedic RPG about friends, foes, and eyes. Lots of eyes. After the death of his mother, Ross Cambell is sent into a frenzy researching the paranormal, and after finding a mysterious golden eye and plans of a demonic invasion, Ross sets out to investigate.

title: Lotion Samurai for Nintendo Switch
description:
LotionSamurai for Nintendo Switch" is a remake of all stages of "Lotion Samurai" and "Shin Lotion Samurai" currently available on Steam and ported to Nintendo Switch.
The main character is Nobunaga Oda, whose entire body is overflowing with lubricant.
The main content is Time Attack.

title: Carry Onward
description: Carry Onward is a narrative gameplay short that follows a grieving man as he packs up his home. Immerse yourself in his thoughts and emotions by interacting with items, which shape his internal state. Experience the transformative power of memories and the hope that arises from embracing change.

title: Vicious Red
description: Vicious Red is a third person survival-horror game that stays true to the genre's best traditions. Set in an alternate universe of the recent past, the game takes place on a space station overrun by a terrifying virus. Players must fight for their lives as they face off against unimaginable horrors.

title: Humanoid Huntress
description: Humanoid Huntress is a top-down shooter Built in a tropical wasteland With 2.5D and 3D graphics mixed from a bird eye view. You can interact with NPCs through dialogue or shoot them down with special weapons. Explore your surroundings as you shoot your way through androids and monsters.

title: Blue Epic
description: Blue Epic is an ocean survival game where players can play marine creatures to survive; Complete control system included in the game

title: On the Brink
description: Manipulate the gravity of galaxies to traverse the universe, solve puzzles, reignite constellations, and uncover the mysteries of Project: Almagest to find your way home.

title: Caved-in
description: Welcome to Caved-in, a crazy, cute, and colorful parallel universe full of exploration and combat. Interact with cute and funny NPC's that will help you in your effort to escape the caverns of Quarry-135.

title: Gundroid
description: Earth is in danger in this classic Run N' Gun action spectacle inspired by the glory days of gaming from the late 80s and 90s! Take control of G.U.N.N.R and and battle your way through hordes of enemies and boss fights accompanied by a rocking soundtrack.

title: Search All: UFO
description: Is a hidden object game in which you have to find all the flying saucers in a large area. The flying saucers will be located in a variety of places, from the most visible to the barely noticeable places.

title: Holy Journey of Salvation
description: Holy Journey of Salvation is a cinematic Immersive Sim FPS. As the Spirit Ascender, you must embark on a Holy Journey to ascend in the Holy Chamber! In this Post Apocalypse setting, your tribe has deep understanding of Chemistry... but did they get it right in all the wrong ways?

title: Vagrus: The Riven Realms - Sunfire and Moonshadow
description: Vagrus's first expansion offers a new, vast region to explore complete with a swathe of new settlements, new enemies to conquer, new stories to be a part of, a large cast of characters, and new quests to complete through which the vagrus may make their mark on Xeryn.

title: Spooples
description: Survive flying through the depths of the Underworld as Spooples the Ghost! Jump through gaps found inside walls of flesh to increase your score. Use bullets to kill Demon Dogs!

title: ShellShot Arena
description: ShellShot Arena is a fast-paced, top-down, online multiplayer game from the 'ShellShock Live' universe. Master a massive arsenal of upgradable weapons to be the last tank standing in Team, Free-For-All, and Battle Royale matches.

title: Glass Masquerade 3: Honeylines
description: Get ready for the Glass Masquerade sequel! With brand new textured glass pieces, immerse yourself in the beautiful world of painted glass art. Assemble jigsaw puzzles inspired by different cultures and themes with new play modes and various fragments cuts.

title: The Mighty Claw
description: The Mighty Claw is a 2D platformer that takes grappling hook mechanics to a new level. Attach your claw to any surface and use tons of cool grapple moves to jump, swing, and zip your way through masterfully designed challenges across a colorful cartoon world full of a wacky cast of characters.

title: Tiling Towers
description: Tiling Towers is a Tower Defense game, where you expand a predetermined path and survive waves of increasingly stronger enemies and bosses. Choose from 3 randomly generated cards every few waves to unlock new towers and bonuses. Can you protect the Crimson Crystal from destruction?

title: Enypnion Redreamed
description: Enter a surreal adventure that delves deep into the subconscious mind of a young boy. Guided by a dream spirit, solve puzzles and explore a realm of eerie wonder, as you find your way back into the waking world. An illusory adventure redreamed!

title: Liberation
description: Liberation is a strategy survival horror game. You have to go to the Deathworld and collect crosses to liberate ghosts. Survive from the attacks of various ghosts!

title: Home Sweet Home: Online
description: Welcome to Niwarn in its fullest form, from the creators of the Home Sweet Home series, ready for you to feel what it's like to be a thrilling visitor. Experience the clash between the two great forces in Niwarn as both the prey and predator simultaneously.

title: War to the Core
description: War to the Core is a tactical multiplayer war game where fleets of motherships battle for global domination.

title: The Doll
description: Lucy bought an exquisite large doll at a low price. While she combs its hair and chats with it, Little does she know that her nightmare is about to begin...

title: Duck's Despair
description: Embark on a brutally hard platforming journey as a desperate Duck who cannot fly. Will you make the pain your friend or give up on your dreams ?

title: 3on3 FreeStyle: Ultimate Edition
description:
Get a lifetime benefit from a single purchase!
Unlock all characters including future legends and battle pass!
Get exclusive access to a special lounge shop!

title: 3on3 FreeStyle: Deluxe Edition
description:
Get a lifetime benefit from a single purchase!
Unlock all characters including future legends!
Get exclusive game buff forever!

title: Big Sword Hero
description: A platform fighting game with 4-player local, a party game that guarantees the mix between fun and epic battles with tense disputes. Simple mechanics and with varied maps and modes, each dispute is always unique.

title: Capt Crabs a Slimy Adventure
description: Capt Crabs, the pirate crab, was out with his crew searching for treasure on a mysterious island when suddenly his ship was taken by some mischievous slimes! Now he's on a mission to retrieve his ship and treasure and get back to the pirate life he loves!

title: Antkeep
description: A 2D ant tower defense strategy game, upgrade the ants' abilities to let them spread out and prevent the invasion of red fire ants.

title: IT Hell
description: You are dead. Welcome to the IT Hell where you have to fight developers, critical bugs and your old equipment to make you way through it. Armed with your keyboard...and some guns, advance through different levels, upgrade your stats and reach the final boss!

title: Death Requiem
description: Death Requiem is a survival fantasy game. You'll explore the dungeon and gothic environment to experience the grandeur of architecture. The rift in the universe has opened and get ready to fight against constant stream of enemies using your strategy and skill combination.

title: Flayl
description: Flayl is a raid based survival extraction looter shooter with physics, built in Unreal Engine 5. Setup your gear, join a raid, fight for your life against up to 50-100 other players & Kovaak's wildlife using weapons, skills/abilities, physics, & do your best to stay alive in deadly weather.

title: Class of '09: The Re-Up
description: The rejection sim returns! Explore a slice of chaotic life in late 2000's American high school as you assume the role of Nicole once again. A 100% fully voiced VN presenting as the most culturally accurate period piece in the history of gaming.

title: Space Saga
description: Space Saga is a universe in which you can control your own ship, travel on it and expand your possessions. You have to make difficult decisions, act on the world stage and create the world with your own hands. What choice will you make?

title: Momatron
description: Enemies have landed on your planet and brought a Big Bomb with them, which they intend to use to destroy your planet. Your task is to stop them!

title: Champion Shift
description: Unleash mythic heroes and their mighty vehicles in this thrilling co-op action roguelike. Seamlessly shift into car form, create builds with unique abilities, and battle endless enemies to stop the evil Dominion. Rev through high-octane missions, conquer epic bosses, and become an absolute legend!

title: Too Many Sheep
description: Too Many Sheep might be the ultimate sheep herding game. Work together with up to 4 players navigating challenging courses or compete with each other to herd your sheep the fastest. Too Many Sheep offers fun for players of all levels. Will you collaborate or compete? Play Too Many Sheep to find out!

title: Unknown Memoirs: The Rental
description: "Unknown Memoirs" is a short horror game series focusing on distressing tales of horror. "The Rental" centers on the main character moving into a rental that they found online. Little do they know of the horrors that await them.

title: The Hostel: Night Terrors
description: In this game, you will find yourself in a hostel in the middle of a mysterious forest. You will discover terrifying and mysterious things, from murders to challenging puzzles. Use your skills to uncover the hidden secrets in the hostel. Get ready for an exciting and hair-raising experience!

title: The Books Tale: A Hop Adventure
description: The Books Tale: A Hop Adventure is a game where you help Verbum save a library from creatures that threaten the interdimensional knowledge books. Overcome levels in a world made of blocks and explore unimaginable worlds to gather the energy necessary to purify them.

title: Paths of Fight: Samurai
description: Plan your moves, slash your enemies, and finish them with powerful combos. Find the correct fighting sequence and slash your enemies in this action puzzle game themed in japan feudal era.

title: Crown of Light
description: Beatrice has trained her whole life for this day, even if she never imagined it would really come. Brave, naive and determined, she will face the trials of her life to fulfill her destiny.

title: Dojo Assault
description: A scientific experiment to create the ultimate modern samurai is taking place ! Battle to create the unsurpassed warrior ninja assassin in the cloning dojo! Cut, stab and shoot your way to shinobi excellence !

title: Ketamina
description: "Ketamine" is a First-Person game in which you need to uncover why you woke up without any memory in an apparently unremarkable apartment, until you discover the secrets of the resident and consider whether you really want to stay or leave.

title: Chicken Tricks
description: Peck, dodge and shoot your way through endless waves of enemies. Upgrade your Chick and prove you have what is needed to avoid being turned into fried chicken.

title: Abyssal
description: A 3D turn-based strategy game where a Monk, wielding arcane magic, and his minions battle hordes of Eldritch-like creatures.

title: Rite as Rain
description: Open world rpg puzzle game with turn based combat

title: Twilight Struggle: Red Sea
description: Answer the summons of the trumpets and bear the burden of the Twilight Struggle. Set during the ideological tension of the Cold War, Twilight Struggle: Red Sea places the United States and the Soviet Union at odds in the Horn of Africa. Every choice you make will impact the balance of power.

title: Asura's Trial
description: Learn new skills based on simple key combinations in this easy to learn, hard to master adventure RPG. Combine over 100 different skills from 5 diverse classes to create an unbeatable combination and reclaim your body by finishing Asura's Trial.

title: Mirth Island
description: You're about to embark on an epic adventure with a young duck who's tired of feeling sad all the time. He's packed his bags, set sail on a rickety boat, and is headed straight for Mirth Island - a place where happiness is said to grow wild like daisies!

title: Hexagon Survivors
description: Is a game that is not for the faint of heart. With its challenging difficulty level, players will need to be on their toes at all times. Those who are up for the challenge, Hexagon Survivors offers a thrilling, cyberpunk-inspired adventure that is sure to keep players engaged for hours on end.

title: A Heroine Story
description: When a wizard comes to the village to help Victoria against a magical entity, things take a turn for the unexpected and the young mayor will have to make a decision that will change her life forever.

title: Mayor May Knott
description: A creepy-cozy 3D adventure, about a shy girl who accidentally becomes mayor of a haunted ghost town.

title: Interlopers
description: Interlopers is a solo-developed FPS inspired by retro classics. Wield big guns, shoot hordes of enemy robots, and explore hand-crafted levels set on multiple alien worlds.

title: J-Town: A Visual Novel
description: A friendly crash course in Japanese American history, culture, and community! Inspired by the real stories of the three historic Japantowns of California: San Francisco, San Jose, and Los Angeles's Little Tokyo.

title: The Cursed Amulet
description: Enter a mysterious cave and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test. Explore the depths of the cave, search for clues, and solve challenging puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

title: Star Quest
description: Star Quest is a third person single player game that integrates space exploration, flight driving, action puzzle solving, and gunfight shooting. The game is developed with Unreal Engine 5 . In the vast universe, you can start this exciting journey by driving your own spaceship.

title: Titor's Time Traveling Tale
description: Step into the shoes of a medieval physicist studying the theory of time travel in "Titor's Time Traveling Tales," the VR escape room game. While conducting experiments on a strange artifact, you accidentally activate it and find yourself transported to a server room in the distant future.

title: Otoko Cross: Pretty Boys Dropout!
description: A SFW port to Nintendo Switch.

title: Bloody Doctor
description: Bloody Doctor is an Action RPG. Control a Doctor facing an epidemic by extracting organs. Fight ennemies and operate on corpses at your lab. Explore an old Steampunk Paris during a strange period.

title: Master of Luna
description: Master of Luna is a turn-based 4x strategy game in a fantasy world with powerful magic and all kinds of mystical creatures. It has tactical battles, cozy pixel art, and a mildly melancholic atmosphere.

title: Cruel Reality: A Horrible Dream
description: Horrible Dream - first of the Cruel Reality trilogy, a visual novel with elements of psychological horror.

title: Music Summoner
description: Music-themed bullet-hell shooting for beginners to advanced users

title: Age of Fear: Total
description: This rich fantasy world loved by fans for its deep tactics and epic stories is due to become that much larger once the upcoming Ratmen enter the fold, bringing with it a brand new, meaty mainline quest for fans to battle through. But like any good adventure, it's never really over!

title: Mop of the Dead
description: Mop of the Dead is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. Our cleaning competitors are stealing our customers. Well, let's steal their household products. Run, scream and don't get caught by the revengeful janitor with his big mop of death!

title: Escaping Atlantis
description: Escaping Atlantis is a roguelite deckbuilder where all your cards are unique Atlanteans. Get to know them, direct them in tactical battles and strengthen your team to face bigger challenges, all with the hope of.. Escaping Atlantis!

title: Animal Kostume
description: No talk, compadre. It's Animal Kostume time! Follow kroc-boy in his path to overcome a series of difficult levels in this hardcore 2D platformer with a lot of enemies, bullets and surprises.

title: Sea Chronicles
description: Sea Chronicles is a first person comedy-adventure game where you're lost at sea. You try to find a way back home, but start to notice that you might not be alone on the ship. Is someone sabotaging your escape, or are you going insane?

title: Hundred Acre Wood
description: Explore and survive a twisted Hundred Acre Wood while being hunted by an old childhood friend, Winnie-the-Pooh. Rescue Christopher Robin with the help of Eldritch Beasts that were once familiar faces. Discover what took place and has changed a once beautiful land into something dark and dangerous.

title: Porpetha
description: An action, adventure and musical game. Perfect for hanging out and having fun.

title: Enlightened
description: Enlightened is a survival horror game with strong focus on puzzle solving. Explore the hotel in which you woke up, find clues about what happened, solve puzzles and find a way out, while surviving horrors that awaits you there.

title: Bus Simulator 21: Next Stop - Official Map Extension
description: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Map Extension DLC is free and extends the "Angel Shores" map with a huge new area. The mountainous nature reserve offers numerous new campaign missions, new stops, and more!

title: Ground of Aces
description: Take command of a remote military air base during World War II. Build your own airfield, manage iconic aircraft and oversee your crew’s well-being. Prepare them against air raids and send your pilots on dangerous missions. Survive and help your nation win the war!

title: Noitapeli
description: First person horror game, you have a special watch in your hand which shows the distance to the noita. Find a bottle which noita needs and bring it back. Use gun, collect mushrooms and avoid noita to find the bottle.

title: NBF0
description: A simple, fun, FPS where you must advance through waves of evil robots. Use your energy weapons to fight them and escape to freedom!

title: Scramble All Fighters
description: Amazing graphics. Countless different units. An addictive Battle Pass. We have none of those things. Just one carrier and as many tiny fighters as you can muster to hold back hordes of enemy fighters and bombers. Victory is not enough - you may win the battle, but still lose the war!

title: Little Ghosthunter
description: Uncover the stories behind a family of ghosts to free them from the confines of their own house, as you search for a way to summon your best friend from the afterlife.

title: Grave Robber
description: Grave Robber is a challenging and addictive game with pixel-art aesthetics and retro-inspired soundtrack. A true homage to the classic arcade games. But don't be fooled by its charming appearance - this game is a true test of your skill, requiring laser-sharp focus and split-second decision-making.

title: Tornado: Research and Rescue
description: Get ready for non-stop action with Tornado: Research and Rescue! Chase down violent tornadoes using 90's style doppler radar, deploy scientific probes, and earn money to upgrade your equipment. Enjoy a unique experience with procedurally generated tornadoes and scenarios!

title: Escape from Garbage House
description: Cleaners undertake the cleanup with a physical operation that involves dumping trash with both hands. Depending on your attitude toward the job, you may get crows or police visits Clean the house through conversation!

title: Runaway Farm
description: Runaway to Skipping Rock and reclaim your Grandma’s farm. You’re going to need to get crops in the ground, harvest and sell lumber, make a fishing pole and catch some fresh fish, and sell weekly at the Farmers Market!

title: Blackheart
description: Blackheart is a 2D single-player dark fantasy action RPG centred around the royal Blackheart family and the internal conflicts that are consuming them from the inside out.

title: Limos' Lair
description: In this Zelda-like / Metroidvania game, you will explore the lair of a long-gone mythical creature and unravel its mysteries. Consume enemies to gain their abilities, use your frog-like tongue to grapple and fight, explore the land, solve puzzles, find secrets, and complete challenges.

title: Hill Dig: The Boring Adventure
description: Hill Dig is a digging adventure game where you will have to explore a world full of exciting and challenging puzzles in a variety of different biomes with a custom built vehicule. Explore a 2D voxel world, solve more than a hundred puzzles, improve your vehicule and go always deeper.

title: Beyond the Plastic Wall
description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

title: Murder at the House
description: 11 people trapped in an old abandoned house together. 8 Innocents. One Detective. One Murderer. You are either the murderer or detective. You must interrogate suspects and find clues in order to solve the mystery, before it is too late.

title: Missing Critters
description: Embark on a delightful adventure and seek out the Missing Critters hidden within intricate cartoon scenes, with a soothing lo-fi soundtrack and no time limits - just relax and unwind. Enjoy a captivating experience that will provide fresh challenges, as each play-through is unique.

title: AngelStrike
description: AngelStrike is an exciting 2D side-scrolling shoot'em'up with handmade pixel-art and a variety of action-packed missions. Play solo or local co-op with friends to rescue refugees, stealthily deliver supplies, escort your allies, and take down hordes of machines in 40 levels across 5 different areas!

title: Villaging
description: Villaging is a simple game of strategy where you reign on a kingdom and you need to manage your ressources and your inhabitant .But you will also get threat from other kingdom so you will need to make an army to fight against them .

title: HeadHorse Legacy
description: The most diabolical killer from smartphones is now on Steam. HeadHorse is your captor and you have a single mission, escape. He is a very intelligent killer with an unmatchable desire for blood is following every single one of your moves, every step, every glimpse of hope you have of escaping, every instant getting closer to his objective, you!

title: Heroes Quest Survival
description: Embark on an exciting journey in Heroes Quest Survival. Unite with fellow heroes to liberate lands from monstrous orcs and zombies. Master the art of swordplay and sorcery to rescue innocent lives in this thrilling quest.

title: Root Connections
description: Digging deep into the root of his world, you play as the hallucinations of a man struggling with psychotic depression. Puzzling your way through the darkness of alcoholism and the fear of losing loved ones, it is up to you to root connect this man’s life back together again!

title: Giant Defense
description: The most challenging tower defense game to date, real-time control 3D perspective, multiple enemy intelligent attack routes! 8 types of towers, each with unique special abilities.25 challenging levels to conquer!Over 10 powerful enemies to challenge your command abilities.

title: Eyes of War
description: Eyes of War is a real-time strategy game set in the medieval era, offering both single-player and multiplayer experiences where you can control every unit in character mode. Build your castle, lead your army, and dominate the map. Eyes of War invites you to epic battles of the medieval era!

title: Nimrods
description: Assemble a limitless arsenal in this survive-em-up roguelite shooter. As a Gun Manufacturer's testing force, your mission is simple: test the latest gun tech and scavenge alien planets. Collect insane weapon parts to invent crazy guns that slay thousands. You may not survive, but your guns will!

title: Emergency
description: Save lives – be a hero! Join forces against the chaos in the newest title of the award-winning Emergency series. Take up your shift as incident commander and coordinate with other players to fight fires, arrest gangsters and rescue injured civilians. Your city needs you!

title: Sakeworld
description:
Welcome to Sakeworld.
Treat the ladies nice and you will be rewarded.
Run and gun to get those weapons and ammo or you're done!
Punch your way out of a crowd and then empty your clip.
Throw a grenade or use a special attack to help keep a cool and level head.
Use the foreground and background to your advantage or you will get smoked.
Beat em up, but be smart, the Mysterious Dr Sake awaits.
Sakeworld is an alternate dimension, so you know things are about to get weird.
Only you can set things right and clean up these streets!

title: Unioverse Proving Grounds
description: Unioverse Proving Grounds is a third-person shooter, speedrun mode within our alpha Hero Viewer. Sprint, shoot, slash through fun obstacles and top the weekly leaderboard for rewards.

title: Insect Wars
description: Insect Wars is a real-time strategy game where you lead an army of insects. Collect resources, build your colony, and destroy the enemy's to win. Scout the enemy, master different unit types and technologies, and face off in 1v1 or team-up against the AI.

title: Sentinent Steel
description: Sentinent Steel is a fast-paced 2.5D action-platformer for up to two players. Fight back against a rogue Artificial Intelligence, avoiding the growths of its synthetic infection, and destroying its fearsome machines.

title: The Dark Pursuer
description: You find yourself locked up alone in an abandoned place, but something is nearby, something dark and dangerous. Try to look for ways to get out of there before you can no longer...

title: The Source
description: The Source is a unique modern take on the Text Adventure genre. An outsider to a foreign world, you must choose a kingdom to help gain an ancient power locked deep beneath a mysterious Well. Explore each kingdom, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery surrounding this shattered world.

title: The Night of the Inquisitor
description: Uncover the mystery behind a cursed rosary in this chilling survival horror game. Evade the Inquisitor, solve puzzles, and interact with NPCs to collect all the pieces of the rosary and break the curse. Can you save Emilia and her mother before it's too late?

title: A Pretty Broken Adventure
description: A Pretty Broken Adventure is a solo-developed, hand-drawn point-and-click adventure.

title: Knights of the Throne
description: Lasha is the leader of the Knights, a young woman of honor and strength. Deadly with a blade and pure in her heart, she will volunteer to take on a perilous path to protect the kingdom from an army of enemies never seen before.

title: Crimson Hollow
description: Crimson Hollow is a cozy fantasy game set in a magical town, kept secret from the outside world. In this game, you will play as a hero who discovers this mysterious village inhabited by magical villagers.

title: Plantsportation
description: Install operational modules on your rocket and program them to deliver plants to the target.

title: Sniper Killer
description: Eliminate your victims as a serial killer dubbed ‘The Sniper Killer’. Terrorize the city with your keen eye and thirst for blood while staying one step ahead of a detective hell bent on bringing you to justice.

title: Pocket Puzzle
description: A puzzle game about fix factory tracks and assembling a pocket game.

title: 9th Land
description: 9th Land is a family co-op multiplayer action-adventure game set in a fantasy world with elements of community simulation.

title: The Two Moons
description: A Comedy/Walking Simulator RPG that follows a 4th-wall breaking main character who knows he is in a crappy RPG maker game and wants no part of it, but he is forced into being the main character by a series of infinite loop Yes/No choices where No isn't a real option. Chaos ensues in this wacky game.

title: Museum No.9
description: Massive artifact collection! Build your museum with extreme freedom! Visitor revenue depends on your route design, and whether you can achieve perfect profits is entirely up to you! Enjoy light rogue-style adventure exploration, and use different skill combinations to battle monsters every time!

title: Dynasty Detective
description: DynastyDetective is a visual Nobel-style mystery story game set in the fictional Joseon Dynasty where monsters appear.

title: Finding Fate
description: A hidden object game following the journalist Fate, in her quest to uncover the truth and her own past.

title: Groob
description: Embark on a challenging roguelike adventure, mastering tactical deck-building and intricate strategies as you explore unknown dungeons. Build your powerful deck, adapt to changing enemies, and utilize cards and items for victory.

title: Blood Lily Ghoststories
description: A horror game about a needy female ghost. A trio of close-knit occult club girls gather late at night to enjoy telling ghost stories. Little do they know that Miss Choker, a ghost that targets girls, is just dying to appear...

title: RogueStone 2: Open World
description: Experience the Ultimate Role-Playing Game with RogueStone 2: Open World. Explore the depths of the Core, uncover the secrets of the Gurus, and discover the 9 Meta Orbs to become the Master of this world. Will you overcome the challenges and vanquish the Consuming Darkness?

title: Crazy The Clown's Balloon Animal Massacre
description: Crazy told them all, more than once. He told them *not* to setup a balloon animal factory at the circus... but no...nobody would listen. Within days the equipment went out of control due to AI software attempting to take over the world and the Circus became an immediate disaster.

title: Cargo Delivery
description: In the game, you become a driver of a car that carries various goods to remote villages, located in snowy areas.

title: Bewitched Balls
description: Bewitched Balls is partly a "color matching" like puzzle game and partly a turn-based combat game set in a world of magic and fantasy where your goal is to defuse six evil gems and finally fight against a powerful witch.

title: Text Twist Classic
description: Get ready for some word-finding fun game in Text Twist Classic! Around 1800 different words to learn! Look at the jumbled letters and find all the word combinations. Over 8000 levels. Two different modes to play: Untimed and Timed.

title: Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia
description: Experience the rulership of a new country in the Suzerain Universe with The Kingdom of Rizia DLC – the first expansion of the critically-acclaimed political role-playing game. As King Romus Toras explore the unique geopolitical and internal conflicts of the Kingdom of Rizia.

title: My Life of Repayment
description: If you don't work, you will eat dirt! To pay off your loans, you will take on various jobs. Make pancakes, perform archery, and operate a space drone! Enjoy a changeable work experience in your busy life!

title: GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the following bonus contents.
・A bonus game - The original "GetsuFumaDen": discover the original game with the guidebook, a newly added Quick Save feature, and an English localized Menu screen (in-game texts and the guidebook are in Japanese only)!
・A gallery mode with following contents limited to the Digital Deluxe edition
-Digital Artbook: contains the game's key arts, stage concept designs, character designs, and the lore from the game.
-Mini-OST: contains 15 sound tracks from the game with its attractive atmosphere.

title: R-Type Tactics I & II Cosmos: Deluxe Edition
description: Includes R-Type Tactics I・II Cosmos: Standard Edition, Digital Soundtrack and a Poster

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Special Edition
description:
This version includes:

- A standard edition copy of the game.
- One randomly selected Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles eye mask
- CD Soundtrack featuring 28 tracks presented in a pizza box styled case
- 4x 30mm Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles metal pins
- Metal Shredder keyring
- Numbered autograph art card
- 80mm sewer manhole cover metal coaster

title: Knightmares
description: Face yourself in an epic tale of honor, courage and fusions. Knightmares will make you see fantasy from... A different point of view.

title: Western Rye
description: Welcome to the harsh and lawless world of the Wild West, where a mysterious fever called the 'Rye Fever' has turned the once-proud frontier into a lawless wasteland. In this world, survival is the only law, and you'll need to be tough, quick-witted, and deadly if you hope to make it out alive.

title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX: Signature Edition
description:
This version includes:

- Physical Game.
- Certificate of Authenticity.
- Enamel Pins.
- Art Book.
- Original Soundtrack.
- Medallion & Coin Pouch.
- Jankenpon Cards.
- Collector's Keychain.

title: The Last Seal
description: When a presumed to be extinct race starts wreaking havoc, Joan and Cadel begin what will be the journey of their lives.

title: The Sisters 2: Road to Fame
description:
Get on trend and take the road to fame!
Double the trouble, double the fun, our Sisters are back to cause twice the chaos!

title: Konike
description: Konike is a turn-based strategy RPG about hunting ghosts for money. Play as a man down on his luck as he uses probability-powered Finder devices to locate invisible spirits in rural America. Use both your skill and intuition to survive, all while uncovering the mystery of your own past and future.

title: August Walk
description: The game has three story branches: normal, realistic, and mystical walk. In the normal branch you can just walk around the summer city, the forest and the spring.

title: Labrys
description: Labrys is a multiplayer (up to 1v5) horror game where players are thrown into a randomly generated labyrinth against a minotaur. Play as the minotaur or one of up to five human players trying to escape the labyrinth while avoiding the minotaur.

title: MoonWool
description: MoonWool is a sheep herding game in a space cartoon universe. You must save your sheep stranded in the cosmos ! On tiny planet, you will have to guide them into safety, against dangerous hazard and monsters !

title: Through the Mist
description: A terrible disease known as the Blight is spreading across all four corners of the world. Without a cure, he who is afflicted by it, is doomed. As the Lighwielder, Edan must now find it's origin and cause and put it to an end. He is people's last hope.

title: Wildstrive
description: Wildstrive - is an open-world first-person survival game. Craft tools, build a camp, harvest crops, explore the land, tame and fight wild animals. Challenge nature and solve the mystery of the lost island!

title: Mother Ghoul: The Curse of Unborns
description: The next victim is you. Mother Ghoul is a horror and thriller game where you try to survive against a cursed ghost that you have been offered as a sacrifice. To break free from the curse, you must find and destroy her stillborn children through a ritual. This is the only way...

title: It Is Ticking
description: The world is being attacked by terrorists, they use highly dangerous explosive devices to cause massive destruction in urban zones. You, A bomb-defusing expert, must take action to protect our nation's lives.

title: A Priest Walks Into a Graveyard
description: A Priest Walks Into a Graveyard is a retro-style action roguelite game with elements of horror. Boost your priest abilities and survive as long as you can in a graveyard full of hostile and never-ending creatures.

title: Real Web Legends: Carter's Quest
description: Fight, solve puzzles, and learn the secrets of Homunculi in this character-action RPG experience. Create and customize your own Homunculus, develop new techniques and combos with an array of weapons, and fight to end a centuries-long conflict.

title: Solar Showdown
description: Welcome to Solar Showdown - the ultimate 2-player couch competitive game where you harvest solar power, build defenses, and produce minions to attack your opponent's towers. Generate enough power to activate your base's ultimate weapon and blow up your rival! Grow, build, defend, and dominate!

title: Cold and Afraid
description:
In the tranquil confines of a college town, an idyllic peace is shattered by the brutal murder of a student. Shocked and alarmed, the local authorities soon uncover a chilling truth:

​this ghastly act is merely the tip of the iceberg.

As a grim pattern emerges with each successive discovery of mutilated bodies, it becomes evident that a cunning serial killer is haunting the town, leaving a trail of terror in their wake.

title: Monster&Strategy
description: A dungeon adventure card game, a maze generated by the program, unpredictable monster combinations, and a large number of cards, treasures, to measure the trade-offs and build your unique card set!

title: The Dead Await
description: Build your deck and try to survive in The Dead Await, a deck-building RPG set during a zombie apocalypse. As one of many survivors, set out across the desolate world, discover the truth about the outbreak, and rebuild human civilization - or die trying.

title: Barold: Inferno
description: "Barold: Inferno" is an action-packed dungeon crawler game where you play as the knight Barold, fighting demons and gods in the depths of hell using different weapons and abilities.

title: Backrooms: Wit's End
description: Backrooms: Wit's End is an immersive coop survival horror game, featuring procedurally generated, non-linear level progression and dynamic gameplay mechanics. Explore the different disturbing levels with your friends, while trying to escape from many puzzling entities.

title: Kiborg
description: Kiborg is a fast-paced, story-driven action game with rogue-lite encounters. Each challenge is unique and the narrative always moves forward, win or lose. Become an unstoppable war machine and face the consequences of your actions as you lead a resistance group on a faraway prison planet.

title: Eternals' Path
description: Eternals’ Path is a roguelike, tactical turn-based RPG about struggles and poor choices you made and had during your life that will haunt you in death. Incarnate anti-heroes through different places. Fight those who wander there, but also people you knew in your life with lots of grievances to share

title: Loot and Shoot
description: Loot and Shoot is a dungeon crawler 2D platformer action roguelite. Travel through various procedurally generated lands, battle challenging enemies, and collect diverse resources to expand your city and unlock new weapons. Avoid lava and carve your own path to the top as everything is destructible.

title: One Thousand Cuts
description: Expanded standalone version of sock's map from Func Map Jam 2: a medium-sized, IKblue-themed, partially ruined temple with two individual routes for replayablility. It comes with a set of medieval-style item boxes.

title: Zombie Ants VR
description: Zombie Ants VR is a short (5-10 minute) experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that drives creatures (in this case ants) to change their behavior in order to propagate the fungus and ultimately kills them.

title: D or D
description: D or D is a psychological horror game that immerses you in daily experiences.One page in high school student Xiaoshan's notebook is written with some words starting with the letter "d"

title: Lonely Path
description: Lonely Path is a relaxing puzzle game where you move and stacks tiles to create paths through 5 nature themed, hand-drawn regions! Try your hand at 100 different levels or make your own and share them with the community!

title: Date with Foxgirl
description: Have you ever wondered why you don't have a girlfriend? Or have you ever wondered if you will ever find a girlfriend? Sometimes it doesn't take much to meet a beautiful foxy girl... Just go to a cafe for coffee in time, and have a little perseverance and desire...

title: IAlly
description: iAlly is a mystery-action game that you can play alone or with 3 friends. Are you ready to feel like a time traveler by solving unique puzzles in a museum full of artifacts from the real world?

title: Kamikaze Lassplanes
description: Fly and fall for powerful Lassplanes! Discover a hand-crafted anime VN with story-driven arcade shoot-'em-up gameplay. Take part in a romantic story with drama and comedic elements set in a steampunk Kingdom filled with magic and torn by a brutal war. Decide the fate of your country and heart.

title: Vengeance of Mr. Peppermint
description: Embody a hard-boiled detective seeking bloody justice. in an old-school, Korean-style beat-’em-up. Plow through the criminal underworld to find and punish those responsible for his sister's death...before his mind unravels and his vengeance completely destroys him.

title: Troubles in Silesia Country
description:
Troubles in Silesia Country is a mod for Half-Life 2: Episode Two which plays in the Silesia region of Poland or the Czech Republic.

The mod's environment is heavily inspired by towns and villages at the Polish-Czech border region, like Úvalno, Krnov and Ostrava.

One day you wake up in your home village and go for a ride just when Combine attack begins...

title: Progressbar Popup Fighter
description:
Progressbar Popup Fighter is a spin-off game of Progressbar95, initially released on 22 December 2020, developed and published by Spooky House Studios.

It is about not overwhelming the CPU with a lot of pop-ups; if it gets overwhelmed, a BSOD will appear.

Even though the game received some updates that added new content and features, it is safe to assume it has been abandoned due to the lack of updates and discussion about it.

title: Underquest
description: Cute fantasy roguelite with backpack mechanics. Combine items to create powerful skills and use them in fast-paced combat. Explore randomly generated dungeons in the Underkingdom and discover the secrets of its inhabitants!

title: Pregnant Talking Cat Emma
description:
Emma the Cat and Oscar are expecting little kittens! Wonderful, right? Too bad Oscar had to go so far away to hunt, so pregnant talking cat Emma is all alone now. Thankfully, she has you! You’ll help your virtual kitty cat Emma go through her pregnancy, right? We all know that’s not easy and Pregnant Talking Cat Emma misses Oscar so much! She is so lonely without him, and she can really use some company and support. Be there for your pregnant virtual cat Emma, and help her prepare to be a mom! Play this virtual pet pregnant game and be the biggest support for your pregnant Emma!

As talking cat Emma is about to have three little talking kitties, she's going to need all the care a pregnant cat can get. Play talking cat pregnant games in order to take this pregnant mommy cat to her doctor so that the kitty cat virtual pet can do an ultrasound and other check-ups. Make sure her talking kitties are safe and sound.

title: My Virtual Pet Louie the Pug
description:
Welcome to virtual pet games pug life, y'all! My Virtual Pet Dog Louie the Pug is the most charming virtual dog out there, the new virtual pet royalty. Adopt this virtual puppy dog now and let him make your day every time you meet with him. Louie the Pug is not a talking dog. He's a virtual puppy dog that will stick his tongue out and be cool.

Your virtual dog needs to be taken care of – feed him, take him out to pee, bathe him, and play with him. Dog dress-up games are what Louie the Pug really enjoys, so play pet dog games with him and make him the most swag virtual dog out there!

title: Cubzh
description: Play an infinite number of games, create your own items and worlds, and share them with friends. Hang out, compete, and chat in a virtual space where creativity knows no limits.

title: Destiny 2: Lightfall - Season of the Deep
description: In Season of the Deep, Guardians must travel to Saturn's moon of Titan and investigate an unexpected distress call. Guardians are tasked with diving into the depths of it's methane ocean to uncover ancient secrets and disrupt the Taken and Hive rituals beneath the waves.

title: Satanislas
description: Gamble your lives in this fast-paced, hard-as-hell precision platformer, and overcome countless devilish traps across five realms of carefully handcrafted levels. Having trouble? Spend a few souls to gain formidable powers... Or handicap yourself with some curses.

title: Space Drilling Station
description: In Space Drilling Station, manage and automate a drilling station on a distant planet. Build a multi-level vertical structure to produce and manage your resources and staff, in order to solve the energy crisis and destroy the competition.

title: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets
description: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets is an indie Action RPG made as a tribute to the Game Boy Advance era of gaming. A spiritual successor to Save me Mr Tako, play in a world where Octopuses were erased from history.

title: PC Building Simulator: IT Expansion
description:
The PC Building Simulator - IT Expansion is the second DLC of PC Building Simulator published by The Irregular Corporation in collaboration with FuturLab. Unlike Esports Expansion, this expansion is free and included when player updated to newer version.

Build and grow your very own computer repair enterprise as you learn to diagnose, fix and build PCs. With real-world licensed components and comprehensive hardware and software simulation, you can plan and bring your ultimate PC to life.

title: Kamek's Midnight Flight
description: Nabbit has stolen the legendary "Miyamoto" book from Kamek's Library. In the wrong hands, this book could cause great danger. Kamek must get it back before the book causes even more chaos!

title: Landborne
description: Someone's stolen the Mushroom Kingdom's entire ocean, and this Cheep-Cheep's not gonna stop dive-bombing his way across the landscape until they find out who!

title: Eddie's World
description:
Venture through Tockin island as Eddie to recover stolen E-Tanks!

This game features Mega man styled gameplay mixed with puzzles and unusual boss fights.
8 standard and 1 special levels to complete and a big hub full of puzzles to explore.

Made with Megamix Engine.

title: Super Mario Construct
description: Super Mario Construct is a browser-based Mario level editor focusing on ease of use and advanced editing tools at the same time.

title: Super Mario Construct 2: Yoshi's Fabrication Station
description: Yoshi’s Fabrication Station is a Yoshi’s Island level editor. It’s easy to use and has a faithful recreation of the original YI mechanics and physics!

title: Super Mario: Magnum Opus
description:
Mario ain't screwing around. He's got a gun this time. Each bullet is gonna send him flying sky high.

Introducing an all new Mario adventure, combining elements of classic Mario platforming, action-packed Run N' Gun gameplay, and a gripping cinematic storyline about family and betrayal.

Journey through flowering fields, ancient desert ruins, nuclear wastelands, and much more. Join the Mario Bros. on their mysterious search to find their third brother, all while fighting against the mischevious business man known as JB.

title: Super Mario Odyssey Safari
description:
Mario's off on a globe-trotting adventure!
Or, he would be if not for some faulty wiring. Explore the mysterious Bonefall Island to find a way to Fossil Falls. From the flowery peaks of Sakura Armory to the forgotten depths of Legend Forest, forge your path through this action packed open-world platformer with familiar gameplay from the hit Super Mario Odyssey.

title: Heritage: A Dragon's Tale
description:
It was a day like any other in the Skybound Isles when a dark mass arose from the clouds that separated the forgotten and dangerous world below from the home of the dragons above. General Mechos, a powerful military leader of the humans launched an attack on the floating islands and abducted the dragoness Crystal for reasons unknown.

Flame, a trainee knight and Crystal's best friend, travels to the forgotten kingdom of Mineria having sworn to find her and put an end to whatever plot General Mechos has planned. On his journey, Flame will face incredible dangers, discover more about the kingdom of Mineria, why the dragons were separated from the earth to live in the sky, and discover his own destiny.

title: Essence of Waluigi
description:
Ralorche is back with his first attempt at a serious fan game!

5 years ago, Luigi was killed by "the essence". As a result of this, Mario has left the Mushroom Kingdom. Now, thanks to a reoccuring nightmare, Mario has decided to go back and destroy Waluigi's essence once and for all. However, "the essence" plans to destroy the world and build it's own horrifying utopia on it's ruins. Mario will have to travel across locations rarely seen in normal Mario games and battle against new enemies. Will Mario avenge his brother, or will he suffer the same fate?
