Or, will he become corrupted by the Essence Of Waluigi?

title: Cook Out!
description: Cook Out! is a fan game made by Cruise Elroy to look like an arcade game Nintendo could have produced circa 1984. The objective of the game is to throw veggies into a cooking pot while avoiding getting caught by beings of fire. The game features 4 unique boards and up to 99 levels of play. How high of a score can YOU get?

title: WarioWare Mouse Workz!
description: WarioWare Mou$e Workz! is a custom made minigame that features eleven microgames and a boss game.

title: Maridows 64
description: Maridows 64 is a mock operating system based off of the Super Mario video game character.

title: Mario Kart: Speed Strife
description: The game features 12 characters, 8 of which are playable from the start. There are 16 tracks split up into four cups. If you get a trophy in one of the cups while playing in Grand Prix mode, you will unlock its respective characters. Additional to the Grand Prix mode there is also Time Trial mode where you can try to set up record times on your favorite tracks, as well as Vs Race where you can play with your own rules. You can customize speed class, CPU difficulty, which items appear, and more.

title: Luigi Doesn't Drink A Glass of Milk
description: Mario is missing. At the same time, the milk factory has seen a massive sudden boost in productivity. His brother, left in the dark, knows that there is some kind of connection... and so, one fateful night, Luigi heads off to discover the truth.

title: Mario Drinks A Glass of Milk
description: In this game, Mario drinks a glass of milk.

title: V-Ware
description:
V-Ware is a WarioWare-themed minigame with 21 microgames, unlockable achievements and online statistics!

Try to get as far as you can to make it to the highscore list, or practice individual microgames while trying to unlock something new!

title: Princess Quest Part 1
description:
A Retro-style Action RPG starring the Mario Bros and Princess Peach!

Every 25 years, the Mushroom Kingdom throws a quarter-century celebration, called the Jubilee. The last Jubilee was held when the Princess was a child, by her father, the late King Toadstool.

It is during the Jubilee that a shocking revelation about the history of the Toadstool Family comes about...

title: Super Mario Bros: Revenge of Bowser
description: Oh no! Princess Peach has been trapped by Bowser! Go through pipes in Peach's castle which take you all around the Mushroom Kingdom in this classic platformer, and collect the stars by finishing a level, finding 5 Ace coins, and finding the hidden shine. Can you collect all 120 stars in 40 levels, and defeat Bowser?

title: Pyoro +
description: An arcade-style fangame featuring the character Pyoro from the WarioWare series.

title: New and Tasty
description: A collection of 12 minigames complete with achievements and online high scores.

title: Koopa: A Winter's Tale
description: Koopa: A Winter's Tale is an atmospheric exploration minigame featuring nearly 100% original graphics and backgrounds. Journey through three wintery levels as a Koopa Troopa, just trying to find the stuff needed for a warm winter night.

title: Mario Learns About Colors: Recolored
description: Guide Mario to the silver pipe through worlds of puzzles by painting him different colors. The game's special rule is that you pass through any obstacle that matches your color. Be careful, this applies to enemies as well!

title: The Legend of the Radient Mask 2
description: Fight bosses, discover areas, find treasure and challenge your friends in 2-player mode!

title: Super Mario Epic 2: Dream Machine
description: The sequel to Super Mario Epic, Super Mario Epic 2 has over 15 levels and features like Flippers, Hammer Brothers suit, and more!

title: Luigi Land: The Bootleg Invasion
description: Trouble's brewing in Sarasaland again! Mario travels there to put a stop to the chaos but gets captured for his troubles. Luigi, not taking any chances, has E. Gadd upgrade the Sky Pop and flies it into Sarasaland, embarking on a challenging journey (depending on your difficulty setting) to save both Princess Daisy and his brother.

title: Ghost House Pong
description:
It's Boo-against-Boo in this arcade-style minigame!

- Play Singles or Doubles matches with up to four players.

- Compete across five different courts, each with its own hazards that can be turned on or off.

- Listen to a playlist of classic tracks from the Mario series, as well as other spooky video game tracks.

- USB Controllers are required for doubles matches with 3-4 players.

title: Ultimate Mario Bros.
description: Classic Mario Bros. action in a single player adventure mode and online multiplayer modes. With the help of Toad, Mario must discover the source of the sewer monsters, and defeat the man responsible!

title: Super Mario Fan Galaxy
description: A sequel to Super Mario Fangame, with Mario Galaxy theme.

title: MFGG 10th Anniversary Time Capsule
description:
July 9th, 2011, ten years after MFGG was founded in 2001, we take a look back on what fangames were like back then.

This compilation contains 11 games from the early days of MFGG, made by MFGG veterans, but ultimately never completed.

Included in the compilation:
1998 - Super Mario X
2001 - Luigi Quest
2001 - Super Sonic Bros.
2001 - Super Mario: The Project
2002 - Wario Eats Everything
2002 - Luigi's Game
2002 - Toad Strikes Back (Prototype Version)
2003 - Mario Spy
2003 - Pocket Mario
2005 - Waligie 3: On Mars
2006 - MarioQuest 3: The Ghost of SEGA

title: A Rare Encounter
description: A Rare Encounter is a short visual-novel written by Raina Lilith Henlan, with programming and art by Sophie Le Blanc. This project was made to get something out there, while testing the waters for bigger projects down the line.

title: Demoniac Words
description: The evil has taken everything from two sorrowful girls, but the girls will not stop fighting, they will not stop resisting. They are not fighting for themselves.

title: MidEvil
description: MidEvil is a singleplayer, multiplayer or co-op open world survival RPG that takes place in a vast 20km medieval island setting. Players start shipwrecked on the zombie infested island with nothing. The goals are simple, survive, build, defend!

title: Pool Blitz
description:
Challenge your friends, enter pool tournaments, and go head to head against players in real-time. Shoot pool with ultra-realistic physics, breath-taking graphics, and play online with friends.

Pool Blitz, has a variety of games modes, something for every Pool fan. Choose 8-Ball for an authentic pool experience or New Blitz mode for a no-wait multiplayer experience. Pick your mode!

title: Drift Horizon: Car Driving & Tuning
description: Become a legendary drifter! Tune and upgrade your car, install parts and boost performance! With a dozen of cars to choose from, get them on the track and test them out!

title: Dice Legacy: Definitive Edition
description:
Roll and use your dice to gather resources, construct buildings, expand your settlement and face the menacing threats of a mysterious ringworld.

Dice Legacy Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original Dice Legacy release plus the three major updates.

title: Syphon Filter: Logan's Shadow
description: A port of Syphon Filter: Logan’s Shadow, originally released on the PlayStation Portable system, featuring optimised rendering, rewind, quick saving, and custom video filters.

title: Pursuit Force
description:
Experience Pursuit Force originally released on the PlayStation Portable system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Five vicious gangs are fighting for control of Capital City. The terrified public has given up hope – and the Chief of Police wants results, fast!

Jump into action as a member of the elite Pursuit Force and rid the state of corruption. Dive behind the wheel of a truck, a speedboat or even a helicopter as you hunt down criminals and recover stolen goods.

This title has been converted from the PSP version to the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 consoles and provides newly added features.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Numberlink
description: Numberlink is a puzzle where you connect the same numbers without crossing lines. Trust your instinct and get connecting! Keep in mind that the longer the distance, the harder it gets.

title: Ritual Bound
description: Deep in the forest, the witches watch over a prison, keeping an Old Horror sealed. Tonight, the seals binding it must be renewed... But there's a problem.

title: The Pizza
description:
You decide to hold a party and order a pizza.
What could possibly go wrong...

title: Five Night At Lego World
description: Very old project from 2014 that I'm releasing in public, it's a five night at freddy's game but in a lego version.

title: Five Nights At Your Mom's House
description:
So you need to work at Your Mom's House.
but some people want to come by and Kill You.

title: Axel in Harlem: The Game
description: You're the chosen one to help him gather homies for... his "night parties". Guide him to victory before the time runs out!

title: Atlantia
description:
A journalist from the Fame magazine, along with a photographer, is sent on the maiden voyage of the luxury cruise ship Atlantia. The assignment is to get an interview from the sheikh of Harrout -- the owner of the ship.

Aboard, several sudden explosions rock the ship, and a voice from the announcement system tells: We are sinking! Get to the lifeboats immediately

title: Santa's Monster Shootout
description: Monsters and Zombies from all the world are trying to steal the gift packages, they want it all and they want it now. But Santa has guns, big guns!

title: Talking Cat Emma Ballerina
description:
My virtual pet Emma the cat has reached a new stage in her life: ballet dance school for talking pets. This talking kitty cat will show off her new ballerina dance skills in Talking Cat Emma - My Ballerina virtual pet game. Teach my talking cat Emma virtual pet bring style and grace into the world of talking pets. Talking Cat Emma - My Ballerina is a talking cat app that enriches all those dance games and ballerina games out there.

Can you multitask and make your talking cat ballerina glow from head to toe by making sure she is well fed, examined and rested? Emma the Ballerina, my talking cat, needs you every step of the way, so download Talking Cat Emma - My Ballerina virtual pet game and help your talking cat pave the way to success! Virtual cat talking games will from now on take your breath away while my talking cat Emma parades her dance steps and ballet moves in her prima ballerina costume.

title: Vigor Chronicles: Salvation
description: Unfold the Chronicles and repent for salvation! What would you do if the apocalypse forced you to leave your precious city? How would you adapt to a different environment? In this update, you can enjoy Myren as an Encounter map and discover the secrets left behind from the society that abandoned it. Gain your vantage point and eliminate your enemies with the new L96 sniper rifle.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Premium Edition
description:
The Premium Edition includes the Kombat Pack, early access to the game beginning Sept. 14, and 1,250 Dragon Krystals (in-game currency).

The Kombat Pack will feature a Johnny Cage character skin with the likeness of famed actor and martial artist, Jean-Claude Van Damme (available at launch), early access to six new playable characters (available post-launch), and five new Kameo Fighters (available post-launch)

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Kollector's Edition
description:
The Kollector's Edition is a physically only release for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at select retailers. It includes all Premium Edition content, along with a 16.5-inch Liu Kang sculpture designed by COARSE and an inspired Liu Kang in-game character skin, three exclusive art prints, a steel case, and 1,450 additional Dragon Krystals (2,700 total).

The Premium Edition includes the Kombat Pack, early access to the game beginning Sept. 14, and 1,250 Dragon Krystals (in-game currency).
The Kombat Pack will feature a Johnny Cage character skin with the likeness of famed actor and martial artist, Jean-Claude Van Damme (available at launch), early access to six new playable characters (available post-launch), and five new Kameo Fighters (available post-launch)

title: Station to Station
description: Station to Station is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!

title: Wizard of Legend 2
description: Face perilous magical trials in the fast-paced rogue-lite follow-up to the acclaimed original, featuring up to 4-player co-op and vibrant new 3D visuals. Master new Arcana and elements, experiment with spell combinations, and seek immortality to become a Wizard of Legend!

title: Cataclismo
description: The Cataclismo left us broken. Construct fortresses and defend against waves of Horrors in this mix of tower defense and real-time strategy. Lead an expedition beyond the gates of the last city, and reclaim mist-shrouded ruins as you rebuild humanity—stone by stone.

title: Lost Skies
description: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

title: Spellarium
description: That's the first game in the successful Spellarium series. It has Solitaire, Spot the Difference levels in addition to the Match 3 levels, plus a beautiful location to build.

title: Axe Me Down
description: An Indie Platform Battler where your main objective is to push your friends off the screen with throwing Axes. Available for two to six players.

title: Pegdrop Hearts
description: A relaxing Peggle-like game with a cozy and emotional theme that will warm your heart, while you learn about love and self-respect. It's a relaxing Pachinko game for you to chill.

title: Canvas Menagerie
description: A slice of life boys love romance about a group of TV actors going through their mid-20s together.

title: Golf With Your Friends: Corrupted Forest Course
description: An unusual meteor strike has seeped corruption into our beloved Forest. Journey through the challenging 9-hole course and delve into the dark side of the woods. Can you complete the course under-par and earn the exclusive crown?

title: Arcade Paradise: Vostok Inc. Pinball
description: Do you like money? How about Arcades? Then you'll LOVE Vostok Inc. Pinball!!

title: The Smurfs 2: The Prisoner of the Green Stone
description: With your crack team and the help of the SmurfoMix, liberate the village of the Smurfs from the grip of the Green Stone!

title: Arcade Paradise: High Score Edition
description:
The Arcade Paradise High Score Edition includes
- Arcade Paradise (full game)
- All 8 Arcade Paradise DLC packs

title: Project Proxima
description: Explore a star system while surviving the harsh conditions of space and whatever lurks in the darkness.

title: Idle: Multipliers
description: An Idle game for your fun and relaxation. Multipliers based prestige system and various gameplay possibilities

title: Umbraclaw
description: Find hope in death. In Umbraclaw, take control of Kuon, a cat who dies in the mortal world and awakens in the Soulplane, the world of the dead. Brave the horrors of the underworld to reunite Kuon with his owner in this 2D action-adventure game.

title: Pinball Dreams Deluxe
description: Pinball Dreams Deluxe includes an enhanced version of Pinball Dreams and its sequel with higher resolution (640x350) and Redbook audio tracks.

title: Pokemon Flux
description: Altera is a wild and diverse region that overflows with abundance as well as danger. It is also the only place in the Pokémon world that emanates large amounts of Flux energy, a potent resource that has many uses. The value and power of this resource led to rapid economic growth of the region. However, shortly after humans began tapping into Flux energy for power, reports started to emerge about vicious, powered-up Pokémon appearing: the Alter Pokémon.

title: Pokémon Sage
description:
Pokémon Sage is an upcoming role-playing video game and Pokémon fangame developed by members of the 4chan board /vp/.

It takes place in a fictional region called Urobos. Urobos is loosely based on Central and South America, with many Pokémon, though not all, being related to the real-life region.

title: The Wonderful One: After School Hero
description:
A standalone version of the free DLC for The Wonderful 101: Remastered made as a crowdfunding stretch goal.

As the latest member of the centinels, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

title: WD-40 Game
description: A free 2001 advergame for members of the "WD-40 Fan Club". Largely forgotten about until 2022, when someone posted about it on the r/lostmedia subreddit, and a copy was located on the wayback machine.

title: C'est La Vie
description: C'est La Vie is a Japanese adventure about an aspiring young painter, who is more interested in pretty, young, naked models than in the art itself.

title: Electric Device Marian
description: Psyluth Decker is a young English nobleman. Upon hearing the news of his father's death, he goes to the family mansion, a place surrounded by strange rumors, from which he tried to distance himself. Shortly after his arrival the young man notices that almost everyone he encounters has a secret, and becomes involved in a battle between powerful shapeshifters and mechanical creatures, aided by the trusty maid Marian.

title: Imitation ha Aisenai
description: In the near future, female fertility decreased, so "imitation women" were created to solve this problem. 20 years later, the fertility values normalized, and "imitation women" lost their existential value. Android women were all stunning beauties, so women's organizations conspired to eliminate this threat. The protagonist is a first class android hunter D who is now given a new task to find three runaway imitation women.

title: Gal Pani X
description: A Qix clone in vein of Gals' Panic, where one must draw lines in the screen to unveil images featuring fanart of characters from To Heart. Unlike Gals' Panic, the images are not sexually explicit, though some are suggestive. In addition, it features other additions to the Qix formula, such as the ability to move diagonally and bullet hell elements.

title: Terra: Destino Final
description: Terra: Destino Final is a racing game between spaceships based around one of the characters of the soap opera Começar de Novo, where you can participate in exciting space disputes, compete against the computer or play online against other competitors with eight spaceships and nine worlds full of challenges and fantastic scenarios.

title: Puzzle Boy
description: Puzzle Boy is a port of the Game Boy title Kwirk, but features more and different levels along with changed graphics. In contrast to the original version, the perspective is straight top-down and there is no undo-function.

title: Coryphaeus Championships
description: Coryphaeus Championships is a competitive card game platform that passionately focuses on openly accessible professional play for all. Immerse in endless competitions and become a tournament champion!

title: Men on the Flying Trapeze
description:
A two player version of The Amazing Flying Brothers.
You play as the infamouse flying brothers as they try to perform the flying trapeze act. The game is a two player coop game. Your job is to get as big of a score as you can.

title: Polytope
description: A fast-paced rhythm-esque game by ubuntor about matching key presses to reshape a constantly ebbing glob of sci-fi goo. A gameplay observation of the Nelder-Mead method, a numerical method used to find the minimum or maximum of an objective function in a multidimensional space.

title: Putt Party
description: Putt Party is a putting golf game that you can play with your friends! Play through themed courses simultaneously as you try to get your ball in the hole in the fewest amount of strokes. Scattered throughout the courses are power-ups that can be used to make your shots easier, or your opponent’s shots harder. Players who complete the course in the fewest amount of strokes are the winners!

title: Sketch Heads
description:
In Sketch Heads, players sketch pictures of a word prompt to get others to guess the prompt correctly.

Sketch Heads has two game modes: Classic and Blitz. Classic mode is a competitive battle against your friends where you take turns choosing a secret word to draw while everyone else competes to guess it as fast as possible! Blitz mode is a chaotic, cooperative race against the clock where you split into two teams, Drawers and Guessers. Drawers share a canvas and rapidly draw words while the Guessers guess as many as possible before the time runs out.

title: King K Roller
description: Roll around as everyone's favorite regal reptile, King K Rool. Collect 5 Remy Coins per level to proceed to the next level, ultimately leading you up to the final boss.

title: King K Roller 2
description:
Everyone's favorite regal reptile returns in a brand new adventure.

King K Rool is nothing but a meme character; at least that's what his peers think of him. This inferiority complex drives his attempt to alter the course of history to be seen than more than just a "meme character". Luckily, after finding a time stone, the crocodile is able to embark on this adventure of altering the past.

This adventure includes 9 rage-inducing levels, jam packed with difficult jumps, engaging boss battles, and captivating cutscenes.

This game is for god gamers only. It is very difficult, and is intentionally rage inducing, but it is much more fair than the previous installment of King K Roller (which I recommend you do not play).

title: Fatman Adventures
description:
The game puts you in control of Fatman, a treasure hunter who discovers a mystery forest mentioned in ancient legends. On his way to collecting all the treasure of the sacred woods Fatman will have to face cruel monsters guarding precious diamonds and rubies.

Fatman will have to outsmart his enemies by digging traps-holes, setting cage-traps and using magic items.

title: Deadenders
description: A text adventures with illustrations, a parody on the TV series the Eastenders.

title: Enjoy the Diner
description: Why not enjoy the diner? The moon is as full as it'll ever be, and there's even a drink fountain.

title: Dread Dawn
description: This is an open world Zombie Survival game, The location of the game is set in the city. You are forced to stay in the city because you can't catch up with the evacuation team. You need to defend the camp with other survivors who stay in the city and survive.

title: Densha-zukuri no Popo
description: This is a story about creating trains.

title: Out of the World
description: "In this world, "only what you see" is true." This game is a 2.5D platformer puzzle action game in which objects seen by the character materialize and disappear from existence when the character meditates.

title: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals - The Absence of Misericordia
description:
Wizardry: The Absence of Misericordia is an expansion scenario for Wizardry: Prisoners of the Battles and the seventh entry in the Wizardry Gaiden series, designed by Kotaro Ichien and developed by 59Studio. The game was originally released in August 11, 2005 for Microsoft Windows published by IID, ported for iOS in March 9, 2012, and Android in December 1, 2013.

A remastered Steam version was announced during INDIE Live Expo 2023 with new contents released on June 22, 2023 as downloadable content for Wizardry: The Five Ordeals. A Nintendo Switch port as DLC, based on the remastered version is scheduled for January 30, 2025 release.

title: Songs of the Hmong
description: The culture of Chinese Hmong nationality boasts pluralistic artistry, and it has its own uniqueness in construction, literature, painting, patterns, craft, etc. However their ways of inherit the knowledge is limited due to the absence of written language. In present days, the younger generation is showing a huge passion about video games, thus demonstrating a possibility for young people to grow interest on these fading traditional cultures by binding them with the Ninth Art.

title: Iromaze Ink Shop
description:
Elozen Ink Store, an ink store that packs and ships mysterious ink inks into bottles.
Ink stunt'Ink-chan' has a habit of getting happy when he shows the same color as himself and enters the bottle.
Be careful, multiple ink dolls can appear at the same time, and at this time you have to show all the colors of the ink ink mixed in.
Get the correct colors fast before the ink gets away!

title: Kotonoha Lernado
description: Let us exchange the KOTONOHA of hope a little more. *Ĉu vi volas paroli la lingvon "Juliamo"?* Do you want to speak *Juliamo*?

title: Zakuro
description: A heartfelt but bloody tale about monsters known as the angels, appears in the cold ruins of Shinjuku.

title: Castle Craft
description: Castle Craft is a game where players build huge castles in an ancient war-torn world and defend them against hordes of enemies in chaotic siege battles of epic proportions. Castle Craft is a unique blend of voxel sandbox, action, and horde defence.

title: Looper Tactics
description: A deck build game that combines the essence of Metrovania. The ancient empire created a world in a box and realized artificial souls. Fearing that it would bring destruction to the world, it was sealed and an endless cycle of reincarnation was set up to ensure its eternal isolation.

title: Romp of Dump
description: Visual Novel with Live2D Animation, Observing Scum Prisoners! In a prison called a dump, a betting card game among dangerous prisoners begins. Penalty game for the losers! Uncover the hidden pasts and bizarre crimes of these lunatics!

title: FishOrChicken
description: You can take your time and prepare your equipment beforehand! You can dive intently while avoiding enemies with a small amount of equipment! Be careful not to make too many items! You can have up to 16 items If you make too much, it might be a big deal. Aim for a high score!

title: Skyhood's Innocent Six
description: This game has three scenarios and three raising modes. It's a deckbuilding adventure game.

title: Deep Sea Sweep
description: A cute 2d platformer where you clean up the sea of all these filthy treasures chests plaguing the various biomes. Swim, jump and bonk meanies on their head in many short but challenging levels with simple but tight controls.

title: The Book of Warriors
description: The Book of the Warriors is a retro SLG+ roguelike game. As a fan of SLG, have you been looking for a kind of war chess that can build a variety of fancy Bulid? Start the game! You will find the charm of SLG~

title: Magical Magic World
description: Pixel art side-scrolling comical fantasy magical action sent by Vtuber magical girl!! This game is an orthodox side-scrolling 2D action game.You can experience various worlds from the beginning with the stage selection type.

title: Rainbow Witch
description: In this game you can not attack. You will have to send back the bullets that are coming your way!

title: Tokyo Pinball
description: A retro high-speed action game in which you can compete with your friends.

title: Droptic
description:
Select column, drop block and see what happen.

Fill bars above to explode rocks.

Get the highest score you can.

title: Lunatic Den
description:
"Welcome to the Madman's Den"

A horror ADV in which you interact with strange and amusing residents while developing a town.
Play time is about 4-5 hours.

title: Candyhouse
description: Throw candy at your enemy but try not to get hit!

title: FreshCharge Ruru
description: Defeat all the enemies on the stage with a deadly flying kick. Flying kicks gain momentum by charging. If you can achieve it before this falls down, the stage is cleared. Please try to clear all.

title: Anomalous City
description: Narrative-adventure game where you contain "anomalies" secretly and prevent the world’s end. Influenced by the "SCP Foundation" and "Cthulhu Mythos," the game offers a blend of unease and curiosity as you delve into a bizarre and disturbing world, eventually uncovering hidden truths.

title: Space Recall
description: "Space Recall" is a 2D horizontal board game with action Roguelike structure, skill and equipment combination as innovation points, and economic operation as the driving force. players can build character skills according to the situation, and at the same time with special abilities

title: Keribato
description: Nikke, the goddess of victory kick through the monster packed dungeon. Keribato is a puzzle RPG game.

title: Yog-Sothoth's Yard
description: Manage a hotel and hire employees including Death, a dragon, a Demon-Slayer, and a bioroid maid. Build your wealth through various means and refine your strategies based on the predictions of Oracles. Your choices will determine which employees become enamored with you.

title: LoveSoTea
description: Tea-making simulator meets adventure game meets visual novel in the modern tale that is LoveSoTea. Once you complete it, you'll know how to brew the most delicious tea... maybe. No promises.

title: My Child: Lebensborn Remastered
description:
My Child Lebensborn is a story driven nurture game based on true events. Play as the adoptive parent of Karin or Klaus, and experience the struggles they go through along them.
In My Child Lebensborn Remastered, we are providing more opportunities for you to create more memories with your child, even at the face of tragedy.

title: House Hopper
description:
House Hopper is a challenging, stylised 3D, precision platformer where you jump through house-themed levels in a minigolf-ish fashion to collect keys to all the rooms, find all playable everyday-use objects and beat your high scores while avoiding falling, crashing and getting burned the best you can at the same time.
Jump. Fall. Crash. Repeat!

title: Chloe’s Requiem: Encore
description:
Chloe’s Requiem is a Japanese 2D adventure game, filled with mysteries and surprises. The young creator, in her teens, created the original game, inspired by free game titles such as The Witch’s House and Ao Oni.

From the original release in 2013, the graphics and sounds have all been completely revamped, allowing all players, new and returning, to have a fresh experience with the game.

In Chloe’s Requiem -encore-, the side story -con amore- is also included, which can be played after the player finishes the original story. Players who have played the game in the past can enjoy the updated art and graphics.

title: Boyhood's End
description: Boyhood's End is an adventure game following Giovanni, the boy with the lowest human score in the universe, and Campanella, the delinquent genius, and their journey on the galactic railroad regarding the "human" and "inhuman".

title: Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss
description: Uncover the mystery of Thalassa, a first-person psychological drama set under the sea. Ill-fate has fallen on your former crew and friends and it’s up to you to find answers onboard the wreckage. Experience the melancholic underwater journey of human stories facing life and loss.

title: Dream Channel Zero
description: Dive into a glitched-out game world! Explore synthwave skylines, fight freaky phantoms, and meet a whole host of quirky characters in this hysterically surreal adventure!

title: Never Grave: The Witch and the Curse
description: A Metroidvania x Roguelite, where you advance using a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build new facilities in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

title: 4 Soccer Simulators
description: 4 Soccer Simulators (later also released as Pro Soccer Simulator) is a collection of four soccer video games developed and released by Codemasters in 1988. It included four games; 11-a-Side Soccer, Indoor Soccer, Soccer Skills and Street Soccer. The games are all played using vertical scrolling.

title: An Elaborate History of Chess
description: An Elaborate History of Chess is a crafting strategy game touring the history of Chess. In true Chess tradition build castles, explore dungeons, farm turnips and get checkmated by a tree. Find answers to Chess's darkest questions, like why the horse piece moves in an L-shape.

title: Halo Infinite: Season 4 - Infection
description: Halo Infinite Season 4 brings Infection to the game, a military career rank system, improvements to spartan customization, new maps, additional forge features, a new battlepass, and more.

title: Milky Bear: Lunch Frenzy
description: Join Milky the Bear as he sets out to run the best restaurant in town! Be it preparing Chinese food, bun, or taco, Milky is always striving to improve his cooking abilities to be the star chef - let's help him achieve his goals!

title: Puyo Puyo CD Tsuu
description: The PC-Engine CD port features full voice work with a cast consisting entirely of professional voice actors, and also includes character-unique chain phrases.

title: Championship Rally
description: Championship Rally is a top-down racing game. The player can choose to control real rally cars: Toyota Celica, Nissan Pulsar, Lancia Delta, and others. There are three modes in the game: time attack, high speed rally, and "adventure mode", which takes the player through a championship in Senegal. Each mode allows the player to select a car and customize its steering, gears, brakes, etc. Car controls are fairly simple, with one button assigned to accelerating and another to applying brakes.

title: Rap Simulator
description: Rap Simulator is in basically a production with a great deal of humour. The action starts in the 80s of the last century. The player takes on the role of a rapper who sets up his first music studio in a rented apartment. Our task is to break out of the underground and become a part of the mainstream for good, opening our own label or creating the best clothing brand. Beefs, chases, money, green leaves, shootings, gang wars or maybe a softer way to success? The way the player chooses to reach the top will depend only on him/her. At the beginning of the game, the player's budget is limited, so you have to decide which aspect of the production you want to devote more attention to at the cost of the other elements.

title: Retrowave Illusions: Aesthetics Edition
description: Retrowave illusions offers above all a visual and sound experience that will delight fans of the genre and will surely make those who don't know it yet discover this wonderful universe. Retrowave Illusions is unique experience of being immersed in wonderful world for at least a few moments.

title: Peekaboo Lite
description: A Cross-Platform Hide & Seek online game. Players are divided into two teams: Props and Hunters. Props hide, taking the form of objects and adopting their physical properties, and hunters try with all their might to find them.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 7: Sin Kiske
description: Adds Sin Kiske to the roster of playable characters

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 8: Bedman?
description: Adds Bedman? to the roster of playable characters.

title: Classic Offensive
description: Classic Offensive is an in development community made modification for Counter-Strike: Global Offensive. CO aims to bring Counter Strike back to its roots with completely remade classic maps, character models, and weapons that hearken back to their original versions while also keeping the improvements that CS:GO has made.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 9: Asuka R♯
description: Adds Asuka R♯ to the roster of playable characters

title: Mumu's Soup Adventure
description:
Jill the candy making witch summoned a cute little ghost cat named Mumu to help her with her candy making duties.

One day, Jill decided to make soup and Mumu agreed to help. All was going well until Jill decided Mumu's heart would be a part of the recipe! Scared for his life, Mumu barges out of the house and escapes, but Jill does not intend on letting him go that easily...

During his escape, he encounters various characters and slowly uncovers the truth that ties everyone together.

title: Call of Duty 4: Promod
description: The official competition mod for CoD4, notably removing perks and Create-a-Class level restrictions, adding several QoL features and bridging the game closer to its contemporaries and past games in the series.

title: Noalone
description: Noa, a lonely young boy, is struggling to cope with his parents' relationship that seems to be falling apart.

title: We Are Out of Food, Milton.
description: "We Are Out of Food, Milton." is a visual novel/walking sim about having to go to the grocery store even though you really don't want to.

title: Pow Vista
description:
Discover the ultimate multiplayer skateboarding adventure!

Join players across the world who are training their skills, earning mythic drops, and exploring the world of Pow Vista.

title: And I Saw the Stars Falling Down...
description:
In an empty theatre, a woman narrates the story of a family and the abuse behind. Everyone tries to convince you it's not their fault... but you don't know who to believe. You can't even trust the narrator. Especially the narrator.

A drama/mystery visual novel around 13.4k words, including 20 CGs with over 12 variations in total. Includes a CG gallery! Bonus content for people who decide to use accessibility tools (Turn off animations & Sound Captions)!

There's also a secret (horror?) route hidden in the game!

title: Puyo Puyo CD
description: A PC-Engine port of the first Puyo Puyo game. Includes full voice acting for cutscenes, in addition to exclusive scenes that play when the difficulty is set to Hardest. Most notably, it also allows both players to choose who they want to play as, making all of the characters playable (except everybody after Witch).

title: Formula One
description: A formula One management game.

title: Fatum Betula + Food Truck Tycoon
description: Immerse yourself in a world of magic and culinary mastery with the enchanting Fatum Betula + Food Truck Tycoon Bundle on Xbox!

title: Daymare Stray
description: Help Daymare Folk find the stray. Who is the stray? Well, see for yourself.

title: You'll Stay Here Forever
description: Proxima Centauri b was discovered on August 24, 2016. The rovers sent to the planet are not responding. It turned out that the planet's atmosphere does not allow radio signals to pass through. You have been sent to the planet's surface to find them.

title: Survivors Will
description: This is a casual Roguelike game that allows characters to become stronger and stronger through repeated choices, breaking free from the heavy siege of monsters!

title: The Adventures of Nerdstan
description: Join Nerdstan In His Ultimate Adventures to save the NerdDom. Defeat Enemies, Collect Coins, Navigate Platforms and Face Powerful Bosses.

title: The Wonderful 101: Remastered - The Wonderful One: After School Hero - Part 1
description:
Get ready for a unique side-scrolling experience in the world of The Wonderful 101: Remastered! This free DLC lets you enjoy a brand new episode in which you experience Luka's story!

As the latest member of the CENTINELS, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

title: Traffic Racer Highway Online
description: Multiplayer highway car racing, with amazing missions, daily event , and Friends Challenge

title: Quick Thief
description: Quick Thief is the simplest 2D game in which you have to steal things and sell them and try not to get in the eyes of the guards.

title: How Many Deaths to Clear?
description: "How many deaths to clear?" is a time attack game where you compete to clear the game as quickly as possible while keeping your death count as low as possible. Try to clear the game as fast as you can without dying too much, and enjoy the thrilling sensation that comes with it.

title: Elven Rivers II: New Horizons - Collector's Edition
description: Celene and her brave teammates have already earn a reputation for themselves: this is why they were chosen to be the first group to explore the neighbouring continent of beastmen.

title: The Diary
description: Several diaries gradually reveal the thrilling story of a missing case; after multiple deductions, are the answers in the past or present? With frequent plot twists, you never know which is the truth and which is the unexpected; in a dense fog, time buries the past, but the marks remain.

title: Delven
description: Explore the subterranean depths of an infinite 2D world and discover unique biomes, monsters, artifacts and more. Build your base to gather and manage resources. Fight bosses in tactical, turn-based battles and unlock dazzling and powerful loot!

title: Citadale Resurrection: Prelude to War
description: DLC for Citadale Resurrection. Prelude to War is an early 1990s handheld styled action platformer.

title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet: Craziest and Madness Edition
description: Embark with Tad and his friends on a new journey through different cities where you will encounter challenging puzzles in your quest to get the emerald tablet.

title: Summer Daze: Tilly's Tale
description: A funny and charming visual novel adventure. Be a rogue among heroes in this professionally voiced fantasy story!

title: Draw and Color: Kawaii - Director's Cut
description: Draw and Color: Kawaii - Director's Cut is your path into the world of adorable delicacies! Use different drawing tools and have some tasty fun!

title: Burger Chef Tycoon: Co-op Edition
description:
Tasty burgers? Only in here!
Like going out to town for a snack? Everybody does!

But perhaps you'd like to see that from the other side?
Not everyone can, so don't waste the opportunity!

Manage the preparation of burgers, fries, crispy chicken and a multitude of other treats!

title: That's a Cow: Premium Edition
description: Soar through the air and don't get milked in this cute game.

title: Swords & Bones: Complete Edition
description: Grab the sword and defend the Kingdom of Vestus in an adventure full of action in the spirit of classic retro games.

title: Boreal Tenebrae: Deluxe Extended Edition
description: Boreal Tenebrae will take you on a retro-style adventure, with a mysterious atmosphere and horror elements. The game is inspired by 90s classics and the best TV series.

title: UnderDungeon: Deluxe Edition
description: Bundle contains the game + a soundtrack!

title: John Cena’s Sexy High School Adventure
description: Fucco-san has had enough of being bullied, so he hopes that in his new school, he'll make lots of friends! Will he be the most popular student? Can he make it in time for prom?

title: Normal Shmup
description: Normal Shmup is a strange shoot em' up game based around classic gameplay. Fight the enemies and regain control of the world again.

title: PokerTH
description: PokerTH is an open-source Texas hold 'em simulator that runs on Windows, Mac OS X, Linux, and Android. PokerTH is written in C++ using the Qt framework and allows for up to ten human players, with computer-controlled players filling in if there are not enough humans. Players can also play against other PokerTH users online.

title: Velocity 2X: Daily Sprint
description:
Originally part of the Xbox and PC release of the game, it was planned as a DLC for PlayStation but was added as a free update after the AGDQ Speed Run of Velocity 2X.

The mode features platforming sections of the game in a randomly generated order with a practice option to see the new layout each day but only one chance to finish the level with a high score for the leaderboards.

title: Sphereout
description: An arcade puzzle game about arranging 3d blocks on a sphere.

title: Waifu Space Conquest
description: Kill the aliens and enjoy the cyberpunk aesthetic

title: Bee in the Valley
description: Be Like a Bee: Fly, Collect, and Attack in a Buzzing Journey through the Undiscovered Valleys!

title: Urban Flow: Silver Edition
description: Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

title: Theft Ride Legacy
description: Gear up for the ultimate treasure hunt on wheels!

title: Puzzle by Nikoli S: Numberlink
description:
Intuitive puzzle where you draw lines
to connect the same numbers.

title: Sudoku: Casual Board Game
description:
Sudoku is a very old puzzle for training the mind, logic and attentiveness!
Sudoku is the oldest and very popular mindfulness puzzle! There are riddles for every taste - from the simplest to the most complex. And if the task is beyond your power, then you can always use the hints that will help in solving the puzzle.

Pleasant music and colorful graphics will allow you to immerse yourself in the game, completely relax and have a good rest. Forget about paper sudoku, now the puzzle will always be with you on your device! Train your brain, develop logic and mindfulness!

title: S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope - Silver Edition
description:
Game includes:
15+ Stages
30+ Weapons

title: Bubble Bird
description: Bubble Bird is a simple yet addictive game that is great for both adults and kids to play. She perfectly develops reaction and the ability to make quick decisions.

title: Runner Roy
description: Runner Roy is a sidescroller platformer where you have to count both on your skills and luck to overcome (and survive!) as many machines and obstacles along the way as you can.

title: Stages of Life
description: Follow the journey of a girl from childhood to old age in "Stages of Life," an exciting puzzle-adventure game. Overcome challenges and reflect on your choices in a vibrant world with an inspiring soundtrack. Try it now and discover the meaning of life!

title: Cross Impact
description: Cross Impact is an indie crossover platform fighting game, featuring a diverse cast of iconic characters, multiple modes, and a fully-fledged training mode to perfect your moves. Gather your friends for local & online matches! Prepare to Make Your Impact!

title: Barrett Foster: Chapter One
description:
Barrett Foster a realistic puzzle game in which you play the famous inspector solving a dramatic personal investigation: The disappearance of Emma and Gabriel, close friends of Barrett.

Explore your environment and solve different puzzles to progress and find answers !

title: Project Hypnagogia
description: An experiment set up by a mad scientist called "Hypnagogia" to reveal absolute fear by revealing the subject's most terrifying images into reality. The line between dream and reality is blurred. It's not easy to find a way out when there's only one scary dream going on around you.

title: Knight vs Giant: The Broken Excalibur
description: Engage in combat against gigantic monsters terrorising the Kingdom of Camelot and defeat them with your Broken Excalibur in this roguelite action adventure with RPG elements.

title: Hotel Renovator: Five Star Edition
description: The Hotel Renovator Five Star Edition includes the base game and a pack of 7 DLC to be released in the upcoming months. Expand your inner designer experience with 7 packs featuring amazing decoration items that will make your hotel stand out from the rest.

title: Lost Colony
description: "Lost Colony" is a Twin-Stick Shooter Action-Roguelike set on an abandoned space colony. Guided by your drone companion, you must explore the planet and defend yourself from the swarms of aliens and the corrupted colony security system. Will you uncover the secrets of the Lost Colony?

title: Sphere Guider
description: Dark Souls but a Ball.

title: Lords of the Fallen: Deluxe Edition
description: A vast world awaits in all-new, dark fantasy action-RPG, Lords of the Fallen. As one of the fabled Dark Crusaders, embark on an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the demon God.

title: Teachers. With Love and Passion.
description: Start your new life as a teacher! You worked hard to get here, but nothing prepared you for a lounge full of charming single teachers. Each has secrets, and your choices can change everything. Will you find love in this school romance?

title: Qīyún Yìmèng
description: Qi Yun Yi Meng (translated as Clouds of Dreams) is a narrative-driven point-and-click adventure puzzle game.

title: Chenmo de Xishuai
description: Chenmo de Xishuai is a cricket fighting game.

title: Abstract Driver
description: Abstract Driver is a 1-person game where you have to move inside a cylindrical space. This game is a dynamic action game in which you have to control the camera to the rhythmic music and score points. If you collect a certain number of points, you get achievements.

title: Survivor's End
description: Grab your guns and get ready to take on the zombie apocalypse like never before!

title: Four Chambers of the Human Heart
description:
A professional cosplayer leads an ordinary life.

He takes on a job in pest control, where his boss insists he works in full cosplay to differentiate the business from the competition.

The story follows the indignation and humiliation of the protagonist, as he aims to become independently wealthy.

title: Geminiii
description:
Don't expect gravity to be complicit to your wishes

How will you apply pressure to the variables? How many turns will it take you to solve Geminiii?

title: AlterSpace
description:
A space exploration game.

Explore the huge universe while you also try to find out why all humans got extinct, and by what.

title: Revvolvver
description: Revvolvver is a crazy multiplayer (up to four) platformer that places emphasis on accuracy. Hitting targets with all six of your revvolvvers bullets will win the game. Will you choose accuracy or brute force?

title: Heroes of Spyria
description: A JRPG style fantasy game reminiscent of SNES classics.

title: Skoory Rush
description: The most absurdly amusing arcade game to hit your screens! Can you keep up with the chaos and out-score your friends? Find out as you climb the online leaderboards and become the ultimate Skoory Rush Master!

title: Puffer Pop
description: Puffer Pop is a short puzzle game about saving a pufferfish from the sharks that chase her. Eat bubbles, inflate, and turn the tides on those that would eat you, all while relaxing to calming sound of ocean waves.

title: Just Skill Shooter
description: Just Skill Shooter is a first-person shooter game where you take on the role of a soldier fighting enemies in two different maps. You have access to different weapons - a rifle, a shotgun or other- which you can use to eliminate enemy combatants.

title: Testament: The Order of High-Human
description: Testament is a first-person single-player action-adventure game with bits of RPG and metroidvania elements set in a post-apocalyptic fantasy world. It offers a mixed combat with different possibilities and combination by sword, spells and bow while it is rich with platforming and puzzles.

title: Pokemon Bois
description: Humorous old-school Pokemon fangame.

title: Type King
description: Type King has three different game modes: Typing, Jumping and those combined makes Type King! With some variety and different difficulties there is a total of fifteen levels to beat before you can be crowned the Type King!

title: Elizord's Tale
description: This is a first-person horror game with jumpscares that tells the tale of the character Elizord who gained a power to take revenge on everyone who mocked him in his kingdom.

title: Synth Beasts
description: Capture and harness powerful beasts to do combat and traverse the world in this monster taming action-adventure. Unravel the mystery of your existence by exploring a sinister island laboratory and putting an end to the creation of the Synth Beasts.

title: Lost in Darklight
description: Lost in Darklight is a live action interactive FMV game. A retired ace soldier, four girls, a hidden chamber at home, genetic cloning tech... Experience interactive panoramic evidence searching with this game and decide your own ending. Every choice you make is crucial!

title: Uchikano: Living With My Lovers
description: Uchikano: Living With My Lovers is a fully-featured erotic visual novel focused around the excitement of living with multiple lovers, with lots of CGs, and everything else you'd expect from having a feminine couple at home!

title: Lord of Terror
description: In a galaxy far away a world is facing doomsday. As nations rise against each other the world is plunged into chaos. Many illegal groups such as gangs and independent militias and demonic cults take the advantage of the situation to expand. Your task is to assassinate a demon dubbed Lord of Terror.

title: Micegard
description: MiceGard is an adventure game where you will play as mouse-vikings. Immerse yourself in a unique world inspired by Scandinavian mythology.

title: The Paradixion: Son's Room
description: The Paraxition: Son's Room is the first series of The Paraxition, a point-and-click adventure game with a mysterious atmosphere developed by a solo developer in Korea.

title: Happy Saint Sheol
description: Two thousand years ago, the Pestis Disaster swept through the land, corrupting all living things and making it too difficult to live on the land. Having touched the darkest darkness the world has seen, one must now face the dazzling light. Thus I pose this question. Whose wings did I see that day?

title: Don't Go, Pikachu!
description:
No time to rest! Pikachu has been kidnapped and needs your help!

Battle your way through five randomly generated environments in this unique roguelike adventure!
Beating the game rewards a badge and unlocks new starters — can you collect all?

Short roguelike Pokémon fangame that runs with a fast combat system featuring permadeath and limited PP.

title: Criptotamagothic Lite
description: They are here!! The Criptotamagothic!! Pet your fiend! One free tamagothic monster will be included in the game Tamarindos freaking dinner! collect them all!! Meet your first tamagothic in this Lite version!

title: 114 Miles to Doctor Noodles Farm
description: A waiting-simulator story epilogue of Tamarindo's Freaking Dinner, the upcoming brand new game sequel of Baobabs Mausoleum. Published by Neon Doctrine.

title: Marley & Marley
description: Your Future is a Horror Story Written by your Crimes! A 2021 X-mas horror short game gift from Jacob Jazz! A horrifying adaptation of Charles Dickens "Muppets A Christmas Carol" Bah! Hambug!

title: Jacob Jazz's The Bus
description: A short horror story epilogue of Tamarindo's Freaking Dinner, the upcoming sequel to Baobabs Mausoleum.

title: Weird West: Definitive Edition
description: Discover a dark fantasy reimagining of the Wild West where lawmen and gunslingers share the frontier with fantastical creatures. Journey through the story of a group of atypical heroes, written into legend by the decisions you make in an unforgiving land. Each journey is unique and tailored to the actions taken - a series of high stakes adventures where everything counts and the world reacts to the choices you make. Form a posse or venture forth alone into an otherworldly confines of the Weird West and make each legend your own.

title: SMW
description: An open-source reimplementation of Super Mario World. It requires the original game to extract its assets.

title: Blow Away Survivors
description: "Blow Away Survivors" is a thrilling casual roguelite action game where you unleash attacks, sending countless enemies flying. Face massive enemy hordes and powerful bosses, level up and grow stronger. Enjoy diverse skills and actions powered by a physics engine, all in short, exciting sessions.

title: Ark: Survival Ascended
description: Ark: Survival Ascended is a next-generation remaster of our beloved ARK: Survival Evolved, harnessing the power of Unreal Engine 5. The base game will include SOTF and all the Ark: Survival Evolved DLC maps (which will be added to ASA over time).

title: Ortheo
description: Ortheo is a bite-sized open-world momentum-based 3D platformer. Join Ortheo and explore massive worlds in this all-new 3D globe-trotting adventure! Explore huge beautiful worlds and collect tons of coins and gears.

title: Akasha
description: Welcome to Akasha. This zen-puzzle platformer will have you questioning your every move. Discover the abilities of the Soul Sphere, solve abstract puzzles, and reunite the Lost Eidolons to reconstruct the pieces of your inner self.

title: Nuke Them All
description: An RTS classic reborn with a twist. Time is of the essence, Commander! Capture the flags, conquer the territories, and eliminate the enemy fort. And finally, nuke them all! This old-school sci-fi Indie real time strategy game, crafted by a devoted fan, revives the genre's enduring allure.

title: Nasty Neighbors: No Country for Curmudgeon
description: A logic-arcade game in which we plague a certain rich neighbor in various ways. The game consists in sabotaging the devices located in the neighbor's villa, as well as causing accidents involving the neighbor. All this is shown in a humorous form and with a big pinch of salt.

title: Wolfhound: The Way of the Warrior
description: Is a Russian computer game in the Action/RPG genre, developed by Gaijin Entertainment for the Microsoft Windows platform. The game is based on novels by Russian writer Maria Semyonova and the movie "Wolfhound", which was released in 2006.

title: Wolfhound: The Last of the Grey Dogs
description: A Russian Top-down Action-RPG game based on novels of Russian writer Maria Semyonova and 2006's film "Wolfhound".

title: Jiggly Zone
description: Welcome to the Jiggly Zone. Become Jiggler and find the seven Medallions scattered throughout the land, by collecting forty-two Shards.

title: Zeta
description: Zeta is an adventure game with light dungeon crawling elements. The star ship Pilgrims is sent to investigate an accident on the planet Z (or Zeta-3) in the Zeta star system, and find out what happened to the first investigation team sent earlier, and to search for the lost transport ship Sanctuary.

title: Matemágica
description: Matemágica is an educational game for children that aims to teach early math skills and logic. The game was only released in Spanish and its divided on 10 CDs.

title: Hana: Hide and Seek
description: You move into the city, away from your family. Luckily you find a cheap goshiwon. Although, the day you move in weird things started to happen. You keep seeing this woman... A woman with long black hair covering her face, scrawny body, with long deformed limbs. And the more you fear it, the stronger it gets. And it won't stop until you're dead... will you survive?

title: Total War: Pharaoh
description: Total War: Pharaoh features a choice of eight faction leaders from three rich cultural hubs, with unique playstyles and diverse unit rosters. Whether you’re charming the courts as a peerless diplomat, charging into battle as an unwavering commander or causing chaos as a fearless warlord, become a leader that history will remember.

title: Löwenzahn: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
description: An educational game based on the German TV show 'Löwenzahn'. The game teaches kids about nature, economy and technical aspects on the world.

title: Hirogaru Sky! Precure: Hirogaru! Puzzle Collection
description: Based on the TV anime "Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure". It is a minigame collection of puzzle and table games that anyone can enjoy, such as finding mistakes and jigsaw puzzles.

title: The Diner
description: A charming waiter confronts you at a humble diner.

title: True Maze Defiance
description: "True Maze Defiance" is a thrilling game where you navigate a ball through a challenging maze, collecting diamonds and avoiding obstacles. Its unique control system, which uses mouse tilting, adds to the excitement and immersion. With engaging gameplay and increasing difficulty.

title: Balls and Coins
description: Are you looking for a definite solution to boredom? Then you are in the right place. Physics-based running game Balls and Coins promise excitement, tranquility, and peace of mind, while also pushing your limits. Avoid enemies and obstacles, collect coins, and be the who achieves the highest score.

title: Cell Machine Indev
description: Get ready for the ultimate 2D sandbox puzzle game experience with Cell Machine: Indev!

title: Circuit Breakout: Dual Polarity
description: Unravel the mysteries of a derelict facility as you control two characters with unique abilities simultaneously in this thought-provoking 3D puzzle adventure.

title: Gerda: A Flame in Winter - Liva's Story
description: Become the leader your team needs you to be in Liva's Story. Play as Liva - the Sparrow - after she and her small group of Resistance members are forced to flee Copenhagen and retreat to the small village of Tinglev.

title: Lord of the Click: Interstellar Wars
description: Let's do it once more, people! New chapter of the critically acclaimed Lord of the Click series is finally here. And it's tetralogy now meaning we're done with the trilogy thing and up for something bigger. Interstellar Wars take the neverending conflict to a whole new level — in space!

title: Raventure
description: In Raventure, you play as a brave warrior on a perilous journey across a scorching desert.

title: Meteorite Miner
description: Meteorite MinerIn this thrilling 2D space mining game, you'll take on the role of a daring asteroid miner. Armed with your trusty mining laser, you'll blast through space rocks to extract valuable minerals and resources.

title: Presences: Dark Awakening
description: Explore a dark reality, discover a forgotten ritual, interact with the world around you, solve ancient puzzles, platform treacherous underground chambers, and feel the terror. Survive the night in this interactive haunted house narrative adventure from a first-person perspective.

title: Sex Simulator: BDSM Girls
description: An interactive sex simulation game with visual novel elements, featuring high definition graphics and videos, with realistic-looking characters set in a beautiful decor. You play the role of an experienced Mistress who initiates three lucky women into the world of BDSM sex.

title: Triad Ball
description: In NeoFuturistTown, anarchy reigns. The underworld barons have taken control and are fighting for territory. To put an end to these confrontations, a brilliant inventor proposed to settle the conflicts by triad matches. A sport created by this man of science.

title: Degroid
description:
The game tells the story of a little man named Degroid, who was caught by Mad Doctor. He had gone crazy during his experiments with teleportation.

A player will have to pass the obstacle course to get to the perpetrator of his imprisonment and get out of this endless madness. On the way there will be loads of circular saws, thorns, aggressive slugs, lasers and other lethal obstacles.

Because of teleports, carrying the Degroid`s body between levels, a player acquires immortality, resurrecting after every defeat.

Will he become mad too after countless deaths?

title: Tilting Tiles: Micro Challenge
description: Tilting Tiles: Micro Challenge is the third installment in the Tilting Tiles series. Micro Challenge brings an entire new take on the unique puzzle series by adding new player movement options and new terrain tiles. Whether you are a fan of the series or a first time player, this is the perfect place to start.

title: Wobbledogs: Console Edition
description: Raise your own hive of mutating dogs, physically simulated down to their guts!

title: Round People
description: "Round People" is a local multiplayer game where up to four players can battle it out on a trap-filled pool table. Strategy and action are key in this game.

title: Korokoro Harley
description:
The world's most "edgy" action game has arrived!
The hedgehog "Harley" who rolls and puts out a needle, unfolds a great adventure!

title: MoonBeam
description: This game is a shooting game where players are positioned at fixed shooting spots aiming to defeat waves of monsters and score points.

title: Blind Bullet
description: Shoot towards darkness.Blind Bullet is a top-down 2D shooting game.You're blind in this game.You can see around by echolocation with your footstep sound.This game is under development.You can play by the end of Chapter 1 with demo version.Full version will also be available for free.

title: Petrovich and all, all, all...
description: A humorous point & click game based on Andrei Bilzho's caricatures. The game introduces us to how and what that same Petrovich and other historical figures live on today. At 25 levels of the game we meet Pushkin, Grandfather Mazai, Chapaev, Kolobok, aliens and many other characters.

title: Haishan
description: "Haishan" is a traditional Chinese-style cultivation roguelite game. Set in a world where the revival of spiritual Qi has awakened demons that wreak havoc on the modern world, you traverse ancient realms with the aid of the "Kunlun Mirror," embarking on a journey of cultivation.

title: Peculiarities of National Fishing
description: "Peculiarities of National Fishing" is a Puzzle/Arcade game based on the popular 1998's STV TV movie of the same name.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: Waluigi Moveset
description: A custom moveset mod for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate which adds in Waluigi into the game.

title: How the Cossacks searched for Mona Lisa
description: A Ukrainian point & click adventure game. It is based on cartoons made in the USSR at the KievNauchFilm film studio by director Vladimir Dakhno.

title: Johnny Trigger: Sniper
description:
Take aim - headshot! Take aim - headshot! What could be more satisfying?

You play as a professional assassin with style, guts and an awesome rifle. Your opponents aren't beaten in the dark either and they can bite back, but you've got enough bullets in your magazine: pick a target, aim, headshot! Way to go!

Earn money for missions to unlock new guns, rocket launchers and even assault rifles. Collect keys to open mysterious suitcases. Shoot exploding barrels, defeat mafia bosses and make sure innocent civilians don't get hurt.

title: Touhou Hyakki Kasen
description: "Touhou Hyakki Kassen" (English: Eastern One Hundred Ogre Battle) is a real time strategy and tower defense game in which players place their units and face waves of enemies. As commander Reimu or Suika the players can select three kinds of units: Walking (very basic but flexible, they move in any direction), Barrage (they attack from distance) and Flying (fast, life bar and damage are various). Each unit is disposable and players can increase their deck level by synthesizing existing cards or collecting new ones each time they win a mission. Touhou Hyakki Kassen is the 10th official game from Strawberry Bose.

title: Touhou Monsters Card - Phantasmal Summoner
description: In Gensokyo magic is considered outdated and people are starting to use monsters in battle. Developed using same game engine as Touhou Soujinengi, Touhou Monsters Card is a mini RPG where the player will travel to various places and dungeons to collect more than 400 monster cards. The battle system shares similar mechanics with the Saga and Pokemon series. When there are no monsters in a player's field, they'll receive a direct attack. Monster cards can be obtained by winning battles or exploring available locations. The developer also provided online features and allows player to duel via their Twitter account.

title: Touhou Quest: Mugen no Spellcard
description: Suddenly, a mysterious fog rolls in and releases hordes of monsters from the dungeons. Accompanied by a group of party members, Reimu is out to save the land from peril. Mugen no Spellcard, literally translated as Spellcard of Infinity, is a traditional turn-based RPG, influenced by SaGa Series and Dragon Quest. Players control a party of characters that can walk into towns and buy items to defeat monsters outside of the towns. Touhou Quest features a skill tree, a tiered skill system that typically branches out into multiple paths, giving the character the ability to perform a new action or giving a boost to one of the character's stats. Skill trees also affect characters attributes such as magic points, weapons, gold, etc. The weapon synthesis system from Touhou Soujinengi is back, so that players can forge stronger weapons.

title: Touhou Battle Raiders
description:
Suddenly, numerous monsters appear and Gensokyo is once again in danger of destruction.
Touhou Battle Raiders is a strategy RPG developed by four doujin circles; Hachimitsu Kumasan, AQUA STYLE, Strawberry Bose and Kanagawa Denshi Gijutsu Kenkyuujo. Through the campaign, the player retains control of four characters, across a battlefield against hordes of enemy forces in real-time with boss battles at the end of each round. In the campaign the player must complete the main objective to proceed to the next chapter, but there are also optional routes which can be completed alongside the main quests with rare items as reward. In between battles, players can access their characters to equip them with purchased goods or items gained from previous adventures.

title: Touhou Eiyuu Musou
description: Touhou Eiyuu Musou (English: Eastern Heroes Unrivalled) is the second game, developed by Kanagawa Denshi Gijutsu Kenkyuujo and Strawberry Bose, and based upon Shin Sangokumusou a series of action games created by Omega Force and Koei. Similar to Shin Touhou Musou, there is no specific storyline and the player chooses one of 12 playable characters, explore 50 stages going after fairies, kedamas, UFOs and a powerful boss that awaits every five stages. Each level has different terrain and random enemies. As the player collects more point items and experience, new skills can be unlocked. The game also supports two player cooperative mode via network feature.

title: Touhou Genmu Youtan: The Nightmare of Rebellion
description: Touhou Genmu Youtan: The Nightmare of Rebellion is the third game of Strawberry Bose's trilogy. It basically uses improved materials from it's predecessor Devil of Decline. All graphics and effect have been completely renewed and are greatly improved. The game features five playable main characters, which all participate in battle.

title: Löwenzahn 2: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
description: The second installment of the educational game series based on the German TV show 'Löwenzahn'. The game teaches kids about nature, economy and technical aspects of the world.

title: Grim Tales: Color of Fright - Collector's Edition
description:
It wasn't bad enough that your train was running late, but now a mysterious note warns that this Gray family dinner will be the last! Inside the Gray family castle, everything is in chaos, with your family nowhere to be found. The walls are graffitied with the scribbles of a madman as his laughter echoes through the halls. Armed with a magical paint set, you are the only one who can save them. Reunite with previous Grim Tales characters, including Luisa, Elizabeth, James McGray, and even your niece, Jackie! Can you unmask the kidnapper and beat him at his own game? Find out in this mysterious Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version.

The Collector's Edition includes:
Can the past be rewritten? Play the bonus chapter to find out
Score soundtracks, screen-savers, and concept art
Check out your achievements and collections
An available Strategy Guide

title: Grim Tales: Graywitch
description: While researching her family’s history, your friend was pulled back in time! It’s up to you to travel into the past to find her, but it won’t be easy. There’s a mysterious monster on the prowl and the town’s history remains a mystery. Can you uncover the identity of the monster and rescue your friend in time?

title: Nuclear Titbit 2
description: Russian adventure point & click game. The second game released by Buka Entertainment under the brand name "Byaka" ("Бяка"), specially created for this kind of games. The idea and scenario of the game belong to Daniil Shepovalov.

title: Grim Tales: The White Lady - Collector's Edition
description: Your nephew and his friend have gone missing from Evergreen Boarding School! Your only lead is that both children recently mentioned seeing the apparition of a lady in white. Can you uncover the secrets hiding in the boarding school, or will you fall prey to the spirits inside?

title: Grim Tales: The Hunger
description: Your niece Jackie Gray has been murdered by a killer whose crimes went unsolved 17 years ago. Team up with Jackie's policeman father and use your powers to go back in time and stop the killer before their murder spree claims Jackie's life in the present! Will you be able to solve the cold case, or will the killer rise again to begin another reign of terror? Travel into the past to find all the clues – and the villain!

title: Grim Tales: The Hunger - Collector's Edition
description: Your niece Jackie Gray has been murdered by a killer whose crimes went unsolved 17 years ago. Team up with Jackie's policeman father and use your powers to go back in time and stop the killer before their murder spree claims Jackie's life in the present! Will you be able to solve the cold case, or will the killer rise again to begin another reign of terror? Travel into the past to find all the clues – and the villain!

title: Nevsky Titbit
description: Russian action FPS game. The idea and script of the game belong to Daniil Shepovalov.

title: Spacejump
description: An unnamed undercover policeman is given a new task, to destroy all aliens on a secret planet.

title: Palm Tetris
description: Palm Tetris is a puzzle game built on various cubes of different colors that need to be decomposed so as to fill the entire void.

title: All is Fair in Love and Vore: The Tavorion Collection
description: Vore visual novel! Vore! Sex! Complex characters! Profound thoughts! Women! Well-researched historical settings! Cannibalism! Never before has it been so easy to play all 6 iconic masterpieces, now with extra content!

title: Supraworld
description: Supraworld is a first-person puzzle metroidvania. Be tiny in a handcrafted toy world. Explore, solve puzzles, ignore the main quest, get out of bounds, find secret areas, convict murderers. Hunt for powerful new abilities to unravel this vast, interconnected world… And don't forget to save the princess.

title: Moon Observatory Melanie
description:
Moon Observatory is a fantasy otome game series created by Batensan.
In the universe of MO, there are thirteen worlds named after months, with one final nameless world. Each world has a Magician, a half-immortal being who watches over their world's residents.

title: Wickie und die starken Männer: Die Mutprobe
description: Vicky wants to join the vikings on their next journey but the crew think he isn't ready yet. To prove how strong Vicky is he needs to beat some of the vikings into challenges, but since he isn't the strongest he needs to come up with clever ideas to win.

title: Oscar the Balloonist Discovers the Farm
description: Oscar is exploring the world and explores the farmland to discover and learn about animals and living on a farm.

title: Popgoes: Lost Dreams
description:
One year after the death of beloved inventor Fritz Glade, an old friend gets trapped in the abandoned pizzeria. Will she survive, or will she follow in the creator's footsteps?

Popgoes: Lost Dreams is a fanmade sequel to Popgoes by Kane Carter. The game features three different chapters, free-roam gameplay, new characters and a whole bunch of jumpscares.

title: Math Blaster Ages 6-8
description: Eight absorbing activities with five levels of content introduce addition, subtraction, and sorting of simple and complex number sets. Over 350 lessons and 1,000 problems and puzzles build operations and data skills, while exploration activities build visual and logical thinking skills. Progress reports and printable activities are included.

title: Die CD-ROM mit der Maus 1
description: Playing, learning, puzzling, drawing and making music with the Mouse and the Elephant.

title: Die CD-ROM mit der Maus 2
description: Playing, learning, puzzling, drawing and making music with the Mouse and the Elephant.

title: Die CD-ROM mit der Maus 3
description: Playing, learning, puzzling, drawing and making music with the Mouse and the Elephant.

title: The Dusk Alliance
description: The Dusk Alliance is a 1-4-player coop Action/Investigation horror game.

title: Fairgames
description: Welcome to Fairgames - your chance to rob the rich and rebalance the scales. Fairgames is a competitive modern heist game where you team up to break into exotic locations and steal the cargo. The twist? You not only need to outsmart guards and security systems - you also compete against other teams. Crews that extract with the most loot and flair might just rise to the top of Fairgames. Take it 'til you make it - who will you recruit first for your crew?

title: Helldivers 2
description: Helldivers 2 is a cooperative third-person shooter in which squads of up to four players are deployed from orbit onto hostile planets to complete strategic missions. Players select loadouts of weapons, armor, and stratagems that allow them to call in orbital strikes, supply drops, vehicles, and turrets during combat. Friendly fire is always active, requiring coordination between teammates. The game features a persistent galactic war where community-wide performance determines which planets are liberated or lost.

title: Ghostrunner II
description: Ghostrunner II is a hardcore FPP slasher set in a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world. Featuring everything fans loved about Ghostrunner plus incredible boss fights, new interactive story, thrilling motorbike levels, improved skills, and more cyber ninja action.

title: Phantom Blade Zero
description:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

title: Sword of the Sea
description:
Sword of the Sea is an action-adventure game developed by Giant Squid, the studio behind Abzû and The Pathless.

Set in a vast desert landscape, players control a character known as the Wraith, exploring ruins and uncovering a lost world.
