description: Murder Mystery: Who Killed Linda Neuman is an exciting and entertaining game developed by iWin Games. At the luxurious Paradise Island Resort, the Grand Fashion Show is just about ready to get underway. However, things come to an abrupt halt when the show’s top model, Linda, is found murdered in her room. The hotel manager is concerned with his hotel’s reputation and calls on the help of Detective Clara. However, as Detective Clara gets deeper into her investigation of the mysterious death of the famous model, she uncovers clues that lead her into a chaotic whirlwind of secrets and affairs. Just when she thinks she has found the perpetrator, she learns something else that takes her back to the drawing board. The plot thickens with each clue she finds!

title: Warhammer Underworlds: Shadespire Edition
description: Warhammer Underworlds – Shadespire Edition is a digital adaptation of the explosive, high- stakes, turn-based strategy tabletop game from Games Workshop that pits mighty warbands from the Age of Sigmar universe against one another in an eternal player versus player batle for Glory. Choose a warband, build your decks and carve a path to victory using dice-and-card mechanics that offer boundless strategic depth.

title: Samba de Amigo: Party Central - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Sonic the Hedgehog music DLC pack: Open your heart,
Reach for the Stars (Re-Colors), and I'm Here
- Sonic the Hedgehog and Tails costumes
- Space Channel 5, Super Monkey Ball, and PuyoPuyo costumes and accessories
- More music from SEGA fan-favorites: Space Channel 5, RGG Studio, and Rhythm Thief

title: The Jackbox Party Trilogy 3.0
description: Take your family get-together or work happy hour to the next level with The Jackbox Party Trilogy 3.0! This collection features all 15 hit games from Party Packs 7, 8, and 9. The best part? Your phone is your controller, so everyone can play - no special equipment required!

title: Doom & Destiny Worlds: Damsels & Dragons
description: Summon 3 playable heroines, sail to 9 uncharted islands, fight powerful horrors and craft epic gear in your final adventure!

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days - Character Set 06: Taizo Kiyokura
description: Additional Card Set for Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days!

title: Mystery Mansion
description: Escape from the haunted house.

title: Skautfold: Usurper
description: With Eldritch horrors having been unleashed by the outer-worldly Citadel, your job is to rid London of its terrors and defeat the Navigator!

title: Food Truck Tycoon + Knights & Guns
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure filled with culinary delights and medieval action with the Food Truck Tycoon + Knights and Guns Bundle!

title: Drill Deal: Oil Tycoon
description: Drill Deal is a fun oil business simulator. Start from a single tiny rig and expand it to a large complex of connected platforms. Optimize & grow your business. Look out for threats like weather, terrorists, fire, and others. Take care of your working crews.

title: Cassette Beasts: Deluxe Edition
description: This edition contains everything you need for the complete Cassette Beasts experience. Set out to explore the world of New Wirral with max expression, unique apparel, and accessories in the Cosplay Pack!

title: Battlefield 2042: Elite Edition
description: Packed to the brim with value, Battlefield 2042 Elite Edition brings 4 Seasons worth of content. Battle on 17+ maps, wield over 35 weapons, deploy as 14 Specialists, and enjoy the “Lost World” Epic Bundle.

title: Moto Rush GT + Food Truck Tycoon
description: Embrace the thrill of high-octane racing and culinary mastery with the exhilarating Moto Rush GT + Food Truck Tycoon Bundle!

title: Kitten Island
description: In a land full of challenges, jumps, secret areas and meows. Play with a very special kitten. To win, break blocks, jump over other little animals, dodge dangerous spikes, and progress to the next level, all while traversing through diverse landscapes ranging from lush forests to icy glaciers and scorching deserts.

title: The Wonderful 101: Remastered - The Wonderful One: After School Hero - Part 2
description:
Get ready for a unique side-scrolling experience in the world of The Wonderful 101: Remastered! This free DLC lets you enjoy a brand new episode in which you experience Luka's story!

In Part 2 of this DLC, don't miss some brand new mode including a Caravan Mode and Online Rankings.

title: Bubble Bobble Nostalgie: Christmas Edition
description:
The developers of Bubble Bobble Nostalgia also released an add-on called Christmas Edition.

In fact, this is the same Bubble Bobble Nostalgia, only with the atmosphere of the New Year or Christmas holidays: the title music is the notorious Jingle Bells, the dragons are dressed up in the costume of Santa Claus or Santa Claus, and the passwords are replaced with the names of attributes of the New Year or the same Christmas. Well, they changed the background and platforms in some levels. And the rest is the same.

title: Rainbow hotel
description: Short game. You are in hotell attacked by rainbow animals. You have to find keys and run out!

title: Sphizofrenia: Concept of Horror
description: Sphizofrenia is a concept of horror.

title: Legends of Haired Pyra
description: Legends of haired Pyra is multiplayer game endless runner.

title: Spacident
description: Made for TK Game Jam.

title: Project Beksinski
description: Game inspired by images of Zbigniew Beksiński.

title: Steamfantasy: Unbelievable Korwin Story
description:
The game world is part of a destroyed planet that is similar to Earth with dimensions connected to it.
Your story begins in an alternate Hungarian Kingdom when King Korwin sends you to save his daughter and bring peace to the kingdom.

title: Hortal
description: You need to escape from caves. Use holes to teleport and have fun!

title: Boyfriend to Death 2: Fresh Blood
description: A sequel to Boyfriend to Death, focusing on new characters Vincent, Cain and Lawrence.

title: Cosmo Knight Zion
description: The project involves significant changes in the story to create an original plot, as well as improvements to the game engine, the addition of new elements and improvements to the controls, changes in the levels, characters and enemies, and modifications to the music. Although the project is still in its early stages of development, I hope to work on it until it becomes a completely new and complete game.

title: Dungeons of the Obelisk
description: A 2D, turn based, dungeon crawling, loot grinding adventure.

title: Aqua Ippan
description: Heavily inspired by arcade games from the 90s, Aqua Ippan is a ‘Shoot’em Up’/platformer game currently in development that can be played by one or two player(s). Despite being a modern game, it feels and plays like a true arcade classic, and pays homage to the Metal Slug series with its artstyle, detailed animations and jazz-fusion music.

title: Bum Fights
description:
Get ready to brawl like never before in Bum Fights! Jump into the ultimate online multiplayer top-down shooter set in a nostalgic medieval world, where you rise from rags to riches as a penniless warrior fighting for survival and glory.

Experience fast paced action and intense combat as you battle other players in the arena, or team up to take on hordes of the undead. Arm yourself with a variety of weapons, from rusty knives to throwing rocks, and fight until you're the last one standing.

But beware: the competition is fierce, and only the strongest and most skilled will emerge victorious. With customizable characters and diverse game modes, there's always a new challenge around the corner.

Gear up for battle and enter the arena to prove your worth as the Lord of the Bums!

title: Hana Awase: Mizuchi
description:
Volume 1 of Hana Awase.

A maiden's prayer shall make the flower bloom.

There is a card game called "Kasen", which is played with cards known as "Hanafuda". Only a handful of people, known as "Kaei", can call on and draw the power of the "flower". With most Kaei are men, the five students who possess the most power within the academy are referred to as the "Gokou" and are revered.

This is a story about a maiden who has dedicated herself to five male students aiming to become one of the Gokou, set in Kasen National Academy, which is a school that produces many individuals with rare talents.

description:
Volume 2 of Hana Awase.

title: Hana Awase Complete
description: Collection of all four volumes of Hana Awase for PC/Mac along with the series' soundtrack.

title: Hana Awase New Moon: Mizuchi
description: Port of Hana Awase: Mizuchi for the Switch, simultaneously released in Japanese, Chinese, and English.

title: Hana Awase New Moon: Iroha
description: Port of Hana Awase: Iroha for the Switch, simultaneously released in Japanese, Chinese, and English.

title: Hana Awase New Moon: Himeutsugi
description: Port of Hana Awase: Himeutsugi for the Switch, simultaneously released in Japanese, Chinese, and English.

title: Hana Awase New Moon: Karakurenai/Utsutsu
description: Port of Hana Awase: Karakurenai/Utsutsu for the Switch, simultaneously released in Japanese, Chinese, and English.

title: Hana Awase: New Moon
description: Spanning across time and realities, Hana Awase: New Moon is the story of a young woman drawn into the web of the game kasen, played with hanafuda cards. Through playing, she comes to meet five mysterious men, all of whom are elite players and all of whom guard secrets that hold the power to alter her world irreparably.

title: Sinking Iron
description:
A strong submarine earthquake caught the attention of an amateur diver and his apprentice.

They were close by when the incident happened and decided to investigate before officials arrived.

You are the apprentice. Good luck.

title: Austrian Avian Association
description: Austrian Avian Association is an episode-length total conversion for Doom II. You play as Katarina Berger, a Schnabelperchten doctor who has to save her home (and, potentially, the world) from a sudden invasion of monsters caused by humans tampering with dark powers.

title: Recreational Warfare
description: RecWar is an action game where the main goal is to destroy as many vehicles as possible. To do this you have several weapons and unlimited ammo at your disposal. You can play over a network, splitscreen against your friends or just kill computer opponents. RecWar also includes team game and Capture the Flag play modes. The flag isn't just any flag though...

title: Trick or Alice
description:
On the night of her birthday, Minase Arisa is inexplicably thrown into a Wonderland much like the one from Lewis Carroll's classic, a strange fairytale-like place that keeps repeating the same day over and over again. What's more, its inhabitants—each bearing an uncanny resemblance to someone whom Arisa knows in real life—insist that she is, in fact, their "Alice".

Will Arisa be able to get away? Or will she choose...

title: The Gold and Black Keys that Cannot Open
description:
Katagiri Kanade is a hikikomori who spent her days lazing off in her room. Her specialty is her broad imagination which often leads to various wild delusions. One night a weird cowboy guy appeared in her dream, saying that he’s her heart’s hero. Due to his encouragement, Kanade decided to try and go have a haircut the next day. It was then when she met a mysterious guy who cut her hair in the park, giving her courage to resume her school days.

Right after her haircut, Kanade was nanpa‘d by a guy who turned out to be her former classmate, Sudou Yukio. Kanade used to like him back then, and he was happy to meet her again. Kanade lives with her non blood-related brother, Sonomura Ikuto. Despite Ikuto’s warning, Kanade went looking for the mysterious guy who cut her hair the next day. She found him in the park, where he introduced himself as Hasui Tomoomi. He’s a professional hairdresser and owns a salon named Azalea nearby. Since Kanade was absent from school for so long, her homeroom teacher, Konno Chihiro, offered to help her with her studies.

Having these guys around her, what will happen to Kanade’s life from now on?

title: Death of the Augnob
description: An alien goes on a quest to defeat the Augnob.

title: Solasta: Lightbringers Edition
description:
The Solasta Lightbringers Edition contains:
- Crown of the Magister: The original level 1-12 campaign. From fledgling adventurers to saviours of Masgarth, this 40h+ campaign will take you through the Badlands in search of ancient artifacts to stand against a mysterious threat.
- Palace of Ice: A level 10-16 campaign, it is the continuation of Crown of the Magister and Solasta's last DLC. Venture north into the lands of the Snow Alliance to help your allies and end the Sorak menace once and for all! Also unlocks the Gnome and Tiefling ancestries.
- Lost Valley: A stand-alone level 1-12 campaign. Trapped by accident in an isolated valley where Manacalon's ancient traditions still rule, the party must find a way to escape by allying various factions jumping at each other's throat. Also unlocks an additional subclass for each class.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Update 3.1
description:
In this update you get:
- A new Legendary Hero
- Bretonnia are getting some love with plenty of changes and rebalances.
- The Great Drill of Hashut will strike in a new Chaos Dwarf endgame crisis for Immortal Empires, The Will of Hashut.
- Beef up the lower tiers of infantry with the fourth Regiments of Renown

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Shadows of Change
description: This DLC will add three Legendary Lords (1 for each race), a Legendary Hero and new units.

title: Total War: Warhammer III - Thrones of Decay
description: This DLC will add three Legendary Lords (1 for each race), a Legendary Hero and new units.

title: Sandtrix+
description: Sandtrix+ is an expanded version of the freeware game Sandtrix. It extends the base game with new game modes, challenging color modes, and unlockable themes.

title: Echoshift
description:
Experience echoshift originally released on the PSP system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The Walker’s life is stuck on repeat. Our hero is lost in a series of dangerous, mind-bending mazes, where time keeps replaying, over and over… Do you have the skill to help the Walker escape?

Test your mental agility in 56 levels of puzzle-packed action, where the clock is always ticking as you work to flick switches, unlock doors and overcome obstacles.

Co-operate with ‘echoes’ of your past self to solve problems as you navigate through this ingenious and endlessly addictive puzzle game from 2009.

title: Firewatch: Audio Tour
description: This update adds a commentary mode in which the game’s protagonist goes on a hunt for new tapes that contain the developer’s recollections, anecdotes and more. It also adds a free-roam mode.

title: Lust Campus
description: Lust Campus is a multi-adventure graphic novel with an emphasis on eroticism and intimacy, with with a diverse cast of complex characters with whom you can connect and meet, and who evolve (or not) thanks to your decisions throughout the story. In LC you will find a game with a femenine gaze an empathy driven storytelling.

title: The Thing You Can't Defeat
description:
Experimental mod for Ultimate Doom. Doomguy has dementia. The Thing you can’t Defeat lets you replay the first episode of Ultimate Doom as it slowly morphs into a confusing and demented nightmare.

This WAD was HEAVILY inspired by the WAD “Doom but somethings not right” and the album “Everywhere at the end of time” by The Caretaker.

title: Young Street
description:
Before bipedal apes invented radio receivers, before we exchanged our gills for lungs, there was radio.
Man-made transmissions mutate and extend the electrosphere.

Remember the alien face of nature!

title: Real Time Assist Replay Time
description: "Real Time Assist Replay Time" is a slot machine simulator.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: Heists
description: Heists was a major content update exclusive to Grand Theft Auto Online. It featured a new 4-player cooperative experience for GTA Online, giving players the chance to team up to pull off a string of intense multi-part heists, raids and robberies. Online Heists spanned numerous missions featuring new gameplay, vehicles, weapons, and scenarios to test a team’s full set of skills.

title: Illegal Crime Game
description: Explore the city and commit crimes. Collect money and commit crimes. Pray to your Crime Deity and invade tombs.

title: Lambda
description:
This a gzdoom mod that contains all of the weapons and items from Half-Life and Half-Life: Opposing-Force, also includes some extra sutff from other mods to fill the item holes.

With a focus on fast-paced combat and visual fidelity, Lambda transforms Doom into a hybrid sci-fi shooter with classic mechanics and upgraded graphics.

title: Lambda-Strike
description: This mod was originally just a reskin of Doom, but now is a full port of all the arsenal of counter-strike 1.6 with some extra.

title: Taiwan 2001
description: Taiwan 2001 is a Japanese parody of the unlicensed SNES game Hong Kong 97. The game was released by Kuso Soft in 2001 and is based around the political status of Taiwan regarding if it is it's own country or a part of China.

title: Star Detective
description:
Star Detective follows a detective who gets a missing person case from a child that wish to a shooting star for help.

It's a simple game where you walk around and talk to people. The game is mostly story focus but you do get to meet some friendly faces as you help a child find their friend.

title: Assassin's Creed Mirage: Launch Edition
description:
Assassin’s Creed Mirage is a stealth-focused action-adventure game set in ninth-century Baghdad. It emphasizes parkour, infiltration, and targeted assassinations. The game follows a more compact structure than recent entries in the series. Players control Basim, a young thief drawn into a secretive order. The title blends historical settings with narrative elements tied to the franchise’s established lore.

The Launch Edition is a special physical release including the base game, a large map of 9th-century Baghdad, and a set of three collectable lithographs (art prints).

title: Grisaia: Chronos Rebellion
description: The newest installment in the Grisaia visual novel series. All of the girls from Mihama, past and present, must face off against a new evil terrorist organization in an all-out war.

title: Emerald Wasp
description:
Operation Rassvet was a model of surprise.

It started as an intelligence operation and ended up becoming one of the most mysterious disappearences to these days. None of the members were found. Forgotten by the world, the last survivor is hiding in the shadows...

title: Orly Kuukou Satsujin Jiken
description: Kanae and Akina went to France for the first time abroad and got involved in a murder case. A Southern Tourist tour operator is killed, and Kanae follows the victim's schedule from arrival to Paris till return.

title: Misty
description: You are a high school student. One day your classmate Miyuki suddenly loses his memory. An investigation leads to his girlfriend who suspiciously disappeared a year ago.

title: Tawhid
description: Year 2031. Main character is a 28-year old ex-operative photographer who travels around the world while taking pictures of ruins destroyed by war. A 12-year old girl who joined you in Egypt is being chased by a secret organization and even the farthest corners of ruins around the world won't stop them.

title: Oddrietta
description: 3 days ago, 22 year old Henrietta was getting ready for work when she received a message from her mother: "Don't go out, the wind is changing people...". A mysterious wind appeared out of nowhere and if someone listens to it, they start to change: some get holes and pimples all over their body, some become grotesque abominations. Henrietta became deaf after a car accident 9 years ago, so she isn't affected by the wind... but she can't stay home forever. What's going on out there? What is that wind? Is Henrietta's mother okay?

title: Mungyodance
description: Mungyodance is the first game in the Mungyodance series. It is a rhythm game that features 167 songs, and has an overall simpler feel than the two succeeding games in the series.

title: Darkland 3
description: DARKLAND is a fun retro-style platform game! Our protagonist, the shadow hero, must cross the valley to find the key to open the portal. There are dangers along the way, pay attention to the traps on the head and the spikes under the feet. Step on the enemy and destroy them, being careful not to fall off the cliff. The game has 50 levels. Wish you have a good time!

title: Outbreak Ultimate Apocalypse
description: Enter the world of survival horror with the Outbreak Ultimate Apocalypse bundle! Featuring Outbreak: Lost Hope, Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles, Outbreak: The New Nightmare and Outbreak at a great price! Can you survive the nightmare?

title: Mungyodance 2
description: Mungyodance 2 is the second entry in the Mungyodance series. The game include almost every song from the first game, with an additional 295 new songs.

title: Mungyodance 3: The Third Rave
description: Mungyodance 3: The Third Rave is the final entry in the Mungyodance series. The game features over 780 songs, including some from previous games.

title: Mungyodance Final
description: Mungyodance Final is a cancelled forth entry in the Mungyodance series. The game was teased on Twitter by Emma Essex in 2013 and was later confirmed cancelled in a 2015 post on her Reddit.

title: Speed Demons
description:
Speed Demons is a racing video game released in 1999. The game was developed and published by Microïds.

The game has 6 vehicles with possible localised damage, with three possible points of view. The game can be played as single player, 2 player split-screen, or by up to 6 players on a network. There are 10 circuits in varying locations, such as American motorways, on the sides of a volcano during its eruption and snow-covered ski slopes.

title: Flif
description:
Baby angels save the world from drought! Bonky glidey flappy physics platforming! Explore clouds & sky ruins & collect raindrops!

Commissioned for Indiepocalypse #38.

title: Notes of Hearts
description: In a world of fantasy and magic, you are a rising strategician unraveling the mysterious magical events occurring all over the world. You are free to choose your gender as well as your species, which ranges from Human, Canine, Feline, Avian, Dragon and Fae. You will meet many characters, most of which anthropomorphic in your adventure who you may befriend or seek a deeper connection with. There are multiple romance options not bound by species or gender.

title: Black, White and Grey
description: Paige, a girl currently attending university in her hometown, discovers that someone has been following her. Strange noises come from around the house at night, and it seems that danger is near. Everyone's trying to keep their secrets, but circumstances force them to reveal more and more. Who will prevail in the end? It's all up to you.

title: Crap Game Compilation 2
description:
“Crappy games are better when they're all in one place.”
A compilation of flash games by JonBro originally on Newgrounds

title: The Riftbreaker: Into The Dark
description: Explore an entirely new area of Galatea 37 in this Story Campaign expansion for The Riftbreaker. Catalog new species. Craft new and unique weapons. Fight hordes of aliens, unlike anything you've seen before.

title: Drainscape
description: Drainscape is a vertical action adventure with roguelite elements, where you must survive your fall through a drain filled with obstacles and enemies with only an umbrella to save you.

title: The Lost & Forgotten
description:
There are cases of disappearances around him.

People will forget about someone, forget their name, and then their existence will be forgotten. That person will disappear. They are 'lost'.

Nikk, a sixth-grader, has a father who locked him up at home after school. He despised him. He thought that there were people that should just disappear.

And if there's someone that he doesn't want to disappear from the world, it's his dear friend, Rea.

title: Slime Roll
description:
Our game, developed for the Mini Jam, embraces the theme of Fusion and incorporates the required limitation of "Control the Environment." In this fast-paced and creative adventure, players will dive into a world where the fusion of objects and abilities takes center stage.

As the player explores various levels, they will encounter unique objects and elements that can be fused together to create powerful synergies. With the ability to control the environment, players can manipulate and combine these objects to overcome obstacles and navigate through challenging puzzles.

To navigate the game world, players will utilize the classic WASD controls for movement, providing a smooth and intuitive experience. Additionally, they will harness the power of fusion through the use of special abilities. Pressing the spacebar allows the character to perform a dynamic jump, while the Q key activates a heavy ability with tremendous impact. For explosive situations, players can unleash the fused power by pressing the E key.

Our game truly embodies the theme of Fusion by emphasizing the combination of objects and abilities to overcome obstacles and solve puzzles. With the limitation of "Control the Environment," players are encouraged to think creatively and strategically to manipulate their surroundings and forge their path to victory.

Join us in this thrilling adventure, where fusion and environmental control are the keys to success. Can you master the art of fusion and conquer the challenges that lie ahead? Get ready to experience a game that pushes the boundaries of creativity and control in the Mini Jam!

title: The Garden of Banan
description: Little Timmy has found himself lost at his kindergarten I mean preschool. You must find Little Timmy before he- well, dies I guess? Just find your kid man idk

title: Akahane Academy
description:
It's back to school after the break!! Your club leader is acting stranger than usual? The teacher is going crazy, and three new boys who are dying to meet you!!

Well, the teacher is always like that... But why is everyone being so weird today?!

These new boys seem to like you...
And by like, I mean it.

title: Spirits Mirror​:​ Digital Possessed
description:
A spirit reflects
The visions you see
Shifting divisions
Between you & me

title: Terrapy
description: Terrapy introduces the player to the complexity of caring for houseplants. Each plant requires its own unique accommodations and will react accordingly to the player’s selections. As is such when caring for each other, Terrapy illustrates the costs and benefits of personal choice and free will within a wholesome environment, integrating horticulture to nurture empathy and growth.

title: Yoshi's Island PC
description: Yoshi's Island PC is a fan made 2D platformer based on the Yoshi's Island series that was released on Mario Fan Games Galaxy by Emma Essex in the early 2000s and later rereleased in the Early 2000s FANGAME HELL collection.

title: Cyber Soldier
description: Fast-paced competitive online multiplayer and offline survival mode, guns and overpowered skills, you and getting cash!

title: Stray Doom
description: Stray's cat rips and tears through demonic hordes in brilliant upcoming Doom mod This mod lets you play as the cat from Stray in the original Doom, and you can shoot your way through the game as the cat. But not only that, but you will be playing in third-person.

title: Escape From Russia: Mobilization
description: Originally russian runner, in which you have to find yourself in the shoes of a poor piglet, running away from the military commissar with a agenda.

title: Tribute
description: A narrative-driven exploration game where your choices shape the outcome as you traverse an ancient temple and confront the fate of an Old God's eternal slumber.

title: TimeQuake
description: Time is your weapon in this online PVP first-person team shooter. Opposing factions bend time to take out opponents, complete objectives and dominate the battlefield.

title: ReplaceR
description: It's a 2D action shooting adventure game where you switch between multiple guns and use interchangeable gimmicks to try to break through the stages! What awaits you in a mysterious facility in a corner of the universe?

title: O Jardim Magico 3
description: The magic class helps to consolidate the knowledge acquired in School in a fun way. Facilitates learning and prepares the child for new challenges. Portuguese Language, Mathematics, Fun holidays, Junior Graphics, and Who knows, knows!, Recess.

title: The Last of Us Part II: Grounded Update
description:
This title update adds Grounded and Permadeath as modes.

It adds the following new graphics, audio, and gameplay modifiers:
- Mirror World
- Mirror on Death
- Slow Motion
- Bullet Speed mode
- Infinite Ammo
- Infinite Crafting
- Infinite Melee Durability
- Infinite Listen mode Range
- One Shot
- Touch of Death
- 8-bit Audio
- 4-bit Audio
- Helium Audio
- Xenon Audio

It also adds the following new options and improvements:
- Saves now display playtime up to the second
- Film Grain Adjustment option
- Disable Listen Mode option
- Motion Sensor Function Aiming option
- Arc Throw HUD Display option
- Aiming Acceleration Scale option
- Aiming Ramp Power Scale option
- Accessibility improvements to Ground Zero encounter, collectible tracking, Enhanced Listen Mode for collectibles, and rope gameplay

title: Insert Title Here
description: This "game" hasn't got any story or plot, any characters, any enemies ... "Insert Title Here" is an interactive experiment in which you will decide what path to choose, how to react ... something innovative which is always nice to try. This experiment will play with you, "talk" with you and put you into a mix of various game genres.

title: Witch Trainer
description: Miss Granger has become a headache for Professor Snapes, and next to this one you will try to "put in waist" to this one, developing not only his personal growth but also affecting other characters such as Snapes, Harry or Ginny, although these are only mentioned.​

title: Muppets Sorting and Ordering
description: Sorting & Ordering is a Muppet Kids CD-Rom game produced by Brighter Child in 1997. This game is volume 6 in the Muppet Kids Reading and Thinking Series.

title: Become A History Explorer
description: My First Amazing History Explorer (aka Tidsmaskinen, Become a History Explorer) is a video game published in 1998 on Windows by DK Multimedia, Norstedts Rabén Multimedia. It's an educational game, set in a history and fantasy themes.

title: Become A science Explorer
description: Become A Science Explorer involves 8 different activities, 20 experiments to print off and try, brilliant graphics and 8 fun worksheets! You can also take the ultimate science test in the Bright Sparks Quiz!

title: Hugo: The Magic Oak
description:
Hugo: The Magic Oak or The Magic Oak is a 1998 video game developed and published by ITE Media for the PC as part of the "Play and Learn" series. It was titled Den Fortryllede Eg / Hugo: Leg Og Lær 1 in Denmark, Tajemný les (Mystic forest) in Czechia, Taikatammi in Finland, Die Zaubereiche in Germany, Zaczarowany dąb in Poland, and Кузя и его друзья: Волшебное дерево (Kuzya and friends: The magic tree) in Russia.

Originally released on 1 June 1998, the game was re-released on 21 April 2005 as Hugo Gold III in Germany. It was also re-released as part of the compilations Hugo 2 in 1 and Hugo - Sonderpaket 1 (with a beach wristwatch) together with Wild River in 1999 in Germany, Hugo: Birthday Party in 2000, and in the Best of Hugo series with Hugo Classic #1 (Hugo) in Denmark.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W Yajilin
description: Draw lines through the centers of cells to make a loop, and paint cells black in this original Nikoli puzzle. It's immensely satisfying to see how the lines and black cells all come together to form a solution, and figuring out how to draw the loop isn't as easy as it might seem.

title: Fritz: Don't Call Me a Chess Bot
description: Play chess with interactive hints and tips

title: Sweet Dreams
description: Light hurt his eyes, use that to your advantage and keep him away. Learn the different points where the creature can enter to be prepared. Sound will give you clues to the creature's arrival. Keep your flashlight charged up. Every night the creature will try new ways to trap you.

title: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate
description: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scribes of Fate is a DLC for The Elder Scrolls Online. It is the 29th DLC released for the game and continues the year-long Shadow Over Morrowind adventure along with Update 37. Its release date is March 13th, 2023 for PC and Mac, and March 28th, 2023 for Xbox and PlayStation.

title: I'll Invaligate your Aid
description: A short game where the antagonist is a lovely girl that doesn't want you to play.

title: Project: Playtime - Phase 2: Incineration
description: Phase 2 is finally here! The horrors continue with an all-new map along with a host of new terrifying monster skins, and intricate survivor skins. Phase 2 also expands on gameplay with new puzzles, a UI overhaul, and a slough of quality of life upgrades.

title: Eperon Defend
description: This time you have to protect the Eperon planet from the meteors, which are incoming.

title: Neko Secret Homecoming Light
description: Explore Neko Town looking for hidden objects. Walk down the streets, find new places to get in. Try a variety of mini games like playing darts, picking locks, breaking safes! Try changing your style using character customization. Finally, find the way to get to the anime factory and hack all its computer's data!

title: Letter To A Friend
description: Letter To A Friend is a short first-person experience by Christoph Frey about the unspeakable horror that creeps up on you at a nightly train station. Its visual references come from expressionistic silent movies and old analog recordings. The game was made in 48 hours during Asylum Jam 2015 and is a proof of concept regarding the visual aesthetics and atmosphere.

title: Million Shells
description:
Manage 15 cannons attached to a huge battleship
and shoot down the enemies that appear.
This is an exhilarating tower defense shooting game!

title: G-Mode Archives 47: 12Gems
description:
The time left is only one night.
Save the world with the power hidden in 12 types of GEM.

"12GEMs" is an RPG that uses the power hidden in 12 types of GEMs (jewels) and travels while summoning partners sealed in each GEM.

The beginning of the story is the aerial castle "Ganseld" floating in the sky with the power of GEM.
The people living in Ganseld chose themselves as noble people, and the lower world on earth was taught as a place where unclean people and horrible monsters wandered around, and they lived without involvement.

However, one day, the GEM that supported Ganseld suddenly scattered to the uncurled ground.
In order to prevent the castle from falling, the main character, the boy "Dino", received the order of collecting GEM and went to the lower world, but it was a mysterious and mysterious world that was different from what was taught in Ganzeldo ...

Until Ganzeld crashed, there was only one night left. The fate of the world was entrusted to a boy.

title: G-Mode Archives 46: Keitai Shoujo: Koi+Hime - Koi ni Ochita Cinderella-hime
description:
Those shoes are cursed if a fake wears...? A princess romance adventure in a sound novel style.

When I woke up, I was alone in the dark wilderness. In the bag I was holding, there were dolls and glass shoes...

The main character with glass shoes is attacked by a "masked man" on the way and escapes from his life, and meets a girl.
In the house where she lives, there are girls with familiar faces...

"Mobile Phone Girl - Love + Princess - Princess Cinderella Who Fell in Love" is a love simulation "Mobile Phone Girl" Gaiden work. It is a princess-like romance adventure game in a sound novel format that incorporates romantic comedy x suspense x moe elements in the Grimm's fairy tale "Cinderella" that everyone knows.

Among the heroines, the story revolves around "Sayo Tomoe" which has a quiet and mysterious atmosphere.
The main character "Hiro Aida" is attracted to her and gets involved in a certain incident.
Please enjoy the mysterious and glamorous world that is a bit different from the brilliant youth story depicted in the previous work.

title: G-Mode Archives 45: Chura-umi Monogatari
description:
A time of peace spun by the gentle sea breeze. An Okinawa life experience for those who are tired of modern times.

Chura-umi Monogatari" is a sequel to the game "Chura-jima Kurashi" that simulates life on the southern island.

The stage of this work is a small island "Kotsubu Island" floating in the beautiful sea. The main character, who is tired of living in the city, decided to move after seeing an article on "Recruitment of Administrators of Kotsubu Island" on the Internet.

You will spend a five-day trial period on this island where calm time flows.

At "Kotsubu Island", you can deepen friendship by deepening exchanges with residents, fall in love, and enjoy various leisure (mini-games) such as "Eisa", "Yashi Fruit" and "Snorkeling".
When you finish 5 days, the ending will change depending on the favorability of the residents and the degree of achievement such as mini-games.

A time of peace spun by the gentle sea breeze. Please enjoy your own southern island life.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Origin
description: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Origin is a DLC that adds an origin reading mode, a new game opening, sprite switching, and Mehagashi-hen from Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou+.

title: Blaze Union: Story to Reach the Future
description: Blaze Union: Story to Reach the Future Remaster is a high-definition remaster of the fantasy strategy RPG first released for PSP in May 2010. In addition high-definition visuals, the updated release offers improved operability and tempo, useful features like rewind and auto-save, and various other adjustments that make gameplay more pleasant.

title: Fall of the New Age: Collector's Edition
description: Find your little brother in this adventure!

title: Vivitter for Nintendo Switch
description: Who's the Chicken?! Introducing a party game that measures your fear level! Online battles for up to 10 players! More than 30 mini-games to test your courage!

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged
description: The world’s raddest cars are back and taking the fun to the next level! Race over 130 vehicles with crazy new mechanics and even more vehicle types. Plus, build your tracks with stunning new environments and different game modes to have fun off and online!

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibugawa Ryousuke Jiken-bo vol.11 - Ane no Kabe
description: "Anesama" is there. What do the silent walls and folklore tell us?

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jiken-bo vol.12 - Nakanai Irainjin
description: Their cries reach no one. In a distorted cage, they quietly await the hand of salvation.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Todo Ryuunosuke Tantei Nikki vol.1 - Kohakuiro no Igon: Seiyou Karuta Renzoku Satsujin Jiken
Pool Together
description: Take the plunge into endless fun and excitement with Pool Together - the ultimate pool game experience!

title: Namariel Legends: Iron Lord - Collector's Edition
description: Free your people from the Iron Lord's merciless grasp!

title: NoEvidence: Scary Horror Quest Survival Story
description: NoEvidence is an intense detective game where you investigate a murder. Navigate a dark environment using only your flashlight. Discover the murder location and prevent the crime. Use detective skills to find clues and important objects like a recorder, tapes, fuses, and a revolver. Solve puzzles and decipher codes to unlock doors and access key areas. With its immersive atmosphere, challenging quests, and gripping storyline, it's a must-play for detective game and thriller fans.

title: Paper Dominoes
description: Get ready to dominate the dominoes in Paper Dominoes - the addictive game that's perfect for all ages! The classic game right in your hands with a beautiful art style.

title: Princess Arthur for Nintendo Switch
description:
Port of Princess Arthur for the Nintendo Switch.

A king has left the world. In this country where for generations the king has been decided by the Holy Sword, a ceremony would be held to select the new king. Out of the many people who sought to draw the Sword, only one succeeded. Neither a knight nor royalty, the person was an ordinary girl.

Persuaded by the legendary magician Merlin, the girl begins to live as the king without understanding anything. It is there that she meets the Knights of the Round Table. The girl stands on a battlefield for the first time in her life. She grips the Sword tightly in hand, still not knowing why it chose her. Tears are in her eyes.

The girl learns what love truly is. Even as several threads of fate entwine around and trifle with her, she will continue to love only one. And so, the girl takes the sword in her hand. To cut open fate for the one she loves.

title: Hentai World
description: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch has to offer.

title: Breakfast Bar Tycoon: Co-op Edition
description:
It's almost time for breakfast! Go and prove that your breakfast bar deserves its fame!
Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen?
In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task!
You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.
Take orders, prepare dishes and fight for tips!

title: Minecraft: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Experience a dramatic tale unfold with Minecraft's Dungeons & Dragons DLC. Explore iconic locations in the Forgotten Realms like Icewind Dale and Candlekeep, battling Beholders, Mimics, and more. Choose your class, unlock classic spells, and ace ability checks to escape sticky situations. Your story awaits!

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou + Origin
description: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou + Origin is a bundle that includes the expanded console port of Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou and its DLC, Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Origin.

title: Chiko-chan no Noukatsu Kenkyuujo
description:
Let's exercise your brain with Chiko-chan by playing a brain activity game supervised by Kikunori Shinohara, professor of brain science! Stimulate every part of your brain while playing 3 genres of brain activity games!

Energize your brain by playing brain-activating games in three areas: attention, analysis, and inspiration.

In "brain activity mode", you can measure your brain age once a day. In addition, there is a "recommended brain activity game" mode that recommends brain activity games that match the current state of the brain.

"Brain activity with everyone" mode where up to 4 people can play together.
"Chikotto Trial" mode where you can play your favorite brain activity game.

In addition, you can enjoy content related to brain activities such as "Brain Activity Quiz" and "Brain Activity Stretch".

title: Telenet Shooting Collection
description:
Welcome to Shooter's paradise.
Telenet Japan Wolf Team's greatest hits return!

title: Ano, Subarashii wo Mou Ichido: Saisouban HD
description: A remake of the 1999 visual novel.

title: Chotto xx na Watashi no Nichijou: Kiki Dasshutsu!? Gyakuten no Nazotoki Life
description:
Save the heros from these unfortunate pictures!
A simple, touch based time killing escape game

Somethings happening in these ordinary bright, yet sad, illistrations
A hidden object game where you aim to seek out a solution to these "Not-so-sad" dangers!

title: Mosaic Chronicles Deluxe: Extended Edition
description: Enter a fantastic world full of magic and charm. Rebuild legendary tales with Mosaic Chronicles Deluxe: Extended Edition. A new puzzle game experience awaits.

title: Isle of Jura Fishing Trip: Extended Edition
description: Visit the remarkable Isle of Jura and catch some delicious fish!

title: Arcade Archives: Tetris - The Absolute: The Grand Master 2 Plus
description: Tetris - The Absolute: The Grand Master 2 Plus is a puzzle game released by ARIKA in 2000. This work has been further enhanced with new modes added from the previous work. Challenge your own limits with "TGM+" where Tetriminos rise up from the bottom and "T.A.DEATH" where Tetriminos fall at a high speed from the beginning.

title: Sneaky Monsters
description: Tower Defense with unusual mechanics, where the AI sends the most inconvenient monsters and you have to constantly sell and rebuild towers.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Season 4 - Critical Corruption
description: Welcome to Season 4 - Critical Corruption! Though we have gained great ground against the rampaging Lithophage in the past months, it remains a constant threat- and to make matters worse, reports of alarming new mutations are starting to come in. Let's get right into it!

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: New Game Plus Update
description: Patch updates 1.07 and 1.08 added a New Game+ mode, Ultimate difficulty, and a series of new features, fixes, and updates.

title: Voxel Doom
description: A mod that replaces 2d characters and props from Doom with fully 3d voxel-based models. For the GZDoom source port.

title: National Videogame Museum
description: This WAD is a near 1:1 recreation of the National Videogame Museum located in Frisco, Texas!

title: Dimension of the Boomed
description: Dimension of the Boomed combines resources, monsters, and aesthetics from Quake with frenetic Doom gameplay to achieve its own unique style. Quake fans will recognise homages to some iconic set pieces, but the majority of the mapset is original content.

title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Battle of Zhongyuan
description: The first DLC for Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty. It includes new stages, difficulty levels, weapon types, enemies and more, promising an exciting experience for Wo Long experts and novices alike.

title: Hentai Girls
description: What happened to the pictures of the girls!? They are all scrambled up! Let's help the girls put the pictures back to normal and they might let us in on their dirty little secrets!?

title: Moving Blocks Puzzle
description: More than 150 puzzles await you to be solved! Slide the pieces around the empty box until you form the target figure. The figures to be formed are "identicons", which are pixel like figures formed from encoded words.

title: Demeo Battles
description: Welcome to the arena! Demeo Battles is a competitive turn-based strategy game for 1-4 players.

title: Memori
description: Embark on a captivating Platforming adventure in Memori! Master challenging obstacles while unraveling the enigmatic secrets of a peculiar world. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and confront mortality, only to be reborn anew.

title: Starsiege: Deadzone
description: Starsiege: Deadzone is a multiplayer corridor extraction shooter set in a dark sci-fi universe where humanity is on the brink of extinction. As space mercenaries, known as Raiders, players will team up with two others to explore the derelict stations taken over by sentient AI. As a Raider, your goal is to extract valuable weapons and resources for your faction. Players will select their class and venture into procedurally generated ships making each match unique. Choose from three distinct classes, each with their own unique abilities and work together to overcome the ship's deadly traps and defenses in order to escape. Beware of the other Raiders seeking the same riches.

title: Etrian Odyssey HD Character Set DLC
description: Originally available as a pre-order bonus, and extended for two weeks as an early purchase reward, this purchase adds the ATLUS-themed character portraits of Joker from Persona 5 Royal and Ringo from Soul Hackers 2 to your character creation options.

title: Everybody 1-2-Switch
description: Mix up your next get-together with the Everybody 1-2-Switch, the follow-up to 1-2 Switch. Grab some Joy-Cons or smart devices for team-based games that are easy to set up and feature everything from balloons to aliens, and more! People at your next party can get moving and show off their teamwork in this multiplayer mashup.

title: Desert Bus
description: Desert Bus is a mod for Undertale that recreates the original game of Desert Bus with an 8 hour long room in Undertale.

title: Grisaia Phantom Trigger 5.5 to 08
description:
Grisaia Phantom Trigger is finally complete!
The second half of the series is now available in one package!

title: Unimime: Unicycle Madness
description:
Unimime is a fun, hard to master, physics based, balancing game.

Enjoy 60 handcrafted levels, various characters to unlock and a game that is easy to pick up (depending on phone and hand size), yet hard to master and equally hard to put away.

Break a leg!

title: So Much Stuff: Collector's Edition
description: The ultimate sorting and matching game!

title: Mad Road: Apocalyptic Shooter Survival Killer
description: Get ready for an addictive and lowpoly gaming experience in "Mad Road"! Take control of a lone biker on a mission to cleanse the world from threats and chaos.

title: Beat Them Up: Street Fight Band Simulator
description: A game in the classic and familiar Beat Them Up genre, in tribute to history, everything in the game is done according to the old traditions of beat em up games, but with nicer graphics and more convenient controls.

title: The Rumble Fish 2: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes the game plus 3 additional DLCs: Hazama, Beatrice and Greed!

description:

title: Dogotchi: Virtual Pet
description: ﻿Set off on a journey of nurturing and attending to your digital companion in Dogotchi: Virtual Pet. These charming dogs depicted in satisfying pixel art are bound to steal your heart!

title: Too Many Super Shotguns
description: Shotguns.

title: Nobody Told Me About ID
description: Nobody Told Me About id is a love letter from DOOM fans to the iconic trinity of Build Engine games; Duke Nukem 3D, Blood and Shadow Warrior. Whether it be ludicrous gore or explosions, NTMAi tries its best to faithfully replicate all things Build on DOOM while also enhancing the base gameplay. Your arsenal may be tough, but some enemies will have a trick or two up their sleeves...

title: Stroke The Dik-Dik
description:
The Dik-Dik is a small antelope, by nature they are pretty shy and will often run away if you try to approach it. This one tough, it's friendly and will stand to attention allowing you to stroke it.

Stroke your own Dik-Dik in your own living room, bedroom, bathroom, wherever you have your TV.

title: Cat Ping Pong
description: Cat Ping Pong is an arcade style ping pong game. The user controls a cat paddle to bat a yarn ball back and forth against its opponent. Use the meddling rat in the middle of the field to gain speed, and change trajectory of the ball to score on the opposing cat!

title: Worlds War 1
description: Worlds War 1 is a shooter sci-fi game where you fight against all odds in a battle to save the earth from the aliens who started attacking the earth - and your home.

title: The Many Sins of House Ocampo
description: A POINT AND CLICK MYSTERY SPANNING 100 YEARS

title: Croaked
description: Help the undead frogs get to safety in this devastated world filled with treacherous lava pits and fire-breathing dragons.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 1 - Rashid
description:
Rashid is the first DLC character for Street Fighter 6 and the Year 1 Character/Ultimate Pass. The character was released on July 24th, 2023.

Capcom describes him as following:
”The Soaring Eagle of the Desert” that fights using parkour. With the wind as his ally, he outfoxes opponents with his high mobility. Born into nobility, he's a carefree but earnest man. Loves video streaming.

title: Bitcoin Man Clicker
description: A clicker game with the goal to click on as many bitcoins as possible before running out of lives.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 1 - A.K.I.
description:
A.K.I. is the second DLC character for Street Fighter 6 in the Year 1 Character/Ultimate Pass.

A poison-wielding apprentice of F.A.N.G, the former Shadaloo officer.
Enchanted by the power of toxins, nothing brings her more joy than testing them on a new target—other than attention from her “master,” that is.

title: Spirit of the Island: Beach Resort
description: Spirit of the Island: Beach Resort is set to bring this much requested feature at no additional cost! With the new DLC, you will have the option to pick a brand new starting location — Beach Resort.

title: Om Nom: Run - Costumes and Themes
description:
New outfits, skins and biomes.
This DLC includes:
-36 new caps
-32 new gloves
-36 new outfits
-32 new shoes
-2 new multiplayer map biomes

title: Om Nom: Run - Ultimate Edition
description:
This bundle includes:
- The base game with 140 single player campaign levels, multiple local multiplayer modes and lots of options for character customization.
- "Costumes and Themes" DLC with over 130 new outfits and skins.

title: Dessert DIY: Complete Edition
description:
Preparing delicious desserts is a piece of cake. Try it yourself!
Make sweet ice cream, popsicles and waffles using your creativeness in one of the best dessert decorating games right now.

title: All Elite Wrestling: Fight Forever - Matt Hardy
description: Play as two of the many Matt Hardys: Matt Hardy and Broken Matt Hardy. Pre-order Bonus for AEW Fight Forever!

title: AEW: Fight Forever - Elite Edition
description:
The AEW: Fight Forever Elite Edition includes access to even more AEW wrestlers and over-the-top minigames including:

- The AEW: Fight Forever FTR: Revival Pack which features AEW wrestlers Dax Harwood and Cash Wheeler PLUS minigames JoinUs and Deth Race-X
- The AEW: Fight Forever Limitless Bunny Bundle which features AEW wrestlers The Bunny and Keith Lee PLUS minigames MJF Car Thrash and Sloth Sling
- The AEW: Fight Forever Hookhausen Very Handsome, Very Evil Pack which features AEW wrestlers HOOK and Danhausen

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie - SSS Summer Splash Set
description: A DLC bundle that includes Daydream 'SSS Summer Splash' and swimsuits for Elie, Tio, Rixia, Noel, KeA, Lloyd, Randy and Wazy.

title: Super Hero Demolition
description:
Demolish everything!
Use superhero powers to demolish block structures!
Upgrade your powers until you are strong enough to demolish it all!
each hero has different powers, which hero are you?

title: Reasoning of Courage Nori 3 Balanced Diet
description:
The boy, courage, solves the mystery of miso soup
solve!

title: Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key - Additional Area "Rosca Island"
description:
Adds a new region (open field) and World Quests unique to that region.
This content requires the game clear data in order to play.

title: Hentai World: Special Edition
description: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose, and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch has to offer.

title: Hentai World: Puppy Nanami
description:
Check the newest appearance of Nanami, one of the girls from the main game, in her new puppy look.
Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all of the puzzles. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" Puppy Nanami. Every success on your part will make her happier!

title: Hentai World: Kitty Rose
description:
Check the newest appearance of Rose, one of the girls from the main game, in her new feline look.
Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all of the puzzles. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" Kitty Rose. Every success on your part will make her happier!

title: Hentai World: Foxy Akane
description:
Check the newest appearance of Akane, one of the girls from the main game, in her new foxy look.
Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all of the puzzles. The difficulty will increase depending on the "outfit" Foxy Akane. Every success on your part will make her happier!

title: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie: Special Edition
description:
The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version!

We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie is a fully remastered version of We Love Katamari Damacy, originally released in 2005, with new and improved graphics and gameplay enhancements to make it easier to jump in and have fun.

The Special Edition contains We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie, the Little Prince Costume, and the Katamari Damacy Series Music Bundle.

title: Isle of Jura Fishing Trip: Ultimate Edition
description: Visit the remarkable Isle of Jura and catch some delicious fish!

title: Super Drunken Guy
description: Are you drunken enough for that game?

title: Street Fighter 6: Ultimate Edition
description: The additional content for the Ultimate Edition comes from the Year 1 Ultimate Pass which includes 4 new characters, 3 outfits with colors 1-10 for the new characters, 2 additional stages and 7,700 Drive tickets (in-game currency).

title: Cuboy
description: Cuboy is a minimalist platform game.

title: Velocity Vortex
description: Velocity Vortex is a challenging fast pased Time Attack Platformer where you only have 5 seconds to finish each level. As you go through the levels the game gets faster, and as you die the game gets slower.

title: X-Force Under Attack
description: X-Force Under Attack brings back all the charm of shmup games from the 80's/90's. It's a frenetic and chaotic space shooter created from amazing graphics with insane battles against extremely difficult bosses.

title: Etrian Odyssey II HD: Character Set DLC
description: Originally available as a pre-order bonus, and extended for two weeks as an early purchase reward, this purchase adds the ATLUS-themed character portraits of Demi-fiend from Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne and Teddie from Persona 4 Golden to your character creation options.

title: Etrian Odyssey III HD Character Set DLC
description: Originally available as a pre-order bonus, and extended for two weeks as an early purchase reward, this purchase adds the ATLUS-themed character portraits of Nahobino from Shin Megami Tensei V and Aigis from Persona 3 Portable to your character creation options.

title: Sono Hanabira: YuriCycle
description: Risa, her weight in extremely (beep) condition due to all those delicious snacks and tea, has resolved to go on a diet! However… cutting sweets out of your diet is extremely hard, so seeing how much Risa is suffering, Mai recommends a cycling diet. Hearing how Mai already successfully lost five kilograms, Risa is extremely interested!

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 1 - Ed
description:
Ed is the third DLC character for Street Fighter 6 in the Year 1 Character/Ultimate Pass.

A Psycho Power-wielding youth aged up rapidly by Shadaloo's experimentation, on a journey and a mission to free other subjects. He gets his short temper and foul mouth from Balrog, his former mentor.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 1 - Akuma
description:
Akuma is the fourth DLC character for Street Fighter 6 and final character in the Year 1 Character/Ultimate Pass.

A demon of combat that has welcomed the Satsui no Hado into his being in his quest to become the ultimate master of the fist.

title: Obey! The Game
description: The rules are changing on you. Be prepared to obey or disobey the task at-hand. Survive as long as you can in this mashup up of microgaming and (strangely) Simon Says.

title: There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight
description: Step into the shoes of the suave secret agent Franklin Benjamin in this single-player spy thriller interactive novel. Drive fast cars, seduce beautiful women, and do whatever it takes to save the day against impossible odds. Because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got!

title: Pokémon Tectonic
description: Explore the Makya region, where old and new collide. Host to dozens of ancient caves and tunnels, Makya was settled anew by the disbanded members of Team Chasm, who 20 years ago sought the power of the Regis. When a strange new group puts those plans back into motion, the people of Makya need a newcomer like yourself to delve deep and find the truth.

title: HoleHole
description:
"HoleHole" is a relaxed adventure game where players freely explore a map, collect objects, and assist residents through conversations. The game features a visual novel-style storytelling experience and allows players to progress at their own pace.

One day, the player accidentally falls into a certain hole and freely explores the dungeon to find objects and search for residents. However, it is also a player's choice to not engage in exploration.

title: Hole Digging Game
description: to dig a hole (or not dig a hole)

title: The Ultimate Death Clock
description: You find yourself in a singularity with Death itself. With few chances to speak with the living, Death proposes a little game. Do you dive deep within yourself to indulge this cosmic guide and find out when you will meet again on official business? The Ultimate Death Clock awaits!

title: Shadow Stalker
description: An Asymmetrical Horror FPS.

title: Emberwood
description: Embark on a thrilling journey through the mystical realm of Viridar. Play as the agile Sentinel or the mighty Dragon Knight, both equipped with their own unique skills and abilities. Gain allies and develop your combat prowess while traversing the war-torn path of the Warrior-King.

title: Meow Master: Battle for Catnip
description: Hey there, fellow cat lovers! Get ready to become a Meow Master and fight for the ultimate prize: catnip! In this game, you'll have to use your cat-like skills to fight, run, and hide your way to the finish line, all while making sure you stay alive. Remember, you only have 9 lives!

title: Typing Bullets
description: Typing Bullets is an arcade typing roguelite game, where you learn new words, you practice your typing skills, all while fighting against enemies based off of keyboard keys. Upgrade and customize your character, and if you get overwhelmed by your foes, respawn instantly through the quiz mechanic.

title: Days of Doom
description: Gather your heroes and fight to make it to Sanctuary in this tactical RPG roguelite. Did we mention the zombies, raiders, and mysterious monstrosities that inhabit this post-apocalyptic wasteland? Welcome to the world of Days of Doom.

title: Puzzle Go
description: Improve your mental agility with our HD jigsaw puzzles for adults. Enjoy daily relaxation while challenging your cognitive abilities. Choose from a range of captivating images and varying difficulty levels for the ultimate brain workout.

title: Eagle Eye: Find the Difference
description: Eagle Eye is an engaging "spot it" game. Sharpen your observation skills by finding differences in stunning HD images. Play at your own pace or compete in the multiplayer mode. Enjoy the challenge and stay engaged for hours.

title: Ships at Sea
description: Experience the thrill of navigating a wide range of ships. Immerse yourself in various career paths such as service, cargo and commercial fishing, as you explore the breathtaking open world of Norway´s Lofoten Islands with its stunning scenery. The ocean is within your reach!

title: Jorogumo
description: Embark on a perilous journey through the haunting depths of the forest in Jorogumo, a gripping stealth and puzzle game. When your brother vanishes in the eerie woods, you must summon your courage and venture into the heart of darkness to unravel the enigma surrounding the ancient legend of Jorogumo.

title: Vitam Finire
description: A Horror Game made by Nobody, we could add more words, but this description needs to be short. Bye Have a great day

title: Dolos: Your Best Future
description: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

title: ItsJustAStory
description: ItsJustAStory is a solo post-apocalyptic game, it's a story about a doctor and a build-up to the production of the actual game. your goal is to stay alive and find the cure, you play through a series of events with tasks simple to complete. the main focus here is to get the story.

title: Reflector Rhythm Master
description: A hybrid of a block breaker and a music game. A strange and fun mechanic where all of the stages fit on one screen. And the antithesis of the easy-to-see music game.

title: Kid Bubblegum
description: Aliens have invaded, and Kid Bubblegum is too cool to let that slide. Armed with his trusty Gumslinger, he’ll kick some alien butt and shoot bubblegum…and he has plenty of gum!

title: Carnival in the Hut
description: There are ingredients on the level that you have to drag into the pot. Drag into the pot: eggs, oil, water in a bucket, flour in a bag, and dough.

title: Doggy Don't Care
description: Unleash adorable chaos as a mischievous pup! Explore, collect, and smash your way around the house & beyond in this cheeky adventure. Fetch the approval of your feathered friend, Rocko the Parrot, by digging into a list of fun-filled tasks. It's sure to be a pawsitively unforgettable day!

title: Biohazard Village: Cloud Z Version
description: Resident Evil Village is a first-person survival horror game and the sequel to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard. The game maintains elements from previous Resident Evil games, with players having to scavenge environments for items and manage their resources. However, it adds more action-oriented gameplay, with higher enemy counts and a greater emphasis on combat.

title: Chickenauts
description: Chickenauts is a companion based, action roguelite game where you battle evil Alien Chickens who've abducted your beloved flock. Free and mutate your chickens to defeat a myriad of foes, explore various spaceship environments and unravel secrets of the Chickens from outer space!

title: Boxed Tower: Actual Tower Defense
description: Defend your tower against waves of enemies. Survive the horde.

title: Dropsol
description: Dropsol is a retro-style arcade game where, equipped only with a parasol that reduces your speed, you have to dodge obstacles and take special items to increase your chances of getting a big score.

title: Witchcraft Survivors
description: Annihilate hordes of enemies in this thrilling, fast-paced action roguelite rpg and fill the screen with your magic. Kill your foes, become stronger each second and upgrade your characters with new spells and abilities. Can you survive the monsters that threaten your very existence?

title: Cube Control
description: Help a lone cube navigate through sixty electrifying levels in this isometric puzzle-adventure game. Carefully manage the use of your limited moves in order to complete each level successfully, all while avoiding dangerous obstacles through careful timing and creative movement choices.

title: Tunguska: Dead Zone
description: The Dead Zone DLC brings players back to Tunguska Exclusion Zone for two additional playthroughs, each being a New Game+ mode with new challenges, new weapons, and new experience. Are you ready to return to the action?

title: Old Boy
description: Old Boy, your coffee is ready! Old Boy? Old Boy is sleeping, and at this moment he's dreaming that he's a young boy with incredible skills of being young! Yes, a young boy in full vigor, and believe it or not, he knows how to run and jump, and he even does it with some mastery.

title: Dread Descent
description: A precision platformer where you have been tasked with infiltrating an ancient spacecraft buried deep beneath the surface of an alien planet. To reach the vessel, you will need to dodge traps, risk harrowing jumps, and descend into a deadly world.

title: Stellar Serenity
description: Stellar Serenity is a relaxation game where you process materials and craft items in a spaceship. No pressure, no chance to fail.

title: Breezy
description: It's like golf, but you control the wind. Harness the breeze to platform through a variety of colorful and wacky courses. Collect Golden Tees to unlock new courses and characters. Conquer holes with random modifiers in Remix Rush.

title: Catcha Snatcha
description: In this VIC-20 game from 1983, busy store detective Barney Bootlace must appease the shop manager by running around the shop floor dealing with various problems, from dealing with lost property and children, to apprehending shoplifters and even dealing with planted bombs!

title: Crownless Abyss
description: Crownless Abyss is a fantasy turn-based rogue-lite dungeon crawler about exploring the treacherous depths of the ocean in a search for a divine relic to restore the world.

title: Dead Detective: Zombie Conspiracy
description: Take on the role of Margh, undead private detective, in this humorous and wacky graphic adventure that combines point-and-click mechanics with an elaborate “deaduction” system. Use your brain (or what's left of it) and solve bizarre and unconventional mysteries in a world ruled by zombies.

title: Operation Space Force
description: Join Operation Space Force, a free-to-play team-based shooter that takes place in space. Explore weapon customization and different heroes, explore your base, fight against enemies, and experience different game modes.

title: Neon D-Fence Remaster
description: An AI menace is headed to your motherboard! Can you survive?

title: Mark of the Deep
description: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey as the fierce Marcus "Rookie" Ramsey and explore the mysteries of a cursed island to find your missing pirate crew.

title: Escape From Crimson Manor: Trapped Together
description: "Escape From Crimson Manor - Trapped Together" is a co-op Escape the room puzzle adventure set in a Victorian manor, where you and a partner must work together to solve challenging puzzles and evade the relentless pursuit of the mansion's sinister owner, Can you uncover the dark secrets and escape?

title: HeroSquare
description: Armed with your ability to parry & reflect enemy bullets, you must explore a colourful metroidvania world that looks like a 1980s arcade game. Return to the Golden Age of gaming, as you fight enemies, face formidable bosses and discover new powers!

title: DHL Box Stacker Pro
description: Beat the best in DHL Box Stacker Pro. Stack boxes as fast as possible to rise above the competition. This single player VR experience features intense gameplay. How high can you try?

title: Parkasaurus: Prehistoric Wonders
description:
10 New Animals
American Lion, Mammoth, Sabertooth, Megatherium, Eastern Puma ,Giant Capybara, Short Faced Bear, Dodo, Dire Wolf, Dwarf Pronghorn

title: Neonscape
description: Embrace Onyx, the master of the Black Lotus, in intense first-person hack n' slash combat. Maneuver compact battlegrounds, unleash spatial manipulation, and showcase unmatched agility. How long can you survive the relentless waves? Brace for an adrenaline-pumping test of mettle!

title: Whispers of the Luminaries
description:
Whispers of the Luminaries is an idol-themed murder mystery visual novel where you balance social life with detective work.

Investigate, obtain clues and deduce the killer.

title: Radix Chronicle
description: Radix is a tactical RPG inspired by SNES and early Playstation classics. With dark themes but bright characters, this fantasy tale changes depending on how you fight! Your magic can even alter the land itself. Use your timing and skill, rather than your luck, to lead your party home safely each day!

title: Homestar Runner: Halloween Hide n' Seek
description: A short Halloween-themed point n' click game featuring the dumb animal characters of Homestar Runner dot com.

title: Heaven's Paws
description: Do all dogs go to Heaven? You have to figure it out! Get through this emotionally adventurous story about a boy and his little friend, Max.

title: Dungeon of Destiny
description: Dungeon of Destiny is a roguelike where instead of loot you get to choose personality traits for your hero. Combine them into classes and more. Shape your behavior, looks and fighting style. Face consequences and find your destiny!

title: Speed Overflow
description: Innovative Rogue-like game. Speed is your weapon! All you need to do is "Dash" and "Burst", to "crash" the enemies in your own style.

title: Makoto Wakaido's Case Files: Trilogy Deluxe
description: A game based on a simple concept: a mystery puzzle you can complete in an hour. Can you solve the cases narrated in this beautiful pixel-art adventure?

title: Caislean: Paranormal
description: A dynamic survival-horror game featuring gadget setup and point-and-click sequences. Investigate the castle during the day and place cameras, sensors, and snares throughout the explored environment. Locate paranormal hotspots and read clues about countering enemies.

title: Wish Us Luck
description: Wish Us Luck is a multi-plot interactive fiction fueled by your hard decisions. Play three strangers whose fates are intertwined by the cogs of chance on an eventful day. But remember: favoring one character means jeopardizing the others.

title: Hotel Boom!
description: Welcome to Hotel Boom! A game about hotel management, where you have to make sure that your guests are happy and well fed. Manage your hotel, prepare delicious meals and provide top-notch guest service.

title: The Rings of Powder
description: "The Rings of Powder" is a fun and ironizing game combining exploration with the construction of an underground kingdom and elements of real-time strategy and idle. The project is a parody of both some of the legendary and less legendary movies and scenes from reality.

title: Skystrider
description: Embark on an epic journey in "Skystrider," a 3D action platformer. As a resurrected hero, explore a ruined world, navigating perilous paths amidst clouds and tides. Unleash ancient technology, unravel secrets, and shape your destiny in this captivating adventure.

title: Battle of Zama
description: Battle of Zama is a video game about one of the most important battles in history. Scipio from Rome’s Army met Hannibal’s Army on the battlefield in Carthage. Battle of Zama is inspired by old Avalon Hill and SPI games.

title: theHunter: Call of the Wild - Emerald Coast Australia
description: Welcome to Australia! Discover breathtaking landscapes and hunt iconic animal species such as the Saltwater Crocodile and Eastern Gray Kangaroo as you explore this magical new hunting destination down under.

title: Apocalypse Run!
description: Escape from Motorlord Dysentery and reverse the Apocalypse while learning about American history.

title: Painted Peril
description: Take up the paintbrush and unleash the power of color with Sylvia the painter mage squirrel. Mix pigments, cast paint spells, and battle living rocks in a vibrant world of magic and adventure.

title: Leap of Legends
description: Leap of Legends is an epic 2D platformer game where players compete as their favorite animal characters in thrilling PvP and PvE battles. Easy to learn, yet hard to master!

title: Fall of the Stick Knights
description: Fall of the Stick Knights is based on physics-controlled characters to player with friends up to 4 people. The game features has skin customization, nice fun hook mechanic and the clumsy characters, providing a lot of fun. Beware of the rain of crates.

title: Starcade Factions
description: Starcade Factions is a turn-based strategy game where space commanders battle ships in short action-packed games.

title: Ilya Muromec i Solovey-Razboynik
description: Ilya Muromec i Solovey-Razboynik is a computer game in the "quest" genre. The game was developed by PIPE studio and published by 1C.

title: Small Town Emo
description:
Small Town Emo is a gay GameBoy walking-simulator. Follow the story of Ken, a 17 year old with an awkward crush on his best friend Fergus.

Talk to characters, solve simple puzzles, make (occasional) dialogue choices, and explore! Navigate through the complexities of a teenage crush, and let the story of this small town emo kid unfold around you.

title: Sabaku no Kuni no bouken-ki: Aru to Chitei no Meikyuu
description: A simple and nostalgic side-scrolling action game with rough dots and 3 chords.

title: Omen Fall
description: Omen Fall is an action platform game with challenging battles set in the fantastic and vast lands of three different realms. Resurrect from the Balbal with Neu, where death is forbidden, and fight to destroy the chaos. Improve Neu throughout your journey and learn his dramatic story.

title: Hawaii Detective: Killing of a Krypto King
description: "Hawaii Detective: Killing of a Krypto King" is a Detective Mystery Visual Novel and Yuri Dating Sim where you play as Detective Laura Ko as she interrogates suspects, investigates clues and follows leads to solve this tropical tale. Maybe she even finds the woman of her dreams along the way too!

title: InfiniPicross 3
description: InfiniPicross 3: The Conclusion of the InfiniPicross series! Faster and more complex procedural puzzles (as well as better looking), even more puzzles (IP 2.0 puzzles packed in), a smooth interface built on previous improvements, easy to tweak themes and a very easy built-in puzzle editor.

title: PowerSimulator
description: Do you want to be a upright official or corrupt officials？Choose your choice,Reaching the pinnacle of power.

title: Where is Mr. Cloud
description: Hello. My name is Toprak, i lost my plush cat, can you help me find it?

title: Town of Dusk
description: Players will enter the Town of Dusk, built on the eve of Empire of Japan's defeat in World War II, along with other characters. Avoid being killed by other characters! Find the mastermind behind the scenes, unravel all the conspiracies, and uncover the 'true' truth! Also Escape the Town of Dusk!

title: The Last Stand at Camp Zombie
description: Face hungry zombies, solve complex puzzles, and explore the hidden secrets of the campsite while working together with a friend in local multiplayer. The tension is high and every bullet counts - will you be able to survive until the end?

title: Puzzle Adventures
description: A choose your own adventure game where the player is tasked with finding out how they ended up in the small house on the beach. To answer this mystery the player must solve puzzles and make choices to explore the story.

title: Calcium Contract
description: Calcium Contract is a fast-paced first-person shooter where you're on a mission to finish a contract that got out of hand. Learn to swiftly move around your enemies and master your arsenal as you fight your way toward the grand finale.

title: Orderly Havoc
