description: Orderly Havoc is a time management game where you must do chores. Each chore has a unique minigame requiring timing or solving. Do this before you stress out or else you'll have a panic attack.

title: Dragot
description: Dragot is a fast paced bullet hell dungeon crawler in which you live or die by the mysterious items you find hidden in each room; Fizzle out early or snowball your newly acquired powers to fight through all six areas and finally defeat the dragon that pursues you.

title: Heretic’s Fork: Probation
description: Dear candidate, start your free probation period as manager of Hell! Punish sinners by using our deck-building system, constructing fiendish towers to manage underworld hordes. Good luck!

title: Final Nation
description: In this challenging action-adventure you are on a quest to find a mystic crystal to save your country from an evil militant cult. Explore vast lands and secret chambers invested with dangerous enemies. In order to succeed you must escape hazards, collect crucial items, and destroy key targets.

title: Saikyo Robots
description: Saikyo Robots is a roguelike RTS, inspired by pikmin and vampire survivor. Explore during the day and command your robot army to gather resources, produce, repair and fight. At night, hordes of enemies will attack your base. Upgrade your army and base to survive and obliterate the enemy onslaught.

title: Ananse and the Pot of Wisdom
description: Embark on a magical journey inside the first story ever told. Do you have what it takes to obtain the Pot of Wisdom from the Sky God?

title: Waking Atlas
description: Wake the great titan Atlas before he drops the world in this colorful and weird JRPG!

title: Balatro
description: Balatro is a deck-building roguelite in which players construct poker hands to earn chips and overcome enemy blinds. The game features mechanics for enhancing a deck of playing cards, purchasing Jokers that modify hand effects, and discovering synergies to progress through increasingly challenging encounters.

title: Gobbo Goes Adventures
description: Gobbo Goes Adventures is a isometric puzzle game with post industrial comic style.

title: Mortal Fighter
description: Mortal Fighter: Choose from 15 unique fighters, battle in 2 dynamic environments, and engage in 15 gripping encounters in Story Mode. Test your skills in Player vs. Player, Local Co-op, or Online Multiplayer. Train in Training Mode and unleash your inner warrior in this intense fighting game.

title: Great Toy Showdown
description: Welcome to the Great Toy Showdown!! A casual shooter 8-player battle royale game where a variety of animal toy friends battle to be the only one left standing and win the love of their lives. Take on outcast and fallen toys and other animal toys to become the only surviving toy!

title: Neko's Rage
description: 2D pixelart action game with many roguelite mechanics and power up. The gameplay is speed and hardcore but very addictive. You play as Nikki a female cyborg in an apocalyptic world rules by mechanicals creatures.

title: April '86
description: April ‘86 - is a mystical first-person thriller which has our protagonist journeying to the abandoned city of Pripyat, to confront the secrets of the past.

title: Dark Hours
description: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and pray for daylight.

title: City Legends: The Ghost of Misty Hill - Collector's Edition
description: The most gruesome incidents often occur in medical institutions, the doors of which hide terrible secrets and unexplained incidents. Can you handle the darkest secrets of Misty Hill?

title: Power Solenoid
description: Meet Rockhound, multidimensional traveler living inside Grand Palace, a place filled with strange creatures called Goblins! Discover their personalities and requests!

title: Barkelona
description: An immersion-style game for Spanish learners

title: Ciudad Alfombra
description: In this game, you must dodge the obstacles in the city and complete the missions available. There is a wide variety of vehicles and colors, such as minivans and large buses.

title: Roll the Dark Heart
description: A creepy and dangerous world, no matter where your feet lead you, only fog awaits ahead, which seemingly mercilessly mocks the troubles of the still living and already dead creatures of this world, among which man is far from being at the top of the food chain.

title: Yggdrasill
description: "Yggdrasill" is a click idle game, you can plant the seed of the last world tree entrusted to you by the goddess, and synthesize stars to save the decayed world.

title: Mystery Solitaire: Cthulhu Mythos 2
description: Feel the cold breath of Cthulhu! Explore the worlds of Lovecraft, collect all the special cards!

title: Code Zodiac
description: Fight for the future in this story-driven, fast-paced robot boss rush. Code Zodiac is a compact, single-player action game with a compelling sci-fi narrative. Slash, shoot, and dodge your way through robotic titans as you fight to save the world.

title: Supracore
description: Supracore is a roguelike base building game. Build your base, upgrade it and defend against ongoing waves of enemies to gather more resource and expand your Core!

title: PISTA Motorsport
description: Get behind the wheel! With realistic graphics and physics, a wide selection of Argentine racing cars, and various game modes, it provides an authentic and thrilling racing experience for enthusiasts.

title: MiniBong
description: "MiniBong" is a lightweight rogue-like game that focuses on dress-up DIY and idle gameplay, while incorporating elements of combat, character development, and strategy.. You can feel the charm of dressing up and fighting at the same time.

title: Sqwrk
description: Fast paced 3d platformer with momentum based movement

title: Rising Snake: The Present World
description: Rising Snake: The Present World is a semi sandbox horror decryption adventure game. A fictional university campus based on real size. A "Taoist" with special abilities. A twisted and bizarre story. Waiting for your arrival.

title: Starlights
description: Starlights is a visual novel focusing on the character Fletcher. It tells a story of a protagonist who had to move schools because of an unforeseen circumstance. At the new school, he meets Fletcher, his roommate, and the story between Fletcher and the protagonist begins.

title: Retrosurge
description: Fight in an action packed fast paced roguelike bullet-hell. You control the waves, go as fast as you want or slow it down to your preference. You are in control of this arena, but can you survive the surge?

title: Pilo and the Holobook
description: Join Pilo and Prof on a new space adventure! Use your Holobook to turn everything into stickers and create your encyclopedia of a new world. Explore new beautiful planets and meet new friends in this sweet adventure game.

title: Bumper Tanks
description: Take control of a tank and dash into the fight in this couch multiplayer, fast-paced, twin-stick shooter game! Collect various power-ups to hook around the destructible environment and blast your friends with whatever it takes. Remember: One shot, One kill!

title: The Four Paths
description: The Four Paths is a game with a multilinear story and strategic battles where you will have new cards according to the paths you choose. Play as Roy and sacrifice everything in exchange for money. Play as William and atone for your sins with a brutal revenge.

title: Late Night Drive
description: Explore various maps with your friends or play solo and relax. Whether you prefer a relaxing drive or a fast-paced, action-packed race, the choice is yours. Get ready to unforgettable journey through the city streets under the moonlit sky!

title: Sir. Ball-Up
description: Unrightfully imprisoned by his father, Sir. Ball-Up ventures up to confront his father and retake the throne which is rightfully his. A hardcore aimed adventure, join Sir. Ball-Up in his quest for repentance.

title: Haphazard Angel
description: In this co-op online multiplayer game, each player controls one of the Angel's wings. Work together to pick up orbs, but be careful not to let one wing become too strong! Communication is key in this funny and cute game.

title: Under Supernova
description: An instant strategy science fiction simulation survival sandbox game. Players can control individuals, teams, and manage multiple bases. Players can farm, build, excavate, fight, produce, graze, explore, trade, record and pass on knowledge, and can also fly a spaceship to explore the starry sky.

title: Coda
description:
The year is 2XXX. The near future.
In order to avoid another catastrophic war, the maritime city of Tokyo is now a society where every action is monitored. Entertainment is restricted.
The family structure has been dismantled. Even children’s memories before their first day at school are wiped out and they have to live their lives without their parents waiting for them.
Although most people are living happily in this society,
Coda is unable to go along with its ebb and flow.
The only people she meets everyday are Legato, a friend, and Riff, a university schoolmate who does not always see eye to eye with her.
She is also sympathetic to Pracito, a moody and silent woman who she occasionally talks to.
But one day, Placito has become the first ever university student to be executed.
The execution is public for all to see and it is greeted with a rupture of applauses.

title: Celente Immortal
description: An Action-RPG game where you can recruit characters from all over the world as you go on adventures and explore new areas.

title: Sky Runners Infinite: Parkour
description: "Sky Runners Infinite: Parkour" is the ultimate cyberpunk endless runner game that will leave you breathless!. Parkour, slide, jump, and dodge obstacles while collecting coins to buy new clothes, weapons, and upgrades.

title: Their Land
description: Their Land is an action-adventure first-person game with puzzles and an exciting story to experience. You play Jeremy, a 19 year old orphan who explores an untrodden island with his much older and more experienced friends. Will you fall victim to this fabled lands many perils?

title: Move My Moc
description: Import and play your LDraw models in an open-world, car-focused sandbox environment.

title: Angola '86
description: The first strategy game to capture the essence of the entire South African Border war, from Omugulugwombashe to UNTAG (Aug'66 - Mar'90)

title: Enchantment: Secret Hideaway
description: Enchantment: Secret Hideaway is a magical hidden object game set in Thicket Wood, featuring various modes and puzzles to locate hidden fragments of magical objects and provide hours of fun and entertainment.

title: PathBlasters
description: Run, blast, and solve your way to victory! Experience the rush of a colorful, fast-paced chase, solo or against a friend! Burst through the levels and up your score in this retro-inspired arcade setting.

title: Succubus Prison
description: You've been dragged into robbing a house by a couple of thugs, but what you discover there is beyond anything you could have imagined.

title: Dr. Carlos' Personality Exam
description: It's a nice sunny day in Dubai, and you decide to wander into the shady clinic of Dr. Carlos PhD. Once inside, you are tasked with answering questions that will reveal your true nature...

title: Destruct Blocks
description: Destruct Blocks is an addictive isometric puzzle game that combines strategic thinking, block destruction, and color matching challenges. Navigate a shape composed of colored blocks through intricate levels, strategically demolishing target blocks while avoiding others.

title: Battle For Cosmos
description: Battle For Cosmos is a fast-paced, action-packed RTS set in space. With a focus on the battle it is perfect for those who want a thrilling and engaging strategy game without the unnecessary filler. Take control of your empire, build your defenses, and conquer the cosmos!

title: Impeachment Survivors
description: Survive the Impeachment! Impeachment Survivors is a political parody action roguelike with many waves of enemies, upgrades, and comedy. Be hypocrite, be corrupt, be a politician!

title: Biplane Baron 2: Flying Ace
description: How does it feel to be a biplane fighter pilot on Worl War I. Try to survive the onslaught, stay focus and embrace yourself to conquer the enemy in order to earn badges of appreciation and admiration from your colleagues. Why don't you try?

title: Horla
description: Horla is a 3D first-person horror game with puzzles and interactive storytelling. Play as Moacir Gonçalo, a private detective that is hired to investigate an old mysterious haunted house.

title: 808cc
description: Fight, drift and trick your way to the top in 808cc, an online arena battle shooter. Switch up the gamemode, map, character and loadout to battle with your friends in a retro-futuristic dystopia.

title: Dirty Room: Chapter 5
description: After knowing Dr. Q's whereabout, you rushed to an unknown graveyard...

title: Monterona
description: Build and decorate cute little streets from your Italian grandma's stories. Colorful houses, inventive decorations, and little citizens are waiting for you! Share your creations and explore how others build the same stories. No score, no pressure.

title: Fruit 66
description: Fruit 66 is a fresh new blend of cooking-and-driving chaos! Take on bite-sized, thrilling levels in this wacky and charming campaign as you concoct and deliver beverages while swerving through traffic at breakneck speeds!

title: The Dead are Not Dead
description: Five years after the world is devastated by a zombie virus, Alfred is looking for Jake, his older brother. Facing a post-apocalyptic scenario and many flesh-thirsty zombies.

title: Dungeons & Dropped Things
description: Ever wondered what happens to all that loot that is left behind when heroes are fighting their way through the dungeons? Well, worry no more, because, in Dungeons & Dropped Things, it is your job to reconnect lost loot with confused, annoying, and loot-hungry players.

title: Slothtopia
description: Slothtopia is a family-friendly charming life simulator game where you can fish, farm, build relationships, and even catch monsters as an adorable, hard working sloth. Explore the tropical island and its surrounding sea as you get lost in the adventure of Slothtopia!

title: Manager Can be Tough!: Case of the Kidnapped Waitress
description: Get back the waitress kidnapped by monsters! The manager of the restaurant takes up arms and stands up. A side-scrolling action game in which you fight using a variety of actions!

title: Terra Toy
description: Cozy planet building toy

title: Telluria
description: One Soul. Two Lives. Separated by 1400 Years. Unravel an ancient prophecy in a 3D narrative adventure spanning two different eras where an entire reality is at stake. When they finally find each other, you will decide what survives — and at what cost.

title: High Times
description: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

title: RuneShroom
description: RuneShroom is a 2D action platformer where you play as Mushu. You must journey forth! Armed with an array of hand animated spell to drive the snails who have decimated the your people's lands, and who now endanger the very diety who gave you life.

title: Pyramid Curse
description: Explore the tunnels of a mysterious underground pyramid.

title: The Stranded Traveler
description: Embark on an epic journey in The Stranded Traveler, a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game where you take on the role of a traveler stranded on a mysterious island. Explore dangerous environments, fight fierce enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!

title: Shield King
description: Fight off hordes of enemies, slay bosses, dash through enemies and push them off the buildings In this shield themed roguelite.

title: Project Teddy
description: Welcome to Project Teddy, the ultimate multiplayer game that promises endless fun and thrilling shootouts with your friends. Get ready to explore a game that was partially inspired by the popular games Garry’s Mod and Half-Life.

title: Square Inertia
description: Try to set the fastest times possible in Square Inertia: a fast-paced, momentum-based precision platformer. Race against the clock to improve your own personal best times and beat the author times set for each level.

title: LumiereMagna
description: 3D action fighting with 4 types of magic Defeat the monsters that await you in the ancient ruins Infinite game magic action game

title: Alien Protection
description: In this exciting game, you become a brave space traveler who finds himself on an alien planet after your spaceship breaks down.

title: Parcel Simulator
description: Inspect and dissect parcels and packages in this parcel inspection simulator! Examine labels for mistakes, contents for contraband and hone your parcel reviewing skills. Build, upgrade and expand your warehouse to take your parcel inspections to the next level!

title: Rap Attack!
description: Tour around the world and become a rap star in this fun 2D pixel-art platformer!

title: Bee-Man
description: Our Bee-Man's hives are scattered all over the place. Help it collect all of the hives in each level and travel to the next level in the bubble!

title: Hidden Kitten
description: Dive whisker-first into "Hidden Kitten," a purr-fectly delightful hidden object game! Follow Charly the cat's dream escapades, and search for hidden objects in charming black and white hand-drawn scenes. Prepare for a paw-sitively un-fur-gettable experience!

title: Launch Director
description: A walking simulator where you can launch rockets! Become the Launch Director for a commercial space transportation company. Can you configure these reusable rockets for a successful launch, ascent and landing?

title: I Hate (other) Animals!
description: I Hate (other) Animals! is a reverse bullet hell game with roguelite elements with focus on exciting loot in a survivors-like setting. Collect loot during each run and buy permanent upgrades to your characters to make the next run a bit easier.

title: Dicefolk
description: Wield magical dice and build a team of powerful Chimeras to stop a mysterious evil in this tactical roguelite adventure. As a Chimera Summoner, recruit and create your perfect team of mythical beasts and command them to victory using unique dice mechanics.

title: Sapiens Craft
description: Begin as a small stone age tribe. End as a global super power in a future age. Craft and research your way through history!

title: Cyber Ninja that Climbs the City
description: You, the Ninja, have to climb up the skyscrapers of Cyber Tokyo using your grapple, while destroying the Tokyo cops with your Katana and Beam Gun! Play simple run of three stages aiming for the top of the Cyber Tower of Tokyo!

title: Ebola 4
description: You open your eyes, it's dark all around. Are you in an underground bunker, alone with your thoughts... or are you not alone there? Fear, apocalypse, darkness swallowed the world, most people are infected. You are at the epicenter... And can you change something?

title: Stunt Paradise
description: Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled ride in Stunt Paradise! Take on epic challenges, perform insane stunts, and experience extreme driving. Buckle up and play now!

title: If: Walls Could Answer
description: What if walls could answer? Whatever that means, you’ll explore the memories of a neurotic scientist resolving puzzles that could help his mental state, discovering different endings of his life.

title: Swapshot
description: In Swapshot, you take control of this fearless protagonist, equipped with an incredible teleportation gun. Your mission is to overcome a series of challenges in a world filled with 2D platforms and intriguing puzzles.

title: Hope is Gone
description: A retro-style first-person horror game set in a dark, decaying parallel dimension where people from our world are not welcome.

title: 69 Balls
description: A Third-Person shooting game but you are not a person. You are a BALL! Imagine a pool ball, a shotgun and football mechanics mashed together! You said you can't? Neither do I! Just shoot everything you see and pray if the black ball goes in!

title: Chemical
description: A first-person action role-playing game where you encounter enemies and explore new spaces to progress.

title: Ball Bash
description: Ball Bash is a fast paced social racing game, where you can use customized ability sets to gain an advantage over your opponents. Dash through procedurally generated tracks and environments, and use your skills to avoid the incoming obstacles. Be the last one standing!

title: Multitales
description: Crazy competitive top-down shooter in the multiverse of fairy tales and legends.

title: V-Air Traffic Control
description: Become an air traffic controller in this immersive simulator! In VR, guide planes on the ground and in the air, manage traffic flow, and avoid collisions in challenging scenarios. Experience the rush of the tower and hone your skills as a controller in this realistic, Early Access simulation game.

title: Strategy Game but With a Penguin Who Has a Sword
description:
You are just chilling when a secret door opens to your basement. But there are lots of monsters!

Take your father's Teleport Sword. Find out where he disappeared long ago.

title: Crackin' Smackin
description: A chaotic stoneage arena brawler with destructible levels for up to 8 players. Customize your character and jump into action!

title: Moon Magic Array
description: This is an open-world 2.5d magic game with a rich story It has eight combat systems The main character's battle system is to draw a magic array, You can also create spells, or customize spell trajectories

title: Noxious Weeds
description: Face the corruption that poisons your harvest! Noxious Weeds is an action rogue-lite where you slay hordes of creatures with the help of cute veggies and a combination of your favorite tools. The harvest is power. Choose wisely!

title: Reel Life
description: Reel Life is a slot machine-centric farming sim where luck, rather than scale, helps to determine your fiscal success. Farming, fishing, mining and more – collect goods to sell from slot machines scattered throughout the world. Leave it all to fate or game the system to make your dreams come true!

title: Karen the Chicken
description: A beautiful and nonsense 3D adventure game. You are Karen the chicken and you need to solve puzzles to escape from Mr. Boris' farm. Ways to escape? Several. Your objective? Find them all. Are you up to the challenge? Or are you going to chicken out?

title: Aggregate Core
description: A FPS Extraction game where players are able to cooperatively explore and clear a procedurally generated world. Collect Loot and complete missions, while progressing through a woven in story.

title: Vesna
description: Vesna is an indie made fantasy, turn-based game. Made using Unreal Engine.

title: Creatures of Ravenwood
description: Play as a hero fighting off enemies in the forest. Advance and learn new abilities to become stronger, but so will the enemies. Can you survive the mystical creatures of Ravenwood?

title: Stardust Defenders
description: Stardust Defenders is a tower defense, roguelike, bullet hell, where you will face hordes of enemy creatures with the power of forest spirits, leveling up and choosing upgrades that will allow you to survive.

title: With Eyes of Ice
description: An atmospheric, dramatic otome visual novel set in Iceland in the 1850s. Follow the kind-hearted heroine, Gréta, as she finds herself caught between the affections of three handsome men who care for her in different ways.

title: The Last Hero: Journey to the Unknown
description: In a world dominated by evil, only one hero against many enemies, explore, conquer, and don't give up if you get lost! Help our hero in this platform game in the fight against the forces of evil.

title: Exorsite
description: TPS/RTS You are an avatar whose soul can leave the body on a mission to resolve a conflict shrouded in mystery. Discover your purpose as you fight the enemy with 2 perspectives and different units at your disposal in a human war created by specters and demons.

title: Terminal 81
description: Thanks to the financial crisis of 2008, Lorena migrated to Terminal 81 to work, but what seemed like a simple Latin American neighborhood, it was a dangerous region dominated by a mysterious criminal organization that carries out murders, kidnappings and human trafficking.

title: Poop Killer 7
description: Poop Killer 7 is a sequel inspired by the trash horror movies of the 80's and 90's. Using references from the movie "Scary Movie" among others... Mixing horror and comedy creating a bizarre and funny experience.

title: The Lost Adventure
description: The Lost Adventure - is a straightforward 2D game in which the main hero must escape from a dungeon and recover lost memories. You will encounter battles against bloodthirsty slimes, cunning goblins, and numerous other dangers that await you.

title: Finely Diced
description: Chefs are mercurial at the best of times, and catastrophically explosive at their worst. In this hospitality roguelite, your family's restaurant is balanced on a knifes edge. You have the ingredients, the stove is on, now you just need to cook.

title: Pocket Oasis
description: Pocket Oasis is a hand painted gardening game. Decorate balconies in cities around the globe. Watch your seedlings grow, bloom, and harvest your own fruit.

title: Dunk Dunk
description: Dunk with or on your friends in Dunk Dunk, a multiplayer action basketball arcade party game full of chaotic fun. Familiar platforming controls plus unique stretchy arm controls make for nail-bitingly tough matches. Dress up your dunker and get ready to dunk across the universe!

title: UFO: Extraterrestrials Platinum
description: UFO: Extraterrestrials PLATINUM is a new edition that includes a number of changes and enhancements that give the player a new perspective on the classic game: new alien species, heavy weapon platforms, heavy mortar fire, crash site bombardment, unique items, global UFO swarms and configurability.

title: Tutenstone
description: In Tutenstone, you play as an adventurer who has discovered an ancient pyramid filled with valuable treasures. However, many treasures are hidden behind stone blocks that need to be destroyed.

title: Tower of the Mad Wizard
description: In this brutal action, rogue-like, survival RPG chose one of many wily adventurers dead set on conquering the Mad Wizard's Tower. To reach the his sanctum you must conquer hordes of enemies, their ruthless generals and navigate the twisted halls of the Wizard's labyrinth.

title: Power Vacuum
description: Power Vacuum is a fast-paced, competitive strategy game. It aims for minimalism, stripping away all the unnecessary detail to let you play as fast as you can. Power Vacuum features a “play against your past self” system that automatically records the games you (and your friends!) play.

title: SnowRunner: The Mastodon
description: Expand your vehicle collection with The Mastodon DLC to receive the ZikZ 612H "Mastodon", a super-large, super-heavy beast of a truck with 3 built-in trailer slots! The Mastodon DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2 or Year 3 Pass.

title: A Whisper in the Twilight: Chapter One
description: An ancient moon shrouded in mystery. Alien enigmas. An adventure beyond the Earth.

title: Queen of the Otaku: There can be Only One
description: A short visual novel about a manga club torn between its two competing princesses.

title: Roober
description: Roober is a worm who is looking for a way out of the jungle, your task is to help him find his way. The problem is, the jungle is a maze! Be careful: in the jungle, traps and moving platforms are waiting for you.

title: Edmund and Eliza
description: Edmund and Eliza is a medieval action adventure game about a knight named Edmund Dantes who ventures into a mysterious village in search of a merchant's missing daughter named Eliza Bonteri. Edmund and Eliza is a senior design capstone project for California State University of Northridge.

title: Exolotl: Zian
description: Zian the Exolotl need to save their planet from King Orion invasion Platform game adventure with 5 Exolotl Character which can be switch character, you can use it in each different level with special moving and ability.

title: Inside the Labs
description: Inside the Labs is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror game. News of possible failed human experiments within an abandoned lab has piqued your curiosity. Uncover evidence and identify the mutation whilst avoiding the darkness that no longer trusts humans.

title: Crystal Tower Defense
description: Stop an endless hoard of crystal-type enemies from reaching the portal to earth! You can build your own labyrinths, unlock new turrets, upgrade them, and also gather permanent bonuses.

title: Press Axe
description: It's a game to find the legendary duck using a double-edged axe.

title: Zodiark Reform: Bandage Rewind
description: The mysterious planet observer, Lance, arrives on this planet to investigate something, and Bandagemon, as a companion on the journey. 《Bandage Rewind》 is a 2D platform puzzle game where you need to rely on your observation skills and intuition to solve various puzzles .

title: Blind Fishes
description: The friendly blind fishes are in danger! Solve the puzzles and save them.

title: Station 13
description: Help the astronaut escape from Station 13 and survive the LAH 13.000 AI and all the traps in a handcrafted platformer game.

title: Dubai Simulator
description: In Dubai Simulator, you'll have the chance to design and build your dream city, complete with towering skyscrapers, bustling streets, luxurious resorts, and awe-inspiring landmarks.

title: Gotchaball
description: Gotchaball is a multiplayer fictional sports game. Players try to score points by capturing totems to win the game. Chase your opponent, tackle and steal the ball from others! Keep hold of it while capture totems to score points! Collect and use coins to capture totems even faster!

title: Mini Drifters: World Racing '89
description: Up to 8 players compete in local multiplayer racing madness! Classic arcade action awaits as you drift, smash and blast through over 50 courses across 3 unique game-modes. Whether you're playing the race, battle or hockey modes there's only one guarantee: a single screen of glorious retro mayhem.

title: The Puppeteer
description: In this short yet challenging action-adventure game, traverse various lands seeking to piece together the methods and madness of The Puppeteer. Craft unique potions to contend with hordes of enemies and uncover secrets rewarded by exploration.

title: Serafina's Saga: Awakened
description: In this otome-style visual novel, journey from the depths of the jungle to the royal halls of Castle Krondolee. Young Serafina must uncover the dark secrets of her past and choose whom to trust in this dramatic adventure of romance and intrigue.

title: Gennady
description: An old-school action platformer with rogue-lite elements. Imagine your grumpy neighbor blowing up the backside of an alien world with a blaster instead of resting after his shift. Blood, noir, and green slime.

title: Metania
description: Metania is an Indie Psyhological Horror game uses Physics to pass obstacles Interaction with lights Objects doors furniture etc.

title: Buildy Stacky 2
description: Construct towering structures with unconventional building segments, stabilize, detonate, shrink, grow, and stick segments with special powers, all while navigating increasingly difficult challenges in this wacky and brain-teasing game that will delight players of all ages and skill levels.

title: Gearhead Karting
description: The ultimate kart racing game with deep customization, realistic physics, and a variety of game modes. Build, tune, and race your way to victory!

title: Operator: Observation
description: Operator: Observation is a Game based on the "Watch Rooms, and Report Anomalies" Concept of "Observation Duty" but now the Anomalies are way more aggressive and have way more ways to make you lose your Mind. Your Instructor will follow you on the way to becoming a good Operator.

title: Maximum Tough Guy
description: "A peaceful village and peaceful daily life were suddenly disturbed by the slimes. These creatures, which used to be quiet, suddenly became active. It seems that an investigation is needed to figure out why this has happened."

title: Elidriel
description: Raise your weapons! In a world ruled by a tyrant, there is no other option but to be strong. Elidriel is a pixel-art RPG set in a fantasy world where technology, science, magic, and religion coexist.

title: Eventide
description: A free noir/cyberpunk horizontal scrolling shoot 'em up. Gameplay inspired by late 80's / early 90's arcade shoot 'em ups.

title: Interstellar Sentinel
description: A thrilling sci-fi fantasy shmup / shoot'em up with epic boss battles and a vast arsenal of futuristic weapons! Battle legions of demonic entities, restore the cosmic balance, and save the universe! Flow state gaming to unleash your inner hero! Feel your skills grow on your way to 1CC S+ tier rank!

title: Maces and Dices
description: Make the most out of every turn when dice decide your fate. When your means of movement and attack, as well as your healthbar consist of dice, you better hope you have brought the right ones.

title: Doom Delta
description: Doom Delta is a GZDoom mod that aims to bring many elements from the pre-release iterations of Doom, from the press release beta to the original design document by Tom Hall.

title: Doom Repainted
description: If you were expecting a professional, well-made, serious mod you've come to the wrong place.

title: Doom: The Way We Remember It
description:
.. Literally.

Also given the names 'Mandela Doom', 'Doom But Something's Not Right' and 'Doom from Memory', we recreated the whole game from memory.

title: Doom 2: The Way We Remember It
description: The entire of Doom 2, including music, text, levels, and some graphics, but from memory. Even includes MAP33, plus 2 bonus maps.

title: They Speak From The Abyss: Zenith
description: A standalone prequel to They Speak From The Abyss. Travel through the realm of despair and head towards the Zenith point. In the distance lies the mighty mansion Melancholia. Will you only find glory, agony, or freedom?

title: Corsairs: Battle of the Caribbean
description: An immersive adventure and strategy game set amidst the thrilling world of buccaneering. As a shrewd captain, navigate tumultuous seas, engage in complex politics, and manage a diverse crew to establish maritime dominance and ensure your fleet's future.

title: Yuuma Game
description: A short Action-Puzzle Shoot-em-up Touhou fan game starring everyone's favourite gluttonous goat, Toutetsu Yuuma.

title: Dragon Quest X: Nemureru Yuusha to Michibiki no Meiyuu Offline
description: The V2 expansion from Dragon Quest X Online remade as DLC for Dragon Quest X Offline

title: Monstrosity
description: Monstrosity is a 2.5D action-platformer inspired by classic 8-bit and 16-bit era games. Explore a planet filled with twisting caverns, hideous creatures and horrifying bosses, while using your mutated arms for weapons! Or blast your friends in our epic PvP mode

title: As Aventuras de Zé Baldinho
description: As Aventuras de Zé Baldinho is a challenging educational platformer that addresses environmental issues and the reuse of organic waste and is full of references to the History of Art.

title: Bloom Defender
description: The Mother Tree, a sacred being capable of producing spiritual energy, is under attack! Defend her by planting and watering trees in this top-down tower-defense game.

title: Pokémon Giovanni Origins
description:
In this story, set roughly 20 years before the events of Pokémon Red and Pokémon Blue, you play as the childhood friend of Team Rocket Boss Giovanni.

Growing up in Saffron City, you and Giovanni will traverse Kanto and Johto together, challenging for gym badges and championships along the way. You will witness first hand the backstory of Giovanni, watching from the sidelines as your friend ventures down a dark path, turning to a life of crime.

As you explore Kanto and Johto, you will see the vast difference 20 years can make to a region. You will find characters and references to the future games hidden everywhere you look. Enjoy exploring the Pokémon world long before the stories of legendary Pokémon trainers such as Red and Blue.

title: Toys vs. Nightmares
description:
The nightmares have been unleashed from your closet and all you have are some books and toy soldiers….

Strategize and defend yourself from the evil monsters lurking in your closet. Use robots, rubber frogs, and miners to stop the ghosts and make it through the night.

title: Ojanko Yakata
description: Ojanko Yakata is an adult mahjong.

title: Forgotten War
description: A "historical" strategy on the theme of wars of different times and peoples with funny characters and nice graphics. The game has a campaign with 16 levels and a sandbox.A "historical" strategy on the theme of wars of different times and peoples with funny characters and physics.

title: A Postcard From Afthonia
description:
Once upon a time, two seemingly different creatures decided to have a baby. (Such things are possible in the Lands of Dream.) But it was a time of revolution and war, and they were worried about their baby's future, so they asked you to help them seek the wisdom of the Oracle…

A Postcard From Afthonia is a short excursion to the Isle of the Sun via the means of a magical portal. Said portal connects to events that take place after The Sea Will Claim Everything, but can be nevertheless be used by someone who has not taken that journey yet.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 1 Character Pass
description:
Year 1 Character Pass
- 4 additional characters (Rashid, A.K.I., Ed, Akuma)
- 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10
- Purchase bonus: 4,200 Drive Tickets

title: Athena Crisis
description: Athena Crisis is a modern retro turn-based strategy game inspired by Advance Wars. Athena Crisis places you in command of distinct units including infantry, tanks, and air forces in your journey across multiple worlds. Embark on a challenging single-player quest or dive into the thrill of ranked or casual multiplayer modes.

title: Love and Demons
description: Dive into the fearsome demonic world! Step into the shoes of Max, a lazy prince who will be accompanied by three odd girls. Can you find a way to get him back home?

title: DekaPari
description:
Your childhood sweetheart is dead. As you reminisce, you notice looming over her eternal site of rest, adorned with flowers, is a giant girl with a familiar face.

DekaPari is a spin-off of Towelket, a long running indie RPG Maker adventure series. Unlike previous entries, DekaPari's exploration is mostly in 2D as opposed to the isometric style. It is described by the developer as a "comfy pixel art RPG."

title: DZ & Riggy vs. the Worlds II
description:
The follow-up to DZ and Riggy vs the World(s), the two aforementioned heroes have transitioned from platformer to RPG and must now save Earth from being taken over by a video game villain that is very personal to the two who has come to life!

DZ and Riggy must traverse through various game worlds such as Final Fantasy VI, Kirby, Pokemon, Super Mario, and many more to rescue their friends and save the day.

title: Rain on their Parade!
description:
Side-scrolling rain shooting (?) game made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 53.

You’re a rain delivery cloud at Cloud Academy, but you’re on your way to flunking the year!

(Nobody told you that raining cats and dogs wasn’t meant to be literal...)

Pass these rainy assignments or you’ll be stuck on golf course sprinkler duty all summer!

title: Q4Max
description: Q4Max adds features which make Quake 4 suitable for use for competitive play (such as timeouts, teamlock, brightskins, chattokens, auto action demo recording), fixes and general improvements to the base game, without changing the underlying Quake 4 gameplay. This makes Q4Max the standard mod for competitive play, and it was used by all the major eSports competitions - CPL, ESWC, WSVG, GGL, CB, QuakeCon, and more.

title: Storybook Weaver
description:
"Storybook Weaver" is a 1990 educational program for the Apple IIGS developed by Charolyn Kapplinger, Patricia Korn, John J. Krenz, Brian S. Nesse, Jean Sharp, and Steve Zehm, and distributed by MECC. The program allowed children to create their own stories using provided images, sound effects, and music.

It was later released in 1992 for DOS with some graphical upgrades, and for Windows in 1995 as "Storybook Weaver: Classic Edition". It was followed by an enhanced version, called Storybook Weaver Deluxe, released in 1994.

title: Walpurgisnacht
description: Memory of forest house at dusk.

title: Marathon: Istoria
description:
Marathon: Istoria is an RPG scenario set in the Marathon universe and designed for the Aleph One engine. It pushes the engine to its limits by using advanced character progression, combat, and storytelling.

Customize your character by choosing your class and deciding which weapons you want to specialize in. Utilize the conventional weapons you are familiar with along with a brand new arsenal of spells and abilities. Explore Istoria while discovering its secrets and how you fit in the world through a combination of terminals and communicating with the recently deceased.

People that have played other Bungie games may recognize some influences from Pathways Into Darkness and Myth. A few sounds, the weapon leveling, level transitions with saved state, and ability to talk to the dead are ideas largely taken from PiD. People familiar with Myth may recognize a couple of the spells you get in the game.

title: Apotheosis X
description:
Apotheosis X pushes the boundaries of what's possible aesthetically with the marathon engine whilst retaining its low resolution 90's charm.

The campaign features engaging combat that scales with player skill and aggression, with a roster of new enemies and weaponry that compliments the original games' nuance and high skill ceiling.

title: Kill the Man in the House
description: A short, visceral first-person shooter about killing a man in a house.

title: 1 Hungry Peasant
description:
1 Hungry Peasant must collect 100 Potatoes.

Created for Moonjam 2021: https://jam.moon2.tv/

title: Blue Nebula
description: Blue Nebula is a fork of Red Eclipse 1. While the Red Eclipse team have moved their game on to another engine for their latest release, 2.0, this also meant a total conversion of the gameplay. Therefore, a group of eager community members have started to fork off Red Eclipse from the last 1.x series release, setting up the necessary infrastructure to (re-)establish a community around Red Eclipse 1.5+.

title: Cursed Halo Again
description: Cursed Halo is a mod for Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary that turns the game into a chaotic experience. New Levels, Weapons, Enemy variations, Vehicles, etc.

title: Secret of the Corral
description: This game was made live on Twitch.TV/StephenGeorg on August 26th, 2020, over the course of 10 hours. The audience could submit words/ideas which had to be used in the final game. It's full of community in-jokes and other insanity. The goal was to "finish creating a game in one sitting", which was successful. Between the end of stream and uploading here, a few little Easter eggs were added. Good luck finding them!

title: Broadway Legend Ellena
description: Broadway Legend Ellena is a rhythm game released in the Disc Station magazine for PC-98 computers in 1994. The title character, Ellena Stevens, would later cameo in Puyo Puyo DA! for the Sega Dreamcast.

title: Greenfinger!
description:
Made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 52.

The annual Harvest Festival is here and you’re aiming for first place! Grab your favorite watering can, find some sunshine, and grow your greens to the…beat…?

title: Revival and Exploration
description: Revival and Exploration is an oriental simulation game. Decorate your town with diverse landscapes and buildings, recruit residents to live in, and build a thriving city! You can also lead armed residents on traveling to different landscapes such as grassland, desert, snow, and volcanoes.

title: I Spy Fun House
description: Solve I Spy riddles to earn tickets to a Fun House, a topsy-turvy world where nothing is as it appears! Master brain-teasing puzzles and play exciting games while exploring the Fun House. The game is based on I Spy Fun House and is a remake of the DS version of this game.

title: Madou Monogatari: Tower of the Magician
description: Madou Monogatari: Tower of the Magician is a first-person dungeon-crawler developed by Compile. It was first released on September 6, 1997 for Microsoft Windows 95 through Disc Station Vol. 16. Unlike most Madou Monogatari games which follow Arle, this game follows Schezo Wegey and his quest for power as he ascends Wish's tower.

title: Madojeongi: Secret of Elysium
description:
Madou Monogatari: Secret of Elysium is a first-person dungeon-crawler with minimal to no numerical statuses. The player navigates the maze-like floors of the towers by solving puzzles and defeating enemies.

Madou Monogatari: Secret of Elysium was only released in Korea.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged - Pure Fire Edition
description:
Wal-mart Exclusive! Boost your fun with HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Turbocharged - Pure Fire Edition, which contains:
• Full game
• Twin MillTM diecast car with an amazing exclusive livery;
• HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Rust and Fast Pack, which includes two vehicles (Mod Rod and FusionBusta)
• HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Speed Kings Pack, which includes two vehicles (Impavido 1 and Electro Silhouette)
• HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Just a Scratch Pack, which includes two vehicles (Speed Bump and Sudden Stop)

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged - Day One Edition
description:
The ultimate racing game is back — and more charged up than ever!

Over 130 vehicles, including new types like motorbikes and ATVs, five new environments with racing surfaces impacting vehicle performance and creating more dynamic gameplay, new driving unique strategies as like lateral dashes and jumps to ensure more wild races, a story-driven campaign, and a variety of exciting new game modes.

The multiplayer experience is enriched thanks to the Cross-play feature, online ranking and PC anti-cheat system. And a lot of ways to show off your creativity are available with the renewed track editor and brand-new stickers for unique vehicle liveries.

title: Madden NFL 24
description: Experience the newest iteration of FieldSENSE in Madden NFL 24. More realistic character movement and smarter AI gives you control to play out your gameplay strategy with the confidence to dominate any opponent.

title: Mir Tankov
description: The world famous tank MMO now developed and published by Lesta Games in RUBY region.

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - Season One: Exclusive Box Edition
description:
MX vs ATV Legends Season One marks the newest addition to the popular MX vs ATV off-road racing franchise. With this game, players can fulfill their dream of becoming a renowned off-road rider, garnering widespread recognition and admiration from fans and sponsors alike. Whether they choose to play the career or online modes, they'll get to experience the thrill of racing to the finish line on bikes, ATVs, and UTVs. This latest instalment also boasts expansive open environments and a comprehensive career mode, allowing players to immerse themselves fully in the world of professional off-road racing and enjoy all the highs and lows that come with it.
MX vs ATV Legends Season One includes 3 extensive DLCs.

title: Touhou Maiden
description: Hachimitsu Kumasan's massive Touhou fangame RPG. Join Reimu and Marisa in their journey through a fragmented Gensoukyou and Tokyo. All throughout their quest, they fight both familiar and beloved characters... because they must.

title: Dinosaurs: Mission Dino Camp
description: The schleich DINOSAURS have come to life and need your help! Find and rescue the legendary giant creatures while you an embark on an action-filled adventure deep in the amazon jungle.

title: Back 4 Blood: Day One Steelbook Edition
Paw Patrol: World
description: Explore the world of PAW Patrol like never before and stop Mayor Humdinger’s super blimp mayhem, in a free-roaming 3D adventure full of pup-tastic fun!

title: Seijundrop
description: Your rather quiet classmate's little brother went missing, and she asks you to help her look for him.

title: Fuhrer in LA: Special Edition
description: Fuhrer in a LA is a grindhouse-styled top-down action-adventure game which takes place around 1947, unraveling the truth about the demise of the Fuhrer post World War 2.

title: Masochistic Maiden Aria and the Cavern of Blissful Agony
description: A surprising spin on the precision platforming genre where the character you control reacts rather amusingly to being stabbed by spikes.

title: Dimensional Dexterity
description: Immerse yourself in the innovative gameplay, where the central mechanic revolves around the seamless shifting of Dimensions. With each shift, the world around you transforms, presenting new obstacles to overcome and hidden paths to discover.

title: Flare: Empyrean Campaign
description: The Empyrean Campaign is a game made by the Flare team. The story begins with the player being exiled from their homeland of Empyrean, resulting in them embarking on a quest to regain entry. This journey takes the player through many regions, with plenty of side quests along the way.

title: Lisa: Definitive Edition
description: Explore Olathe and its dark and twisted secrets with Lisa: The Definitive Edition, including the original story-driven RPG game Lisa: The Painful and its sequel Lisa: The Joyful

title: Lisa: The Painful - Definitive Edition
description:
LISA: The Painful - Definitive Edition is the newly updated version of the original quirky side-scrolling RPG, set in the post-apocalyptic wasteland of Olathe. Beneath the charming and funny exterior is a world full of disgust and moral destruction. Players will learn what kind of person they are by being FORCED to make choices permanently affecting the gameplay. Make sacrifices to keep your party members alive, whether it's taking a beating for them, losing limbs, or some other inhuman torture. In this world, you will learn being selfish and heartless is the only way to survive...

The Definitive Edition brings new content and nightmares to the game with HD graphics, party member campfire conversations, updated battle systems, new border art overlays, music player, painless (easy) mode, and new secrets to explore.

title: Lisa: The Joyful - Definitive Edition
description:
Lisa: The Joyful - Definitive Edition is the newly updated conclusion to the quirky side-scrolling RPG Lisa series. Explore Olathe as Buddy in your quest to punish the world that has treated you wrong. Along the way, learn about Olathe, your family, and the monsters and men in power. The world’s out to get you… Get. It. Back!

The Definitive Edition brings fresh blood to the game with updated battle systems, 6 brand new Warlord skills, new border art overlays, music player, painless (easy) mode, and new secrets to explore.

title: C.H.A.I.N.G.E.D.
description:
The antichrist has won, the world has ended.
Time to make some choices.

title: Legacy Of The Legends
description:
A PSX Style, Horror, RogueLike, Adventure, MetroidVania Game Made By Digital Artisans Game Team

Available For Microsoft Windows, Linux, And MacOS

title: Irem Collection: Volume 1
description: Irem Collection Volume 1 is a collection of classic legendary arcade shoot 'em up games including Image Fight, Image Fight 2, and X-Multiply brought to modern platforms.

title: Mobile Wars X: Ultimate Simulation Battle
description:
Ultimate Simulation Battle is an expansion for the free game Mobile Wars X that was released as an update on Steam in 2019.

The updated changed the UI and added a 1bit game mode with 3 new characters.

title: Pixel Run!
description:
Pixel run! A perfect game to play when you're calm!
This game has been inspired by Scott Cawthon's game, There Is No Pause Button!

title: University
description:
In this horror game, you get to guard a school
where a previous killing was taken.

Ever been to a haunted school? well, now’s your chance.

title: Underworld Unfinished Business 1: Recruiting Demon Smalls
description:
This is a sequel to The Lizard King. This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2005.

title: Fava Beans
description: Fava Beans is a Doom episode replacement mod of nine levels, created by Sean Birkel, with one level from Ben Gates

title: The Sky May Be
description: The Sky May Be is a semi-serious joke WAD for Doom.

title: Doomworld Forum Adventures!
description: It's a small, underdetailed map about the dream of a newbie. Work your way up the ladder to become ruler of Doomworld! It's a DOOM map centered around comedy, just in case you're a bit slow.

title: ZDoom Adventures!
description: The sequel of Doomworld Forum Adventures

title: Doomworld Forums 3
description: This WAD tells the true story of what REALLY happened in the recent episode at the NewDooM forums. My sources are infallible, so don't even try to dismiss any of this as false, because it is the cold, hard truth and it will hit you like a speeding bus in the middle of a rainy night. It's that powerful.

title: Underworld Unfinished Business 2: Ghost Train at Castle Orr
description:
The third entry in The Lizard King series. This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2005.

title: Nyanpaya
description:
It's a 3-match puzzle game that can be played by up to 8 people!

If you align 3 or more pieces with the same pattern, the pieces will disappear and you will get points!

Score up by erasing while disappearing! Aim for a high score and erase them within the time limit!

title: Iron Armor Storm
description: Iron Armor Storm "is a 3D strategy game based on the theme of World War II Tank War, with the collection of various legendary tanks and tank strategy combinations as the core gameplay, and community-based, camp based cooperation and competition as auxiliary means.

title: Maze Tanks
description: Control the tank to search the maze for your enemies. Obstacles block the field of view, which you can use to hide, or destroy to create a better view and direction of fire. While firing a cannon can also give away your position, it can also be used properly as bait to attract a target.

title: Z World
description: Supernatural aerial combat open world action adventurer. Defend the city against monstrous invasions. This game features interactive NPCs, levitation powers, and avatar choices. Explore.

title: Unibat
description: Real-time strategy Unibat is a game where you build your own kingdom and manage them, train knights and fight against enemy camps of orcs.

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Airport Marseille
description: Marseille XP includes a custom replica of the LFML Marseille airport, extensively created to provide an authentic flight experience. In collaboration with ShortFinalDesign, FSS AG has brought another important airport to the X-Plane world.

title: White Blade
description: Strategic turn-based combat, utilizing various complementary skills to deal with enemy attack patterns.

title: Sky is Arrows: Dragon Bracer Item Chest
description: The Sky Is Arrows - Dragon Bracer Item Chest DLC unlocks 6 completely new, unique, and groundbreaking items. The player can use these items to enhance their current playstyle or create new strategies. It's up to the player to determine which items are the best from the random options given.

title: Arcana: Heat and Cold. Stories
description: The events surrounding the unskilled magician are heating up! Could an unusual way of curing the Arcane Fever have caused such a stir?! Or have we accidentally become involved in a story whose scale we cannot yet comprehend!? Comedy, hentai scenes, and new hilarious adventures await you.

title: Butterfly//Circuit
description: Glimmers of hope are hard to come by, so what happens when the one you have is suddenly snuffed out? In the dark recesses of the city, just out of sight, silhouettes come in to view and connections start to form. Butterfly//Circuit is a cyberpunk thriller kinetic visual novel.

title: BlueSuburbia
description: BlueSuburbia is a haunted world where you explore poems through immersive environments. Seek out dark secrets, confront your demons, and delve deeper into a dream that dances between beautiful and terrible. Explore forgotten dreamscapes and open worlds on your quest to find hope.

title: CityDriver: Alvarez-Lentz Marathon 420 CTI
description: Expand your vehicle fleet by the first ever Van in the history of CityDriver: The Alvarez-Lentz Marathon 420 CTI!

title: City Legends: The Ghost of Misty Hill - DLC
description: The doors of medical institutions often hide terrible secrets and outrageous accidents. Don't let ghosts get in the way between you and your search for answers!

title: Cozy Cabin: Coffee Boutique
description: Cozy Cabin is a first-person coffee making game set in a scenic mountain hideaway. Players run a coffee shop and play mini-games to progress an endearing narrative. Physics-based coffee making, unique characters, lively music, and an enchanting atmosphere make Cozy Cabin the game for you! Order up!

title: Cricket Captain 2023
description: Create your own cricket management legacy with Cricket Captain 2023. A new adaptive aggression system, designed for the modern game, puts you in control. Enhanced statistics include historical international player rankings (including all-rounders), real-world form data, and wicket keeper statistics.

title: Fenrir's fury
description: Unleash Fenrir's vengeance. Explore, fight enemies, and make crucial decisions. Trust no one. Seek revenge.

title: Fashion Holiday: A Game of Texas Hold 'Em
description: Unleash your poker skills in "Fashion Holiday: A Game of Texas Hold 'Em," where a mall-bound evening sets the stage for playful matches against intriguing characters. With 32 stunning outfit choices, immerse yourself in light-hearted dialogue and stylish 4K art.

title: Exchange Student
description: Exchange Student is an exciting visual novel for adults only, full of unexpected twists and unforgettable moments. You'll take on the role of James, a young student who decides to make a fresh start by moving to a new city and embarking on his university studies.

title: Cyberside Picnic
description: Cyberside Picnic is a eulogy for the cyberian commonplace that just eluded us. A love letter to a lost future of alternative video games, delete and overwrite.

title: I Commissioned Some Pigeons
description: I paid more artists to hide pigeons and bread in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Hungry Dogs
description: Quick arcade strategy hungry fun getting items in the backyard of wild dogs that hungry in wild.

title: Gulch Guardians
description: cute + tough card tactics autobattles

title: Gentlemen's Puzzle Club
description: Try to complete all puzzles in this amazing relaxation game and collect all locked girls behind the covers.

title: Furry Toys
description: Furry Toys - is a classic 2D game in the memory genre which is about you find the same pictures and enjoy different images of furry beautiful ladies.

title: Heavy Metal Titans
description: Heavy Metal Titans is a modern-retro Run n' Gun Shoot ‘em up that takes players on a blood-soaked time traveling quest to defeat General Glen Planamento and retrieve the stolen time crystal, a powerful relic that can manipulate time and reality.

title: Hot Rider
description: Dynamic racing with a good soundtrack, compete with the rest and become the best!

title: True Driver
description: Take a seat, start the engine and enjoy high speed! Choose between freemode, countdown and helirace. If you like challenges, you are at the right place! Race with time or with a helicopter! Sounds easy, right? Your blissed car is prepared for your journey, so what are you waiting for?

title: Tower Walker - The Ancient Ones
description: Tower Walker - The Ancient Ones adds exclusive bonus content. 6 new ancient playable races with special and unique racial traits.

title: The Silicon Shadow
description: An early 1900's retro futuristic sci-fi Movement Shooter. Glide and shoot through murderous robots, navigate platforming challenges and explore a dark and atmospheric space station to uncover the truth of its downfall in this short length game.

title: The Pulse of Evil
description: Find yourself on a mission exploring the depth of an ominous forgotten mine. You arrive barehanded but quickly find the tools needed to go deeper. Destroy the infected living parts of the mine and face the final threat and complete your mission.

title: Snoody: One of the Ayrie
description: Bring back color to the wonderful planet Ayries! Together with Snoody and his friend Picke go on an exciting adventure to other planets. Explore distant worlds, study elemental magic, collect crystals and defeat monsters! Save the people of ayrie and find out, who is responsible for their troubles.

title: Sparky Marky: Episode 2
description: It's your first day at Amber's Park - strange recreational camp for children. Complete employee training and meet Sparky - a friendly mascot at day, Kinder Surprise with a monster inside at night. Solve puzzles to deactivate Sparky and save your life.

title: Street Fighting Grandma
description: Guide the Grandma through the mean streets and figure out what is really happening in the city

title: Sunny Girl
description: Enjoy cute girls in the background of gentle music and complete puzzles. The game is a jigsaw puzzle, where players move puzzle pieces to restore the original image.

title: Striker Zone
description: Join in with friends in a online shooter about modern warfare!

title: Riverflow
description: Let the river flow, and nourish the land.

title: Sáivu
description: Sáivu: Spill basert på samisk kultur. Utforsk 8 årstider med unike utfordringer. Vinn gaver til offersteinen. Hjelpespill: Joikememory, eventyr, overnaturlige. Bygg lavvo, joik dyr, lag medisin, bekjemp overnaturlige, jakt, fang rein, lag duodji, fisk på isen. Avslutningsspørsmål om læring.

title: Settris
description: "Settris" is a block-placement puzzle game in which players place pieces in the empty squares on the puzzle board, and fill all empty squares to clear the board.

title: RockTop
description: Rock Top VR game is an online gameplay that adds multiplayer chase to traditional VR climbing gameplay. In addition to conquering different terrains, players can also play different roles in multiplayer mode to obtain more gems

title: Sex on Beach
description: Sex on Beach - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Restaurant Simulator 2023
description: Welcome to Restaurant Simulator 2023! Experience the joy of running your own restaurant in this cute and relaxing economy game. With charming graphics, automate your workflow to maximize income, hire managers to keep your workers motivated, and make smart investments to boost your economy!

title: Redline Crooks
description: Redline Crooks is a fast-paced roguelite vehicle combat game in which you destroy cops, walls and possibly yourself in a chaotic pursuit of freedom and riches. Upgrade, Slam, Taunt and Boost your way out of imprisonment through the lawless roads that lie ahead, and you may find personal absolution.

title: Popologist: Camera Slinger
description: You are on assignment of a newspaper company. “The POPOLOGIST”, on a mission to capture photo images of events, people & objects throughout the city within your cameras battery life & memory allotted. Overshoot & you cant complete all assignments. Will Your Pics make Front Page News?

title: Pixel Punk
description: Pixel Punk is a strategy tower defence. In pixel Punk you build different turrets that will protect you against the never ending waves.

title: Oome
description: "In oOme, control time with your mouse, make the celestial bodies dance, feed your black hole, but avoid contact. A relaxing and hypnotic arcade game."

title: Nightmare Zapping
description: A horror channel browsing game where each channel holds a different nightmare to experience, explore them and find out the truth about what has happened in a small town where the inhabitants have disappeared.

title: Neon Fantasy: Girls
description: Neon Fantasy: Girls is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: Murder at Mystic High
description: Cute visual novel murder mystery game

title: NextNight
description: This is a third person tower defense game where you need to use the space wisely to place defenses to kill zombies at night.

title: Kāla
description: You were born in a mining colony far below the surface of Planet Kāla, sentenced to an indefinite quarantine. Legends suggest that the spirit of the planet, Gaia Kāla helps those who prove their worth. Can you escape the grasp of Synterra's Mineral Corporation?

title: Idle Magic Legend
description: Team up to kill monsters and explode equipment. Through the program, thousands of people practice, make friends, and get married. You can also participate. You can become friends with her and learn magic together. Bring your dog to battle

title: Mango's Wonderland
description: Mango's Wonderland is a free horror game where you play as a detective that needs to try to find anything about an old theme park called Mango's Wonderland. You need to solve puzzles to get ahead in the old theme park and survive old animatronics that used to be attractions there...

title: Market Warfare
description: Lead the Fruit Army and defend your base from the evil vegetables in this Tower Defense game.-Create your strategy with a variety of characters.-Adapt to different scenarios-Manage your money to keep your defense line full of fruits.

title: Mahjong Travel
description: Journey into the world of mahjong! Colorful locations, pleasant music and interesting levels will meet you on your way!

title: Lita's Dream
description: Popular high school girl Lita finds herself trapped in a strange dreamlike world. She needs to escape from a dangerous, eerie castle with the help of her mysterious ally, Ian.

title: LabyrInk
description: LabyrInk is the result of a 5-day Game Jam. It's an exciting third person shooter where the environment starts out completely invisible. You and other Goblinks must paint it up in order to reveal a path to your opponents. Features two distinct game modes: Last One Standing and Deathmatch.

title: Idle: Generators
description: An IDLE game for your fun and relaxation. Generators based gameplay and two prestige systems with various gameplay possibilities

title: Underworld Unfinished Business 3: The Plain of Jars
description:
The fourth entry in The Lizard King series. This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2006.

title: Underworld Unfinished Business 4: Taking Care of Business
description:
The fifth entry in The Lizard King series. This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2008.

title: The Eastermansion
description:
This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles. This TRLE was made for Easter.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2012.

title: NetGame Adventure
description:
NetGame Adventure is a short puzzle-horror adventure game.

Explore the 'Haunted Journey' server of a forgotten browser game.

title: Star Wars: Episode 1 - Director's Cut
description:
This is a Stand Alone Game. It is not compatible with the Lara At The Movies project and cannot be substituted into that game. It is a tribute to the wonderful Star Wars adventures. This release is in response to feedback from some players who had difficulty with the original Lara at the Movies version of these levels. I have called this new release the Director's Cut as it contains material not included in the original version (one new playable level and two cutscenes). The original levels have been significantly revamped with revised texturing, atmosphere and additional audio. The timed runs and podracing events should now be playable by players of all skill levels.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2007.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Remembering
description: In the biggest story update yet, uncover the mystery of the Forgetting in the Forgotten Lands Biome with help from a magical resident of the mysterious Pumpkin House. Journey through the Dreamscape—the dimension between Dreams and Reality—and experience epic story Quests alongside your Disney and Pixar friends in the Valley.

title: Truck Simulator USA Revolution
description:
From the makers of Bus Simulator 2023 comes the new and improved Truck Simulator USA Revolution. Want to know what driving an 18 Wheeler feels like? Truck Simulator USA offers a real trucking experience that will let you explore amazing locations. This American Truck Simulator features many American and European semi truck brands and all kinds of big rigs with realistic engine sounds and detailed interiors! Drive across America, transport cool trailers such as vehicles, gasoline, gravel, food, ship anchors, helicopters, and many more… Become a professional truck driver and enjoy the career and the online multiplayer mode!
Drive your favorite American or Euro truck across the American continent, play Truck Simulator USA Revolution!

title: Moose Lost in the Woods
description: Moose Lost in the Woods is a cozy 3D platformer without a language barrier. Explore by running, leaping, bouncing, and splashing around in Swedish forest environments, whilst stuffing your backpack with goodies!

title: Anyu
description: A 3D third person narrative exploration game, set in a frozen wasteland where an ancient civilization fell. Centered around movement puzzles and dealing with environment mechanics.

title: Viking Heroes 4
description: Join the Viking heroes in a race against time to save the world from eternal darkness. As the sun and moon falter and Fenrir threatens to consume them, the Vikings must travel across realms to forge a magical chain that can capture him.

title: Base of War
description: Base of War is a next generation 4x RTS game.

title: Digital Chain
description:
Digital Chain is a short, mystery visual novel about 3 kids who explore a haunted school.

The game focuses on a supposed 'Haunted School' and an Incident that occurred there in the past. With your two friends, Shuhei and Hiromi, explore the Haunted School. Online there were claims of a ghost summoning ritual that allows you to speak with the dead using only your cellphones. They called this ritual, The Digital Chain.

title: Winnie's Hole
description:
Join Winnie on a new adventure, from within!
Play as a virus in his body and mind. Capture cells to mutate and build a deck of actions to unleash in combo-driven combat.

A genre-blending roguelite with a dark yet charming story. Embrace discomfort - Sometimes we can't help being seen as a monster...

title: Simply Purple
description:
This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

Warning: This level is very gaudy and all nonsense. Not to mention all those hard challenges and incredibly demanding gameplay. So play it on your own risk.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2010.

title: Rescue Hannah
description: This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

title: King Arthur Project
description:
This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2013.

title: No Man's Sky: Singularity
description: The new No Mans Sky update, Singularity, continues the narrative arc that began in the Interceptor update and will progress throughout this year. In this five-week long expedition, players investigate strange robots that are delivering cryptic clues across the galaxy, following a story tangled in AI corruption. Watch the trailer for a peek at what's coming to the adventure survival game this time around.

title: Memoryland Prelude
description: Trapped in a world of memories, you must retrace the past after a glitch in the simulation threw everything into chaos. Discover cards that can summon strange creatures and fight to unravel the mysteries of Memoryland. Memoryland Prelude is a dreamlike card based JRPG, and is the first chapter in the Memoryland series.

title: Terra Memoria
description: A shortage of magic crystals and the sudden awakening of ancient robots leads six new friends on an incredible investigation across Terra – a cozy and fantastic world that combines 3D and pixel art.

title: Forgotlings
description: Award-winning cinematic narrative adventure set in a hand-drawn world of living forgotten objects. Lead Fig and the crew of the Volare through a story of identity, unity, and survival—where diplomacy, difficult choices, and moments of action shape the fate of five divided tribes.

title: Light Odyssey
description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

title: Dwarf Delve
description: In this first-person extraction roguelite adventure, strap on your gloves, grab your Battlemallet, and explore randomly-generated mines as a new Delveling. Gather riches, avoid deadly hazards and try to make it out with your beard intact!

title: Toxic Crusaders
description: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

title: Quest Master
description: Quest Master is a dungeon maker inspired by the classics that first made us love dungeon crawling. Unleash your imagination, alone or in local co-op, to make dungeons full of puzzles, traps and monsters. Upload them for others to explore and challenge yourself with other players’ creations.

title: A Bonnie Odyssey
description: An open world sci-fi adventure set in the Scottish wilds. A tale of a father and daughter separated by time. A Bonnie Odyssey is a retrofuturist puzzle mystery where you’ll explore an enigmatic abandoned island, unravel the secrets of your own past, and make odd little friends along the way.

title: Dark Deity II
description: Verroa is a peaceful continent on the brink of war as the Asverellian Empire seeks to expand - at your homeland’s expense. Command unlikely heroes, fight challenging turn-based battles, and watch hardship forge iron into steel. Dark Deity is back, bigger and better than before!

title: En Garde!: Student Project
description:
A swashbuckling adventure!
En Garde! is a swashbuckling action-adventure game set in 17th century's Spain. Play as Adalia de Volador, a noble & impetuous swordswoman! Your palace has been seized by a mysterious mastermind and his hoard of guards - you will have to defend your family's honor!

Fight with your rapier and acrobatic moves against numerous opponents, and use the environment to your advantage in an intuitive way (every object is interactive, from tables to chandeliers!). You can even use your sense of repartee to taunt your opponents. Combat is a spectacle and should be done with panache!

This En Garde! prototype features story-driven action in an open level (the Volador's Palace) for a total play time of about 30 minutes.

title: Grifford Academy
description: Grifford Academy is a story-rich, coming-of-age RPG set in a mystical book realm where your decisions shape the personalities of the characters. Engage in strategic turn-based combat as you set out to discover the secrets of Caldria.

title: Crashlands 2
description: Slap your way across a vibrant world where interstellar friendships are the key to your survival. Befriend eccentric aliens, craft bizarre weaponry, and stick it to the man in this sequel to the award-winning open world crafting RPG Crashlands.

title: Deck of Souls
description: Roguelite deck-building meets souls-like. Break out of an infinite loop to close the hell gates, turn enemies into cards, and build your own omnipotent Deck of Souls! Rolls included.

title: Lake: Season's Greetings
description: It's Christmas time, 1985. Thomas Weiss spends the final few days of the year as he's always been doing: delivering mail and celebrating Christmas with his friends and family in Providence Oaks. However, this holiday season turns out a quite a bit different than expected...

title: Bye Sweet Carole
description: Bye Sweet Carole is a horrific thriller game inspired by the greatest animation movies and created by Chris Darril. (Remothered series) Be ready to jump into the world of Corolla and meet the rabbits that has infested it.

title: A Void Hope
description: A Void Hope takes you on an atmospheric puzzle platforming adventure to find a cure for a collapsed city. Follow the story of a tormented couple as they try to decipher reality from nightmares and overcome the shadowy threats lurking in the dark.

title: Crypt Custodian
description: Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania about cleaning up the afterlife. Play as Pluto- a mischievous cat who has died, and is sentenced to be the afterworlds janitor... forever! Hang out with other doomed ghosts, battle beasts, and explore a vastly expansive landscape.

title: Grime: Tinge of Terror
description: Enjoy a New Game + mode featuring revamped enemies and bosses, endless progression, and a terrifying secret boss!

title: Dawn of the Monsters: Arcade Edition
description: This DLC adds Arcade Mode, new playable character Meteor Temujin, and more!

title: Echoes of You
