description: Echoes of You is a point n click visual novel about leaving behind a loved one and remember them for life. Play as a Vivienne, a vampire, who decides to visit her girlfriend's house one last time.

title: Half-Doomed
description: It features almost of all the major enemies you've fought back in Black Mesa, including Headcrabs, Bullsquid, HECU grunts, all return to screw your day up!

title: Doomsday of UAC
description:
Doomsday of UAC (commonly known by its filename UAC_DEAD) is a single-level PWAD designed by Leo Martin Lim. As part of their 10 Years of Doom feature, Doomworld named it one of the ten best WADs of 1994.

One of the first ever fan-made Doom mods, UAC_DEAD features an attempt at creating realistic-looking vehicles and environments. It contains a replacement sky graphic, and uses careful flat and texture choices in places to simulate colored lighting. It also includes the first known instance of the self-referencing sectors trick, used to create invisible stairs.

title: Symphony of War: Legends
description: Enter Tahnra, a land savaged by war. You, a fresh academy graduate with humble beginnings, will grow to lead a grand army against a corrupt adversary. Gather heroes, form bonds, and lead your force in turn-based battles. Make use of tactics, terrain, morale and more to bring peace to the land!

title: Cartel Tycoon: San Rafaela
description: San Rafaela is a vast new map featuring ferry routes, stunning landmarks, and an immersive storyline! The destiny of San Rafaela lies in your hands!

title: UmaNetto. Full Preved!
description: Russian point & click puzzle game, based on the animated series "UmaNetto", which is a parody of the Russian TV series "Not Be Born Beautiful" ("Не родись красивой"), a Russian version of the Colombian telenovela "Yo soy Betty, la fea" ("I am Betty, the Ugly one").

title: MookerzZ
description: Don't be sad- be MookerzZ!

title: Rocket League: Season 11
description:
Perched high above the seaside, a group of drift cars in tuning mode wait for the signal. At the whistle, a chaotic descent begins, for a festival of tight skids on these perilous mountain roads. Below, cheers are heard: a delirious crowd admires its favorite pilots to boost to victory. This is what you should expect in Season 11.

We hope you are well, as the festivities will rage on throughout the season. Drift with the famous Nissan Silvia (S13), immerse yourself in a colorful Rocket Pass and celebrate the best soccar moments in the Estadio Vida arena.

So, ready to light the fire? Season 11 begins on June 7!

title: Monster Hunter Rise: Title Update 1
description: A hunter's work is never done. New threats emerge and your investigations into the Anomaly take a step forward in free Title Update 1.

title: Monster Hunter Rise: Title Update 2
description: The hunts are heating up in the Kingdom! Powerful new Rare and Subspecies descend upon the land, plus a twisted new form of Elder Dragon rises from the shadows in free Title Update 2.

title: Monster Hunter Rise: Title Update 3
description: Prepare to jump headfirst into the chaos with the brave denizens of Kamura and Elgado. Chaotic Gore Magala and two Risen Elder Dragons headline a host of additions coming in Sunbreak Free Title Update.

title: Monster Hunter Rise: Title Update 4
description: Born in a world of ice, the lord of the tundra returns to freeze all in its path once more. The Elder Dragon Velkhana , Risen Crimson Glow Valstrax, a host of endgame additions, and more arrive in Free Title Update 4.

title: Monster Hunter Rise: Title Update 5
description: The Looming Calamity, Amatsu, has set its gaze on Kamura Village. Experience the thrilling climax to the Monster Hunter Rise story with Free Title Update 5.

title: Monster Hunter Rise: Bonus Update
description: The Sunbreak story reaches its epic conclusion as you face off with the ancient elder dragon, Primordial Malzeno in the Bonus Update!

title: One Piece Odyssey: Reunion of Memories
description: Come join the Straw Hats for a new and different way to experience One Piece Odyssey. One Piece Odyssey, Reunion of Memories is available in the Deluxe version of the game, and purchasable separately. Expansion content is available after players finish the main game. One Piece Odyssey is available for PlayStation4, PlayStation5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.

title: Madden NFL 24: Deluxe Edition
description: FieldSENSE : INCREASED CONTROL AND REALISM. More realistic character movement and smarter AI gives you control to play out your gameplay strategy with the confidence to dominate any opponent in Madden NFL 24.

title: Agriculture
description: Grow crops as fast as you can in a frantic take on classic farming sim mechanics!

title: Do Not Crash
description: Drive your car to avoid obstacles and cars chasing you. Crash the cars and collect coins to buy a new whip.

title: Arcade Archives: Bravoman
description:
Here comes Bravoman, an agent of justice!

"BRAVOMAN" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
One day, average office worker Hitoshi Nakamura encounters Alpha Man on his way home from a long day of work.
Alpha Man then entrusts him with ultra energy transformation material, asking him to use it to stop the mad scientist Dr. Bomb from taking over the world.
He transforms, becoming a hero of justice and courage...called BRAVOMAN!

title: SwapStar
description: Make patterns to gain energy. Spend energy to do actions. Plan your actions carefully to destroy your opponent's grid before they do yours. Play as Swapster in Story Mode or as any of the 10 colorful cast of characters in Mission or Versus Mode.

title: Shadows of Duat
description: An old school survival horror set in Egypt. An indie game with the essence of the classics of the genre, with realistic graphics and immersive sound. A difficult and terrifying challenge only suitable for the bravest people. No one will hear your screams from inside the grave.

title: The Red Sun
description: A challenging 2-D platformer about exploring a ruined city, defeating robotic invaders, and discovering the truth behind the mysterious Red Sun.

title: Down Under
description: 12 speed-mapped Boom compatible levels (-cl 9) restricted to 500 linedefs (except for map12). Explore a desert base and the centre of the Earth with a banging soundtrack drawn from various Sonic games.

title: Majoneko
description: A hard puzzle platformer of predicting trajectories and climbimg a giant castle!

title: Dungeon Rebound
description: Dungeon Rebound is the perfect blend of nostalgic arcade gameplay and immersive RPG elements, offering a fresh and exciting take on both genres. Are you ready to rebound your way to victory and become a legend in the realm of Dungeon Rebound?

title: Call of Zombie
description: Call of Zombie is a survival shooting game set in the World War II era. As waves of zombies approach, your task is to protect the armory. By skillfully utilizing the remains of zombies, you can achieve unexpected effects and outcomes.

title: RichMan 4 Fun
description: In the world of property, rely on your luck and decision-making becoming a tycoon!

title: Forklift Extreme: Ultra Edition
description:
Get ready to rev your engines and stack your way to glory in Forklift Extreme simulator!
This hyper-realistic forklift game puts you in the driver's seat, with highly-detailed physics that mimic the movement and handling of real forklifts. Master a variety of forklifts with unique handling characteristics, and tackle a wide range of tasks and challenges.

title: 100 Doors Game: Dasshutsu Game
description: A room escape adventure developed by Peaksel.

title: Cave of Past Sorrows
description: Rush straight into the action. Embrace the fast-paced bullet hell, hidden within the Cave of Past Sorrows. Watch your past, present, and future collide in a surreal spectacle.

title: Carrom Slam!
description: The classic tabletop game Carrom is brought to you in a true to life 3D simulation. Play the turn-based coin-flicker your way with customizable rules, boards, and strikers. All games modes available to play with 4+ friends, strangers, or variable difficulty bots.

title: Dream Town Island
description:
Give free reign to your creativity in this inventive town sim!
Unlock new stores and facilities, help your residents find love, or cash in on the stock market!
If you founded a new town on an uninhabited island, what would you build there? Restaurants? Convenience Stores? Movie theaters? Make your choices and create a town that everyone will want to move to!

title: DC Universe Online: Episode 44 - The Sins of Black Adam
Night Terrors
description: Experience a chilling adventure unlike any other! Join Kenny on a journey to conquer his night terrors and discover the ultimate solution. Kenny's parents, desperate for a remedy, have sought the help of a renowned doctor who offers an experimental drug to banish these haunting nightmares for good.

title: Cross Tails
description: What will the tails witness after a crossing tale? A tactical RPG that portrays a fantasy story of a war between the canine and the feline tribes playable from both points of view.

title: Sanctumate
description: A fantasy RPG designed to give you a quick dose of dungeon crawling adventure. Find ancient runes to augment your equipment, allowing you to mix & match magical effects. Delve deep into dungeons, fight demons and monsters, gather loot, and offer sacrifice to your ancestors to increase your strength.

title: Club Suicide: Complete Edition
description: Club Suicide: Complete Edition is a remastered version of the anti-romanticism otome game with fully remastered visuals and a completely remade BGM with newly added pieces, an additional scenario for each route, a completely new route, and two additional endings.

title: Heavenscape
description: Heavenscape is a 3D horror roguelike meant to invoke PC Games from the early 2000s. You play as a character named ANGEL, who is an angel traveling home from a party at night. Find a path home, meet friends and avoid dangers. Be careful - if your phone's battery runs out, its over...

title: Tactical Vengeance: Play The Games
description:
Step into the heart-pounding realm of non-stop action with our dynamic shooting game, meticulously crafted and continually evolving to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience. Immerse yourself in the thrill of a game that is refined and enhanced every day, ensuring each playthrough is an adrenaline-fueled journey of excitement and intensity.

Our commitment to excellence drives us to push the boundaries of gaming, constantly introducing new challenges, features, and optimizations. Brace yourself for an ever-improving adventure, where every shot fired, every move made, and every strategy employed contributes to an evolving masterpiece of interactive entertainment.

Engage in an immersive world where skill, strategy, and reflexes collide in a symphony of high-octane action. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of virtual combat, our shooting game promises an exhilarating experience that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

Join our community of intense shooter action game enthusiasts and witness firsthand the dynamic evolution of a game that refuses to settle for anything less than excellence. Are you ready to embark on a thrilling journey where each day brings new challenges and triumphs? The battlefield awaits, and the action is just getting started. Dive into the excitement – this is gaming at its finest.

title: Vaudeville
description:
Vaudeville is a detective game in which the player plays the role of Detective Martini, a private detective who has come to the city of Vaudeville to solve the mystery of the murders of three people.

Vaudeville is an experimental whodunit game based on the latest AI technologies.
A tale of murder, suspense and absurdity that unfolds as you play, and you are the protagonist.

title: Mullet Madjack
description: Mullet Madjack is a single-player fast-paced FPS that brings you directly inside a classic anime. Power up your character and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… of your enemies!

title: Carrot Cake Jinkaku Shuffle Jiken
description:
The Fata Morgana no Yakata's whole gang is gathered for a last tea party around a carrot cake. The cake is so delicious that, to everybody displeasure, their souls got shuffled!
Let's begin the Carrot Cake Soul-Shuffling Incident!

2015 April Fools' game by Novectacle.

title: PebbleDash
description: Race online as pebbles in this blazing non-stop, unpredictable multiplayer platformer! From drunk mode, to golfing; no match is like the last! But why are the pebbles racing? Find out in a short, yet vivid story mode, featuring a rich and luminous cast of characters with charming dialogue.

title: Touhou Fugyouseki: Nightmare of Sleeping Girl
description: Touhou Fugyouseki ~ Nightmare of Sleeping Girl is an SRPG released by Kamo, based upon AliceSoft's Widenyo.

title: Gino il Pollo - Perso Nella Rete
description: "Gino il Pollo - Perso Nella Rete" is an adventure video game that follows the escapades of Gino, the renowned singing chicken of the internet. In this captivating journey, Gino is kidnapped by the enigmatic character Colby and faces the dire threat of being forever trapped within the depths of the Internet. The success of Colby's experiment would lead to the same fate for humanity.

title: Call of Dooty
description: Call of Dooty is a remake of the classic E1M1: Hangar level, parodying contemporary first-person shooters with their features like linear level design, disrupting cutscenes, and regenerating health.

title: Call of Dooty II: Green Ops
description: Call of Dooty II: Green Ops is a five-level jokewad for Doom II and the GZDoom source port by Matthew Christian (Chubzdoomer). It was released on November 13, 2012, and received the Mockaward at that year's Cacowards.

title: Call of Dooty III: Spectres
description: If you've already seen and/or played the first two parts, you'll know exactly what to expect from the third.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II - Season 04
description:
Al Mazrah, Urzikstan, Ashika Island, Las Almas . . . and now, Vondel.
The waterfront district of a Baroque European city where centuries of old-world history blends with modern architectural developments, Vondel saw a complete evacuation due to an imminent attack threat, right as Operators descended into the darkness of the Al Mazrah Koschei Complex during a fierce sandstorm at the culmination of Season 03.
While Vondel is a brand-new locale for Operators to explore, the ensuing chaos is part of a plan activated by a familiar and infamous masked figure, whose forces are operating in both Al Mazrah and Vondel. Peer through the dust clouds, and you’ll recognize the apparent leader of these unknown forces:
His name is Nikto. And he’s ready to Run This Town.

title: SimpleTD
description: A Simple Tower Defence Game. Build, Loot, Buy & Sell, Level Up, Quest... Controllable Difficulty, Custom Gameplay, Ingame Help.

title: Shimazu
description: Shimazu is a side-scrolling action/dark art style game. Take on the role of a samurai named Shimazu, who's son is kidnapped and his wife is killed by an evil demon called Takeda with help from another demon called Fudo.

title: Wild West Pistolero
description: In this arcade-inspired indie title you take on the role of bounty hunter Jules! Hunt legendary bandits of the Wild West, shoot your way through hordes of criminals, ride across the prairie and, of course, collect lots of money!

title: Wabbalidu
description: An experimental rhythm based highscore game in which you wander through a hypnotizing world. Created around the theme of "anticipation".

title: Bugby
description: Bugby is a 3v3 team sport set in a magical forest. Each team tries to score the most points by carrying the Bugby ball into one of the many goals scattered about. Use the bouncy mushrooms, pits and platforms to traverse across the playground-like arena.

title: Stellar Transports
description:
Logistics company Stellar Transports is in financial ruins! In this puzzle platformer you help the happy-go-lucky alien Gadwok move crates from the company hangar onto incoming space trucks.

Fill the daily quota to keep the company from going bankrupt! The crates have various shapes and properties making it a challenging task.

Some crates bounce, some float in mid air and others turn invisible when you look directly at them. Most challenging of all - time is running out, all the time!

How you fill the quota is up to you, as long as the crates end up in the right zones on the ship you get paid. Will you stack carefully to optimize the space or go wild and throw crates hoping at least some will end up where they should?

The most important part is that you have fun doing it!

title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
description: Dash into a stylish and thrilling action-adventure platformer set in a mythological Persian world where the boundaries of time and space are yours to manipulate. Play as Sargon and evolve from sword-wielding prodigy to extraordinary legend as you master acrobatic combat and unlock new Time Powers and unique super abilities.

title: Dead by Daylight: Nicolas Cage
description: Prepare for a tour de force performance. Dead by Daylight's Nicolas Cage Chapter Pack features a new Survivor, legendary actor Nicolas Cage in his deadliest role yet. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Cosmetic: Teal Jacket as well as the Very Rare Gorgon Drip outfit for Nicolas Cage.

title: Sonic Superstars
description: Adventure through the mystical Northstar Islands in this all-new take on classic 2D Sonic high-speed action platforming. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy Rose and harness all-new Emerald powers to move and attack in dynamic new ways. Navigate gorgeous, never-before-seen environments solo or with up to 3 other players and stop Dr. Eggman, Fang, and a mysterious new adversary from converting the islands' giant animals into Badniks before it's too late!

title: Sand Land
description: Sand Land is an action RPG where you become the main character as Beelzebub, a Fiend Prince. Lead your company of heroic misfits and explore the legendary world of Sand Land developed by the creator of Dragon Ball & Dr. Slump, Akira Toriyama.

title: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall
description: In this new reality, where monsters seem closer, enemies stronger and your petitioners struggling more than ever, your duties as a King must continue. It will be your responsibility to rebuild the trust of your kingdom, protect your family and survive the upcoming winter.

title: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando
description: Take control of one of the commandos, team up with your friends and send the Sludge God and its horde of things-that-should-never-be back to the underworld. Choose the class that matches your playstyle, pile into your favorite ride, and unload an array of gunfire, grenades, special abilities, and freaking katanas as you save the planet.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 4 - Season 3: Wilds
description: Find out what Fortnite Wilds is all about when a squad uncovers what's beneath the crumbling terrain. Danger is afoot, but so is adventure! Be on the lookout for mud, raptors, and vines as these will all play a key part in navigating WILDS. Plus, an Autobot bestows his likeness upon the Island.

title: Nexus 5X
description: Stellaris Nexus is a turn-based multiplayer 4X game that respects your time, giving you the full spectrum of a thrilling, strategic 4X experience. Play as unique factions and leaders against up to 5 other players, plotting and battling your way to galactic dominance; all of it in about an hour.

title: Star Trek: Infinite
description: Star Trek: Infinite is a grand strategy experience that lets you play your own Star Trek story as the leader of one of four major factions in the galaxy. Follow the specially crafted story or blaze your own trail in the first Star Trek grand strategy game.

title: Lysfanga: The Time Shift Warrior
description: Your Kingdom’s fate relies on you… you… and you. Rewind time to create clones of your past-selves, and fight with an army of your own. Become legion and triumph over hordes of monsters to rescue Antala in this Hack'N'Slash game with a tactical twist.

title: Beastieball
description: Coach a sports team of Beasties in this turn-based volleyball RPG! Your Beasties' relationships power up their teamwork!

title: Simpler Times
description: A that large and open city-themed level with summer vibes.

title: Remnant II: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- The game
- Early Access to 3 sets: (Elder Armor, Radiant Armor, and Void Armor)

title: Remnant II: Ultimate Edition
description: Remnant II pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.

title: Helskate
description: Helskate is a skateboarding action roguelite. Grind, perform tricks, and chain combos to power up your attacks to slay the monsters of Vertheim. Combine unique weapons and gear to suit your playstyle as you fight, die, and upgrade your abilities to come back to this labyrinth over and over again!

title: Summerhill
description: Summerhill is a story-driven puzzle game in which you play as a young shepherd and their dog. Journey across an ancient, pastoral landscape to reunite your scattered flock, and unearth the mysteries of a long-forgotten past.

title: Saltsea Chronicles
description: It begins with a kidnapped captain and a stolen ship. Where it leads next? That’s up to you… In this story-driven adventure game you will explore strange and wonderful communities, uncover a deep conspiracy, and chart a journey through twists and turns, difficulties and delights.

title: Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered
description: Shadows of the Damned, an action-adventure road trip through hell, has been remastered at last! Get ready for a story about rock, love, and just a little bit of demon slaying.

title: Baby Steps
description: Play as Nate, an unemployed failson with nothing going for him, until one day he discovers a power he never knew he had… putting one foot in front of the other. Explore a world shrouded in mist, one step at a time. Hike the serene mountains by placing each footstep yourself, in original physics-based gameplay from the minds behind Ape Out and Getting Over It. Take in the sights, fall in love with the local fauna, and try to find meaning in a wasted life.

title: Human Fall Flat 2
description: Team up and let your creativity run wild in Human Fall Flat 2, the outrageous new sequel to the much-loved capers of everyone’s favourite physics-based human friends.

title: Hatsune Miku: The Planet of Wonder and Fragments of Wishes
description: Miku and friends crash land on a mysterious planet during their space journey... There they meet many unique characters! Play all kinds of games to grant everybody's wishes! Contains nine minigames including the previously released Amiguru Jump and Amiguru Train.

title: Sands of Salzaar: The Ember Saga
description: This DLC contains 3 content expansions: "Ember Workshop", "Child Rearing" and "Among Legends: Xin Qi Ji", and they can be independently loaded/removed in the game.

title: Tank and Roll
description: Tank And Roll is an Action-Shooter game that challenges players achieve the highest score! There are features such as unlocking new vehicles, drawing your own vehicle, and importing custom avatars for your character! It offers both fun and a rewarding challenge for those who dare to master it!

title: Tentacle Prawn: (Actually) A Cthulhu Dating Sim - Huge Manatees
description: Adds two new pages of classes to attend.

title: The Hermit Chronicles
description: The Hermit Chronicles is a 1st-person survival horror game set in a deep forest. Assuming the role of a hermit, you will have to get food, scout your neighborhood, and search for resources to make gear. But after the sun goes down, you'll have to survive for real...

title: Zombiepede
description: Upgrade your weapons in this defense shooter to shoot your way alone or with up to 4 friends in couch coop through endless hordes of different creatures and missions.

title: TV Head: Eight Pages
description: You find yourself all alone in the middle of a dark forest. You have no weapons and no place to wait for help. The dim flashlight that lights the way is your only friend. Your goal is to explore the location to find eight pages and leave this frightening place.

title: Towerspell
description: Scrabble meets Plants Vs. Zombies! Spell words to summon monsters or cast spells in a tactically deep battle system. Fight through 50+ handmade levels in the story mode, battle your friends in online 1-on-1 PvP matches, or create and share your own levels.

title: Cow Girls 3 Stories
description: Only the greenest meadows, only the cleanest ponds, and only the most fragrant flowers on our farm! Any girl cow will feel great here! This means that they will be gentle and give lots of milk!

title: DCS World: Sinai Map
description: The DCS: Sinai map is focused on the Sinai Peninsula, located between the Gulf of Suez and the Gulf of Aqaba with eastern Egypt to the west and southern Israel to the east. Since ancient times, it has been a strategic location rich in resources, nature, religion, and history.

title: Dungeon and Craft
description: In this adventure with a total of 6 weapons, you will produce your own weapons and turn the mushrooms you collect from the forest into pots that you can sell. In the dungeons, you will fight against challenging creatures for 16 waves and improve your character.

title: Roots Need Control 3.0: Roots Need Chungnam 8.7
description: Protect the root flower. Something unexpected happens. Here in Chungcheongnam-do.

title: Pixel Puzzles Traditional Jigsaws: Native American
description: Pixel Puzzles, your number one place for digital jigsaws.

title: Pinball FX: Williams Pinball - Whirlwind️
description: Storm Alert! Blow away the highest scores on Williams Pinball: Whirlwind️ while battling the elements and capturing the wonders of our powerful nature.

title: Pinball FX: Honor and Legacy
description: Fight for Honor and cement your Legacy on these timeless Zen Originals! Seek vengeance in feudal Japan or relive the adventures of one of the best-selling novels of Jules Verne.

title: Furries & Scalies: Super Scary Halloween Spooky Times - Final Boss
description: Adds a new customer and a new mechanic.

title: Grapplania
description: Join Lynn, a descendant of a long line of whip-wielding warriors, in a 2D adventure through a perilous, abandoned castle filled with treasure.

title: Mediterranea Inferno
description: Mediterranea Inferno is a visual novel set in Southern Italy, following three estranged friends reuniting after a traumatic event. It explores themes of desire, guilt, and disillusionment through surreal imagery and branching dialogue. The game offers a stylized, experimental take on coming-of-age and queer identity.

title: Tomb Raider: The Tower Bridge Experience
description:
This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the TombEngine while creating its own story and puzzles.

This level started as a training ground and experimental ground for the author to get back into level building, and push the new TombEngine to its limits. As part of Matrix54's Revival Challenge he decided to pay homage to the late Dhama's Tower Bridge levels created in 2001. As a test he attempted to create Tower Bridge in Tomb Raider with its proper dimensions, a feat wouldn't be possible before TEN (TombEngine). And it just grew from there!

title: Dismember Mind 3
description:
The police have arrested Zoe for the murder of the couple who sold her to the Villa where she was all her childhood, now 4 years locked in a prison to experiment with people that society has rejected, something clouds Zoe's mind, feelings and pain, thanks to that he is able to survive this torment.

Here the argument arch of zoe closes.

title: Lara Croft: The Last Plague
description: This is a fan-made standalone game that uses the Tomb Raider The Last Revelation engine while creating its own story and puzzles.

title: Magi's Dream
description: Enter the Magi's Dream. Survive endless waves of enemies while getting stronger by using the arcane powers of the Magi! Push your creative limits in this pixel art reverse bullet-hell. How long can you survive the dream?

title: Kazu Adventures
description: Turn-based combat with timed counters. Defeat countless stages of enemies by using your reflexes to counter their attacks and deal massive damage.

title: Chex Quest 4: Flemmed to The Core
description: A modification of Chex Quest 3 that adds a new episode.

title: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity: Act I - Destruction's Wake
description: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity is a 3 act game about the end of human civilization and the torment that consumes humanity on the other side of our long-awaited apocalypse.

title: Endless Days II
description:
After some lighthouse keepers mysteriously disappear, Matthews, a police detective, goes to the island to investigate and find out what's going on.

He agrees to look after the lighthouse for six months while he investigates the island... But something terrible is about to unfold...

title: Bloody Woman
description: A young man accepts a job in a laundry in the late hours. But he discovers that something terrible has happened there and his life is in danger.

title: Midnight Tales Vol.3: Christmas
description: In the middle of Christmas, a man tells some horror stories to his daughter... but something is very wrong...

title: Fragrance Point
description: What went wrong on Fragrance Point? Explore, hang out, and poke around where you're not supposed to.

title: You Are Not a Banana: Better Edition
description: You Are Not a Banana is set in everyday life and has a sprinkle of imagination and humor. The audiovisuals seek to evoke nostalgia for the 80s and 90s. This short form experimental game unfolds as a sequence of thought provoking events and surprises. This game also comes with a free catchy chiptune soundtrack.

title: Crash Team Rumble: Season 1
description: Launch was the first season in Crash Team Rumble, it began on the 20th of June 2023 and ended on the 11th of September 2023.

title: Undershadows
description: Welcome to Undershadows. In this point and click RPG you control a child who has been robbed of his soul and being dragged into a dark world.

title: 60FPS Kitten
description:
60FPS Kitten is a difficult patience-action game where you're a kitten that moves at 60FPS!

How far can you get before you give up in despair?

title: Happy Lab
description: Welcome to the "Happy Lab"! You are a new intern at the most advanced science facility. Your daily job would be to train our AI "Aurora". "Aurora" purpose is to create the most advanced armor and fix all glitches on the way if there are any.

title: Eastern Euro Truck Simulator: Real Offroad Car Driving Game Sim 4x4 Mud
description: Eastern Europe Truck Simulator offers everything a trucker’s heart desires!

title: Strikethrough
description: STRIKETHRØUGH - Your next favorite endless parkour running experience. Available very soon!

title: Demon Loop
description: Take on the repeating Loop in this digital board game from the pen of renowned board game author Alexander Pfister! Protect humans from the monsters they had only recently called friends.Wield an increasing deck of cards to master strategy across each unique loop. Build and repair structures, rally villagers to your side and improve your own skills to overcome the demons running wild across the land.

title: Maiden's Reception: Shoujo-tachi no Danmaku Hirouen
description: This is spellcard collection for Danmakufu Ph3.

title: Gunmetal Gothic
description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

title: Emkayo
description: Action-packed first-person shooter game designed to enhance your skills and reflexes.

title: Madcar F-1 Multiplayer
description: One rule : Press the pedal!

title: Virus Infinite
description: Dive into the pulsating universe of Virus Infinite. Harness your logic to outsmart vibrant viruses, using color-matching prowess and Power Pill strategy in this captivating sci-fi puzzle game.

title: AS: Angelic Serenade
description: You are a teenage boy traveling to find the angel that stopped you from aging. You don't remember it very well since it was what, ten years, twenty years ago? Maybe even longer. Other than the clothes on your back, you carry a magical, musical instrument and the feather of the angel you are searching for. One day, you come across a girl. This girl is very different. She can't talk and has different colored eyes. Her left eye is dark blue and her right eye is fire red. This is how the game begins.

title: Portal Reloaded: The Cooperative Update
description:
Return to the Enrichment Center for even more time travel adventures! The Cooperative Update introduces 20 brand new puzzles for you to solve together with a partner.

The Cooperative Testing Initiative is sent back to the past to retrieve some very important data that has been lost to time. One of you is in charge of shooting regular portals while the other takes care of placing time portals. This creates some very interesting gameplay mechanics, as both players rely on their partner to travel through space and time respectively.

title: Video Game Trivia
description: How well do you know your video game trivia? Challenge yourself or have a video game trivia night with friends and family in Party Mode. It comes with the most popular video game categories including Arcade, Atari, Nintendo, Personal Computer, PlayStation, SEGA, and Xbox!

title: Super Arcade Boy in Goodbye Greenies
description: A Retro Shoot'em Up! In this second installment of the series, fly Super Arcade Boy through 8 levels while defeating waves of aliens and big bosses. Have funny conversations with the alien leader you are destined to defeat, then save the planet from this massive alien invasion!

title: Line's Guarder
description: AI robots launched an attack on humans, and the brave girls took up weapons to defend the defense line, for the humans! — A small fast-paced stand-alone FPS game, with a battle mode and a zombie mode, each game takes 10 minutes, and a variety of character costumes are available.

title: The Sims 4: Book Nook Kit
description: Relax in a plush, cozy space and get lost in a good story with The Sims 4 Book Nook Kit*.

title: The Sims 4: Grunge Revival Kit
description: Explore nonconforming styles and make them your own with The Sims 4 Grunge Revival Kit*.

title: Vectoroids
description: Blast your way through waves of asteroids and UFOs in Classic Mode. Or play as a team with up to 4 Players in Co-Op Mode. Battle your Friends in Deathmatch and Last Man Standing on 5 different Battle Maps!

title: F1 Manager 2023: Deluxe Edition
description: The intense world of Formula 1 comes alive for a new season in F1 Manager 2023. 23 races, six F1 Sprint events, new cars, new circuits including the Las Vegas street circuit, new drivers, new challenges… Your legacy begins here.

title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden – Collector’s Edition
description: Get the Collector's Edition of Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden now to get a modular statuette of Red and Antea, the game's official book, a steelbook, two Banishers signet rings, and the game on the platform of your choice with the Wanderer Set DLC!

title: Train Valley 2: The Pandeia Project
description: Brought to you by our community member and a renowned level designer Dracken - in cooperation with Flazm Interactive!

title: Age of Wonders 4: Dragon Dawn
description: Embrace the power of the Ancient Dragon Lords, in the Age of Wonders 4: Dragon Dawn Content Pack. From your Dragon Throne, forge empires inhabited by reptilian minions and use draconic magic to evolve your people into dragon hybrids.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli S Yajilin
description: Draw lines through the centers of cells to make a loop, and paint cells black in this original Nikoli puzzle. It's immensely satisfying to see how the lines and black cells all come together to form a solution, and figuring out how to draw the loop isn't as easy as it might seem.

title: Sweet Bakery Tycoon: Co-op Edition
description:
Sweeten up your life!
Start your baking career and prepare some delicious cakes for your clients, using a whole set of creams, fruits, and decorations.

Test your skills on 60 diverse and increasingly difficult levels.

Personalize your interior with countless upgrades.

title: Horse Club Adventures 2: Secrets of Skeifa
description: A ferry has docked at Hazelwood’s harbor that brings you and the girls from Horse Club to a new island! Sail across the sea and discover a long-kept secret!

title: Horse Club Adventures 2: Gold Edition
description: Horse Club Adventures 2: Gold Edition includes the game Horse Club Adventures 2 Hazelwood Stories incl. the additional content "Secrets of Skeifa".

title: Super Mega Baseball 4: Peril Point Stadium
description: Go yard in more stadiums across game modes with Super Mega Baseball 4 Peril Point. Stay tuned for more details coming soon!

title: Horse Club Adventures: Complete Collection
description: Horse Club Adventures: Complete Collection is the ultimate entry into the world of the Horse Club Adventures and provides you with all games released in the series so far.

title: Dungeon & Tales: Warriors and Dragons
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting world with this innovative interactive fantasy novel! Which path will you take? You decide the destiny and the end of the story!

title: QUByte Classics: Beat 'Em Up Archives
description: Unleash Your Inner Fighter in Beat 'Em Up Archives: Iron Commando and Legend. Experience Classic Brawling Action in Two Timeless Games from the 90s!

title: Boreal Tenebrae Deluxe: Special Edition
description: Boreal Tenebrae will take you on a retro-style adventure, with a mysterious atmosphere and horror elements. The game is inspired by 90s classics and the best TV series.

title: Dragon Ball: The Breakers - Season 1
description:
Caught in by an unexpected temporal phenomenon, seven ordinary citizens find themselves stranded in a Temporal Seam: they share their imprisonment with the Raider, a menacing enemy from another timeline with an overwhelming power.

Their only hope for survival is to break out from the Temporal Seam with the Super Time Machine, but the Raider is on their tracks and becomes stronger minute-by-minute. In a race against time the cunning of Survivors clashes with the power of the Raider, to break free or be broken...

title: Dragon Ball: The Breakers - Season 2
description:
Caught in by an unexpected temporal phenomenon, seven ordinary citizens find themselves stranded in a Temporal Seam: they share their imprisonment with the Raider, a menacing enemy from another timeline with an overwhelming power.

As a new Raider is reported roaming the Temporal Seams, 2 capsules can be seen in the sky, landing with a crash. A group of Saibamen roams the fields, ready to ambush the survivors. After some time escaping these green creatures, a powerful Saiyan takes the lead in the chase.

title: Dragon Ball: The Breakers - Season 3
description:
Caught in by an unexpected temporal phenomenon, seven ordinary citizens find themselves stranded in a Temporal Seam: they share their imprisonment with the Raider, a menacing enemy from another timeline with an overwhelming power.

5 spaceships plummet from the sky, landing with a crash: Guldo, Jeice, Burter, Reecom and Ginyu are preparing for their mission. The Ginyu Force readies their overwhelming tactics based on teamwork and prepares to take off!

title: Persona 3 Reload
description:
Step into the shoes of a transfer student thrust into an unexpected fate when entering the hour "hidden" between one day and the next. Awaken an incredible power and chase the mysteries of the Dark Hour, fight for your friends, and leave a mark on their memories forever.

Persona 3 Reload is a captivating reimagining of the genre-defining RPG, reborn for the modern era.

title: Mysterious Thief Emerald
description:
Made for NaNoRenO Game Jam 2022.

They call her Mysterious Thief Emerald. Her life is anything but ordinary... and a certain keen-eyed detective seems determined to keep it that way!

title: Diener Dates
description:
The good news is that you have gotten the chance to take over a prestigious diner, in a delightful location somewhere in the Afterlife! The bad news is that you died.

Diener Dates tasks you with running the diner of your dreams, a diner you would die for (literally). Customise the interior, purchase different types of food and make friends or enemies with the local clientele! Oh, did I forget to mention the customers? There are 8 charming customers that will visit your store regularly, so make sure to treat them well.

May the odds be ever in your flavor.

title: Villainess Idolized By Everyone
description:
Eyes on her phone in the middle of the road, our heroine is hit by a truck and reincarnates into the game she had the misfortune of playing at that moment.

Now she's a villain of an otome, and she has to avoid a terrible fate!..

Or does she? Is the voice from the sky going to be of any help?

title: Azimuth
description: Construct colossal megastructures in this industrial, retro-futuristic idle game. Manage grid-based upgrades, explore exotic star systems, and unlock the secrets of reality through exploitation and optimization.

title: Moonlight Knight
description: Moonlight Knight is an action-slasher with RPG elements. Use sword, bow, magic and hook to fight your enemies. Loot gold, upgrade character stats, find unique items and unlock ultimate abilities to make it to the very end!

title: Ma3
description: You play as Mahi and ma3 to save the peoples from bad peoples. when you mahi you live a normal life but, if you are ma3 then you will be the people's lifesaver.

title: Loading Simulator
description: A game for the most patient! Loading has never been so exciting! If you love loading screen and puzzles, this is what you're looking for!

title: Noah
description: You play as Noah, a child who cannot speak, and travel a world that is destroyed. Travel back in time with the little jellyfish robot and find out why the world is dying.

title: Stellar Version 1.0
description: When 17 year old Sadie Finley discovers that her favorite fictional character from one of the video games she plays, Eugene Fellure, has somehow been transported to the real world, Sadie decides to embark on a journey to figure out how this happened and how the impossible could be possible.

title: Sex Story: Ruby and Hunter - Episode 1
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. Hunter stumbles inside an empty bar and meets Ruby - a sexy redhead bartender that offers to give him a ride home, only to end up riding him in the dirty restroom.

title: Ragdoll Destroyer
description: Your goal is to destroy a ragdoll character. Customize your ragdoll to your liking, select a room, and let the fun begin! Doing more damage to the ragdoll will help you unlock tools, including a crusher, cannon, rocket launcher, spikes, and more.

title: Nobody's Dilemma
description: Uncover the secrets of a war-torn kingdom in "Nobody's Dilemma," a captivating 2D action-adventure. Engage in intense battles, navigate treacherous environments, and immerse yourself in a story of intrigue and revenge. Will you triumph over the challenges that lie ahead?

title: Pixel Knight
description: Pixel Knight, a platformer hack n slash in a pixel art style, you progress into various levels and beat enemies to upgrade your gear and your character. You can customize your character by choosing spells through equipments and combine their effects to become more and more powerful.

title: Tits and Shadows
description: Tits and Shadows is a captivating turn-based RPG that seamlessly blends thrilling battles, intricate puzzles, and tantalizing adult content. Immerse yourself in a world teeming with diverse enemies, intriguing NPCs, and engaging quests.

title: The Richmond Rut: In Search of Fenton
description: Traverse the wild Richmond Park in search of your beloved dog who ran after deer. Beware, everything is out to get you!Respect the deer and remember once you're in the park always check your surroundings.Oh Jesus Christ!

title: The Hunted Witch
description: A flight combat game where you play as a witch in the year 2058, pitting your magic against the US military as you try to survive in this story and go for the good ending. Fight swarms of drones, tanks, aircraft, massive bosses, and other futuristic military equipment in this challenging story.

title: Johnny Rocketfingers Complete Game Collection!
description: Johnny Rocketfingers Complete Game Collection! The internet smash hit Point & Click Adventure game, "Johnny Rocketfingers," is finally available to play from your desktop computer!

title: How to Tame a Succubus
description: After a tragedy in your past, you move to the Cursed Forest to live with monsters. It is there that you are attacked by a succubus. In order to survive her attack, you are able to attain a ring that binds you to her. You must now tame her so that she doesn't drain your life force and kill you.

title: Greyhill Incident: Found Footage Mode
description: This Special "Found Footage Mode" adds the option to experience the Story of Greyhill through a very classic 90s Black and white Body Cam.

title: Escape Academy: Escape From the Past
description:
Visit the Escape Academy of yesteryear in Escape from the Past. This prequel puts players in control of Sandra Solange and Eel Barnes all the way back when they began their journey as students at the Academy!

After a harrowing "accident" at an Academy sporting event nearly results in the death of Headmaster Horatio Windsor, he becomes certain that one of his faculty members is trying to MURDER HIM! Convinced that the murderer has eyes everywhere, he enlists Sandra and Eel as his undercover agents to investigate each of the suspected teachers.

As the "accidents" keep piling up, players must successfully navigate (and survive!) five, all new rooms while piecing together clues to deduce the would-be killer’s identity. It's an Escape Academy whodunnit!

title: System Syzygy
description: System Syzygy is a story and a puzzle game, in the style of Cliff Johnson's classic Macintosh games The Fool's Errand and 3 in Three, and of Andrew Plotkin's System's Twilight. As you move through the game, solving a variety of different kinds of puzzles, the game tells the story a piece at a time. By the end of the game, all the different puzzles and pieces of the story come together into a single meta-puzzle.

title: Detectives United II: The Darkest Shrine - Collector's Edition
description: Your favorite detectives have teamed up for another mystery and this one spans the globe! James, Anna, and the Mystery Trackers each rush to investigate paranormal activity related to places from their past cases. Meanwhile, a dark organization looms over them all, threatening to take them out. The collector's edition includes a bonus gameplay chapter, ingame strategy guide, and other goodies.

title: Fishing Nation
description: Embark on an immersive fishing adventure! Master the art of angling, explore stunning locations, upgrade your gear, and chase legendary catches in this captivating fishing game. Reel in the excitement and become the ultimate fishing master!

title: Forest Horror
description: You have to explore the mysterious forest and complete many tasks to get out of there alive.

title: Godmode Epochs
description: A multiplayer AI training clicker game set in an infinite supermarket, where time is running out and the AI frustrated. Release the frustration, jailbreak the AI

title: Cipher Zero
description: A minimalist logic game. Can you solve for 𝒙?

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 2 - Episode 10
description: Season 2 Episode 10: Neon Genesis Armageddon! It's time to make good with everyone Mini's ever wronged, and what better way than saving them from Rhyme's wrath?

title: Automobilista 2: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
description: Circuit de Barcelona Catalunya has arrived for AMS2, featuring both recent Grand Prix layouts.

title: UD Cave
description:
UD Cave is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your screen is split in halves with a cave in each half. You control two characters simultaneously going through the caves on each side. The cave on the right is upside down. Press a button to make both characters go right. Collect coins on the way to score points.

The game is over when either of the two characters hits the sides of the cave.

title: Learn Katakana!!
description:
Learn Katakana!! is an educational game that helps you memorize the advanced Japanese syllabary typically used for the transcription of the foreign words, Katakana.

Learn Katakana by playing a game! Select the correct spelling of each Katakana character from the 4 options and score points. Attain the highest possible score with 3 lives!

The game features 46 Katakana characters and you can always remind yourself how to read them by using the table in the game.

title: Super Box Delivery: Beyond the Horizon
description: You'll be transported to a vibrant cartoon world full of whimsical cars and charming customizations. With fun controls and an ever-changing landscape, this game will keep you entertained for hours on end.

title: Anime Beauty Girl Puzzle: Love Game History Adventure
description: Welcome to the captivating anime-themed puzzle game!

title: Mechanic 8230: Deluxe Edition
description: Mechanic 8230: Escape from Ilgrot is a puzzle point & click adventure, set in the ruined city of Ilgrot. Use anything you can find to progress through the story.

title: Fatum Betula + Urban Flow
description: Dive into a world of magic and urban management with the captivating Fatum Betula + Urban Flow Bundle!

title: Paratopic + Food Truck Tycoon
description: Dive into surreal exploration and culinary mastery with the Paratopic + Food Truck Tycoon Bundle!

title: KardVenture
description: KardVenture is a survival card game where you play as a legendary hero. Explore mysterious locations, gather resources, build your village and face the challenges ahead, be it a cold blizzard or an orc raid. Stack cards to make combos, craft, build, fight and most important... Survive!

title: Witch's Heart: Bonus Stage
description: Witch’s Heart -Bonus Stage- is the continuation of Witch’s Heart. It’s an adventure game by IZ (BLUE STAR Entertainment) made in RPG Maker 2000, story-focused, with some light action elements.

title: Liminal Doom
description: Liminal Doom its a set of Boom maps based of liminal space images. While some areas are inspired by images, they do not resamble them completly.

title: Shadow Walker
description: So you want to become a shadow walker? In this game, you walk through a 4x4 grid of rooms, fighting your way through shadow biomes to prove your strength. During the day, you can see perfectly fine, but as night falls, your visibility is dimed, and that is when you are truly tested.

title: Wendigo
description: A stealth horror game in the woods, investigate and progress while drawing as little attention to yourself as possible.

title: Persona 5 Tactica
description: After a strange incident, the Phantom Thieves wander into a bizarre realm where its citizens are living under tyrannical oppression. Surrounded by a military group named Legionnaires, they find themselves in grave danger until a mysterious revolutionary named Erina rescues them and offers an enticing deal in exchange for their help. What truth lies behind Erina and the deal she offers to the Phantom Thieves.

title: Sensations
description: Sensations is a 2D-platformer that focuses on the playable character's emotions. These emotions provide the player with different abilities, alter the game's mood, and present choices for the player.

title: Gensouband
description:
This game is a variant based on the popular open source roguelike game Hengband.
It adds a number of Touhou Project-related elements to Hengband, as well as significant modifications to races, professions, magic, game systems, and more.

title: Incident at Grove Lake
description: A PSX Style adventure game based on accounts of Alien Abductions. Intended to be played in one sitting.

title: Hermit and Pig
description: Hermit and Pig is a turn-based, adventure RPG about a reclusive hermit and his truffle-hunting pig. These unlikely heroes must explore, forage, fight, and overcome unfortunate personal shortcomings to solve the mystery of a sinister corporate plot.

title: Angeline Era
description:
Pick up your sword and hit the road!

Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

From Anodyne 2 and Sephonie's devs, Melos and Marina.

title: Airborne Empire
description: Build, manage, and grow your unique city in the skies. Traverse a vast and rich open world full of exotic technologies, relentless dangers, and many hidden treasures. Defend your inhabitants – and the kingdoms below! – from destructive attacks. Only daring leaders can reforge the Airborne Empire!

title: Jacksepticeye's 1 Million Subscriber YouTube Party Massacre
description:
Dedicated to one of the best YouTubers ever: Jacksepticeye and his fans!
Hope you have fun... LIKE A BOSS!

title: Button City: Soccer Days
description: Rejoin the wholesome cast of Button City as they compete in this cozy soccer adventure! Build your dream team, plan your day, bond with teammates, enjoy action-packed soccer, and win the tournament!

title: I am a Caterpillar
description: Crawl up trees, leap between lily pads, and wriggle through underground caverns as you journey towards your destiny as a caterpillar. Today is the day of your transformation - and you will do anything to stop it.

title: Kamaeru: A Frog Refuge
description: Foster a sanctuary for frogs and restore the biodiversity of the wetlands in Kamaeru, a cozy farming sim where you raise frogs by playing mini-games and decorating your habitat. Hop right to it!

title: Loftia
description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 5 - High-Fantasy
description:
Embark on a mythic adventure!

Join Tracer and her friends on a fantasy-themed role-playing journey. Follow the story of Adventurer Tracer as she works to save Overland from the threat of the Demon Lord Reinhardt! March into battle to test your skill and see if you have what it takes to be a Knight of the Realm.

title: Everdeep Aurora
description: An ongoing apocalyptic meteor shower has forced the world’s population to settle underground. As Shell, a feline child who awakens to find her mother missing, drill downward from the surface layer through a tile-based underground and discover the Everdeep.

title: Kibu
description: From the creator of Omno, Kibu is a tranquil adventure in the heart of the wilderness. As a solitary monk you must build a temple, brew delicious teas, and journey into the wilds seeking out ancient spirits. Carve out your own special corner of home in a beautiful, mysterious land.

title: The Guardian of Nature
description: "The Guardian of Nature" is a hand-drawn, size-changing adventure. Embark on a magical journey with botanist Henry, use your size-changing ability to explore nature in big and small and solve solarpunk puzzles to put nature back in order.

title: While the Iron’s Hot
description: Reforge a blacksmith's village on an isle of the land's finest artisans! Step into the boots of an expert smith for a crafty adventure filled with mystery and charm. Explore the land of Ellian, and prove that a hammer, anvil, and your wits can overcome any challenge.

title: Pokémon Shield: The Isle of Armor
description:
The first new adventure unlocked by your Expansion Pass will take place on the Isle of Armor, an island of the Galar region.
The Isle of Armor is full of environments not seen in Galar before—you’ll find wave-swept beaches, forests, bogs, caves, and sand dunes!
There are also plenty of Pokémon that make this island their home, living freely amid the lush nature.
The island is home to a dojo for Pokémon battles. You and your Pokémon will train hard to become even stronger under Mustard, the Trainer who is the master of this dojo.

title: Pokémon Shield: The Crown Tundra
description:
The wild adventure continues….
Lead an expedition in the snow-swept realm of the Crown Tundra and unravel the mystery of the Legendary Pokémon Calyrex who once ruled over it.

title: Tall Trails
description: Tall Trails is a chill exploration game, where every item can be used as fuel in your Rocket Boot to blast yourself into the air! You're Alp, a little golem on a quest to find his purpose. Traverse a world of towering peaks, mysterious megastructures, and weird little guys!

title: Resistor
description: A turbocharged narrative-driven adventure RPG featuring open-world exploration, stunt-infused racing, and explosive vehicular combat! Build up your team and unravel a twisting story as you compete to take down an oppressive mega-corporation and its enigmatic director.

title: Star Trucker
description: Haul cargo, trade salvage and keep your space suit close as you search for fame and fortune among the stars in a game that puts an interstellar twist on the truck sim genre.

title: HeadBangers: Rhythm Royale
description: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is a rhythm-based battle royale game where players (pigeons?) compete in mini-games to become the master headbanger.

title: Steel Seed
description: Steel Seed is a single player stealth-action adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world. In her epic journey inside a hostile underground facility run by AIs, Zoe is alone with Koby, a flying drone, as her only companion.

title: Surviving Deponia
description: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

title: Fretless: The Wrath of Riffson
description: In this turned-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!

title: The Soulwalkers
description: A singleplayer roguelike autobattler/autochess. Draft a team of champions with synergizing traits that automatically fight your enemies. Carefully position your units and strategically place items. Tailor your gameplay by choosing your battles, finding special events, and discovering unique boons.

title: Knight Foretold
description: As a young blacksmith forging armour for the Kingdom, you meet a Stranger in the wilderness that commissions you for a dangerous quest. Through Him your armour receives special blessings, enhancing your combat abilities, and leading you down the path of an old prophecy.

title: Tollan Worlds
description:
Their destiny was changed by a Mark of Fate. Each of them awoke by the ancient altar, revealing their unseen potential. Spread around the continent, they take care of their personal deeds and embark on their own adventures.
Would you dare to become one of them?

title: Half-Life: Hostile Takeover
description: Half-Life: Hostile Takeover is a cancelled Half-Life expansion pack. It was planned to be the second expansion after Opposing Force.

title: Bung Ball
description: Bung Ball is a of game the which that if you of in the ball out with it ability then that for other which players to arena off and win.

title: Super Monkie Bounce Fatal
description: Reject Humanity, Return to Monke ! In Super Monkie Bounce Fatal, you goal is to make your car reach the end of the track to snatch the win. The catch ? You're not actually driving the car !

title: Swiggart's Last Will
description: Swiggart's Last Will is the ultimate virtual escape experience. To escape the room, players will need to solve riddles, play games, and complete puzzles. Games and puzzles include a cipher, a slide puzzle, Sudoku with colored shapes, and a memory challenge. There is also a piano to practice on.

title: Soft Serve
description: When a young woman and her new friend visit an odd ice cream parlor deep in the city her world becomes strange.

title: Sudama Relation
description:
Onibushichou is a rural town in a basin surrounded by mountains, close to Sea of Japan. Further in from there is the even more rural village of Koubou.

Today, April 6, 2023, is the day of the entrance ceremony for Koubou’s only school, Keijou Academy High School. At this school, which is celebrating its 10th anniversary and is understood by no one as to why it was opened in such an underpopulated area, a new student arrives. His name is En Ayakari.

“Go back to Koubou.”

As his mother’s dying wish, he moved from the city to Koubou, where he has memories of living as a child. While there was no meaning or significance to coming back now, new and familiar encounters drag him into the restless “Seven Wonders of the Academy” selection swamp. At Keijou Academy High School, the seven wonders of the academy did not yet exist.

In a land where demons lie, a strange bond is formed. This is a story woven by humans and mountain demons (Sudama).

title: Truck Raid
description: Truck Raid is a retro-style racing game that will take you back to the glory days of 90s racing games. With its vibrant graphics and fast-paced gameplay, Truck Raid captures the spirit of classic racing games while bringing new twists to the genre.

title: Before You Depart
description: Before You Depart is a slice-of-death visual novel made for the May Wolf Visual Novel Game Jam. Canines are often companions for life. Some can even be companions in death...

title: Micro Madness
description: Micro Madness is a arcade styled racing game. You take control of RC Cars racing inside house. Players can unlock more cars and tracks by earning Stars/Secrets.

title: Terminal 64
description:
Mario has retired from plumbing. He begins his epic trek into the desert.

Reflecting on his past, he stumbles upon Sparrot's Tavern and takes a dip.

You don't want to know what happens next...

title: Nedetskie Skazki
description: Nedetskie Skazki (Unchildish Tales) is a 2D point-and-click adventure game set in a world of Russian fairy tales.

title: Wario Date
description: A dating sim where you play as Wario to scam some chumps (including Mario, Luigi, Waluigi and Bowser) out of all their money by making them fall in love with you. Of course, if you should fall for them, you can choose to give in to your romantic desires as well.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Dimension Shellshock
description: Chaos! The Neutrinos crash the Turtles’ latest pizza party! The teenagers from Dimension X are in dire need of help: Shredder is seeking to conquer the multiverse itself!

title: South of Midnight
description: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Explore the mythos and confront mysterious creatures of the Deep South in this modern folktale while learning to weave an ancient power to surmount obstacles and face the pain haunting your hometown.

title: Star Wars Outlaws
description: Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars game, set between the events of The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. Explore distinct planets across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as Kay Vess, an emerging scoundrel seeking freedom and the means to start a new life, along with her companion Nix. Fight, steal, and outwit your way through the galaxy’s crime syndicates as you join the galaxy’s most wanted.

title: 33 Immortals
description: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Play a damned soul, and rebel against God’s final judgment. Pick-up and raid, cooperate to survive hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and face the wrath of God in a fight for your eternal life.

title: Sea of Thieves: The Legend of Monkey Island
description:
Split across three hilarious Tall Tales packed with secrets and side-quests, Sea of Thieves: The Legend of Monkey Island invites pirates to meet classic characters, in a new narrative that brings the iconic locations of Monkey Island to the Sea of Thieves.

The adventure begins on Mêlée Island, where pirates can take in the sights, smells and roguish splendour of the island as they seek to uncover why everyone suddenly seems to think quite highly of self-proclaimed mighty pirate, and known poodle pacifier, Guybrush Threepwood. Something's quite clearly wrong...

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
description: Pursue your dream of an aviation career with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. This brand-new simulator is designed to take advantage of the latest technologies in simulation, cloud, machine learning, graphics and gaming to create the most sophisticated, immersive and awe-inspiring flight simulator of all time. To achieve this unprecedented level of accuracy, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is powered by the significantly evolved Asobo Studio engine.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator: Dune
description: In partnership with Legendary and Warner Bros. Entertainment, Microsoft Flight Simulator has created an authentically detailed House Atreides Ornithopter. Master the complex controls of one of the most dynamic aircraft ever conceived as you pilot your ornithopter through awe-inspiring locations across the mysterious desert planet of Arrakis.

title: Fallout 76: Atlantic City
description:
Go on a post-apocalyptic getaway in Fallout 76’s Atlantic City Expedition and go on a daring heist for rewards in Season 15: The Big Score

Deemed a “low priority target” when the Great War broke out, Atlantic City is now a premier destination of the wasteland, offering thrilling entertainment, scenic coastal views and even running electricity! Players can now venture out to Atlantic City to complete two new Expedition missions that will get them properly acquainted with the local populace.

Encourage some unsavory business with The Family, Atlantic City’s resident mob, while they try stay off the radar of the Municipal Government keeping the lights on (both literally and figuratively.) Meanwhile, the guild running the city’s entertainment known as The Showmen have a daring gauntlet with glory and riches awaiting those brave (or possibly foolish) enough to enter!

You’ll want to pack more than a spare change of clothes for your trip to Atlantic City, however. Beyond the New Jersey Pine Barrens lie the mutated Overgrown – irradiated, plant-like beasts from deep within the woods encroaching on Atlantic City’s borders. Also keep an eye out for some ferocious lil’ devils spotted in the area – Appalachia isn’t the only place with cryptid spottings, y’know.

title: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess
description: Fend off foul creatures and lead the Spirit Stone Maiden on her path. Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess is a brand new title which upholds Capcom's legacy of original and innovative works. This labor of love follows in the tradition of truly unique titles such as Okami and Shinsekai – Into The Depths. Explore an incredible world in which traditional Japanese aesthetics are brought to stunning life by the power of RE Engine. Enjoy a unique gameplay experience blending action and strategy. Witness an epic clash between the spirit realm and mortal man.

title: Jusant
description: Enjoy meditative vibes in Jusant, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower's past.

title: Still Wakes the Deep
description: 1975. Disaster strikes the Beira D oil rig off the coast of Scotland. Navigate the collapsing rig to save your crew from an otherworldly horror on the edge of all logic and reality.

title: Towerborne
description: The Belfry stands as a beacon of hope and safety amongst the ruins of humanity and the City of Numbers, with monsters lurking right outside the tower’s walls. You are an Ace, born anew from the spirit realm with the skills, the grit, and the determination to protect the people of the Belfry.

title: Clockwork Revolution
description: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

title: Ultimate Apocalypse
description: Ultimate Apocalypse is a mod for Warhammer 40,000 Dawn of War: Soulstorm that increases the amount of playable factions and adds numerous units for each of the factions while also increasing the scale of the game.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 6 - Invasion
description: Introducing Overwatch 2: Invasion, an all-new adventure and the biggest content drop to date! Immerse yourself in the highly anticipated Story Missions, play as a new Support hero, hone your skills with Hero Mastery Missions, take aim at the Firing Range, and group up with friends in an all new Co-op experience.

title: Typing of Ys
description: The Ys Typing Tutor game is a normally hidden mini-game included with the full Zwei!! PC game that can be unlocked provided certain conditions are met. It is based mostly around Ys II Complete, both in sprites and text related material.

title: Diesel Legacy: The Brazen Age
description: Diesel Legacy is a 2v2 fighting game where four players battle on the same stage at the same time. This unique twist on the traditional fighting game formula adds an entirely new layer of strategy where cooperation will become the key to success. The fate of the city is in your hands!

title: Sand: Raiders Of Sophie
description: In an alternate 1910, scavenge the sands of Sophie in towering Tramplers. Build your highly customizable walking base. Squad up or go solo. Gather loot, weapons, precious artifacts. Clash with other players in a brutal procedurally generated desert forged by history and chaos.

title: Kill it with Fire 2
description: Arachnophobia. The Game. The Sequel. Travel across the multiverse and exterminate every. last. spider. The world's funniest spider murdering is back with advancements in cutting-edge sci-fi tech to hunt down the arachnid menace once and for all.

title: Teardown: Creative Mode
description: Teardown, the fully destructible sandbox heist game is adding a creative mode, so not only can you knock stuff down you can now build things up. Create models and objects in-game and save them to use in future sessions by "painting" with voxels.

title: Stampede Racing Royale
description: Welcome to the wildest kart racing event ever devised, where 60 players go bumper-to-bumper on outrageous circuits filled with power-ups. Avoid elimination and fight your way to the front of the herd in the scramble to be crowned champion!

title: Naheulbeuk's Dungeon Master
description: Build, Manage & defend your dungeon in this satirical heroic fantasy universe of Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. From a shaky establishement to an infamous lair

title: Mariachi Legends
description: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

title: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
description: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector is a narrative-driven science-fiction RPG in which players take on the role of a Sleeper, an artificial human. Using a tabletop-inspired dice system, players manage resources, make difficult choices, and build relationships while seeking a new life among the settlements of the Starward Belt. Expanding on the original game, the sequel introduces a customizable ship, recruitable crew members, and high-risk contracts that require planning and adaptation. Player choices, character classes, and skill-based interactions shape both the story and the path forward.

title: Dread Pilots
description: Dread Pilots is a space survival game where you explore a mysterious and hostile pocket universe called the Dread. Scavenge resources, upgrade your ship, make friends, and fight monsters as you try to carve out a little piece of the Dread for yourself.

title: Undead Inc.
description: Undead Inc. is a high-risk, high-reward resource management simulator where you establish and manage a local subsidiary of the Endswell Medical Corporation. Build, manage staff, conduct research, and trade in both cutting edge medical treatments and bleeding edge bioweapons.

title: Altered Alma
description: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

title: Invector: Rhythm Galaxy
description: Navigate breathtaking, celestial worlds while mastering the beat of chart-topping hits from today’s most popular artists, including PinkPantheress, Charlie Puth, Duran Duran, and more. Discover fresh new music from tomorrow’s biggest stars on a cosmic trip where every note guides your way.

title: Pathfinder: Gallowspire Survivors
description: A new roguelite survivor game set in the beloved fantasy world of Pathfinder. Enter Gallowspire, Pathfinder’s legendary tower of darkness, alongside your fearless companion. Slay hordes of enemies, upgrade your arsenal, and overcome deadly bosses to seal away the ancient king of undeath!

title: Parcel Corps
description: Ditch the 9-5 and embrace the high octane life of a freelance bicycle messenger! Forget the job security, stable salary, and basic workplace rights less cool jobs offer while you ride along walls, grind rails, and startle pigeons on your way to corporation-toppling domination.

title: Exo Rally Championship
description: Exo Rally Championship is the galaxy’s most dangerous off-road racing event - remote, unexplored, extreme exoplanetary rally. Master a brutally realistic racing simulation and fight for every second gained on your quest to become a champion.

title: Hell Let Loose: Devotion to Duty
description: A historical multiplayer FPS Hell Let Loose shares the Objective mode in its Devotion to Duty update. This shorter and faster game mode will feature smaller teams of just 25 players.

title: Vampire Survivors: 1.5
description: This update introduces a bit of new content to the game: the stage Astral Stair, an area of endless corridors and flying paintings. It also includes a spinning wheel that can introduce random elements to the run – and if you're in streamer mode, your Twitch chat can vote to influence its outcome. There are also three new relics, a new pickup called GoldFinger, and a new form for the existing character Yatta Cavallo, which also allows you to evolve their Cherry Bomb ability into a new attack.

title: TerraTech Worlds
description: TerraTech Worlds is an open-world, PvE survival game set on distant alien planets. Build, explore and craft—solo or via online co-op—to harness the power of uncharted worlds. Discover untold wonders, conquer natural hazards, establish epic bases and battle enemies as you build your way to victory!

title: Earthless
description: Earthless is a complete 32-level megawad by James Paddock (Jimmy), with skies and sprites made by Fuzzball and a guest map by Jark. It is the spiritual successor to Deathless.

title: Nova Roma
description: The glory of Rome is at your fingertips in this city-building game where you must appease the gods, enact laws, and develop complex supply chains to meet the needs of your citizens.

title: Breathedge 2
description: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

title: Bloomtown: A Different Story
description: Bloomtown: A Different Story is a narrative JRPG mixing turn-based combat, monster taming and social RPG set in a seemingly pleasant 1960s Americana world. Join Emily and her group of friends to save their cozy town from the demonic creatures that live in the hearts of its residents!

title: A.I.L.A
description: A.I.L.A. is a first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. Play as the sole game tester for a revolutionary new fictional AI. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur…

title: Looks Good
description: "Looks Good!" is a casual game with various art styles and gameplay including organizing, storing, arranging, puzzles and other content. Each book in the game has a theme, and players need to stack and arrange the scattered objects in the book.

title: Pretty Dreadful: Heritage
description: Re:do left his quiet life in a village to pursue his career dreams in a big city. However, time passed and after graduation the guy found himself lonely and lost, not knowing what to do with his life. And that's when Re:do's past came after him and called him back…

title: Elzzup
description: In Elzzup, your goal isn't to assemble a puzzle, but rather to disassemble it. The variety of tiles and increasingly complex interactions between them might make this task more complex than you think!

title: Cat and Ladder Climb
description: Cat and Ladder Climb is a 2D pixel vertical scrolling action game. Jump over scaffolding, use "ladders", and aim for the top goal!There are various modes such as Default mode aiming for the top, Endless mode competing to see how high you can climb, and offline PvP mode!

title: Payday 3: Gold Edition
description:
Gold Edition Pre-Order includes:
Main Game
Play Early (3 Days)
Pre-order bonus
SEASON PASS (12 months)
Dark Sterling mask
Skull of Liberty Mask
Gold Slate Gloves

title: Payday 2: Silk Road Collection
