description: The Payday 2: Silk Road Collection takes the Payday Gang on a wild ride across Mexico. Includes 14 DLCs.

title: Payday 2: Gage Mod Courier
description: The Gage Mod Courier DLC is the sixth DLC for Payday 2. It allows players to act as a courier for Gage the arms dealer, picking up packages containing mods that are scattered all over D.C.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged - Deluxe Edition
description: Turbocharged - Deluxe Edition and get the full game, Season Pass Vol. 1, and 4 vehicles!

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged - Legendary Edition
description: Turbocharged - Legendary Edition and get the full game, Season Pass Vol. 1 and Vol. 2, and 8 vehicles.

title: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition brings together all five ground-breaking episodes of The Expanse: A Telltale Series along with Telltale's bonus episode “Archangel".

“Archangel" is a brand new chapter in the saga and sees Shohreh Aghdashlooyou returning as fan-favorite Chrisjen Avasarala, a canny operator who must out-maneuver political adversaries and deal with personal emotions while fighting to protect the planet during her early career as Under-Secretary for Peace Operations, an organization formed to defend earth from impending danger.

title: DokiDoki Academy
description: Love Story at the Academy.

title: Codename Madruga
description: A fan game featuring Seu Madruga (Don Ramón) from Chaves (El Chavo).

title: Highway Crossing Madruga
description: An fan game featuring Don Ramón from Chavo, with a Frogger clone gameplay.

title: Madruga From Mars
description: An unofficial space shooter featuring Don Ramón from El Chavo.

title: Madruga Goes Home
description: An unofficial platform game featuring Don Ramón from El Chavo.

title: Madrugacraft
description: An unofficial Warcraft clone featuring Don Ramón from El Chavo.

title: Chapolim & Super Sam: a lenda dos super heróis
description: An unofficial overhead arcade shooter featuring El Chapulín and Super Sam.

title: Chaves Arena
description: A simple unofficial 3D graphics fighting game featuring characters from El Chavo. It has only two characters (Chavo and Don Ramón) and two stages. It is considered as an evolution of the previous game Street Chaves.

title: Pac-Chaves
description: A Pac-Man clone featuring characters from El Chavo.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Better Sages Mod
description: A mod which changes the appearance and behavior of the Sages companions in the game, making them stronger and faster, removing their cooldown and making their appearance the same as their original Secret Stone holders.

title: Mearcair/System Pulse
description: Dive into System Pulse, a rhythm-fueled roguelike bullet heaven where you must outmaneuver swarms of robots moving while attacking to the beat. Unleash your reflexes, survive rhythmic encounters, and master the symphony of chaos in this electrifying action game.

title: PersoNO 0
description:
PersoNO 0 is a full-length original parody of Persona 3, and a sequel/prequel to the original (and kinda crappy) PersoNO, that centralizes the themes of death and moving on after loss... or maybe it just centralizes an apathetic, tender man with one eye trying to get some alone time with his robot girlfriend.

Step into the shoes of renameable protagonist Chungus Munshin--your ordinary 17 year old boy with dead parents, one eye, blue hair and seemingly no emotions. Life finally seems like it's looking up for Chungus as he transfers to Gekkoukan High School, and even receives a personal invitation to stay at the Iwatodai Dorm. He even makes some interesting new friends who are eager to pretend like they don't know him!

However, after an unfortunate incident involving a large blob monster and a gun, Chungus learns that he's had a hidden talent all along: calling forth a vuvuzela-wielding Persona by the name of Orpheus by shooting himself in the head! After this little stunt, Chungus accidentally ends up leading the group known as SEES in their battles against the entities known as Shadows as they fight to find a way to end the Dark Hour with a reasonably low body count.

title: PersoNO
description:
Per-so-NO is a dumb original parody of Persona 4, about lies, betrayal and mystery...

...Or maybe just an idiot with no eyes and his group of friends who for the most part are either scared of him or hate him.

Located in the glorious nation of Dubbed Japan, the small town of Inaba is suddenly struck with a terrible incident... the arrival of Useless Narukami, who can be easily identified by his constant wearing of sunglasses. To most people, he appears to be a massively unlikable weirdo with a libido big enough to crush continents, but in reality, he is a massively unlikable weirdo with a libido big enough to crush continents WITH THE HEART OF GOLD KIND OF. He moved from the city to the rural town due to very vague reasons involving his parents' jobs. How a job they are doing could require their child to have to live with his uncle in a small town for exactly a year before moving back is better left out of the question. But, soon after arriving, it all goes to bad when after the mysterious death of a woman in the town, Useless discovers he has the ability to stick his hand into his TV! At first it only appears to be a neat party trick, but after a foreplay joke or two, him and his newly found "friends" end up discovering a world that can only be accessed through entering a TV! Long story short, being that Useless is a special snowflake, he ends up with a massive dude with a flat cap and lead pipe living inside of his mind, the voice in his head called it a "Purse Owner" or something, and now with this power, him and his greatest buddies must venture into the TV World and slay shadows (copyright free .pngs with masks on) to learn the truth behind the mysterious murders going on in Inaba.

title: Battle Snails
description: Create a snail and join the battle. Take control of the backyard with Battle Snails! Climb walls, hang upside down and move anywhere. Team up with your friends for a tank game unlike any other!

title: Witches X Warlocks: Lawrence's Route
description:
This optional DLC comes with 40+ mini CG illustrations, one additional romance route (Lawrence) and 5 additional CGs in stunning HD.

Time to enhance the game with these eye candies and have a spooktacular Halloween with Witches x Warlocks!

title: Sweepers Mine
description: Sweepers Mine is a standard minesweeper game, featuring different difficulty modes: Classic, Easy, Medium, Expert, Custom.

title: Break Them All
description: The game type is A Roguelite barrage shooting game, Choose different upgrades after each level, and each upgrade can be integrated to form a unique gameplay. Every game is a brand-new experience. After each customs clearance, the difficulty increases and the playability is enhanced.

title: Debug Quest
description: Debug Quest is a single-player game on an adventure to heal a bugged game world. Use blocks, items, and plugins to heal the game world and complete missions! Explore the map and connect the road with blocks!

title: BossHunter VR
description: BossHunter VR is the first version of the game where players will have to fight many interesting opponents, use multiple weapons, and a unique mechanic of its kind where the player directly commands a weapon to execute something with the help of speech. The hunt is on!

title: VRC PRO: Pattaya 2 Offroad Track
description: Pattaya 2, the 2nd version of the famous Thai off-road track! A new challenging lay-out to test your r/c offroad racing skills!

title: Quebec Mortis
description: Quebec Mortis is a retro-styled survival horror game. It has elements from the modern survival horror games but in a NES-era fashion. It is packed with puzzles, action and a creepy atmosphere. Complete it in one evening!

title: Demon Subduing Master
description: A horizontal version of casual adventure and decompression action game, where players will play a Taoist who subdues demons and eliminates them, kills the demon king, obtains the demon king's inner elixir, and strengthens their own strength.

title: Pure Sniper
description: Hunt your target & become a strong PVP sniper in this Epic 3D sniper FPS game.Pure Sniper is an exciting and realistic sniper shooting game with a massive campaign mode that can be played offline and a realtime multiplayer PvP combat mode.

title: Shards of Her
description: Embark in a world of magic, where once mighty gods reigned supreme, but now are hunted and on the brink of oblivion. Can you save your love amidst a world consumed by lust and betrayal?

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Wicked Warfare
description: 3 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Wild Western themed tables with a 50's and 60's style pinball inspiration.

title: Floppy Cat Bow Golf!
description: Golf, but you use a bow and launch yourself at the target, Also you're a cat.

title: Slippery Sammy
description: Slippery Sammy is an arcade game where you help Sammy to walk as further as possible in a snowy afternoon, trying not to slip so much on the freezing sidewalk.

title: Mixed Unit Tactics
description: Mixed Unit Tactics is a medieval turn based strategy where you control a growing army. Command your units well to take advantage of their unique strengths as you push through hostile forces to reclaim your home castle.

title: Bana Simulator
description:
A hilarious bullet hell adventure where a Bana (sentient banana) goes on a quest with his friends to defeat the tyrant Shadow Bana and save the world!
Travel the world to collect treasures, build new weapons, vanquish numerous bosses, and more!

title: Just Dance 2024 Edition
description: Dance and share exciting moments all year long with the #1 music video game platform of all time! Just Dance 2024 Edition features 40 new tracks and universes from all genres and eras, including “Flowers” by Miley Cyrus, “Tití Me Preguntó” by Bad Bunny, “How You Like That” by BLACKPINK and "I Wanna Dance With Somebody" by Whitney Houston!

title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown - Deluxe Edition
description:
Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown is a 2.5D action-adventure platformer. It follows Sargon, a warrior searching for a kidnapped prince in the cursed city of Mount Qaf. The game features acrobatic platforming, time-based powers, and a Metroidvania-style world.

The Deluxe Edition features the Immortal Outfit for the protagonist Sargon, the Prosperity Bird Amulet, and a Digital Adventure Guide to assist players in their journey. Purchasers of the Deluxe Edition also received three-day early access to the game.

title: Mega Man X Dive Offline
description:
The newest entry in the hit action series Mega Man X makes its way to Steam and smartphones! Strengthen your characters and weapons with a variety of powerups to make them all your own. Then test them out in the side-scrolling action of "what-if" worlds in Mega Man X!

This product is the offline version of Mega Man X DiVE. Online features such as Battle Mode, Co-op, Ranking, Guild, and Capsule are not included. Collaboration contents such as characters and stages from other Capcom franchises are not available in the game.

title: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy
description:
Court is back in session with Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy!
Featuring three games - Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies, and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Spirit of Justice - join Apollo Justice on his journey to bring order to the courts and bring an end to the dark age of the law!

title: Final Goal
description: This game attempts to provide you with an immersive experience of storytelling and diversity while playing, and has explored some new gameplay methods.

title: Medical Record Sheet
description: The game is a single-player combat roguelike in which you play the role of a doctor who chooses various medical records to treat, and then controls various human immune guards, equipped with a variety of core weapons to enter various areas of the human body to fight against a variety of pathogens.

title: Super World Run: Bosses
description: Can you rescue the princess?

title: Loop Kingdom
description: Loop Kingdom is a game focused on selling veteran fighters and hiring new ones.... while improving your market and keep searching for that legendary fighter that will take you to floor 200 or 400....

title: Sunya
description: An enchanting pixel art platformer that embarks you on a quest to find and wield the immense powers of the four elements: air, earth, water, and fire. Players are granted the ability to transform into different elemental forms at will, enabling them to adapt to and overcome intricate obstacles.

title: Wind and Mist
description: Wind and Mist "is a 3D free flying fairyland, role-playing real-time combat adventure game.The film level image quality brings a visual feast of national style. Come and enjoy this quiet time of cultivating immortals!

title: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney
description: Apollo Justice is the first game in the series that does not feature Phoenix Wright as the main protagonist, though it is not the first time a different attorney has been playable. The game is set in the year 2026, which is seven years after Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trials and Tribulations. Phoenix Wright has been stripped of his attorney's badge, and Apollo Justice, an up-and-coming attorney, becomes his apprentice.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies
description: Eight years since he last stepped into the courtroom, Phoenix Wright makes his triumphant return in Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies! When an explosion rocks the courts, it’s up to the Wright Anything Agency to bring the hammer of justice down on those responsible in an adventure filled with all the swerves, shenanigans and stepladders that the Ace Attorney series is known for.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Spirit of Justice
description:
Court is back in session with Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy!
Featuring three games - Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies, and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Spirit of Justice - join Apollo Justice on his journey to bring order to the courts and bring an end to the dark age of the law!

title: VR Cops
description: In VR Cops you can customize your guns with various attachments and accessories, and feel the realistic physics and recoil as well as different handling for each gun. You will also be immersed in a gripping story of a young cop.

title: Katanirvana
description:
The year is 2057. Society has digressed to corporate feudalism.

Enter Tris, an ex-mercenary on a vengeance mission to kill the Tech-Baron who ruined her life. Master her cyberkatana to mow down enemies, utilize powerful drugs to augment her capabilities, and progress through the Zen battle system to kill the Baron in this dark cyberpunk revenge story.

title: With All My Heart
description:
This is a wee interactive experience made back in 2013 in Flash (R.I.P.) using Actionscript 3/appropriated sprites/sounds and vocal synth via UTAU. It was inspired by my memories as a lil kid playing the Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening on the Gameboy - specifically, Marin singing the Ballad of the Windfish in the village square.

<3

title: Beat Banger
description: Beat Banger is a mature furry rhythm game. You are the lone protagonist in a rags-to-bitches story. Work your way to the top of Beat Banger Studios, a small and rhythmic porn production company in desperate need of assistance. You apply for a simple production job, but the CEO has another position in mind for you. Jump in now. You won't want to miss a beat.

title: Gavril
description: A short horror VN that's more satirical than scary. Your goal is to survive an encounter with a home intruder with characteristics beyond your comprehension.

title: Space Pirate
description: Space Pirate is a rogue-lite, time-survival space game with active and minimalistic gameplay.

title: Spreen Game
description: Spreen (twitch streamer) leaves his house to buy an Spreen x Speed energy drink but he will face with a lot mobs, he will pass them succesfully?

title: |][-@I7 in vitro #Dead in Vitro
description: "|][-@I7 in vitro #Dead in vitro" is a vertical scrolling bullet hell shooter developed by Cupro Laboratory. Control "Ferrum" a boy who was newly born as a zombie in a certain laboratory, and confront powerful enemies.

title: Just Dance 2024 Edition: Limited Edition
description: Pre-order the Limited Edition at your retailer to get exclusive additional digital content, including customization items for your Dancer Card, a Victory Celebration, and more!

title: My Time at Sandrock: Collector's Edition
description: Pre-order the Collector's Edition of My Time at Sandrock, which includes the digital PC game, a &quotPensky&quot plush toy, a wooden workshop to assemble, a 40-page comic book &quotA Logan Story,&quot two wooden Standees of Logan and Nia, a Builder's License, and additional digital content!

title: Payday 3: Collector's Edition
description:
Payday 3: Collector's Edition includes:

Base Game
The Collector's Mask
Custom Deck of Cards
Stickers
Membership Letter to the Collector's Club
Gold Season Pass

title: Jumanji: Wild Adventures
description:
Explore Jumanji’s lost world of dangerous beasts and secret treasures.

Drop into the dangerous game world of Jumanji and start a thrilling adventure, as you search for the stolen jewel, The Jaguar’s Eye, and a way home!

Choose your avatar from heroes Smolder Bravestone, Ruby Roundhouse, Mouse Finbar, and Shelly Oberon, and explore uncharted territories home to fierce predators, warring factions and devious traps that can sweep you off your feet.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Ultimate Edition
description:
Ultimate Edition includes the game, Year 1 Pass, Fitted Ultimate Pack, and up to three days of early access to the game!

Pre-purchase to get the Liberty Walk Pack, including the Toyota GR Supra 2021 LBWK Edition.

Welcome to Motorfest, the ultimate driving experience! Explore the vibrant open world of O'ahu in Hawaii as you compete in intense races, themed events, and much more!

title: Cyber Hunters
description: Try your skills and have fun with our amazing bundle of two action games.

title: That's a Cow: Definitive Edition
description:
Soar through the air and don't get milked in this cute game.
Jet udders

You are an animal rocket. Launch yourself and don't get shot down.

New goodies every hour

Play with the claw machine every hour, or after flying through enough levels. Get a new look for the cow with different headgear or projectiles.

Fly and shoot

title: Turtle WoW: Mysteries of Azeroth
description: A fanmade story expansion inspired by the Warcraft universe of Blizzard Entertainment and developed by the Turtle WoW Team. This expansion aims to take a different path from the Burning Crusade, emphasizing the familiar Azeroth of Vanilla WoW over the cosmic battle with the Burning Legion. While being heavily based on the lore from Warcraft 3 and Vanilla WoW, Mysteries of Azeroth seeks to enhance the game by adding content that matches the already well-established lore of Warcraft Universe.

title: The Third Wish
description: The Third Wish is a sci-fi point & click adventure about a family and fate and consequence. Full voice acting.

title: Math & Topology
description: A puzzle that challenges both the topological and mathematical skills of the player. Draw lines, use operator tiles to produce new numbers, and complete levels with square- and hexagon-shaped tiles!

title: Spider
description: A platform game

title: DanSparkling
description: Music/Rhythm/Dance game play with just one PC camera. Of course, you can also use your phone camera.

title: Gigachad Survivals
description: Kill lots of rocking enemies and survive to the end of your gym workout! Gigachad Survivals is a casual game with an emphasis on humor and memes with elements of a simplistic RPG. Here, every decision you make can cause an avalanche of consequences for the hordes of enemies you have to fight!

title: Run On
description: The goal of this game is for the player to reach the goal while avoiding obstacles. Throughout the game, various obstacles appear, and the player's agility and strategic judgment play a crucial role. The game becomes easier for a limited amount of time whenever you obtain certain randomly generated items. Items provide various functions such as , jetpack, speed-up, etc., enhancing the excitement of the game

title: High on Life: High on Knife
description: High on Knife is set two years after the ending of the main game, where you and your talking weapons go on an adventure because Knifey received a package from home.

title: Wing Queen
description: Wing Queen is a 2D platformer, cardgame with metroidvania elements , In Wing Queen you will be able to build a deck and choose the combination of skills you prefer, obtain resources, fight against enemies and bosses.

title: Bowling for Apples: A Special Apples to Ashes Episode
description: Short non-canon episode of "Apples to Ashes"

title: A Bit Tied Up
description:
A hero's journey isn't one of constant victory; Thalius knows that extremely well. But he's never down for the count for long. Whenever he's captured by his arch-nemesis Xinali, he's able to use his wiles to piece together clues from the villainous mage's evil monologues in order to get back on his feet.

Except...Thalius didn't get much sleep last night. So when he wakes up with his arms bound to a dungeon wall at the very end of the speech with a menacing silhouette walking away from him, he's kind of at a loss.

title: A Bro's Desire
description:
In this short adventure, Gael navigates through the COVID-filled streets to satisfy a bro's desires. Watch as he suffers in the name of pure friendship (and unrequited feelings?)!

A remake of the 2020 Version, which was made for the Extra Credits Game Jam #6.

title: Everhood 2
description: An unconventional arpg where you battle enemies through musical encounters while being accompanied by a Raven who promises you to retrieve your voice if you slay the mighty Mind Dragon!

title: Nexomon 3
description: The upcoming third entry in the Nexomon series, featuring a large, story-rich 3D open world and a new battle system.

title: Go Mecha Ball
description: Go Mecha Ball is an acrobatic action roguelite where you shoot, roll and boost your way through a futuristic wonderland in pursuit of an ever more glitched-out rogue AI. Augment your ball mechs using an increasingly ludicrous arsenal of weapons, abilities and upgrades to shut the glitch portals!

title: LEGO My Style: Preschool
description: LEGO My Style: Preschool is an educational game for children aged 2-4 starring the animal characters from LEGO's Duplo line of toys. There are four learning environments - math, art, music, and language - which players can visit to learn the basics of the aforementioned principles by playing simple mini-games.

title: Drag Her!
description: Drag Her! is a fast, frenetic, and fundamentally fabulous fighting game featuring drag royalty. With a cast of iconic characters from the Drag Race & Dragula universes, Drag Her! gives you the core fighting game fantasy, with an experience that is equal parts stupid and fun.

title: Tiny Terry's Turbo Trip
description: Terry wants to become instantly famous by launching himself into space using his new car. Doing something this cool and reckless will surely make him the talk of the town.

title: Fallout 76: Once in a Blue Moon
description: The Blue Moon rises over the hills of Appalachia, bringing forth new Cryptids to threaten the mercantile progress of the Blue Ridge Caravan Company. Defend their Brahmin herds and trade routes from crazed Cultists and monstrous creatures in two new Public Events and side quests, plus face enemies infected with a deadly new Daily Ops mutation for a chance to earn new rewards!

title: Hi-Fi Rush: Arcade Challenge
description: This Hi-Fi Rush Arcade Challenge Update adds two new challenge modes to the game. The two new modes are BPM Rush and Power Up Tower Up, each with their own challenges and rewards to unlock.

title: Hauntsfield
description: Hauntsfield is a short Halloween RPG designed for Game Boy. Play time is about 40-60 minutes. The game has spooky themes, but isn't scary and is appropriate for kids & adults alike.

title: RollerGirl
description: A narrative adventure about a summer spent rollerblading in the mid-2000s. Explore a quiet town as Naomi, a teenage girl looking for an escape. Your in-game MP3 player isn't just for music; its playlist shapes the world & story as you run errands for quirky neighbours / get entangled in local drama.

title: Dead by Daylight: End Transmission
description: Dead by Daylight’s End Transmission Chapter features a new Killer – The Singularity – and a new Survivor, Gabriel Soma. A new Map, Toba Landing, is available for all players. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Singularity’s Curved Scythe and Gabriel’s Illuminated Shirt.

title: Magic or Machinations
description: Design your own character and choose their personality with a dialogue between you and a sentient AI drone in the middle of space. Then wake up in an open-world desert and try to find your way home by discovering new abilities and using them to cross time and space.

title: The Sims 4: Horse Ranch
description: Work hard and play hard with animal friends and your own stretch of land in The Sims 4 Horse Ranch Expansion Pack.

title: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia: The Rise of Evil
description: Embark on a new adventure and delve deeper into the lands of Nostalgaia. Go where nostalgia, tradition, and progress converge, awaiting your heroism to mould the landscape anew. Stand against the onslaught of mighty new adversaries and forge your legacy as a harbinger of change.

title: Bayoen Wars: Daimadou Senryaku Monogatari
description: Released in Vol 5, Daimadou Senryaku Monogatari is a turn-based strategy game.

title: Artificer's Tower
description: Are you the master of the magical arts? Prove it in this new colony-sim wizard tower defense game. Build your base, keep your mages happy, craft recipes, research new magics, and defend your wizard's keep. Will your Artificer's Tower be the envy of all your magical friends?

title: This Is Crying
description: Traverse distorted memories.

title: Monster Mop Up
description: Rescue the scared little Ragamuffins from the human world- and clean up all evidence of their existence. Mop stains, burn poop, and get rewarded with high tech gear and upgrades. Save enough, and you can even expand your home, decorate it, and live happily ever after with your fluffy little friends!

title: Tales Up
description:
Tales Up is a cooperative role-playing game, a blend of board game and interactive stories such as “choose your own adventure” books.

You’ll find zombies, pirates, vikings… Hijinks and surprises will ensue!

title: As usual.
description:
"Today, as usual."

This is a linear atmospheric game.
There are no loud scares, so please use headphones!
Some grotesque imagery is present, if it's not to your liking please refrain from playing.

title: White Hearts
description: White Hearts is a Ren'Py visual novel set at the Ecole Lyceé Saint Louis de Gonzague, prestigious university in Paris, where Rosaire is the only male student. Players holding a White Hearts NFT have access to the game via the token gated website.

title: Construction Simulator: Airfield Expansion
description: With the Construction Simulator: Airfield Expansion, fans of heavy construction machines can look forward to the most extensive expansion for Construction Simulator to date. The DLC opens up access to a new construction campaign on each of the game's two maps, so you will get the exciting opportunity to build a new airfield for the respective region. Within these huge campaigns, it’s not only a matter of preparing, levelling and asphalting the runways - of course, the control towers, terminals and hangars have to be built too!

title: Chojiro
description:
"The wandering ronin.
Night breeze carries the scent of burnt horse flesh to his nostrils.
He follows it through the weeds, and comes across a village ablaze.
What horrors unfurled here...?"
This is a small horror game on itch.io made for a game jam. Gives ps1 vibes with its visuals.

title: Bandit Brawler
description: Robberies, mugging, stealing, picking pockets, and wreaking havoc in a beautiful medieval world - it all waits for you in Bandit Brawler. Follow orders from a magical rooster, pick fights with everyone around, and blow up a couple of patrols. You know, like back in the ol'days.

title: Trainwreck
description: Trainwreck is a nonlinear visual novel where your choices will have a significant impact on the story. Navigate it wisely, as their lives are in your hands.

title: Sakura Shadow Monsters
description: Challenging platform game where you control Sakura, a character with a different personality. Your mission is to rescue your girlfriend who is in the middle of a zombie apocalypse (or not) and leave the island.

title: Ragnarock: Sabaton Raid
description: This new DLC for the Rhythm game Ragnarock brings you a unique collaboration with the epic band Sabaton.

title: PalMz' Insane Warfare Mod
description: The game is pretty much the same, but sort of amplified with all the possible units implemented, 250 pop-limit and a special method to make bot send bigger forces.

title: Finger Football: Goal in Two
description: Take aim and shoot! Can you make the goal in just two shots in this relaxing and minimalist finger football puzzle game.

title: Cambrian Dawn: Biceratopsidae DLC
description: Welcome 11 brand new species from the Family Biceratopsidae into your game!

title: Castle Crafter
description: A Craft online battle game in a voxel world with many single and online game modes like deathmatch and capture the flag.

title: Puzzled Towers
description: This is a tower defense style game set in a dynamic first person world. You create the enemy path in real time. The Alpha Stage comes with a free unlocked steam achievement.

title: Hoppy Square DX
description: It's hip to be square, and no square is hipper or hoppier than a Hoppy Square!

title: Stack,Clack,Clock!
description: Stack, Clack, Clock! is a game about stacking bricks, where players build a tower one brick at a time.

title: Project Speed: Njarovik
description: Do you want to play on a new map, but on the original Project Speed game? This DLC is for you! - This DLC adds the Njarovik map from Project Speed 2 to Project Speed.

title: Grapploteer
description: A puzzle platformer about a defect robot where you grapple from wall to wall and escape the factory. Pixel art graphics and many music tracks. Head through factories, sewers, trash dumps and cities to find freedom.

title: Pine Creek: The Book of Judith
description: A cozy-thriller adventure game focused on exploration, story, and following clues. Have friends, think about life, think about death, eat tasty food, and play games in the arcade!

title: Rusty Lines Remastered
description: We'd like to introduce to you yet another re-make of a widely known "Color Lines" game which we called "Rusty Lines"

title: Theft Ride Legacy: Extended Edition
description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-packed adventure in "Theft Ride Legacy"!
Bundle includes an "Extra Mission Pack" !

title: Rice Bowl Restaurant
description: Challenge yourself to serve the best Mixed Indonesian Rice dish and make your customers happy

title: Gramik Paint Roller
description: Can you win this challenge?

title: Arcade Archives: Megablast
description: Feast on a four-way firing frenzy!!

title: Mountain Climb Driver
description: Break into extreme racing - go through a high-speed hill climb, complete the race and become the "King of the Hill"!

title: Medieval Royal Chess: Classic Board Game
description: Chess is a very old and very popular board game for logic and mind in the style of the Middle Ages!

title: Sentimental Death Loop
description: Just as you begin to settle in for a fun day at your best friend's house, something changes in her and she kills you. And not just once—she ends your life time and time and time again. Your goal is to escape from this endless loop of despair.

title: Ordinary Rooms
description:
You are Joey, a very curious person who likes to explore the abandoned places. This time, you read the newspaper about the abandoned facility and decided to go there to explore.

Game inspired from Roblox Rooms.

Menu music by chromestones

title: Violet Storm
description: Neon space shooter arcade.

title: Scavenger Hunt: Switzerland
description:
In Scavenger Hunt: Switzerland you have to solve various puzzles to reach the goal. The puzzles lead you across Switzerland in different levels.
To master the levels and the puzzles you need internet access and a web browser!
The game will be available in English and German.

title: Crusader Kings II: Ruler Designer
description:
The Ruler Designer is a minor DLC for Crusader Kings II.

It allows the player to create a ruler with customized:
- coat of arms,
- dynasty name,
- attributes and traits
- marital status,
- appearance,
- religion
- culture

title: Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Chapter 1 - Take Control
description: Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Chapter 1 - Take Control is the first chapter of Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy.

title: Guards II: Chaos in Hell
description: There is chaos in Hell. Drive a group of heroes through five different underworlds. Survive against tons of evil creatures in amusing turn-based combat to find and face the Devil!

title: Demon's Bane
description: Save the animal kingdom in this innovative roguelike deckbuilder. Battle enemies, unlock abilities, and customize your deck. With 10 classes, 350+ cards, and a 100 different enemies. Experience strategic card combat with a twist. No In App Purchases.

title: Elite Status: Platinum Concierge
description: Find the unfindable and do the impossible? It’s all in a day’s work for you. As a concierge, how far will you go to make billionaires’ dreams come true?

title: The Girl Who Kicked a Rabbit
description: The Girl Who Kicked a Rabbit is a tight, turn-based JRPG-lite for those who want just the meaty part. Kill cute enemies, collect loot, and build devastating new spells. Then do it all over again.

title: Monkey Math
description: Inspired by DK Jr. Math. A mathematical puzzle game to test your speed and knowledge of endless mathematical operations! Compete against your friends or compete against your personal best to improve your high score. There's monkey's, there's math, it's Monkey Math!

title: Vegangsters
description: A 2D roguelike that brings deckbuilding games to the next level! Set in a world full of crime, you will take control of a potato inspector that uses cards to arrest criminal vegetables.

title: Koi Zen: Opposite Colors
description: Immerse yourself in a vibrant and tranquil puzzle game, featuring elegant koi fish to enhance your gameplay. Take control of both the white and black pieces to paint the board with amazing colors.

title: Doozie the Unicorn
description: Doozie the Unicorn, a Gothic, Dark Fantasy, Medieval, Action, Adventure, Fairy-Tale.

title: Gate of Souls
description: I got a job as a night guard. They promise to pay a lot, but for my own safety I have to follow strange rules. As you progress, you'll have to find keys and open locked rooms. A first-person game with elements of horror. Explore the hospital and its rooms, collect batteries for your flashlight.

title: Duck Life 9: The Flock
description: Raise your ducklings into the ultimate team of racers in Duck Life 9, where everything is bigger, bolder & more beautiful than ever before! Embark on a quest as you journey across the huge Featherhaven Island, meeting new friends & taking on recruits to help topple the competition & take the crown!

title: Kenny 7
description: In the near future, machines have taken over the world. Every 5 years, new models are produced that are always more advanced. The old models are destroyed because they are considered too obsolete. Kenny_7 models whose AI has failed have risen up against the established order. You are one of them.

title: Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Chapter 2 - The Lustrous of the Universe
description: Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Chapter 2 - The Lustrous of the Universe is the second chapter of Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy.

title: Sex Hotel Simulator
description: Sex Hotel Simulator is an adult Visual novel with the mechanics of pumping a hotel . Welcome to the captivating world of "Sex Hotel Simulator," where you'll take on the role of a brothel owner and elevate it to the pinnacle of fame and success!

title: Ancient Wonders: Pharaoh's Tomb
description: The Pharaoh is dead and It's time to finalize the preparation of the Tomb. Play through more than 100 levels and earn enough gold to fully decorate the Tomb of the Pharaoh!

title: Blade and Burden
description: Blade and Burden is a rogue lite dungeon crawler where different adventurers slash, roll, and solve their way through a trick filled tower in order to reach their own goals, whether that be to save a kidnapped royal, complete a contracted hit, or just to cure their boredom.

title: Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Chapter 3 - The Final Rave
description: Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy: Chapter 3 - The Final Rave is the third and final chapter in Jorel's Brother and the Most Important Game of the Galaxy.

title: Rift Loopers: Pyro Class
description: Get access to the Pyro class and their arsenal

title: The Last Veggies
description: The Last Veggies is a 2d top-down shooter roguelite where you play as a farmer or his friends fighting hordes of monsters while trying to save humanity by delivering fresh veggies. Play different maps with different characters and an always changing set of Items and Upgrades.

title: Chronicles of Vipers
description: Chronicles of Vipers is a remake-demake first-person shooter inspired by old 8-bit and 16-bit console games, as well as VHS-era movies.

title: Last Life
description: Last Life is a breathtaking adventure game set in NeoNova, a cyberpunk city where high technology and dark secrets intertwine. Our protagonist, a cute cat controlled by players, will embark on a mysterious journey to find their lost lover.

title: WildCraft
description: Wildcraft: Embark on a Thrilling Journey of Online Survival Crafting Game that takes players on a captivating adventure in a vast and beautifully rendered 3D environment.

title: Slag
description: You are tasked with servicing Terraformer Ai cores. To do this you will have to blast your way through the automated defense system. Turn the bots you come across into slag and get what "res" you can out of them as you will need it to load out your tank with different weapon and mods systems.

title: Sold Out
description: You play as a grocery store owner with limited starting capital and the only thing you can rely on is your business acumen. You will use operations such as purchasing, hoarding, and selling to satisfy your customers, so as to earn enough profits, um, and the rent that keeps rising.

title: Plasmatic
description: Plasmatic is a virtual space in which our society has been closed with its own approval. We wake up from it unexpectedly. Our goal is to repair the main simulation core of Plasmatic. The continuation of life lived in it before will not be possible without the reparation…

title: Ground Zero
description: Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

title: Cosmic Carnage
description: Prepare for an interstellar showdown like no other in a gripping roguelite/roguelike top-down twin-stick shooter set in the vast depths of space. Pilot your advanced starship, engaging in relentless battles against hordes of alien adversaries. Destroy, Collect, Upgrade, Die, Unlock, Repeat.

title: Overlewd
description: Follow along on a journey to catch all them hotties! Overlewd is a 3v3 turn-based RPG battler for everyone to enjoy. Control battles with ultimate spells and strategic targeting keeps you on your toes. Manage your castle and increase your might following stories about your harem.

title: Arknights: Release
description:
Arknights: Release is a fan-made game based on the Arknights IP using the Ikemen Go engine.

The game has various modes to choose from, such as arcade, two-player, online multiplayer, survival, lord conquest and so on. Currently, only arcade, two-player, survival and lord conquest are released in the test version.

title: Garestia
description: Garestia is an online multiplayer battle Game with Sexual Content and Nudity.

title: Imaginary Girl: Prequel
description: The future art will be drawn by two people... Platonic love? Drawing? Adventure game?

title: Nine Paradise: The Origin
description: A Roguelike card game. In addition to hundreds of basic cards, there are also unique ways to practice martial arts and spells, and dozens of powerful magic artifacts and pets with their own characteristics, making the game more fun.

title: Sneak Out
description: A stealth-puzzle game where you play as a boy, trying to escape from his parents house to get to a party in hilarious and unique ways. Get ready to outsmart, fool and trick your parents to make the ultimate escape!

title: Delearnia: Fractions of Hope
description: Delearnia: Fractions of Hope is a thrilling puzzle adventure where action, mystery, and mathematics collide. Navigate the enchanting world of Delearnia, conquer challenges, and defeat enemies with the power of mathematics. Rediscover the fun in being a thinker. Become the Mathemagician!

title: Hidden Pass
description: Hidden Pass is a tactical turn-based RPG with base management that blends tactics with fascinating visual effects. The game sets in unique technomagic fantasy world. Plan your steps carefully while you lead an expedition to the center of a vast cluster of uncharted isles floating high in the sky.

title: Rush On
description: Fast, score-based endless runner with procedurally generated levels. Perfect for a quick, intense game whenever you got a few minutes.

title: Bucket Brawl: Ahlman Edition
description: A fast-paced arena fighter where animal toys seek to recycle each other in a world of plastic and raining buckets. Throw buckets on the heads of other players, push them off a ledge and be the last toy standing.

title: The Witch In The Woods
description: Deep in the perilous Greywind Forest reside a mysterious witch. She is rumored to be evil and dangerous. Nellie has her own reason to enter the forest. When she encounters the witch, what will happen? This is a light yuri fantasy visual novel.

title: Desolated District
description: Desolated District is an open world survival game. Loot, craft, build and fight in a post-apocalyptic dystopia, alone or with friends. Explore the dark and dangerous depths of the city while looking for a way out.

title: Soulknight Survivor
description: Soulknight Survivor is a topdown action-roguelite game. Survive the waves of enemys to unlock new areas. Level up your character and loot equipment to gain power. Craft new powerful equipment and upgrade the buildings of your hometown. Follow your way to become the Soulknight.

title: Pop and Chicks
description: Help Pop the hen rescue her chicks. Take one move at a time, and be careful where you're going.

title: Project Hardline
description: Project Hardline is a party first person shooter game where two teams fight to capture an uplink station. This uplink station contains vital intel and must not fall into the wrong hands. With every round a team faces, they will come back with better gear. This game is perfect for a party of friends.

title: Rafting Frenzy
description: It's rafting time! Rafting Frenzy is a rafting game where you're going to need both luck and skill to get a big score on either racing or free rafting modes.

title: Quatro!: This is fine DLC
description: Heat Up With the Quatro! This is fine DLC

title: Paradise Lust 2
description: Continue your adventures on Tuvatuva island in a sultry 2D point-and-click adventure where romance blooms, fish are caught, drinks are served, puzzles are solved, and passion ignites in paradise.

title: Drill Keeper
description: Drill Keeper combines roguelite deckbuilding and tower defense into a strategic battle for survival. Dig through completely destructible worlds to strip them of their riches and build an impenetrable fortress of mining.

title: Gravity Waves
description: Gravity Waves is a twin stick shoot 'em up in space with waves of enemies and realistic gravity to provide constantly changing gameplay.

title: Hexguardian
description: A Roguelite tower defense game where you can shape the terrain yourself. Build roads and rivers, construct defense towers and economic buildings, recruit units, learn spells, and defeat various enemies from land, water and air. Hundreds of unique talents and combinations await you to dig out!

title: Elemental Odyssey
description: Elemental Odyssey is 2D platformer where you need to RUN, JUMP, SLIDE, AVOID TRAPS, and don't let the game make you mad!!

title: Agents of SomeCompany
description: Unleash your speedrunning skills and complete your missions as fast as you can in this first-person parkour platformer. Speed through the low-poly world and compete with other players to prove you're SomeCompany's best agent.

title: Damned 2
description: Damned 2 is a asymmetrical multiplayer (4vs1) horror game where a group of survivors must come together to solve puzzles and escape an immersive environment while another player takes the role of a unbeatable monster ready to slay all trespassers.

title: Patou
description: When Kit finds herself all alone in a dream-like world, giant dog Patou comes along. On their journey home, strange creatures and lonely spirits await, guarding ruins of memories buried deep.

title: Aftershock: Coastline
description: Aftershock: Coastline is a thrilling retro-styled survival horror shooter inspired by the design of Resident Evil and the atmosphere of Bioshock. Spend an hour delving deep into a seaside bunker in an uncanny land, uncovering its secrets and surviving against the cosmic horrors which dwell within.

title: Eris Dysnomia
description: Eris finds herself alone in a world full of monsters with a scythe and a gun as her only means of protection. Join her on her journey as she battles her way through a swarm of enemies to reach her goal!

title: The Backrooms Origins
description: Enter the Backrooms and search for truth. Be careful in there! Because they are coming for you!

title: While Waiting My Turn
description: Discover the joy of building tiny structures with board game pieces in this relaxing game. Stack and create unique buildings. Complete optional tasks that fuel your creativity. Construct whatever you want – no puzzles to solve, no races to win.

title: Wyrmhole: The Forbidden Knowledge
description: A daemon spawned by a lab accident steals the Sacred Texts of Fauna Akademia and vanishes into the tunnels beneath. As the Head Librarian May, and with a team of laboratory researchers, conquer the tunnels and demand on time book returns.

title: Find with Seoul: Story Puzzle
description: Follow the story of clones set in post-cyberpunk dystopian Seoul while solving 3-match puzzles. Experience the change in the low-grade clone Charashi who couldn't even afford a piece of bread.

title: Chrono Crystal: Giant Gate DLC
description: Chrono Crystal is a tower defense game. Spanning across 5 major regions with the Prince and facing numerous challenges, an unprecedented great war is about to break out. Build your towers, upgrade your heroes, and defend your crystal against waves of enemies—until the countdown timer runs out!

title: Toy Shire
description: Are you prepared for a thrilling toy army tower defense adventure? Welcome The Toy Shire! Battle diverse foes in various locations, defend your family, and repel foes from your area. Save the world by strengthening your defense with toy towers!

title: Time Handlers
description: Time Handlers is a cooperative puzzle game where you play as 2 employees of the Time Company tasked to repair the spatio-temporal rifts caused by a mysterious tower. Face baffling and exciting challenges to progress through the various levels of the rift that threatens time.

title: Pongspin
description: A surreal, experimental take on Pong challenging you to protect a circular "core" using an orbiting paddle to deflect the ball.

title: Love Is All Around
description: The player becomes Gu Yi, uses the first-person perspective to immerse himself in meeting six beauties, and embarks on a joyful and sweet love journey with them. Six girls that are charming, innocent, intelligent, wild, sexy, glamorous, who will go to the end with you is up to you to decide.

title: Synergia: Sunrise
description: One year after the events of the Synergia Incident, Cila and Mara's lives have drastically changed, as have the lives of all those around them. This DLC is a small glimpse into their future outside of The Empire, and the repercussions of their actions during the main game.

title: Kill The Crows
description: "Kill The Crows" is a fast-paced top-down arena shooter set in the twisted western era. A gunslinger burning with vengeance steps into the ruins of a forsaken town, ready to face death. Prepare for one-shot, one-kill gunfights using classic revolvers and fanning techniques.

title: Living Cell
description: You are the only liquidator in block G-326 of the endless Gigakhrushchevka who survived. Now you have to find out what happened in this block, evacuate the residents and find a way out for yourself. But is everything as obvious as it seems at first glance?

title: Cat Lobster Simulator
description: Beautiful simple and cute game where you raise a Cat Lobster. Feed, play, wash and rest your cat lobster in real time. Earn gold coins in minigames, and customise the lobster's tank! If you raise your cat lobster well, it will moult its shell and evolve into an adult cat lobster.

title: Backrooms Rec.
description: Dive into the haunting Backrooms, where reality blurs and nightmares lurk. Survive, explore, and uncover dark secrets. Solo-developed, immersive, and coming soon to Steam Early Access. Shape the future. Adventure awaits!

title: GanaBlade
description: This is a hot barrage shooting game. Destroy enemy planes with powerful firepower, shuttle and evade in the barrage. Various scenes with rich colors Planets, Fire Stars, Jupiter Stars, Water Stars, and huge battleships. It's time to drive a space fighter and show your strength! !

title: Mimic Logic
description: "Mimic Logic" is an automatically generated logic puzzle roguelike. Listen to the statements of the treasure chests, find the lying mimics, and open the rest of the treasure chests! Opening a mimic results in a game over.

title: Within The Depths
description: Explore a mysterious island flooded with dangerous creatures in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer gamemodes!

title: The Chronicles of Eleos: The Hall of Azaron
description: The Chronicles of Eleos: The Hall of Azaron is a classic RPG where we control an archaeologist wizard on a journey through the continent of Eleos, a place with various peoples and cultures and full of mysteries and craziness just waiting for a nosy enough wizard to reveal them.

title: Classified: France '44
description: Command an elite team of allied special operators in Nazi-occupied France wreaking havoc in the run up to D-Day in this ambitious turn-based tactics game. Take on the might of Germany's war machine and launch daring raids in occupied territory. Can you do enough to ensure Allied victory?

title: Happiness Market
description: A simple simulation and management game. Build different shops and earn money from passing customers.

title: Le Mans Ultimate
description: Le Mans is a continually evolving story... powered by emotion, speed and glory. Le Mans Ultimate – the official game of the FIA World Endurance Championship & 24 Hours of Le Mans.

title: Cannon Target
description: Cannon Target - A simple puzzle game, the only goal of the player is to choose the firing direction of the cannon and hit the target.

title: Blackout Memphis
description: Blackout Memphis is a fast topdown shooter, characterized by bloody melees and action-packed gunfights. The demanding gameplay is backed by electronic music that adds a special atmosphere to the gritty and violent action.

title: Platboarder
description: A combination of a board game and platformer. Roll the dice and play your cards to complete all the levels. Don't forget to pet the animals along the way!

title: Tower of Pandemonium
description: Tower of Pandemonium is a top-down RPG and 2D platformer full of action, puzzles, mystery and memorable characters where your choices determine your fate.

title: Mystery Trackers: Fatal Lesson - Collector's Edition
description: It's no ordinary town... Can you stop a mad mayor and his destructive robots?

title: Riversiders
description: Raft down the river, camp in the wild, and make friends!

title: Backrooms Abyss
description: Explore and survive levels based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level offers various escape routes but also introduces perilous obstacles. Players can immerse themselves in the seemingly boundless and unsettling levels of the backrooms, experiencing the game's eerie and intricate mazes.

title: Epic Knight 2
description: Epic Knight 2 - Bad Dudes are attacking the Kingdom (Again). It is up to You to put Your RPG Skills to the test and stop them !

title: Bubblegum Bandit
description: With the power of gravity manipulation and bubblegum, the Bubblegum Bandit wreaks havoc and takes revenge! Steal from evil robots and blow up their ships!

title: Survival & Horror: Mortanis Prisoners Prologue
description: Survival & Horror: Mortanis Prisoners Prologue is a first part of the Survival & Horror: Mortanis Prisoners.

title: The Dark Climb
description: The Dark Climb is a challenging, third person, resource-based, stealth game in which you try to reach the end of a dark and dangerous map. You are equipped with a light source, which is directly bound to your life in the game.

title: 3D Puzzle: Desert Wind
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: 3D Puzzle: Medieval Inn
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: 3D Puzzle: Farming
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: Creepless
description: This is a multiplayer co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Collect items, repair car and get out! But monsters will bother you.

title: Times Of War
description: "Times Of War" - A sci-fi tower defense strategy game with armored vehicles, tanks, choppers, planes, explosive action, and three unique environments. Upgrade towers, earn Tech points, manage resources, and defend your base in epic battles. Get ready for intense warfare!

title: SkyDribble
description: Dribble the object to reach the goal! In the bottomless sky! A simple mouse-only 3D platformer game that anyone can enjoy.

title: Wordsock Classic
description: Compete in local or online word battles. Supports solo mode with or without AI players.

title: Train Simulator Classic: Western Maryland H-9 Class
description: Return to the glorious age of steam railroading in the Allegheny Mountains with Machine Rail's extraordinary Western Maryland H-9 class 2-8-0 built by The Baldwin Locomotive Works!

title: SS.Archives
description: This is a text adventure game with elements of horror, suspense, and puzzle-solving. Players take on the role of a detective, encountering various mysterious cases. These cases may be bizarre, eerie, or seemingly calm on the surface, but with turbulent undercurrents beneath.

title: Star Conflict: Edges of Risk - Stage one: Deluxe edition
description: This pack includesAccess to additional rewards in the event “Edges of risk. Stage one”.Upon receipt, the following 15 levels are immediately unlocked and all rewards of the unlocked levels are available30 days of premium license.

title: OMSI 2: Add-On Coachbus 303-Series
description: The Coachbus 303-Series add-on for OMSI 2 is a high-quality expansion that provides a realistic simulation of the iconic O303-Series bus from various countries.

title: Xargon Remake Ep.3
description: A remake of the classic 1993 DOS video game Xargon.

title: Four Lights: The 1st World - Iruka Route
description: Four protagonists E.B. and Iruka have become the targets of Lucifer. With a terrorist attack being the first, various misfortunes come over them. Fight against the world alongside the angels and protect your loved ones.

title: Knight Overloaded
description: Night Overloaded is a roguelight survival game that reinforced strategic choices. Beat enemies falling from the sky endlessly, and expand your inventory!

title: Hell Trigger
description: You are Unit ***, a soldier who was tasked to do a yearly expedition to The Flesh. Your Mission: Find and gather data about The Heart of The Flesh, and why it is eating up all of humanity. Can you reach The Heart in this brutal horror inspired rouge like?

title: Ecumene Aztec
description: The Great Tenochtitlan is on fire. Now that the war has broken out, I must choose whether to join our compatriots to repel the invader, or to join the newcomers who want to liberate us from the priests sacrificing our own brothers and children.

title: Vroom Vroom Valley
description: Hit the race track and improve your racing skills or take a sunday drive in a beautiful scenery. Vroom Vroom Valley offers a safe driving experience for the rookies but can also challenge the most seasoned veterans.

title: Turn on the Light: Jigsaw
description: A minimalist game about connecting circuits, solving jigsaw puzzles and mind-bending recursive circuits.

title: Mines Of Moritania
description: Experimental, None Linear, Cosmic Horror Game.

title: Grim-World: Survival
description: Grim World is a survival and adventure game in which you can build your home, create your character and shape it to your liking . You can become a warrior, a hunter or even a magician. You may well be halfway between a hunter and a magic like you want

title: 49 Squares
description: Simplistic, relaxing puzzle game. Click boxes to create patterns. Make patterns to complete 100 achievements.

title: Train Simulator: China Railways CR400BF
description: Board the China Railways CR400BF ‘Golden Phoenix’ from Just Trains for an exhilarating run along South West China High Speed.

title: Artificial Fright
description: Artificial Fright is a tense horror survival game where you play as an assistant robot in an old, abandoned warehouse. Explore your surroundings, conserve your battery power, and manage your systems using a Unix-like terminal.

title: Weather Dominance
description: 2D action platformer game where you don't play as the player but you play as the weather and you help the players to platform and save the environment from the eco-disasters

title: Hanctt Origins
description: Hanctt is a continent covered with fog, and surviving in the black fog, which is called black fog, is next to impossible.

title: Old School RPG
description: Old School RPG is a first-person fantasy turn-based role playing game. Create a party of adventurers and clear out dungeons and solve puzzles. Find and eliminate the source of evil that has come to your lands.

title: Dogu the Adventurer
description: Dogu the Adventurer is a story-based action adventure game that takes place in different worlds. Help Dogu to find his homeland while exploring worlds and islands with his balloon.

title: Russian Village Simulator
description: This is a simulator of life in the Russian countryside, where the player will be engaged in the garden, picking mushrooms and berries, collect firewood, hunting and fishing, brew moonshine and much, much more.

title: WarSphere
description: WarSphere is a fast-paced, Roguelike Top-Down Shooter. As an Armed Spherical Robotic System, you blast, loot and boost your way through procedurally generated worlds and dungeons in order to fulfill your purpose and become part of 'the Archive', which only marks the end of the beginning. Endgame activities include Daily Speed Running Leaderboards, Community Maps, etc.

title: Comet Clash
description: Take control of humanity’s last resort in defending the planet from the many dangers outer space has to offer. Shoot or deflect incoming projectiles, harvest them from the moon and spend the loot on upgrades.

title: Island Notes
description: Shipwrecked on a mysterious island, choose self-preservation or alliances. Master base-building, farming, fishing, romance and pet taming in this morally-charged survival simulator that blends strategy with human drama. Forge bonds, conquer nature, and evolve your humanity.

title: Agent Team Simulator: Your Agent in the Game
description: Unleash your imagination and create your very own Agent to feature across all versions of the game!

title: Doors & Loot
description: Make your way to the top of the tower and stop the sorcerer who controls it to free the unwary people who got there and are now cursed. Trade, craft, upgrade your skills and loot as you discover its history, as the higher you go the better the reward.

title: The Directorate: The Spy Who Killed A Saint
description: Play as a spy vying to stop unthinkable destruction. Sneak, fight and trick your way through countless grunts, guards and bosses. The 60s themed comical experience will challenge you to foil the destructive plans of a malevolent overlord within pre-set in game hours.

title: Dice Mayor
description: Welcome to Dice city, new mayor. Govern your city with only dice. Dice Mayor combines dice rolling with city building in a roguelike setting.

title: 7th Domain
description: "7th Domain" is a horizontal version action game derived from Roguelike Metroidvania combined with treasure grinding gameplay. You will play a child of destiny who repairs the world and finds the truth of the broken world. You will grow in battle and challenge the unknown and hidden forces.

title: The Necromancer Cometh!
description: The Necromancer Cometh is a tower defense game with a focus on mazing, fun characters, and interesting abilities. Build towers with special abilities, upgrade them to more powerful levels, create your maze through interesting maps, and survive wave after wave of enemies with unique powers!

title: Little Odyssey
description: Relax while traveling around fantasy desert on your giant turtle-giraffe. Deliver packages and explore the world in your Little Odyssey!

title: Dreamcore
description: Dreamcore Retro is a short and relaxing low poly indie game based on lucid dreaming and liminal spaces to concern about endangered species and other problems from the future society. The game mainly consists in exploring the dreamy surroundings of these psychedelic and minimalistic worlds.

title: The Multiverse Cleaner
description: You are Ted, a multiverse cleaner. Travel across multiple universes and realities to complete your employer's tasks. Each mission takes place in a different universe, but there is a central plot that connects them all. It's up to you to protect the multiverse.

title: A Silly Goofy Dream 2
description: This game is funny, it is not meant to be taken seriously. ASGD2 is a funny exploration style game in which you go around finding funny NPC's and interacting with them, trying to find them all in a vast world.

title: MazeMaze
description: "MAZEMAZE" is an adventure game where you explore maps, find objects, and progress through the story. One day, the protagonist jumps off a building and finds themselves in a mysterious space. They are guided through corridors in a maze where various things exist.

title: The Event
description: The Event is a first-person psychological horror game that offers immersive gameplay and a rich narrative. Find yourself stuck in mystery and struggle in the dark against paranormal activities, demons from other worlds and much more. Will you be able to find out the truth and return home?

title: LongStory 2
description: Award-winning LongStory gets a sequel! The Weasel Heights gang continues to surprise and delight as you learn more about yourself, friendship and love. Play as the gender of your choice and date the friend you like best. Throw a big mystery in the mix and you’re in for an adventure!

title: Wild City
description: Shape your urban ecosystem in Wild City, a unique roguelike deckbuilder! Rule a harmonious society or indulge in the citizens' primal instincts, as you shape your own concrete jungle!

title: Defenders of Legends
description: Defend your kingdom against legendary monsters. Place turrets strategically to block their path. Upgrade your defenses to fend off enemy hordes. Become the legendary guardian of the earth alone or in co-op!

title: Zamakan
description: Experience an alternative reality where ancient Egyptians have become a space travel civilization. Fly an Egyptian-themed space ship through an asteroid field, avoiding collisions with objects that bend the fabric of time-space. How far can you go in this endless runner game?

title: Another Chance
description: Another Chance is an isometric, story driven experience which pits you in the midst of an alien apocalypse. Split apart by your wife, your only objective is reuniting with her...or is it?

title: Xochi's Apothecary
description: A deceptively cozy narrative game about an alchemist that immigrates to a new country and opens an apothecary. Get to know your weird and wonderful community, brew the potions your customers need, and use your words to stir up a country on the brink of change.

title: Wyrd Gun
description: A roguelite looter shooter about breeding guns and leveling up to survive hoards of creatures on a strange planet!

title: Hearthkeeper
description: Hearthkeeper is a fantasy colony simulator, with rpg and platformer elements. Your characters will require food, water and shelter as the seasons change and the world turns. Plant crops, build structures, defend against raiders and beasts, research technologies and much more.

title: Marine Glory
description: Marine Glory is a single player sailing looting adventure. Find treasures, buy and upgrade new ships and explore multiple universes.

title: Dreaming Diorama
description: A unique casual puzzle game where you create a variety of dioramas. Explore and assemble dioramas in a 3D environment. Enjoy relaxing gameplay that allows you to create dioramas at your own pace with no time restraints.

title: Mr. Mookie and the Runaway Cookie
description: Help Mr. Mookie retrieve his giant cookie in this adorable puzzle-platformer! Glide through the clouds, explore alien lands, and solve complex puzzles to get the cookie and dip it in milk.

title: Hainya World
description: You are an adventurer, you need to explore this continent, make good use of the resources of this continent to arm yourself, explore this world full of monsters and unknown things and survive!

title: Falling Down
description: The main character must find all six pieces to repair the spaceship in order to continue the journey. Obtaining the six pieces requires navigating through challenging stories and making difficult decisions involving the people on this planet.

title: Chrono Crystal: Factory DLC
description: Chrono Crystal is a tower defense game. Spanning across 5 major regions with the Prince and facing numerous challenges, an unprecedented great war is about to break out. Build your towers, upgrade your heroes, and defend your crystal against waves of enemies—until the countdown timer runs out!

title: Live at Strummer's Pond
description: Come for a visit to Strummer's Pond with your friends! It's a cozy place full of tiny musical critters. Explore, ride a frog, pollinate flowers, and play some tunes along the way. ✨

title: Mortal Kombat: Defenders of The Realm
description: This is a Mortal Kombat fan game made with OpenBor.

title: Kaardik
description: Join the exciting world of Kaardik, a creature collection game. Embark on exciting adventures with your Kaardiks in the fascinating region of Kodumaa. Capture all the Kaardiks, battle with other trainers, and beat the king.

title: Burger Zombies
description: A top down free roaming shooter where you play as a burger delivery man who is completing his orders during the zombie apocalypse. Pick up and deliver orders while shooting and driving against a ever growing horde of zombies.

title: Machi: Above the Void
description: Is a captivating voxel-style indie puzzle game set in Japan style. Immerse yourself in its mesmerizing atmosphere, solve puzzles, and enjoy relaxing Asian-inspired music. Compete in multiplayer, climb leaderboards, and unlock achievements. A captivating journey of tranquillity and challenge awaits.

title: Silent Shores
description: Silent Shores is a first-person open world horror game where you play as a father searching for his missing son on an abandoned island.

title: Fall into Decay
description: A girl named Celica woke up in a strange mansion one day. She seemed to have forgotten something important... But her first goal was to find a way to escape from here.

title: Rise for the Fight
description: A Cartoon Multiplayer FPS Game, where you can upgrade your guns by dealing damage or gaining multikills.

title: Queen of Moths
description: It's a winter night. You are coming home by train. You have to change trains at a small train station in the middle of the forest.It's not the first time you've traveled this route. But now you feel like something is different. As if something was watching you.

title: Project Hunt
description: A casual-friendly hunting game that focuses on fun, punchy shooting rather than hardcore simulation. Track animals, line up the perfect shot, and inspect every hit on detailed animal models.

title: Blind Frontiers
description: Embark on an RPG-survival road trip adventure with Niuma, a unique and singular character on a quest to uncover The Eldorado. Navigate through a post-war world marked by limited resources. Explore cities, interact with locals, and manage resources while confronting your stigmas to survive.

title: Pipelinks
description: Welcome to Pipelinks, a 2D tile-based puzzle game where you'll use your problem-solving skills to connect a variety of pipe creatures and help them navigate challenging levels!

title: Riddle for your Life
description: Do you have what it takes to solve all riddles? Your life may depend on it. The stakes are high. Winning grants you a powerful reward, losing means certain death. Are you brave enough to play the odds?

title: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency
description: H.I.A: Horror Investigation Agency is a fun multiplayer horror game in which you and co-players have to investigate unique horror cases. Among finding victims and evidence of the horror event that has taken place, you will be faced with jumpscares and scary monsters along your investigation.

title: Invaders from the Third Dimension
description: A retro space game with 3D graphics and modern controls. Rotate your ship and shoot at any angle, instead of just sliding back and forth. Enjoy 3D graphics with lighting effects and realistic explosions.

title: TD Royale
description: TD Royale is a real-time multiplayer tower defense where you summon enemies for your opponents. Balance economy and offense without letting your own defenses fail in order to outwit your enemy and be the last summoner standing!

title: Galactic Grinder
description: Rider, skateboarder extraordinaire, is about to embark on a journey across the solar system after a catastrophic event sets him on a course to save us all.

title: Doppelganger: Nightmare Realm
description: This is a dark story about a little boy trying to survive in a parallel world of his doppelganger. You will have to experience adventures in places of life and death of your doppelganger, solve all the puzzles, and make your way from the cemetery to birth.

title: Trash of the Titans
description: It's turn-based fantasy combat with trash animals. Defend your trash from invading vermin, and use your trash to upgrade your team. Think your way out of ruin by using the shape of each level to your advantage. Be creative, and try to not die.

title: Jack Holmes: Master of Puppets
description: Survival Horror in first person where you must manage your ammunition well, explore varied scenarios and face nightmarish beings, while investigating the macabre experiments with children, the result of a mind unhinged by madness and family loss.

title: Wholesome: Heartdrawn
description: Wholesome: Heartdrawn is a Turn-Based RPG and adventure game about Lyra, who creates her world to imagine her memories to escape from some things. Explore real and imagined worlds, and go on adventures. Lead Lyra and help her handle everything.

title: Daedalus: You Have Been Chosen
description: Go on a scary adventure, whether you decide to face the dangerous path alone or team up with your friends. This intense game guarantees a mysterious experience every time you play. Get ready to solve tricky puzzles, avoid a terrifying monster, and fight your way out of the intricate maze.

title: Card Detective
description: "Card Detective" is a unique single-player card game that combines card gameplay, deduction, collection, and educational elements. The game features an engaging storyline and innovative gameplay.

title: Cybergrid Runner
description: This is a stealth puzzle game set in a cyber city. Help the hacker infiltrate the system by manipulating the intricate 5x5 tile system. Collect powerful implant upgrades and weapons. Brace yourself for endlessly thrilling playthroughs, as each session unveils procedurally generated labyrinth.

title: Will You Wheel?
description: Transform your rusty vehicle into a powerful race car by skillfully installing various parts. Engage in a variety of money-making activities such as woodcutting, nocturnal racing, or pizza delivery. Perhaps you're interested in managing a workshop for yourself? The possibilities are endless!

title: Mars Survivors
description: Ready to tackle the challenge? On Mars, confront countless mutated creatures and mechanical monsters. Choose survivors, weapons, and skills wisely for diverse battles. Employ precise shooting, agile dodging, and strategic use of props and skills to fend off enemy attacks.

title: A Deep Rest
description: A Deep Rest is a collection of short stories about men and their relationship with mental health and depression. Taking control of a different character in each story, you will experience life from their perspective. See the problems and issues they face and help them find ways to be alright again.

title: Stars, Stripes, and Subgames
description: Immerse yourself in a world of captivating and diverse subgames, inspired by the essence of America.

title: Angel Legion: Lil Lily - Green
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Haunted Memories: The Return
description: Haunted Memories: The Return is a psychological horror in which you assume the role of yourself. You decide which path you will take and what will happen in Green Park this time. But the question remains - will you ever be able to leave?

title: A Date with Death
description: Fight against and romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a chat simulator visual novel where you date the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through fully voiced video calls.

title: Drug Lord Tycoon
description: Start from nothing and rise to the top as you expand your criminal empire in Drug Lord Tycoon.

title: Unmanned: Midnight Nightmare
description: Welcome to Megan’s Mall, the place where dreams come true! It’s your first day on the job as a security guard, and it’s going to be an experience you’ll never forget.

title: Sender
description: The winds of the frozen wasteland are calling in this atmospheric horror game. Operate an aging vehicle to locate the missing driver of the previous expedition. Be careful not to stray from the path...

title: Survivter
description: Survivter is a roguelike first-person shooter where you no longer have to press a button to make your weapon fire, it shoots itself as long as there are enemies in the room. The gameplay consists of dodging enemies and upgrade character.

title: King Story: Prologue
description: A storm of darkness is taking over the world. Adventure in search of your quest escaping the demon darkness that chases you. Upgrade your items to progress through the maze like environment in this Metroidvania-like challenge. Can you find a Hermit's lost son in your quest to save the world?

title: Scroomage
description: Destroy property, kill companies, run fast, and punch opposing workers in this fast-paced first person shooter.

title: Dollar
description: This dollar is an excellent steam inventory item based on a real life currency item of the same name. Every hour you will receive a dollar, with a very small chance to receive the golden dollar. Good Luck!

title: Quintus and the Formidable Curse
description: ‘Quintus and the Formidable Curse’ is a Horror-Adventure game with a difference; the protagonists are a Man and Mouse duo!

title: Bucky's Grounds
description: Bucky's Grounds is a first-person Retro style mascot horror game, where you uncover the dark truth of a mysterious town within another dimension, visit the Khancoban playground while avoiding the sweet toothed rabbit who despises yellow light.

title: Append
description: Destroy friends or strangers in this online multiplayer bullet heaven/hell shooter. Collect powerups, combine weapons, build your defenses and obliterate the opposition. Hundreds of weapon combinations and multiple game modes.

title: Straftat
description: Straftat is a 1v1/2v2 online first person shooter with quick rounds in over 350 maps. Including all weapons, proximity chat and 4 players FFA.

title: Clash of Stars
description: MMO Real-time strategy star game.

title: Welcome to Mars 9
description: Welcome to Mars 9: The Tale of River is an old-school graphic adventure about a person adrift in space, rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you will be drawn into a world of comfort and pleasure, only to soon discover that the station hides a dark secret.

title: Breaking Friendships
