description: High speed action 2D platformer that requires strategical thinking as Agent Jump jumps all over the stage using jump pads. Kick your way through to the next level!!

title: Accelerate Zone
description: FULL-THROTTLE STG "ACCELERATE ZONE". This is an action shooting game where the faster you go, the better your strategy. It's okay to take your time and go at your own pace.

title: Football Cup 2023
description: Unleash your football skills like never before and show other countries who's the best team in the world! Lace up your boots and prepare for an unparalleled soccer experience!

title: The Last Hope: Dead Zone Survival
description:
The Last Hope: Dead Zone Survival is an intense storyline game set in an apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies. As the main character, your sole objective is to survive and find a way to escape the nightmarish chaos that surrounds you.

To endure the challenges ahead, you must undertake daring missions that test your survival skills. Each mission you take can be the difference between life and death.

title: Katamari Damacy Reroll & We Love Katamari Reroll + Royal Reverie
description: This bundle includes the two remastered games for the Katamari series.

title: Endless Space 2: Definitive Edition
description:
Endless Space 2 is Amplitude Studios’ third title in the acclaimed Endless Universe. This Strategic Space Opera is set in the mysterious universe of the “Endless”, God-like beings now long gone… though the secrets of their time still echo throughout the galaxy.

Become the leader of one of twelve unique factions as the benevolent guide your people need, or as a charismatic tyrant serving your own interests and building the influence of your empire.

Explore the galaxy and encounter new life forms. Whether to befriend or to conquer them is up to you, regardless, you’ll need to build a strong fleet and adapt quickly to overcome those who cause a threat to your rule.

Whichever route you choose, delve into this adventure in its most complete form with the Definitive Edition which, along with the base game, includes:

Endless Space 2 – Vaulters
The resilient and stubborn Vaulters left the dying planet of Auriga for a new chance at finding a place they can finally call home.

Endless Space 2 – Supremacy
Meet the Hissho, a militaristic faction focused on expanding their empire and subjugating those who stand in their way.

Endless Space 2 - Untold Tales
Even if they are not the leading forces of the galaxy, minor factions still have their own heroes and their own stories: hear them out.

Endless Space 2 - Lost Symphony
The Harmony are back. The travelers of this minor faction are experts at exploiting resources and will be invaluable allies. Also includes seven exclusive music tracks.

Endless Space 2 - Harmonic Memories
Enjoy nine remastered tracks from the original Endless Space as well as a new Harmony Hero: FES2 Reflects.

Endless Space 2 - Celestial Worlds
The Leader of the Academy’s influence is wavering, and Restless Heroes start to rise… this epic multiple ending questline will make each of your decisions count.

Endless Space 2 – Penumbra
The Umbral Choir faction does not usually meddle with the rest of the denizens of the galaxy, but even they cannot ignore its death cry.

Endless Space 2 – Awakening
The Nakalim faction was once a vast galactic empire under the guidance of their gods, the Lost. When the Lost were slain, the Nakalim fell from grace. They now seek to reclaim their ancient territories.

Endless Space 2 - Dark Matter
With twelve new story quests, investigate ancient mysteries and… less ancient problems caused by unruly subjects of your empire.

title: Mahjong Woods
description: Beautiful and relaxing nature inspired mahjong game!

title: Momo and the Mine
description: Help this charismatic mole collect matchsticks in an abandoned mine in this challenging platform game!

title: Neptunia: Sisters vs. Sisters - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

- Digital Artbook*
- Soundtrack (x9 Tracks) *
- PC Theme*
- PC & Mobile Wallpapers (x5 & x13) *
*Note: Once purchased and downloaded, the digital artbook, soundtrack, PC theme, and PC wallpapers can be found in the "Deluxe Set" folder in the game root directory.

- Swimsuit Costume Set**
*The Swimsuit Costume Set is purely cosmetic. The set provides swimsuits for the Goddess Candidates and the Goddesses.

Costume "Morning Glory" (Nepgear)
Costume "Little Polka-Dot" (Uni)
Costume "Cobalt Dive" (Rom)
Costume "Pink Dive" (Ram)
Costume "Beach Fresh" (Neptune)
Costume "Girly Campus" (Noire)
Costume "Aquamarine Shell" (Blanc)
Costume "Floral Paleo" (Vert)

- Adventurer's Pack**
**The Adventurer's Pack includes the followng in-game items:
15 Healing Grass Z
5 Life Fragment Z
5 MEGA Juice Z
5 MEGA Capsule Z
5 MEGA Pill Z
3 Panacea Z
2 All Heal Z
1 Magic Crystal Z

title: Neptunia GameMaker R:Evolution - Digital Deluxe Edition
Summer Party Time
description: Get ready for the best summer ever! Party with your friends anytime, anywhere!

title: Puzzle Girls
description: You can use a variety of items to complete the missions，earn rewards and try to challenge the hardest 'Zen' mode. Live2D dynamic images may icrease the level of difficulty.

title: Die Siedler IV: Die Neue Welt
description: The Vikings discovered America - the new world. But instead of claiming it for their own, they announce a regatta: Whoever arrives first in the new world, can keep it. Neither the Romans, Trojans or Maya say no to the challenge and each race has their own reasons to get to the promised land as fast as they can.

title: Station.exe
description: Strange CD short liminal style game with large bulbous heads following the player.

title: Koisuru Oukoku
description: In a mythical age, a young man seeks to become an adult. He leaves his farm home to face the frontiers of the kingdom. He comes to a town where one can seek any apprenticeship freely. This is so one can find his own purpose in life, and perhaps his own lover as well. Jobs include: border guard, educator, various magical schools, fisher, and more. With each job there appears to be a respective woman in the same profession to charm. Will the hero be able to find and woo the girl of his choice in time for the town's festival?

title: F.O.O.D.S.
description: Decode alien recipes and cook peculiar dishes while solving puzzles and work as a team to become the greatest fast-food service in the universe!

title: Sonic Forces: Super Sonic
description:
Speed through the levels faster than Sonic... as Super Sonic! Transform into Super Sonic across 20+ Modern and Classic Sonic stages. Collect the right amount of rings and Super Sonic will spring into action, giving you the ability to sprint across stages at break-neck speeds.

Please Note: You cannot participate in the rankings with Super Sonic.

title: Rotten Apples
description: After leaving your ex-fiancé at the alter, you move towns to find a more adventurous life (hopefully filled with more romance). However, the guys who seem to be taking an interest in you seem a little… off. The new town you’re at doesn’t seem to be as safe as you thought as well…

title: Hop Owl
description: Hop around obstacles while collecting ancient dust!

title: Bó Cócó Zinha
description: On a quiet planet full of ranches, a little chicken must take over the family restaurant and recover the golden recipes, which have been stolen and scattered across several worlds full of juicy enemies and spicy dangers. Face the challenges and regain the hopes of the Galo family.

title: Yume no Office
description: A romance visual novel where you choose who to spend your days with, featuring shifting moods and dynamic dialogue, as all routes progress simultaneously… until something starts to feel wrong.

title: Neko-nin ExHeart Spin!
description: Neko-nin ExHeart Spin! is the Steam release of the upcoming side story of the Neko-nin ExHeart series.

title: Loop Loop Room
description: Loop Loop Room is an upcoming simple puzzle platformer game filled with a variety of gimmicks.

title: Pumuckl: Fangt den Klabauter
description:
Pumuckl is a small red-haired goblin character from a popular German TV series. His major concern is to trifle with humans.

The non-violent, fun, and educational jump'n'run game with Pumuckl and the Blue Klabauter. Missed opportunities in the game can be compensated for by solving math problems.

title: ARIA: Angelic Realms In Arborea
description:
Welcome to "ARIA: Angelic Realms In Arborea" a thrilling platformer that combines the charm of classic 2D gameplay with a fresh, updated style. Embark on an epic adventure through five enchanting worlds, each with its own unique biome and a climactic boss battle awaiting you at the end.

In this captivating game, you'll have the opportunity to play as different characters, each possessing their own distinct skills and statistics. Take control of the agile and graceful Angel, an expert Archer with the ability to double jump, allowing you to traverse the treacherous terrain with ease. Alternatively, you can embody the cunning Spec Ops, armed with a trusty Pistol and Grenades, granting you swift movements and a penchant for tactical warfare. If you prefer a more resilient approach, choose the Desert Soldier, equipped with a powerful Rifle and boasting higher health, albeit at a slower pace. The swift and lethal Ninja wields a deadly Katana, making lightning-fast strikes against enemies a breeze. Finally, the valiant Crusader, though slow, compensates with a sturdy shield and a mighty sword, ensuring both high health and formidable defense.

Prepare yourself for a visually stunning journey as you explore five vibrant worlds. Traverse the lush grasslands of the default world, challenge the scorching heat and unforgiving sand dunes of the desert, venture into the eerie depths of the graveyard, navigate the dense and perilous jungles, and experience the wonders of a futuristic sci-fi realm. As you progress through each world, face thrilling encounters with foes specially tailored to the environment, ensuring that every battle is a unique and exhilarating experience.

Throughout your adventure, discover power-ups and collectibles that will aid you in your quest. Gather health and mana potions to restore your vitality and magical abilities, while collecting feathers that unlock new and potent skills unique to each character. Utilize these abilities strategically to overcome challenging obstacles and decimate your adversaries.

Prepare yourself for an unforgettable journey as you dive into the immersive world of "ARIA: Angelic Realms In Arborea".

Embark on a heroic quest, test your platforming skills, and unveil the secrets hidden within each world as you bring forth the resurgence of the immortal allegiance. Are you ready to rise above the challenges and embrace your destiny?

title: Gefangen in der Drachenfestung
description: Join the PLAYMOBIL-kids Laura and Alex on an exciting trip into the world of knights. Princess Laura gets kidnapped from the evil wizard Grimmbart and captured in Dragon's Castle. Squire Alex wants to rescue her. He needs to win the knights' tournament as well as beating the dragon, other knights and the evil wizard. He needs to beat level 3 in 11 exciting minigames.

title: Lostboy.exe
description: Controversial video game leak turned big because of ulterior motives.

description: MMO-Chatting game with a strange art style rumored to be 'shut down'.

title: Curtain Call Crusade
description:
Mira, a college third year transfers to a new university to pursue her passion for theater acting, eager to make a name for herself. But she has a secret: She's a magical girl that fights evil! And it seems she's not the only one when a cocky outgoing hero appears in front of her one night, and things don't end well. Meanwhile in her regular life there’s a boy in theater class that she can't seem to get along with, but he seems to be hiding something.

Engage in competitive flirty banter, create mishaps and hijinks, and uncover secrets in this funny romantic comedy otome game!

title: Pearlglow Cafe: Sweet Crumb Kisses
description:
"With every wave, a new adventure..."

Near the edges of a seaside town, where salty breezes kiss skin and a radiant sun shines on the horizon, an enchanting cafe emerges... Owned and operated by an spirited young witch, every pastry she serves has a singular purpose: to spread boundless joy and compassion throughout the world.

Enter the world of Pearlglow Cafe and guide Juniper as she embarks on a charming journey filled with new beginnings, gentle romances, and delectably magical treats!

title: Saintess Alasdair is Dead
description:
Saintess Alasdair was hailed in Filigree and the kingdoms beyond as the reincarnation of the morning Goddess. Beautiful, pious and powerful, she was forever victorious in battle and perfect in her devotion.

But now the Saintess is dead, her body scattered over the battle field like weeds after rain.

You are Gwendolyn, the Saintess’s much less impressive sister, and your marriage to the King of Assynia will fix whatever complications the Saintess left behind.

You will not fail.

title: Pilla's Paradise
description:
In the year 3227… humanity is scattered across the solar system, connected only through Lifesight.

Follow Pilla, a cute and bubbly streamer as she decides to reinvent herself with a trip of a lifetime to a planet she’s never known! What might she discover in the Last Paradise on Earth?

title: Paranoia: The Game Edition
description: Meet a new state of the famous thrilling first person shooter - PARANOIA is released now as a stand-alone game. This release is a pretty simple port of original PARANOIA mod v1.2 for Half-Life to Xash3D Engine. It allows you to play PARANOIA as a standalone game right after installing. All required resources are provided with the game, Half-Life or even Steam are not needed.

title: Cloak & Dagger: Shadow Operations
description: A short, single player, third person, tactical stealth action game set in the early 1990's meant to be finished in one sitting. Use the shadows, shoot out lights, stun enemies, and conceal yourself in the darkness through 5 Missions.

title: Febilis
description:
This game is a prototype version.
It has been designed for Xbox controllers but can still be played with mouse and keyboard. It features a save system you can use to save your progress and keep playing later on.

title: Delicious Quest
description: Delicious Quest is a game about a dog on his journey to find the Holy Roast Turkey. Unfortunately, this dog can't control himself and will require your help to go further in his epic quest!

title: Top Jump
description:
Welcome to Top Jump, an exhilarating and addictive game that will test your speed, agility, and strategic thinking! Race against other players in a thrilling vertical challenge, as you strive to reach the summit of a treacherous cave and secure your position on the leaderboard. Can you conquer the heights and claim the top spot?

In Top Jump, your primary objective is to ascend the cave as quickly as possible. Leap from platform to platform, avoiding obstacles and deadly traps, all while maintaining a lightning-fast pace. Precision and timing are crucial as you navigate through the ever-changing environment, filled with pitfalls and hurdles that can hinder your progress.

What sets Top Jump apart is the ability to manipulate time. In the infinite training mode, you have the power to rewind time endlessly, enabling you to perfect your strategies, explore alternative routes, and enhance your skills. However, in the competitive ranked mode, time manipulation is limited and can only be used sparingly during each run. Be strategic in deciding when to activate this feature, as every instance will cost you valuable seconds, potentially affecting your chances of climbing the leaderboard.

Are you ready to embark on the ultimate climbing challenge? Put your jumping skills to the test in Top Jump and prove that you have what it takes to reach the summit and become the reigning champion of the leaderboard!

title: Coloring Game: The Family
description: This is the first theme-based DLC for the Coloring Game which is fully dedicated to a single family. The package contains 30 new images.

description: First commercial DLC for the Coloring Game: Little City. The package contains 15 new images.

description: Third commercial DLC for the Coloring Game: Little City. The package contains 15 new images.

title: Coloring Game: Little City - No.4

title: Coloring Game: Little City - No.5
description: Last commercial DLC for the Coloring Game: Little City. The package contains 5 new images. The completion of all the levels takes approximately 12 hours.

title: Aojuji Hospital: Tokyo Eidolic Anatomy Division
description: A Japanese horror novel adventure set in Japan in 1999. Confront the mysterious events and anatomize the paranormal!

title: Christ's Revenge: Ascension
description: Jesus Christ is back... For vengeance. Jump, Dodge, and Glide your way to the top as Jesus Christ himself.

title: Abaddon's Veil
description: Abaddon's Veil is a short dread-driven space submarine horror game inspired by Iron Lung.

title: Dishonored 2: Limited Edition
description:
Reprise your role as a supernatural assassin in Dishonored 2. Play your way in a world where mysticism and industry collide. Will you choose to play as Empress Emily Kaldwin or the Royal Protector, Corvo Attano? Will you stalk your way through the game unseen, make full use of its brutal combat system, or use a blend of both? How will you combine your character’s unique set of powers, weapons and gadgets to eliminate your enemies? The story responds to your choices, leading to intriguing outcomes, as you play through each of the game’s hand-crafted missions.

The Dishonored 2 Limited Edition is a limited supply edition of the game (available by pre-ordering from specific retailers before the release date) that comes with additions. They include the following physical and digital rewards:

- A free digital copy of Dishonored: Definitive Edition, an enhanced version of the original title which includes all the DLC and features improved graphics
- Physical editions from participating retailers come with the Imperial Assassin’s Pack:
- Duelist’s Luck Bone Charm: bullet packs have an increased chance of holding one more bullet
- Void Favor Bone Charm: supernatural powers have an increased chance of consuming no mana
- Lore Book: A Musician’s Farewell
- Antique Serkonan Guitar
- 500 coins to use in black market shops

Retailer exclusives include:
- Best Buy: Dishonored comic book. (Also offers an exclusive The Royal Protector Bundle with Collectible Steelbook, Corvo Keychain and Dishonored: Corroded Man Novel)
- GameStop: a reversible mask
- Amazon: free Dishonored soundtrack

title: Deep Dive
description:
Fly through a number of checkpoints into the finish line as fast as possible.

The Glider has no propulsion, the only way is down.

You can brake midair to slow down and fold in your wings to drift.

Happy Highscore Hunting.

description: Here is the video game “Kakuhina”! Released in 2004 on Windows. It's an action game, set in an anime / manga, fighting and 2d fighter maker themes.

description: 2004, the year Soldier of the Empire was released on Windows. Made by Fragmaker and published by Russobit-M.

title: Bunny Battle Nemesis
description: Sci-fi, bloodthirsty bunnies, and the powers of a goddess at your disposal! This is Bunny Battle Nemesis. Experience intense action, explosions, and chaos as you defend the Bunny Kingdom from certain doom at the hands of a vengeful demigod and her army of mercenaries.

title: Pinfall
description: From the center of the Earth to the outskirts of reality, overcome the impossible in Pinfall: An extremely difficult physics-based platformer where momentum is key. While talking to NPCs, collecting items, and customizing your look, keep climbing as the impending fall awaits...

An obscene Disney fangame made in RPG Maker 2003 where Donald Duck has to rescue Daisy from Ronald McDonald alongside a pothead Mickey and his homosexual nephews.

It won the 2004 Misao entry for worse game of the year.

description:
An otome game by Snapdragon.

The story is set at the 19th century at the United Kingdom, in a rural town called Wingfield.

title: Phobos: Anomaly Reborn
description:
Phobos: Anomaly Reborn is a PWAD level set by Christopher Lutz released in 2003. The episode features a similar design as Lutz's other levels, with highly detailed and realistic environments. Examples of such include a moving train and a hangar with ships and transport rails. The episode was included in Doomworld's Top 100 WADs of All Time list.

Thematically, the episode serves as a replacement of the first Doom episode. However, it is much more difficult than the original, with bigger puzzles and stronger enemies appearing earlier.

title: Nightmare in Squidville
description: Do you remember Squidville where Spongebob and Patrick were looking for Squidward? At the end he flew away with a reef blower. But did he? And how long have they been searching? Find it out in this Walking Simulator and explore what happened in Squidville after this episode in an alternative reality.

title: Drug Prince & Narcotic Girl for Nintendo Switch
description:
A Nintendo Switch version of Drug Prince and Narcotic Girl that includes the Main Story, from the first encounter with the main characters all the way up to the fake marriage chapter.

In addition to the newly written story from the boyfriend’s point of view, the Switch version also includes a new opening movie, newly drawn illustrations, and a new sensitivity feature. Also, the Side Story, which is available as an additional purchase, includes a “newlywed” themed story that was previously only available in the fan book.

title: Final Fantasy XI: A Crystalline Prophecy
description: Add-on episode of Final Fantasy XI

title: Sirenum
description: Sirenum is a monochromatic game taking place on the Pope, a ship that has been lost in space for more than a year. You and your sick companion, Lev, fly by what seems to be another dead planet. Or is it? You receive a transmission from this planet inviting you to land. Lev is not himself and becomes charmed, will you?

He doesn't know if anyone or anything currently haunts these walls, but there is one thing he can conclude: He shouldn't have come here.

Assemble your squad, equip items and abilities, and outplay your opponents in fast-paced strategic battles. Discover the world of Skygard in a multi-campaign solo adventure, or fight in thrilling PvP matches!

Overcome your opponents with powerful new charms!
Discover new secrets and stories!
All with an incredible new soundtrack!

description: How high can you go? Find out in this Cookie Clicker inspired journey that never stops. Collect golden dust to unlock new skills to go up even faster. Keep your game running so you don't go down. Compete with your friends and the world to ascend to the greatest heights.

title: L00P

title: Repunk

Repunk is a single player immersive sim with permadeath... and writing.

Explore. Scavenge. Create. Survive.
Live a unique adventure from an old overland train.

Welcome to an alternative universe, where Mars was colonized... in 1939.

title: DNF Duel: DLC 1 - Spectre
description:
'Spectre' can be used in DNF Duel.

Spectre is the first character in the DNF Duel: Season Pass and was released alongside a major balance patch and gameplay update that added new systems to the game.

This is a new world that is a drastic rearrangement of the previous "Trapped Girls".
Solve the riddles in the mansion and rescue more girls.

description: As a player, you take on the role of a pilot, and compete in a futuristic gameshow that pits mind-controlled robots - known as Gladiators - against each other in adrenaline-fueled matches, televised within the extended Contenders universe.

title: Fetish Locator
description: Play as a young college student exploring love, lust, and sexual fetishes with the hottest women in town. Score points in the Fetish Locator app, which has taken the campus by storm. Make choices and decide the fate of the story in Fetish Locator!

title: Atomic Heart: Annihilation Instinct
description: Continue the story in the Annihilation Instinct DLC and learn what happened to this dystopian world after the climax of Atomic Heart. Prepare to embark on a journey through the new mind-bending Mendeleev Complex and its surrounding swamps, and discover the truth about NORA as Major P-3 is pulled back into Facility 3826. Survive vicious, shape-shifting new enemies and take them down using two cunning new weapons - ranged one the Secateur and melee one the Klusha - as well as your glove’s new Techno-Stasis ability, allowing you to manipulate time itself. Meet a new enigmatic character, as well as returning ones in surprising circumstances and dive deep into the AI’s insanity to curb its Annihilation Instinct.

title: Mannequin The Spotting
description: Prepare to re-enter a chilling world where malevolent mannequins lurk in the shadows, waiting to strike. In this horror game, your survival hinges on your ability to navigate an environment infested with these eerie figures. Utilize the security cameras to discern the evil ones from their benign counterparts, but beware, for one wrong move could lead to your untimely demise.

title: The Joy of Creation: Classic
description: The Joy of Creation: Classic was a point and click survival horror video game that was being remade from the ground up for the Fazbear Fanverse, Including new assets, new gameplay, new everything.

title: King's Son
description: The King's son, whose kingdom has been taken from him, wants his kingdom back

title: Professional Fishing 2
description: "Professional Fishing 2" is the second installment of an exciting fishing game that takes you into the world of thrilling angling adventures. Step into the shoes of a novice angler, embarking on a journey with simple yet reliable gear.

title: Play Chess with Lady Bongcloud
description: "Play Chess with Lady Bongcloud" is an unique chess game that allows you to engage in thrilling chess matches with the Lady Bongcloud. The lady hails from the noble Bongcloud family, renowned for their unique "Bongcloud Opening".

title: American Eristics
description: Would you believe one of your friends is a killer? Return home in this 2.5D horror story.

title: Trigger Tennis
description: Trigger Tennis is a third person shooter with tennis elements where rackets are swoped for guns and tennis balls for bullets

title: Endless Suburbia
description: A hyper-realistic horror driving game set in a suburban environment. Drive through six different atmospheric experiences where an alien invasion, spider infestation, murderous mime, and other frightful events will happen.

title: Idle Industries
description: Idle Industries: Build, Prestige, Prosper! Unleash miners, refine resources, and construct your empire in this addictive factory-building sim. Reach new heights of wealth and prestige with doubled rewards. Original music, 20+ hours gameplay, and customization!

title: Heart of Mobius
description: Dive into a captivating standalone story in just an hour! Presenting the first installment of the "Handy Novel" series. Highly praised on smartphones, this acclaimed narrative is now ready for your enjoyment on Steam for PC/Mac!

title: I Have a Dream
description: I HAVE A DREAM is a 3D puzzle line game. You wake up in a place you've never seen before. Adapt to the transformation of various points of view and get out of here!

title: Cats Hidden in Paris: Extra Level
description: Play a brand new level enriched with intricate details, vividly illustrating the mesmerizing city of love! 100 Cats have once again decided to hide themselves but this time it will prove to be a much greater challenge to find them all!

title: Crossroad of Worlds: Magic Stars - Collector's Edition
description: Uncle Randall of his investigative agency and the Guardian of Worlds appeal for your support in another plea for help - someone has once again encroached on the stars of magical worlds!

title: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad
description: Expect blasts of green zombie goo painting the screen in this top-down shooter packed with crazy guns that blow the heads off some… freaky zombies. Your mission is simple: graffiti the whole city before these mutants dog-pile you.

title: The Horror Within
description: A short indie horror game with puzzle elements where you're playing a horror game inside the game.

title: Mr. Wings
description: Mr. Wings is an upcoming adventure platformer from linearharu which builds the core mechanics of movement, combat, and dialogues while using 8x8 pixel art and progressive music.

title: Ronald McDonalds
description: Your objective is to steal the secret recipe from McDonald's without Ronald finding you.

title: I am Dave
description: Is a 3D walking simulator/adventure, where you will go to the office, buy groceries, chat with your colleagues. Live a completely normal life until you start to notice weird stuff and signs from the universe. By the way, who is Dave?

title: Death Elevator
description: Death Elevator is a simple roguelike where every hit is lethal but time slows down whenever you are in danger. Reach the top floor or die trying!

title: Oddsmaker
description: Play as 4 children on a journey to restore the balance of power on Earth after a cataclysmic war & subsequent invention of a devastating weapon has all but decimated human civilization as we know it.

title: The Posthumous Investigation
description: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

title: Awakening Sarah
description: Awakening Sarah is a 2D platformer with emphasis on exploration. Unravel the dreams and realities of Sarah, a girl who's recovering from a coma, while helping her understand the world around her and herself.

title: Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer
description: Murder Is Game Over: Deal Killer takes you on an immersive journey through the Italian Alps. Unravel the murder mystery amidst an alpine backdrop, exploring opulent settings and unmasking the killer in this thrilling detective game.

title: Pain Loop
description: Pain Loop is a horror game where you are a 6-year-old little girl named Nina who, after experiencing the assassination of her older brother by a killer with details that remain unknown. She is disturbed every night by horrible nightmares in which her room is transformed into a dark and claustrophobic environment.

title: Thorn for the Villain: Reincarnated as an Extra in an Otome Game?!
description: When an office lady end up reincarnated as a noble lady in an otome game she was playing, she decides to intervene into preventing the story from never starting... however, her actions catches the attention of the game's original villainous underground organization, Snare.

title: Final Fantasy XI: A Moogle Kupo d'Etat
description: The second add-on scenario for Final Fantasy XI. It was originally sold online through the PlayOnline network. It is now also available on disc in the Ultimate Collection of Final Fantasy XI. Like the previous add-on scenario, it focuses on exploring the story of Final Fantasy XI through a series of missions and does not introduce new locations or jobs.

title: Aiyra
description:
Join this adventure with Aiyra, the world is in danger, and It's up to Aiyra to save the guardians of the forest so that together they can defeat the evil that is reappearing!

Aiyra is a platform game with action and puzzle elements. In each chapter, new mechanics are introduced, and combined they allow the player to choose their own path! You will face many challenges, dealing with a variety of combat and puzzles involving elemental arrows! In the path of Aiyra's journey, she will deal with tons of demons, and also corrupted animals, that she's not allowed to kill!

description: Add on Scenario for Final Fantasy XI

description: Add-on Scenario for Final Fantasy XI

description: Add-on Scenario for Final Fantasy XI

title: Final Fantasy XI: Heroes of Abyssea
description: Add-on Scenario for Final Fantasy XI

title: MiSide
description: MiSide is an adventure game with horror elements, telling the story of a simple guy who, for mystical reasons, finds himself in a mobile simulation. Appearing in the house he has just observed on his smartphone screen, the hero becomes confused. The stunned guy follows the instructions of a certain device he discovered in the bedroom. A few moments later, he is greeted by a pretty girl, whose image is also familiar to the young man from this mobile game.

title: Monument Valley II: The Lost Forest
description: The Lost Forest is a special chapter to Monument Valley 2. It was created for the Playing For The Planet Green Game Jam and to raise awareness towards environmental causes.

title: Cheogsh
description: A wad for Doom II: Hell on Earth with 1 very large map.

title: NBA 2K24
description: Grab your squad and experience the past, present, and future of hoops culture in NBA 2K24. Enjoy pure, authentic action and limitless personalized MyPLAYER options in MyCAREER. Collect an impressive array of legends and build your perfect lineup in MyTEAM. Relive your favorite eras as a GM or Commissioner in MyNBA. Experience next-level gameplay and lifelike visuals with your favorite NBA and WNBA teams in play now.

title: Ex Vitro
description: Ex Vitro is a dark sci-fi 2D platformer where you delve into the ruins of a military research facility and discover the horrors within. Whether machine, creature, or something else entirely, you’ll face the violent legacy of the last survivors of humanity.

title: Half-Life Alyx NoVR
description: Half-Life Alyx NoVR is a mod that lets you experience the next story in the Half-Life universe on a flat screen, without any VR equipment. It adapts most of the VR interactions and features to a traditional mouse and keyboard setup, such as gravity gloves, weapon upgrades, cranks, doors, cabinets and more. It also supports many other workshop mods that enhance the gameplay and visuals.

title: Mega Man: Wily Tower
description: The 8-bit demake of Wily Tower is finally finished! Play through the Wily Tower mode from Mega Man: The Wily Wars as a standalone game, with modern quality of life features and bonus content! It includes a playable Proto Man and Bass, optional "improved" versions of the weapons, bonus stages, extra bosses, a boss rush mode, cheats and more!

title: Koro-koro Reimu 2
description: This is the second installment of the side-scrolling action game Korokoro Reimu.

description: Kowloon's Rhizome: A Day of the Fire is an Adventure game.

title: Kowloon's Rhizome: A Day of the Fire - Vol. 2

title: Kowloon's Rhizome: A Day of the Fire - Vol. 3
description: Kowloon's Rhizome: A Day of the Fire is an Adventure game.

title: Pacer: Classic
description: Immerse yourself in Pacer: Classic, an adrenaline-fueled anti-gravity racing game set in a vast, interconnected universe. Personalize your paceship and weapons, engage in a riveting campaign, or single-player races, or even face off against your foes in a dynamic online multiplayer race within the expansive PacerVerse.

title: 1 Date Danger
description: It's your first semester at the prestigious Lombardi University, and you've immediately dived head first into the chaos of organizing the student-run New Year festival. You immediately befriend Trait, a kind but slightly disturbed rabbit, and his best friend Stoney, a perma-stoned dog who keeps up a strong emotional guard around new people. What will you do to win their hearts?

title: Geminism
description: Two pairs of twins war for love, life, and limb beneath the curtain of a dark Tokyo night. From the artisans at CRAFTWORK comes a visual novel lush with art, action, and mystery; a story of GEMINISM—deformity and divinity.

title: Doodle Dice Monsters
description: Doodle Dice Monsters is strategic turn-based battling game where you draw your own characters! Form your six character dream team, then duel in tag-team combat: the winner not only gets epic loot, but gets to take one of the defeated Doodlemon for their own!

title: Arugisu no Tsubasa
description: Arugisu no Tsubasa (Wings of Arugis) is a sequel for Miracle Warriors: Seal of the Dark Lord.

title: Le Fol
description: Le Fol is a point-and-click narrative game with multiple endings, puzzles, and poetry, featuring neo-impressionist 2D isometric art. Inspired by The Fool’s Journey from the Tarot de Marseille and the city of São Paulo, it follows an unconventional protagonist, exploring the fragility of human connections across eight branching storylines.

title: Magic and Legend: Star Seekers
description:
Magic and Legend: Star Seekers is an arcade platformer with the goal of collecting stars across multiple levels themed on locations around the world with a variety of other game styles in between.
The second in a planned trilogy of homebrew games.

title: Grandmaster's Gambit
description: A different take on the chess genre. Build massively overpowered decks to fend off endless hordes of chess-like pieces and seek out the 8 Grandmasters in this open-world deckbuilding roguelike experience.

title: Romarinho a Caminho do Gol
description: Romarinho a Caminho do Gol is an interactive CD-ROM featuring puzzle and soccer-related games.

title: Cuber 2: Ice Age
description: Cuber 2: Ice Age is the sequel of Cuber if your not sure you will like this game play Cuber one and then come back.

title: The Groundskeeper
description: The Groundskeeper is a 2D top-down indie horror game featuring retro pixel art and a mysterious threat to uncover. Button up your overalls and grab your flashlight as the night shift approaches and Gramen Park needs its guardian... for you may find that something sinister lurks in the dark.

title: Power Rangers: Beats of Power - Special Edition
description: Power Rangers: Beats of Power Special Edition is a version of the game with several improvements, such as support for 4 players, one additional Zord level, new easy mode and life bars for bosses.

title: Holding Keys
description: Step into the shoes of a food enthusiast and embark on a gastronomic adventure like no other. Unlock hidden taste profiles by holding the keys while preparing a wide range of dishes from various cuisines. Engage in fun time mechanics, experiment with ingredients, and challenge yourself with time management.

title: Tsukihime Typing Online
description: a versus typing game featuring the cast of Tsukihime

title: Tomb Raider II: The Forbidden Place
description:

title: Working Noir

How far will one man go to prove his innocence?

title: Kalikan
description: Kalikan is a vertically scrolling bullet hell 'shmup inspired by Dodonpachi- pushing the limits of ~virtual~ hardware . Control one of 3 1 ship(s) featuring two varied attack modes . Maintain your chain to compete for the highest scores.

title: Dark Table CCG
description:
Dark Table CCG is multiplayer card gaming re-imagined: Free-to-play, online 4-player, cheaper and easier deck-building, more customization that matters, and a focus on social atmosphere and building friendships. We listened to everything card gamers desperately want, that AAA is not providing, and built it into an experience that will be unparalleled.

Set in a grim Lovecraftian theme, Dark Table brings a unique strategic experience with up to 4 players battling in a free-for-all, using temporary alliances and mutual interest to get ahead. Select your leader and build your deck around it to survive the onslaught and claim your world.

title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato HD Remaster

Remaster of the 1985 Laserdisc arcade game Uchuu Senkan Yamato.

Apart of the Taito LD Game Collection.

title: Time Gal HD Remaster
description:
An HD remaster of an action game in which Reika, the ace of the historical security police, goes back in time and tracks down the future great villain Luda, who stole a time machine and fled to the past.

A part of the Taito LD Game Collection.

title: Revenge of the Ninja HD Remaster
description:
Included in the Taito LD Game Collection.

The player guides Hayate through the "Castle of Evil" avoiding dubious traps and fighting various enemies such as "the fire breathing Marco Killmore, the Wolves of Seidenfeld," and "the Immortal Skeleton Warriors of the Undead."

The gameplay is in the format of an interactive movie where the player has a limited amount of time to hit the right commands from the prompts on screen. The success or failure of completing these quick-time events will determine the set of animation you will receive, which will either depict Hayate delving further into the castle or humorously being squished between a wall of spikes. The player earns a score for how well they can run through each level and time the button presses.

If players were able to master the game and complete the game on hard mode, the publisher Renovation Products, Inc. would supply the player with a "Master of Ninja Arts" degree.

title: Taito LD Game Collection
description: A collection of Taito's LaserDisc games: Time Gal, Uchuu Senkan Yamato (Space Battleship Yamato), and Revenge of the Ninja for Nintendo Switch.

title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato
description:
Uchuu Senkan Yamato is based on the anime series Space Battleship Yamato, also known as Star Blazers. The events of the game follow those of the initial episodes.

This incarnation of the series is essentially a real-time strategy game with a somewhat unusual approach to the genre. Rather than navigating units on battlefields, the player takes direct control of every crew member onboard the ship. Each one of them is responsible for a certain function (supplying power, manning a gun, turning the ship, etc.); in order to win battles, it is crucial to coordinate their actions. The game proceeds in real time, but pauses when the player accesses crew members and performs actions for them.

title: Marble It Up! Ultra
description:
Marble It Up! Ultra is the pinnacle of marble platforming from the minds behind Marble It Up! and Marble Blast. World-class level design, buttery-smooth controls, gorgeous visuals, and exhilarating multiplayer - welcome to the ultimate marble experience!

Roll through an extensive single-player campaign filled with dangerous obstacles, mind-bending paths, shifting gravity, bouncy floors, and potent power-ups.

Embrace the five competitive and chaotic multiplayer modes. Team up to hunt gems, score goals, escape zombies, and prove your marble mettle online. Blast your way to glory!

Unlock a magnificent collection of marbles, trails, and hats! Find hidden trophies, earn medals, and play online - all while earning your next piece of marble fashion.

Push yourself to the next level. Hunting achievements and climbing the Global Leaderboards are sure-fire ways to become a marble master! Weekly Challenges add new modifiers to levels for a fresh new way to compete each week!

Get ready to roll!

title: River City: Rival Showdown
description:
River City Ransom is back, rebuilt from the ground up! Rekindle old rivalries and relive past rumbles through a completely revamped story!

A re-release of the classic Nintendo 3DS sandbox brawler, this version of the game has been updated with tweaked controls, graphical upgrades, and a new online mode in the form of Double Dragon Duel 2023.

description:
You work the 24/7 at your own bar. Between dealing with rabid rodents and wild customers, you have your hands full. Today seems to be your unlucky day.

The Ballbusters have planned their biggest raid yet, and every hour seems to be rush hour! It's up to you to take care of these pests... well, and the moles too.

title: EA Sports UFC 5
description: EA Sports UFC 5 is as real as it gets. Powered by Frostbite engine’s advanced rendering capabilities, your favorite fighters now have unparalleled character likenesses to complement next-level environment fidelity that’ll make their walk to the Octagon feel like a PPV main event. The all-new authentic damage system brings the intensity and strategy of a fight to life, as cuts and strikes absorbed can affect mobility, defense, stamina, and more. Take too much damage, and the doctor will check to see if you’re able to continue. For lovers of the ground game, the new Transition-Based Submissions make grappling feel more fluid and realistic than ever before. And if you like to admire your handiwork, new Cinematic K.O. Replays capture your fight-ending finishes in all their punishing glory. Plus, a completely revamped live service schedule builds exciting challenges around all PPV fight weeks. Bring the next evolution of the fight game home with UFC 5.

A shy protagonist undergoes an intense training for his first kiss!!
Everything for the sake of the one he loves...

title: Needy Princess Nerd Club
description: Kaoruko joins the nerd club full of boys so that she can receive attention from them. An nerdy princess with a strong need for approval goes wild!

title: Eroblast: Waifu Dating Sim
description: You'll be able to chat with attractive girls, know their engaging storylines, receive spicy pictures, and solve Match-3 Puzzles to unlock new and cool pick-up lines for your waifu!

title: QUByte Classics: Risky Woods
description: Fortunately, you - the young warrior Rohan - have arrived to deliver justice to the evil hordes. With weapons in hand you must enter the risky woods and free the monks from their petrified captivity. Only when you've set the monks free and sent Draxos back to hell will wisdom be restored for good.

title: Eroblast: 24 Hot Waifus
description:
24 Hot Waifus includes:
- Playful Pack
- Spicy Pack
- Passion Pack

title: Polar Pool
description: Chalk up your cue and play some pool - just watch out for airborne penguins! Play classic games like 8 and 9-ball, or use power-ups, bonus pockets, and special characters to master the game.

title: Don’t Let It Out
description:
There’s something in your bathroom. No matter what you do, don’t let it out.

Don't Let It Out is a short horror game that takes about 10-30 minutes. It is connected another game "From the Sun to the Moon" but it isn't necessary to play that one first to enjoy this one. The main character is nonbinary and uses they/them pronouns.

title: From the Sun to the Moon
description: Soleil (pronounced “soh-lay”) and her girlfriend Esmeray (pronounced “ehz-mer-ay”) have been together for almost three years! Leading up to their third year anniversary, Soleil decides the best way to celebrate would be to take Esmeray out on a date each day leading up to their anniversary! Will the dates be successful, or end in total failure? Play now to find out!

title: Blood on the Clocktower
description:
Blood on the Clocktower is a game of murder and mystery, lies and logic, deduction and deception for five-to-twenty courageous players and one devious storyteller.

A social game played in person or online, seated in a circle, each player receives either a ‘good’ or ‘evil’ token with their unique character on it. Good players share information to solve the mystery whilst evil players lie about who they are and what they know. The good team wins if they can piece together their knowledge, trust each other, and execute the demon. The evil team wins if the demon can sow distrust, evade detection, and wipe out the village.

title: Untitled Black Panther Game
description:
A game involving Black Panther was announced during the 57th anniversary celebration of the character. It was the first project for EA's novel studio, Cliffhanger Games, announced as an original, third-person, single-player Black Panther game in collaboration with Marvel Games.

The project was cancelled in May 2025 following the closure of the studio.

title: EA Sports FC 24
description: EA Sports FC 24 is a football simulation game and the first entry in the series following the rebranding from the FIFA name. It features licensed leagues and competitions including the Premier League, UEFA Champions League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, and several women's football leagues. Game modes include Ultimate Team, Career Mode, and online multiplayer. The game uses the Frostbite engine with updated motion capture and ball physics for realistic on-pitch action.

title: Stark Tower Defense
description:
Oh no! The town is under attack in the Stark Tower Defense game. The Marvel superheroes have no other choice but to do their best to stop the villains from conquering their headquarters. The Stark Tower is the only thing keeping them close, so they have to defend it at any price.

There are various defenses you can opt for when protecting the city. Each one is based on one hero's superpower. It is on you to be the strategical mastermind behind the defense line. Without your bird's eye view of the problem, these superheroes will be lost!

title: Minecraft: Better than Adventure!
description: Better than Adventure is a mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3. It was originally intended to add a few new features for a personalised experience, but has since grown into a full-fledged fork of Minecraft, adding dozens of new features for players to enjoy. Its philosophy is to add new gameplay that enhances and improves on the existing aspects of the game, without drastically changing the core experience. The question we like to ask ourselves is, "Would Mojang have added this to the vanilla game back in 2011?" If the answer is yes, it's probably a good candidate for BTA.

title: Street Fighter 6: Year 1 Ultimate Pass
description: The Year 1 Ultimate Pass includes 4 new characters, 3 outfits with colors 1-10 for the new characters, 2 additional stages and 7,700 Drive tickets (in-game currency).

title: Fear Underground
description: Left alone with the horror of the dungeon, the main character must uncover its secret. It is he who will become not only a test of strength and endurance, but also a guiding thread leading to the unraveling of the unknown forces guarding this secret.

title: Homeworld: Raider Retreat
description: Homeworld: Raider Retreat is a promotional version of Homeworld that was made available through the pre-order version of Homeworld: Cataclysm. The game added an additional mission, along with the first four missions, focusing primarily on the Turanic Raiders, which was cut from the original game for unknown reasons. None of these missions are available in Homeworld: Cataclysm.

title: Mage Mayhem
description: Mage Mayhem is a team-based strategy game where you can compete in up to 4v4 battles with your friends competing across different game modes and maps to prove who is the best mage. Customize your character with many different classes, abilities, and perks to fit your playstyle.

title: Shuvani
description: Shuvani is an isometric roguelite with a Romani-inspired aesthetic, where action and strategy complement each other in a system of magic related to music. Will you be able to escape from the forest?

title: Bionic Momentum
description: A hardcore old school 2D physics-based sci-fi action puzzle platformer, with an emphasis on retaining speed and momentum

title: Shan Hai Express
description: Step aboard Shan Hai Express and experience an fantasy journey through the world of the ancient Chinese mythology Shan Hai Jing ( 山海经 ). This is an interactive narrative game inspired by the nonlinear structure of the text of "Shan Hai Jing".

title: Cabezurrio vs Robots
description: Platform game in which we control Cabezurrio, a soldier who must collect all the gems and destroy all the robots in its path in several different scenarios. We have a rifle with which to shoot the robots.

title: CometSoldier
description: "Comet Soldier" is a 2D top-down view action shooting game. Advance through the battlefield and defeat the bosses that await.

title: Rise of Block
description: Rise of Block is an endless game where you avoid obstacles trying to beat your high score.

title: Rescue To The Parallel
description: Collect allies and weapons in parallel worlds and defeat thousands of enemies. Rescue to the Parallel is a new roguelike game. Rescue characters to make friends, search for weapons and treasure chests. The route you choose extends your survival time infinitely.

title: Yappie! Knockout
description: You can play with up to 24 players simultaneously across 13 levels. It's time to call your friends and use your running, jumping, and other skills to win in Yappie!

title: HamsterBall Soccer
description: Hamsterball Soccer is a funny football game with simple mechanics. Challenge the AI or your friends in two modes where you can play with up to 8 players in 18 levels with its own unique characteristics. Share your controllers to play with a maximum number of players. A game for the whole family.

title: Video Editor's Toolkit
description: Take on the role of Mark Brown and edit the GMTK video of the best games of this year's jam! Watch out though, because the video editing software is misbehaving a bit today... it may get a bit puzzly!

title: Underlevel
description: Underlevel is a game where you play as a horde of skeletons while a player is raiding the dungeon, trying to get as much XP as they can so they level up and potentially kill the boss at the end - it's your job to stop that from happening. Try your best to rescue all the skeletons, destroy all the loot and keep the player from levelling up before they make it to the final floor.

title: Maple Winters in Leafbud Rampage!!
description: An action roguelite horde survival game about Maple Winters.

title: Ednaldo Pereira: Mobile
description: Ednaldo Pereira: Mobile is a captivating platform game inspired by platforming classics that offers an engaging and challenging gaming experience. Explore different stages filled with obstacles, enemies, and treasures to unlock. Overcome thrilling challenges, collect golden notes, and improve your skills while enjoying vibrant graphics and an exciting soundtrack with remixes of Ednaldo's classics.

title: Wyrmicide: Tombstone Die
description: Unlock the Tombstone die to let loose the living dead! This DLC allows you to bring the Tombstone die into any battle. It offers new pieces and buffs, and its offerings may be purchased by either player in a match.

title: Ascending Inferno
description:
Ascending Inferno is your ultimate goal in this gorgeous, challenging-but-fair 2.5D precision platformer with a ball.

Playing as Dani, it’s not enough to run, jump and platform your way out of Hell - you’ll need to dribble, kick and header her dead brother Vincent’s ball-shaped soul along with you!

Just be sure you don’t fumble the ball - the depths of Hell is a long way to fall…

title: Cafe Master Story
description:
Have you ever wanted to run your own coffee shop?
The smell of fresh roast beans, the gurgling of the espresso machine, the sheen of a squeaky-clean counter... All this and more await you in this quirky sim game!
Just set up your tables and counter seats, and wait for the customers to come rolling in. Add handy features like magazine racks, or chic furnishings to give your cafe a more welcoming atmosphere.

title: Disrepair
description: Disrepair is a 9 (10 counting secret) map episode that makes use of G/ZDoom enhancements, including, but not limited to, DECORATE monsters, 3D Floors, and Scripted Events. There is also a Survival Mode included, which changes seven of the maps into an endless horde mode with some slight objectives.

title: Marathon: Resurrection
description: he Marathon: Resurrection project is breathing new, fully 3D life into an old 2.5D action game. With the advanced 3D capabilities of today's graphics cards, Marathon can become an even more visually-stunning and addictive game. The vessel for this rebirth: Unreal Tournament.

title: The Last Solver
description: Solving puzzles is all you need to save humanity.

title: EA Sports FC 24: Ultimate Edition
description: We welcomes you to The World's Game: the most true-to-football experience ever with HyperMotionV, PlayStyles optimised by Opta, and a revolutionised Frostbite Engine.

title: Gylt: Collector's Edition
description:
Gylt - Collector's Edition invites players into a beautifully crafted world filled with captivating storytelling and atmospheric exploration.

This collector’s edition includes:
- physical copy of the game
- an exclusive art book showcasing stunning concept art and designs
- a soundtrack CD featuring the hauntingly beautiful music
- a collectible poster to enhance your gaming experience.

As players navigate a dark and twisted version of a familiar world, they will encounter unique puzzles, challenging foes, and heartfelt narratives that resonate deeply. Ideal for both avid fans and newcomers, this limited edition is a must-have for collectors and gamers alike.

title: NBA 2K24: Black Mamba Edition
description:
Grab your squad and experience the past, present, and future of hoops culture in NBA 2K24. Enjoy pure, authentic action and limitless personalized MyPLAYER options in MyCAREER. Collect an impressive array of legends and build your perfect lineup in MyTEAM. Relive your favorite eras as a GM or Commissioner in MyNBA. Experience next-level gameplay and lifelike visuals with your favorite NBA and WNBA teams in PLAY NOW.

Recreate some of Kobe’s most dominant and captivating performances during his rise to global superstardom. Revisit his early career triumphs as a young phenom, and progress through his transcendent journey from elite scorer to one of the greatest players of all time.

title: 30 Sport Games in 1
description:
Ready to win?!
"30 Sport Games in 1" is the ultimate game that brings together 30 different sports in one game!

title: Yandere AI Girlfriend Simulator: With You Til The End
description: Escape Room game with a Yandere AI girlfriend, who is integrated using ChatGPT.

title: Kraken Odyssey
description: Little kraken in danger! Dive into this 3D action game and avoid dangers. Explore worlds like beaches, jungles, mountains, dungeons. Unlock costumes, be a pirate or unicorn. Love octopuses, beach, adventure? Play Kraken Odyssey!

title: Schlag den Star: Das 3. Spiel
description: Fans of the popular TV show "Schlag den Star" can look forward to a new gaming experience: "Schlag den Star" is back in its third edition. The game promises even more fun, excitement and challenging games for all fans of the format.

title: A Life of Logic
description:
A Life of Logic (ALOL) is a story-based game built upon an elegant logic puzzle where the objective is to fill a board with two different tiles while satisfying three simple rules. How simple? You'll find out after installing :)
Solve challenging puzzles to unfold a charming story about a life full of memorable milestones. Exercise your brain every day with daily challenges. Battle other players in exciting real-time matches. Compete in global tournaments and become the best solver. Welcome to a new life of logic!

title: Hollenburg 'Hell Castle'
description:
You are Father Karras and before you return home with your parishioners, you must travel to the Austrian border and put an end to all these evil experiments.
Explore the castle of hell and defeat the four satanic generals hiding in its dark walls.
Hollenburg is an arcade with video adventure elements; Explore the huge castle, collect items, collect experience points to level up and discover hidden secrets.

title: Jailbreak: The Ultimate Escape
description: Immerse yourself in a captivating journey through the world of incarceration in "Jailbreak: The Ultimate Escape," an exciting and intriguing visual novel game.

title: Master of Magic: Rise of the Soultrapped
description: Master of Magic: Rise of the Soultrapped is a large expansion to a 2022 4X turn-based strategy game, Master of Magic. Rise of the Soultrapped introduces a new kingdom - Techmagic - where magic merges with technology.

title: The World of Nifty Craft
description: The World of Nifty Craft is a 2D Sandbox MMORPG featuring a player-driven economy, classless combat system, and intense real-time PvP battles. Explore the world map, gather resources, craft items and fight monsters. Your Nifty Craft Adventure is written by you!

title: Outbreak: Gwen's Nightmare
description: Live Gwen's desperate fight for survival in the undead apocalypse across Outbreak: Lost Hope and Outbreak: Epidemic!

title: Dogotchi: Virtual Pet - Deluxe Edition
description: Set off on a journey of nurturing and attending to your digital companion in Dogotchi: Virtual Pet. These charming dogs depicted in satisfying pixel art are bound to steal your heart!

title: Pixel Paint 2: Deluxe Edition
description: Pixel Paint 2 is a sequel to an extremely popular game by the same name. The rules are quite simple. Put your mind at ease, follow the numbers, and fill out every last pixel with the right color.

title: Unsolved Case: The Scarlet Hyacinth - Collector's Edition
description: It's time to make your choice! A whole series of crimes happens right before your eyes: a murder in an alley, your boss getting shot, abductions in broad daylight, and so on… Can you deal with it all?

title: Unsolved Case: The Scarlet Hyacinth - DLC
description: It's time to make your choice! A whole series of crimes happens right in front of your eyes: a murder in an alley, the murder of your boss, a kidnapping in broad daylight, and so on... Can you handle it all?

title: 2D Dogfight
description: 2D Dogfight is a simple air combat game. Players can drive various jet aircrafts from the Cold War to modern times to complete various types of combat missions. The game has a basic simulation of the physics of aircrafts, allowing players to experience the charm of air combat in the 2D world.

title: Lofi Ball
description: Lofi Ball Is A 3D Platforming Game, Inspired By Super Monkey Ball And Ball Race, Dodge Obstacles And Smash Through Walls To Get To The End Of Each Level And Find Multiple Ways To Complete Levels, Has Endless Mode And Infinite Levels

title: Lofi Ball: Wipeout
description: This DLC will give you 10 more levels to play and some more customization for your ball

title: Lofi Ball: Dungeon
description: This DLC will give you 10 more levels to play and some more customization for your ball

title: Urânio 235
description: Urânio 235 is a point-and-click adventure game designed to teach basic chemistry to high school students where you have been sent to an abandoned village by a UFO and told about the story of aliens who lived there and how a miscalculated neutron beam has hit a uranium atom, destroying most of its population. Now your mission is to deactivate the beam.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Randomizer
description: A randomizer mod for The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.

title: Safe Robber
description: A simple sokoban-like puzzle game about robbing houses full of furniture.

title: Computer Repair Shop
description: Become a dishonest computer repairman, steal rams. Burn the motherboards!

title: Mad Way
description: Mad Way is a game where you have to climb a strange universe without falling to find your love!

title: What Remains of Us
description: When you left the capital to escape the clutches of the sun god's council, you hoped that you could put your past behind you and start anew. Unfortunately for you, pasts always have a way of catching up to people; and yours just happened to come in the package of a bleeding man at your doorway.

title: Astor: Blade of the Monolith
description:
Journey across Gliese, a mystical world under threat by dark forces in this vibrant, action RPG. Aided by a mysterious presence, embark on a dangerous adventure with the power of the Runic Swarm in your hands. Crush the minions of evil on your path to fulfill your destiny and become the planet’s savior.

Aided by a mysterious presence, embark on a dangerous adventure with the power of the Runic Swarm in your hands. Crush the minions of evil on your path to fulfill your destiny and become the planet’s savior.

Play as Astor—a young Diokek engaged in a fight for his world’s survival as he attempts to unearth the secrets of the past. Learn new abilities, gain magical powers, and collect legendary weapons on your quest to stop an unholy ritual.

title: CoopValor 2056: Ukraine WW3
description: Fight in Ukraine as a soldier of the Ukrainian special forces or the International Legion. Fight alone or with friends against AI enemies and other players to reconquer Europe.

title: The Making of Karateka
description: Play the history. Go behind the scenes of Jordan Mechner's landmark game Karateka in this interactive documentary from Digital Eclipse, with archival materials, video features, and more. Experience pixel-perfect versions of this legendary game, with all-new features.

title: Three Glyph Tiles
description: Three Glyph Tiles is a tile placement puzzle game by Modular Independent Interactive.

title: Chromata
description:
Chromata is a game about experimentation in an original way.

You don't have control of the movements of the character but rather mix up colors in order to move him in the game world. Red moves the player forward, Blue makes the player jump vertically, pink makes him jump at an angle, green makes the player stomp downwards. Now add to that that you can boost the effects of colors by adding up to four of them in a row, just pick your 10 colors, chose the direction and then watch as your mixture of colors gets auto-played to see if you beat the level or not. Can't you already see how many possibilities there are?

title: Iceberg Command
description: This game recreates the eternal strugle between ships and icebergs. But you are the icebergs.

title: Traveler's Game
description:
You are Camus Chen. Yesterday you received a video mail from your friend Lu. He thinks you have too few friends and recommends you a popular game:
『This is a battle game but many people use it as a chat room』
Lu told you so.

You decided to join your friends in this game to meet new opponents and chat with them while playing against them. Lu wants you to chill.

But what you didn't expect is that some of your opponents will have a connection to your life in the future. One of them will even learn the great secret behind you and your friends...

title: Taishou Mebiusline Teito Bibouroku
description:
A fandisc of Taishou Mebiusline.

The FD features the after stories of Hiiragi Kyouichirou and the four other main characters: Misaki, Shigure, Senge Iori, Tatebayashi Kai. In addition, the twins Ise Kaoru and Ise Kahoru also get their own mini-route.

title: Of Moons and Mania
description: Of Moons and Mania is an interactive psychostic break, based on lived experience. It uses elements of its design to explain the struggles of psychosis, and tells a personal story about mental illness.

title: Holy Breaker! The Witch Betrayed Blue Moon Wicca
description: Hinoue Itaru's visual novel project, with Kashida Leo as the scenario writer. A low-priced visual novel that was initially sold at Comiket 87.

title: Holy Breaker! 2 The Wish in the Night of the Star Talers
description: Sequel to Holy Breaker.

title: Kagami no Kuni no Legend
description:
Kagami no Kuni no Legend is a Japanese-style first-person adventure game. The player interacts with the game world by selecting verb commands from a menu and combining them with objects or characters. Commands such as "Examine" or "Talk" appear at most screens; if an object can be taken, an appropriate command is displayed after the player has thoroughly examined a location. There is also an inventory with items that must be used at specific moments; however, there are no real puzzles in the game. Navigation is done by selecting the "Move" command; in a few locations the player navigates the hero with directional buttons in a pseudo-3D environment. Wrong choices may sometimes lead to a Game Over.

Most of the background and character graphics is done in anime style, with the exception of Noriko herself, who appears in digital photos, sometimes accompanied by song performances.

title: Cell Phone Love Letter
description:
Romance visual novel by Love Conquers All Games.
Cell Phone Love Letter was scripted entirely in Ren'Py, as an entry in 2007's NaNoRenO. It's a short non-branching visual novel.

title: Touhou Fantasy Destination
description: What kind of game is this? This is a second fan game of Oriental project. This work contains different settings from the original, so please pay attention to the players who feel uncomfortable about it

title: W.O.L.F
description: Become Wolf, a research staff member, and get to the "place to return". This is an action game that can be played easily with only the mouse! Clear about 50 challenging action scenes while repeating failures over and over again!

title: West Ride
description: Explore a mysterious world, conquer challenges in West Ride, an anime-inspired open-world driving game full of excitement and adventure.

title: Born to Rise
description: To complete Yridis' mission, you'll have to make your way through the bowels of a vast underground dungeon filled with unique environments, deadly dangers and mysterious beings. Jump, dash and give the enemies you encounter their due thanks to powerful weapons.

title: City Car Parking Simulator
description: Enjoy city driving in the City Car Parking Simulator, full of realistic driving experiences and challenging parking missions. Customize your vehicle and test your skills in this simulation game that offers a unique atmosphere with its graphics.

title: Continent of the Ninth Golden
description: Continent of the Ninth Golden is an action MMORPG. Players take part in the game as heroes of Blenheim to stand against Nefer, an evil villain trying to open a gate to the Netherworld and swarm the land with his infernal legion.

title: Sky the Scraper
description: This is a building cleaning Roguelike action game, about a young man named Sky, who chases uncertain dreams as a building cleaner. Conquer thrilling randomly changing high-rise stages, upgrade skills and gear with your money and will, and find your path within a two-month limit.

title: Shadow of the Night: Monsters
description: Shadow of the Night : Monster is a battle against monsters on a deserted island and a struggle for survival.

title: Just Find It 2
description: Find more differences and play an assortment of fun new games in Just Find It 2!

title: I Love Finding Cats & Pups
description: Have a pawsome adventure finding cats and pups!

title: Tay Son Dynasty
description: This is a multiplayer action combat game set in the period of Tay Son dynasty which had many victories highlighted the intelligence, bravery and patriotism of the Vietnamese people.

title: The Legend of Santa
description: Run and jump through the North Pole on a quest to take back Santa's Workshop from the evil South Pole Troll and save Christmas!

title: My Mundane Life Is Threatened by the Tropes of an RPG!!!
description:
You play as Natsuna, a girl who works at a nondescript office doing nondescript work.

Doesn't really matter, that's the boring part! But her daily mundane "life" of a monotonous cycle is interrupted by Slimes, Boss fights, Giant Crabs and more!

title: 100 Doors Escape: Let me In!
description: 100 doors game challenges and brain teasers are quite fun, but we invite you to try your luck in 100 Doors Escape: Let me In! Join our guy in this toilet rush game and help him overcome numerous obstacles by playing hidden object mini games and solving escape puzzles. 100 Doors Escape: Let me In! game is a fun find the key to open the doors experience. Unlock the door to enter the room in this quite amusing get in the toilet game.

title: Flipinity
description:
Flipinity is a puzzle game with very straightforward gameplay which can surprisingly lead to very challenging combinations. Your task is to rearrange board tiles using pre-defined operations to assembly either compact image or pattern. One could say that game mechanics is a combination of the jigsaw puzzle and the 15-puzzle.
The game features 96 hand-crafted levels divided into 5 level sets that ensure that the difficulty curve is not so steep. But do not be fooled - to finish all the levels is definitively not a piece of cake. When in trouble, try to spot a hidden trick that each level has in it.
There are 3 game modes: jigsaw-like image assembly, number tiles ordering and pattern recreation. Does the level count seem to low? Feel free to generate a random level for each game mode with the in-build level generator.

title: Andromeda Six: Team Time with Oppo
description: side story for the sci-fi visual novel, Andromeda Six.

title: Aliens Versus Predator 2: Gold Edition
description:
Aliens Vs. Predator 2 Gold Edition brings together thrilling campaigns and intense multiplayer action, offering a unique gaming experience that spans three different species. It takes players back to planet LV-1201, the historic first encounter site with the Aliens, where an ominous new threat lurks. Here, human scientists have managed to clone Aliens, adding a new dimension of danger. Simultaneously, a band of Predators have also arrived on LV-1201, seeking their own challenging hunt.

This edition includes both the original Aliens Vs. Predator 2 game and the intriguing Primal Hunt expansion pack, enhancing the narrative and gameplay opportunities. Players have the flexibility to choose from any species in the exhilarating multiplayer mode, further amplifying the unpredictable nature and diversity of the game. The Gold Edition thus expands on the classic Aliens Vs. Predator experience, promising a dynamic, thrilling journey through one of sci-fi's most enduring universes.

title: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour Thailand
description: An unforgettable journey to the land of bright colors, smiles and fabulous beaches. Collect puzzles and enjoy the atmosphere of mysterious Thailand.

title: Team Fortress 2: Gold Rush Update
description:
The Gold Rush Update, also referred to as the Medic Update, was the first major content update for Team Fortress 2.

The update centered around the Medic as the first class to receive three new weapons that provided alternate means of gameplay. Alongside the introduction of these weapons, the Character Info and Loadout system was implemented to allow players to equip the different weapons that would come in later updates.

The update also detailed the introduction of the new Payload gamemode, the related titular map Gold Rush, and the release of Meet the Scout. Numerous improvements and additions were also included.

title: Hyperbowl Plus! Edition
description:
HyperBowl Plus! Edition is a 3D bowling-style video game made in 2001 by HyperEntertainment. It was published by Microsoft, and could only be accessed by use of a Microsoft Plus! CD-ROM.

The version of HyperBowl included in Microsoft Plus! for Windows XP contains two of the six lanes initially available (Classic and Pins of Rome) and is designed for a single player. When the upgrade has been purchased and installed, four additional lanes are installed. Multiplayer support is also enabled, allowing up to four players to bowl and keep track of their scores during a game.

HyperBowl is similar to a basic game of ten-pin bowling: the goal is to knock down as many of the ten pins as possible within thirty seconds. Unlike in normal bowling, the lane also contains obstacles, like moving vehicles in the Tokyo and San Francisco lanes and trees in the Yosemite lane. The player can use a mouse or trackball to guide the ball while it's moving in order to avoid obstacles and aim for the pins. A clock at the upper-right corner of the lane window displays the time left to knock down pins. The game displays players' scores in a similar way to the displays found in traditional bowling alleys. The game ends when all players have completed the ten frames.

title: Russian Square Plus! Edition
description:
A 3D Tetris-like puzzle game. Erase lines or columns by regrouping shapes of the same color. More columns or rows appear at a faster pace as the game progresses resulting in a race against the clock.

All of the games use 3D graphics, themes, sound effects and music to take advantage of the operating system's DirectX capabilities.

title: Rolling Atop It
description: A ball rolling game of epic proportions! Good music, higher-skill gameplay, and enough different rolling mechanics that we might go out of business!

title: Abandonware
description: A lo-fi collection of horror mini games that begins to warp and shift as you uncover more. Play and watch the lines blur between fiction and reality in this one-of-a-kind experience.

title: Team Fortress 2: Mann vs. Machine
description: Mann vs. Machine is a new co-operative game for Team Fortress 2 that lets you and five friends wage a desperate battle to stop a lethal horde of robots from deploying a bomb in one of Mann Co.’s many strongholds. Take advantage of breaks between waves to upgrade your abilities and weapons. Survive all the waves in any of a variety of missions to earn incredible loot.

title: Color Together
description: Activity selected co-op coloring game apart inside of Discord's Nitro program. Grab some friends and let the chill music soothe your soul as you paint some color into the world.

title: Chef Showdown
description: Activity selected co-op cooking rush game apart inside of Discord's Nitro program.

title: Team Fortress 2: The Pyro Update
description:
The Pyro Update was the second major content update for Team Fortress 2.

The Pyro class was the focus of this update. In addition to three new weapons, the latent Hadouken taunt was upgraded to become the first Kill taunt. The update also added compression blast to the Stock Flamethrower, an ability that would become a core technique for the class.

Two community-made maps, Fastlane and Turbine, were made official and included in the update, along with a link to the Valve Developer Community site. Meet the Sniper was also introduced in a similar manner to Meet the Scout. Additionally, many improvements and fixes were included.

title: ChillCraft
description:
A clicker game heavily inspired by Minecraft.

You gather resources and then use the resources to craft and upgrade your world and unlock new features. Survival features to be added in the near future.

A simple game to mindlessly click away and forget your life's worries

title: Cosmic Crunch
description: Cosmic Crunch was made as a 3 week long 2nd year student project from Breda University of Applied Sciences as a challenge of making a game with a custom controller. In this game you fly as a fish through space to get to your delicious destination. Dodge the deadly obstacles and crunch through weaker hurdles. Eat powerup boxes to regain lives.

title: Elephantastic
description: Elephantastic is a short cartoony 3D Puzzle Platformer, in which you defeat you enemies through sheer weight!

title: Microsoft Plus! for Windows XP
description:
Microsoft Plus! for Windows XP is an add-on product for the Microsoft Windows XP operating system (OS) that includes additional desktop themes, screen savers, programs, and utilities.
