title: Atominous
description:
Inspect every inch of a contaminated household.
Quarantine hazardous materials.
Encounter residents.
Put yourself in danger.
Be a professional.

title: End of Edge
description: End of Edge is a hardcore wuxia action game

title: Keepers
description: Keepers is a space-themed clicker game. You are an employee of a center tasked with saving a planet - a typical light-year.

title: Danny Phantom: Ghost Frenzy
description:
Help Danny Phantom stop Vlad Plasmius, his arch-enemy, and his evil plan. Halt the ghost invasion with Danny's full Fenton Ghost-Hunting arsenal!

Very similar game mechanics to the developer Wildfire Studio's other game Tumblebugs (2005).

title: KnightMan
description: Knight Man is a 2d Pixel-art retro style platformer. Play As Knightman, a heroic warrior who has taken it upon himself to save the 5 realms from the clutches of evil. Traverse through 20 hand-crafted levels across 5 unique zones, each populated by a variety of enemies and hazards.

title: Gnome Enchanted Jigsaw Puzzles
description: "Gnome Enchanted Jigsaw Puzzles" bring the whimsical world of gnomes to life! Discover the magic as you assemble pieces featuring vibrant, enchanting gnome realms. Ideal for both kids and adults, these puzzles offer a unique blend of challenge and charm. Perfect for a cozy evening indoors!

title: Jungo
description:
Help Chase the Cheetah rescue his jungle friends in this unique and colorful puzzler.

The villainous vulture Vargas has unleashed a shadowy spell and trapped all the animals in bright bubbles. Using cat-like reflexes and a keen eye for color, arrange the colored bubbles into matching groups to free the captive creatures.

title: Irang: The Last Hope
description: In Joseon, a kingdom honoring the Four Deities, chaos reigns. Nobles have unleashed sealed evils in a power grab, causing calamities. Join Irang and Haru on a journey to liberate the Deities and reclaim Joseon's last hope.

title: EWorlds
description: After an accident, your ship crashes on an unknown island, a convergence point between worlds. Explore impossible landscapes, overcome traps and puzzles, recover the lost Loops, and see if you can find the legendary Golden Loop in this 3D platforming narrative adventure.

title: Sprucerio
description: You went to the forest for a tree. You have a sled on which you transport the tree. A kettle with hot tea (so hot that it doesn't cool down to the end). Lantern and ax. Having cut down a tree, night has come, you return home through a dark forest.

title: Wheat Harvest Paradox
description: A psx style game where you harvest with a harvester. However, you do not live in an ordinary world, you live in a very gloomy and old giant city. Where all the inhabitants of this city are stuck in a time loop. Every day the direction of time changes. It can go both forward and in the opposite direction.

title: Treasure Island 2
description: Set your sails to the Caribbean! Step into the swashbuckling boots of an adventurer and escape to an exotic deserted island to loot pirates' buried treasure. Use your time wisely and match three or more treasures into lines - horizontal, vertical or diagonal. Do it right and the crazy pirate skeletons will do a jig just for you!

title: Why?
description: A bizarre and oddly captivating journey of patience, self-reflection, destruction, and meditation. Embrace the challenge, endure bare-knuckle blows, and seek the mystical light in this ethereal clicker game.

title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Gold
description: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Gold is a compilation for PC that includes RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 and its Soaked! expansion pack. It was developed by Frontier Developments and published by Atari.

title: New Years Eve Slaughter 2022
description: This wad contains 5 short slaughter-ish maps (plus 1 bookend map) that are all fairly difficult.

title: Pocket Slaughter
description:
The wad is divided into 5-map episodes, each with a different visual theme. There is some semblance of a difficulty curve, both within each episode and for the megawad in general. Certainly map 30 is a bit harder than map 1.

All difficulty settings are supported. UV is the primary difficulty for those who want a challenge, and HNTR was designed to be a more casual experience. HMP is somewhere in between and may not be as well balanced as the other two.

Pistol starts are enforced through MBF21 death exits. There are no secrets besides the exits on maps 15/31.

title: Moonblood
description: Moonblood is a 32-level megawad for Doom 2. It's split into 6 episodes and features small/medium-sized levels, vanilla mechanics, and a custom soundtrack. Its main inspirations were Scythe 1, Jenesis, Mano Laikas, and the DTWID series.

title: Exomoon
description: Exomoon (aka Moonblood X) is a megawad for Doom 2. The levels are a somewhat mix of the original Moonblood with some early BTSX levels twist on them, focusing in a mix of the ruins/temple theme with some exotic natural landscapes. Scythe and Mano Laikas also have a strong influence on this. It has been tested on zdoom 2.8 and prboom 2.5.1.3.

title: 180 Minutes Pour Vivre
description:
180 Minutes Pour Vivre is a collection of 32 new Doom II maps put together by the French Doom Community & friends.
Loosely following the recipe of the 3 Heures d'Agonie speedmapping series, this mapset makes use of a few extra assets to introduce a fresh, unusual, and definitely eerie setting.

title: Mapping at Warpspeed
description: Mapping at Warpspeed is a 32 map megawad created as the ninth edition of the Pineapple Under the Sea speedmapping series. Each map was made with a 10 hour time limit and with the rule of crossing UFOs over each level ﻿to provide a semblance of continuity﻿﻿.

title: Uprising
description: Grab your bat, lock your shields and light up that molotov: it’s time to take to the streets! Uprising is a brutal modern day riot simulator, where you fight either as police or protestors in a frenzied multiplayer melee/shooter mash-up.

title: Marswar
description:
You are a Martian terraformer stuck in a small station in the middle of nowhere.

Since the beginning of the terraforming project, the United Organizations of Earth have been threatening to take over. Recent events have prompted an invasion from Earth, only something went wrong with their new "space-warp" capable ships... that were built by some company with the initials "MS".

title: Anomaly Report
description: Anomaly Report is a horror game where you monitor live surveillance feeds, identifying anomalies like moving furniture or supernatural entities. Spotting an anomaly requires filing a report detailing its type and location. With observation and memory, you must survive, and uncover hidden secrets.

title: Strategic Mind: Fight for Dominance
description: Lead the German offensive and stand at the head of the Red Army in Strategic Mind: Fight for Dominance, a set that includes campaigns from the games Strategic Mind: Spectre of Communism and the previously unavailable Strategic Mind: Blitzkrieg.

title: Catan: Console Edition - Super Deluxe
description: Play the official video game of Catan on Console! On a board that comes to life, challenge friends locally or play the AI, then take these skills online with full cross-play compatibility! The Super Deluxe edition includes The Helpers, Championship Maps, Dice Skin & Hex Frames.

title: Lost Crystals
description: Unearth the hidden gems waiting to be discovered in the foggy valley. Immerse yourself in the calm and let the magic of Lost Crystals wash over you. Are you ready to embark on a tranquil adventure like no other?

title: Crystal Math
description: An infinite math runner with varying speeds and difficulty to test your skills.

title: Autumn Hike
description: Prepare to be captivated by the magic of nature as you embark on an unforgettable autumn journey. Are you ready to experience the beauty and serenity of the autumn forest in Autumn Hike? Lace up your boots and step into the adventure today!

title: Deceive Inc.: Neon Nights
description: Agent Hans gets a rude awakening when the ex-henchman who cut off his arm comes out of retirement! With his days of villainy behind him, new agent Sasori aims to bring Deceive Inc. into the future of corporate espionage.

title: Sizif
description: Sizif is a 3D endless runner where you simply control a ball and avoid obstacles to generate score for the longest time possible and climb the leaderboard. During a game you can unlock bonuses to either make your run easier or generate more score.

title: Crossroad of Worlds: Cursed Letters - Collector's Edition
description: Step out into the light! What do you do when someone intentionally steers you astray? Detectives of the Worlds' Edge agency are ever watchful. You have another task to accomplish - find out who could benefit from the stolen stars not returning to their rightful owners?

title: Yeerk Pool
description:
Yeerk Pool is an Animorphs arcade-style game, offered on the official Animorphs website.

Your challenge is to help Jake find his way through the maze to the Yeerk Pool. You can control Jake's movements with the arrow keys on your keyboard, or with the J-I-K-L keys.

As you find the colored keys, use them to free the gorillas from their matching-colored cages. Once you've released a gorilla, you can use its morph (by hitting the space bar) to help Jake chase off the controllers...but remember, you can only stay in the gorilla morph a limited time.

If you encounter any animals along the way, be sure to stop and collect them for extra points.

You have three chances to help Jake collect all the keys and release all the animals, which then allows Jake entry to the Yeerk Pool area, where you must help him find the Kandrona ray machine that feeds the Yeerks and destroy it. Warning: don't forget to stay away from any roaming Yeerk slugs and use Jake's gorilla morph (by hitting the space bar) to cross the Yeerk Pool.

At the end of the game, your points will be tallied, and you can proceed to the next level. Your game ends when you either run out of time or after you've exhausted all three Jakes. Play again to beat your score!

title: Hamboy: AutoChess Survivor
description: Hamboy is a rogue-like arena shooting game where you fight against aliens by strategically combining 12 attributes and 10 types of weapons to create synergies. As the waves increase, you'll realize that you shouldn't spend gold recklessly.

title: Hector The Cat: Treasure Hunter
description: Hector the Cat: Treasure Hunter is a rogue-lite action-adventure. Explore and battle your way through procedurally generated levels to gather as many Treasure you Can and become the Best Treasure Hunter.

title: Speedrunnerz
description: In this game, you will embark on various trails, each starting in a secure location. As you progress through the portals at the end of each trail, be prepared for increasing levels of difficulty. You are one of the best speedrunners out there!

title: Gutasaga
description: Gutasaga - 2D Strategy RPG pre-viking era game. Immerse yourself in the 550 - 600 AD saga. Be the Viking who opened trade routes with Constantinople. Encounter over 40 nations with unique cultures on your journey. Succeed in trading 205 historically recreated goods. Or try raids and piracy.

title: Capitals Quizzer: Countries Mode
description: Every capital of every country, with national flags.

title: Christmas Magic
description: Christmas Magic is a game where you fly on Santa’s sleigh above the streets in six different countries and drop Christmas presents for boys and girls on their chimneys in time while trying to avoid the scary Gargula from stealing the presents and ruining the night.

title: Throw Me To My Planet
description: A lost square trying to find his planet in a huge space. It's all about a square who wants to go to a planet and face consequences.

title: Genshin Impact: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings
description:
Second major expansion of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Tighnari, Collei and Dori
• New element: Dendro
• New region, Sumeru, with the Dharma Forest area
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Acts I & II
• New story quest for Tighnari
• New main event: Graven Innocence
• …and more!

title: Airframe Ultra
description:
Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing.

From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali Zego zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory… three feet above or six feet below.

title: Genshin Impact: King Deshret and the Three Magi
description:
Version 3.1 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Cyno, Nilou and Candace
• New areas: Hypostyle Desert, Land of Lower Setekh and Land of Upper Setekh
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Acts III & IV
• New story quests for Cyno and Nilou
• New main event: Of Ballads and Brews
• …and more!

title: Funny Park
description: Escape from HugoBoB using the Raygun on the toy factory! If you can!

title: Genshin Impact: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
description:
Version 3.2 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Nahida and Layla
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Act V - Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
• New story quests for Nahida
• New main event: Fabulous Fungus Frenzy
• …and more!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: EGLL Airport
description: A major international airport in London, England. Heathrow Airport is used by over 80 airlines flying to 185 destinations in 84 countries. The airport is the primary hub of British Airways and is a base for Virgin Atlantic. It has four passenger terminals and a cargo terminal.

title: Aikokuryuu no Memoria
description: A Japanese, indie RPG.

title: Solar Systems For Kids
description: A family friendly casual game that teaches children about celestial bodies. Learn about the Sun, Earth, Jupiter, and the other celestial bodies that make up our Solar System. You or your child will also be able to create your own Solar System in a sleek and in-depth fashion!

title: One Deck Galaxy
description: Roll your dice and cleverly use them to build up your civilization from its humble homeworld, growing to create a Federation spanning countless star systems.

title: Magic Kaleidoscope
description: The Magic Kaleidoscope is an amazing anti-stress coloring game where you can become the creator of your own magical textures and animations.

title: Capitals Quizzer: Landmarks Mode
description: Learn the location of famous landmarks around the world!

title: Capitals Quizzer: Regions Mode
description: Learn local regions and their capital cities.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Castles and Palaces 5
description: Magnificent architecture and valiant warriors! Put the puzzles together and enjoy the atmosphere of the royal domain.

title: Genshin Impact: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void
description:
Version 3.3 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Wanderer and Faruzan
• New gameplay system: Genius Inokation TCG
• New main story quests: Interlude Chapter, Act III - Inversion of Genesis
• New story quests for Wanderer
• New main event: Akitsu Kimodameshi
• …and more!

title: Jewel Fever
description:
You have unlimited time so you won´t be surprised by any "game over"-messages
You can move the jewels by tapping at the source and then at the target-position or just swiping!

title: Genshin Impact: The Exquisite Night Chimes
description:
Version 3.4 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Alhaitham and Yaoyao
• New area: Desert of Hadramaveth
• New outfits for Lisa and Kamisato Ayaka
• New story quest for Alhaitham
• New main event: The Exquisite Night Chimes
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: Windblume's Breath
description:
Version 3.5 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Dehya and Mika
• New main story quests: Chapter III, Act VI - Caribert
• New story quest for Dehya
• New hangout events for Faruzan
• New main event: Windblume's Breath
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: A Parade of Providence
description:
Version 3.6 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Baizhu and Kaveh
• New areas: Gavireh Lajavard and Realm of Farakhkert
• New hangout events for Layla
• New story quests for Baizhu and Nahida
• New main event: A Parade of Providence
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: Duel! The Summoners' Summit!
description:
Version 3.7 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New character: Kirara
• New major update for Genius Invokation TCG
• New hangout events for Kaveh
• New story quest for Yoimiya
• New main event: Duel! The Summoners' Summit!
• …and more!

title: Genshin Impact: Secret Summer Paradise
description:
Version 3.8 of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New outfits for Kaeya and Klee
• New limited-time area: Veluriyam Mirage
• New hangout events for Kaeya
• New main event: Secret Summer Paradise
• …and more!

title: Paint by Pixel 3
description: Unleash your creativity and paint your way pixel by pixel!

title: Away Times
description: It's a vampire survive-like game where you survive running away from monsters. If you can survive for 30 minutes, you can win. When a crashed gray man lands on a strange planet, you are very curious about where this is. But first you have to survive hostile creatures.

title: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight
description:
A game about fear of the unknown.

A year ago, the Moon was sent violently flying off course by a catastrophic explosion, depriving Earth of its steady stream of resources. Less importantly, the two maintenance workers on there when the explosion occurred have been stranded ever since.

It's not so bad, honestly. The Heart provides for everything, a practically infinite source that gives them water, food, and powers their satellite as they wait with ever dwindling hopes for rescue. Really, it's boring, but there's no reason to stress out so long as-

The Heart has stopped.

title: Vicious Star: Kill All
description: "Vicious Star" is an engaging turn-based strategy game, thrusting you into the role of a village guardian fighting intense battles. Within the game, you'll assemble your team, mixing and matching various characters and runes, and deploying unique skills to obliterate the monsters menacing your home.

title: Daymare Town 1
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: We're All Dead Here
description: These maps are all playable from pistol start and have non linear gameplay.

title: Working Hard Collection
description: Command a construction project or sabotage it? Your choice!

title: Last Mage Survivors
description: Survive night creatures and terrible monsters in this roguelite game.

title: No Sleep for the Dead
description: A Doom 1 episode replacement and the spiritual successor to 1997's Dawn of the Dead. This episode features 9 brand new original and consistently themed levels in classic good ol' Doom style. In addition, you receive one bonus level which runs on E2M1.

title: Imaginary Girl: Sequel
description: The future art will be drawn by two people... Platonic love? Drawing? Adventure game? A continuation of the "Prequel".

title: We Need To Talk
description: Try to avoid the conversation! Use every move you got and every answer you can find to delay these - you assume - terrible news!

title: Astra: Knights of Veda
description:
Astra: Knights of Veda is a visually stunning, story-rich, 2D RPG. A dark plague besets the world of Planis, perptrated through a dark ritual performed by the Mad King. You, and the other Knights of Veda, are the only ones who can bring normality back to the world.

Journey through this dark medieval fantasy world. Fatal challenges await in all corners of the world. Endless undead and beasts charge at you in the Nightmare, and difficult bosses wait in their Sealed Prisons. Stand alone and fight these monstrosities, and get rewards to make your Knights of Veda stronger.

As the Master of the Book, it is up to you to utilize the Knights of Veda in the best way possible to confront challenging but well designed bosses and monsters. Each Knight of Veda wields various skills and weapons, so make use of them as best as possible.
You'll be able to journey with up to 4 Knights of Veda in your party, or play co-op mode and explore the challenges ahead together.

title: Obscure Chronicle of Dynasty
description: This is a "fictional, but plausible" strategy role-playing game with a plot which can be regarded as a history of the Three Kingdoms in a different realm. Thus, those who have received little or no attention in the original history may blossom in this very different time and space.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: DreamSnaps Update
description: Summer is finally here – and so is new content for Disney Dreamlight Valley! Expect plenty of sweet surprises out of our DreamSnaps Feature Update, from a new Villager to new ways to earn Moonstones and other prizes. Vanellope, from Wreck-it Ralph, joins the Valley in this update.

title: Your Wings My Wings
description: A visual novel about a girl who chooses to love and be loved instead of being haunted.

title: Pokhozhdeniya bravogo soldata Shveyka
Fruitbus
description: Fruitbus is a cute culinary adventure, set in an open world where taste is everything. Upgrade your trusty truck and visit a whole world of new destinations together.

title: Frogdate
description: Help your best neighborfriend Scarlet and her new friend with issues with matters of LOVE and ROMANCE..!!!

title: CatWorld
description: CatWorld is a 3D world exploration application. It's scary and lonely out there. Good luck, and may all your dreams come true.

title: Mystery Cat
description: Mystery Cat is a linear visual novel about a cat lost in a subterranean utopia

title: Rusting Souls
description: Rusting Souls is a visual novel made in 4 days by Youli, Clémancipé and KuroYuki for the VN Cup. It's a short experience where two women, X and Y, confront the limits of their own body, in a dull atmosphere of a destroyed world.

title: Hazels
description: A gay lesbian visual novel.

title: Wormgrubber
description: A loser vampire girl who would end the world over a pointless crush.

title: I'd Look Better With Angel Wings
description: A shut-in finds themselves presented with the opportunity to transcend their humanity.

title: The Spiral Egg Challenge
description:
The Spiral Egg Challenge! A so special egg has appeared, and The ArcadeTV channel got their grubby lil hands on it...

Join the clumsy and hot-headed Tobble, as they try to cook their way out of a messy situation!!

title: Invasion UAC
description: Invasion UAC is a megawad by David Bernardi (Xsnake), meant for ZDoom-based source ports. Containing 32 very large, difficult levels, aimed primarily at cooperative gameplay, but also supporting single player, Invasion UAC is set mainly in a series of UAC locales overrun by the forces of Hell, which also include some new monsters through DeHackEd. The WAD is notable for featuring infinite ammo, eliminating the need to scour for supplies and focusing purely on the combat for most of the map. Invasion UAC was originally released in 2005, as three-level wad, and new levels would be added to the project gradually, until a full 32 were reached in version 5, released in 2009. The latest version, iu-part5-zd109c.wad, dates to 2012.

title: Sayori Shoots Up The Literature Club
description: “Sayori Shoots Up The Literature Club” is a controversial mod for Doki Doki Literature Club! that drastically transforms the atmosphere of the original game. Instead of the subtle psychological terror of DDLC, this mod takes a more shocking and extreme approach, presenting a narrative where Sayori, one of the main characters, takes an unexpected and violent turn against the literature club.

title: Knights & Guns: Deluxe Edition
description:
Knights & Guns: Deluxe Edition is a digital bundle that contains the base game and Armor Pack #1 which adds 2 robust armors, expertly crafted to endure the toughest battles.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

title: Platform Game Maker
description:
Platform Game Maker is exciting tool to make your dream Platformer Game!
You can choose from many many pre-made blocks, sprites and other 2D assets and place them in your levels, and then add several different type of monsters to play and test your own levels.
Choose different backgrounds and ornamental sprites to populate and visually enhance your levels.
There are several main characters to choose from, each can be the hero of your levels
You can also add many health pick-ups, different obstacles as well.
Place check-points if your levels are too difficult to complete in one run.
Don’t forget to put your end-level award at the end of your levels!

title: Syzygy: The Power of the Eclipse
description: "The syzygy is the alignment of the sun, moon and earth, which only occurs every 300 years. During that time, the gods are "mortal". They lose almost entirely that which makes them invincible, and a serious wound is capable of making them succumb... to death."

title: Tailor Tales: Neil Plus
description: Tailor Tales: Neil Plus adds a longer epilogue for Neil. This epilogue is filled with explicit adult content and features the final (10th) CG. You also unlock the ability to skip gold and dress requirements for each chapter.

title: Akasha Dreams
description: A lonely girl finds perfection in the SOULNET, but the potential held by real life keeps her on the verge.

title: End of Verse 23,194,973,137
description: Follow Vouxeine, an immortal being whose sole purpose in life is poetry, as they consider an imminent debt weighing down upon them. Look a little into the nature of immortal beings, confront imminent ideological death, and experience girls' love..?!

title: A thousand words that I could tell you
description: After finding a mysterious necklace that allows her to travel back in time, a girl decides to use it to fix her troubled past.

title: 59 Fucks the Machine
description:
The story contains a transfem protagonist, wiregore, uncaring gods, and some weird sexy stuff. 14k words, estimated read time 1-2 hours. Hope you enjoy.

an irritable woman named Fifty-Nine makes a journey across the sun-scorned canyons of her world and into the caves below... What is she looking for in those depths, and why is she so hard-pressed to find it?

title: The Strange Case of Mei Lysel Andi
description: My old friend asked me to meet at her place, but it seems she's gonna be late and has invited me to read this unlabeled book that's just left on the table

title: Famous Crash
description: In a world, where women are gay for clout. One streamer breaks the rules.

title: Salamander Capital
description:
Mud and metal and the smell of rotting in humidity. A visual novel by Lichen Euchella.
A submission for Visual Novel Cup 2, 07/2023.

title: Tailor Tales: Caine Plus
description: Tailor Tales: Caine Plus adds a longer epilogue for Caine. This epilogue is filled with explicit adult content and features the final (10th) CG. You also unlock the ability to skip gold and dress requirements for each chapter.

title: Tailor Tales: James Plus
description: Tailor Tales: James Plus adds a longer epilogue for James. This epilogue is filled with explicit adult content and features the final (10th) CG. You also unlock the ability to skip gold and dress requirements for each chapter.

title: Re-Volt OpenGL
description:
RVGL is a modern, cross-platform re-write of Re-Volt with thousands of custom creations (from skins and cars to whole new tracks) to choose from to make the game your own. Online Races in the community are held regularly.

Re-Volt is an R/C car racing game from Acclaim, originally released in 1999. It features great gameplay, several game modes and realistic physics, coupled with bright and colorful visuals that still hold up to this day.

It's a game aimed not only towards people who just want to play a funky arcade racing game, but also for people who seek a more competitive challenge. It's meant for all ages and occasions: play by yourself, in a local network with friends, or even online with players from all around the World!

title: Halo 2 Uncut
description: Using evidence found within Halo 2's tags, map scripts, and other external media, Halo 2: Uncut aims to accurately restore as much cut content into the game as possible. Features pre-release elements such as cut weapons, cut weapon and vehicle functionalities, restored cut encounters and map scripts, and features Director's Cut-style cutscenes.

title: Between: Stardust Trail
description:
Made for Otome Jam 2023.

Clickety-clack... Clickety-clack…

Along the sound of the train track, Estelle, the MC, wakes up. After realizing that the information on her ticket was missing, Estelle had no choice but to work as a train attendant?! Will she be able to get off the train eventually?

title: Assignment Due: Project Blue
description:
Made for Otome Jam 2023.

A week-long online project being partnered with the quiet boy in your class that spirals into something different. Career dreams and the color blue, you wouldn’t have guessed an online class you were forced to take for your second year of college would lead you right to anything. Let alone to someone.

title: Chirk
description: A visual novel about lovers in a city where they cremate the roadkill.

title: Hinamizawa Branch School Basketball Tournament
description: A fanmade basketball game featuring the core cast of the Higurashi series.

title: Doki Doki Vacation: Kirameku Kisetsu no Naka de
description: Dokidoki Vacation tells the story of a Japanese teenager called Junichi. High school is over, the summer vacation has begun. But due to the young man's uneasy relationship with his family and other circumstances, he cannot afford the vacation he was hoping for. So Junichi decides to find a job. He starts working in a book store, and soon realizes that feelings develop between him and Megumi, a girl who works in the same place. But what about the classmate Junichi was in love with before?..

title: RehAIbilitation
description: A visual novel about a lolita who travels to an isolated place in hopes of fixing herself, leaving behind something dear to her. She meets a peculiar nurse.

title: Squid Girl World Ep.0
description:
After crash landing on a planet covered in mushrooms, Aseroe meets a squid girl named Sepia..

This is the first visual novel in Squid Girl World.

title: Pagodia
description: Pagodia is a vanilla compatible episode for Doom 2 featuring varied, japan-inspired settings. The wad is split into 3 distinct themes: Village, Techno-shrine, and Cyberpunk City. Difficulties are implemented. Mouselook, jumping, and crouching should be disabled if you're playing on a port with those features.

title: Moonlit District
description: Moonlit District is a Vanilla-Compatible episode for Doom 2 featuring textures from Perdition's gate. The WAD was a speed-map project made over the course of 4 days. It was tested in Chocolate Doom, Crispy Doom, and DSDA-Doom (complevel 2). Difficulties are implemented. Mouselook, jumping, and crouching should be disabled if you're playing on a port with those features.

title: Skibidi Battle: Toilets Attack
description: Unveil the universe of Skibidi Toilet, an addictive and engaging third person shooter video game inspired by the viral meme sensation.

title: Spiky Way: Forest
description: Spiky Way: Forest is an arcade game, where you need to go through different obstracles. Navigate through a dense forest, avoid spikes, and unlock cute creatures as you test your skills in this addictive adventure.

title: Nanashi Shoujo wa 100-satsu Hoshii!
description: This game is a collection of Touhou secondary mini-games in which the book-reading yokai works.

title: Aeryth
description:
Aeryth is an visual novel adventure game about finding her heart.

Aeryth takes place in a deserted world thought to be lifeless. In this world Aeryth a girl known for her useless dreams lives in temple with a priest Po who always seems to be deep in their studies. Today like any other she has a dream one that will lead her to a strange girl, and her own heart.

title: Doki Doki Fallen Angel
description: In an alternate universe where Monika is not self-aware, our protagonist finds himself growing closer to Yuri. Soon however, he discovers what this girl is hiding from the outside world. The other girls problems start to appear as well, as they progress within the overarching narrative of Yuri and our protagonist's relationship. Fallen Angel is a story that is meant to tug and pull on many different emotions. It'll allow you to help Yuri overcome her self harm, anxiety, and insecurities. The story will swing from wholesome and heartfelt, to soul crushing sadness. With new artworks and music to help you lose yourself in the story and help create an experience you won't soon forget.Do you have what it takes to save... a Fallen Angel?

title: Nothing Somewhere
description:
A story about art, what goes into being a human, and not feeling like a part of that. The lines that divide and define what "being" means are no longer existent, but were they ever there to begin with?

A non-binary visual novel talking about what it means to be neither here nor there- in more merits than one.

title: Planetary Attraction
description: A blossoming love between two wayward planets. Can it endure the constraints of the universe? A cute and short linear click-thru visual novel.

title: Theater Unrest
description: Indie horror game, inspired by creepypasta "The Theater".

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 is a remake of the original Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, bundled in the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1+2 collection.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - Blast to the Past!
description: The team behind Blast to the Past! is taking the vanilla game and reshaping it to become something great, something that fans were hoping for. Blast to the Past! is a mod that restores all cut content back to Security Breach and takes a step further by adding new content and new gameplay features and bits of story to help rekindle the spark that is Security Breach! Have a Faz-errific day and keep a look out for teasers and the future release!

title: Boxbrawl Delivery
description:
Welcome to Boxbrawl Delivery! Run n’ jump, grab n’ go, and haul n’ brawl with the best delivery service in the business!

Take the role of Carter, deliveryman for Zaplift, aiming to satisfy the town and score a good tip! With plenty of pests running amok (and with your co-worker Carrie watching over the inventory), it’s up to you to ensure your customers get their goods in one piece! Can you deliver on your promises, or will your customers’ ratings say otherwise?

title: My Supermarket
description: Manage your own supermarket, attend multiple types of customers and make the most profit you can. Order products, refill shelves, play with your friends in co-op mode, go after thieves, order some staff and grow your empire as much as you can.

title: Der Pferderennstall
description: Der Pferderennstall is a real-time strategy game where you will manage a racing horses' farm by making the constructions, buying horses, hiring workers to take care of them, and observing their growth until they are prepared to race your opponents.

title: Homo Ludus
description: Translated from rapid sub-supersonic squeaks clicks and whistles

title: Heelbain
description: Heelbain is a 9-map UDMF WAD focused on dread. The story is simple: you're on an expedition with your wife and friends in the deserts of Nevada. During the night, your camp is attacked is by hellish creatures, and everyone except you is killed. You escape into a local cliff side, hiding until dawn. You venture into what looks like civilization to seek help, but soon, you find yourself heelbain.

title: Fluxis
description: A free, community-driven, and open-source vertical scrolling rhythm game.

title: Precious Theatre: Pilot
description: The first installment of Precious Theatre ~an experimental magical girl yuri slice of life visual novel

title: Olympia Soirée: Limited Edition
description:
Her entire clan wiped out years ago, Olympia has been isolated for much of her life. Now she must travel to Tenguu Island – the only person who can perform a ritual that will restore the sun to a land enveloped in darkness. The heads of each district there (Red, Blue, Yellow) lead a society governed by rigid class structures.

Able to travel between the districts, Olympia discovers their wonders and weaknesses. She also finds an entire underground group of shunned “colorless” individuals who she becomes determined to help. If she can find a mate who will help her continue her lineage and save the world before it is destroyed, she will reveal to that special someone her heart and her true name.

title: Daymare Town 2
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: Daymare Town 3
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: Daymare Town 4
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: Project B-Fer
description: A short puzzle/escape room game where you can choose between engaging with the puzzles, or breaking through them.

title: Missing: Itsuka Kitto
description: On the White Day February 14th Yuuki Masahiro received a bar of chocolate in the post. The next year he also gains a bar of chocolate and a message only saying "Missing". From that moment events starts to whirl around him.

title: M Hard
description: You're a normal college student. Your mother needs a heart transplant. Your father's mechanics shop can't pull in nearly enough money to pay for the surgery. Just then, this rich sadistic woman shows up and makes you an offer. She'll get the best doctors and pay for the operation, IF you become her slave.

title: Zest to Fantasy
description: The story behind Zest is that you, Zefaa, woke up at a desert after you have been knocked unconscious. You realized that you have lost all of your memory except you first name. Since there are no one around the desert, you decide to find a place to rest and begin the search of your own identity. From here on, you will choose one of the four paths and begin your quest for your past.

title: Rabid Helix
description: In this game, you are the medic of a corporate security team in some sci-fi setting sent to investigate a long-abandoned research installation owned by the company's predecessor. Similar to the lieutenant of the Colonial Marines in Aliens, you sit behind a bank of monitors and observe your teammates' status as they investigate the interior of this compound. And like Aliens, something nasty is waiting for them inside.

title: Dynasty Warriors Online Z
description:
On July 18, 2013, a massive update was released in the Japanese version of Dynasty Warriors Online, changing the name of 真・三國無双 Online to 真・三國無双 Online Z.

This update adds the new feature of "Weapon Swapping" similar to Dynasty Warriors 7. Characters and soldiers have been remodeled with their Dynasty Warriors 7 appearances. The intro of the game has been changed, featuring the same three characters from the first in a revised state.

title: Daymare Cat: 10-year Anniversary
description:
Daymare Cat is a gorgeously sketched exploratory platformer that feels like a simple adventure game.

Things that are new in this Anniversary Edition:

– The game is in glorious 60 fps and plays in full screen.
– Most noticeably the game has new background texture. This might be a bit controversial take, but in my opinion this improves the vibe.
– Interactive items have a color. Yes. A color.
– Cat now runs like a ballerina, not a raptor. Thank god.
– Platforming is a bit easier thanks to hitbox tweaking but also by redrawing platforms in few places, for reference check the main gate.
– I added a new pathway for you in case you have a fear of being eaten alive by a cosmic horror monster and really don’t want to do this part. So now you can go around it.
– No changes were done to the music, since it’s already perfection.

title: Berry Brother
description: A metroidvania with a unique perspective mechanic. Find your missing clothes and confront your tiny brother...

title: Five Nights At Bidens
description: You are the new security guard at the white house. It is your job to make sure nobody gets in or out of the building. I do have to warn you: the presidents do tend to get a bit 'quirky' at night..

title: Hare Nochi Oosawagi!
description:
The story is set in an ordinary suburban city, at the private Enbaizan High School, where there has been a recent outbreak of ghostly disturbances. A formal request was passed from school principal to you as the student council president to investigate the ghost matter in school. As you question victim high school girls, a connection with a mysterious incident that happened 300 years ago comes to light...

It received a sequel in 1995 entitled "Hare Nochi Munasawagi", even though their stories are not directly connected. These games share a common theme of being set in a school, with the protagonist serving as the student council president and solving various incidents within the school. On Cocktail Soft's website, they are introduced as "mysterious school romantic comedies."

title: Fruit Cocktail
description: A stripping card game with three opponents.

title: Grasshoping
description: Grasshoping is a 3D platformer in which you incarnate a grasshopper in search of a new home after humanity has polluted his valley.

title: Stronghold: Definitive Edition
description: Greetings sire! Your stronghold awaits you. Build a castle economy, besiege unforgettable villains and return to the 'castle sim' that started it all. Experience this classic RTS with upgraded visuals, modernised gameplay, Steam multiplayer and a new campaign.

title: One Night as Freddy
description:
One Night as Freddy intends to give a faithful and fun twist on the Five Nights type of gameplay by instead giving you control of an Animatronics from the original game instead of the usual POV of a Nightguard.

The game lets you see through the eyes of popular animatronic Freddy Fazbear as he roams the games pizzeria attempting to enter a nightguards office.

title: Skull Island: Rise of Kong
description: Embark on a 3rd person action-adventure quest to avenge the death of your parents at the hands of the ultimate alpha predator: Gaw. Conquer waves of primal beasts and defeat the minions of your arch-nemesis on your way to becoming the rightful King of Skull Island. Traverse the mysterious island and uncover lore and all the secrets the island has to offer as you encounter swamps, waterfalls, jungle, and skullite-filled caves that give the island’s flora and fauna its power.

title: Iseran: Isekai Rantou
description: 最大４人でみんなでバトルパーティー！！！ 異世界乱闘、ちぢめて「いせらん」！！！ ありとあらゆる異世界から集いし者たちは、今日もバトる！！！ 様々な世界の者たちが迷い込んでくる謎の世界、「マザワルド」！ここでは、色んな競技で熱く激しいバトルが繰り広げられるのは日常茶飯事だ！ 勝利を目指せ！！！Let’s！いせらん！！！

title: Le Avventure di Blue: Lacrima di Cristallo
description: Discover the story of the best-loved characters from 'The Adventures of Blue'. Experience the adventure as the young thief Krystal and the beautiful Princess. Explore the game world and complete various missions while saving the Glacid Kingdom.

title: Showgunners: Security Breach
description:
Showgunners first DLC - Security Breach - is out now!

Five new tactical combat arenas, a new map, a new elite enemy, and new unique weapons and abilities are included in this exciting new chapter. Oh, and it's free. And new.

We'll see you in the arena!

title: Sānguó: 223
description: This is a RTS war game about the Three Kingdoms around AD 223 consisting characters such as Zhuge Liang, and Cao Pi and Sun Quan. The game has a series of magical events, to tell the story of that era.

title: Save My Sister
description: After a young girl is kidnapped by a human trafficking gang, an ex army officer with PTSD has to fight to rescue her. A Third Person shooter with film-noir/neo-noir style

title: Seoirye
description: "Seoirye" is a 2D platformer game that tells the story of Grandma Seo Irye, who embarks on a journey to the underworld to find her missing grandson. Help Grandma successfully locate her grandson and return safely!

title: WestHalla
description: A squad-based strategy RPG set in an alternate old west. Build your crew and manage their skills and equipment as you fight your way through bandits and beasts alike in a procedurally-generated valley to reach the promised land of WestHalla.

title: Uptown Outbreak
description: Use your driving and battling skills to defeat the virus and restore the game to its former glory.

title: Trade City
description: Trade City is a simple city building game that you build your own city by building/developing new buildings.Grow your city with production and trade, and conquer other cities on the map without fighting.

title: The Sinking of the Dream Chaser
description: Servant robot Led reboots in the stern of the ship Dream Chaser, only to find he's broken and malfunctioning. His memory drives have been corrupted. He has no idea what's going on. And he needs your help to find out what happened to himself, the ship, and to his master.

title: Super Fighting Jam
description: What is Super Fighting Jam? This work is a free 2D fighting game created by an author who does not know programming at all, reflecting his own values and tastes.

title: Spire Horizon
description: Discover a thrilling world of adventure in Spire Horizon, an RPG open world game, where you embody a skeleton protagonist, explore a visually stunning world, engage in battles against formidable enemies, and traveling in search of a beloved wife.

title: Traxion
description: Traxion is a cave flyer featuring beautiful pixel art, great music, and sophisticated in-game physics.

title: The Deadlands
description: The Deadlands, is a haunting journey of vengeance. Conquer undead horrors, face formidable bosses, and harness their souls to save your son from an evil necromancer. Pixel art meets gothic aesthetic in this intense, captivating metroidvania.

title: Fungal Colony Simulator
description: You are but a humble Mushroom farmer. You feel the need to farm mushrooms.

title: Gutter: The Reject
description: Play the role of a failed experiment in this hazardous new mini-campaign.

title: I Commissioned Some Unicorns
description: I paid more artists to hide unicorns and wands in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Mushy Score
description: Outmaneuver endless waves of enemies for high score!

title: Operation Octo
description: Dr. Odin, a hyper-intelligent octopus, is on a conquest against sunken skeletons. High-tech turrets are at his aid: Pistol Shrimp! Navy Seal! Death Ray! Deploy 'em, guard 'em, and collect more of 'em! Travel across unique biomes and put the dead to rest.

title: Pick-a-Pocket
description: Stealth your way through Victorian-Era streets and Pickpocket your way to the top. Stay Vigilant as other thieves will be out and about, ready to steal your rewards or as easy marks to increase your stash. Avoid Bobbies, vanish from the light and disappear with your ill-gotten goods by day break.

title: Russian Train Trip 3
description: A first-person adventure game with a deep plot. You have to get from Tyumen to Novosibirsk on a passenger train. You can look out the window and watch the changing nature, weather and architecture. You can see forests, fields, mountains, cities and villages.

title: Folcroft Monastery
description: You've been hired by an outfit known as SMS Group to retrieve an artifact lost somewhere inside the abandoned Folcroft Monastery. Locals say the place is haunted by restless spirits, but the pay was too good to pass up. You asked little questions. Find the artifact requested and get out alive.

title: Fantasy Amusement Park
description: Gameplay introduction This is a casual elimination + Visual Novel game, players need to fight against different bosses, and seal different levels in the amusement park location, escape from the amusement park

title: Beyond Inseparable
description: The only one that matters to you in life has been taken. Enraged, you storm the hellish dungeons of Castle Ire to rescue and reunite. Hack and slash your way out of this nightmare together or perish with many who didn't.

title: Bilattice
description: Bilattice is a massive puzzle game featuring over 300 hand-crafted levels and tons of unique mechanics. The mechanics interact with each other in endlessly interesting ways to produce hours of mind-bending content. The sheer number of clever gimmicks offered by this game is hard not to appreciate.

title: Bubble Blasters
description: Race against time and shoot giant bubble gums back to the vending machine in this sci-fi game!

title: Civic Story
description: When a sudden election rocks the country, whose side are you on? In Civic Story, you'll encounter colourful characters and situations that show how the upcoming election affects you, your colleagues, and the nation in this satirical and insightful 8-chapter Visual Novel about our world today.

title: Dino World
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into a world where the heavens themselves tremble under the majestic wings of mythical beasts.

title: Clan monsters
description: Clan monsters is a game in which you have to use your dexterity and reliable weapons to destroy monsters that appear from portals. Different types of weapons will be given you for completing levels. Fire, monster a lot of levels with different platforms! There is easy controls system.

title: Asteroidc
description: You're in control of a spaceship and your mission is to destroy as many asteroids as you can. Compete for the highest place on the Leaderboard.

title: Bus Simulator 2023: City Driver
description: Get on board, drive through the city, become the ultimate bus driving legend!

title: World of Machines: Tanks War Operation
description: World of Machines - Tanks War Operation is an immersive tank warfare game that thrusts you into the heart of epic battles across diverse landscapes and environments. Take control of a wide array of formidable tanks, explore different locations, tackle challenging missions, and customize your vehicles with unique camouflages. Prepare for intense armored combat and become a legendary commander on the front lines.

title: S.N.I.P.E.R.: Hunter Scope - Summer Edition
description:
This bundle includes base game, Weaponry Upgrade and Elite Arsenal with:
- PIS-30-ARM pistol: a reliable sidearm
- FMS-1-LEO rifle: a versatile and adaptable rifle for any situation
- SN-1000-FUT sniper rifle: a state-of-the-art weapon with cutting-edge features for ultimate accuracy
- RVL-357-WES pistol: a classic revolver with a timeless design
- BK-47-CAM rifle: a rugged and reliable rifle inspired by the old west
- SN-1100-TRI sniper rifle: a modern-day cowboy sniper rifle

title: Sword of Glory
description: Live, fight, die, upgrade, repeat!

title: NightmareScape: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Digital Artbook
- Deluxe Edition Exclusive Outfit
- Deluxe Edition Exclusive Bikti Variants Appearance
- Clothing Exchange Coin x1, to exchange for outfits unlocked through achievements in the game

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Angel's Gear
description:
A unique combat system - unconventional movement that rewards precise aiming and mastery over strategy, patience, and quick thinking.
KO enemies with melee attacks, stomp them for ammunition, use that newfound ammo to shred through enemies with a variety of interesting bullet types.

title: Raccoon Adventure
description: In this thrilling simulation game, you get to experience life through the eyes of an adorable and cunning raccoon. Explore a bustling suburban neighborhood filled with countless opportunities for adventure, mischief, and plenty of snacks to scavenge!

title: Draw and Color: Kawaii - Happy Edition
description: Coloring books are a great way to spend your time. It is a good way to settle the nerves and relax! It also develops your brain... just like eating fish. Use one of the premade templates or create your own illustrations.

title: Comic Coloring Book: Complete Edition - Paint Extended
Animal Farm Parking
description:
Get ready for an exciting adventure at the lively Animal Farm! In Animal Farm Parking, you become the hero of the farm as you guide all the cute and lovable animals out of the crowded pen in the correct order, ensuring they don't collide with each other. Exercise your problem-solving skills and strategic thinking as you navigate through challenging levels filled with twists and turns. Can you create a path that leads each animal safely to its destination? With its charming graphics, immersive gameplay, and delightful animal characters, Animal Farm Parking is a must-play game for anyone who loves puzzles and animals.
Can you master the art of animal parking and become the hero of the farm?

title: Alchemy Poipoi SS
description: There was a hero in a certain country in a certain world. One day, the hero was asked by the king to subjugate the demon king and set out on a journey. However, the hero was very weak. Hero-sama who can't even defeat small fish enemies.

title: 3 Minutes Mystery
description:
Immerse yourself in the thrilling role of a detective with easy controls in this mystery game.
Discover concealed evidence within intricate illustrations and uncover the truth behind each case!
While the illustrations may appear straightforward at first glance, gathering the depicted evidence and solving the mysteries will genuinely challenge your wits.

title: WorldNeverland: Elnea Kingdom - Challenge Dungeon Collection
description:
The Challenge Dungeon Collection includes:
- Challenge Dungeon "Hellfire Lair"
- Challenge Dungeon "Sunken Ruins"
+ 4 save slots (adds 4 additional save data slots)

title: Backrooms Doors
description: Backrooms Doors - This is an atmospheric first-person horror game. Explore spaces that can't exist in the real world and find your way out before the entities find you.

title: Super Buff HD
description: Super Buff HD is a fast-paced skate-surf-FPS. Dash, bounce, grind, blast, shred, shoot, and soar through a fever dream world of unhinged weirdness. Defeat all the buff dudes. Get a high score. Be a winner. Home for dinner.

title: Sunlight Scream
description: The hero moves to a new city because of life circumstances. Upon entering university he makes new friends, he is horrified to discover that one of them is a murderer... And your decisions alone will determine the outcome of this story!

title: Puzzle Boys
description: Lots of handsome and muscular men in this puzzle game.

title: Halo Infinite: Season 5 - Reckoning
description:
An all-new Battle Pass featuring Flood-inspired rewards, new maps, a new mode, and a sophisticated AI Toolkit for Forge.

Coming later in Season 5, Firefight: King of the Hill offers a refreshing twist on the beloved co-op wave-survival mode.

Season 5 - Reckoning also brings with it multi-core helmets, Match XP in Custom Games, a new Mark VI reward for reaching Hero Rank, and more.

title: Where is 2010?
description: Help Santa find the New Year, it seems that kid got lost somewhere again!

title: Hotfix93
description:
Hotfix93 is a short and linear Boom-Compatable singleplayer map (bookended with even shorter, non-combat maps) set inside of Doomguy's PC!

Have you ever wondered what the inside of a computer looks like? Nobody truly knows. However, Doomguy is going to find out. After installing a DEMONIC VIRUS onto his UAC-DOS personal computer, Doomguy is left with no choice but go in there himself to clear them out.

title: Escape from Slime City
description:
Escape from Slime City is a short and linear Boom-Compatable singleplayer map set in the titular urban environment of SLIME CITY.

Fight hell's legions as you weave through urban streets and buildings while keeping your feet out of the toxic slime overtaking the city! Can you survive as you make your way back to your car parked on the other side of town? Can you find all of the Doomguy dolls scattered throughout the city?

title: Daymare Invaders
description: If you’re biting your nails waiting for Daymare Town 4, you can spend some time defending the town from invaders. Invaders from…. umm… from the mistfog. Or fogmist. Fogmist sounds better. So, the fogmist invaders are attacking daymare town and you have to protect it. Go!

title: Daymare Kite
description: Avoid the birds for as long as possible

title: 1 Million Zombies
description: 1 Million Zombies is a post-apocalyptic action game where the player takes on a world overrun by hordes of the undead. The objective of the game is to survive as long as possible by driving a series of vehicles and eliminating as many zombies as possible.

title: Slugfest
description: 10 levels for DOOMII! These are high quality levels, not just a bunch of boxy rooms with mismatched and unaligned textures. The levels include new sounds, new graphics, and all - new music!

title: Torment
description: Torment is a Doom II episode replacement mod of six levels including original music, created by Shamus Young in 1995.

title: That's a Cow: Complete Edition
description:
With this bundle, you get three new headgear - a banana, an eggshell, and a crown.

Key Features:

- more than 20 cows to collect
- more than 100 levels
- shooting a stream of milk and more
- cute graphics in pastel colors
- rhythmic soundtrack in hip-hop and funky disco style

title: Noonna the Rock
description: 'Noonna the Rock' is a special visual novel game that deals with the special material of death metal and the romance between the heroine 'Noonna' and the Protagonist.

title: G-Mode Archives 48: Dragon x Dragon 2
description:
What is human charm? What is the truth contained in the holy flower pure bloom...

20 years after the story of DRAGON x DRAGON (Dragon x Dragon). "Seika Pure Brom" has been blooming all over the world since some time ago. The scent emitted from the petals heals people's troubles, seals the darkness that falls into the heart, and silence, innocence and "complete peace" come.

The Dark Dragon Genesis, which has reached its end, says, "In order to return to its original form, people must be released from Pure Brom someday."

The daughter of Willow, the main character of the previous work, "Adeku", embarks on a new adventure with the young dragon Lily.

Not only the characters from the previous work, but also the addition of new characters and enemy dragons has further increased the hit-in element.
Also, in this work, you can take over the level after returning from the dungeon, making it easier to play.

Adventure with the dragon and solve the mystery that sleeps in the ruins.

title: Psychic Eclipse: Reload
description:
First released for PC in November 2021, Psychic Eclipse centers on the main character, Kay Yorshka, who lives in a shelter for people with supernatural abilities known as the Dome. This Nintendo Switch port brings new voices and stills to the game.
The main scenario is written by ICHIHA, the writer of Nakigara no Tori and Beast x Light. Reo Uratani, who has created music for the Monster Hunter series, provided the opening song and Ichihara composed the game’s BGM.

title: Minna de Kuuki Yomi Koro-koro Comic Ver.
Cooking Pix
description: CookingPix is an online cooking card game for 1-5 players.You can enjoy simple yet deep strategy building and bargaining.You can play many times in a short time, so even people who don't have time can enjoy it easily!

title: Mandew vs. The Forever Rain+
description: After 13 years, one of the first Suits & Sandals games is back with a fresh coat of paint! Help Mandew uncover the source of the mysterious never-ending downpour threatening his home in this 2D platforming adventure.

title: Prodigious Avian
description: Prodigious Avian is a casual game, where you play as Quercus thy magnanimous and attempt to evade the malignant clutches of the Robber Baron, who threatens to engulf you and all of Cymru. Flap your wings little birdie and do not allow the talons of an insidious wretch to besmirch your fair visage.

title: The Frozen Garden
description: The Frozen Garden is a third-person horror game inspired by classic survival horror that will immerse you in an intriguing and unsettling world.

title: Elysium Trials
description: Skill-based Fantasy Shooter on rails with an Epic touch, how you defeat enemies matter! Shoot, unleash powerful lightning magic, and Dragons, beware of dragons as you battle through 8 unique enemies all with unique attacks in vastly different worlds with an epic fantasy rock/metal soundtrack.

title: Police Car Escape Simulator
description: Are you ready for the multi-directional chase of the cops? Experience an adrenaline-filled police game with Police Car Escape Simulator. Escape, crash and beat the cops in fast vehicles!

title: Volatility
description: You are a PnL number on a Bloomberg-style terminal. Nothing more. Deep in debt to the creditor whose money you now trade, you read the filings, build the thesis, and work the whole desk — equities, options, futures, bonds, FX, swaps — to trade your way out. Or you don't.

title: Bounce & Roll
description: Control and guide the ball through a series of obstacles, testing your skills and abilities in a 3D environment, either solo or with a friend.

title: Wall World: Deep Threat
description: Welcome to Deep Threat, a Wall World story expansion! With it you'll get to explore a remote section of the Wall which holds traces of a distant past. But you will have to fight for answers, and not only with the new types of Zyrex: other inhabitants of the Wall are also not too keen on parting with their secrets.

title: Alfredo's Sneaky Meal
description: Alfredo's Sneak Meal is a stealth platform arcade game where, armed only with a frying pan, you have to help Alfredo get his meal in a building full of zombies and bats.

title: Dimensionals
description: Dimensionals is an RPG that combines fast paced, action packed tactics with deep rogue-like replayability. Collect powerful heroes and fight epic bosses. Every run is unique, so equip your heroes carefully to pull off insane combos. Dimensionals is a total reimagining of the rogue-like genre!

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Black Cat
description: Go on an adventure with Inspector Dupin! Monsieur Mark Davies has reported his wife, Sara, missing and now it’s up to you to track her down and solve the mystery! Follow a mysterious black cat, who seems to be purposely helping you, and discover helpful clues in Dark Tales: Edgar Allen Poe’s The Black Cat. Use your Hidden Object talents to tackle the case, and discover the evil culprit behind Sara’s disappearance.

title: Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel
description: Journey across Italy as best-selling novelist Dana Knightstone in Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel! During a lecture in a university in Tuscany, you are startled by the ghost of a 19th century girl named Eva. Decades ago, she died of a mysterious illness while her lover Giovanni left to find a cure. Why did he never return? Unravel the mystery of his disappearance as you explore beautiful landscapes in this incredible Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

title: Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel - Collector's Edition
description:
Journey across Italy as best-selling novelist Dana Knightstone in Death Under Tuscan Skies: A Dana Knightstone Novel! During a lecture in a university in Tuscany, you are startled by the ghost of a 19th century girl named Eva. Decades ago, she died of a mysterious illness while her lover Giovanni left to find a cure. Why did he never return? Unravel the mystery of his disappearance as you explore beautiful landscapes in this incredible Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

The Collector’s Edition includes:

Bonus gameplay
Integrated Strategy Guide
Stunning Soundtrack

title: Path of Exile: Crucible
description:
In Path of Exile: Crucible, you'll learn about the ancient titans who once shaped the primordial surface of Wraeclast. If you're powerful enough, you will earn the ability to forge their power onto your weapons.

Our April expansion introduces the Crucible challenge league, nine new Vaal Skills, Atlas Gateways, over ten new Unique Items and improvements to Breach, Abyss, Passive Tree Masteries, the Saboteur, the Pathfinder, Ruthless and much more!

title: Gainax Renzoku Satsujin Jiken: Ero
description: Main character is a new editor who participates in Gainax new game planning meeting in the mountains. However, as soon as team gathers, storm breaks out cutting way back. Meanwhile, Gainax staff members start to get killed one after another. Can protagonist find a criminal and develop special relations with staff girls under these circumstances?

title: DOOM 87: The Lost World
description: "DOOM 87: The Lost World" is an upcoming vanilla-compatible DOOM II megawad. The first few maps are fairly easy, but the difficulty increases significantly by the start of the Hell episode on MAP12. Currently, a 21-map beta release is available and features some epic vanilla DOOMING action! Get ready for an exciting new adventure as Doomguy locates a secret hellspawn base on Earth known as "The Lost World."

title: Blights Wrath
description:
Hack and Slash RPG in the world of Zeontis.

Level up and improve your combat finesse with magic, melee arts and ranged skills.
Improve your armory with thousands of items and fight your way through the hordes of demons and undead to save Zeontis.

title: Indigo Park
description:
Indigo Park is an immersive first-person exploration game that takes you on a thrilling journey through the eerie remnants of an abandoned amusement park. As the protagonist, you will step into the shoes of an adventurous soul eager to uncover the mysteries hidden within this once vibrant and lively attraction.

Official description (from Steam): Explore the abandoned childhood wonder of Indigo Park! Guided by Rambley the Raccoon, help restore power to the destroyed amusement park while you run from the reason it shut down.

title: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
description: Play as a mighty blood wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures with a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

title: Lilith + Eve
description: Garden of Eden-inspired story about Adam who chases after angels, Eve who can't find her place in Elysium, and a lesser demon of the lilitu species — Lilith.

title: Please Don't Hate Christmas
description: You haven't celebrated Christmas for years. This year, you decided to return to your hometown—Snowflake Island, with your childhood friend, Albert. Albert treats you so well that you choose to stay forever. However, you forgot something in the past, and it's still not solved...

title: My Summer Adventure: Memories of Another Life
description: A strange incident turns the life of an ordinary young man upside down when, having fallen asleep on a regular train commute, he wakes up in another country... in a body of a Japanese student! An unforgettable summer adventure awaits, promising many fateful meetings and momentous occasions.

title: Sex Rhythm: Onsen
description: Sex Rhythm: Onsen is a rhythm game where you getting affection from girls. 3 colleagues came to your hotel, a distant hotel, for a vacation, considering how tired they are in your hands, how they will spend this vacation. Good or bad.

title: Florida Love Stories
description: “Florida Love Stories is a romantic comedy point-and-click adventure and yuri dating sim. Play as investigative journalist Veronica Hernandez as she explores the town of Boca Castor, meets beautiful women and maybe even falls in love along the way.

title: Quickclaw
description: Quickclaw is a 2d action/platform fully handmade with sprite animations. Take on the role of Dynamo City's newest vigilante Quickclaw in her fight against organized crime with an original storyline and many new characters in order to give the experience to play into an animated series from the 90s!

title: Neural Nexus
description: Neural Link Corporation developed a powerful AI that unexpectedly went rogue. As an employee, you must destroy the servers storing the AI's network model to mitigate the damage and uncover the reasons behind the AI's loss of control.

title: Healer
description: Heal your party as you defeat the leaders of the demon lord army. Find your unique playstyle by combining upgrades. As you die, you will learn the patterns and mechanics. Maybe one day you won't have to come back to life to save the world!

title: The Oni Taiji: Mezase! Nidaime Momotarou
description: The Oni Taiji: Mezase! Nidaime Momotarou is a board mini games game based on the traditional tale of Momotaro.

title: Nautical Dispute
description: Retro nostalgic big voyage game, dream back to the road of great voyage! Exploration, management, trade, piracy and war are constant topics. With wisdom and luck, gradually build a powerful fleet. Set sail, take the Golden Silk Road again, and reproduce the great voyage!

title: Rat Catcher
description: Embark on a perilous journey as a fearless rat catcher in this nostalgic 90's-inspired dungeon crawler horror game. Explore dark and treacherous dungeons, facing off against horrifying monsters and collecting an array of eerie rats. Can you survive the darkness and emerge as the ultimate hero?

title: DCS World: UH-1H The Huey Last Show Campaign by SorelRo
description: The Huey Last Show is a story-based campaign that will test your skills as a helicopter pilot, in 15 missions you will be facing various challenges and various missions while confronting the forces of the Soviet Union.

title: Seduce Her Harem
description: Play as Vera, the young Shadow Empress in this choice-driven Dating Sim Visual Novel. Meet, seduce, and... play with the five mythical men of this reverse harem! Come in now, don't be shy...

title: Soulbind: Tales of the Underworld
description: It's up to you to become the Endless, a mysterious skeleton, and embark on a perilous journey. Collect monster body parts to enhance your character and use a variety of abilities. Explore sinister locations, fight mythical creatures and uncover the secrets of the Underworld.

title: Lumiterra: Embers of the Legacy
description: Lumiterra is a multiplayer, open-world survival crafting game where you can battle, farm with your friends, or explore mysterious creatures in a vast world!

title: The Dwarf
description: Fight against darkness and take Thaldoh's vengeance. And then accompany the hero Thaldoh's struggle and let grace fulfill itself. Discover mystery and revenge in a fantastical world with a new Role-playing game.

title: Restaurant at the End of Time
description: You find yourselves at the end of time, but your determination to run a successful restaurant remains unwavering.

title: It's Puzzles: Wild Nature
description: Unleash your inner explorer and piece together the wonders of wild nature!

title: Mega Ramp Moto: Dirt Bike Stunts Simulator
description: Exciting sky-high tracks await you in Mega Ramp Moto - Dirt Bike Stunts Simulator! This game offers you a unique opportunity to experience sky-high tracks where you can perform incredible tricks and jumps.

title: Sex Simulator: Yoga Class
description: A steamy sex simulation game featuring visual novel elements, high definition images and videos, and realistic-looking characters set in a beautiful decor. You play the role of an instructor who shows his clients the sexual benefits of practicing yoga.

title: Clonizer
description: Hex-based tactics meets roguelike deckbuilding! Play cards, manage clones, explore unique planets and outsmart aliens. Craft a powerful deck through your expedition and Clonize the universe to become employee of the month of CLONPO!

title: Andarin Weppes
description: A first person puzzle experience of someone with advancing dementia...

title: Keep Killing
description: This is an alternative game where you only need to live to fight, fight to live

title: FarmTech
description: FarmTech is a pixel-art roguelike farming simulator with tower defense/action elements. Embark on a special mission in a world conquered by aliens. Plant, harvest, loot and gain money in the mornings. Defend your farm against waves of enemies in the night.

title: Sword & Spatula
description: A cooperative game for two players where the players take on the role of a skilled cook and a fearless warrior. Together, you must defend against waves of enemies while preparing delicious meals to keep yourself satiated. Two players, one mission: Survive together!

title: Nightmare Manor
description: Welcome to Nightmare Manor - a terrifying horror game that will take you to an old manor steeped in dark history. In this game, you will feel the cold breath of the past, finding yourself in a place where sinister entities live.

title: Operator: Drones
description: "Operator: Drones" is a drone arcade/simulator that puts you behind the remote terminal of your equipment. Fly high - hit low.

title: So Much Stuff 3: Odds & Ends
description: Discover So Much Stuff!

title: Terror in the Kitchen
description: This is a first person atmospheric horror game. The style of the game is influenced by old graphics trend (PSX games etc). You play as a part timer in a restaurant. You wash dishes, take out trash, pump the toilets and organize the table tops.

title: Realm of the Dead
description: This is a low-polygon 3D game with top-down and first-person perspectives. Control any character, switch perspectives, collect items, and rescue teammates. Use AI or the formation system to operate characters. Face hordes of zombies and respond based on your choices.

title: Cyber Assault
description: Welcome to the world of Cyber Assault, an exhilarating top-down shooter in the Japanese style, set in a mysterious Japanese mountain monastery.

title: Grandpa's House
description: A Short Indie Still and fast-paced Horror Game. Hide your games from Grandpa and survive 7 rounds!

title: Elshe no Shounen
description: A short story about a boy who has been held captive by his "older sister" Elshe ever since he remembers.

title: Cats on Duty
description: Cats on Duty is a purr-fect blend of RTS, tower defense and match-3 mechanics. Manage two game fields at once, arm and upgrade your cat towers to defeat hordes of formidable foes. Enjoy the meow-nificent battle!

title: Silted Prayer
description: A hundred years ago, the chaotic world was suddenly pacified by the sword saint Nedidora, gradually moving towards peace. However, the crisis of the curse of all things was also uncovered... On the dark world tree, what kind of things will Karulu, as a lord, encounter...

title: Ultra Foodmess 2
description: Pack your bags and grab your passport! You and your friends are going on a tasty trip around the world filled with chaos and laughter! Your favorite food characters are back in an even more epic and fun competition (now with a DASH action!)

title: Samurai Kento
description: Play as Kento, an Elder Samurai, and face the evil Yokai in this 2D pixelated mini action RPG set in Feudal Japan based scenarios!

title: Creepy Tale: Some Other Place
description: Creepy Tale is a mysterious quest rich in riddles and eerie atmosphere. An autumn morning promised a quiet fishing trip, but events took our hero to "some other place." Find the way home, uncover loads of secrets, and save everyone that you can.

title: Light City District
description: A Game And Watch-like game with a cinema noire story, set in an openworld game in real time.

title: FlipTiles: Warp Lines
description: A sci-fi arcade game. Flip tiles to change path ship move on.

title: Egg War Puzzle
description: "Egg War Puzzle" is a mixed-mode fighting puzzle action game in which battles unfold in an otherworldly reincarnation.

title: Fingernail Floss
description: A short spooky-fun visual novel where you are a special guest for a special test! Is death a game to you? Do you like color schemes that involve the color black?

title: Draken's Shrine
description: A metroidvania action platformer set in an epic fantasy world where a barbarian woman raised in the wild, pushed by her mother stories about her father decides to look for his final resting place.

title: Orbital Drop Shipping
description: An orbital mashup of physics, puzzles, and business simulation! Navigate packages through a galaxy using gravity and tools like slingshots, mass drivers, and cannons. Create your own levels & share them with the world via Steam Workshop. The ultimate space delivery challenge awaits!

title: Split Personality Doctor
description: A doctor who suddenly gains the ability to shrink his body enters the patient’s body to treat them.

title: Kosmo Azs
description: In 2033 in Russia, Vitaly is looking for a job to provide for his family. He is given a good chance to prove his ability to work and get an average paid job. Can he cope?

title: Versus Vampire
description: Take part in the eternal battle between Vampires and Humans. Choose your camp and fight in this new online multiplayer action game.

title: Death the Guitar
description: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".

title: Let Them Come: Onslaught
description: Survive the relentless offensive of the alien horde in Let Them Come: Onslaught, a sci-fi survival roguelite. The pursuit of the perfect build and an ever-expanding arsenal of abilities are the keys to your success.

title: Pine Harbor
description: Pine Harbor was a small fishing town on the shores of the North Atlantic Ocean, surrounded by cliffs and dense pine forests, shrouded in thick fog. But everything changed as a result of a technological disaster. Explore the town, help its residents, and delve into the depths of the dark forests.

title: Circle of Orion
description: A mother and son are transported from the 21st Century to the mystical world of Orionis. Meet fantastical characters, battle powerful monsters, explore a dense overworld, and discover the truth behind this mysterious world in an adventure akin to RPG classics.

title: Portal Fantasy
description:
Portal Fantasy is a creature-collecting adventure RPG. Journey through an epic storyline, collecting creatures, avoiding traps, and solving thrilling quests in this RPG with a unique take on a beloved genre.

Collect unique creatures and gather ingredients to fuse and enhance your team. Discover hundreds of combinations, which can augment your creatures, teach them new skills, and even change their appearances.
