The community of Oakheart has been terrorized by Teddy, a masked serial killer. As the body count rises, you discover there is more going on here than just a man in a mask killing helpless teenagers.

title: ModelMaker
description: ModelMaker gives you the freedom to create assembly models with the editor, without any restrictions or presets. You can design unique assembly models to show your imagination and creativity.

title: Detective Solitaire: Butler Story 3
description: Get in the middle of an investigation! Solitaire solitaire puzzles and train your mind!

title: Ia Scatter City
description: Ia Scatter City is a level made with unreal engine and the "ia scatter" add-on where you can fly through a small part of a sci-fi city.

title: Re:Night
description: Re:Night is a roguelike deck-building & turn-based strategy game. Lead your team, slay monsters, collect loot, and defeat bosses. Utilize elemental power and tactical wisdom to end the loop of nights and bring back the dawn!

title: Kazoe Meshi
description: Have you ever wondered how many grains of rice are in your bowl when you are eating white rice? This game is a very simple game in which all you have to do is count the rice grains in the bowl. You will never have to worry about how many grains of rice are in your bowl again.

title: Bronzebeard's Tavern
description: A multiplayer tavern management game.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Vecna Unleashed
description:
The mini-expansion introduces a climax to The Codex of the Infinite Planes Saga, where players must face the sinister presence of Vecna and his cult in Morgrave University.

Vecna Unleashed offers new adventures in various locations, including Sharn, the Plane of Water, the Abyss, and the Astral Plane. Players will battle against new monsters such as humanoid rodent Wererats and abyssal demonic Vrocks, while also unlocking a new Epic Destiny called the Machrotechnic.

title: Saviour of the Wasteland
description: Saviour of the Wasteland is a very NSFW adult, interactive visual novel. Scavenge resources, build your settlement, meet lots of new people, discover secrets and have lots of sex while navigating the challenges of the wasteland.

title: Wish Upon a Llama
description: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

title: Bingo: Pet Rescue
description: Experience the joy of bingo and pet rescue combined! With delightful gameplay, embark on missions to save adorable pets while enjoying your favorite bingo games.

title: Cube Kingdoms
description: You are the Lord of a small village in a medieval fantasy world. Build your kingdom by expanding your economy, defending yourself, recruiting troops, making your people happy (or not), all while your neighbors are breathing down your neck.

title: Breaking Survivors
description: Brick-breaking gameplay meets Survivors-like mechanics. Use your balls to destroy bricks, level up and pick upgrades to hold your ground against waves of incoming bricks and try to high score in this roguelite brick breaking game.

title: Commander: Zombie Wars
description: Embark on a gripping turn-based tactical game in a zombie-infested world. Choose survivors or zombies. Gather resources, recruit allies, and strategize against the undead or join the undead. Shape custom maps, and decide the fate of the world. Join the fight now!

title: Sparky
description: Help the robotic dog named Sparky complete the mission!

title: Exotic Kosmos
description: Invite your friends to an exchange of punches where up to four players can compete in the same arena in search of the glory of being the great champion. Also face the adventure mode where there are numerous mysteries, in a virtual and exotic adventure to the sound of a beautiful soundtrack.

title: Sunset Survival Station
description: After receiving a cryptic message with coordinates, you arrive at Sunset station, humanity's first stronghold in the past. Only ruins remind you of its former glory, and hordes of mutants roam around trying to tear apart uninvited guests.

title: They Dug Too Deep
description: Turn-based Dwarven Roguelike. Can you deal with the swarms the dwarves unleashed since They Dug Too Deep?

title: Skade
description: Upon her fathers' death, a young Jotunn woman swears vengeance upon the gods and begins a journey towards Asgård.

title: Stack-Making Neighbors
description: Stack-Making Neighbors is a casual physics-based puzzle game. Remove blocks from a tower, and carefully stack them on top. Play alone, or with friends.

title: Provoron
description: It's an adventure game about black&white crows.

title: ShantyTown
description: ShantyTown is a relaxing diorama-building game about finding beauty in everyday chaos. Bring new locations to life, stack your urban buildings high, and fill each little nook and cranny with your own touch. Even messiness has its own little charm.

title: Chained Horror Experiences
description: This is a point-and-click horror game set in modern Japan. You must carefully explore the stages where items are randomly placed and escape while you have life. It's up to you to solve all the mysteries and stop the chain of fear experiences...

title: The Knight's Path
description: This game is an invitation to challenge a hero to become what the princess has been waiting for. Solve several ancient puzzles based on the classic Peg Solitaire game to reach the princess in a remote castle. Will you be the champion?

title: Just in Crime
description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

title: Naughty College 18+
description: Welcome to the world of Naughty College 18+ - an immersive visual novel for adults. In this game, you will witness the unique story of a young university professor who unintentionally becomes not only a mentor but also the object of passionate love for three seductive students.

title: Trade Post Forest
description: Trade Post Forest is an open world exploration game about a successful trade post in the middle of the woods. Explore the trade post and the surrounding land to discover new landmarks and tools. Don't get lost.

title: Refidenptio
description: A Boomer-Shooter with epileptic 1-bit pixel art. Immerse yourself in an enigmatic story destroying all enemies in front of you with a unique combat mechanic. Face depression head on, your enemies are just things created by your mind.

title: Pin Crasher
description: Pin Crasher is an exciting and unique casual game that combines the classic sport of bowling with the fast paced action of endless runners.

title: Broken Hearts Island
description: Broken Hearts Island, a visual novel in the fantasy genre, tells the story of the adventures of a young oceanologist on a mysterious island.

title: Bandit Knight
description: Step into the boots of a master thief in Bandit Knight! Outsmart enemies, steal legendary treasures, and navigate a vibrant 2.5D pixel world. Customize your tools, unlock upgrades, and rise to become the ultimate King of Thieves!

title: Sweet Girl Gurumelo
description: Amanita is feeling down lately. She lost her best friend and she can't do anything about it. Could you listen to her story, and maybe help her out?

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Egypt
description: Puzzles of Egypt!

title: 07th Theater
description: 07th Theater is a crossover between Higurashi, Umineko, Higanbana, and Rose Guns Days.

title: Cerulean Days
description: On a seemingly idyllic island, the Internet is shut down. What will become of those unable to adapt? In 2018, a lethal biological attack claims a significant number of lives. While tragedy occupies people's minds to the brim, a controlling governmental plan is put into effect.

title: 10Minutes
description: This game is a single player FPS where you have 10 minutes to fight zombies in different locations, test your zombie survival skills and compete for high scores.

title: Buried Alive: Breathless Rescue
description: Are you ready to embark on a spine-chilling adventure? Step into the shoes of the protagonist and experience the terror of being "Buried Alive" in a crypt. Your mission is clear: Escape the confines of your coffin, find the key to unlock the door, and unveil the dark secrets that lie within.

title: Martial Arts Peerless War
description: This is a horizontal version of the machine street clearance/combat gameplay, featuring multi character AI development, editing combos, and action strategy games for battles in large scenes.

title: Nantara Adventures
description: Grow in virtue or infamy amongst others as you fight your way to become a renowned guild in a roguelike procedurally generated unique world of Nantara.

title: Sensual Adventures: Episode 8
description: Episode 8 contains 5 new positions for your excitement.

title: The Symbiant Re:Union
description: Take a deep dive into Danya’s and Brahve’s heat and romance in The Symbiant Re:Union. The events take place after two Endings of The Symbiant’s main game.

title: Exorcist Simulator
description: Exorcist Simulator is an immersive multiplayer horror game that will captivate players and immerse them in a world of supernatural events and dangers.

title: World Guesser
description: World Guesser is a multiplayer party royale game where you and your fellow contestants compete to deliver packet to successive target countries for the sake of being the last one to remain. It's a battle royale concept geography game that sends you on a plane trip around the earth.

title: Crossroad OS
description: Crossʀoad OS is a single-player adventure where you solve puzzles, meet strange creatures and explore a sacred operating system created as a junction between the human and spirit world.

title: Joyride: Lowpoly World
description: Joyride is a low-polygon style racing game. Different seasons have different scenery, and different locations have different driving pleasures. You can race, off-road, hang out, and even operate drones here. You can also discover hidden levels in the game to get a completely different experience.

title: Jarpug
description: Jarpug is a JRPG about a pug with a jar on her head. Help Pug and her friends explore a 3D platformer world and fight in turn-based RPG battles. Designed for VR and flat screens, either way is a great way to play! Explore the magical, fantastic world of the modern dog.

title: Claw Machine Sim
description: Physically accurate claw machine simulator!

title: My Unusual Feline Friend
description: From another dimension, a strange and very cute catgirl visits you. She is very curious how sex works in this dimension and she has chosen you to teach her all about it!

title: Pogo3D
description: Tough-as-nails 3D platforming using only your mouse! Bounce off platforms and even the walls to reach the next checkpoint. Go on a linear adventure through an interconnected world, or quickly test your skills in challenge mode.

title: Sylvana's Chronicles
description: A turn-based strategy game with roguelike and deck-building elements. Explore a dark and magical world full of forgotten lands, monsters, and secrets. Build your own deck of cards to fight your way through the dungeons. Upgrade your cards, unlock new items, and discover ancient artifacts.

title: Da Paper Boy
description: Get locked and loaded as 3 Teens run through the town delivering mail in a whole new modern way! As you generate points on the leaderboard while dodging OG granny and the neighborhood watch. Only one question remains... Are you the best paper boy or paper girl? Let your score tell it all!

title: Gorgon Shield
description: Gather your party of expendable heroes. Climb a vast tower atop a shiny shield. Who will fight? Who will heal? Who will laze around and take all the treasure. The choices will be yours alone, but only those who work together will reach the top of the Tower Shield.

title: Mortarmen
description: Mortarmen is a strategic multiplayer PvP first and third person shooter, pitting the New American Coalition versus United Communist Front in a battle for control of Arakousa, a Mediterranean paradise, where soldiers traverse via sliding, rolling, climbing, and HALO drops.

title: Lunia Z:Revival
description: Lunia Z is an "Action Arcade" MMORPG. This translates to being a more action-oriented game, where you directly control your character and its actions, combining attacks you can create using the keyboard keys. It feels like watching an animated film with a powerful 3D impact and presentation.

title: LightSup!
description: LightSup! is a couch-action co-op game for 1-4 players with rogue-lite elements where you play as adventurers encounter ferocious monsters crawling from the Eclipse Dungeons. Prepare your weapons and protect the Altar of Light at any cost, or the world will be doomed into darkness forever.

title: Across Kiloparsecs
description: A science-fiction novel where you investigate the mysterious circumstances surrounding the death of a close friend.

title: Skinny Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Sweety Sweets
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Lovely Brides
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Cool Lady
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Nova Strike
description: Fire up your blaster cannons and take on waves of enemies in this retro shoot'em up with procedural levels. Come back stronger with each attempt and beat the high score!

title: School Bus Driving Simulator
description: Experience a realistic school bus with the exciting School Bus Driving Simulator! Get students safely to school, earn rewards, and customize your bus.

title: Rebirth Moment
description: At the end of the world where alien bugs and zombie thugs run rampant, you are a special "bug slayer" who was sent to an unknown town to perform a final mission. As one of the executors of the "Rebirth Plan", you must find the "Reborners", protect them, and survive as long as possible...

title: Space Tales
description: Space Tales is a real-time strategy game set in a retro-futuristic environment. Take on the role of a commander in the Intergalactic Planetary Expansion (I.P.E.) and immerse yourself in a thrilling mission to explore and conquer new planets, pushing the boundaries of the Human Empire.

title: Doom Sweeper
description: Doom Sweeper is a 2D pixel-style game. Clean up the approaching zombie climax, and exchange it for cash, embarking on a journey to become an arms dealer in the apocalypse. Complete the game, unlock more items in the shop, and achieve various achievements to obtain different CG!

title: Office Is My Harem
description: After being unreasonably criticised by your manager, you decided to fight back. Unexpectedly, this attracted your female colleagues. Could it be that a chance to fulfill your fantasy of having a workplace harem? This visual novel game has a readily story rhythm and lots of erotic scenes.

title: Heavy Sword
description: Heavy Sword is an action adventure Platformer with some RPG elements. Imagine if you took some of the best parts of Zelda II NES, Super Mario World SNES and fused them into something new! Take Control of Pike in his quest to rid the land of horrendous monsters!

title: Truth
description: A horror game where you are in a hotel with an entity that only comes out in the dark. Your goal is to find the hotel owner hidden somewhere among the rooms...

title: Oberty
description: Oberty is minimal shape-blending puzzle game where you XOR-blending simple geometric shapes to make a beautiful complex target shape.

title: Bleak Winter
description: The world is against you in this brutal third-person survival experience, and your only goal is survival at any cost. Loot, build, scavenge and craft your way to survive against the world and everything within.

title: RunNCrush
description: RunNCrush is a party platformer game where you play your friends in various mini games. Try your hand at soccer, racing, and more, while crushing your pals!

title: Art of Golf
description: Physics based 2D golf game. Play tournaments, beat challenges or compete for high scores. Many game modes, extra sports and mini-games.

title: Bare Knuckle Sandwich
description: Bare Knuckle Sandwich is a 2D fighting game with side-scrolling exploration and a character-driven narrative. BKS tells the story of a young, directionless guy, Gunner, who joins an underground bare-knuckle boxing ring.

title: Lazy Jiangshi
description: A visual novel about lazy jiangshi Mao and her even lazier mistress.

title: All Chess
description: Create, collect and play board games from around the world, you can customise board sizes, piece moves and their unique look. There's 1 board game I've created, 20+ classic board games and countless future games of yours!

title: Age of Wonders 4: Empires & Ashes
description: The empires of mortals resurge after the devastation brought forth by the Wizard Kings. In Empires and Ashes, players fuse Magic and Steel to unleash devastating war machines to drive the Godir back into the Astral Sea. Includes a new Culture, Tomes, Empire Building options and Story Realm.

title: Prison Survival: Architect of Crime Simulator
description: Prison Survival: Architect of Crime Simulator is a sequel to the warmly received Prison Simulator, but with an unusual twist - you're no longer a prison guard. You are the prisoner! Steal, sell drugs make deals with the guards, - whatever suits you, prepare for hardships you have never seen before!

title: 60 Clicks: Read, Select, Connected Worlds
description: This is a Short Visual Novel, that ends the story by your 60 clicks, and in full Live2D animation. Choose the options that appear again and again, to interact with the heroine. Repeat the story, understanding the mysteries, and fall in love with her.

title: Haiyuuenchi no Memento Memoria
description: An abandoned amusement park in a broken world. It was a paradise called "Lagoon" where children were self-sufficient. A boy working as a mercenary in "Lagoon" happened to meet a silver-haired girl. The wheels of their destiny begin to move.

title: Parfum Nostalgique
description: Parfum Nostalgique is a heartfelt tale about the people who change us, for better and for worse. From betrayal to unconditional love, from regret to hope… see the drama unfold between exes and lovers, old friends and new, when you dive into this kinetic visual novel dram-com series. With delicate vintage shoujo-inspired art, original soundtrack, and a diverse cast of voice actors, Parfum Nostalgique is a lovingly handmade passion project packaged with sweets and scented with roses by sole developer Prince Rosalium for your reading pleasure.

title: WCP Word Girlfriend
description: A game that combines visual novel elements with gameplay for vocabulary memorization. With this game, we offer an exciting adventure that transforms word learning into an enjoyable and rewarding experience. Join us now to explore the joy of English learning in this visually immersive game!

title: Five Nations: Renegades
description: Renegades is the first official expansion pack of Five Nations, an old-school sci-fi real-time strategy game. It features a new campaign, new playable factions, units, stations, weapons, and skirmish maps.

title: Hex Racer
description: Race through the asteroid belt, hit checkpoints to increase your score, Use power ups to help you. Game Modes - Monthly event with leaderboard - Endless/practice - Split Screen - Story mode

title: Search and Rescue: Yosemite
description: Search and Rescue: YosemiteThis DLC will include huge map of major Yosemite Park trails.Five times bigger map than Tatra National Park!

title: Dickland: Racing
description: Dickland: Racing is a two-player arcade action racing game! The main feature among such races is the amazing pipe world and the physicality of the game characters!

title: Girls in Pajamas
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Tunguska: Shadow Master
description: Enjoy enhanced stealth gameplay in Tunguska with new melee and steath weapons and a new game mode: Sticks-And-Stones.

title: Internet Addicted Youth 2005
description: Netjunker 2005 is a story-oriented role-playing game that incorporates a variety of scenario-appropriate gameplay. You will play the role of Wang Xiaoleng, and face the criticism of Internet addiction and games from teachers, classmates and parents in the early 20th century.

title: Ski Jumping PVP
description: Experience the thrill of being a ski jumping champion! Step into the shoes of a professional jumper and engage in exciting competitions against players from across the globe. Take on authentic ski jumps inspired by real-world locations.

title: Joy Life
description: In the game, you need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. If the flopped cards are inconsistent, there will be no change. The way to pass the level is to eliminate all the cards in the picture.

title: RTS Football
description: RTS Football is a game with all the classic mechanics of a 2D Real Time Strategy game but with added (American) Football elements. Battle and blow up the opposing robots in pursuit of scoring touchdowns, or preventing them.

title: Football Streaker Simulator
description: We all thought about it, and now you can give it a try. Run onto the football field, take a selfie with your favorite player, escape from a huge crowd of stewards, and disrupt the game for the entire stadium. What could be better?

title: Sex City: 2069
description: Sex City: 2069 is a third-person cyberpunk shooter, you'll embody a captivating female protagonist amidst an atmosphere of cyberpunk and science fiction. Prepare yourself for adult-oriented content as you dive into the depths of this virtual city.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Landscapes 3
description: Puzzles of landscapes!

title: Battle for the Board
description: Adventure through a colorful tabletop-themed world, strategically rolling special moves and attacks to defeat enemy pieces in this turn-based action strategy game!

title: Noel the Mortal Fate: Season Final Part 2
description: "Noel the Mortal Fate" is now complete! The time of the decisive battle has finally arrived. Noel and Caron finally confront Burrows, they raise their fists in a final counterattack in the face of the onslaught. What does the girl see at the end of her revenge.

title: PPP
description: PPP is a 2D puzzle platformer game where you solve your way out. There are 20 different enjoyable levels where each of them offers unique experience.

title: Jump King Quest
description: Plunge into high-stakes punishment platforming in JUMP KING QUEST! Explore alone or fall together in dynamic online climbing action as you fight your way upwards on an unhinged quest to The Smoking Hot Babe at The Top. In this world, every ledge is a battlefield…

title: Sangoku Xiangqi
description: A strategy board game set in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Combine various soldiers with generals and command your troops to aim for victory!

title: Politon
description: Politon is an easy to learn turn-based strategy game where you challenge the minds of your opponents with your cunning and wits.

title: Stickfigurez
description: Stickfigurez is an indie platform fighter featuring iconic characters from classic stick figure animations. Play with up to 4 players locally or online!

title: Recycle Bin Battle
description: Reycle Bin Battle is an arcade puzzle game based on 3 differents gameplay. Make combo with rubishes to make ball, use ball in a breakout to get energy and finally use energy to shoot Kaiju coming from outer space.

title: Creeper World IXE
description: The Creeper always returns... but this time, we have the advantage! Explore new worlds where the creeper, sand, and particles all merge in a pixel level simulation pushing the bounds of real time strategy into new territory.

title: Hero of Luxuria
description: Immerse yourself in the fantasy world of Hero of Luxuria. Save the world from the danger hanging over it.

title: EcoGnomix
description: A quirky mix of roguelite and city builder. Build a lively little city above, by looting mystical caves with a team of gnomes below! Use multiple runs to unlock upgrades and abilities to help your gnomes venture deeper into the dangerous underground.

title: Tensei Brave
description: Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed. In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned. Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord. Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

title: Wizard's Owl: Magic Delivery
description: Wizard's Owl invites you into a captivating world of wizards, owls, and a quest to save the magical realm. In this adventure, you take on the role of a determined owl working for a prestigious mail and parcel delivery service. Your aspiration is to become a personal owl for the main wizard.

title: Packet.Breach()
description: Packet.Breach() is a strategy roguelike where you place hacker program towers to manipulate, duplicate, and teleport enemy projectiles to destroy security programs. Add towers to your deck as you progress and develop your own strategy—and uncover the truths behind the mega corporation's agendas.

title: Succubus's Making Lunch
description: Everyone loves to eat, and succubus is no exception! Our succubus loves to eat and has an inhuman appetite! Help her cook before she eats you!

title: Engaging Destiny
description: A fantasy platformer where you can explore the town of Faranel and its surrounding areas. Meet the townsfolk, interact with them in various ways and maybe even have some special fun with them while you're at it!

title: Sleepy Time Jack: Digital Talking Body Pillow
description: Fall asleep to the soothing sound of your Sunny Day Jack's voice as he praises and comforts you in this Digital Talking Body Pillow app!

title: Pocket Waifu: Rekindled
description: Pocket Waifu: Rekindled is a unique Visual Novel experience with a complex story hiding behind a simple facade. Make a pact with a Succubus, through which a whole bunch of beautiful, sexy ladies will show up at your door! Can you satisfy them all?

title: Furry Futanari Jigsaw 2
description: Be a good girl or boy and have fun with this sexy futanari puzzle game.

title: Mercenaries Saga 2: Order of the Sliver Eagle
description: “Mercenaries Saga 2: Order of the Silver Eagle” is a tactical simulation RPG where you fight through 32 stages with Claude, Captain of the Silver Eagles and his team.

title: Mercenaries Saga 3: Gray Wolves of War
description: “Mercenaries Saga 3: Gray Wolves of War” is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy background. It is the third game of the Mercenaries Saga.

title: Out of the Mist
description: Challenge yourself to master a unique control scheme in this platformer game. Take control of the environment and traverse through atmospheric, yet challenging levels.

title: Behind the Horizon: The Sky Fortress
description: Expands the game Behind the Horizon with a new exciting main story, many new areas, items, spells, new pets and plants ! - A farm RPG in a nature simulation that keeps changing the world. Dive into a new adventure! BtH-The Sky Fortress awaits you...

title: Plastomorphosis
description: Evacuated from his hometown due to the dangerous bursts of dark energy, the ordinary citizen is trying to overcome and survive a series of events in a new reality, where living as a human being is not possible anymore. 3rd-person horror with fixed camera angles and retro-styled graphics.

title: Bloc-Age: Path of the Oracle
description: A story driven fast paced action FPS with a retro twist.

title: Black silk girl
description: It's a casual whack-a-mole like game with lots of pictures of girls, and when the block turns red, click on it. You can remove it, remove all the squares, you can see the girl's face.

title: Cooking Simulator 2: Better Together
description: Cooking Simulator is back – bigger, better, and with optional multiplayer! Create your own recipes and take advantage of new and improved controls to become the best restaurant cook in the city! Or just have fun and enjoy cooking at your own pace. You’re the chef here!

title: One Button Games 5-in-1
description:
Challenge yourself with these 5 one-button fast-paced games.

In "B Cannon" you are moving around the screen and can reverse your direction by pressing a button. Your goal is to shoot the circles that are bouncing around. You aim automatically and shoot at the current aim position. Hold a button to shoot. The circles break up into smaller ones and you have to shoot them until they can no longer be broken down. The game is over when you touch any circle.

In "Cate P" you score points by destroying the caterpillars crawling around you. When you press a button you will rotate clockwise and shoot in the direction you were looking at before. Try to hit the caterpillars and avoid being hit by them. You score points by shooting the segments of a caterpillar. The game is over when any caterpillar touches you.

In "S Lanes" You are constantly moving between the four lanes on the left side of the screen. Your goal is to shoot enemies that are coming from the right to keep them from reaching the lanes. Hold a button to shoot and to move forward towards the enemies. Collect the coins that enemies drop after you destroy them to score points. The game is over when any enemy reaches any of the lanes.

In "Thunder" you are running in the middle of a thunderstorm. Collect the stars that form when lightning strikes the ground to score points. But avoid getting hit by lightning. Reverse your direction by pressing a button or by hitting the sides of the screen. The game is over when you get struck.

In "UD Cave" your screen is split in halves with a cave in each half. You control two characters simultaneously going through the caves on each side. The cave on the right is upside down. Press a button to make both characters go right. Collect coins on the way to score points. The game is over when either of the two characters hits the sides of the cave.

title: Blasphemous II: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Penitent One awakens as Blasphemous 2 joins him once again in an endless struggle against The Miracle. Dive into a perilous new world filled with mysteries and secrets to discover.
Includes a Digital Soundtrack and a Digital Artbook.

title: Strangers on Paper
description: What better place to find a muse than among strangers in a bar? In a quest for inspiration, your choices will dictate how you navigate reconnecting with people from your past and helping each other towards a better present and future.

title: Portal: Bagley
description:
Portal BAGLEY is a fan-made, free modification for Portal 2 which plays in an unknown time period.

Set in an unknown time period, Portal: BAGLEY tells a new story using new characters including the test subject, you!
You play as a test subject who is awakened by a scientist named Bagley. Bagley wants to help you escape the facility... But what will you discover?

title: Sassy Girl
description: Working in a gossip magazine. Being surrounded by beautiful women, and having incredible erotic adventures!

title: Soulslinger: Envoy of Death
description: You are a gunslinger in limbo, involved in a gritty war against "The Cartel", a ruthless organization harvesting souls to break free of the shackles of the afterlife. Grow stronger with each new run, gather the essence of lost souls to take on the biggest threats in this rogue-lite FPS!

title: Wacky Wonderland Wollop: A 3D Platformer for the Ages Game of the Year All Time: The Game
description: A 3D Platformer 3PShooter Dialogue Driven Soulslike with RPG elements and free Unity assets. What it doesn't have in Art Direction, it makes up in charm, mechanics, features, and very funny smart political commentary that says alot about are society.

title: Heroic Tale Value!+
description: Calling all the heroes! Take control of a party of adventurers and embark in this dungeon crawling journey through three different scenarios!

title: Waifu Club: Ayame
description: Waifu Club is the perfect Waifu puzzle game. Enjoy Ayame in 6 images in the gallery after you unlocked them in the game. The Gallery itself is easy controllable.

title: Neon Runner
description: Test yourself on the neon lit tracks of Neon Runner. A fast paced runner style game that requires speed and precision to complete all levels as quickly as possible and set a high score.

title: Sky Escort
description: Sky Escort is a rouge-like card game featuring TD and management. Players roleplay an airborne mercenary,escorting clients' cargo to earn rewards. Buildcard decks, recruit crew members, and customize arms to enrich gameplay. Multiple factions can be chose from, each with unique combat style.

title: Black Box LSS: The Merciful Savior
description: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art AVG that blends love, crime, and romantic comedy. A story of a young man forges connections with his online friend, and gradually falls in love. If you're a fan of love story, yandere, and don't mind a touch of thrill and crime, you will greatly enjoy this game.

title: Haven's Compass
description: Haven's Compass is a Fast Paced but Tactical FPS with Hero Shooter elements that you can interchange!

title: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World! Love for These Clothes of Desire!
description: It's time for a Visual Novel Quest with a twist! Join Kazuma, a reincarnated adventurer, and spend turbulent days with his unfortunate party members. Prepare for waifus, dress-up and resource management and get ready for an Isekai comedy that’s out of this world!

title: Pusher: Drug Tycoon
description: Thrilling business tycoon sim where you step into the shoes of a drug dealer in 1980s USA. Your main goal is simple: Buy low and sell high. Get ready for an experience where you'll combine strategy, risk-taking, and decision-making to build your criminal empire.

title: Doubumon
description: Doubumon is an RPG monster collecting/battling game. Experience tactical battles as you choose 4 Doubumon to fight with on the battlefield. Grow, evolve, and customize your attacks while developing different strategies in order to win, as you fight and explore your way to become the Doubumon champion.

title: Taboo Trial
description: In the "Forbidden Trial", a Roguelike role-playing action game, you will play a girl Einherjar in the Spirit Hall of Norse mythology, and find the truth of the gods at dusk through fighting and exploration.

title: The Winning Secret of the Newbie Strategist Princess
description: A neighboring country has declared war! The first war in a long time. Due to a shortage of personnel, Estelle, the princess, has taken command of the army. Eh?! "Whoever performs well, can marry the princess as a reward." How can this be!?

title: Eonia Revelations
description: Take on the role of Blin Albius, the last Knowledge Seeker apprentice, and sort through the most exotic plants, minerals, and animals, in a vast and colorful fantastical world. Unravel the truth behind the great powers of the world and the secrets that rule everything.

title: Relic Odyssey: Ruins Of Xantao
description: Fight off disgusting beasts and enemies, drill for resources, search for ancient relics, craft technology and upgrades, and use a glove with special abilities! Follow the team as they search for an ancient relic lost long ago in this hand-crafted, story-driven sci-fi adventure packed with action!

title: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Case of Banker's Final Debt
description: This mysterious case involves the murder of Oswald Mason, found dead at home. Lestrad and Scotland Yard believe that the murder was a result of Mason disturbing a burglar. I have my doubts. The Treasury wants us to investigate the case as Mason was dealing with sensitive Treasury work at the time.

title: Agent Heart: Deception
description: Join Agent Steve Heart, an experimental augmented military operative, in a thrilling episode of deception, mystery, action, and seduction. Embrace your fate and experience an unforgettable journey filled with relentless challenges and the promise of future conflicts.

title: Wrangler
description: A turn-based sex RPG.

title: Replay Boys
description: Band emergency! This was supposed to be Hannah’s day off, but now she’s been roped into managing The Replay Boys, an up-and-coming boy band. Make choices to stoke multi-timeline romances, keep the band from killing each other, and fight a resurrected ’80s pop star ghost. Can you manage?

title: Casino of Desire
description: Casino, money, beauty girls, desire, everything is superficial, hidden behind a huge conspiracy.

title: Grand Tactician: The Civil War - Whiskey & Lemons
description: Start your own Career in the American Civil War. Create your character and sign up to fight for the Union or the Confederacy. Write your story through the war, and become one of the legendary commanders of the American Civil War!

title: Deathless Survivors
description: Embark on an online co-op Survival Roguelite adventure. Team up with friends, slash through endless waves of foes, conquer formidable bosses, fulfill quests, craft potent weapons, and unlock unique characters!

title: Blackout: Zero Point
description: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

title: Serum Run
description: A dogsled Oregon Trail-like originally made in 48 hours.

title: Arcane Depths
description: Arcane Depths is a 2D action roguelike dungeon crawler game with a magical world. Become a powerful sorcerer and dive into dangerous depths filled with enemies and treasures. Combine a multitude of spells and relics to annihilate your foes. Procedurally generated dungeons, intense combat, and powerful bosses awaits!

title: Fabricationist DeWit Remakes the World
description: After a sleep of centuries, a synthetic being receives an unexpected visitor—along with a new role in the Great Project.

title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
description: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 is bigger and better than ever with all new gameplay, campaign, characters, voiceover, modes and more!

title: A Mother's Inferno
description: A mother loses her son on a train and must confront the five demons of loss in order to get him back. You play as the mother in this disturbing and uncompromising vision of a train ride gone to hell.

title: Cupid Parasite: Sweet and Spicy Darling - Special Edition
description: The special edition of Cupid Parasite: Sweet and Spicy Darling comes with a drama CD and bonus booklet.

title: Fuukan no Grasesta
description:
"Grasesta, City of Interception", capital of the Kingdom of East Gohdia.
The city was built atop the subterranean labyrinth known as the "Black Pit", a remnant of the once thriving Demonic Lands of Samara, whose infamous name has been carved deep into the annals of Western history.
In order to defend the holy barriers keeping the "Blockaded Expanse" sealed up, the city, being the central hub of retaliation against the most fearsome of the Demonic Lands, requires vast amounts of manpower to be brought in to replenish its forces in the ongoing onslaught.
These reinforcements consist primarily of slaves that were sold from other countries and mercenaries that flock to the area in search for a chance at fame and fortune, soon turning the city into one whose populace had only one thing on their mind: treasure.
Our protagonist, "Judar Schwarka," is one such slave that's been sold to Grasesta due to being captured after a lost battle. To win back his freedom, he will have to step foot into the twisted landscape of the Blockaded Expanse...

title: Cook, Serve, Delicious: Remustard!
description: The million-selling cooking sim is BACK in this all new re-imagining of a classic! An all new campaign, expanded music, new foods and art, and new gameplay modes round out a celebration of the ten year anniversary of this massive series.

title: Maze IV
description: Move through 20 levels of castles, pressing buttons to raise and lower the water or make things vanish! Can you find the finish, collecting as many gems as possible on the way. The game has hundreds of secret areas. Can you find them all?

title: Point 236
description: Your task is to capture back a curative spring. Many enemies attack you, all in full 3D environment.

title: WickedWhims
description: WickedWhims is a mod for The Sims 4 that offers sexual and nudity interactivity, enhanced relationships with extended personalities and attractiveness, playable adult careers, and many more gameplay additions.

title: Nullspace
description: Experience epic space battles in NULLSPACE, a story driven real-time strategy set in a retrofuturistic universe. Command massive fleets across the battlefield or jump in and take direct control of individual squadrons. Lead your forces to victory in visceral space combat.

title: Valhalla
description:
Valhalla is a blockchain-based MMORPG inspired by Norse mythology, offering players the chance to discover, tame, and battle with creatures called Veras. The game features a player-driven economy and a hexagonal battlefield designed for dynamic combat. You can play the game now and it will be officially launched on Mainnet on June 30, 2025. Valhalla was developed by FLOKI.

Valhalla is a turn-based combat game that tests your tactical skills. Use your Vera’s magical abilities and strategic thinking to outwit opponents. Plan each move carefully and anticipate your opponent’s actions for victory.

title: THT: Threnody
description:
Ty Halderman, the essential pillar of the Doom community, passed away in 2015. He is greatly missed and his contributions to the Doom scene have helped keep this old game alive and kicking. This project tries to honor Ty with levels that pay tribute to his work be it in the form of his levels or contribution to the Boom sourceport.

There are 20 levels in this megawad along with plenty of new music and awesome new, original skies! The project also uses a big part of Team TNT's The Return and Final Doom: Evilution resources.

title: Plutonia Revisited Community Project 2
description: Plutonia Revisited Community Project 2 (PRCP2) is a continuation in the series of Plutonia-inspired megawads. During Plutonia 3's development, there were a handful of great maps that didn't quite fit in a Plutonia 3 megawad but would fit great in a PRCP megawad. So PRCP2 was started! PRCP2 is not as classic as PRCP or Plutonia itself, but we dare say the spirit is very Plutonian and fun to play.

title: WonderfulWhims
description: WonderfulWhims is a standalone mod for The Sims 4 that offers plenty of social, relationship, and pregnancy enhancements in the forms of Attractiveness, Impressions, Personality Archetypes, Menstrual Cycle, Birth Control, and many more.

title: The Lion King: Operation Pridelands
description: Operation Pridelands is a video game inspired by The Lion King. It was released on March 11, 2004, by Disney Interactive Studios.

title: Basemental Drugs
description: Basemental Drugs is a collection of functional drugs for The Sims 4. It features custom drugs, custom animations, altered walkstyles, altered moods, altered needs, come-ups, peaks, comedowns, hangovers, addiction, rehabilitation, and loads more.

title: Basemental Gangs
description: Basemental Gangs is a mod for The Sims 4 that add gangs to the game. It features rivalries between gangs, micromanaging your own gang members, use gang members as drug runners, run your operations through your own gang headquarters, exclusive new opportunities from your right-hand man, and much, much more.

title: Skateboard Drifting Simulator with Maxwell Cat: The Game
description: Skateboard Drifting Simulator with Maxwell Cat: The Game is an exhilarating skateboarding game that features meme characters navigating levels filled with obstacles. Customise your skateboard and perform stunts to earn points. With its vibrant art style and intuitive controls, it offers a fun arcade experience suitable for all skill levels.

title: Arcade Archives: Growl
description:
"GROWL" is an action game released by TAITO in 1990.
Choose one of the four rangers to control and save the animals from the evil poachers.
Use weapons you can pick up along the way, such as swords, guns, and rocket launchers, as well as a variety of techniques that you can perform by combining buttons to defeat the poachers.

title: Construction Machine Simulator 2023: Hard Truck Work Job
description: Become the owner of a bustling construction site: take control of powerful heavy machinery and a team of professionals!

title: AiCaterine
description:
A fan game for AiCaterine, the magical time-traveling elf!

AiCaterine found a mysterious artifact that sends her into the far future. Help her repair the artifact and return to her own time!

title: The Sims 4: Extreme Violence
description: The Sims 4: Extreme Violence is a mod where you can perform violent interactions and murders. Turn violent and beat sims up in different violent ways, kill sims in 40+ different ways, develop a horrible reputation by becoming the most hated and feared sim in town, and join gangs or start a feud with them.

title: Knightmare Gold
description: A fanmade remake of Konami's legendary Konami game Knightmare.

title: Mother: Encore
description: A re-imagining of Mother with all new content, tweaks and remastered visuals. The soundtrack features remakes from the original game along with brand new pieces! The battle system is also built from the ground up to give each battle a more polished experience. The story adds more depth to the characters you love. The maps have no dead-ends or pesky mazes, and the world is filled with countless little touches to really bring Eagleland to life.

title: Tumble Tundra
description: Tumble Tundra is a Foddian Platformer where you must escape a mysterious crevice that you've fallen into. Will you be able to make it to the top?

title: Arma 3: Creator DLC - Spearhead 1944
description: Grab your rifle and prepare to deploy to the fields of Normandy. This new addition will take you back to historic World War II, fighting alongside the US First Army in Normandy, and introduces new vehicles, weapons, clothing, gear, co-op campaign, and more.

title: Only Cum!
description: You have an important challenge ahead of you to climb to the top! However, if you succeed in doing so, you will receive a very satisfying reward.. The most realistic animations and 3D models are waiting for you to Only Cum!

title: Evasion from Cluster 42
description: Evasion from Cluster 42, an arcade space-shooter for 1 or 2 players with 3D GFX and a Background Story. Play every level from top down view or from side view. You'll get a different view and a different experience that way for each level!

title: Exo-Leviathan
description: A lone pilot sent to the main asteroid belt, your task is to collect carapaces, dragon remains. But beware, they might not take too kindly to you collecting them. A short sci-fi, first person, indie, thriller/horror game. Triggers my Thalassophobia.

title: The Haunted Hospice
description: The Haunted Hospice, You got yourself stuck in the hospital while you where searching for your friend. Are you capable and smart enough to escape from the hospital and save your friend? Remember that you are not alone in the hospital there is always danger lurking.

title: Fantasy Up
description: Join Alf in "Fantasy UP!" in a world upended by a gravity-reversing Demon King. As Alf, ascend, gain experiences, and aim to defeat the Demon King. This RPG tests determination, with average completion of 30-60 minutes. Every fall strengthens you. Ready to climb, Alf?

title: Simple Tower Defense
description: A suuuper simple tower defense game with a suuuper simple perk tree.

title: 1989 QianShanMen
description: In a distant realm, there lies a mysterious and beautiful country known as the Winter Country. Currently, Winter Country is under the control of a political party called the "Dongshan Party"... And on Winter Calendar June 4th, 1989, an event unfolded at the QianShanMen Square...

title: Hyakki Yako: OH&S
description: Haramita Renkai is trapped somewhere deep in the underworld after a ritual gone awry. Armed with naught but his wits, his talismans and a burning desire for self-criticism, Renkai attempts to flee the grasp of the ravenous Demon Parade and escape back to the mortal plane.

title: Romgadr
description:
This is a mini-game shmup.
Defeat all 20 mid-bosses.
When the last boss is defeated, it is the end.

title: Aonar
description: This is an immersive cinematic storytelling experience based on Scottish folklore. Become a part of the lighthouse keeper's story, and take a journey with him on the Scottish Isles. This is an exploratory application.

title: For Honor: Ocelotl Hero
description:
Stalk opponents, and when the time is right, strike them with overwhelming ferocity.

The Ocelotl Hero offer includes:

One New Hero: Ocelotl
One Ornament
One Elite Outfit
Seven-Day Champion Status (Extra XP, Extra Loot, and More)
Three Scavenger Crates with Random Gear

title: Settlement Survival: Tourism
description: Settlement Survival: Tourism contains a whole new tourism system, with 9 attraction structures and 10 commercial structures. You can earn Silver Coins and Access Points from tourists, and increase Town Attractiveness to bring more tourists immigrating to your town.

title: Gloom: System Breach
description: A 3D sci-fi action adventure game in which the player takes on the role of a small robot controlled from a third-person perspective. We wake up in a non-working system, help to activate it by activating individual systems and fight opponents who defend the necessary parts.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Vs. Chara
description: Friday Night Funkin': Vs. Chara is an Undertale-related mod for Friday Night Funkin' based around the character Chara. The mod features 3 new songs related to the character.

title: Kinny and the Star Track Puzzle
description: Kinny and the Star Track Puzzle is a story about the friendship between a cosmic witch and a shining cat head. Embark on a journey through space to illuminate the darkened stars and restore constellations to the world!

title: Choppy Heady
description: Choppy Heady is a short, intense horror game set in an abandoned children's camp. Trapped by psychopaths, your goal is to survive and escape. Navigate the environment, solve puzzles, and avoid the psychopaths. Can you make it out alive?

title: A Scoundrel in the Underlair
description: Head out into the woods and find the dreaded Underlair in this traditional turn-based roguelike.

title: Stress Chess
description: "The real chess was the friends we made along the way." - Randy Mc'Chess

title: Kitten Force FRVR
description: Join a squad of Space Kitties and Break Blocks with your PAWsome Lasers!

title: Cosmic Salvage
description: Embark on an interstellar journey in 'Cosmic Salvage,' a thrilling 2D platformer game made in Unity. Become the intrepid astronaut who crash-lands on an enigmatic and treacherous alien planet. Stranded far from home, you must navigate through perilous landscapes and cunning adversaries to retrieve the vital components needed to reignite your plasma engine.

title: Utsurogami
description:
The main character is a young boy who works for the wealthy Kito family.
The game has two stories, the second of which can only be accessed by picking exact choices.

The first story is about a series of mysterious disappearances of young girls from the same school, which the protagonist investigates with the help of the Kito family's daughter.

Second story is about the village's mountain and coal mine, where an unknown yokai is apparenty roaming. This story features two unique main characters who do not appear in the first. It's also far more sexual and less complex, with each character having a single, straightforward ending.

title: Save the Settlers
description: This is a tower defense game in which you have to defend a settlement from bloodthirsty creatures.

title: Ore to Mahou no Koibito
description: Me and My Magical Boyfriends stars Simba, a magician in training; searching for love. Using the Spellbook of Almagest in hopes of acquiring a boyfriend, he accidentally summons four men from different worlds. With inspections approaching within a month, if Simba doesn’t return them home in time, he may be forced to renounce his magicianship. [From vndb.org]

title: Bouga Kyoukai
description: In a mountainous town there is a serial murder case with all the victims' necks cut off and either heads or bodies taken away. Main character is a student from a parallel world who claims that his twin brother and sister heads got replaced in early childhood. Normalcy and absurd come together in this investigation.

title: Ryuusei-gou ni Notte
description: This supplementary game is devoted to five side-characters who never got their routes before.

title: Sengoku Rance: Sanbiki ga Kittari Tsuitari Moyashitari - Slash! Thrust! Burn!
description: Suzume's past comes back to haunt Kanami as a Silver Eye Sect ninja named Kakusui steals Kanami's Decapitation Blade and plans to get revenge on Suzume and Inukai over the death of her leader, Gumo Danjou by using its abilities to become stronger than Suzume. The chase is on, as Kanami, Suzume and Senhime work together in order to get Kanami back her Decapitation Blade.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel - Northern War
description:
A smartphone RPG based on the anime The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki - Northern War.

In addition to the story of the anime, the mobile game will feature an original story and new characters. The tactical orbment system “ARCUS II” introduced in The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III will also be implemented. Players will be able to explore the world while progressing through the story, and experience the “pure emotion and exhilaration” of the Trails of Cold Steel series’ battles on mobile devices.

title: Blocxlide
description: Blocxlide is an arcade puzzle game where players must quickly and strategically slide blocks to create miniature art. Including a puzzle editor and "shuffle" mode, endless brain-scratching challenges await, where only the most efficient will triumph with top grades.

title: Metaverser
description:
Metaverser is a revolutionary new virtual world that offers players the opportunity to explore, create, and interact in a vast and immersive 3D environment. The Metaverser platform is the first of its kind, allowing players to seamlessly switch between different gaming platforms while still earning rewards and progressing in the game.

One of the most unique features of Metaverser is its play-to-earn system. Unlike traditional games where players have to spend real money to purchase virtual items, Metaverser allows players to earn rewards by simply playing the game.

title: Lost and Damned
description:
Resident Evil-inspired modification, featuring basic mechanics from classic RE games, such as static camera, inventory, tank controls and more...

Players find themselves in a mysterious mansion, full of zombies, headcrabs and other dangers. With limited inventory and movement, escaping the residence of evil horrors will not be an easy task.

title: Harmonic Time-Bind Ritual Symphony
description: A musician's manic episode binds fiction and reality into a joyful union.

title: Mobius Final Fantasy: Warrior of Despair
description: Act 2 of the RPG Mobius Final Fantasy, which added new characters, new jobs and a new scenario quests.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail
description: Final Fantasy XIV: Dawntrail is the fifth expansion pack to Final Fantasy XIV Online. The expansion will bring an abundance of fresh content, including an increased level cap, multiple new jobs, sprawling new areas, new allied tribes, new dungeons, and new core battle content such as FATEs, Hunts, Treasure Hunts, and sidequests, and much more.

title: Ratatan
description: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

title: Wandering Fighter
description: Published in 2005 by Migami, Wandering Fighter was an above-average platform title in its time.

title: Doki Doki Hell's Kitchen
description: World renowned Chef Gordon Ramsey came to your club to show you the beauty of the culinary arts! He's here to educate, motivate and tell you how to make the best cupcakes. Will Gordon have enough patience for these mouthy high schoolers? Can the club members take the heat of the kitchen? And most importantly... where's the lamb sauce?

title: Water Spirit
description: Water Spirit is three maps I have made for a year, with lots of enemies and detailed architecture. The feel is intended to be slightly moody, but with lots of action and danger that will test the player.

title: Travelling to the Moon
description: Travelling to the moon is a boom compatible map that was designed in about 5 months (maybe a bit more) and it is a rather large map (it was intended to be short/medium at first though).

title: Man on the Moon
description:
"Man on the Moon" is a boom compatible map that was designed in about a year (on and off, give or take a few more more months) and it is a rather large map.
It serves as a sequel to my previously released "Travelling to the Moon" and, this time, well as the title suggests, it actually takes place on the moon (at least some moon). It has more of a focus on set pieces and incidental combat rather than a succesion of arena fights.

title: Tangerine Nightmare
description: Tangerine Nightmare is a collection of 8 (+1 credit-map and a bonus one) limit-removing maps. They were designed by the french doom community, with all new textures/GFX/flats made by franckFRAG.

title: Violence
description: A four map short episode based around the colour purple. Meant to be a nice relaxing "sit back and play Doom" set.

title: Voidspawn
description: A somewhat small and uncomplicated map for Boom (-cl9).

title: Terminal Stages of Nostalgia
description: A moderate-to-large single map for vanilla Doom II.

title: Super Wario & The World of Wirio
description: "Ugh, not again! Scared to death while sleeping this year, too! Some meteor-thingy crashed into a mine nearby, and two Toads want me to check it out for 'em. I bring the meteor home, hoping I can get a bunch of hamburgers for it. But without me knowing it, it absorbs my DNA! And in the night, it creates a shadow clone of me! Luckily, the two stupid Toads are out for a walk when they see this shadow-me. They overhear his plans, and finds out he calls himself for Wirio (how original), and that he is going to return to his own world and prepare to lay our world in shadows. Oh, and that he has 5 shadow-generators or something that will protect him. And after hearing this the next morning, the Toads want me to go into Wirio's world and stop him, blablabla. The only reason I go, is because of treasure...and to stop that thief who stole my good looking face!"

title: Five Nights at Wario's 3
description:
The third and final chapter in the Five Nights at Wario's trilogy, where you find yourself in a big mansion, hiding in different rooms every night, while you try to find your way out.

This game features a new mechanic never before seen in a FNAF game, being hiding. You choose between 2 different rooms to hide in, every night, with each night having its own mechanic and own characters. A total of 12 nights, Easter Eggs, and more!

title: Team Fortress 2: Summer 2023 Update
description: The Summer 2023 Update, also labelled as simply Summer, was a major update for Team Fortress 2 that was released on July 12th, 2023. It introduced 14 new maps, 25 new cosmetic items, 10 new War Paints, 6 new taunts, and 20 new Unusual effects in total (12 for cosmetics and 8 for taunts), as well as a new community-created game mode: Versus Saxton Hale.

title: You're Not Actually Supposed To Die (At The Tournament Of Death)
description:
You're stuck in a submarine with five ridicolously rich people. The submarine don't work good. What will you do?
I resisted the impulse of making this a dating sim btw. Which I should be praised for.
It's a game. I don't know what else to say about it. The bulk of it has been written while mildly sleep deprived.

title: Every 10 Seconds I Find New and Exciting Ways to Hate Myself
description: A Game About Working Minimum Wage While Having Intrusive Thoughts

title: My Stomach Hurts and Things Will Never Get Better and I Want to Puke
description: A short game about stress eating.

title: Absolute Silence: A Game Album
description: Absolute Silence is an experimental album of lo-fi abstract games.

title: The Life of a Magical Circle
description: The Life of a Magical Circle is a deceptively simple evade-and-collect game about following your dreams. Take control of a circular creature and see if you can figure out your purpose with only a little help from a mysterious narrator.

title: Defy the Omphalos
description: A trio of glitched out Doom II maps from The Shareware Vats crew.

title: Octate
description: The first Doom map from Mr. Hypnos, inspired by and dedicated to the memory of John W. Anderson (aka "Dr. Sleep") and the legacy he left behind.

title: 1 Bad Wad
description: 10 short, quick Boom speedmaps + 1 credits map with a solid colors theme

title: DIY
description:
DIY is a community project aiming to create maps out of solid color textures. It was originally conceived by xvertigox based on "One Bad Map" release.

The maps were ultimately arranged roughly in order of increased difficulty. By the end they turn very hard.

title: Idol
description: Idol is a small work-in-progress mapset for Doom 2, designed to be played in limit-removing ports.

title: 50 Monsters
description: 50 Monsters is a project I started back in 2014 when I was just really getting into mapping. It got a bit out of hand in the second half of development, and as such the final product is fairly inconsistent in terms of overall quality. Still, though, it was a good learning experience and I enjoyed creating it.

title: Maybe Valentine's Day Isn't The Worst
description: A gay visual novel made by Dudebulge

title: King's Guard
description: In this turn-based strategy roguelike your job is to keep an ungrateful king alive. As the royal guard's manager you unlock upgrades, assign badges for special skills and try to keep morale and supplies from collapsing faster than the monarchy.

title: Soleil
description:
The direct sequel of: The Water is Wide.

Many people have tried to find the key to eternal life before, but... This isn't what this game is about. Play the part of Coco, a mysterious ex-orphan trapped inside a world where death exists no more, and where every single human has been blessed with the gift of immortality... if you consider that to be a gift, of course.

Join the main protagonist and their friends in a quest to find the truth behind the strange condition that has been bestowed upon humanity. To make everything the way it was before, or to do nothing about it... That depends on you.

title: Siemb Chronicles: Arkos The Traitor
description:
Caberhi Tram, elite commander of Emperor Shakar's military forces, is a legend in the Ururben galaxy. Even in the service of the evil intergalactic ruler, his adventures across countless worlds have made him a hero to the oppressed.

Following his legendary quest to find the three galactic tombs that ultimately spelled the end of the empire, his adventures are told in whispers and tales, in palaces, cantinas, markets, and homes across the galaxy. A series of adventures that are collected in the "Chronicles of Siemb".

title: Deep Breath
description:
Deep Breath - a short mapset at the bottom of the ocean.

In this project, our little green hero steps through the entryway airlock of an underwater base, the H.A.D.E.S (Hydro Atomic Deepsea Experimental Science) Facility, to find that demons are running rampant. Our mission: get to the heart of the Facility and activate the self-destruct protocol. Hopefully Doomguy can make it out alive, or at least sink down to a watery grave with all the monsters.

Greatly inspired by AD_79's map 05 from Tetanus by Squonker Team - the ingenious mechanics and visuals used in that map made me think of other potential ways in which to continue that narrative and visual thread.

title: 1000 Lines Community Project
description: A 34 map megawad made for vanilla Doom 2, made by the community with a strict line limit of 1000 lines.

title: 1000 Lines 2 Community Project
description: A 34 map megawad made for vanilla Doom 2, made by the community with a strict line limit of 1000 lines.

title: 1000 Lines 3 Community Project
description:
We have 32 totally awesome vanilla compatible maps for you (+ 2 bonus maps), powered by a vanilla friendly version of Otex1.1.

The episode themes this year, I feel are pretty interesting, unique and hopefully people will enjoy them.

title: Pumping Station
description: A singleplayer map made for the GZDoom port. Mouselook is recommended, but not required. Dynamic light must be enabled.

title: Shadow Zone
description: This minipack consists of three levels, two of which are redone old levels, and the third is completely new. Mouse look is supported but not required. Music taken from Quake II by Sonic Mayhem.

title: Outer Base
description: This is a small map with a good design, stuffed with blood and gore.

title: Digital Eclipse Arcade: Jollyball
description: Making toys is hard work, and even Santa's elves need a break. Thankfully, the North Pole Elfletic League gives everyone at the Workshop a workout. The Winter Invitational is underway, giving all of Santa's helpers the chance to be crowned seasonal champions of the North Pole's most popular 2-on-2 sport: Jollyball. (It's like standard volleyball, only much cooler.) The teams are ready, the net has been set, the Power-up Presents are primed, and there's fresh snow on the court — are you ready to sleigh the competition?

title: Temple of Blood
description: All difficulty levels are supported. Mouselook is recommended, but not required. For correct perception, the dynamic lights must be turned on.

title: Refinery Complex
description: A singleplayer map made for the GZDoom port. Mouselook is recommended, but not required.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Growing Light
description: Patch 6.5 introduces: new main scenario quests; the third installment from the alliance raid Myths of the Realm, Thaleia; a new trial, The Abyssal Fracture; a new dungeon, The Lunar Subterrane; a new Crystalline Conflict map, The Red Sands; a new Variant and Criterion dungeon, Aloalo Island, and more sidequests and sidecontent.

title: One Week at Flumpty's
description: One Week at Flumpty's was the original third and final installment of the One Night at Flumpty's series, but it was later canceled and the name was repurposed into the One Week at Flumpty's trilogy of shorts.

title: Hi-5: Let's Play
description: Hi-5: Let's Play is a CD-ROM game based on the Australian TV series Hi-3 released in 2003 by Dataworks.

title: 50 Blockbuster Games Volume 1
description: 50 Blockbuster Games Volume 1 is a compilation game by Nodtronics released in Australia.

title: 50 Blockbuster Games Volume 2
description: 50 Blockbuster Games Volume 2 is a second compilation game by Nodtronics released in Australia.

title: Gekihaden
description: A unique side-scrolling shooting game in which all the graphics other than the background, such as your own plane and enemy planes, are written in kanji. Players use lock-on lasers and regular bullets to complete a total of 7 stages with a wide variety.

title: Hedonistic Offering
description:
A former occult magazine editor, who had just been dumped by his girlfriend, suddenly lost his memory after drinking at a gay bar in Shinjuku, and found himself lying on a strange tropical beach.
The island is Shishia Island, a penal colony for homosexual felons in the Meiji era, and he is told that he is one of them.......

title: Escape from the Darkness
description: Your name is Alex Johnes. You're one of scientists caught up in the Black Mesa disaster. After being trained in a special Black Mesa self-defense course three months ago, you're unwilling to accept the sure death as your destiny. You will neither let the troops catch you, nor will they wipe you out. Make your way. Find Gordon Freeman. He is the last hope that drives you traveling on...

title: Frontline Force
description: In Front Line Force the players are divided into two teams: Attackers and Defenders. The object for the Attackers is to capture various Capture Points spread throughout the map. The object for the Defenders is to defend those points. Once a point is captured by the Attackers it cannot be taken back. The round is over when either the Attackers capture all the Capture Points or when the round time runs out, in which case the Defenders win. After the a team wins, the roles of are switched. If you were previously attacking, you are now defending, and vice versa.

title: Sandpit
description: Sandpit is a sandbox mod for Half-Life.

title: Hostile Intent
description:
Hostile Intent focuses teamwork, communication, and realism over a run and gun playstyle.

Hostile Intent for all intents and purposes is the thinking man's First Person Shooter. In Hostile Intent the player has to use cover wisely, conserve his ammo, work well with his teammates, use communication effectively, keep the mission at the forefront of his mind and especially keep his cool under fire.

title: Syndicate Black Ops
description:
The action takes place after the Dark ages (in a far future). You are a member from the Syndicate, a powerful criminal group specialist in assassination and delicate missions.

One of the more powerful mega corporation : Croon, contact you so that you "clean" their little error : Inadvertently they opened some hell's gate and the Federation send its choc troops in order to pacificate all of these things and to bring some proofs against Croon.

title: Tour of Duty
description: Tour of Duty is a realistic team play mod for Halflife by Valve Software. The game is set at the height of the Vietnam war, between 1967 and 1973 allowing you to relive the conflict fighting either for the United States Marine Corp (USMC) or the Viet Cong (VC)/North Vietnamese Army (NVA).

title: Stargate: TC SG-1 Missions
description: SG-1 Missions is a singleplayer modification of the older known Stargate TC multiplayer mod, it delivers hard 11 missions that take place in the Stargate universe.

title: Refracted Reality
description: 15 maps of gothic/abstract glory. Linear and non-linear layouts, high detail, color in abundance and great gameplay making use of advanced port features. (GZdoom 3.7.2 or higher required)

title: The Settlements
description: A set of 3 maps with an emphasis on exploring surreal environments. Some bits may had challenging combat and traps. Mostly non linear progression. This mapset its a spiritual succesor to Liminal Doom aesthetics in some ways.

title: 10 am Break
description: 5 quick maps for your 15 minute morning break from work.

title: Senses in Decay
description:
After the "resonance cascade", the H.E.C.U spread to almost all the sector of Black Mesa. The sector A was the most closest to the surface, that's why our protagonist manage to escape so easily.

John White escaped in a car, but he stopped in a storage facility of Black mesa. He destroy a vent to find supplies, but he find himself trapped in that supply room. The only way to escape is crossing all the F,G,H sectors of Black Mesa to the principal entrance.

title: Crypts of Eternity
description: A journey into a decrepit castle and crypts.

title: Doomkid
description:
Doomkid posted a bu﻿nch of midis a few years ago stating "Re-tuning and remastering of MIDI files I've found on the net. These should be perfect for DOOM ﻿maps. Enjoy!" so I made some Doom maps.

14 Maps + Secret Map + End Map based around the midi song names. Mostly ~5-10 min each. Slaughter adjace. Skill settings implemented. Tested in DSDA and EE. Boom CL9 compat.

title: Sniper Rush
description: Immerse yourself in an epic action experience with your friends with our exciting first-person shooter. Get ready to embark on a limitless adventure in the sky and on the ground. This game will take you to an astonishing map where freedom of movement is absolute! Enjoy thrilling flights, sprint at full speed, and jump like never before thanks to an innovative hook that allows you to reach inaccessible places. Fun and excitement are guaranteed in this gravity-defying shooter! Are you ready for action?

title: Touhou Dream Runner
description: A one button rhythm action game that Youmu beats her enemies(?) to the beat.

title: Fatal Hearts
description: Fatal Hearts is an English-language visual novel/adventure game in which players control a teenage female protagonist who is having strange dreams while people are being murdered. It was released in October 2007 for Microsoft Windows.

title: The Tale of Dragons and Oceans
description: The Tale of Dragons and Ocean is a fast-paced boss rush game where a mother must defeat four huge dragons to retrieve her son's soul from the sea by throwing a spear and pulling the enemy's energy through a rope while dodging their attacks.

title: Toing's Pops
description: Toing's Pops is a singleplayer survival horror game, you must run and hide from Toing while uncovering the information needed for your escape. Amidst all the chaos, just remember why you came...

title: The Dreamer Must Die
description: 'The Dreamer Must Die' is an RPG shooter where you're the only hope for a fading dream world. Advance the story, find new equipment, and improve your character within the mind menu to ensure your survival.

title: Duas Vidas
description:
The year is 2032, Brazil has suffered a coup d'état in which a president supported by a fundamentalist militia has taken over the country.
Paulo and Júlia, two young black people from a fictional ghetto in a fictional city in a future that is, unfortunately, getting closer and closer to reality, have to make decisions in a single day that can impact the rest of their lives as well as the millions of people around them. And who will make those decisions? You.

title: Block Room
description: In Block Room, you need to escape the dangers and collect the apples that serve as a shot to unlock the path to the next level.

title: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
description: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

title: Zaum Gadget
description:
Billed as an "interactive cyber event," this interactive hypercard stack is said to have been found by by creator Amendant Hardiker among some Babelian ruins dated back to 9999 BC, then deciphered from a since forgotten machine language. It is thought that Zaum Gadget was a subliminal event-structure capable of subtly manipulating the beliefs of any participant.

Inspired by Russian futurism, Zaum is a unique digital experience.

title: Cyber Storm Edge
description:
Fast-paced 2D Retro Side Scroller Platformer! Fight against Cyber Space Pirates!
Attack and shoot through the stages and defeat each stage boss.
A total of 5 stages, and one unlockable character, one time trial per stage, and one No-Damage challenge per stage.

title: Princesa das Nuvens
description: Princesa das Nuvens is a chaotic game where the player controls the knight tasked with protecting a princess. But she has a fragile heart, so while repairing damage to the tower done by enemies, you need to calm the princess down.

title: Metamorphism
description: This map started out for vanilla doom2.exe but we quickly pushed the limits. Several days before release however, the HOM's and VPO's were vaporized with MANY thanks to BSP. QWERTY and stx-Vile are credited with pinpointing them.

title: Lily's Memories
description: Lily is an 8-year-old girl who wakes up in her bed at night, hearing voices and strange sounds. The voices tell her that she is in danger and needs to find something important that she lost (her memories of what happened in that house). Lily discovers that apart from the voices, she sees terrifying creatures that try to capture her.
14/? is an exploration game where you explore strange rooms while walking through doors that lead you to other strange rooms.

title: Pseudoregalia: Jam Ver.
description: When reality feels like it's falling apart, one might retreat to a world in their dreams to escape it. Unfotunately, dreams aren't made to last. Explore a perverse image of noble living. Grow strong, and free those trapped within this rotten dream.

title: Marvel's Avengers Definitive Edition
description:
Marvel’s Avengers is an action-adventure game developed by Crystal Dynamics and published by Square Enix in 2020. It features both a single-player campaign and multiplayer missions, combining narrative-driven gameplay with cooperative online play. The story follows Kamala Khan as she reunites the Avengers after a catastrophic event. Players can control multiple heroes, each with unique abilities and skill trees.

The Definitive Edition includes all released DLC missions and heroes. Spider-Man is available exclusively on PlayStation.

title: Doll's Liminal
description: Avoid or defeat dolls that move when you're not looking, take their bodies, and make your way to the 399th dimension. This is a short horror game of fear and strategy, an exploration survival horror.

title: Bitter/Sweet Blythe
description:
On their birthday, Bunnie (renameable + pick your pronouns) makes a wish, but will they get more than they bargained for when a bunny-eared being named Blythe shows up to give them their best-ever birthday?

Made in under a month for Yandere Jam 2023.

title: The Graveyard Shift
description:
Created by Melancholy Marionette using Naninovel x Unity.
Based on a script by Reece Shearsmith & Steve Pemberton (Adapted, altered, and added to by Melancholy Marionette).

title: Dawn of the Damned
description: Anxious to attend your job interview at Aurora Antiques, you arrive to discover a room full of melancholy mannequins. One, in particular, captures your interest, drawing you closer.

title: Solipsism Reigns BxG
