description: Visual novel by Melancholy Marionette.

title: Love in Lockdown: Ella version
description:
Visual novel by Melancholy Marionette.

7 different endings depending on your choices
Casual choices and choices with consequences
The option to rename ELLA and name yourself
Gender-neutral - ELLA will refer to you by your chosen name + 'you' and 'they'
Full (terrible) British voice acting with 2 different voice options to choose from
Mild adult content

title: Chrono Belt: Ayakashibito & Bullet Butlers Crossover Disc
description: A crossover visual novel by Propeller.

title: Motoko Hime Adventure
description:
A PC-88 visual novel.

Motoko Hime is science fiction writer. After finishing writing a novel she was sucked into the novel and you're the only one who can save her.

title: Oops! All Techbase
description: A 32-Level Megawad, each level Techbase themed.

title: Spire Horizon: Companion Expansion
description: Traveling alone is not difficult at all, but with a companion to solve loneliness, it could be even better. Shared experiences and lasting memories make the journey more fulfilling. Solo travel offers freedom, while accompanied travel provides companionship.

title: Slimeria
description: Welcome to Slimeria, an exciting adventure game set in Middle-earth! your mission is to overcome various challenges and find the golden goblet that will give you the strength to free the villages from the clutches of darkness.

title: Cecelia
description: A mysterious island. A giant baby made of stone awakens. Learn to trust each other if you want to explore the perilous terrain, seeking answers from the island's enigmatic call and an ominous force awaiting you in the distant lighthouse.

title: A Nest for Us
description: Fly through the forest collecting twigs to build your nest with in this minimalistic, nature-inspired platformer.

title: Absurd Story: Back Home
description: A runaway wanderer, a frail Taoist priest, who want to return to their hometown at the end of the world. But when they step into the empty city, they are swept into the dead ruins…

title: Abyssey
description:
Abyssey is a strategy log-like game with Pixel Horizontal Scroll View!
Get jewelry and get a job! You get one job depending on the jewelry you're wearing!
Depending on your job, you will be able to use your own basic attacks and skills!
There are a total of 16 jobs, and you can experience new plays every time!
You can also gain item synergies, and item synergies can earn additional skills and stats to complement your job skills!
You can strengthen your items to make your current skills and synergy stronger!
There are more than 60 items. Try combine them in a variety of ways!
And, Beat enemies and bosses by creating my own synergy combination!

title: Click Dungeon
description: This is a turn-based strategy game, Train your fighter, carefully select equipment for him, carefully select the target of attack, and meet the coming elite monsters, Defeat monsters to get loot and improve combat power! Form a team of fighters to fight various bosses!

title: Crossroads: What Was Lost - Collector's Edition
description: When Eden struggles to find direction after a devastating loss, Crossroads and bartender Mistress Eve appear just in the nick of time! Eden's love of fairy tales and legends makes these three spine-tingling fables the perfect way to set them on the right path. So, are you up to the challenge?

title: Cyber Prison Management
description: You are tasked with managing 8 prisoners in a flying space prison for 30 days with your camera system. You'll need to manage the stock market, hostile ships, and keep prisoners in line. Or play as one of the prisoners, hiding and trying to escape. But be careful - danger is always around the corner.

title: Laruaville 14
description: Touch the Oriental Wisdom from the ancient sage himself and build him a town!

title: Girls Divers
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Don't Not Live
description: Don't Not Live is a precision platformer where you can dash in any direction. Climb to the top of the afterlife to meet god and receive the special prize for completing his hellish obstacle course.

title: Mandemon
description: Decaying Japanese school buildings, a series of bizarre incidents, eerie Mandemon legends. Lies and truths intertwine, love and hate entwined in the mist. What should one do? Whom should one believe? Welcome to this cruel world filled with deception and harm —

title: Shadowblade Odyssey
description:
"Shadowblade Odyssey" is an enchanting 2D platform adventure game that draws inspiration from the classic retro Shadow style. Embark on a thrilling journey through a mysterious phantasmal world, where players take on the role of a young hero.

In this game, players must skill fully evade cunningly placed traps and employ their mastery of blades and darts to vanquish enemies. However, combat is not the only approach; players can also learn potent shapeshifting abilities to conceal themselves within the shadows, quietly elude adversaries, and seek out hidden treasures.

Players can exchange their hard-earned currency to acquire new abilities, upgrade their existing skills, and unlock powerful enhancements for their character. Whether it's improving the effectiveness of their blades and darts, extending the duration of their shapeshifting ability, or acquiring unique and rare skills.

title: The Panic Room: House of Secrets
description: A hidden object game featuring an exciting detective plot, realistic graphic and atmospheric music.

title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon - Management Mode Set
description: The Yakuza: Like a Dragon - Management Mode Set includes three sets of employees that can be added to the Management Mode roster.

title: Gord: Deluxe Edition
description: Gord is a dark-fantasy, adventure-strategy game set in a hostile land inspired by Slavic mythology. Besieged by vile creatures, you must build to survive. But to prevail, you must conquer the darkness beyond the gates. Command the Tribe of the Dawn and lead the conquest that will shape the kingdom.

title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon - Karaoke Set
description: The Yakuza: Like a Dragon - Karaoke Set adds a variety of classic and new karaoke songs to the jukebox in the Survive Bar, a key location in the game.

title: Tail & Trails
description: A short exploration game where you and your magical pets take a walk on one fine evening.

title: Fate/Samurai Remnant: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
In this set:
- The main game
- Digital Artbook
- Soundtrack
- Season Pass (featuring 3 Additional Episodes)
- Season Pass Bonus: Hallowed Relic Sword Mountings (Equipment)

title: Hollow Victory
description: "Hollow Victory!" is a short visual novel about visiting your ex in jail after he tried taking over the world...

title: WorldNeverland: Elnea Kingdom - The Makeover Collection
description:
Contents:
-Cosmetics set (Magical Makeup, Hair Catalog)
*You can buy it at any time in the game shop( Fashion Store in Castle St. ) when you purchase it.
-Luxury Wedding Attire Set ( White, Pink, Blue )
*You can buy it at any time in the game shop( Clothing Store in Castle St. ) when you purchase it.

title: Strawberry Shortcake: Berry Rush
description:
Get ready for some Strawberry Shortcake fun!
Strawberry and her friends want to bake fruitilicious cakes, but they need your help!
Run, slide and leap through the wonderful world of Berry Bitty City and grab all the strawberries, cherries, oranges and other yummy fruit you can find!
Then it’s time to decorate your cake, and snap a picture to show your friends!
Collect as many sticker packs as you can and fill the amazing sticker book!
Play as Strawberry Shortcake or one of her friends! Look: Cherry Jam, Orange Blossom, Blueberry Muffin, Lemon Meringue, Raspberry Torte, Plum Pudding and Huckleberry Pie… they’re all here!

Run along with the super-adorable and cute puppy pals! Every day is a special occasion for Strawberry Shortcake, and that calls for a fresh and fruity look. Each character has her own set of stylish outfits.
Come join the fun and play Strawberry Shortcake’s berry exciting Berry Rush adventure!

title: Trapped in the Kanal
description: I got locked in the keep-out area in a waterway The quiet sound of water flow makes me uncomfortable I need get out of here……

title: The Scientists' Secret: Hidden Object Game
description: Can you find all the differences in the scenes? Discover them to unveil the mysteries of the scientists, only then you will know what has happened in their research.

title: Mechanic 8230: Escape From Ilgrot - Extended Edition
description:
Mechanic 8230: Escape from Ilgrot is a puzzle point & click adventure, set in the ruined city of Ilgrot. Use anything you can find to progress through the story.
Even the tiniest coin can prove vital in this adventure. Remember – the only weapon at your disposal is your mind!

title: Hyper Torque Racing
description:
Be the wind on the circuit! A real racer experience with simple visuals! That's Hyper Torque Racing.
Move the kart with just the accelerator, brake, and steering wheel. The simplified driving operations give you a deep, authentic racer experience you can enjoy.

title: Moto Rush GT: Gold Edition
description:
This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack and Grip Collection #1 with:
-4 new motorbikes (each with special colors)
-New colors for the rest of motorbikes
-New colors for gloves
-Special, Golden colors for motorbikes
-four pairs of brand-new, high-quality racing gloves. Each pair is designed not only to upgrade your control, but also to boost your rider's aesthetics. Feel the real rush!

title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Character Pass 2
description:
Character Pass 2 contains three DLC Character Packs, each containing three playable characters, for a total of nine playable characters!

Includes:
- Character Pack 4: The Battle of Onigashima Pack
- Character Pack 5
- Character Pack 6
- One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 Onigashima Battle Law Costume (Character Pass 2 Bonus)

title: Dual Chroma: Haereticus
description:
As a scribe, you serve in subterranean tombs. You once adored a different version of Him before His transformation. Now, as He calls you to the Cerean Hall, how will you respond?

A glimpse into the shadows of Aradal ages past. Haereticus is short experience set in the Dual Chroma universe made for OA2A jam.

title: Fairytale Thief: The Goldfish
description:
One fine morning a lavish palace appears out of thin air.

Not unheard of in a magical world, but still a curious event.

Rumours travel fast, and they say the fabled wish-granting golden fish is being held prisoner inside its own creation.

Sounds like a job for a phantom thief!

title: Eroblast: Playful Edition
description: You'll be able to chat with attractive girls, know their engaging storylines, receive spicy pictures, and solve Match-3 Puzzles to unlock new and cool pick-up lines for your waifu!

title: Master Detective Archives: Rain Code - Ch. Fubuki: Fubuki's Luckiest Day
description: The second DLC for Master Detective Archives: Rain Code is a substory that features protagonist Fubuki Clockford, and allows players to control the Master Detective with the Forensic Forte "Time Leap."

title: Counter Delta 2: Eastern Crisis
description:
War clouds begin to gather over the Eastern European region. A single-player TPS game that fights against terrorists around the world!
“Counter Delta 2: Eastern Crisis”is a solo single player/Third-Person Shooter.
Team up with our soldiers to complete the battlefield mission.
Enjoy a thrilling TPS game with a diverse play mode and various weapons that can be unlocked by leveling up.

title: Canvas of Kings
description: Canvas of Kings is a minimalistic mapmaking tool that focuses on randomness and auto-generated elements on user-definable and interactive paths and plots.

title: Please Leave a Message
description: Please Leave a Message is a 2D puzzle game where the player finds themselves in the role of delirious man named Schitz Mann, as he crawls through an underground, labyrinthine facility.

title: Hentai World: Definitive Edition
description: Feast your eyes with Akane, Rose and Nanami in the most sensual puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch has to offer.

title: Snake Jump
description: You're a snake who is tired of living on the ground. You wanna explore the sky and go as high as you can. Take on a thrilling obstacle cours and a beautiful mystery awaits you at the top...

title: Spell Disk Survivor
description: "Spell Disk Survivor" is one of the game modes in "Spell Disk" where you survive against the endless waves of enemies. Craft overpowering builds using synergizing items and unlock new powers!

title: Eukarion Tales: Origins
description: A retro-flash, isometric RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Battle hordes of enemies, upgrade your abilities, and experience a deep, fantasy-filled storyline in a European Middle Age-inspired world!

title: Boreal Tenebrae: Deluxe Definitive Edition
description:
Boreal Tenebrae will take you on a retro-style adventure, with a mysterious atmosphere and horror elements. The game is inspired by 90s classics and the best TV series.

You play as multiple characters, each with their own story, and travel to actual locations in town and dark versions of them.
In this nightmare, you have to solve the murder, search for your missing sister Sarah, and complete the mysterious ritual to save the dying town. Will you be able to unravel all the dark secrets of Boreal Tenebrae?

title: Call of Farming
description: A game for you to create your own farming or simulation game. It includes an inventory, craft, building, growing plants, farm animals and much more.

title: Fashion Friends: Special Edition
description:
Fashion is better together with your friends!

Become a stylist to the models, actresses and fashion girls! Play a mix of classic arcade games where you have to cut the picture in a new game aimed for children and adults alike.

title: Cooking Arena
description: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!

title: Battle of Tarlis
description: "Battle of Tarlis" is game where you explore many areas to get the best gear or highest level to defeat bosses or survive the hardest zones!

title: They Linger
description: Navigate the narrow hallways in the darkness to find and rescue Jessica and survive the infinite Labyrinth.

title: Wind Love
description: Visual novel in Japanese style. An exciting story with four endings, a huge number of choices, 10+ CGs, 5+ BGs, original music and animated sprites of the main characters will allow you to immerse yourself in a cruel world of deceit and sincerity..

title: Horror Loop
description: Horror Loop, made with a new generation game engine with a deep, impressive and original story, is waiting for you!

title: Soluble Dream
description: Soluble Dream is a visual novel for adults only. Venture into a world of passion, temptation and mystery. Starring Jackson Taylor, a brilliant programming student who must make tough decisions while guarding his reputation and struggling with himself.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Medieval Mayhem
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Medieval themed tables filled with cannons that will blast you to the past!

title: D.C. III PS: Da Coda III - Plus Story
description:
The sakura that bloomed year-round is now a thing of the past and Hatsune Island is now known as an island that shows the beauty of each season.

Kiyotaka is a second-year student at Kazami Academy who is part of the news club along with the school idol Rikka, his younger sister-like childhood friend Himeno, his mixed-race cousin Charles, a hard-working junior who skipped a grade and is in his class Sara, and energetic in spirit but weak in body Aoi.

Unlike in the past, there are no more mysterious things happening on the island. That was until one winter day when the sakura began to bloom. All the news club members got a message on their cell phones telling them to do something at a promised place when the sakura begins to bloom. They couldn’t make out the rest of the message but are surprised that it was dated 1951. Rikka was extremely curious about the message and the sudden blooming of the sakura, so she called on everyone to solve the mystery with her.

title: Evil Officer
description: Escape the haunted house before the vengeful "Evil Officer" claims you. Only 5 days, cunning, and stealth will save you. Can you survive the horror and outsmart the relentless pursuit? Beware, he hears everything!

title: Survivors of the Plague
description: Survive against the Scarlet Plague in an action-packed survival roguelike.

title: Shin Galaxy: Engage
description: Shin Galaxy: Engage is an action game with RPG elements in a top-down perspective, where you control spaceships and tries to survive as much as possible in the stages. Improve performance, change appearance and unlock new ships to get as far as you can.

title: Jaden & Jasmine: Lost Memories
description: It's been exactly one month since Jaden Black was shot and betrayed by Jasmine Miles. Did she complete her mission? Well in Lost Memories you not only find that out, but you find out what Harmony's motive was. This game follows the events of the first game Jaden & Jasmine: The Curse of Deception.

title: Lethal Operation: Episode 3 - Lethal Arms of Justice
Hayarigami: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File
description: An enhanced port of Hayarigami: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File, the first entry in the urban legend mystery adventure series, originally released in 2004. The 2023 version features optimized high-resolution visuals and includes the additional scenarios and content introduced in earlier expanded editions. It was released as a standalone digital title and is also included in Hayarigami 1-2-3 Pack.

title: Hayarigami 3: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File
description: An enhanced port of Hayarigami 3: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File, originally released in 2009. This version brings the urban legend mystery adventure to modern platforms with optimized high-resolution visuals and all previously released additional scenarios and content. It was released individually as a digital title and is also included in Hayarigami 1-2-3 Pack.

title: Hayarigami 2: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File
description: An enhanced port of Hayarigami 2: Keishichou Kaii Jiken File, originally released in 2007. The 2023 edition adapts the supernatural police investigation adventure for modern platforms, featuring improved high-resolution presentation and the additional scenarios and content included in previous expanded releases. It is available digitally as a standalone title and as part of Hayarigami 1-2-3 Pack.

title: Keltika
description: Keltika is a story driven economic strategy game inspired by celtic myths and history. Ancient druid magic, power of the celtic gods or even perseverance and knowledge of your people - only you choose the way to conquer Keltika!

title: Raindrop Sprinters
description: Avoid rain, get stars, and run across the passage!

title: Hatsukoi Sankaime
description:
A censored port of Hatsukoi Sankaime.

Everyone has experienced first love and it is a truly bittersweet experience. Taichi had also fallen in love once, but it ended very painfully for him. Two years later, he was ready to take a step forward and fall in love again. Just when he was about to begin his new relationship with a girl who he fell in love with at first sight, the ghost Rin descended from the skies. Aside from the colour of her eyes and her hair, she looked exactly like his first love. Will he be able to forget his first love and move on, or will he still yearn for it?

title: Wash Simulator: Clean Garage, House, Cars Business Tycoons
description: Welcome to the ultimate cleaning adventure, where cleanliness is your path to success! In Wash Simulator, you're the savvy entrepreneur, ready to conquer the world of washing and cleaning.

title: Survival Nation: Lost Horizon
description: Survival Nation: Lost Horizon is an open-world, top-down zombie survival game. Keep yourself and other survivors alive in a world gone to the zombies, upgrade your gear and skills, and keep civilization going in a world where humans are the top pick on the menu.

title: Sorrow Asylum
description: Sorrow Asylum is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison.

title: Echoes of Karma
description: Echoes of Karma is a game about a flirty demon and gay magician who travel the multiverse. As they travel, they discover a threat known as Glitch. The game is a turn based RPG, but with Blocking Mechanics during the enemy turn. Save TP by skipping your turn to use higher level abilities!

title: Battery Hunter
description: "Battery Hunter" is a 2D pixel-art style linear level game where player must ensure their ability to defeat the final boss.

title: Red Titans
description: Red Titans is a single player vertical shoot em up, use the resources available to stop the threat, you will have to be very skillful since there are no continues.

title: The Shapeshifter 2
description: Welcome to the world of "The Shapeshifter 2 - Become the Animal You Touch" by Green Boy Games, the second part of the trilogy that has taken the Game Boy community by storm! In this unique and original Old-School Adventure game, you'll join Elliot on a mission to save the Elven world from the wizard's spell. Armed with a great power to become any animal he touches, Elliot must race against time as the powers run out at dawn.

title: Infernal Wave
description: It's an intense cooperative survival shooter that pits a team of up to five players against endless waves of zombies. As the last line of defense in a post-apocalyptic world, players must work together to strategize, survive, and take down the hordes.

title: Fandominion
description: Battle it out as your chosen champion to prove who has the best fandom! 2-4 players can fight across multiple venues in this brawler party game. Attack other champions, avoid stage hazards, and win minigames! Decide which nerd will come out on top and which fandom is superior in Fandominion!

title: Camera Anima
description: The Artisan, one of one of Awyr's most infamous killers, is said to walk the cloudy streets looking for his next masterpiece. Pursue the Artisan, save your sister, and uncover the past, but remember what the stories say…Meet his face, and never wake again.

title: Doki Doki Corrupted Files
description: With the files corrupted, and a looming threat on the loose, our crew find themselves in a precarious situation. Set during a decaying act 4, you'll witness a short story that introduces brand new concepts to the all-too well-known story of the Literature Club.

title: Kingdom of Paradise
description: Experience Kingdom of Paradise originally released on the PSP system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Ray Mohawk's Manic Monday
description: Ray Mohawk is a 100% vanilla-compatible mini-episode for Doom 2. 6 maps of fun and sun to blaze through - engaging, but never unfair. Despite having a bit of a beachy theme, these maps are mostly Classic Doom, just like momma used to make, but with a dash of palm trees, bright blue skies and a cruisy, light-hearted soundtrack.

title: Ray Mohawk 2: Ray Wreaks Havoc!
description: Ray is BACK and ready for more vanilla-compatible action in the tropics! This is a community project and sequel to my older wad, Ray Mohawk's Manic Monday.

title: Skulltiverse
description:
Skulltiverse is a community project built around constrains in both playable space and build time. Each map was mostly completed within a week.

The wad contains 32 maps split into 6 themes - Techbase, Corrupt Techbase, Ruins, Marble Hell, Fleshy Hell and Void.

title: Acción Rescate
description:
Panrico and BetyByte have launched a game, 'Acción Rescate', in which there are six mini-games framed in each of the continents, Europe, Africa, America, Oceania, Asia and Antarctica, where the players — surely fans of buns Panrico—should save the lives of endangered animals.

Elephants, seals, tigers, wolves, koalas, all of them depend on your effort and desire to save the planet and the ecosystem in which they live. The African jungle, the European rivers, the frozen sea of Antarctica are full of animals that need the help of the Action Rescue Team, a group dedicated to saving various animal species in danger of extinction.

Each player will have to lead their character —be it Darren, Lia, Shasa, Kumo, Marvin or Veruka— through the different continents saving as many animals as possible. If you finally achieve the objective, each player will be able to get a diploma in which they will be recognized as an active member of the Rescue Action Team.

title: Skull Jones
description: Skull Jones tells the story of a badass ladybug trying to change the natural selection of his habitat, where everyone judges his species as fragile.

title: Acción Rescate: América
description: One of the 6 CD's that contains the America minigame.

title: Sapo Xulé and the Unwanted Marriage
description: Sapo Xulé is back! To celebrate the character's 30th anniversary, Squash Studios and the character's creator, artist Paulo José, present “Sapo Xulé and the Unwanted Marriage”, a 2D platform game inspired by the character's games released in the 90s.

title: Adventurous Mind
description: Explore the depths of suspense, adventure, and intrigue with this bundle of must-have games: Alfred Hitchcock - Vertigo, Beyond a Steel Sky and Syberia 3. Immerse yourself in fascinating worlds, solve captivating mysteries and discover extraordinary stories.

title: Have Fun Together
description: The more the merrier! Gather friends and family for hilarious game nights with this bundle dedicated to party games.

title: Comic Book Legends
description: Discover the adventure and action bundle, bringing together three thrilling games: Blacksad: Under the Skin, North & South and XIII. Immerse yourself in unique universes and prepare for captivating and varied experiences.

title: There Are Dinosaurs
description: In There Are Dinosaurs, you'll face the formidable challenges of resource management and dinosaur encounters. Construct and expand your underground refuge, strategically allocating rooms to meet the essential needs of your community, including food, water, power, and entertainment.

title: Neoclip
description: An arcade-like explorative experience about revealing unique De Stijl inspired compositions. Navigate a complicated labyrinth of evolving levels using the shadows of the walls to highlight the obscured regions.

title: Labyrinth Trials
description: Descend into the ever-shifting Labyrinth Trials, a relentless roguelike FPS where survival depends on your skill, your weapon, and a little bit of luck. Face hordes of nightmarish creatures, scavenge powerful upgrades, and conquer the maze… or die trying.

title: TD Tower Defense
description: Build your towers according to the enmey you are facing in the wave. Upgrade your turrets to increase range, damage or rewards. Each enemy wave will be random and increases in speed and damage resistance. How far can you go!

title: Made in Hell
description: "Made in Hell" is a 2D pixel vertical scrolling action game. Throw bones and jump (warp). Throw a bone and keep climbing.

title: Tachyonest
description: Engage in a fast-paced, third-person spaceship shooter, where strategic combat meets explosive action in an interstellar battlefield.

title: Shadows of Zana
description: Swing, dash, slide and slice your way through the Sequel of Phantom of Zana. Blast, hack and slash your opponents or bounce off their heads! Power up Fantastic Fania and bring The Color back to Zana in this retro inspired 2D Action Platformer.

title: Color Splash: Cats
description: Color Splash: Cats is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable cats and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful cat paintings.

title: Amare Inversus
description: Amare Inversus is a psychological thriller about a surgeon deeply obsessed with her patient. Love, lust, and obsession will begin to blur, leaving the audience with an unforgettable visual novel.

title: Music Man 2: New land
description: Sequel to Music man game. Collect all notes at 4 different levels to play piano and find also mysterious blue crystals

title: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
description: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

title: To My Forever Love
description: 2D platformer in which you cannot walk. I wish you a fruitful journey.

title: Three Days to Chicago
description: One of them is visiting a friend in Chicago. The other wants to shake things up in New York City. It starts in San Francisco, but where this relationship goes is all up to you.

title: YaoGuai Hunter
description: Yao-Guai Hunter is a Wuxia roguelike deck-building game. In a world where Yao-Guai roam free, player battles with various evil beings, collecting cards and learn inner skills. Encountering various adventures in the martial world.

title: Lethal Crisis
description: Lethal Crisis is a bullet hell action game with cute anime girls!

title: Explore
description: An open world, soulslike action game with authentic battles with chibi characters.

title: Owari no Kane ga Naru mae ni: Chapter 1 - Plus Edition
description: This popular visual novel has returned with additional content.

title: Mystery Lover: Nonexistent Summer
description: Wei who's in the supernatural club must solve the missing virtual idol incident with his girlfriend Bansha.

title: I'm on a Watcher Duty: Anniversary Special
description: The game to celebrate the Watcher Duty series.

title: Blood Hunting
description: Blood Hunting is a first-person survival horror game by Holcomb Entertainment LLC. A true survival horror experience that sets the stage on how dangerous revenge can be... if you can survive it.

title: Can Strike
description: Your employers at Fish Co are sending in Robots to end your strike! Use your union-granted weapons to destroy the waves of robots to keep the strike going.

title: Connected! 2
description: Minimalistic puzzle game. Connect the opposite sides of the same color by rotating the tiles. Each level is randomly generated, but guaranteed to be solvable!

title: Sel Mounta: Siege the Demon Castle
description: An RPG in which a party of 6 adventurers continue an ongoing quest to stop an invasion from a mysterious isolationist nation. Features JRPG style gameplay and a focus on story.

title: I Must Eat Chili Oil
description:
I miss her mapo tofu.

436 words. Lumpy and greasy.

title: Climbing Over It with a Spear
description: Climb a mountain with a spear, if you fall, you get up.

title: Frog's Adventure
description:
Frog's Adventure is a point-and-click game about a frog who gets given a brain! Chase after a mischievous fairy, and get it to turn you into a regular frog again.

On your adventure, you'll meet many different animals who share the same fate... Can you lift the curse, and make everyone their true selves again?

title: Mystery Box: Escape The Room
description: Welcome to the 3rd chapter of the "Mystery Box" series. You're trapped inside dark rooms and must solve intriguing enigmas to open boxes and escape. Can you make it?

title: Witch's Heart: Shirarezaru Kako Majo Dorothy no Himitsu - Kanketsu-hen
description:
After "Witch's Heart: Bonus Stage", it is the third entry of the series by IZ (BLUE STAR Entertainment). This time, it focuses on one of the main protagonists and his conclusion: Sirius Gibson. It is an adventure game with horror themes made in RPG Maker 2000, story-focused, and contains simple action scenes.

Although published as a separate game, it is part of the main game.

title: Atmospheric Extinction
description:
Atmospheric Extinction is a Boom (-complevel 9) mapset comprised of 9 maps divided into 3 distinct and action-packed episodes.

This project began when I was messing around with OTEX and trying to see if I could come up with some interesting layouts with a sense of progression, interconnectivity, and be fun/rewarding to explore.

title: The Walking Dead: Betrayal
description: Betray your friends in this 5-8 person game of cooperation and social deception set in the universe of The Walking Dead. Work together to survive, but trust no one! Traitors have so many ways to sabotage the team, the walkers are the most predictable threat.

title: The Ultimate Doom: In Name Only
description: The project was designed to be a creative exercise in building levels around the original map titles for all 36 maps of the Ultimate Doom with an increasing emphasis on creating challenging but enjoyable maps that will even given experienced veterans a stern test (Especially for an Ultimate Doom megawad and especially so for episodes 3 and 4). All maps are built to a limit removing (complevel 3) format and are beatable from a pistol start, difficulty setting are included, but some may need a little refinement to pitch the difficulty with more precision. Co-op starts are included but anything beyond this will be patchy and dependent on the author who made the map.

title: Marble Magicks
description: In this Game your goal is to place 3 marbles of the same color next to each other, by taking a marble from the top depot and letting them fall on the scales below.

title: Un Presagio de Huesos
description:
First part of Un Presagio de Huesos, where the promises of the old witch of the swamp are told and the Hero is presented with the ultimate temptation.

Play, O muse, the story of the futile hero; the story about the struggle against heaven and earth that cost the lives of countless orphans, brought a brother from the abysses of the confines to the borders of the Dream and made the rivers of the continent red.

title: Dawn of Marionette
description: An android suddenly comes to the player who was leading an ordinary life. A thrilling life with battles and adult activities.

title: Boxes
description: Welcome to Boxes, a nostalgic pixel art game that will put your puzzle-solving skills to the test! Embark on a delightful journey through over 100 mind-bending levels in this charming and addictive box-pushing adventure.

title: Borderlands 3: Designer's Cut
description: Borderlands 3 gets even bigger with the Director's Cut add-on content! Test your mettle against the most fearsome of all Varkids, scour the galaxy to solve a string of murders, experience never-before-seen content and insights from the creation of Borderlands 3, and earn rewards with three new Vault Cards featuring themed loot and powerful gear.

title: Dair
description: A platform fighting game with only one attack, this sequel to Nair focuses on edgeguarding and off-stage play.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II - Season 05
description:
When darkness falls, the shadows will rise.
Shadow Company and Task Force 141 face off in Season 05 of Call of Duty Warzone and MWII Which side will you choose?

Graves is alive.
Even if Task Force 141 successfully secured the warhead as part of their RAID, Farah lost her brother — and AQ asset — Hadir . . . but not before he revealed that a greater threat is on the horizon.
Unbeknownst to Price, Gaz, and the rest of 141, Farah and Alex head back into Urzikstan. A meeting has been set up with a former enemy who apparently wasn’t incinerated in his tank at the Fuerzas Especiales Headquarters in South America.
Three elite leaders pore over a map of Al Mazrah, where Graves has intel on a new ultranationalist threat now present in the AO, the same group Hadir could not speak of in his dying breaths:
The Konni Group.

title: A Bite at Freddy's
description:
A Bite at Freddy's is a bite-sized Five Nights at Freddy's experience.

Freddy Fazbear's Grill needs your help to test and repair the Freddy Fast-Food Delivery machine! Work along the restaurant manager to ensure food orders can be delivered from kitchen to customer without issue.

Complete orders, repairs, and challenges!

title: Fredbear and Friends: Out of the Machine
description: Spend 5 nights as the night guard at Fredbear and Friends. Listen for the grandfather clock's chimes.

title: Five Nights With Mr. Hugs (& Friends)
description:
(WARNING : Super serious game about super serious self-aware vacuums)

Welcome to Freddy Fazbear's bakery! We mainly deliver to Fazbear restaurants, but we also will make cakes for personal parties! (For a proper fee, of course)

We are currently hiring for a janitor to vacuum the filth from this establishment, as our air system has broken down. Our self-aware vacuum cleaners have also turned evil and try to eat up anything in the building (including you), so defend yourself if they come nearby.

title: FeedBee and Friends: Left to Rock
description:
Warning: This teaser game is not for the faint of heart.

In this game, you must swiftly defeat FeedBee to save mankind, and of course your sanity.
This is no l
aughing matter, whatsoever.
At all.

title: A Night at Fanny's
description:
In a short parody of the first Five Nights at Freddy's game, you can spend a night with Fanny and friends!

Warning : This game is very difficult, you must listen for the movement patterns.

Fanny FanSteel's Fanaria will blow you away with their new fans, unlike those abominable Fazbear rinky-dinky desk fans. They name their fans "Animatronics", which is odd. We don't entirely understand.

Remember, the fan blades are metal. Watch your fingers. Hold your hats.

title: A Night at Fanny's 2
description:
In a short parody of Five Nights at Freddy's, you can spend a night with Fanny and friends! Again!

Welcome to Ferdinand's Fan Shop, where we have been designing all-new fans! While our alarm system is temporarily down, we need your help to make sure that no one steals the new models.

Remember, the fan blades are metal. Watch your fingers. Tuck your shirts.

title: Ponyvania: Order of Equestria
description: Ponyvania: Order of Equestria is a fanmade 2D action-platformer based on the My Little Pony series and the Castlevania games.

title: Colors of Fate
description:
Within a peaceful village in the middle of a forest lived Melia, a cheerful and stubborn young girl; and her best friend Enris, who dreamed of becoming the village's next herbalist.

Both of them were happy without worry until an unfortunate incident separated the two children tragically.

Life is not always made of fairytales and tranquil days.

But come... and see Melia's fate unfold before your eyes, as she becomes a strong and independent young woman throughout the years!

title: Alienated
description:
Alienated is a 10-level wad made for GZDoom and Zandronum. It features levels of varying size and difficulty, all made with the Ancient Aliens texture pack. There are 9 regular levels and one secret map, accessible from map06.

The wad is meant to be played with dynamic lights turned on. Freelook is recommended, but not required. No jumping or crouching. Do not use vanilla or software in the sector light mode settings, as these options can mess with certain tricks used in map08 and ruin the experience for you.

title: Skinship
description: Skinship is a large map for GZDoom with four new custom monsters, replacements for the cacodemon, imp, hellknight and baron of hell. They were all taken from realm667 and modified by me for balance's sake. Freelook is recommended. Dynamic lights should be turned on. Otherwise, important switches could be missed.

title: Perpetual Powers
description: Perpetual Powers is a 21-level megawad made for and tested with GZDoom and Zandronum. The wad is split into three distinct episodes, each containing 7 maps - usually short to medium sized ones, with a large one to end the episode. The project is co-op compatible.

title: Sliding Rails
description: Lead the TRAIN by sliding the rails. Get the STARs! This game is a sliding puzzle! Slide the rails and lead the train to the goal.

title: The Shrouded Parchments
description: Arise, lowly foreigner, and embark on an epic quest! Unravel the mysteries of this fantasy world, slay the monster that threatens to crumble it, and save it from its own destruction. Or, if you're feeling more ambitious, profit from its collapse.

title: Detective Barnett: The Cursed Artifact
description: Put your sleuthing skills to the ultimate test to solve a mystery like no other in this wild match-3 puzzle adventure!

title: Wizard Heist
description: The wizard isn't home. Can you steal his treasure and survive?

title: Lightracer Spark: Grey and Green
description: Lightracer Spark's first free DLC - Destinating to a tide-locked planet, choosing between Mechanical upgrade or Genetic modification, and finding the way out for the divided High-Skulled Ant civilizations.

title: Astro Flame: Starfighter
description:
Astro Flame Starfighter is a classic scrolling shooter with modern 3D graphics.
Upgrade the systems of your spaceship, upgrade your weapons and sweep away hordes of enemies on your way.

title: Primal Carnage: Evolution
description: Primal Carnage: Evolution builds on the bones of what came before, taking dinosaur versus human combat to the next level. Featuring an expanded roster of prehistoric playables, evolved gameplay, and a wealth of brand new content to sink your teeth into.

title: Real Motocross Driving Simulator
description: Get the real Motocross driving experience! Complete exciting missions, earn rewards and unlock new motorcycles.

title: Dirt Bicycle Rider Simulator
description: Choose your bike, conquer the town and mountains! Test your skills in Dirt Bicycle Rider Simulator, packed with realistic graphics and exciting missions.

title: Racerloop
description: Racerloop is a zero-gravity arcade racing game based on the Outer Ring universe where you take on a new challenge to be the fastest in the universe. In Racerloop, you will be able to customize and upgrade your ships, trading and exchanging parts and vehicles in a blockchain-based economy and marketplace.

title: Lost Girl In Mirror
description: This is a girl puzzle adventure game, through the wisdom of the gentlemen's minds, through the complete patchwork scenes, to save the girls trapped in the mirror, to give them a place to live. More than a dozen different characters and scenarios for you to explore.

title: My Kingdom for the Princess II
description: The official sequel to the addictive, award-winning strategy, time management, simulation game "My Kingdom for the Princess" It's the right time to prove yourself worthy of being a knight once again!

title: Hentai Abigail
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: The Creature Zone VR: Nightfall
description: Eddy Miles Is Sent On A Mission By The Creature Zone Department Of Science, Where He Will Travel Back To The Locations And Times Of 3 Infamous Incidents, The First Terry's Pizzeria Murder, The Extraterrestrial Massacre On Camp Clearwater, And The Death Of A Kid In The Vents Of Terry's Pizzeria.

title: GalaX
description: A doujin shoot-em-up by MasaHG.

title: Melvor Idle: Atlas of Discovery
description: Atlas of Discovery, Melvor Idle’s second expansion, is all about exploration! Discover eight new Combat Areas packed with dozens of monsters to fight and hundreds of new items to find. Unlock two new exploration skills, try the all-new Ancient Relics Gamemode… and more!

title: Stairs of Basically
description: An entirely new narrative experience from Davey Wreden (The Stanley Parable) and Ryan Roth (Starseed Pilgrim, The Yawhg).

title: Ataxia
description: A brutal cyberpunk 4X turn-based strategy game. Take control of one of 5 gangs in Technograd — a dark, crime ridden city where getting to the top is the only thing that matters.

title: Truco!: Chapter 1
description: Truco!: Chapter 1 is the first chapter of the game Truco!

title: OwnRulesRPG
description:
"OwnRules RPG" is an immersive open-world role-playing game that allows you to slip into the role of a fictional character.
The game offers a variety of features that allow you to fully customize your character, from choosing their appearance to their clothing and vehicles.

title: D-Virus: Evil Menance
description:
D-Virus: Evil Menance is a short RPG made with RPG Maker MV to participate in the Major Jam, whose theme was Cosmic.

Playing as Melissa Casanova, you must use the power of your HERZ to fight against a deadly virus that spread through the Wittelsbach spaceship. The HERZ is the only way to fight these demons!

title: D-Virus: Devilnitive Edition
description: D-Virus: Devilnitive Edition is an update for D-Virus: Evil Menance that completely improves the game and adds new content.

title: Zodiax
description:
Get ready for a unique shooting experience!

ZODIAX redefines the rules of the shooter genre by merging surgical precision with pure velocity. Forget everything you know about movement: here, your shot is your only engine.

Your mission? Traverse the 12 stations of the Zodiac on a journey where every shot counts. The concept is simple yet addictive: aim at the orbs with your mind to teleport instantly through the void. Chain your shots to leap from orb to orb and progress through this fantastic world. But beware: the further you go, the more elusive the target becomes!

The path is infested with formidable enemies that you can only defeat by chaining fast, precise shots. Hit the orbs protecting them in increasingly complex patterns to clear your way.

In ZODIAX, the line between movement and attack vanishes: every successful shot is a leap forward, every mistake is fatal. Do you have the reflexes and the composure required to become the ultimate shooter and conquer the 12 stations of the Zodiac?

title: Minecraft: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description:
Cowabunga! The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles have found their way into Minecraft in this radical DLC. Play as any of the four Turtles to take down gnarly enemies, save New York from Shredder, and eat all the pizza!
Includes official TMNT skins (based on the original '87 Turtles and the new Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Mutant Mayhem movie).

title: Ultimate Chump
description: In this action packed rouge lite, you find yourself as the chump that's got to survive and eliminate swarms of horrors. Mix and match your loadout, then select various upgrades and augments as you fight to setup numerous possible builds through each playthrough.

title: The King in the Shades
description: A classic survival-horror experience set in a fictional universe where the invisible hand of unspeakable horrors is turning humanity into a fleeting memory. Enter the world of The King in the Shades and rid this decaying world of the curse of Gods.

title: Soul Devourer
description: Soul Devourer is a metroidvania action-platformer with a classic 2D horror style. You'll explore the vast, cursed Sakuradoki High School, master unique abilities, fight twisted monsters and uncover the long-buried secrets concealed under the school.

title: SexWife: No Limit
description: No limit is adult visual novel with puzzle elements. Follow your hidden desires with sexy hot wife cheating on her husband.

title: Castle Push
description: Castle Push is a fantasy and strategy game developed by Blue Cat Studio. Play the classic browser strategy. Complete all levels and unlock all possible achievements in this game. And listen to the best music from Haindale.

title: Chaotic Pursuit
description: Chaotic Pursuit is a hardcore Top-Down Shooter with cute graphics. You miss a shot and you're out!

title: Dragabox
description: Use your intellect to clear a pathway to the door. Push and pull boxes out of your way, and deactivate electrical barriers. Over 200 levels of brain-busting challenges. Give it a try. See if you can complete them all!

title: Gloaming Comedian Simulator
description: Survive a monstrous weekend in Transylvania using your sharpest weapon: humor. Gloaming Comedian Simulator combines Casual, Arcade, and Visual Novel genres in a hilarious adventure filled with frights and laughs. Get ready to steal the show in this ghoulishly gag-filled game!

title: Taimanin Asagi
description: Asagi was the strongest Taimanin in Tokyo, but after completing her last mission, she just wants to settle down and marry her lover Kyousuke. Her old nemesis has other plans, however, and creeps back from the dead to seek vengeance...

title: Genshin Impact: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
description:
The third major update (Version 4.0) of Genshin Impact, which included:
• New characters: Lyney, Lynette and Freminet
• New region, Fontaine, with new areas: Belleau Region, Beryl Region and Court of Fontaine Region
• New gameplay mechanics: Underwater Exploration
• New combat mechanics: Arkhe (Ousia and Pneuma energy)
• New main story quests: Chapter IV, Acts I & II
• New story quest for Lyney
• New main event: Mega Meka Melee

title: Fire Emblem 8: Self-Randomizing
description:
Romhack of Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones by circleseverywhere.

Randomization options:

Tactician name as seed value
Random classes for players and enemies
Random Growths (& Bases)
Random Personal Skills
Random Weapon Stats
Random Chest and Event Items
Palettes That Might Be Janky Because That’s Part Of The Charm

title: Daba: Land of Water Scar
description: Daba: Land of Water Scar is a new title from Dark Star. It tells the story of a humanoid clay puppet. When the world is on the verge of collapse, the puppet traces the whereabouts of the water fragments within the ancient city, and throughout their journey of defeating enemies and seeking answers, unravels the story of the world and oneself. The game features various landscapes including abandoned ruins, a magnificent ancient city, gloomy prison, vast rift valley, expansive snowfield, deadly forest, and a floating city. Non-linear levels are interconnected, distinct, and intricate.

title: Exiledge
description: The universe trembles, the soil shatters. A young man called Alter embarks on the adventure to uncover the destiny of the world built by Zora. In Exiledge, experience a unique combat system on the base of third-person shooter with hack and slash. Fight along with the mysterious girl, Zora, and experience colorful battles and epic boss fights. Search for the truth of the universe and the opportunity to save the world in an eternal cycle.

title: The God Slayer
description: The God Slayer is an open-world action RPG featuring a highly immersive gameplay system and story experience, allowing players to enhance their abilities through battles and world exploration with the ultimate goal of defeating enemies and saving the world.

title: The Winds Rising
description: The Winds Rising is a story-driven action RPG developed by TiGames. It follows the journey of a girl from a peaceful village who embarks on a grand adventure after she encounters a lost monster cub, which affects the rise and fall of the entire kingdom. Her fate is in the player’s hands. Players can look forward to a refreshing and smooth combat experience, immersive and captivating story, and a world of ever-changing adventure.

Hone your skills as a Star Clearer in our many single-player modes, clearing colorful stars in the night sky. title: Absolute Dishonor
description: Absolute Dishonor is a brand-new 8-level WAD created between Michael Jan "valkiriforce" Krizik and Jon "40oz" Vail - four maps from each map author. The levels are inspired from old-school Doom WADs from the 90's such as Memento Mori and The Plutonia Experiment.

title: Vaporware
description:
Vaporware is a collaborative project for the Eternity Engine, created by a loosely-organized group of friends from various corners of the Doom community. We like making maps, we were aware of Eternity’s capabilities, and we decided it’d be fun to create some maps that made use of those capabilities. We organized a little project amongst a few of ourselves, and over time it evolved into this.

Vaporware also includes a large quantity of new resources, including textures, monsters, weapons, ambient sounds, and an original ogg-format soundtrack composed by Julian Hope and Esselfortium.

title: Doom Redemption
description:
A 'tribute' to Doom 1. All the styles of episodes 1, 2, 3 (and even 4) squished into a 9 map episode.

This wad doesn't use any ZDoom features that are not seen in the original doom, except for HUD messages at the start of each level, and of course the features that come with Hexen format maps.

A small, locked room with a clock. Two subjects with missing memories. A researcher. You. The final result will depend on you.

title: Quaint
description: Quentin “Q” Hawthorne is a coffee-loving IT specialist living a quiet life in the small town of Millbrook. But he’s about to learn that this charming place holds a secret – it is home to a 200-years old mage association known as the Snake and Saber Society. Invited to join their ranks, he’ll now have to redefine his understanding of the world. But each step he takes on this new promising path will also bring him closer to his troubled past. Will he be able to confront it? Or will the shackles of guilt stop him from ever moving on?

title: Angelique: A Grief Encounter
description: A text-only adventure. As Angelique, your task is to survive trials, and tribulations, to meet up with Arnold.

title: Femdemic
description:
Lead an alien bacterial race that induces male to female body transformations, one cell at a time. But as the new women embrace their bodies, the politicians close in… Femdemic is a witty, trans-affirming idle clicker with two story paths that explore gender, happiness, and femininity:

Liberation is a wholesome, trans-affirming story for the LGBTQIA2+-Audience.. Lead a benevolent mission to give each trans woman the body she needs. Increasing your hosts’ self-love is crucial to success. But beware politicians as they attempt to lock down this trans awakening …

Compliance is a feminization-fetish story for kinkster players. Your alien bacterial race spreads to new hosts through sex, but there’s a catch - All natural-born Earth women are immune. The solution: Transform infected males into new females! Change each male host into a sexy female one - then encourage them to mate and spread the infection. Operation Feminize Earth has begun.

description: An indie precision platformer that offers an atmospheric and captivating experience. Take control of the young boy as he navigates through a series of meticulously crafted levels. title: Item Tower
description: "Item Tower" is a unique game that turns the mundane into an exciting challenge. Players build towers by expertly arranging a variety of everyday items - from chairs and bananas to microwaves, washing machines, and statues. The challenge lies in balancing these unpredictable pieces. Stacking up 10 items gives your tower stability, but watch out! Any less and your tower could come crashing down. Stack up 50 items and watch your tower magically disappear, leaving behind your well-earned points. Competition escalates with an online leaderboard, as players from around the world vie to amass the most points in this whimsical, strategic game. Step into "Item Tower" and elevate ordinary objects into extraordinary adventures!

title: Arcade Archives: Baraduke 2
description:
"Baraduke 2" is an action shooter released by Namco (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1988.
The crablike "Octy" were not fully eliminated from their fortress in the previous title, "Baraduke".
Rely on help from the Paccet you rescued in the last game as you complete your mission to finish off the vicious Octy extraterrestrials!

title: The Voices Stories
description: A collection of 5 short stories written by Matthew Green about 20 years ago

title: Jimbaori: The Onin War
description:
Set in feudal Japan during the late 16th century, the story follows the rise and fall of Hideyoshi, a man consumed by his hunger for power and the tragic consequences that ensue.

As Hideyoshi's life nears its end, his insatiable thirst for power and the consequences of his actions culminate in a dramatic clash between nations.

Driven to expand his influence and secure his legacy, Hideyoshi embarks on a campaign that will test his military prowess and, ultimately, seal his fate.

As the invasion unfolds, Hideyoshi faces unexpected resistance from the Korean forces led by the renowned Admiral Yi Sun-sin.

title: Ducky Bouncy

title: Submachine: FLF
description:
This is the game about memories, how they fade away, trick us or straight up lie to us.

Do you remember this game? Are you sure?

Try this version – you might not recognize it. Did you really hear this music? Is it changed? Or maybe it was there all along… I don’t remember anymore. One thing I know for sure – those pictures… I recognize them, they’re… from my past, my ancestors. I’ve seen them so many times, but were they here before? Is it possible that somebody changed them? Did I change them?

There’s a machine I haven’t seen before. There’s a room I haven’t been to, but I could swear I did. My memory about this game is murky. That’s how I see this game now. That’s the one I did so many years ago. Or is it?…

title: My First Craft Survival
description: When I woke up, I found myself on an uninhabited island. And I had nothing with me! Anyway, the first priority is to find food to avoid starvation. At night, mysterious creatures attack, so I need to craft equipment and build a base to defend myself! In the end, there's a boss waiting for me!

description:
This was a world made out from the best intentions. The year is 2020 and tensions have reached critical mass between the four major factions of the world - The United, The Guards, Modernists, and Zealots. Having enjoyed peace and world-wide social and economic freedom since the end of World War II, the United Democratic Government has finally collapsed due to increasing pressure from radicals to reintroduce borders and independence between countries. This has given rise to underground warlords wishing to take advantage of this situation be it from a moral standpoint or for pure profit.

Do you believe in absolute independence like the Zealots or do you trust in the powers of a United government? Choose a side or play the field to build the ultimate force.

The smallest mistake might lead you on a (psychologically) painful fall.

Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your own breakfast kitchen?

In Breakfast Bar Tycoon, you'll learn that it's no easy task!

You will take on the role of a breakfast bar manager and try your best to serve the hordes of hungry customers as quickly as possible.

Take on a series of epic battles against powerful bosses. Unlock new abilities and power-ups and become the ultimate warrior. Dodge a barrage of laser beams, and explosions and make sure YOU are the last one standing.

title: World Football 98

World Football 98 is a soccer game, released just before the 1998 Football World Cup.

It featured Kiko Narváez, the Spanish national team striker, prominently in the Kiko World Football version. The game was also later distributed as a gift when buying Danone yogurts under the name of Danone World Football where it was an ad game, as in the break between halves advertisements are shown.

title: The Last Sigh(t)
description: An empty world stretches before you, one still marked by her footsteps in the soil below, and one where her voice can still be heard across the howling winds that carry her fragrance. But despite everything, you remain faithful. Do not lose yourself in this journey for the summit.

title: Meta
description:
A parody of amateur adventure design, this metagame consists of a simple treasure hunting game, and a complex editor needed to complete it. The editor and its assistant Cuppit are all part of the game; anyone involved in game or level design should appreciate the humor.

The editor is an exercise of twisted logic and lateral thinking. You have to see it to believe it; with its offbeat controls, inventory items that kill you, and intentional misspellings, it's the weirdest thing since sliced bread!

META is based on Adventure Game Studio, the platform for most of our games, and is runner-up for two AGS Awards.

title: Submachine 5: The Root
description:
This is the original flash version of the game
in high definition and playable in fullscreen.

title: Themm: Harukanaru Meikyuu
description: Long time ago, human beings believed in gods. But time has passed, and the humans stopped worshipping them. The gods got angry. The world plunged into chaos. Demons who looked like pretty girls have appeared, driving people insane. Five kings have sent brave heroes to find a magical stone that alone could restore peace to the world. One of these heroes is Lucido. Aided by a simple village girl, he bravely descends into a dungeon full of seductive monsters - but he should beware of the competition...

title: Citadel Remonstered
description:
An updated version of Citadel by Pawel Matusz and Artur Bardowski of the original development team with help from Adam Nowakowski.

This enhanced version removes some bugs discovered over 20 years and improves some aspects of the gameplay such as performance, player control, and an update of the in-game graphics and level design.

title: A Message For The Stone King
description:
You have a gravely important message to deliver to your leader, the powerful and legendary Stone King, about an enemy army approaching the kingdom's borders. However, after many years of firm, decisive leadership and uncontested rule it will be difficult to make him hear you.

Dig your way out of the dungeon and try to find out why the king won't believe a word you say.

title: The Anglerfish Project
description: Use your friendly probe, Paul, to fish for communication packages in the cosmos. Aim at an alteration in the sky and, being careful of your strength, cast your fishing rod. You will need to decrypt these hidden messages to help keep everyone safe. Good luck, angler.

title: Kitten Milk Replacer
description:
Those brave women of legends, Long defeated, but still clinging to her sacred vows:
Whereas others scoff at her with "it's not MY responsibility", she dares to rebuke them:

"Well, what does that matter?"
Needless to say, they bear a terrible curse.
...Can that girl really free us from our suffering?

title: Misión Triple R
description: This game, which was given away to various schools, aims to teach kids from Málaga about the importance of taking care and respecting their environment. The game mostly consists of trivia questions about variosu general areas of the province of Málaga, like the city or the mountain. Every couple of questions the game will present the player with a minigame like matching cards or racing on foot to a location. The objective of the game is to beat it in under 40 minutes, which done correctly would allow the player to enter a contest.

title: The Night Owl Murder
description: You need to solve the case before a chip in victim's head runs of out time. However, the time passes ONLY through your actions. So feel free to read and listen to dialogues in your own pace. Time passes only when you click on a dialogue option. Time is limited so choose wisely!

title: Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes
description:
The first in the series to include rollback netcode, prepare for blistering online matches.
New moves and new battle systems have been added to further evolve the battle.
Experience high-octane battles with ultra high definition pixel graphics.

The tale of the Hollow Night is about to reach its climax...!

title: Tomorrow is my Birthday
description:
we don't have to do this
why don't we just leave?

There's a certain kind of coolness haunting this summer. And two friends want to run away from it. Get to know Petal, Bios and their summery secret.

The words you choose to say during this journey will decide its ending. Watch all the flowers closely. Breathe in the humid colors around you. Catch the essence of Petal and Bios' relationship. To escape this skewed reality.

A denpa Point-and-Click-Adventure about becoming a person, giving up, and a doomed friendship. And don't forget that you always can go home again.

When i’m near death i feel more real.
Do you feel real often in your life?
I forget... all the time.

title: Tasokare Hotel Re:newal
description:
Tasokare Hotel Re:newal is an adventure game on Steam, iOS, and Android. This is a remake of Tasokare Hotel. The goal of game is to escape the hotel.

The game is divided into three parts: novel, search, and interrogation. You read the story in the novel part. In the search part, you find the evidence you need to solve. The interrogation part you use evidence to get to the bottom of the case.

title: Delivering Hope
description: Get IRyS flying and deliver hope as far as you can in this hololive fangame!

title: Big Yeetus
description: As the unicorn Big Yeetus you have to run along a parcour to the top of the castle. Most things in the game will kill you instantly if you touch them. This is a difficult game that takes some practice to beat. When you have learned how to pass a section you can finish it very fast though.

title: Pokémon Castaway
description: Welcome to Pokémon Castaway! The player is the (not-so) fortunate winner of a trip to Alola. On the flight there, however, the plane is struck down. Landing on the mysterious Bermada Island, the player is tasked with exploring their environment while searching for fellow survivors and a way off of the island. As the player traverses further inland, it becomes evident that the island is anything but deserted. Will the player find a way off the island? And, more importantly, will they get to go on an Alolan vacation?

title: Lost Ascension
description: This mod takes up the mantle of expanding and perfecting the recipe that DDLC created back in 2017. With a precise focus on character development, world building, and psychological emotions, you won't find another mod quite like it. If you're after a mod that gives love and care to its characters (both literally and metaphorically), then you've come to the right place. This is an 8-9 hour experience, best suited for readers who are after seeing the dokis grow into better people, all the while facing off against impossible challenges, and plenty of sweet moments to truly cultivate into something memorable. The Silence Will Be Broken.

title: Central De Fantasmas: Los Huéspedes De Mortimer
description: Spanish educative graphic adventure game from the year 2003, developed by CMY Multimedia destined for children between 6-12 years.

title: Grand Ore Deal
description: Solve puzzles, find secret levels and mine magical ore which makes you faster the more you carry and bring it back to the level start to complete levels

title: Joyville
description: Joyville is a horror-puzzle adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. Brace yourself for a gripping journey through the shadows, solving puzzles, and trying to survive amidst the hidden horrors that await you.

title: SCP: Nemesi
description: SCP: Nemesi is a multiplayer survival-horror game where one player takes on the role of the SCP (anomalous creatures, each with its own abilities and appearance), and the other four players play as Humans, each with their own personal goals and tasks that may branch into different paths.

title: Project A-ko
description: A PC-88 visual novel based on the anime.

title: Project A-ko 2
description: The second Project A-ko video game for PC-88.

title: Butcher's Creek
description: Use rusty tools to brutalize a perverted gang of serial torturers in the remote Appalachian Forest.

title: Kagi wo Kakushita Kago no Tori: Bird in Cage Hiding the Key
description: Kagi wo Kakushita Kago no Tori: Bird in Cage Hiding the Key is a mystery visual novel where the main character and four heroines who live in a mansion work together to solve a murder that took place in their town.

title: Kagitori: Bird in Cage Hiding the Key
description: Kagitori: Bird in Cage Hiding the Key is the western release of the mystery visual novel where the main character and four heroines who live in a mansion work together to solve a murder that took place in their town.

title: Lyssa
description:
"Let us live, since we must die"

Lyssa Is an RPG developed by Vih. You will be playing as Alayss, a college student warped into the Soul World, a world full of demons and deceased spirits. Will she be able to find the person who kidnapped her while trying to regain the faith of her late best "friend"? Or will she fall into despair?

title: Voxel Doom II
description: Voxel Doom II is the follow up to 2022's award-winning Voxel Doom. This is a new graphics mod that replaces all monsters, weapons, props and items with fully 3d voxel models. It replaces all monsters from both Doom and Doom II.

title: Demons of Problematique
description: A short trip through hell, set on by a classic Doom story. Originally intended as just a Boom compatible level, I got a little carried away with it, especially the ending credits\scenes.

title: Demons of Problematique 2
description: An obvious sequel to Demons of Problematique. No cutscenes (aside from the ending), no new weapons, no new monsters, just Doom. With some fancy effects.

title: Barbie Girl
description:
Barbie Girl is a single, limit-removing complevel 2 (doom (strict)) map for DOOM 2.
This was made in response to a Doomworld post that nobody should ever use a MIDI of the pop song "Barbie Girl" by Aqua in a Doom map.

title: Strinova
description: Strinova is an anime-style third-person tactical competitive shooter developed by Day 1 Studio. Switch freely between three-dimensional and two-dimensional in this one-of-a-kind shooter experience with a unique tactical shooting system.

title: The 64 kb challenge: Vanilla
description: 34 maps made under or equal the file size limitation of 64 kylobites, all these levels are vanilla doom / DOS executable friendly.

title: The 64 kb challenge: Limitless
description: 35 maps made under or equal the file size limitation of 64 kylobites, all these levels are limit-removing ports (complevel 2) compatible, don't play these with vanilla sets or original DOS executable

title: Incineration
description: A replacecment for Episode 3 of Doom. Just maps in here no new music or graphics.

title: The Great Urban Battle
description: One Player ..... One City ..... Many Monsters. Your mission is simple. Seek, destroy and escape!

title: Data.Expand
description:
A procedural player-controller multimedia sculpture driven by fast-paced arcade gameplay.

Survive as long as you can while avoiding enemies. As you do, your hits will generate glitch-like visual and enticing sounds.

title: HexaWars
description: Retro twin stick shooter that gradually gets more difficult as you defeat more waves of enemies and Bosses.

title: Mini Garden Cafe
description: Mini Garden Cafe is a cute and simple relaxation game where you make and sell coffee, bread, and plants to expand your shop and fill up a Dex.

title: Bingo Pinball Gameroom
description: A collection of 80 Bingo Pinball simulations. Discover why people became addicted to these mysterious machines in the past. 'For amusement only', but used for gambling nevertheless. Too dangerous, so eventually banned in many states. Start right away: Bally Show Time is included, free to use!

title: Movierooms: Cinema Management
description: Become the manager of your own Cinema in this thrilling new Tycoon! Through space and time, explore the various aspects of handling a thriving business. Manage movie choices and screenings, staff, rooms, and more!

title: Bellus Battle
description: Enter the world of Bellus, a world where cute animals run wild in a epic battle for glory. Blast your friends with Shotguns, Rail guns, Zeus lightning bolts, Bombs, Portal Guns, and much more. This is Bellus Battle. Be the last one standing!

title: Escape from Nalaxion
description: Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled, intergalactic battle like never before in our intense FPS shooter game! As a brave commander leading your platoon on a critical raid on Nalaxion 54, fate takes a thrilling turn when you accidentally stumble upon a hidden trap door.

title: Monday Meltdown
description: Unleash your inner Monday rage in "Monday Meltdown," a 2D multiplayer mayhem. Engage in intense battles across casual environments like the office, gym, and grocery store. With a vast arsenal of weapons, be the first to achieve 10 kills for victory. Let off some steam and conquer Monday madness!

title: She Fell Off
description: Uncover the cryptic remnants of a destroyed world in "She Fell Off," a solo-developed indie game. Embark on Eve's intense journey through a dark post-apocalyptic underworld, devoid of familiar life. Navigate a dark environment, endure unforgiving gameplay, and immerse yourself in an eerie mystery.

title: Captain Goose
description: Captain Goose is a shoot 'em up game in the style of naval battles and the golden age of piracy. Accuracy and precision calculation will help keep your ship afloat and ensure the success of your mission. The strongest will survive at sea!

title: Ursine Science
description: A fantasy visual novel featuring intense action at every turn, following the struggles of a bear trapped in the body of a man. Part II of The Enonoia Saga, and the definitive conclusion to Ovine Replica.

title: Final Flock
description: Build a powerful flock and take to the skies to battle hordes of enemies. Glide and weave through perilous obstacles to gather resources and loot. Unlock powerful synergies and abilities to survive as long as you can.

title: Tragedy Theater
description: Tragedy Theater is an RPG Maker Horror game. You'll get the thrill of being chased by those mascots. Don't get caught. Help your friend, result puzzles and choose the choice that won't make our boy out of his mind.

title: Lumiel the Awakening
description: Lumiel the Awakening is an Open World Top Down Hack and Slash RPG Game set in a Fantasy Sci-fi Setting. Stranded on an island, players focus on exploration, building, and harvesting while battling monsters, collecting rare items, and uncovering hidden treasures in diverse dungeons.

title: Idle Build RPG
description: This game is an idle RPG game. Players only need a few simple operations to enjoy the joy of obtaining top-quality equipment.

title: Bridge Hunter
description: Greetings, pilot. Get ready to deploy your drone for the mission at hand! Your objective is to prevent the enemy from using a vital bridge. You have the freedom to try out various tactics and abilities in a fully destructible environment. Your role is crucial!

title: Entity: The Black Day
description: A third-person survival horror action game set in dark, atmospheric underground environments, blending psychological suspense with intense combat.

title: Water Me & You
description: Water Me & You is a cozy two-player co-op adventure in which you play as a water droplet or a seed-like creature that can change states, on a quest to regenerate a world left behind by humans.

title: Dragonscale Monastery
description: Tame the mountain peak and create a dragon sanctuary. Carefully expand your monastery and discover the secrets of dragon breeding. Survive harsh winters, limited resources, hunger, cold, and many other adversities. Experience unique survival city-builder in the world of Dragonscale Monastery.

title: Planet Iridium
description: Planet Iridium is a third person, top-down, fantasy, Sci-Fi game. The game is heavily based around colony, economy and base building. Along with close-quarter combat and unique survival systems that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you unveil the deep dark secrets of Planet B58.

title: Dust Raiders
description: Dust Raiders is a management strategy game, set in a lawless wasteland. Upgrade your vehicles, engage in tactical fights against raiders hunting for your resources and gather a crew to rule the area.

title: Thursday Nite Thunkin'
description: I'm not sure why there are two descriptions but pretend I put something really funny here

title: Zombiflux: Sleepless War
description: Survive and create your own civilization!

title: Sans Logique
description: Sans Logique is a first-person game that blends puzzle and adventure gameplay. You'll explore different dreamlike worlds, discover the story of your character, and solve some original puzzles.

title: Square Dungeon 2
description: "Square Dungeon 2" is a dungeon exploration + roguelite text-based indie game. The demon king left a prophecy to the human king before death that the warriors would betray him when the Armageddon came. As a warrior, what will you choose on the Armageddon?

title: Conviction
description: Conviction is a FPS, Dark fantasy DOOM-like, play as a man with nothing left to lose as you face off the onslaught of cultists and demons in a world enshrouded by darkness, prepare to show your conviction...

title: Cats & Castles
description: In 'Cats & Castles', as King of the Cats, you must build, manage, and defend the greatest kingdom a cat has ever seen. Choose your cards wisely and balance your economy, food supply, and military. It's your responsibility to defend your kingdom from monsters with your mighty cat soldiers.

title: Galvanic Bride
description: Feel the intenseness of stealth in the eerie great mansion of Frankenstein. Play Bride, Frankenstein’s creation, Perfect yet incomplete. Use electric interactions and skills to overcome challenges in your style. Think and struggle through the intertwining conspiracy, and resolve in your own ending.

title: Orcish Skies
description: Orcish Skies blends Roguelike deckbuilding, turn-based, Slay The Spire-styled gameplay with a grid-based map. Fire a missile into a cluster of enemies. Rain down lightning on an enemy Carrier from afar. Fly past a swarm of frigates to pick off the sniper shooting you from across the map.

title: Surreal House
description: A point-and-click puzzle game inspired by escape rooms. Enter the house if you dare.

title: Infasia
description: Vous êtes Xen, un diplomate d'une région paisible du Nord qui se retrouve plongé dans la capitale du monde d'Infasia. Entre guerres de clans, invasion de Sans-âmes, lutte entre des puissances incommensurables, vous devrez vous forger un nom dans ce royaume pour accomplir vos objectifs…

title: Dragon Quest X: Mirai he no Tobira to Madoromi no Shoujo Online
description: This is the sixth major expansion for Dragon Quest X, known as Version 7, which will feature a new story, new characters, a new area called Zenias, and the new master vocation Dragon Mage.

title: Celebrities Hacked
description: Celebrities Hacked' takes you on a mesmerizing journey that pairs the familiar excitement of classic Qix and Xonix games with an innovative, bold twist. Here, your skills and reflexes are rewarded with a gallery of art that peels back the curtain on some of the most alluring celebrities. As you navigate the game landscape, strategically deploy power-ups, and overcome ticking clock challenges, you unlock the enthralling, unseen layers of the stars' private lives.

title: Porta-Tower
