description: Porta-Tower is a roguelike tower defense game where you can pick up and move your towers when their position becomes suboptimal. Relocate, upgrade, and unlock towers to defend your portal until the very end.

title: Emme Saves the Galaxy
description: Join Emme the dog as she battles block invaders in this puzzle action game. Defeat all kinds of unpredictable blocks across hundreds of levels.

title: Fruits of Fury
description: Lace up your boots! Fruits of Fury is a bullethell roguelike (bullet heaven) where you will decimate waves of fruit minions using an arsenal of unlockable and upgradeable skills. Then, step into the ring and face off against the champion fruit bosses as you journey from rookie to legend!

title: Currently Unstable
description: Master electrifying puzzles in 'Currently Unstable'! Strategically transfer electricity, utilize dynamic electrical components, and conquer each level to Activate the Power Core. Unleash your puzzle-solving skills and tame the currents for endless fun!

title: Little Eden
description: In this mix of farming simulator and spaceship shooter, you control Little Eden, a flying farm-ship. Destroy planetoids, collect seeds to plant, craft ammunition and fight for survival against the terrible Pirate Coalition.

title: Digital City
description: Digital City is a novel simulator intended to support local authorities representatives and urban planners in their day-to-day work.

title: Death Animal Parade
description: Casual Strategy game full with Animals

title: Cube RPG
description:
Be a cube! Alone or with your friends, play together or against each other. Chop down cube trees, mine cube resources, build a cube house.

Collect resources, craft weapons & armor, and build your base. Explore a world of cubes and uncover its mysteries. Level up your character, and customize it too! Invite your friends to play with you if you have some! Show them that hat that you're really proud of. Destroy your friend's house, and blame someone else!

title: Lost Tenet
description: In a war-torn 13th century, the once protectors become the predators. After the razing of the sister city of Romne, the Knights Solomin have tasked themselves with the extermination of the alleged party responsible, the Clergy.

title: Artisan Story
description: Aspiring to be the best artisan in the world, our young artisans are opening their own workshop complete with a monster ranch. Tame monsters from the dungeon, tend to your fantasy farm, collect materials and craft recipes, and experience a carefree story rich fantasy life

title: To Mortal Dust
description: This is an RPG game where you will follow our protagonist to fight and save lives!

title: A Step From Insanity
description: A Step From Insanity is a 2D platformer-shooter where you play as a man with many psychological illnesses searching for the end to his insanity. Guided by an unfamiliar friend, search for the mysterious sanity powders told to be able to cure any mental illness.

title: Smoots Pinball
description: Enjoy an exciting and fun multiplayer pinball experience with Smoots Pinball! Play on 5 tables based on our popular Smoots games, complete missions, and unlock extras. Can you score 1,000,000 points? Play solo or with friends and show off your pinball skills!

title: Emberward
description: Emberward is a unique tower defense game that focuses on maze building and interesting tower mechanics. Construct mazes with blocks of different shapes and set up defense towers on them to withstand the onslaught of monsters!

title: Over Jump Rally
description: RALLY! Hot blazing sun!Relive arcade racing with Over Jump Rally – an unofficial remake of Sega Rally from the '90s. Unreal Engine 5-powered stunning graphics, nostalgic music, and intuitive controls bring classic racing to a new generation. Easy, right? Maybe!

title: Cat City
description: In this game you will need to explore the whole city, as well as many other rooms to find all the seals! A cat named "Ponytail" will help you figure out the game, and will fully introduce you to what is happening in this cute little cat town!

title: One Life to Alice
description: This game consists of two interconnected parts. The first part is a visual novel about a girl named Alice, living in the near future. The pleasant visual presentation and a story based on real events will not leave you indifferent.

title: Super Space Arcade
description: SUPER SPACE ARCADE is a fast-paced 3D interpretation of the classic arcade shooter games combined with action platformer elements.

title: Insanity's Grip
description: Insanity's Grip is a first-person psychological horror game in which the player uncovers the secrets of his forgotten past and experiences nightmares from which he can no longer escape. Be careful, some visions can be more dangerous than they seem!

title: Escape the Dark Tower
description: Step into a realm of mystery and magic with Escape the Dark Tower, a captivating escape room adventure in charming pixel art.

title: Star Apprentice: Dazzling Danmaku Detective
description: Find evidence, interrogate suspects, and shoot down contradictions in this magical girl detective game! Your magic turns each interrogation into a bullet hell logic battle - Use it to uncover the truth behind each magical mystery in your way!

title: Pricolage: Idolized
description:
Who are you...?
Pricolage: Idolized is an SNS-based interactive Visual Novel.

title: Flawless Darkness
description: Flawless Darkness is designed so that blind and non-blind people can have the same play experience. That's why you play the game only with sound, with no graphics at all. Players will have a special experience just escaping the maze in darkness.

title: Farmwand
description: Welcome to the world of Farmwand! Farmwand is an open-world fantasy adventure with lots of farming, potions and spells, where you will immerse yourself in an enchanted land full of monsters, magical creatures and tons of interesting characters.

title: DreadFall
description: Embark on a chilling odyssey in Dreadfall, a horror platformer where you descend into your own nightmare. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, and upgrade your abilities as you journey through a haunting dream world.

title: Rune Golf
description: Guide a small golf ball through the ruins of a forgotten civilization, filled with traps and mysteries. Explore the remnants of a lost people, combining skill and curiosity in a unique narrative and contemplative journey!

title: Tangled Crisis
description: Beat the maze with limited vision before the time runs out! Avoid the dangers, find secret chests and shortcuts, while trying to get the highest score, in this casual retro themed experience.

title: Pixels With Comics
description: Pixels With Comics is musical bullethell game that based on avoid pixels and get defeated by comics, also enjoy music and absolutely die and don't forget to repeat.

title: Keys and Kastles
description: Welcome to Keys and Kastles, a simple but very challenging platform game! Go through different stages and try to look for hidden treasures! Be careful as there are traps around every corner! Good luck!

title: Tooncop
description: Battle mischievous cartoons that have escaped their TV shows and save humanity in this thrilling FPS Horde Shooter. Players need to survive 15 minutes with an aim to reach the highest level possible with the most amount of cash. Do you have what it takes to step into the shoes of Tooncop?

title: Century of Steam
description: Century of Steam is a physics-based multiplayer railroad simulator and strategy game. Build your route through beautiful landscapes, customize and operate your fleet of historic trains, discover the sights, sounds, and stories of railroading with industry-leading steam, firing, and audio simulation.

title: Zen with a Pen
description: Embark on a mesmerizing journey. Draw lines, guide the enso symbol, and conquer challenging maps. With a minimalistic style, casual (sometimes) yet addictive gameplay, this game offers a perfect blend of relaxation and arcade fun. Can you master each level and achieve true serenity?

title: Surfing Legends
description: Surf the waves, rescue the wildlife, and collect the magic diamonds in this thrilling adventure! Buy faster boards and beat the clock to open new levels!

title: Thawed Waters
description: Boating adventure of the old priest who stands against the ruthless corporation practising animal testing. Dive into flooded Siberia of 2047, where remnants of humanity fight another thawed virus. The game offers unique physics-based gameplay, wrapped in a heartfelt rabbits rescue saga.

title: Epic Trains 4
description: Run a transportation empire with planes, trains, automobiles and ships. Out compete AI companies or play solo. Become a transportation tycoon.

title: Sojo
description: An online RPG with a persistent world, gear/level based progression, fast active turn based combat, platforming puzzles, and challenging objectives. Kill creatures, get loot, sell and buy loot, group with allies, and progress to overcome the games greatest challenges.

title: Lights of Life
description: In this medieval-themed horror game, you'll stealthily navigate a semi-open world, escaping from zombies and vampires to survive. A thrilling adventure awaits filled with fear, action, and secrecy!

title: Alchemist: The Garden
description: You find yourself in a strange garden. You aren't sure how you got here but you know what you must do, escape! The path is simple, but nothing is as easy as it seems. Learn the rules of the garden if you wish to escape. Caution - this game is simple but can be challenging!

title: Cannon Block Ball
description: Knock down blocks from the platform using balls in this physics-based game. Encounter various block types, from explosive bombs to rotating and growing blocks, adding challenge and strategy to the gameplay.

title: Sunbeam
description: A garden-themed 2D RPG which tackles the struggle of problem-solving in an uncomfortable and unknown place. Solve and explore your way across this dark landscape to uncover the truth behind your visit, meeting a familiar face to keep you compay.

title: The Secrets of Skellig
description: A mysterious puzzle game with crossword inspired gameplay. Use your brain, keyboard, and mouse to unravel the secrets beneath a remote island.

title: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown
description: Get ready to blast into retro-racing madness with Cosmic Race! Our game reignites the arcade racing thrill, hurling you through mind-bending tracks, intense combat, and eye-popping visuals. It's like the 80s and 90s racing games on turbo steroids—strap in and relive the glory days!

title: Projected Dreams
description: Drag toys from the shelves and drop them on the table to create a shadow play in this cozy puzzle game. As the shadows unfold, immerse yourself in a heartwarming story full of nostalgia from the 90s and blur the lines between fantasy and reality.

title: Nothorian
description: Challenge the awakening of ancient evil in Nothorian, where heroes, monsters, and the dreaded Lords of Hell battle under the shadow of legendary dragons and forgotten gods.

title: Reincarnatio
description: "Reincarnatio" is a village-building card game. Build houses, populate them with people, and work to acquire resources. Construct various facilities to develop and expand the village.

title: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
description: Somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, how he got there or what happened to him. A short point-and-click adventuregame about a man overboard survivor.

title: Text Adventure
description: Look at art, listen to jazz, and immerse yourself in the world of Joey Pawelko's Text Adventure.

title: Unit Down Charge
description: A futuristic action rail-shooter! Action packed, and full of quirky character dialogues, unique level designs, and epic boss battles!

title: Experimentation
description: A linear visual novel about five short stories, unrelated at first glance. Be prepared for mysticism, gloomy atmosphere and light psychological horror. Not recommended to play if you are experiencing depression or severe psychological state.

title: Pyrene
description: Defeat hellish monsters and rebuild your home in Pyrene, a fast paced roguelike dungeon-crawler. Play with different heroes & spells, collect powerful relics to upgrade your deck while uncovering the mysteries behind your village’s destruction.

title: Cydoku
description: A cyber themed, procedural generated, graphical Sudoku with over 2 million unique play-field permutations. Track your mastery by claiming achievements and gauge your play via in-game statistical analysis and Steam Leader boards!

title: TriFute
description: TriFute, a unique button soccer game, puts you in control of your team. Compete in thrilling matches and customize with mods in this immersive simulation.

title: Lifeforms: Binary Fission
description: Clone yourself to take over the environment in this bacterial evolution roguelite. Choose mutations and abilities each time you multiply and unlock new morphologies and environments. Compete against other evolving species in survival mode and experiment with unlocked abilities in sandbox mode.

title: Cryptower
description: Welcome to the world of Cryptower! In this captivating tower defense game, creativity and strategy intertwine. Develop your unique talents, enhance tower parameters, and unlock powerful abilities to defeat endless waves of enemies. Become a master of defense and protect your world

title: The Backrooms: Last Expedition
description: "The Backrooms: Last Expedition" is a cooperative horror game designed for 1 to 4 players. Its main objective is to create an enjoyable gaming experience for friends. Players will navigate through terrifying levels, filled with various entities and dangers, as they strive to escape.

title: Cats on Broombas
description: A wholesome MS-DOS puzzle-game about cats zooming around on Broombas collecting stars. They need your help!

title: Where Beasts Were Born
description: Where Beasts Were Born is an experimental Action-RPG with evolving creatures. As the creatures fight the players, they use a genetic algorithm to evolve unique, stronger evolutionary stages, including body, stats and brain - procedurally!

title: S: Lost Chapters
description: Prepare for a brand-new type of horror. Delve deeper into the depths of infamous stories once told and unearth the terrible secrets left behind. Brace yourself for an immersive journey that is equal parts horrifying and breathtaking. An experience that is both familiar, yet different…

title: Late Night Delivery: The Bewitched Collection
description: Experience the horrifying Halloween-themed sensual mischievousness of "Late Night Delivery: The Bewitched Collection"! Now with an exclusive third chapter that expands on the plot further. Buy it today, enjoy it tonight~

title: Truth of Beauty Witch: Marine's Treasure Ship
description: A miraculous collaboration between Houshou Marine and "Tsugunohi" has come to fruition! When the main character becomes a crew member of a pirate ship led by Houshou Marine and realizes a certain fact, you are struck by a series of horrors. Can you unravel the secret behind Houshou Marine's beauty?

title: Space Tournament
description: Space Tournament is the ultimate destination for experiencing captivating drifts in a stunning 2D space environment.

title: AntiGolfity
description: A unique spin on the golf genre where you play as the course — in space! Interact with the environment by moving, manipulating, and disabling pieces of the level in order to help guide your ball to the goal.

title: Cavemen Tales: Collector's Edition
description: Help Sam and Crystal and their family to find a new home in this time management strategy game! Explore, guide the tribe, build, gather resources, overcome obstacles and enjoy the tale of family, friendship and courage!

title: PP
description: This is a "butt" as the protagonist of the breakthrough game Players will take the role of a pink ass in a hurry to go to the toilet. Dodge all kinds of fast food attacks on the way, break through the obstacles and finally reach the toilet!

title: Galactic Warship
description: I always wanted to play a game where I could take direct control of a capital ship in 3D space. When I couldn't find that game, I decided to make it. As a solo developer I spent two years crafting Galactic Warship - letting you pilot massive capital warships in full 3D with complete 6-axis freedom.

title: Artifact Seeker: Legend of Aurorium
description: The Demon King invaded Aurorium. Heroes require legendary artifacts to save the world. Obtain them by defeating corrupted foes, collecting Vingold to trade with a merchant, or exploring altar chests. Level up to use skill combos and evolved skills against countless enemies. Defeat the demon king!

title: Seas of Kahtaone
description: A fantasy naval combat action-adventure game. Explore the open ocean and fend off pirates with your cannon broadsides and magical arsenal. Summon the wind to boost your ship forward and release fireballs to light up your enemies. Upgrade your ships armor, weapons, and much more to win the day.

title: Lunar Lander Beyond
description: Guide a roster of colorful pilots, eclectic advisors and state-of-the-art landers through a taxing series of missions. Deliver cargo, retrieve resources, and rescue stranded pilots as you navigate a mysterious universe of moons and planets.

title: Deep Under
description: DEEP UNDER is a grim visual novel about how an ordinary camping trip with friends can turn into a real nightmare.

title: Garbage Country
description: Drive through a pixel art 3D wasteland. Explore vast procedural terrains dotted with hand-crafted landmarks, each holding echoes of a forgotten past.

title: Spelly Cat
description: Solve word puzzles. Rescue your owner. Get fed!

title: Storm Striker
description: Stormstriker is a hyperactive 5v5 PvP third-person shooter with colorful hero characters, action-packed gameplay, and an emphasis on teamplay! Join the battlefield by choosing a hero that’s right for your playstyle!

title: Time of the Wizard
description: Time of the Wizard is a Magic-Casting, Bullet-Hell, Dungeon-Crawler where you will: Burn, Poison, Freeze, Explode, Electrocute and Melt through hordes of enemies by casting your OWN spells. Take back the Wizard's stolen magical tome and destroy the remnants of the Monster King's army!

title: R00000
description: A home brewed 360° interactive horror flick. Witness a troubled soul craving to make a chilling home movie realize that the monster lies a lot deeper than he could have ever guessed. Play the cassette and rewind the terror hidden inside.

title: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost
description: Gelatinous is a platforming adventure with deep roots in games like Mega Man, Metroid, Castlevania, and other classics.

title: Platformer Helmet
description: Achaapur is taken hostage by a local gangster Gundam. You are the only hope left. Each helmet has a unique super power. Switch between different helmets to use those powers. Fight against different goons of Gundam. A Platformer game that has fights and platforming action.

title: Squares and Stuff
description: Build, experiment, and share in Squares and Stuff, a pixel-retro sandbox game inspired by classic "falling sand" games. Unleash your creativity in an open-ended world filled with sandbox elements like water, paint, fire, sand, animals, humans, zombies, and a controllable 2D platform character.

title: Juna: The Dreamwalker
description: Immerse yourself in a captivating retro-style adventure. Utilize the transformative power of the rod to take on the appearance and abilities of monsters and objects. Unravel the dark origins of the monstrous invasion and discover the secrets behind the ancient portal.

title: Banners of Ruin: Iris
description: Summon spirits that augment your party with the haunted fox, Iris!

title: To Have and to Hold
description: A short boys love / yaoi / gay visual novel about a couple of cousins whose paths cross at a family wedding. They both get a little drunk, emotions run high, and things take a surprisingly steamy turn.

title: Touhou: The Unreachable Oneiroborder
description: “The Unreachable Oneiroborder” is a beginner-friendly Touhou-styled Bullet Hell shmup. Indulge in a uniquely Touhou experience with intricate patterns and stylish effects.

title: Whispered Promises: 14 Days of Love with Anna
description: This game is a cohabitation and management simulation where you live together with your beloved childhood friend. Enjoy your free time with Anna during the 14-days break!

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
description: 26 years on, a brand-new entry in the Fatal Fury series is set to arrive on the scene! FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves features a unique art style that stimulates the senses and an innovative REV System that supercharges the excitement. Here, at long last, a new legend is about to unfold…

title: Milfvania Ep. 3
description: Encompass the whole story in this largest and final episode. Graduate from the so-called "KGB University" by building your harem. Don't mind the atmospheric, decaying background. The girls will make up for it!

title: Fattening Career
description: Welcome to Fattening Career, a Visual Novel that centers around feeding, weight gain, and a touch of breast expansion. In this game, you’ll have the opportunity to become an A+ Feeder, a chocolatier, a lab researcher, and more.

title: The Grey Dream
description: The Grey Dream is an adult Visual Novel about a man who got offered a job in an international trading company right after graduation. As soon as you accept it, the consequences of the past start to manifest. Who knows? Maybe you can get rid of your past or spice up your future with it.

title: Kingdoms Rise and Fall
description: Kingdoms Rise and Fall is a captivating Real-Time Strategy game that takes you on an epic journey through different eras, spanning the entirety of history and beyond!

title: Wanderer: Broken Bed
description: Wanderer: Broken Bed is a hentai adventure game with dating-sim, point-and-click and RPG elements that will take you to a world of pleasures and lewd adventures.

title: Maid Slaves & Golden Dungeon
description: A dungeon exploration RPG. Living a pure love life with a captured general. Go to the dungeon to earn money with the former general who now is my maid!

title: Futanari di Funghi
description: Satisfy your customers by enriching their food with your nutritious & delicious futanari sauce!

title: Freedom Tower
description: Roleplaying set in a dystopian universe inspired by early twentieth-century wars and Ukrainian folklore. You are seventeen-year-old Orest, and you might be the last hope of your land occupied by the Black Empire.

title: Lusófona Games Collection 2023
description: Lusófona Games Collection 2023 is a selection of four distinct experiences, ranging from puzzle and exploration games to more action oriented ones. These experiences summarise the diverse work produced by our students, during their project based classes while attending the Video Games degree.

title: DDI Rally Championship
description: Strap in and get ready to experience the thrill of high-speed racing, as you navigate through dynamic terrains, including rugged mountains, dense forests, and treacherous deserts.

title: Bizarre Mushroom Cycle Simulator
description: The bizarre mushrooms will surely bring you surprise and healing. Watch them with enchanting fireflies, and listen to the forest sounds. Experience a unique life only mushrooms offer. Living as a mushroom isn't so bad after all. Let's fully enjoy the mushroom life together!

title: Servonauts
description: Servonauts is an absurd couch co-op fuel-attendant game for up to 4 players. Connect pipes, mix fuels and overcome deadly hazards to meet all the customers demands, or die hilariously while trying.

title: Dominions 6: Rise of the Pantokrator
description: In Dominions 6 you take control of a powerful being that rules a nation and aspires to godhood. The type of Pretender Gods can vary from magically powerful arch mages to old dragons or an enormous tree. Dominions is a deep 4x turn based strategy game with a very large variety of spells and units.

title: Non-Fellows
description: Follow adventures of four not as much friends as they finds their way through zombie city, get acquainted with an ancient vampire and discover what happened to their cute blonde friend after this meeting. Republish of an old point-and-click adventure, with all 3 episodes in a single game.

title: TetherGeist
description: TetherGeist is a 2D Precision Platformer about Mae, a young villager with a mysterious illness that has turned her right of passage into a treacherous journey. Join Mae in her struggle to prove herself as you make your way to a mystical temple using powers of astral projection.

title: In Wonderland
description: InWonderland is a healing casual puzzle game. Enjoy it leisurely.

title: Garganta
description: 'Garganta' is a 3D Platformer influenced by Tsutomu Nihei's works. Embody Servo, an android racing to neutralise a device that'll engulf the Universe in innumerable singularities. Encounter peculiar characters and unveil secret plots designed by an AI, maddened by horrors it was never meant to witness.

title: Self-Portrait
description: Self-Portrait is a short exploration game on a island filled with chickens in a dream. Enjoy observing the growth of chickens through four seasons, dancing chickens, and others in the coop.

title: HoneyFury
description: Base Construction and Strategic Card Management. You will construct and defend your base from enemy invasions. Employ clever layouts to enhance your base's defenses and acquire resources through card management. Get ready to embrace this strategic and thrilling honey-fueled frenzy!

title: Your Journey of Survival
description: Your Journey of Survival is an open world, sandbox game, mixing together the best elements of FPS, Survival, Tower Defense, and RPG games.

title: RunOut: Hothead Paws
description: RunOut is an online party platformer game for 2 to 6 players! Pick a cute animal character, race through unpredictable obstacle courses, collect coins, and be the first to grab the stuffed bear. Prepare for a fun, fast-paced mix of running, fighting, and partying!

title: Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire Plus
description: "Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire" the solitaire game with Klondike rules, is now available in a powered-up version! Play solitaire against 11 beautiful girls, from cool beauties to tsundere ladies!

title: Roman Conquest: Rise to Power
description: Roman Conquest: Rise to Power is a turn-based strategy game in which the player can feel like a great commander of the Roman Empire. Lead a legion and go with your army to recapture the occupied lands.

title: The Last Windmill
description: Embark on an epic journey in The Last Windmill an action-adventure game where you defend the last standing windmill against relentless hordes of monsters. Engage in intense battles, face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Become the hero that saves humanity in this thrilling fight.

title: Puropu Defense Squad
description: Co-op action-tower-defense game where you defend your precious extractor against hordes of wacky humans. Build dozens of traps, turrets, items and use your hero’s abilities in 1-4 player campaigns, and against other players in unique PvP game modes!

title: Project ST
description: Jump into the madcap world of Project ST, a free online multiplayer party shooter stuffed with colorful characters, wacky weapons, massive robots, and fast-paced battles!

title: Meowing Point
description: Point and meow. 3D hidden cat game. These creatures have been turned into stone. Find and save them all.

title: Terminal Error
description: Preyed upon by grotesque experiments, you must find a way out of the research centre alive in this first-person point-and-click horror game. However, to escape, you must first delve hopelessly deeper into the maddening corridors of the facility.

title: The Book Of Hiro
description: “The Book of Hero” is a 3D visual puzzle game where players solve challenges and puzzles using illusions and perspective to find the hidden key in the map. The game tells the story of a brave villager named Hero who was ordered to meet the king and encountered various challenges and puzzles.

title: Starfall Invaders
description: Embark on a roguelike shooting game set in a mysterious world that combines 2D and 3D elements. Survive and escape from an unknown planet. Utilize enemy resources to enhance yourself, repair your damaged spaceship, and prepare for increasingly powerful and numerous enemy forces.

title: Forgenator
description: "Forgenator" is an item crafting game where players take on the role of a forge apprentice. With the guidance of a powerful wizard, players take on exciting challenges to craft powerful weapons, armor, and items.

title: Birnchen & Friends: Minor Confrontations
description: Visit Pear and Mr. Blue in their playroom and fight each other for a bowl of candy in this colorful RTS! Whether it's fruity attack or stormy chaos, you choose the side!

title: Invincible Presents: Atom Eve
description:
Become Atom Eve and take control of your own path as one of the most powerful superheroes in the Invincible universe! Unravel a mystery and balance the dangers and responsibilities of being a superhero with the relatable challenges of everyday life.

Experience an original story with striking art directed by Rossi Gifford and creative direction by award-winning writer Jill Murray, and explore the life of Atom Eve in a world filled with beloved characters. Based on the comic book by Robert Kirkman, Cory Walker, and Ryan Ottley.

title: Chester: Into The Darkness
description: After being thrown into the trash, Chester has to fight his way back home while learning to face the darker side of himself.

title: Flies Flies Flies
description: 6-episode visual novel. One day, Finn Flynn wakes up in the body of a housefly. Without the use of his voice, he'll have to enlist his prankster ex-boyfriend, and his dads, an insectophobic mad scientist and a punk rocker, to solve the mystery of his transformation, and maybe get his life back?

title: Soul Keeper
description: Soul Keeper! Story based platform game. Sometimes it will drive you crazy with its difficulty, but it will drag you along with its story. Overcome obstacles, pass levels and collect the story!

title: Junkyard Fury Breakout
description: Junkyard Fury is back, with a vehicular combat style game! Each vehicle has its own progression and story, and each environment has its own destructive mechanics. Breakout and destroy everything and everyone in your way!

title: Deja Vu: The Backrooms
description: Deja Vu: The Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op exploration game set in procedurally generated levels. Traverse diverse scenarios, with unique entry points, entities and levels, as you aim to reach the end of each journey.

title: Swollen to Bursting Until I am Disappearing on Purpose
description: "Swollen to Bursting" is a weirdo RPG in which something is very wrong. A flying saucer has crash landed in town, but it's Thursday so you have to go to work at the post office.

title: Bushido Saga: Nightmare of the Samurai
description: Embrace the way of Bushido! Prepare for an Action-packed Adventure RPG game, as you step into the shoes of Oishi, an honorable Samurai. Engage in thrilling dynamic combat, embark on a gripping Saga, vanquish the forces of darkness, and uncover a sinister plot against Lord Asano.

title: The Armardisp
description: A physics-puzzler in which you drive around a little tank and knock down buildings from afar.

title: Little Doll Queen
description: Gensokyo suddenly plunged into a huge miasma of toxic fog, and the lands are now gloomy and lifeless. The source of these strange phenomena is the Nameless Hill, a forgotten land of sin. It's a danmaku experience full of poisons and suffocation. That means, this is a shooting game.

title: Defendron
description: Defendron is an epic, acion-packed, cyberpunk/futuristic themed tower defense with unique twist on upgrade path. Place towers, fend of huge enemy waves and emerge victorious!

title: Hidden Nightmares
description: Hidden Nightmares is a horror experience set inside the endless nightmares of a psychiatric patient. Experience the horrors generated by the human mind and wonder if you will ever wake up again.

title: Valor & Victory: Kursk
description: In an effort to reverse their fortunes in Russia, the Germans committed their best forces to the Battle of Kursk. However, they were met with an unyielding Russian defense.

title: MGP Manager
description: MGP Manager is a Motogp themed management simulation. Take control of a GP team, and sign riders & staff and upgrade machines to try to win the riders and teams championship.

title: Match It Sexy
description: Embark on a captivating gem-matching adventure! Win the hearts of three charming ladies through strategic gameplay. Unlock stunning animations as rewards. Enjoy High Quality renders and animations.

title: Repair This!
description: A cell phone repair shop simulator with a first-person view, with the ability to spy on customers through gaining access to phones.

title: Suborbital
description: A sci-fi survival game with a twist. Set in a suborbit of a black hole, collect materials and scavenge in orer to repair your damaged ship. However, time is not on your side.

title: Ardem
description: Ardem is an immersive open-world survival RPG that takes you into a virus-ravaged, fully interactive world. Alone or with friends, explore abandoned places, gather resources, build shelters, repair vehicles, and restore power to bring remnants of civilization back to life — or let them fade forever.

title: Vault of Power
description: Unleash your tactical prowess in 'Vault of Power', a roguelike auto-battler that plunges you into a treacherous dungeon. Draft from 60 unique skills and combine them to obtain class bonuses. Master the art of tactics, make unique builds, and become the supreme champion of the Vault.

title: Ewe Shall Not Pass
description: Ewe Shall Not Pass is a cozy farming action-roguelike adventure. Play as Shmandalf the wizard and herd your sheep through lands unknown, fighting off hordes of enemies with magic while upgrading your spells and growing your flock.

title: King of the Bridge
description: Face off against the bridge troll in his bizarre game of chess! Decrypt, Twist and Enforce the rules as your devious opponent attempts to break them in King of the Bridge!

title: Dustland
description: Dustland is a significantly new look on survival. It's a shooter where escapes, looting, and battles are just a veil hiding the world's mysteries. It's a captivating adventure from a dozen seasons, where uncovering the truth will change everything. Only a few will be able to reach the real answers…

title: Solitaire Quest: Garden Story
description: Join the captivating journey of Solitaire Quest: Garden Story and watch the garden bloom under your care. Solve solitaire puzzles, restore the garden's beauty, and uncover the secrets that await. Play now and immerse yourself in the world of solitaire delight!

title: Finding America: The Great Lakes
description: Explore the beautiful areas surrounding the Great Lakes of America!

title: Save City R
description: Introducing "Save City R" – an adrenaline-pumping game where you take on the role of a courageous team of tank fighters on a mission to liberate the сity of R from the grips of the notorious criminal organization known as "Shai Guu".

title: Twilight Town: A Cyberpunk FPS
description: Twilight Town: A Cyberpunk FPS is a brutal, funny, bloody FPS game with an advanced gore system. Featuring 15 beautiful levels, a variety of weapons and a deeply engaging story that follows the journey of a young man and his friend tackling on a criminal underground to give his AI wife a real body.

title: Bloodthief
description: Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through medieval dungeons and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath the surface.

title: Ablaze
description: Those alien bastards have built a base in the mountains. Your mission: destroy it.

title: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell
description: Embark on an epic journey through Dante's 9 circles of hell as clumsy angel Dumbriel, whose mission is to reclaim the souls you lost. Explore angelic and infernal skills, collect shards, craft elixirs, and battle formidable creatures in this Metroidvania-style action adventure.

title: HoneySun
description: HoneySun is a CASUAL FARMING and DATING SIMULATOR. Grow crops, fall in love with numerous amazing characters, and explore unique game mechanics in a vibrant SANDBOX OPEN WORLD!

title: Answer Campus
description: A visual novel that takes you on a journey through a college campus to explore challenging scenarios around identity markers such as race, gender, sexuality, ableism, and more.

title: Rock Star Life Simulator
description: Rock Star Life Simulator is an extensive fame simulation game. Start this adventure by playing the guitar on the street, form your own band. Protect the fame, money, and charisma you earned with the right decisions and become a world star!

title: SCP: Josie
description: SCP: Josie is a game about a cat that is not all there, literally. Set in the expansive and collaboratively-created SCP universe, you play as an anomalous cat named Josie, or her more official designation: SCP-529.

title: Bonfire Kingdom
description: Bonfire Kingdom is a cosy city builder mixed with RPG elements in a dark medieval fantasy world - like a hauntingly beautiful German fairy tale. Superior enemies are creeping out of the darkness. Protect your village by leading your band of loyal knights into battle.

title: Human Wall Simulator
description: All is about humans forming a wall, and breaking it! Gather your people and stand hand in hand. Hold up against rushing enemy. Explore wall scenarios and watch the humans fight in a real-time physics simulation playground.

title: Dead End Mission
description: The humans fled for their life! Now only aliens remain in the city. Your name is Mark, a professional marksman. You have one mission, to kill the alien Queen! Your helicopter buddy will provide you with supplies during the mission. But this will not be easy...

title: Unending
description: A roguelite-puzzle anthology.

title: Infection X
description: Join the viral adventure in this arcade-style game. Play as a virus, infect cells, defeat antibodies, and solve puzzles to collect RNA points. Navigate through lung, cell, and nuclear challenges, facing unique enemies and a thrilling boss battle. Get ready for a contagious gaming experience!

title: APlaceDominatedByHoles
description: Turn-based role-playing game to help the protagonist find the truth

title: Withering Flowers
description: In a world of magic, Shira embarks on a journey to find a cure for her sick girlfriend, facing her enigmatic teacher and her fiery sister. With the aid of a fearful friend and a bold rival, she seeks answers and a chance to mend their bond after breaking up.

title: Cursed Fables: A Voice to Die For - Collector's Edition
description: Marianna, the sea witch, is investigating a mind-control mystery, but she soon discovers that she may know the culprit personally!

title: LuckLand
description: LuckLand is a strategy game that combines elements such as slot machines, card building, and Roguelike. To achieve ultimate victory, all you need to do is rotate the chessboard. This game does not include any real world currency gambling or micro trading.

title: I'm Just a Slime
description: A dragon has moved in on a nearby mountain, causing havok in the surrounding ecosystems. A slime is chosen to go on a journey to confront the dragon in order to save their home. But will they be successful? After all, they are just a slime.

title: Cozy Space
description: "Cozy Space" is a relaxing home decoration game with true-to-life models and rooms. Enjoy a leisurely gaming experience and easily create cozy spaces. It cleverly blends music elements, allowing you to be a composer, interior designer, or simply relax without specific tasks!

title: Terre Scramble!
description: Terre is a merchant doing business in the city, and in order to earn more money, she often ventures into the labyrinth. However, the labyrinth is fraught with danger...

title: Jet Soccer
description: Jet Soccer delivers thrilling, physics-based soccer matches. Steer your aircraft, perform swift maneuvers, and score epic goals in minimalist, yet vivid arenas! Enjoy competitive fun with friends locally or online.

title: Coco
description: This is a single player exploration and decryption type of game, the player controls the young magician in the map to find the exit, the way may have to explore a variety of props, acquire a variety of skills, in order to successfully find the exit.

title: Top Racer Collection
description: The Top Racer Collection showcases the renowned 16-bit racing game franchise, featuring beloved titles such as Top Racer, Top Racer 2, and Top Racer 3000, along with exciting new and exclusive content.

title: Goliath Depot
description: Goliath Depot is a door-slamming 2D arcade platformer taken straight from the early 80's. Close all doors, kick the enemies and rack up a high score in 4 different worlds. Are you good enough to lift the curse of the Goliath Depot?

title: Room In Dream
description: A peaceful, and chill casual puzzle game. Discover, collect, and assemble furniture to decorate your little cozy room and surrounding environment in the peaceful land, feeling the white noise of the nature, time flow and weather change.

title: Yarashii Hotel
description: Welcome to Yarashii Hotel, a place where all your dreams will become real! Explore hundreds of procedurally generated rooms while you meet all kind of entities eager to satisfy all of your desires! But beware! Some of them will try to catch you and make you stay in the hotel forever...

title: Monarchy
description: A 2D strategy game about a young heir who must defend the crown from those who want to take it.

title: The Severn Rising 2222
description: A graphic adventure set 200 years in the future in the flooded city of Worcester. Who were the humans? Why did they have to leave? Where are they now? Guide a swan and a duck as they attempt to find out.

title: Hentai Aim Puzzle
description: Relax and enjoy hentais while shooting puzzles!

title: Hook Adventure
description: Every 200 years the balance support mechanism is destroyed, the crystals that help it work are scattered around the world, and only you can collect them all! Use hook to move between the flying islands and collect all the crystals!

title: XR22-Seaguard
description: XR22-Seaguard is a PC and VR game that reimagines the classic grid-based game of Battleship. This immersive PC and VR game puts you in the heart of a dynamic 3D industrial environment, where you'll strategically place and sink ships using state-of-the-art weapons and defenses.

title: Astro Heist
description: Launch into the exhilarating world of Astro Heist, an asymmetric PVP Screen vs. VR game of cunning and infiltration set within bustling space outposts. Blend into the environment and sneak through challenging missions, but beware, the VR watcher is vigilant and one false move could give you away!

title: Darker Skies: Remastered for PC
description: Darker Skies comes fully remastered to PC. Incorporating new graphical features and gameplay enhancements for the definitive way to play Darker Skies. Survival Horror set after the War of the Worlds.

title: Rotting Rumble: Zombie Football
description: Run to the end zone in this 3D platformer as you're chased by hordes of zombies! Collect weapons and items to fight back against the undead. Can you outrun the zombie horde?

title: VenusBlood Gaia International
description: Embark on the impossible quest to rescue the decaying world of Palastra in this dungeon defense SRPG, interwoven with a story of epic proportions!

title: Human Farm: Pratice Section
description: Human Farm - Pratice Section is a "milking-specialized exploration escape game" developed by Tokkuri Kurage! Find a way to escape from this farm where women are treated like cows!

title: Zombie Virus Ukraine 2022
description: Zombie virus Ukraine 2022 is a game in which our main character is faced with the fact that massively armed, infected people began to enter Ukraine across the border, as a result, chaos, cruelty, and massacres formed around.

title: Forgotten Lectures: Fall of a Dynasty - The Beginning
description: Humanity went out to the stars and conquered a significant portion of the known galaxy. While technology advanced society did not necessarily. Greed, the struggle for power and influence is stronger than ever before and while besieged from outside forces there’s no lack of internal strife.

title: Adventure Field Remake
description: A long time ago, in the fabled kingdom of Sarook, a young boy was witness to words of light filling his dreams. An evil aura had consumed and poisoned the Sarook King's soul, and the corruption swayed him to unleash an army of monsters upon his own kingdom. Relive the very start of the legend...

title: Assault Shell 2
description: A high-risk, high reward shoot em up as you power yourself and your enemies up to bring utter chaos to the battlefield!

title: Deep Secret
description: This is a casual puzzle match-3 game. Players need to use the mouse to select two unobstructed squares, and if they are the same, they will be eliminated. After success, you can advance the plot and story development of the two protagonists!

title: ROFL
description: The ultimate mash-up of Reversed Bullet Hell and Tower Defense! Rage of Fluffy Looters is a game where you play as a cat and must fight off hordes of monsters with your towers. Protect your fur and unleash your furious rage!

title: Sex Story: Ruby and Hunter - Episode 5
description: An erotic Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters. Ruby and Hunter just returned home from a date when they catch their naughty maid getting it on with her newest boyfriend on their terrace. They seduce the hot couple into letting them join the fun.

title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - The Dragon's Gambit
description: Brace yourself for 15 thrilling missions and find the valuable high-tier weapon cache in every mission. Introducing the Longbow fire-support 'Mech. Unlock Izanagi Warriors Variants as exclusive campaign rewards! New Instant Action Team Combat Mode, Garrisoned and Free For All.

title: Mini Settlers
description: Mini Settlers is a minimalistic city builder! Settle islands, construct cities, and design efficient logistic networks to fulfill your buildings' needs and fuel population growth to adventure into new worlds.

title: Error143 DLC
description: Following Micah's arrival to your room, you go on dates! Play his specially curated game for you until morning rise, go star gazing together, and howl at the moon! Have some late night talks and just...enjoy each other's presence.

title: Icarus: New Frontiers
description: New Frontiers expands Icarus with a whole new map with hazardous environments, alien life and weather. Advance the story with six new chained narrative missions that delve into the mysteries of this alien planet. Extend your experience with 100+ new items to craft, collect, build, deploy and use.

title: Vampire Mansion
description: Explore the mansion, find a way to fight the vampires, find the key, and escape the mansion.

title: Exorcism
description: "Exorcism" is a first-person parkour-style puzzle + horror game. Brave the fog-shrouded town, exorcise the spirits, unravel the mysteries, and save the town!

title: Flying Shark
description: Experience Toaplan's arcade shooter Flying Shark (AKA Sky Shark) on PC with the latest quality-of-life features. Ride through the skies as they burn in a rain of armor-piercing bullets! You have been chosen for the mission. Because you are the best pilot there is!

title: Goodbye Eternity
description:
Goodbye Eternity is a point-and-click, adventure game with elements of visual novel and dating sim.

You have the possibility to have several paths when you interact with people, especially with women, depending on your actions and answers, the story will be different.

title: Under the bed
description: Under the Bed is a spine-chilling horror game that will take you on a nightmarish journey into the depths of fear.

title: Rocket Car: Ultimate Ball League Machines
description:
Introducing Rocket Car: Ultimate Ball League Machines — the perfect blend of fast cars and thrilling soccer action!
Choose from a variety of stylish vehicles, each with its own unique abilities. Whether you prefer speedy sports cars or powerful machines, there's a ride for everyone in Rocket Car.

title: Retro Mystery Club Vol.1: The Ise-Shima Case
description: This classic-style mystery adventure game, inspired by the Famicom Detective Club series and illustrated by Famitsu's legend Kiyokazu Arai, will take you on a suspenseful journey through the beautiful landscapes of Ise-Shima.

title: Aery: Flow of Time
description: Enjoy a combat-free journey through colorful worlds and search for the cure! Lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying.

title: Traxion 2
description: Welcome to Traxion 2! Again you take the role of a daring starship pilot, embarking on a series of break-neck missions into the caves of a dangerous alien planet. This time around, you can join forces with a second player, or challenge each other in deadly deathmatch mode!

title: Andromeda
description: In this casual sci-fi side scrolling space shooter, you are the last human and decide to make a final trip to the Andromeda galaxy before saying your final goodbye to the universe. Conquer enemies, experience the story, and find out what awaits you in Andromeda.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Free Edition
description: Enter the world of Granblue Fantasy at no cost with the Free Edition of Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, which includes: 4 playable characters (Gran and 3 rotating characters), part 1 of the story, online matches and lobby access (including access to Grand Bruise Legends!). Some features are limited in the Free Edition.

title: Regulate
description:
A universe...
It's filled up with garbage asteroids.
Planets have spaceships to destroy them.
But they are not using attack ships. Nobody knows why.
And they need some objects. These objects can be found in neighbor planets.
But they are not going for taking them too!
This universe needs an organizator. Wonder who can make things right here...
Maybe you can?

title: BetterSADX
description: BetterSADX is a modpack for the Steam release of Sonic Adventure DX: Director's Cut, which features various enhancements and features that have been added by members of the community.

title: Orbo's Odyssey
description: Orbo Stetson is just your average personal assistant. He files documents, he drafts up risk mitigation plans for new products, and he can launch himself like a .50 caliber bullet when prompted. On this fateful day, however, Orbo and his coworker Peeb find themselves in a bit of a predicament... The automatic door opener has been fried, and with the duo lacking a single arm between them, they are now trapped in their Boss's office. It's up to Orbo to scrounge up enough gear parts across 4 unique product portals to engineer a prosethetic arm so that he and Peeb may finally open the door and escape from this unsavory work environment...

title: El Viaje de Diciembre
description: Set of 6 levels with a consistent rustic theme, inspired by EARTH.wad, Fistful of Doom, Evilution and other 90's goodies. The project originated as a speedmapping challenge for me where I'd make the first two maps in a day each, the next two in 2 days each, and so on. I wanted to have 6 full maps originally, but I only managed to finish 4, excluding the thank you map and the secret map.

title: Eldritch Voyage
description: Eldritch Voyage is a new mossy jungle themed episode for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports made by various members of Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz.

title: I Cant Give You Any thing
description: I Cant Give You Any thing is a set of 27 (to be ~29) MBF21 speedmaps, mostly by me, primarily themed around usage of monocolor textures, HOMs, "ugly/distracting/disorienting" textures like FIREBLU, visual disorientation, perception fuckery, etc. All of my maps were made within ~30 minutes to 2 hours each, with the guest maps being more variable (4-6 hours in some cases). Gameplay-wise, maps are mostly slaughter-y, with some of them on the side of macroslaughter and others being much more compact. Inspirations for my maps vary wildly, but mostly take from music and other art that I like outside of Doom.

title: Pleasant Vibes from the Party Garage
description:
A glorious community project that takes advantage of boom features, 32in24-15_textures that are baked in and a wide variety of talent from 29 unique mappers from all over the globe!

Each map name was thought up by Clippy's wife and mappers got to pick which name to use in which to map with. This had unexpected and super creative results!

For the most part, maps are meant to be short and playtime is usually 10-15 mins each - get ready for a wild ride that should keep you entertained with unique map after unique map!

title: Sekhemti
description: A Boom compatible 6 maps journey through the valley of the Kings. Each map can be completed in 5-10 minutes (except Map 05 which is approximately 15 minutes long).

title: 10 Years of Doom
description: 10 Years of Doom was a mapping contest held from April 9 to May 3, 2021. The event was organized by Richard Frei (Tarnsman) to celebrate his 10th year anniversary in the Doom community. A total of 17 entries were accepted.

title: Boomer: Beyond Vanilla
description: Limit-removing Doom 2 WAD, focused on action, adventure and exploration, featuring a brand new MIDI soundtrack inspired by classic shooters' music.

title: Violetshift
description:
This is a collaborative set of 13 Boom-compatible (-cl9) levels made from and inspired by Stardate 20x7. Proto-slaughter, tight skirmishes, casual combat, and various puzzlery await, all splotched with purple for the eyes to feast on. This is a mix of short void vignettes and extensive gothic/cavernous menageries, so maybe there's something for everyone here.
This set is comparable to late Sunlust, Fractured Worlds, and its very inspiration. Difficulty settings have been taken into account, and we've done our best to make HNTR/HMP enjoyable experiences while still being somewhat challenging.

title: Headless Chicken
description: Headless Chicken is a delicious variety megawad in progress where Doomguy is continuously chased by chickens and other demons, too.

title: Arrokoth
description: Dark and Moody vanilla-compatible E1 replacement for The Ultimate Doom.

title: Limit Buffet
description: Limit Buffet is a 39-map limit-removing community megawad made of maps and songs which each adhere to their own strict limitations. Perhaps you’ve seen wads based on such mapping limitations: using only 100 linedefs, 64 vertices, or 30 monsters for example. Limit Buffet samples a variety of these ideas, some traditional, some zany. We’ve even got a full soundtrack in this spirit!

title: Thirty Monsters Challenge
description: The mission was simple: make a map with thirty monsters in it. In the end, sixty-four of them were made, for your personal enjoyment.

title: Vae Victus
description: A 7 level "episode" for Doom 2 utilizing new textures and music. For fans of Deus Vult and Alien Vendetta. There are only two difficulty settings: Normal (easy and medium) and hard.The most noticable areas of difficulty change is in key areas, such as replacing an archville with a baron of hell (for example). Normal difficulty is a toned down version while Ultra Violence is what makes VV fun. My advice is to play it on UV, and if it proves too much, play it on normal. However, Map06 in particular is quite hard on UV.

title: Quarantine Breach
description: A single map replacement for UDoom, made during a spark of inspiration in using the "containment area" theme.

title: Demonic Deviation
description: This wad contains 11 maps replacing Maps01-11, these are pretty much tech based themed though they can be separated by the traditional map07 intermission screen, the first six are more earth base style and revolve around a power facility, the final five are more military base style. There will be a lot of familiairty from some past works of mine (Maps 07 and 10) or indeed other peoples works from the past (Map04 and perhaps 11). This wad is limit removing (complevel 2)

title: ConC.E.R.Ned
description: 3 episode wad for ultimate doom with the usual tech/hell tech/hell setup with a few exceptions from time to time. This is an expansion from my cbspeed.wad I realeased last August, so the first episode is an updated version of cbspeed with hopefully improved gameplay and layout flow. Episodes 2 and 3 were solely built from scratch. The wad is designed to hopefully give a varied and at times challenging gameplay experience.

title: Winter Memories
description: After the unforgettable summer memories you’ve made half a year ago, Yui, Rio, and Miyuki are back. With the change of seasons and the cold falling snow, a new page to your story is about to begin.

title: What?!
description: What?! is a single-player mystery game that focuses on its compact story and unconventional solutions. Players will take on the role of Pat Irvin, a ditzy private investigator struggling to maintain his family business.

title: Hot Beaver Camp
description: Enter a world of horror and suspense, in this RPG action game, fight to survive, rescue and escape alive from a camp in the middle of the forest.

title: Godsvivors
description: Prepare for epic battles between gods and Hades in this top-down action roguelite! Choose your deity, unleash powerful combos, and fight against underworld enemies. Feel the adrenaline for 15 minutes and restore order in the underworld. Get it now!

title: Turret Rampage
description: Defend humanity from underground monsters as the last standing turret! Force burrowers out of the ground with an artificial earthquake, capture elusive ghosts with silver shackles, and shatter alien bugs into pieces using powerful rockets!

title: Bring The Chickens Home
description: Find your lost chickens and bring em home in this casual action isometric 3d platformer. Compete against other players best times around the world. Work and fight together in local co-op. Save as many chickens and survive in endless mode.

title: Swordcar
description: Swordcar is an automotive Car-achter action game with a healthy serving of gore. Slash and slice at 100 MPH and bathe in the blood of the mysterious busy corp.

title: Roll Ball
description: Roll & Ball is an American Football board game where you can call plays and control a playmaker. Play with dice to control the balance of a play or without to determine the right play.

title: Cats in Heat: Convenience Coworkers
description: Adult-Only Visual Novel featuring 3 catgirls who work under you in a small grocery store - Enjoy comedy and animated sex scenes!

title: Void Survivors
description: Void Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike game where you have to survive relentless hordes of monsters for 20 minutes!

title: Cody's Nightmare
description: Cody's Nightmare is a beautiful 2D pixel art game about a little boy named Cody who is stuck in his nightmare! His only way out is to conquer his fears! But don't worry, he won’t be alone. He will get help from his friends inspired by his favorite toys, comics, and video games.

title: Mechanic 8230: Mission Citytone
description: Mechanic 8230: Episode 2 is the continuation of the point-and-click adventure of Vigo and his robotic friend RO-2, as they uncover the secrets of the space station Сitytone this time.

title: Manny's
description: A starving castaway on a deserted island discovers that a fast food restaurant appears once the sun goes down. As if beckoning him inside in his most desperate hour of need, this stranded soul will have to work for his meal...and for his life!

title: Zombie Sanctuary: Arelia
description: This is a fun 3D mowing magic battle game. Very decompression, press a few keys, move the mouse can feel a pleasant game experience.

title: The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary
description: Adam wakes up trapped in his apartment building, where darkness and strange visions abound. To unravel the mystery and escape, he must find missing diary pages, embarking on a heart-pumping First Person Visual Novel Adventure in 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary.

title: Squab
description: Squab is a young pigeon who woke up in a cage, but his father Maximus had disappeared, leaving only a red cap behind. Find out how to save Maximus by overcoming unimaginable challenges in this thrilling and exciting adventure.

title: Cush's Amazin' Adventure!!
description: A monster living in a small town set on a journey to become a hero. Explore stages of typical fantasy world. Help this monster kill the demon king and become a saviour of the world. But if you don't want to... You have another choice.

title: Twyla
description: You are a spaceship pilot involuntarily involved into some events whose income is unclear. You meet a beautiful stranger, an inhabitant of another civilization. You're taking her side and going to protect her in the circumstances.

title: RBM Studio's Gettysburg
description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by the legendary Mark Herman. Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's. Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

title: Chemical Sort
description: Chemical Sort is a science-themed casual puzzle in which you unscramble various colored chemicals by sorting them into their own test tubes.

title: Let's Play Jigsaw Puzzles: Canada
description: Get ready to explore, learn, and be enchanted by the majestic landscapes of Canada.

title: Eastern Front
description: Eastern Front is a semi realistic multiplayer game combining real time strategy and boots to the ground fps combat. Generals command their divisions and manage war industry while soldiers go to the battle with equipment given to them.

title: Square Word: Back to Work
description: Square Word is coming on Steam! Discover 100+ words spread in 4 chill themes! Handcrafted grids, hints, mini-objectives & more!

title: Creature Rumble
description: Creature Rumble is a turn based, single payer card game that allows you to collect 65+ unique creature cards. Create the best deck to defeat your foes and become the greatest rumble master of all time.

title: Zettai Zetsumei Shoujo: Kokuu no Houteishiki
description: 30 minutes left until the girl's death... "Zettai Zetsumei Shoujo" is a short science fiction visual novel that pays homage to "Cold Equations" and "Trolley Problem". You will be forced to make a life choice: a girl who stows away on a spaceship to meet her mother, or a group of victims of a space accident waiting to be rescued. Choose the life you want to save and see the girl's fate.

title: The Prospector Odyssey
description: A lonely trek to a desolate planet unearths a strange anomaly, seemingly causing denizens of a nearby station to become horrifying, violent mutants. Run, think, scavenge and improvise. Only the smartest will survive.

title: Retro Revengers
description: A retro-style adventure platformer game, inspired by hits of the past and featuring wonderful music created by Manami Matsumae, will take you on an eventful journey through the diverse environmental stages to encourage you to save the world of retro gaming.

title: Puzzillion
description: A logic puzzles 3D first person game. Move things around, toggle switches, open doors, blend colors - train your brain solving challenge after challenge. Includes classic puzzles and new puzzles, physics and logic, light and electricity, twists and surprises.

title: Prison Colony: A Convict's Tale
description: Fight enemy vehicles on a procedurally generated, foreign world in this 3D Mecha game. Build better vehicles until you can afford your own spacejet, and escape the prison colony using that spacejet. Defend your base from enemy attack or pick the next mission to play.

title: Nano Citizens
description: Nano Citizens, the city-building game that takes simulation to new heights! Dive into a world where you have the power to micro-manage every aspect of your metropolis. Influence the lives of virtual citizens, shaping their careers, and witnessing the profound impact of your decisions.

title: Etaine: Magic Survivor
description: Etaine: Magic Survivor is a top-down arena shooter survival roguelite game. You can eliminate thousands of enemies through magic or artifacts. You can also choose talents to shape different builds to strengthen yourself. Will you be able to survive when you against the thousands of monsters？

title: This is a Small Town
description: A trainee police officer arrives in a strange small town, but unexpectedly falls into a conspiracy. What happens during the process of investigating the truth?

title: Frogreign
description: Leap into Frogreign! Set forth as Rill, an exiled prince traversing the wild depths of their kingdom as they unravel a royal conspiracy. Master your agility, sword, and sticky tongue to defeat wild beasts and explore ancient dungeons in this swashbuckling, amphibious action-adventure!

title: Bird Watching Simulator
description: An avid bird watching simulator with realistic watching mechanics. Grab your binoculars and build your attention span, Bird Watching Simulator is an unbelievably relaxing and interactive game that draws you so close to nature, it feels like you're apart of it.

title: A Creature's Journey
description: A peculiar creature finds themself alone with no memory of their past and a strong desire to find purpose for the future. After embarking on a journey to seek out answers with the aid of a mysterious traveler, hope turns to fear when an uncovered secret threatens the world.

title: Bellboy Boris
description: Bellboy Boris is a 2D platformer where you have to collect luggages and delivery them to specific and randomly defined rooms as fast as you can.

title: Plant Therapy
description: An unapologetically cozy plant collecting and decorating game. Build a beautiful indoor garden from the ground up in your New York City apartment.

title: Harma
description: Harma began with the belief of humans overcoming hardships. We have created an immensely challenging strategic card game that befits this theme. If you are someone who doesn't shy away from life's trials and faces them head-on, this game is for you.

title: Thief Simulator: Shopping Center
description: To access this content you need to have the game Thief Simulator on Steam.

title: GameDev Trash
description: GameDevTrash is a highly unconventional game.Each level presents a new genre for you to experience: shooter, open-world RPG, horror,and much more! The game's plot revolves around the modern gaming industry and its peculiarities. All of this is mixed with a slightly insane storyline and trashy humor.

title: War of Being
description: War of Being is a single-player VR sci-fi adventure with standard mode playability, based on the music and concept for TesseracT's 2023 full length album. Explore 'The Strangeland' filled with surreal landscapes and characters. Solve puzzles and find hidden objects that unlock TesseracT's new music.

title: Faster
description: Faster is a high-speed running game where only one winner survives. Race against other runners on a futuristic track set in a surreal city. Knock your opponents off the track and do whatever it takes to stay ahead. It’s parkour meets hardcore, runner vs. runner. Are you faster? It's time to prove it

title: Deckweaver: Descent Into Chaos
description: Deckweaver: Descent into Chaos is a first person deckbuilding game where the player crafts their abilities using different cards they find in the environment. Obliterate forces of chaos, fighting through corrupt locations in the world before getting the chance to face and defeat Chaos itself.

title: The Blue Stars
description: The Blue Stars is a strategy RPG where you can bond with weird alien party members. It features simple yet deep strategy combat and a lot of characters and enemies.

title: Escape from Russia: Mobilization Madness
description: You have received a summons to the military enlistment office, and there is only one way out - to run. In Kazakhstan, Upper Lars, try to fly somewhere or look for salvation in grandpa's bunker, the main thing is to have time to run out of the apartment before the public services page loads

title: Isle of Maligree
description: Become an investigator in a dark fantasy story. People keep going missing in Maligree, before being forgotten by all who knew them. Will you solve the case before you forget?

title: National Park Girls: Episode 5 - Eternal Evergreen Part 2
description: National Park Girls: Episode 5 - Eternal Evergreen Part 2 is the final installment in the episodic visual novel National Park Girls.

title: Rage of Mechs
description: Experience intense mech battles in the post-apocalyptic wasteland of Rage of Mechs. Command powerful mechs, upgrade weapons, and strategize in multiplayer sessions. Unleash your rage and conquer the wasteland!

title: Disruptive
description: Immerse yourself in a first-person sci-fi horror experience, trapped in a desolate laboratory. Explore its dark corridors, unveil its horrors and find your way to survival, as you are stalked by atrocious threats. Question yourself, make decisions and discover your destiny.

title: The Lancaster Leak: Crisis at Call Center
description: Another tape has been leaked, this time a cover-up of a tragic mass casualty event.

title: Handmancers
description: Handmancers is a Rock, Paper, Scissors Roguelite deckbuilder with a first-person twist where clear tactical choices meet deck-building depth. Craft your deck, enhance your cards, equip tricky artifacts and face powerful enemies in strategic fights

title: Ekans
description: Experience the classic Snake game with a twist! You're the fruit, and your mission is to escape the snake. Outsmart your opponents, climb the leaderboard, and face the thrilling challenge!

title: Kart Life
description: Download now and start your quest for karting glory!

title: Cat at Home
description: This is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle game with a cat as the main character. The game takes place in a villa, where you play as a cat that has just entered the house. You meet animals with different personalities, solve one problem after another, and finally resolve the crisis at home.

title: Orbit Zero
description: Create a Company, Build structures, Collect Resources, Make Investments and Speculate on Assets. Carefully manage your Workforce, Finances, Resources, Shareholders, BOD & Political Partnerships.

title: Skeler Boy
description: Experience a nostalgic aesthetic right out of 1970s and 1980s cultural classics, with adventure gameplay and a dark and disturbing narrative!

title: The Jusou
description: "The Jusou series", renowned as the most terrifying horror escape game in the history of smartphones, is now available on Steam! Many players have abandoned their games due to the sheer terror it instills! *Please play at your own risk if you experience any unusual phenomena after playing this game.

title: Jamboy: A Jelly-cious Hero
description: Jamboy and Billy are devoured by a giant and now they have to escape from its guts! Explore the giant's intestines as you defeat food monsters in this frantic, multi-genre game and go on a stomach-churning adventure!

title: Hear My Cult
description: Hear My Cult is an Action RPG with Rogue-Lite and RTS elements where you summon and command minions. You take the role of a cult summoner and necromancer, customizing an elemental deck of cards to build an army of units while gaining the favors of the Old Gods.

title: Steel Division 2: Men of Steel
description: The fighting men of World War II take center stage in Steel Division 2: Men of Steel. In this major new expansion 8 new divisions, new nations including Bulgaria, dozens of new units, 2 new Aces, and new Unit Traits will lead you to victory on the battlefield.

title: Lost Oath
description: A Souls-like platformer with Roguelike elements.

title: Flying Tank
description: Get into your Flying Tank and shoot 'em up like it's the good old days! Kill strange bosses, drop bombs from above and build an arsenal of fun, powerful weapons. Reclaim the stolen Earth - alone or with a friend - in a rich action-packed side-scrolling shmup!

title: The Rush
description: The Rush is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up with graphics inspired by classic space shooters of the MSX. Buckle up and see if you have what it takes to master the highly adaptive Chameleon Quartz space fighter, single-handedly obliterate the alien invaders, and overcome The Rush!

title: Alien Land
description: This is a special simulation tower defense game, where you need to command each citizen to build a base. To produce food, one also needs to resist monsters from the night!

title: Zombie Sanctuary: Ash
description: This is a fun 3D mowing magic battle game. Very decompression, press a few keys, move the mouse can feel a pleasant game experience.

title: Strike Force 3
description: Join Strike Force 3, an elite unit combating ruthless terrorists. Engage in adrenaline-pumping firefights, stealth missions, and complete daring objectives. Enlist now for the ultimate combat experience!

title: Ruthless:1
description: Ruthless:1 combines ARPG Hack and Slash with creature collection and puts it into a war-torn sci-fi world. Destroy enemy Mechs, grow your army and build the ultimate roster. Countless skills and items allow you to play the style you like.

title: Wirewalker
description: A first-person platform game with puzzle elements immersed in a mysterious realm of glittering wires. The player must explore and conquer the maps by exploiting resources, using logic, casting powers, facing entities and interacting with the environment.

title: Hope of Bion
description: Hope of Bion is an adventure game with a lean towards story and atmosphere. Visit different locations, examine the objects of environment and fight enemies using weapons of melee and ranged combat.

title: Terralora
description: Terralora is a simple Rogue-lite where you traverse a shattered world to overthrow a tyrannical kingdom. Take on the role of a chaotic little knight: Skye, as you explore procedurally generated zones filled with secrets, mysteries, and many untold treasures!

title: Package Runner
description: Your number is 22, a Package handler at Zenith Company. Your job is to fix those packages and keep your workspace tidy. Hot bath service is the only reward in this damn job. With work going on, you'll find the truth of the company.

title: Purrfect Survivors
description: Kill monsters, Gather paws, then you will be stronger and stronger! Purrfect Survivors is a roguelite game, which you need to get runes and arrange them against the thousands of monsters. Every rune has its own ability and it shows completely different ability depending on where you arrange it.

title: Hatone
description: Dive into a NES-inspired Action-Platformer with Metroidvania elements. Play as an Illuminati henchman battling fearsome bosses and unearthing secrets in an ancient castle. Fulfill your duty… but are you the architect of your fate—or just a pawn in a game someone else is playing?

title: Rapis the Bullet
description: It is a Danmaku shooter ...... but the protagonist cannot shoot bullets. She only has a sword.

title: Vapor Up! With Man with Apple
description: Have you ever wanted to play a video game? Well, how about playing this one? Run and jump like a parkour master and save your dog from rats. You are robot from a vaporwave ghetto. Sounds cool, right?

title: Forbidden Tapes
description: Forbidden Tapes is a game consisting of three different horror stories. In the first episode, discover Jeremy Winterroad's recording, an urban exploration enthusiast searching for abandoned places full of stories. He won't be disappointed when he explores the old McNale house.

title: The House on Ninth Avenue
description: Explore the house and surrounding garden to uncover clues and to find a way out.

title: Warlocks Deeds
description: Embark on an extraordinary journey through a mystical realm where warlocks and magic reign supreme. Introducing "Warlocks Deeds," a superbly crafted medieval survival sandbox voxel game that will transport you to a world of enchantment and adventure!

title: Veritus
description: Unshroud secrets hidden deep within the dark chambers of the god of shadow, Veritus’ castle. Persevere through monsters and mysteries lurking in every corner. Prepare to leave camp and journey into the castle’s lonely halls by collecting resources and equipment to make it out alive.

title: Magma Fever
description: "Magma Fever" is a 2D pixel-style mining action-adventure game. You will pilot a mech and dig into an underground volcanic world. Complete missions and confront enemies in various environment, overcome disasters like earthquakes and lava surges, bring back ores to upgrade your mech at the base.

title: DawnOfCombat
description: "DawnOfCombat" is an indie game I'm developing, due on Steam this year. Players navigate a vast universe, battling foes, modifying spaceships, and strategically upgrading with collected coins. Decisions shape each fresh challenge. The game beckons thrill-seekers towards cosmic glory and victory.

title: Culture House
description: Culture House is a nurturing + adventure game based on biological cultivation experiments. Set in a building influenced by 20th-century modernist houses, the game portrays serene and strange days, unravels the mysteries hidden behind the experiments, and culminates in the arrival of the apocalypse.

title: Gazolinas
description: Gazolinas is a competitive arcade racing game. Master precision driving, customize classic cars, and compete globally across diverse tracks. Enjoy realistic physics and dynamic environments in this thrilling race to the top.

title: Dungeon Crawl Tower Run
description: Single player 3D action roguelike extraction game. Create unique builds out of various combinations of skills and equipments to reach the 6th floor of the Tower!

title: Scrumlords
description: Fight off hordes of angry peasants and reclaim your realm in Scrumlords! Lead your formation of loyal soldiers into battle in this action-roguelite, unlocking new gear and increasing your abilities as you play.

title: Talented
