Our goal is for the DLC to offer a fusion of peaceful landscapes and the rhythm of a buzzing economy that's unlike any other.

title: Haunted Hotel XVI: Beyond the Page - Collector's Edition
description: Travel to spooky hotel to track down a horror writer whose inventions might just be leaping off the page!

title: Sea of Treasures
description: Sea of Treasures is an exciting 2D platformer that takes you on an epic adventure through multiple islands in search of the legendary treasure map. Embark on a thrilling journey, explore and overcome treacherous obstacles while gathering the pieces of the legendary treasure map.

title: One Life Clicker
description: A unique idle clicker game with RPG elements and hardcore survival mode with only one life available

title: Let's Sing 2024
description: Let’s Sing 2024 brings a thrilling new karaoke experience to your living room. Enjoy chartbreaking hits and all-time classics that are guaranteed to make you sing at the top of your lungs. Step into the spotlight with the brand new career mode and rise to stardom. Become a VIP and test your vocal range with many more songs online. Experience seasonal events online with Let's Sing Fest and join the never-ending karaoke party alone or with friends while you play with people across the globe.

title: My Camp of Memories: Episode 1
description: Visual novel in the genre of romance and adventure. You are eighteen years old, and you have just entered the last stage of education. However, strange fragments of memories, notes and a series of events say that it will not work out to study calmly. The path you take is entirely in your hands.

title: Gauntler
description: Avoid numerous dangers using the power of Mystical Gauntlets and make your way to the summit, braving increasingly harder challenges.

title: Pumpkin Hell
description: Have a spooky map anyways. This was originally mapped for Pigeon Speedmapping Session hosted by Bonnie, but I wanted to flesh the concept out into a more substantial map. This should take you about 10 to 20 minutes. Par time for the original was 2:00, for reference.

title: Safe Haven
description: "Safe Haven" is my interpretation of a safe place removed from the world of the living - it's not necessarily heaven, but a happy place nonetheless. All souls are welcome. Negative influences are buried here. Your stay may be temporary, or permanent - that's up to you.

title: Ode to the Odonata
description:
A quick semi-speedmap made for @Dragonfly's birthday! Inspired greatly by his "Order of the Odonata" map from a few years back.

Simply collect the three teal skulls to open the exit. Blind playthrough probably takes about 20 minutes.

title: Exquisite Amethyst
description:
Here is a new single map for GZDoom, inspired an inordinate amount by Cyb's "Void".

Ambition outgrew the time allotted before Fuzzball's birthday, so it was released 2 weeks late.

title: Gloombase
description: "Gloombase" is a love letter to early 2000s ZDoom mapping, employing linear, objective-based gameplay, and abundant use of ZDoom features such as slopes, colored lighting, ambient sounds, lightning and weather effects, and a LOT of scripted sequences including interactable NPCs and menus. It is also a teaser for something bigger still to come. Stay tuned!

title: Flashback to Hell
description: A 15-level mapset for DOOM 2 that is compatible with the "-complevel 9" setting. Features new music by PRIMEVAL and James Paddock, as well as high-quality redone sound effects by Per Kristian Risvik. If the new music tracks are buggy in ZDOOM while using FMOD, updating to the latest non-official revision might fix the problem. I recommend using Fluidsynth, though. The first eleven maps are tech-base themed and are re-imaginings of the first eleven maps of Doom II. The next three maps are hell-themed, with the fifteenth map serving as an epilogue. There are two bonus Wolfenstein 3D themed levels in the two secret map slots, accessible via the epilogue.

title: Death's Dichotomy
description: Death's Dichotomy is 5 maps by 4 mappers for GZDoom. This is an offshoot of the now cancelled Near Death Experiences project. The aim of the project is to explore ideas and thoughts on death and dying.

title: Demonastery
description: A medium sized, architecturally detailed single-player map which twists back in on itself several times, set in a crumbling monastery made of marble and corpses.

title: Preacher
description: Preacher is a 10-level PWAD for Doom II requiring a Boom-compatible source port. It was released by Darch in December 2018 and is a "musical conversion" based around medieval Christianity. Some music is provided by the band Those Poor Bastards.

title: Into Hell
description: Into Hell is intended to be an episode of levels that take you deeper and deeper underground, until you find a crack in the Earth and dive into the realm itself.

title: The Warlock's Hearth
description: The Warlock's Hearth is a very large map for limit-removing ports with an emphasis on atmosphere, exploration and enjoyable fights that still challenge the player without putting the pressure on all the time. The map features an .ogg soundtrack courtesy of Der Wolfmensch (Marco from Decoded Feedback's sideproject).

title: Scourge of Viscerus
description: Scourge of Viscerus is 7-level hub-based mod for Hexen. It was created by Matt Tropiano (MTrop) and released on July 1, 2010. Set several years after the defeat of the Deathkings, the players must venture out to stop a demon named Viscerus, who seeks to resurrect them in order to conquer the world of Cronos. Scourge of Viscerus features new boss enemies and new music tracks.

title: Elf Gets Pissed
description: An episode 1 replacement for Heretic.

title: The Realm of Parthoris
description: The Realm of Parthoris is an episode one replacement for Heretic, created in 2015 by the Doomworld community, led by Jeff King (Egregor). It requires a limit-removing port that also features Heretic support to play. Development began on January 27, 2015, with the aim of creating a full Heretic megawad, but due to a lack of interest from mappers, the project was scaled down to a single episode

title: Theorists
description:
Welcome to my game, buddy!

Matt is glad to see you! He waited a long time for someone to visit him! Feel like at home and get ready for endless theories!

This game is a parody of the Mr. TomatoS game based on the intro of an Game Theory video. It's not meant to make fun of the original, it's just a silly fan game.

title: Afflicted
description: Afflicted is a thrilling post-apocalyptic shooter with exciting game modes and a cheesy storyline.

title: Mutus Meteora
description: A virtual gallery where players can explore the highlands, its architecture, discover works of art, collectibles, interact with a third-person character, and adjust the time of day.

title: Everlasting Flowers
description: Everlasting Flowers is the first installment in a series of "cinematic novels" that tells the story of two girls, Mina and Ran, and their struggles and growth as they search for their own approach to life.

title: KINDa
description: It has been designed for old-school, single player and cooperative play. There are 32 maps and the themes really vary.

title: Mia's Hunt
description: Survive the horrors of 'Mia's Hunt: Forest of Fear' as 18-year-old Mia fights through a zombie-infested forest. Arm yourself, and escape the nightmare.

title: Suwako-chan Cubic
description: Suwako-chan Cubic is a Touhou fangame featuring a unique take on the Touhou formula, featuring 3D movement and attack patterns for the titular protagonist to get through. Sequel to Suwako no Danmaku Pyonpyon Daisansaku.

title: Shinjuku Soumei
description: Shinjuku Soumei is an upcoming visual novel from G-MODE and Plus81 that questions the value of life in a city where life and death intersect.

title: Cute Fames Adventure
description: Cute Fames Adventure is an RPG game, more or less, where you play as this little creature that is called Fame, Fame is a normal looking humanoid creature that was turned into a dog by an experiment that only happened in their town. It is now your time to find out who did it and get him back to what he looked like!

title: SRG Mixtape Volume #4
description: Super Rare Mixtape Vol. 4 is a physical indie game collection including 30 games and 10 demos. Packaged as a USB drive shaped like cassette tape with only a limited number sold.

title: Teenage Demon Slayer Society
description: A turn-based character action game where the only thing harder than growing up, is cutting a demon in half next to the person you may or may not have a crush on. This is Teenage Demon Slayer Society.

title: Paranormal Syndrome: R Dolls Edition
description: A remake of the chapter 1 of the game Paranormal Syndrome, with changed graphics, menus and even some changes in the game mechanics.

title: Kikai: The Silent Cat
description: In a world of anthropomorphic animals, a ninja cat is imprisoned for his crimes of murder and fights to free himself.

title: Pushpully
description: Pushpully is a puzzle game where you try to reach the end of the level by changing your polarity and interacting with magnetic blocks around the levels.

title: Crusade to Die
description: Made in 2 days for the GMTK Game Jam 2022 with the theme Roll of the Dice. Lock onto tiles and move them around to help a little bard avoid skeletons and collect coins. Grab D6 to generate new tiles and D4 to reroll tiles. Getting hit will lose you tiles.

title: Gaia: A Protetora da Natureza
description:
Get ready to go on an adventure and help Gaia protect Planet Earth, which is being invaded by aliens with the ability to blend into the soil of the region where they landed.

Use your water and wind equipment, cause erosions on the enemies, and thus prevent them from destroying nature.

title: Forget Your Chains
description:
Forget Your Chains is a visual psychological horror novel about the horrors of forgetting anti psychotics.

Play as Nonnie, a strange girl with schizoaffective disorder and try to make the right decisions for her survival. Explore her world, an empty home, through her eyes and mind. Interact with strange & surreal characters as you try to search for medication or try to create safety.

title: Enigmoon
description: Metroidvania with challenging puzzles and free exploration as long as you have oxygen.

title: Magicliment
description: In this real-time action adventure RPG, players set off as Pururin, a fledgling hero freshly graduated from the Hero's Academy. Jump, fight, and use magic to collect the seven Rainbow Fragments scattered across the world and prevent the Demon King's resurrection.

title: Something in the Woods
description:
Something In the Woods is a short horror game that places you in the shoes of a Police Officer on a fateful night. While driving down a desolate road, exhaustion compels you to stop at an isolated gas station for a cup of coffee. However, as you step inside, you look at a board with dozens missing person posters and wonder who or what could have done this. An eerie silence pervades the gas station, devoid of any staff or customers. You need to find out where everyone has gone.

It's getting dark, better hurry.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom
description: PC version of Spongebob Squarepants: Battle For Bikini Bottom. Unlike its console counterpart, it is a collection of mini-games.

title: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect
description: Embrace the enthralling explorations and challenges with your characters, each uniquely customized through roguelite gameplay. Discover the truth of the world during the adventure, and alter the course of human destiny through your choices.

title: Fortress 1024
description: FORTRESS 1024 is a gothic like map set inside a fortress. The playing area is mostly built within a 1024x1024 scale and the majority of the level is set outdoors. I've tried my hardest to make the gameplay good and challenging. Plenty of teleporting surprises so watch your back. The exit is located in the middle of the map around a nukage moat, you must raise a bridge to get out of this level.

title: Palace of Nemrac
description: A Huge Level for Doom2, created back in 1998. Was my first map for Boom and now has been finally released. Was originally intended for the Doom Millennium project which was never released. The level originally didn't have as much detail, but I have given it a big facelift. In this map, you encounter every type of monster present in Doom2 and all weapons are present except for the BFG?, but who knows, it could be there?. The level is large and detailed and contains several unique sections such as a church and a Nazi building with Swastikas on the floors. Obviously the Demons are using the Nazi's for an experiment with silent teleporters. There are a few Arch Viles hanging around so be cautious. The 10 hard to find secrets come handy, many of them unmarked.

title: Doomed Space Wars
description: Doomed Space Wars is a Star Wars-inspired mapset but with mostly Doom enemies and weapons. There are 9 levels divided into 3x 3 level mini episodes and 3 secret levels. At the end of each 3 level mini episode there is a boss. Every map is huge and takes advantages of Zdoom's special features such as 3D floors and reverb. Also there are tons of secrets and a few top secret Easter eggs. The aim for the level design was realism and a dark atmosphere, with huge height variations and a semi linear overlapping progression.

title: Death Tormention: The Complete Trilogy
description: 20 years after the release of the original Death Tormention. I present "The Death Tormention Trilogy". This compilation megawad contains all previously released 3 Death Tormention episodes in one megawad replacing Episode 2, Episode 3 and Episode 4 of the Ultimate Doom with improvements to gameplay and various bug fixes over the original. Also replacing Episode 1 is Simply Phobos.

title: World War Alpha
description: Despite their conceptual differences, World War Alpha actually ties into both Sure Shot 3D and Wrecked to complete a trilogy of games. The treacherous ending of Sure Shot (whereby Major Merc Paramount abandons his partner on the island) sent our 2 heroes down separate paths. While Wrecked concerned itself with the island that was left behind, World War Alpha proceeds to tell the story of what happened to the army that flew away. The details are fleshed out in the game via a series of episodic cut-scenes, but the basic gist is that their maniacal appetite for world domination takes them deep into the past - where they expect to brutalize their primitive ancestors with their superior knowledge and technology! Fortunately for us, they get much more than they bargained for from our resourceful forefathers...

title: Vila do Nevoeiro R.E.L.I.D.O
description: Vila do Nevoeiro R.E.L.I.D.O is an psychological horror game that tells the story of Adam, who has recently moved to the strange Nevoeiro Village shortly after divorcing his wife, and his son, Charles, who has mysteriously disappeared in the midst of a distorted world. Desperately, Adam searches for Charles, not knowing if he is dreaming or going insane.

title: Candy Land Adventure
description: Candy Land Adventure is an adventure game developed by Realtime Associates and published by Hasbro Interactive in 1996.

title: Ys X: Nordics - Limited Edition
description:
The limited edition includes the following contents:
- A physical copy of Ys X: Nordics
- Ys X: Nordics Original Soundtrack mini
- Downloadable Content “Legendary Cleria Armor” for Adol Christin
- Ys X: Nordics original logo pin
- Ys X: Nordics visual card set
- Ys X: Nordics original crossbody sling bag (Adol Christin model)

Japanese release is handled by Falcom themselves, while Clouded Leopard handles the Chinese release and NIS America handles rest of the world.

title: Hex-a-Hop
description: Hex-a-Hop is a hexagonal tile-based puzzle game with one simple goal: destroy all green tiles! There are infinite undos and no time limits -- you just have to find a way to destroy all the green tiles and step on a safe tile at the end.

title: Sombras
description: Sombras is a horror role-playing game that tells the story of a teenager who ends up getting involved with demon worshippers.

title: My Favorite Monster
description: My Favorite Monster was developed by Cute Company, a division of Schoolscape, and released in the United States by Simon & Schuster Interactive.

title: Gnilley
description: A game for Game Jam Sydney 2010 where the object is to scream to advance.

title: Mouse Wants Cheese
description: 30+ levels packed with cheese, what more could a mouse want?

title: Street Fighter V: Luke
description: This DLC adds Luke as a fighter.

title: Mayhem Survivors: Animals
description: Mayhem Survivors is an action rogue-like game, where you feed cute animals with various different foods in order to Survive. It is inspired by Survivors-like games and features 3 different game modes.

title: 1001 Jigsaw World Tour China
description: Tea ceremonies, ancient temples and red dragons! Put your puzzles together and embark on a colourful and unforgettable journey through the multifaceted China.

title: Xonix
description: Remake of a classic old-school hit, one of the first arcade games ever!

title: Rune Factory 3 Special: Digital Deluxe Edition
Pinball FX: Williams Pinball - Star Trek: The Next Generation
description: Experience an out-of-this-galaxy pinball adventure on the Star Trek: The Next Generation Williams Pinball Machine! Join Captain Picard on the U.S.S. Enterprise-D and fight against Romulans, Cardassians, and the Borg!

title: The Rabbit Crazy Adventure
description: The Rabbit Crazy Adventure is an exciting precision platformer with 50 levels full of challenges and enemies. Take control of a brave rabbit as he embarks on an epic adventure through vibrant and dangerous worlds. Traversing chasms, avoiding deadly traps, and defeating cunning enemies are just a few of the skills you'll need to master to progress.

title: Overwatch 2: Hero Collection
description: Jumpstart your hero roster and dominate the battlefield

title: Overwatch 2: Complete Hero Collection
description: New to Overwatch 2? Unlock the full game experience with the Overwatch 2: Complete Hero Collection!

title: The Last Three
description: In the depths of a magical, peaceful forest lives the last stone tiger family, guardians of balance and protectors of the mystical creatures' realm. Their tranquil life is thrown into turmoil when a dark power invades, kidnapping the mother to use the family's powers for their own ends. The father and cub set out on a journey to find and rescue her, restoring harmony to the forest while facing a brave and determined adventure against the forces of darkness and mystery.

title: Burger Restaurant Simulator
description: Join Burger Restaurant Simulator for delicious moments! Enjoy making hamburgers with great graphics and rich content.

title: Airplane Race Simulator 2 Player Game
description: Welcome to the adrenaline-pumping world of Airplane Race Simulator - 2 Player Game, where you can experience the joy and excitement of racing airplanes in captivating environments. This highly enjoyable game offers a thrilling race experience with different locations, game modes, and a versus mode that takes the enjoyment to new heights.

title: Wroom Wroom Puzzles
description: Happiness in Every Piece: Wroom Wroom Puzzles - Where Little Minds Thrive!

title: Wildagotchi: Virtual Pet
description: The ultimate simulation game for all animal lovers.

title: Wizards Legacy: Nightmare Park Manager Simulator
description: Welcome to Wizards Legacy: Nightmare Park Manager Simulator, a thrilling simulation game that puts you in the shoes of a talented little wizard tasked with building and managing the scariest amusement park imaginable.

title: Moto Rush GT: Extended Edition
description:
Racers, beware!
One of a kind game entirely playable with... Toy-Con Motorbike!
Forget about speed limits and traffic rules 'cause on this road you're the boss!

title: Hentai Stars
description: Dive into the world of hentai stars and meet lovely girls.

title: Hentai Girls: Extended Edition
description: These girls want to invite you into the most tempting puzzle game experience Nintendo Switch has to offer.

title: FR Master: Formula Racing Simulator
description: Become a Racing Legend in FRMaster: Your Journey to Greatness Starts Here!

title: Outbreak: The New Nightmare - Revisited
description: Return to the roots of fixed-camera co-op survival horror as you face monstrous hordes, scrounge for supplies and attempt to survive the nightmare. You have one life. Make it count!

title: Outbreak: Devious Beginnings
description: Race against the clock and battle the undead in this co-op survival horror nightmare.

title: Outbreak: The Nightmare Chronicles - Reinvestigated
description: Experience an immersive and horrifying episodic single-player survival horror nightmare. Trapped alone in a desolate manor and hunted by monstrous foes, you will need to scrounge for supplies, manage your resources, solve puzzles and battle the undead to survive.

title: Outbreak: Endless Nightmares - Restless Dreams
description: The nightmare continues for Lydia and her fellow survivors. Experience true horror in this co-op survival horror roguelike featuring all new content.

title: Savant: Ascent Remix
description: Get ready for an adrenaline-filled elevator ride through a robot-infested tower. Wield powerful magic, and acrobatic moves as you reclaim the Alchemist's domain from a horde of mechanical fiends.

title: Dirty Room: Chapter 7 & 8
description: Start final battle in an old city, Chapter 7 & 8 included.

title: Kiss Me
description: Kiss Me is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Schleich Puzzles: Farm World
description: Sheep, cows, pigs, horses, chickens and much more: The exciting world of schleich Farm World in 60 lovely designed puzzle scenes. All puzzles have been carefully designed for children ranged between 3-7 years old.

title: Neko Odyssey
description: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

title: TrotMania: Rhythm is Magic
description: TrotMania: Rhythm is Magic is the first installment in the Trotmania series. The game primarily features songs from seasons 1 and 2 of My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic, with the addition of various fan made songs and remixes.

title: TrotMania: Chrystalize
description: TrotMania: Chrystalize is the second installment in the TrotMania series. The game includes various songs from season 3 of My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic series and tracks from the first Equestria Girls movie, in addition to various fan made songs and remixes.

title: Truck Preparation For Driving VR Training
description: Train your professional skills inTruck Preparation For Driving VR Training safely and in full correspondence with international standards!

title: Dyin to Live
description: A contagious puzzle game where death is the only way to live! Use infectious abilities to expand your virus hive mind. But spread carefully, because each ability results in your host's death! Master your deadly skills so you can live another day.

title: Fisher's Wharf
description: ️ Welcome to Fisher's Wharf! ️ Dive into the pixelated world of fishing fun! Cast your virtual fishing rod and get ready for an epic adventure at the colorful Fisher's Wharf!

title: End Up Alone
description: In a dark world, in an empty place full of hidden secrets and parasites, you have to try to escape.

title: Hynpytol
description: Hynpytol is a microscopic puzzle adventure with highly-contagious fun. Where Malady held illimitable dominion over all, there was found only one who put forth HAND to seize Malady.

title: Be the Richest
description: is a tycoon management game that inherits the classic gameplay of Richest #1. It introduces an exciting new stealing mechanism where you can get rich quick by stealing funds from tycoons to strengthen your own power.

title: Barbie Fashion Show: Eye for Style
description: Design fashion shows to help Barbie get ready for Fashion Week in Paris

title: According to Cain
description:
Two brothers. One murder. And a mystery as old as mankind.

You are a medieval investigator sent back in time to learn the secrets behind mankind's first murder. Using a novel alchemy system, observation, and your wits, you must discover the untold truth about Cain and Abel.

title: 12 Labours of Hercules XV: Little Big Adventure
description: Help Hercules free from the tiny folk's shackles and save Lilliputians' lands from a shadow-casting island floating in the sky!

title: Ardaria
description: Procedural building, crafting, RPG skills, resource mining, and dynamic NPCs. Master parkour moves, face hordes of enemies, and tame powerful mounts! Embark on an epic adventure in Ardaria!

title: Fuzzys Quest 2
description: Its been 3 months since Fuzzy last defeated King Koodie and all seems quiet. Unbeknown to Fuzzy his dreams of a quiet life was all about to change. King Koodie is still out there, What could he be planning?

title: NHL 24
description: NHL 24’s all-new gameplay features bring authentic on-ice action to life. Experience the rush and fatigue of a high-pressure game with the Exhaust Engine, where sustained pressure in the attack zone leads to new game-changing effects like goalie fatigue that slows the netminder’s reaction time the more they get worn down with offensive action; change the momentum with Physics-Based Contact as you break the glass and send players into the bench with big body checks; and get unparalleled player command with the new Vision Passing System and Total Control Skill Moves. Chel is more connected than ever with cross-play in all online team play modes, along with HUT Moments, which lets you recreate classic moments in hockey history and today’s biggest plays. Adding an extra layer of authenticity, Flex Moments introduces 75+ new goal celebrations, and a wholly refreshed presentation complements an enriched crowd atmosphere that makes playing the game feel like you’re at the game.

title: As Talk As Walk Wayfarer Team: One Percent Sleepy
description: It's a boring hypnotic game in the Land of Music. All you have to do is count sheep, count sheep, count sheep,,, flock.

title: Conrad's Quest
description: A 3D top down strategy game. Do u have what it takes to complete all these level and help Conrad. Only the best gamers will be able to complete the last level.

title: Vexed Heroes
description: Welcome to Vexed Heroes! Fun fast paced survival bullet hell, unlock classes and create your own powerful builds and rage through endless new game plus!

title: Revenge of Ilcoin
description: In a futuristic sci-fi action setting you will become “The Miner” and your mission will be to take your powerful weapons and protect your Ilcoins (The ultimate treasure in ILCs) from the space aliens pirates and the evil DBoss leader.

title: Return to Riddle School
description: A fan-made remake of the cult-classic Riddle School, originally released in 2006 by Jonbro (now goes by Jonochrome). Released on the same date as the final entry in the series.

title: Object-37
description: The game takes place in the near future in Freak Squad's office. During the game, the player will to walk around the office, as well as meet one interesting streamer, who has changed a lot (or not so much) with time. The game is made in the escape-horror genre, where the player has to get out of a closed location, trying not to get caught by its unfriendly inhabitant. Of the tools, the player will only have a weak flashlight and his own microphone, with which he can open doors. However, it is worth remembering that the microphone can both help and harm, forcing you to pay too much attention to you.

title: Kinder
description:
In a certain town in a certain place, there lived a boy named Shunsuke Takano. One day, Shunsuke set out alone to visit his grandparents' house, and on a Saturday morning, he promptly departed. It seems that his neighbor, Mami is coming along with him to the bus stop.
However, there was still some time before the bus arrived, so Shunsuke-kun decided to go to the secret meeting place where he usually gathers with his friends.
After playing there for a while, Shunsuke-kun finally boarded the bus.
The next day, when Shunsuke returned he finds not his familiar hometown, but a ruined town of death...

Players control the elementary school protagonist, Shunsuke Takano, navigating the transformed 'town' where they live. The game involves defeating three monsters and uncovering hidden mysteries. Aside from the three monsters, be aware of various traps and puzzles. Additionally, choices and actions in the game may lead to the death of other companions. Be cautious and think carefully about your actions to understand the consequences. Even if companions die, the story will continue, but the ending may change slightly.

While the initial goal is to defeat the three monsters, the objective may shift along the way. You'll eventually discover the truth behind the story. Admittedly, the content may be divisive, especially considering the horror genre with elementary school protagonists.

Encounters are generally non-existent (only occurring during specific events). The game primarily features event-based battles, and as such, the concept of leveling up is not present.

title: Sternly Worded Adventures
description: Sternly Worded Adventures is a roguelite word puzzle RPG inspired by Bookworm Adventures where you travel through a forested peninsula with Yorkshire-sounding place names fighting monsters with the power of words to uncover whatever dark secrets may be lurking beyond.

title: Mega Man: Day in the Limelight
description: Mega Man: Day in the Limelight is the first game in a fangame trilogy based on the 8-bit series of games, and created by Riverroad.

title: Sold Soul
description:
Sold Soul is a full-on Heretic episode with 9 levels and challenging gameplay.
The story is that you play as a merchant with some unnatural powers and skills who have been betrayed and seeking revenge.

title: Relyctum
description: A new episode that replaces the first standard Doom II. The levels gradually introduce the player into a dangerous world of death by showing ways of survival and success in it.

title: Gorehounds of Doom
description: Gorehounds of Doom is an 18 level megawad for doom 2 in mbf21 format started by Thelokk. The theme of the project was simple and unrestrictive, with each mapper creating something under their personal interpretation of horror in a doom wad. The result is a wide variety of maps ranging from atmospheric environmental storytelling to slaughter under a dark/gory aesthetic.

title: Drought
description: 3 short, Boom compatible maps built with @Noiser's excellent D4V mod and using @ukiro's wonderful OTEX texture pack. Each map is originally a ~1 hour speedmap that has received tweaks and refinement over the last month since their initial version.

title: Brood of Hatred
description: For reasons unknown you wake up in a strange place. Another world. A world populated by evil. The brood of hatred! And once again you really have no other choice...no other choice than grabbing a nearby shotgun and start blasting your way...home?

title: Angel Sweet
description:
This is the first game made by Parun.
Three angels embark on an adventure to find ingredients for sweets. Multiple stages are prepared, each with a different story.

title: Assembly Line
description: Assembly Line is a facility map created in UDMF format with a warm color scheme and clean visual style. The map makes use of arena based encounters, modern scripting capabilities and a dynamic, purpose written soundtrack scoring your playthrough.

title: Hell's Farthest Shore
description: Hell's Farthest Shore will be a replacement episode for The Shores of Hell, with a focus on huge, imposing architecture and atmospheric exploration, punctuated with frantic combat.

title: Infraworld: The Hatehammer
description:
The basic ideas of this map are infernalism in design and the general non-linearity in gameplay. I have never tried to widely disclose them in my maps and wanted to practice. In some places everything turned out as I had planned, in some places very average. Nevertheless, I am pleased with the final result. As an experiment, I added coop-starts, but cooperative was not tested at all. The difficulty is above medium, but you can choose from HMP and UV.

The map is very long (about one and a half hours), so it will be tiring to go through in single try. The player is faced with the task of finding 6 yellow keys scattered across map locations. The keys must be placed on pedestals in a separate huge room, which can be reached via a teleport in the center of the map (where the hammer is). I think this should help you not to despair if you get lost.

title: 25 Years on Earth
description: To celebrate the 25th Anniversary of the introduction of such wonders as the Super Shotgun and Arch Vile, I present a brand new, limit-removing megaWAD, which uses every line and sector action at least once! Difficulty starts low and gradually builds through this set as your journey unfolds across a planet lost to Hell 25 years ago. Will this be the mission that finally defeats the demons? No jumping or crouching, please! Do feel free to use mouse look (I do), and if gameplay mods are your thing, go ahead - this should be compatible with everything. The megaWAD is designed for continuous play, but every map is beatable from pistol starts if that's how you prefer to do things!

title: Sucker Punch 2
description: Sucker Punch 2 contains nine small, single-player maps for Doom II. The maps require a limit-removing port. The WAD is made up from three mini-episodes of three maps each which escalate from easy (with green details) to harder (yellow) to hardest (red). These are slightly larger than the maps in the original Sucker Punch (2018), and should mostly take 3-5 minutes each to play. Difficulty settings are implemented. The maps are designed for pistol starts.

title: Team Fortress 2 Classic: Death & Taxes
description:
The Death & Taxes update, was the first major update for Team Fortress 2 Classic.

The update focused on cut content from Team Fortress 2. Its flagship feature is the VIP game mode, in which BLU team must escort the new Civilian class to the end of the map, while RED team has to assassinate him. To highlight this new game mode, three VIP maps were included: Trainyard with a single capture point and a one-life VIP, Mineside with a VIP-exclusive briefcase that must be delivered to unlock the capture point, Harbor with three capture points and no special gimmicks, and a VIP version of Badwater Basin with four capture points (later reduced to three) and a nighttime atmosphere.

Another major feature was the addition of Four-Team mode, shattering the previous paradigm of RED and BLU by introducing GRN and YLW. The new Four-Team maps were the Arena map Flask, and a Domination version of Hydro - which itself is a new game mode, with Oil Canyon as a two-team exemplar. The update also brought back 9 new weapons based on unreleased Team Fortress 2 content, as well as 6 weapons and 31 maps that already exist in TF2.

In addition, most mechanics were rebalanced based on Team Fortress 2 updates, and the vast majority of the game was refactored in design, interface, and content. The prior "deathmatch" game mode was removed entirely, as well as numerous weapon concepts and aesthetic choices. Finally, the update also included improved bot support for offline play, a new achievement system, nametag medals for developers, contributors, and beta testers, and many, many exclusive settings, console commands, and weapon attributes.

title: Tetraptykon
description: Tetraptykon is a set of four maps for strong limit-removing ports (PrBoom-Plus would be the minimum requirement, and -complevel 2 would be the preferrable option) that aim to merge oldschool-flavored slaughter gameplay with modern visual appearance. For the sake of the latter, @ukiro's OTEX resource set was also applied.

title: Literalism
description: Literalism is a 26-level Boom mapset that came to life as a community project hosted by MFG38. Running between July 22nd and August 22nd, 2021, the project employed a gimmick somewhat inspired by how speedmapping sessions often place a thematic restriction. Participating mappers were given a randomly generated map title to make maps inspired by. Maps were compiled into this mapset in order of submission, so the difficulty curve may be all over the place.

title: Dungeon Synths
description: Dungeon Synths is a 9+1 map musical odyssey from the Digital Bards Krew, merging the worlds of medieval fantasy and vintage synthesizers. This is the first of (hopefully) many bimonthly ZDoom-oriented community projects organized by several veterans of the DBP series, run on the ZDoom forums. The project targets ZDoom 2.8.1 but has also been tested with recent GZDoom versions. Dungeon Synths features an ogg soundtrack of music from classic RPGs, particularly Legend of Dragoon and Dark Cloud 2, newly arranged for (virtual) vintage synthesizers and drum machines.

title: The DBK Holiday Special
description: The DBK Holiday Special is a 15-map Christmas adventure from the December Bastards Krew, which takes the holiday season into the darkest reaches of outer space. Fans of Alien Bastards! and Spaceballs: The Seque﻿l should be particularly interested in this one! ;)

title: Shrine of the Silver CyberPrimate
description: Shrine of the Silver CyberPrimate is a 6+? map techno-mesoamerican adventure from the Diabolical Broadcasting Korporation, serving as a semi-spiritual successor to DBP09: Legends of the Hidden Tech. The project targets ZDoom 2.8.1 but has also been tested with recent GZDoom versions, especially 4.10.0. As with previous DBKs, the goal here is to use well-established ZDoom features to suggest a hypothetical '90s game engine made up of bits of Doom, Build, Quake, and Hexen. Since our goal is not to push the bleeding edge of modern source ports, effort has been made to keep the set playable on lower-spec machines.

title: Team Fortress 2 Classic: Fight or Flight
description:
The Fight or Flight update, was the second major update for Team Fortress 2 Classic.

True to its namesake, it focused on content related to mobility, as well as several weapons and maps. Its flagship feature is the Jump Pad, an Engineer building that allows taking to the skies. The Anti-Aircraft Cannon was designed for Heavy to swat enemies out of the air, while the Twin Barrel affords Pyro greater mobility. The Brick gives Scout a hard-hitting projectile, while the Heavy gains Chekhov's Punch and the Pyro gains the Harvester - both weapons that store critical hits for later. Finally, L'escampette gives the Spy an alternate watch, allowing for easier escapes.

The update also introduces the Arena map Floodgate, the Four-Team King of the Hill map Frigid, the Payload map Jinn, the Four-Team Medieval Mode map Krepost, and the new Territorial Domination game mode with the map Caper.

title: Invasion...: Level 1 - Contamination
description:
This is level 1 of a 9 level storyline episode.

You thought it was all over after you finished the grand tour in hell after Episode 3 -- Inferno.

Well, Mars Base has sent in an urgent distress call and this time you are called again for one final encounter against the... INVASION!

title: Invasion...: Level 2 -The Upper Decks
description:
This is level 1 of a 4 level storyline episode.

[It's too much work to make 9, so we decided to compress the story a bit!]

title: Skepland
description: An attempt to create difficult, non-linear maps in the plutonia visual style, without going the slaughterfest route.

title: Zaero
description: Zaero: Episode 1 is a three-level PWAD for Doom II, released in June 2005 by Steven Searle. Built for the ZDoom source port, Zaero is heavily inspired by Quake II and features a similar aesthetic, with the gameplay enhancements being reinforced by the addition of several custom enemies through DECORATE. Planned to be the first entry with more maps to come, no sequel ever materialized.

title: Rylayeh
description: Ten levels based on the Lost City of R'Lyeh.

title: Nensha
description:
Nensha is a mostly run-and-gun style loop through a grimy, demonic techbase, made in boom format (complevel 9). I've never been big on making techbases, but I had fun exploring some ideas with this one. Fingers crossed that it's bug-free and some kind of entertaining!

In terms of difficulty, I tried to aim for that Plutonia/Scythe/Valiant range (with varying degrees of success). It's not a complete pushover, but not overly punishing.

Hurt Me Plenty was what the map was built for (""intended experience""). It has some kick to it here and there, but most players shouldn't feel too out of their element. Ultra-Violence is just HMP with a few extra cheeky monsters/encounters, intended to catch the player off guard a bit more.
HNTR is now Hunted! Taking inspiration from Mutabor's "Onslaught!", this is an alternate version of the map for anyone who prefers their Doom extra spicy. Gets into slaughter territory, and I probably wouldn't recommend it as a first impression.

title: Caffeine Injection!
description:
Caffeine Injection is 5 maps long episode for Doom II done between 2020-2022. It's made from various projects I couldn't finish in time or left when I changed my mind. I didn't want to waste those levels, so I compiled them in one small ep.
Pistol start is the intended experience.

title: Azazel's Second Descent
description: Azazel's Second Descent is a full, 32 map megawad. This is a one-man megawad and all maps were made by me. I would categorize the maps as slaughter-lite, meaning it is not full-on slaughter but you might face a horde or two, especially the farther into the wad you go. The WAD is broken down into six 5-map episodes. There are 4 new monster types and 2 bosses added.

title: The Box of a Thousand Demons
description: The Box of a Thousand Demons is a brand new 32-map Boom megawad, targeting DSDA-Doom as a port and using OTEX as its main texture pack. It focuses on variety over visual consistency, and explicitly caters to all manners of niche and aberrant gameplay - within you will find lite and fat slaughter, key hunts, puzzles, platforming, pacifist maps, Tyson maps, NoMo maps, ammo starvation maps, the whole nine yards. A little something for everyone. Atmosphere was my main concern, with streamlined gameplay a distant second.

title: Twelve Easy Pieces
description: "Twelve Easy Pieces" (formerly known as "Constraining Order") is a set of twelve (or was it thirteen?...) Boom format maps that sets out to do exactly what it says on the tin - provide you some fun in an easy, stress-free environment. No evil archvile closets here (although my memory might fail me, it's been a while since I cleaned out those closets); no nasty obstacles to your carefree circlestrafing (watch your step though, I'm not insured); and certainly no revenants (skinny guy in red pants told me, how could he be wrong?). Take a stroll through techbases, temples, aquatic environments and out-there voids, always knowing that even on UV you'll never face anything worse than a slightly spicy HMP Plutonia. Small maps with low monster counts, a restrained texture choice, and occasionally a dash of my personal foibles - puzzles and platforming. Nothing you can't overcome, believe me

title: Declared New Apocalypse
description:
The player will travel through prisons, rifts, mazes, fortresses, forests, graveyards, sewers, factories, labs, the Hell, haunted libraries, all to chase down (or be chased down) by new stronger demons and bosses, but with the help of new powerful weapons at his disposal.

The wad presents 3 new Episodes, with 14 new levels, 12 + 2 secret, a Hub (reachable by beating the final level or just by entering the "Reliquary" episode), from where you can play all of the levels pistol starting (actually "fist starting"), go to a "testing area", change the skill level and reach the secret 15th level, a wave based arena.

title: The Man in the Park 2
description: It's been so long. You've tried to forget, however tonight you must walk through the park again. Now there are two men in the park. Will you help one, or both? Who will you trust?

title: Project Americas
description: Project Americas is a game that shows life in a criminal area as it is. You play as an ordinary fighter who has grand ambitions and strives for more. Make your way to the top of the criminal world, make your orders, create your gang, and keep the whole city at bay.

title: Catch Up
description: Welcome to the enchanting world of "Catch Up"! Get ready to embark on an exciting precision platforming adventure like you've never seen before! Join an epic journey with a brave cat where skill and precision will be your best allies.

title: Well, me neither
description: Originally designed for a community project, Well, me Neither is a short Doom 2 adventure through a possibly flesh-infested neighbourhood. It didn't quite fill the project's rubric, but I still feel it scrapes by just enough to deserve a second lease on life.

title: Reconstruction/Decomposition
description: A silver spaceship with custom textures. Loosely based on Termination by mrthejoshmon. The second map in the wad is just a small "outro" level.

title: Dark Tide
description: A sprawling coastal castle swarming with Hellspawn

title: The Old Bean Factory
description: The map is pretty linear and has a bunch of tangents and secrets and is stuffed with low-tier enemies and pickups for all you murder-headed-secret-hunting-bonus-fiends out there.

title: Death Again
description: Death Again is a single player horror fps. Journey through a nightmarish realm that lies between dimensions in search for salvation.

title: Mujina: Maze Game VR
description: Mujina is a Maze Exploration game where the player has to activate 4 objective points and reach the end portal. Beware of the monsters and the numerous traps awaiting you! If everyone dies, it will result in a failure! Group up with your friends to complete the 3 type of mazes!

title: The Magenta Spire
description: The Magenta Spire is a partial conversion mapset taking place in parallel to the events of Doom 1; albeit on a much more remote planet. Much too far for any hope of "backup" arriving from Earth. A lone UAC communications technician must find a way to survive the onslaught of demonic forces invading the remote research complex. A shuttle off of this rock, a big gun, or maybe a bomb shelter to hide and weather the storm. The walls of every installation are coming down and the monsters seem to have brought their own reality with them.

title: The Isle Survival
description: The Isle Survival is a vast open world survival / crafting game. Loot resources, craft items, build camps and explore the environment. Protect yourself from hazards and wildlife. Find ways to survive in hostile living conditions.

title: Ring Stars
description: Ring Stars is a physics-based 3D fighting game with local multiplayer for up to 4 players.

title: Color Splash: Dogs
description: Color Splash: Dogs is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable dogs and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful dog paintings.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted Plus
description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted + is a mod for FNAF Help Wanted, that aims to bring back cut features from the original Help Wanted, and add in completely new levels and characters!

title: Kusok
description: Kusok (Kurashiki's Kuso Map) is a two-level minisode made for Boom-compatible source ports.

title: Trolls Remix Rescue
description: Play as Poppy, Branch and more of your favorite DreamWorks Trolls as you explore, smash, dance and battle your way towards rescuing the Troll Kingdom from a melodic mastermind who’s trying to alter the Trolls’ musical harmony!

title: A Space for the Unbound: Collector's Edition
Persona 5 Royal: 1 More Edition
description:
1 More Edition includes:

Treasure Chest Box - Collector’s box to hold your palace’s treasure.
Le Grimoire Art Frame - Plastic art frame inspired by Justine’s Le Grimoire clipboard.
Phantom Thieves Art Prints - Set of 5”x7” glossy high-quality prints made to be displayed in the included Frame.
Akechi’s Briefcase Bag - Akechi’s signature briefcase made into a 15” bag with logo on the front.
Arcana Tarot Card Deck - 24-card tarot deck featuring artwork of the arcana in a branded box.
Persona 5 Royal SteelBook Case - SteelBook game case featuring Persona 5 Royal artwork.
Physical Persona 5 Royal Game - Copy of Persona 5 Royal with over 40 items of previously released DLC included.

title: Fort Solis: Limited Edition
description: The limited edition physical version contains a special 3D cover and an exclusive metallic effect postcard.

title: Record of Agarest War: Limited Edition
Sargasso
description: Sargasso is an 11-map space adventure episode for DooM II which requires a Boom-compatible port to play. You play as Wolf - the leader of a mercenary team which resides in a space station hideout known as Sargasso - until one day aliens capture a loaded cargo ship and wreak havoc on any who oppose. It's up to you now - grab your high-tech weaponry and show them who rules this side of the galaxy!

title: Eternally Yours
description: Eternally Yours is an 11-map episode that should work for vanilla Doom. I would say the levels work better playing from pistol start to avoid having too much for the next level, but that's your decision. Anyway, I hope you enjoy playing them as much as I did making them

title: Hai Shuuraku Tansaku
description:
The protagonist embarks on a journey to an abandoned village upon a friend's request...
Investigate what happened in the abandoned village in this first-person horror game.

title: Hai Byouin Tansaku
description:
The protagonist heads to an abandoned hospital at the request of a friend...
A first-person horror game about finding out what happened in an abandoned hospital.

title: Bloody Heck
description: An 8 map WAD with level design inspired by mouldy's Going Down

title: The Other Me
description: The Other Me is a first-person psychological horror game delving into the realms of horror that prowl the recesses of one's psyche. Pursue the dread ruminations amidst the maelstrom of the Asylum. This game offers both mind-bending horror elements and realistic environments.

title: Space Vikings
description: Pillage and plunder across the galaxy as part of a crew of Space Vikings in this sci-fi roguelite bullet hell dungeon crawler. Find exotic weapons, upgrade them with powerful augments, explore mysterious alien planets, and unleash viking vengeance on their inhabitants.

title: Bullets & Brains
description: Bullets and Brains is an adrenaline-pumping arcade top-down 3D shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by brain-hungry hordes of zombies. Prepare yourself for an intense battle against the never-ending onslaught of the undead.

title: Hyperlight Survivor
description: A Competitive Bullet Hell with roguelite mechanics. Fight against endless hordes of enemies in ever-changing arenas, unlock new spaceships and upgrade them with devastating weapons and Power-Ups. Beat your highscore and reach new ranks to become the ultimate Champion!

title: An Arcade Full of Cats
description: Journey through gaming history's time and space, while searching for adorable feline companions in 'An Arcade Full of Cats,' the ultimate pet'em up hidden object game.

title: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones
description: Kombate Mexicano Elexiones is a fighting game featuring digitized stereotyped character trying to win the presidency of Mexico.

title: Lessaria: Fantasy Kingdom Sim
description: Lessaria is a unique strategy game that combines city building with indirect hero control. Build and manage a thriving kingdom while issuing commands and quests to guide your heroes in their adventures. Explore, conquer, and shape the destiny of your realm in this epic fantasy world.

title: Rhino Runner
description: Runner Game where Rhino needs find balloons in different maps and avoid deathly traps.

title: Wobble Warriors
description: Wobble Warriors is a 1-4 player ragdoll fighting couch co-op game. In this dungeon crawler, you and your friends play as some wobbly dragons on a mission to conquer the goblins who stole your gold. Jump, dash, ground pound, and bonk your way to victory by clearing each room.

title: Black Journey to the West
description: Black Journey to the West "is a vampire like survivor game that integrates Roguelike elements. Choose a character from a scripture gathering team, build character treasures and skills, challenge the blackened All Sky God Buddha, and shatter the darkness that envelops the Divine World.

title: Fittest Fire
description: In a ruined world, overrun by evil robots, a disabled cyborg named Blaze rests. Send a spark of energy from your world to Blaze’s to wake him up. Help Blaze take revenge against the robots in this fast paced 2D platformer where you workout to level up.

title: Nature Escapes 4
description: Nature Escapes is back with another delightful assortment of enjoyable hidden object scenes!

title: Sunstone War
description: Harness Aztec bracelets, defend your village! Unique tower defense with epic freedom & diverse enemies. Unleash the Sunstone power now!

title: Astral Rot
description: Astral Rot is a fixed camera, survival horror sci-fi game by the co-creators of Tormented Souls. You play as Adler, a space mining engineer, that will have to face impossible choices in order to save his brother and anyone in the asteroid that hasn't been infected by the Stardust Disease.

title: With My Past
description: "How should I face my past in my ever-changing life? "Listen to her inner voice and solve these challenging puzzles to help her face her past self.

title: Dark Galaxy
description: Dark Galaxy is an action based rogue-like top-down shooter. You pilot a space drone to oppose the insectoid like species called Minaripods and get stronger by travelling to different star systems. Can you free our galaxy from the invaders?

title: Bestial Reception
description: In the game "Bestial Reception" the strongest survives, grab a weapon and start running towards the enemy. Shoot and destroy everyone who happens to be near you. Get new more powerful weapons with the help of earned gold.

title: Dead Underworld

title: Last Spartan: Glory Over Madness
description:
In this deck-building roguelike, you'll customize and build your own dice set to use in turn-based battles as you explore a dark, randomly generated world, full of new enemies and encounters on every run. Experience a story-driven campaign! Fight for your Sanity and defeat the Lovecraftian horrors.

Last Spartan sees you playing as the titular Last Spartan as you battle through a story-driven randomly generated campaign where keeping a grip on your waning sanity becomes increasingly difficult as you do battle with more and more enemies that draw inspiration from Greek mythology and the Lovecraft mythos.

It's a roguelike with deck-building elements. The unique part here is that your deck is actually a set of customisable dices, with each face acting as a slot for a different ability. There are over 700+ dice faces to discover, allowing you to develop and learn numerous synergies to suit your preferred playstyle, especially when god selection comes into play.

Aside from the dice, you will be accompanied on each run by an ally Greek god. There are over 10 of them currently, although they won't all be unlocked immediately, and each provides distinct active and passive abilities. With them, you can develop different strategies for dealing with the many foes you encounter.

According to the developer, for the first ten hours, you will face new enemies on every run, with over 100 regular enemies and 20-plus mini-bosses to discover and fight in turn-based combat. This should keep the game feeling fresh and surprising for far longer than other entries in the genre.

The same applies to encounters with over 200 NPCs to meet and choices surrounding them to make. Depending on your interaction, they might provide you with a reward, blessings, or even curses that will remain constant until the end of that particular run.

Some of those NPCs will make their way to your city. It's here where you respawn after dying and spend resources you've gathered throughout each run to upgrade the various buildings in a bid to rebuild Sparta. This is the more permanent side of the Last Spartan game and will eventually provide you with perks that increase your chance of completing a run and progressing the overarching story.

The indie game Last Spartan is set to come out in early access on PC/Mac/Linux via Steam in February-March 2024 and full release coming to all Platforms and major storefronts by April 2024 ( Coming to PC/Mac/Linux first and then to all major consoles like Xbox & Playstation & Nintendo Switch & IOS soon after PC and console release )

title: Nope Nope Nope Nope Nurses
description: The thrilling final installment of Dark One!'s hit visual novel series! Hapless protagonist Yamada is once again at the mercy of the tender depredations of the world's worst staff of nurses... and this time, it's up close and personal with the ruthless Head Nurse who dominates all the rest!

title: Idle Weaponshop
description: In Idle Weaponshop, you are handed your very own weapon shop to manage. Design and sell weapons, build up your local community, hire employees, and send adventurers off into danger for fun and profit... all before prestiging to earn powerful bonuses, all so you can do it all over again.

title: SCP: Contamination
description: A bodycam footage game based on a member of D-class personnel who has awoken during a facility-wide contamination lockdown, you must escape the facility by navigating through the labs, basement areas & SCP classes that now roam free.

title: DefenseCraft
description: DefenseCraft brings revolutionary new mechanics to the tower defense genre, combining the traditional tower defense style with exploration, crafting and more! Sent to a far-off land called Sector 4, in search of a lost group of explorers, we find that the land is not as docile as it seems.

title: Wiki's Wild Ride
description: A birthright denied. An alliance forged. A plan hatched. The Jerks have locked away your dinners deep in the depths of the basement! Now you must ride your trusty steed through the house and reclaim what's rightfully yours!

title: Cyborg3003
description: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest with cyborgs, monsters, and aliens.

title: Meat and Metal
description: You are the operator of a combat turret defending the border beyond which lies the last human city!

title: Extreme Bus Driver Simulator
description: Are you ready to become an experienced bus driver? Experience the thrill of transporting passengers in a realistic city with Extreme Bus Driver Simulator! Get passengers to their destination on time and safely, earn rewards and customize your bus.

title: Wyred
description: You play as a little robot looking after a lonely outpost on a distant planet. In each puzzle, your goal is to find a way to the other (or one of several) connectors while laying down a wire as you go. But be careful; you cannot cross over the wire you have laid, lest you break it!

title: Plebs
description: Plebs is a casual real time strategy game about controlling ancient Nations to victory through strategic town building, creating mighty and diverse armies, and intelligent resource management.

title: Pim: The Forgotten
description: In this wonderful and colorful world, play as Pim, a fearful red panda able to wield the elements. Solve puzzles, support great heroes and discover the origin of the world in this Action and Adventure 3D game!

title: Ellan: The Lost Soul
description: Ellan is a beautiful first-person adventure game about the journey beyond life, Traveling with a light companion in dream-like worlds, and uncovering the meaning of eternal by overcoming the illusion of choice to light the path to Moksha.

title: Black Otaku 2: Taekwondo is in my Blood
description: Join Sahara B. Shabazz as she honours that Korean man's sacrifice by winning this martial arts tournament with the Taekwondo that flows in her veins.

title: Infinite Realms
description: Discover a blend of 4X Strategy, Deckbuilding, and Roguelite! Find cards and customize them with runes, summon creatures, cast spells, terraform the world and push back Morrigan's Corruption!

title: Risky Sanctuary
description: Create, customize, and manage a vibrant sex club filled with adorable anthropomorphic characters. Watch the party unfold, while you install adult devices, navigate finances, protect your reputation, and manage a team of dedicated employees.

title: Ardent Passions
description: Ardent Passions is an adult visual novel where Heroman uncovers his girlfriend and her friends' vigilante secrets on a camping trip. With the fate of these relationships at stake, the game unfolds through decisions that determine if these vigilantes become allies or enemies.

title: Fights in Tight Spaces: Weapon of Choice
description: Weapon of Choice is the first major content drop for Fights in Tight Spaces, and gives the player access to a new gun-fu inspired deck with 30+ new cards, new levels, music tracks, and a set of deadly new enemies.

title: Suisenka
description: Main character comes from a powerful family and thus has everything he wants. His colorless life gains new palette after meeting a girl who introduces him to the world of sensual pleasures. But one day mansion inhabitants rebel against such life and try to find their own happiness.

title: Invention 4
description: Save the world from an impending threat in a dynamic 3D shooter with quest and puzzle elements.

title: Call to Arms: Gates of Hell - Liberation
description: “Soldiers, Sailors, and Airmen of the Allied Expeditionary Force: you are about to embark upon the Great Crusade!” This DLC introduces the western front action in 1944, featuring the US faction, as well as German western front content.

title: Legendary Slide
description: In "Legendary Slide" you have to clear away the mahjong tiles by sliding them next to matching ones. Solve unique and mind bending puzzles and collect gems to restore ancient temple of Air. Continue your journey through the Legendary world! This is the Platinum Edition with unique extra content!

title: Star Legacy VR
description: Star Legacy VR is an immersive virtual reality shooting game that incorporates intriguing Roguelike elements into gameplay. Players assume the roles of interstellar guardians who venture across diverse planets and traverse through various time zones.

title: Stellar Initiative
description: Stellar Initiative is a roguelike tower defence game where you land on the planet and use your orbit ship to deliver buildings and support you with fire. Complete missions, install new upgrades, discover powerful artefacts and find the best strategy!

title: Sound Lock
description: "Sound Lock" is a multi-ending puzzle RPG game based on the perspective of a girl without a mouth. The story takes place in a world with hundreds of similar rooms, where the decorations are nostalgic. Explore rooms full of death traps and try to clear the fog to find the buried truth.

title: Vapor Tanks
description: Explore Cyberspace in Vapor Tanks, an arcade 3D shooter with a focus on satisfying gameplay, addictive replayability, and surrealist visuals. It features a 30 level long single player, and Online PVP up to 4 players.

title: Arinn
description: Arinn is a precision platform game with dungeons full of enemies and deadly traps. The only way out is to escape from the enemies and overcome all the challenges. Collect all the treasures and help Arinn pay off his debts.

title: 2BBee
description: Exciting adventures await you in the world of the most hardworking little creatures! You will have to survive in the world of bees, develop your hive and raise new generations for your life with the dangers that may await you on your way! Survival sandbox, but how long can you survive?

title: V Gate
description: V gate; It is an open world game that includes first and third person shooter, survival, exploration, crafting, horror, thriller, team, building, mystery, management concepts and drags you towards different worlds with explorations.

title: Boyscout: Patrick's Town
description: Boyscout is a top-down adventure in which you play as Patricio, a little boy who is learning to help his neighbors while his father is trying to grow his own business in a rural town. One day, an unusual event will change the lives of the locals forever.

title: Kill The K.O.T.H
description:
The people call and beckon forth a hunter upon their shores to ascend the hill and kill their king who is rotten to his core.

Kill The K.O.T.H is a first-person climbing game by Rubeki.

title: Princess Maker 2 Regeneration
description:
Princess Maker 2 Regeneration, an enhanced port of Princess Maker 2 Refine, will release on Switch, PS5, PS4, and PC on December 2023.

It will have English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese language support.

title: The Blobjob
description: The Blobjob is an educational adventure video game developed by Detonium Interactive and published by Sampo. It tells the story of Joe Ridley, a security officer of the NanoBlob Corporation who needs to prevent an intruder from stealing a piece of technology that will adversely harm the world.

title: La Nuit
description: La Nuit is a platformer representing the Art Deco art movement, with elements from Cassandre to Lempicka. Collect the glasses, and wine bottles and avoid the ghost to win!

title: Burasagatte Iru Kiji
description: Burasagatte Iru Kiji is a game where you are a ninja with a hook, do not allow enemies to go unpunished.

title: Pampas & Selene: The Maze of Demons
description: Join Pampas and Selene as they overcome monsters, demons, and the Dark Priest with the help of the gods themselves! Explore this metroidvania 8-bit platformer alone or with a friend. This retro game is a loving tribute to an MSX2 masterpiece from the creator of UnEpic, Ghost 1.0, and UnMetal.

title: Adonis: Escape from Urania
description: 17-map Boom megawad, sequel of Urania. After defeating the tyrant monster from Urania, your spaceship was hit by unknown forces and you had to catapult back to the surface of Urania, in the industrial area, between the jungle and the mountains. Earth coalition ships are under fire and cannot help you. Received information from the command center: this time the threat comes from the moon of Urania - Adonis. The task is to find a way to get to Adonis and destroy the enemies there.

title: Mass Extinction
description: Full 32-map megawad done in the styles I like the most, E1, E2, Alpha and Doom2 Techbase. the mapset is divided into 4 episodes and it covers 4 geological periods of time, from devonian to triassic, and each map represents an age.

title: Alpha Centauri
description: Doom2 episode using doom1 stock textures plus alpha textures. I put more emphasis in lighting this time.

title: Cyberpunx
description: Doom2 episode with 9 levels with custom monster behaviour via Dehacked.

title: Rupture
description: Ultimate Doom episode with 9 levels which run in episode 4

title: Knee-deep in 2023
description: Classic E1 replacement

title: Eviltech: Soul of Megawad
description: Classic doom megawad with 34 maps. The levels take the names of the buenos aires subway stations and most of them have a color predominancy of the respective station.

title: Locked Arcadia
description: A Caravan shmup made by kollumos, with music by scowsh, for the Gunner Parade game jam 2023.

title: BeZombie Anime Invasion
description: Dare to survive in BeZombie Anime Invasion! Navigate a monstrous city as a transformed heroine, recover lost memories, and unravel your past. Thrilling battles and a compelling story await, all in vibrant anime style. Do you have the courage to face your past and challenge fate? Start journey now!

title: Wolf West
description: Follow Luna's vengeance journey to defeat the sheriff and bring back the forest balance. Accompanied by the Druid, explore and fight the world of the Wild West in the name of your fallen brothers and sisters.

title: Dungeon Survival
description: A side-scrolling, turn-based character development game, where you play as a lord leading your heroes to brave the depths of dungeons.

title: Magical Girl Konoha
description: To aid the King, Priestess Konoha plunges into "Grimoire"! The world inside "Grimoire" is formed by another world called Grimoire Land in which Konoha becomes a magical girl, and has come to save the world!

title: Checkers RPG: Online Battles
description: Experience the ultimate fusion of classic online PvP checkers gameplay and RPG elements in Checkers RPG.

title: Boaty Tanks
description: Embark on an aquatic adventure! Control a small boat, armed with weapons, and navigate arenas. Battle enemy pool floats, test your skills, and immerse yourself in thrilling boat combat. Survive challenging fights and show off your shooting skills!

title: Elon Simulator
description: Elon Simulator is an immersive Trillionaire Simulator with TONS of fun mechanics and activities. As Elon, you can: Smoke Weed (a lot), Print your own Money, Sell Lithium to Earth for billions, make millions while you sleep in real life, Become a Trillionaire, and tons more! Made by one dude.

title: 52Beatup
description: 52Beatup is a Deck-Building, Fast-Paced (Like Really Fast-Paced), Fighting Game! Enjoy Chaotic and Quick matches with friend or foe!

title: Gas Station Tycoon
description: Build a gas station from zero to become the best gas station business empire in the world!

title: Puppeteer: Control
description: Puppet Master Simulator. Become the Puppet Master and find exhibits for your toy house hells collection.

title: Mushroom Path
description: Let the mushrooms help you on your journey through the different seasons in this difficult 2D precision platformer that full of dangers around you.Still in early development, more content coming soon!

title: Sky Sojourn
description: Welcome to the world of Sky Sojourn! You are an adventurer who embarks on an amazing journey overcoming obstacles on floating islands. Will you be able to conquer the peaks and reach your goal? Get ready for an unforgettable climb full of amazing discoveries!

title: Crossing the Sands
description:
A first-person dungeon crawler RPG with turn-based combat and grid-based movement.

Assemble a party of adventurers and explore a medieval desert world, fighting monsters in turn-based combat to build the skills and gather the equipment you'll need in order to vanquish the leader of the raiders. Master powerful healing and offensive magic to aid you on your adventures, and delve deep into ancient ruins to find out who's really pulling the strings.

title: A Murder of Crows
description: Try to get all the crows before disaster comes for you

title: Bahamut2-Come on, Fight
description: Roguelike combat mode, every battle is a new start, choose your favorite transfer route, learn new skills, face different enemies, and challenge the invincible devil. Bahamut 2-Bride of the Dragon parallel time and space, what different stories will there be?

title: Fire Shark
description: Get ready for classic shoot-'em-up action in Toaplan's Fire Shark, now on PC with modern updates. An evil and overwhelmingly powerful military force is about to take over not only a small country, but the whole world... Defeat the enemy and accept your place of honor!

title: Hammerwatch: Anniversary Edition
description:
Hammerwatch: Anniversary Edition beautifully remasters 2013’s original Hammerwatch in celebration of its 10th anniversary.
Embark on the new Shaftlocke Tower campaign, in addition to the already released Castle Hammerwatch and Sun Temple campaigns. Experience the game with new art and remade character classes with new effects, as well as a brand new item system, and more!

title: My Little Career
description: My Little Career is a visual novel for adults only. The story of a young girl who moved from a distant suburb to the big city to become a photo model, but everything is not so easy, the world of big business is much more complicated than she expected, but she will stop at nothing.

title: Yebushou: Defeat Pirates
description: In the 16th century, a large number of Japanese pirates appeared in the coastal areas of China, and a Chinese general was born. He led his troops to victory with very low battle damage, but when he first took office, the army was not capable of fighting, and only you two could save the early war.

title: Vultures: Scavengers of Death
description: Face zombies and fearsome monsters in this turn-based survival-horror roguelike as you seek the path to recover a valuable artifact. Unravel the history of Salento Valley and its downfall after a bioterrorist attack led by a secret cult involved with the powerful corporation Eugenesys Tech.

title: Beneath the Bleeding Moon
description: A boys' love / yaoi visual novel set in 19th century Japan. Follow the adventures of Haru, an aloof young man forced to crossdress by his mother from childhood, and Kishou, a cheerful and irreverent thief brought up in poverty, as they travel across the country to break an age-old curse.

title: Citadale Resurrection: Darkness my Curse
description: DLC Pack for Citadale Resurrection. Darkness my Curse is alat 1980s handheld styled single-screen platformer.

title: Fishing: North Atlantic - A.F. Theriault
description: Expand your fishing fleet with the brand-new official DLC for Fishing: North Atlantic

title: Underverse Battles
description: Underverse Battles is a multiplayer turn-based fighting game using the Undertale mechanics. Select your character and fight against other players. Dodge enemy attacks, choose your attacks carefully and win the fight.

title: Embattled
description: Embattled is a fast-paced one-button game. You are constantly moving up and down while enemies on both sides are shooting at you and approaching your position. To change your direction, press a button or hit the top or the bottom of the screen. Hold a button to stay still and put up shields to protect yourself from enemy shots. But when you have the shields up enemies shoot faster and move towards you. Try to avoid enemy shots and make them hit each other to score points. The game is over when an enemy shot hits you.

title: Hentai 18+
description: Hentai 18+ - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Kurayami Zaka no Ie
description:
Afterwar Tokyo. There is a hill called "dark slope". There is an old house where master is missing for 18 years already. Women in the house still know nothing of that mysterious disappearance.
That is the beginning of the story about a serial killer.

title: Devilish Girl
description: Devilish Girl is a Casual Erotic Puzzle game, you reveal 15 devilish girls in increasingly dificulty puzzles.

title: The Lost Son
description: The Lost Son is an upcoming indie puzzle platformer game. When trapped inside a mysterious world, Sean and Belle embark on a journey to discover the secrets behind the digital dimension and to find their lost son.

title: Carousel
description: Ready to start unlocking your puzzle skills? Come on, challenge and bring the beautiful image back to full display!

title: Football Stars Legend 24
description: Step onto the football field with Football Stars Legend 24, full of exciting football matches, realistic graphics and gripping tactics! Choose your favourite team, feel the fans' enthusiasm and start the match to embrace the victory.

title: Barbie PC Fashion Design & Color
description:
Introducing a whole new world of fun!

Now, you can enhance your child's creative potential with the new Barbie PC Fashion Design & Color! It's an explosion of fashion, color, and fun!

This menu-driven software program lets your child select, then color Barbie fashions. Thousands of combinations to choose from for hours of fun. Available for IBM or IBM-compatible PCs in 3½ inch and 5¼ inch Disk versions.

title: Tibili et L'île de la Panthère
description: French educationnal game for 5-8 years old.

title: Euotopia
description: A rogue-like MMO.

title: The Conductor
description: A short horror game about a train journey and a descent into madness.

title: More Bloons
description: By popular demand, More Bloons is here. Play 50 all-new challenging levels, and a new special balloon type! Some of these levels are very hard, and should keep most of you busy for a while!

title: Across The Obelisk: Sands of Ulminin
description: The Sands of Ulminin await you and your friends now. Delve into the desert canyons, solve the mysteries of the pyramids, and discover what lurks beneath, with two new heroes, a new zone, dungeons, and new events to explore!

title: HoloCure Update 0.5
description:
This update added the Achievement, Stamp, Enchantment and Fandom Systems to the game as well as full mouse support and general changes to most existing aspects of the game.

The new content includes 9 new characters from Hololive Japan's generation 1 and 2, 11 items. 7 collabs, 3 stages, 2 weapons and various new outfits for the 20 characters already in the game.

title: Amberial
description: Roll and bounce in this mystical cave spanned along 15 levels filled with contraptions that will challenge your gaming-skills !

title: Holocure: Update 0.6
description:
This update hasn't been fully revealed but is set to add 9 new characters from Hololive Indonesia generation 1, 2 and 3 with related items and stages.

The main new content added in this update is Holo House, a hub area with minigames, stores and a house area to customize. It has cooking, fishing, farming, NPC recruitment based on character mascots and various new challenges that can unlock additional furniture items for the house.

title: Pleasure Zones
description:
Unlock the Secrets of the Pleasure Zones

The hottest girls of Vivid are waiting for your special touch, including the gorgeous Racquel Darrian, Janine, Kelly O'Dell, Ashlyn Gere and more. Caress these luscious stars just right and you'll be up all night!

With the mind-blowing SexPad interface. You have total interactive control - and you can cut to the chase with just the click of a button.

title: Virtual Vixens
description: Save your friend from the evil Crystal who has imprisoned him in a VR pleasure world for his failure to please her. Before you can reach Crystal you must satisfy three beautiful women and solve the mystery of their strange erotic existence.

title: Man Parts
description: 36 sexciting games that challenge you to find, remember and piece together various hunks.
