Once you win, you won't be puzzles, because whether you're female or all male, after completing each puzzle your personal dancer will dance just for you! If you're in it for the game, the game can be adjusted to varying degrees of difficulty. Man Parts is where your brain meets brawn!

title: Dere Vengeance
description:
Unleash your fears in a fourth-wall-breaking platformer that will leave you questioning allegiances... and reality itself.

Let the hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack and meticulously designed pixel art engulf you in paranormal encounters, impossible glitches, psychological horror, and the nostalgia of classic side-scrolling games.

Enjoy the guidance of A.I.D.E. and a very kind and morally right "Dev," who'll be there to assist players every step of the way. The companions also help give an eerie charm to the surreal experience of playing this unique game. Players also encounter eccentric characters, scary creatures, and unsettling corruptions along their journey.

Experience terror as you navigate nightmarish yet fair platforming challenges with precision and dread. The old-school hard gameplay is reminiscent of classic games that are hard to put down, preparing the brain for the kind of scares that make most analog horror media effective.

Dive into thrilling meta-horror that defies the boundaries of the creepypasta digital horror genre, blending fear and suspense into a truly surreal experience. In DERE Vengeance, the player is part of the story.

Embrace the perfect blend of nightmare and adventure in this story-rich platformer that promises genuine scares and enjoyable gameplay. You can embark on DERE Vengeance without playing our other games, though not advisable, as this terrifying adventure stands on its own with a unique and intriguing experience.

title: KKHTA: Security Watch
description: A KKHTA style I'm on observation duty game.

title: Get Them Boats: Orca Revenge
description: You are an orca, a killer whale, out for revenge against the elites mucking up your waters. Attack the rudders, and eat the rich!

title: Floating Cuboid
description: You are an infinitely jumping cube, that doesn't mean that the challenges in front of you become any easier however, sometimes it is hard to stop yourself and sometimes you go too far, but can you make it just like you were before, in one piece?

title: Final Resistance
description: Fortress Besieged is a cartoon style game that combines strategy and leisure. You need to control a castle surrounded by various monsters, collect resources, make equipment, and arm your warriors to defend it to the end in this prison like castle!

title: 911: Prey
description: Search items and solve puzzles to escape from the cannibal's plate. Cover up your tracks so that the maniac does not suspect anything.

title: DCS World: Mi-24P The Border Prequel Campaign by Armen Murazyan
description: In the summer of 2015, the Russian Aerospace Forces achieved significant results in the fight against terrorist groups on the territory of the Syrian Arab Republic (SAR).

title: Just Hit The Button
description: Hit the button to win. The simplest game ever.

title: Imagindar
description: Imagindar is an online PvP Arena game that you can enjoy with your friends for free! There are no predefined classes or heroes. In each match, you create your own class and play exactly how you want with complete freedom. How will you build your dynamic class and outsmart your opponents?

title: To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora
description: Delve into the captivating realm of Faenora in our upcoming real-time strategy RPG game, To the Grave: The Battle for Faenora. Drawing inspiration from timeless classics like Final Fantasy Tactics and Ogre Battle, we're modernizing the elements that made these games unforgettable.

title: ThrowBomb
description: Throw Bomb is a basic entertainment of 80's PC. Select angle and force, fire the bomb.

title: Orca: a lenda dos mares
description: Orca: a lenda dos mares is a role-playing game set in a fictional world, where almost the entire planet is covered in water, except for a few islands, created by Orca, a mystical being with the powers of a magic whale, who can create matter, life and give abilities to other beings at will.

title: Orca 2: O Mistério de Wakkita
description: Orca 2: O Mistério de Wakkita is a sequel to the role-playing game that takes place after the events of the first one, where you now control the guardian of the Wakkita Island, Toots, accompanied by the Red Dragon, Arkos, who is going to investigate a strange sailor who has arrived on the island.

title: Orca 3: A Maldição dos Barbatantes
description: Orca 3: A Maldição dos Barbatantes is the third entry in the role-playing game series. In this new adventure, players will be immersed in a new legend, with new secrets and a completely new world to explore. Sail the Great Sea, meet new inhabitants of this magical world, and maybe even reconnect with old acquaintances.

title: Punisher
description: A rehashed MAP01 - but with more monsters than you can shake a BFG at.

title: Her Love Just Washed Away
description: Love is so confusing.

title: Junkfood
description: Junk Food is a Boom compatible Speedmapping Community Project held in Meowgi's Community Discord Server. The basic premise was to make "Junk Food" slaughter ala BFG spammy, high monster count maps where not a lot of time is spent deliberating about layout/detailing/fight design/other things that can bog a mapper down. It's just good BFG fun.

title: Chillax
description: Play mini games while enjoying the sight of sea creatures.

title: Eternal Slumber Party II
description: Eternal Slumber Party II (often shortened to ESP2) is a megawad for Doom II created by TimeOfDeath and released on April 16, 2018. Just like its predecessor, Eternal Slumber Party, it is a collection of maps that TimeOfDeath had previously released as standalone PWADs, or as submissions to larger community projects.

title: Vow of Vengeance
description: Vow of Vengeance is a collection of 12 fast-paced, action-packed levels with themes of tech bases, caves, hell and snowscapes. It features midis by Dragonfly, Ax34, Jimmy and Eris Falling.

title: One Humanity
description: One Humanity is a new level for the 1994 id Software release DOOM II created by John Romero to support the people of Ukraine and the humanitarian efforts of the Red Cross and the UN Central Emergency Response Fund. 100% of the proceeds go toward this support.

title: Tozerath in Ruins
description: Tozerath in Ruins is a indie RPG game with Turn-Based combat. Is the style of pixel top down with the setting of medieval fantasy.

title: Heart Chain Kitty: All Screwed Up
description:
Heart Chain Kitty: All Screwed Up is a 2d platformer with 3d graphics featuring Kittey, the perpetually tired cat. After a delivery goes wrong, Kittey's island is covered in big screws, kicking off a new adventure.

The game is a continuation of the freeware "A Game with a Kitty" game series.

title: Little Devil: Foster Mayhem
description: Destroy furniture, mess up the house, and anger your foster parents!

title: Tasking
description: "Tasking" is an idle monster-hunting game. You will start as an archer and recruit your own team members, use gold coins to purchase powerful skills, challenge formidable bosses, and defeat them one by one, gradually conquering each continent.

title: White Middle Class Guy Simulator
description: The most boring game ever made.

title: Cosmic Survivor
description: A brutal, Roguelite Arcade Blaster. Similar in style and gameplay to arcade classics like Asteroids and Defender.

title: Dewborne Dawn
description: In this new hand-drawn, story-rich metroidvania, explore the last haven of a dying world, and discover the purpose you play in saving it. Shape your own path, fight the all-consuming blight, and help bring hope back to the survivors. Take up the flames of dead gods, and stand firm in Dewborne Dawn!

title: Narrenschiff
description: "Narrenschiff" is a psychological horror puzzle game. Players take on the role of an amnesiac man who awakens in a mysterious mental hospital. As they explore, they unravel a story involving their own origins and the conspiracy brewing within the walls of the mental institution.

title: Diamond Rush
description: Diamond Rush is the simplest 3D game in which you have to overcome various traps and look for diamonds.

title: Assassin's Creed III: Benedict Arnold
description: Benedict Arnold is a single-player downloadable content addition for Assassin's Creed III. It was originally available exclusively for PlayStation 3 and PC.

title: Princess Nom Nom
description:
Her Royal Highness could really go for a snack, but Her Royal Butt is too tired to move. Food catering is a servant's duty anyway.

Pop a minion and order him to steal some food nearby. Then order him to get some more. Pop a new minion. Pop a fuckton of minions. Get a fuckton of food???

title: Pleasure Party 2
description: Create Wild Themed Sex Parties in Exotic Locations around the world in Pleasure Party 2, a "Sandbox" style Orgy Simulation Game. Create up to 25 custom characters and arrange them in any of over 75 sexual positions to create and manage the Orgy of your dreams!

title: Horny Spy: Secret Mission
description: Horny Spy: Secret Mission is an adult visual novel with a spicy plot. A dangerous adventure, undercover missions and passionate romantic dates are waiting for you.

title: Zombie Survivor: Undead City Attack
description: Welcome to Zombie Survivor: Undead City Attack - prepare to survive zombie outbreak in this FPS shooter game!

title: Alibi: The Dinner Party
description: Play as a Police Detective investigating a murder at a luxurious villa. When your old friend Jasmine Lee becomes the prime suspect, it's up to you to reveal the truth. Navigate a gripping case filled with twists and turns that'll leave you guessing until the very end.

title: Final Fantasy: Sky Warriors
description: An interesting twist on the background history of the original Final Fantasy! This game feature what happened 200 years before the original Final Fantasy 1 for the NES, featuring an unexpected cast of characters otherwise known as the 'Sky Warriors' in the canon game. Witness the catastrophe of the four Fiends of Elements making their grand entrance into the Final Fantasy world, and experience the Lufenian response!

title: Glaive 2
description: This is a set of 7 levels for Doom 2 inspired by the gameplay style of Scythe - short, straightforward, and fast paced, with plenty of action and challenge. While the first Glaive was techbase themed, this set is hell themed and aims to be much harder.

title: Glaive 3
description: 10 short, action focused maps for Doom 2, inspired by Scythe. The wad is divided into 2 visual themes. The first 5 maps are techbases, the next 5 are a visual mashup of Shores of Hell, Plutonia and Scythe 2's jungle episode. The gameplay is classic styled mostly without slaughter, but there are some large fights.

title: Warglaive
description: Warglaive is a set of small to medium sized maps focusing on action-packed, difficult, classic-styled gameplay. Difficulty starts off moderate and escalates to very challenging on the later maps, though lowering skill level can ease things up significantly if needed. There are 7 main levels and one bonus level accessed through a secret exit on map 7, which is intended to be a very difficult challenge for seasoned players.

title: Snowfury
description:
Snowfury is a single map wad for Boom set in an snowy castle featuring classic styled gameplay. The level should take around 15-20 minutes to complete, and provide a decent challenge. Difficulty levels are supported. Freelook is fine, but avoid jumping.

The main gimmick of the map is that it uses a snow effect that doesn't require decorate or a more advanced engine, inspired by the old map "nordhell" by Eternal/Deadall. The effect can break down if you look at it too closely but most of the time it looks pretty nice.

title: Tech Blast
description: Tech Blast is an action-puzzle game where a young mechanic explores an abandoned planet, solving puzzles, building mechanisms, and battling ore insects.

title: Starshine
description: Starshine is a limit removing wad for Doom 2 set in a techbase ripped from the earth and tossed into space! The goal was to make bases where rock and grass were still barely clinging along as they floated in the lonely void, perhaps after some disastrous teleportation experiment. It's mostly a visual theme and the gameplay is otherwise classic styled, so you won't have to worry about falling into the void while killing demons.

title: Sex: The Game
description: A Truly Interactive Game where you adventure through mazes, solve puzzles and satisfy the fundamental human desire!`

title: Penetration
description: The mod story does not consider events in Half-Life 2:Episode 1. After explosion of citadel, G-man immerses Gordon Freeman in stasis, but after a while deduces it from there for the new mission. The target of this mission is penetration into a citadel which is in City 18 (the city located near to City 17). In this citadel there is a teleport in Combine world. Using this teleport, it is necessary to get in Combine World and to destroy their leader.

title: Sleepless Night 2: Ladies' Night(mare)
description: The sequel of the to the original game 'Sleepless Night', Sleepless Night 2: Ladies' Night(mare) is a horror/psycho sound novel.

title: Kodamachi
description: Kodamachi is a 2D arcade platformer where you can’t jump so carelessly. With a platform changing mechanic that lets your discover new paths, quirky NPCs, and a retro arcade aesthetic, play through a delightful short story as you swiftly drift atop the brilliantly lit rooftops of a Japanese city.

title: Bloomverse
description: Bloomverse is a Smart game where players can own characters and items and earn Bloomie tokens on the Solana network. The game features virtual lobbies, malls, and arenas where players can partake in different events and socialize. The game is available on browsers and mobile platforms.

title: Warlock and Boobs
description: Krowly always wanted to learn magic, hunt for monster girls, and most of all, get laid. Help guide Krowley in fulfilling his dreams!​

title: NHL 24: X-Factor Edition
description:
NHL 24 X-Factor Edition includes:

-Dual Entitlement
-3-Days Early Access
-4600 NHL Points
-Exclusive Cale Makar Player Item
-HUT Power Up Icon Choice Pack
-WOC Battle Pass XP Modifier (x5)

title: Ape Escape: On the Loose
description: Experience Ape Escape: On the Loose originally released on the PSP system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Arcade Archives: Dark Adventure
description:
"DARK ADVENTURE" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Our heroes in this title have been sucked into the Devil World after they opened an ancient coffin found in some ruins.
Now, they must set out on an adventure through the labyrinthine Devil World to find the demon king, defeat him, and make their way home.
This title includes a Japanese Version, European Version, and also a North American Version that allows 3-player co-op.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - 23rd World Tournament
description: Experience the story that leads to the main plot of Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot and the 23rd World Tournament, where many upheavals took place! The title of Tenkaichi begins now! Goku and Ma Junior battle for the fate of the world.

title: Kitty Krawler
description:
Puzzle, action, friendship! Jazz the Cat is up to visiting Jeenxie the Kitty. Climb the vine and crawl your way to the window where your friend lives. Wait, but Jazz is afraid of heights!
And of spiders, and of many other hazards...
Could Jeenxie help maybe? Would you help them both?!

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Bark, Bone and Blood
description: This DLC contains one Legendary Hunter, two Legendary weapons, and one Legendary tool: Iron Bark (Hunter), Bonecutter (Caldwell Rival 78), Hunter's Guide (LeMat Revolver), and Traitor's Tooth (Knuckle Knife).

title: Crash Dive 2 - Aleutian Islands Expansion
description: Includes one campaign, two new mission areas, four new ships, one new plane, and more!

title: Warstone TD: Gold Edition
description: Warstone is a Tower Defense game with RPG elements, strategy and city building. A dreaded chieftain is assembling an army intent on taking over the kingdom. The villagers call for a hero, help them stand up against the forces of this feared villain. The hero is you!

title: Gord: Hold Your Ground
description: Defend your gord against increasingly stronger waves of enemies. No one knows what wicked things lurk beyond the veil of darkness. We must prepare our defences and brace for the coming onslaught. May we all have the fortitude to survive what is to come.

title: World War 1: Ruined Part 1
description: Embark on an enigmatic odyssey with "RUINED Part 1" DLC. Uncover secrets in a decaying world, battling foes and moral quandaries. Enhanced visuals, immersive gameplay, and a haunting soundtrack await. Redefine your understanding of "RUINED" in this gripping expansion.

title: Sushi Blast
description: Sushi Blast is a vertical jumping arcade game where you progress to the top by jumping on various platforms. Blast away enemies and collect powerups on your path to Sushi Greatness!

title: Top Racer: Crossroads
description: A new game in the Top Racer series, being a collaboration with Horizon Chase.

title: Seven Steps to Limbo
description: Created for a game jam with the restriction of allowing only one choice in the game, Seven Steps to Limbo is a cinematic visual novel about a group of jazz players who are stuck in purgatory.

title: World War 1
description: Dive into the epic saga of 'World War 1.' Navigate a realm consumed by conflict, unite forces, and lead mighty champions. Delve into the enigma of the fractured world and wield destiny's reins. The battle for existence is underway.

title: Angellus: Asas do Anoitecer
description: In a fictional world anticipating a grand festival, you experience the intertwined stories of two young protagonists whose painful destinies conceal deeper mysteries across angelic and demonic realms. Built with RPG Maker VX, Angellus blends exploration, narrative, and classic RPG progression in an isometric presentation.

title: Kuroinu 2 Redux
description: As the Nation faces invasion from the peoples it has pillaged for a century, one man defends it: Derek Rondo, the second coming of the Mercenary King Vult. He fights for his country, but plots to seize the throne for himself... A new visual novel betrayal epic begins from within!

title: Astonishing Baseball 22
description: Astonishing Baseball (or AB for friends) is not your usual baseball simulation game. It's not only about tables full of players and stats. It's about people! Well okay, you heard that line from your Economics 101 class already. But I promise, this game will be way more interesting! It's like a narrative roguelike sports game, Seriously!

title: RubyDung
description:
RubyDung was an unreleased base-building strategy game prototype created by Markus “Notch” Persson. Developed prior to Minecraft, the project was inspired by Dwarf Fortress, but with a focus on accessibility.

The name "RubyDung" was a placeholder name for a "DUNGeon game in the RUBYlands", the "Rubylands" being a rough idea for a game world that Notch had.

During the later stages of RubyDung’s development, Persson discovered the indie multiplayer game Infiniminer, developed by Zachtronics. This inspired him to experiment with a fantasy-themed, first-person, block-based prototype, reusing and adapting portions of RubyDung’s code and assets.

That experimental prototype demonstrated strong performance and positive early reception, leading Persson to abandon RubyDung entirely and pursue the new project full-time. This work would eventually become Minecraft, with RubyDung serving as a direct technical and conceptual predecessor.

title: Valis
description:
Valis a 32 level singleplayer megawad for DOOM 2.
All maps were designed with pistol start in mind, but continuous play works as well.
Freelook is not required, but recommended. Turn off infinitely tall monsters. Difficulties settings are available.

title: 1x1
description: Become a little soul lost in a dangerous factory, avoid obstacles and battle bosses. A challenging bullet hell game where you advance by opening and closing doors!

title: Sensory Deprivation Chamber
description: Surreal, sometimes eerie, fast-paced, textureless(-ish, there's only 1 texture that looks like anything) mappack that uses a modified version of supercharge where every monster is a hyper-aggressive non-infighting glass cannon, taking some inspiration from extremely early game builds and tech demos.

title: Uncharted Ocean: Adventures at the Poles
description: This is a world of oceans, islands and ships. Players will start their own journey from Faro, facing an impermanent ocean and awkward opponents, and gradually build a strong fleet with wisdom and luck. The chaotic seas and tempting treasures, under the guidance of the banner, work hard for survival!

title: Cum Clicker
description: Do you ever fantasize about having a lot of cum? Yes? Well this is your chance! Click cum, collect cum, upgrade cum. Be patient and you will have all the cum you can ever ask for!

title: Jelly Fruits Adventure: Magic Match 3 Puzzle
description: Match 3 is a popular puzzle game in which you have to be careful and collect all the fruits three in a row!

title: Utsuho's Great Hunger Battle
description: This is a Touhou fangame and Utsuho Reiuji is the main character.

title: Risk of Rain: Starstorm
description: Starstorm is currently the biggest content mod for Risk of Rain (ModLoader) featuring new survivors, items, enemies, stages, artifacts and bosses. Starstorm focuses on expanding the content of Risk of Rain by adding a whole new layer of diversity to improve gameplay and breathe new life into the game.

title: Home trip
description: This is an adventure casual game where you will play the role of collecting materials and experiencing the natural scenery.

title: Hoversteppers
description: Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.

title: Electrogical
description: "Jigsaw Puzzle + Arithmetic" is a casual yet engaging game that appeals to puzzle gamers who enjoy immersive experiences. Customize your gameplay by rearranging "piece placement," "number manipulation," and "score selection" to aim for a high score in each stage.

title: Raddoll
description: A ragdoll physics infinite runner

title: Cloud Jump
description: Take to the clouds in this singleplayer 3D precision platformer! Jump over obstacles and navigate moving platforms as you make your way through the sky.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Celestial Eyes Above Mortal Ruins
description:
Version 1.3 of Honkai: Star Rail, which included:
• New characters: Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, Fu Xuan and Lynx
• New main story quest: Obsequies Performed, A Long Road Ahead
• New area: Aurum Alley
• New companion missions for Dan Heng, Luka, March 7th and Lynx
• New main event: Aurum Alley's Hustle and Bustle
• New Simulated Universe mode: The Swarm Disaster
• New QoL changes: Trailblaze Power System Optimization and Phone Wallpaper
• …and more!

title: Vivid's Hot Slots
description:
The Future...

You've set your coordinates for the Hagar System. Word has it that after the sexual holocaust, Admiral James escaped the Garion Asylum to establish a world designed in his new image. A world dictated by sexual pleasure and exitement.

Lord Stevos has ordered you to locate Admiral James and negotiate his return to Earth. Be aware that James has created the ultimate sexual machine hot slots, which is run by his evil assistant Rothman. A machine so erotic, those sent before you have never returned.

Prepare yourself now and launch your probe into Vivid World and hot slots!

Featuring Janine, Ashlyn Gere, Nikki Dial, Lené, Heather Hunter and all your Vivid favorites.

Including spectacular 3-D graphics and original music, custom video footage, erotic game play, and much more!

title: Draw and Color: Kawaii - Amazing Edition
description: This bundle lets you try out the new whiteboard set and drawings.

title: Jackpot Jubilee
description:
Jackpot Jubilee is a single player slot machine game.

The shareware version of the game has a single, traditional, three reel fruit machine with a single pay-line whereas the full registered version has three differently themed machines and a reel hold option. The game screen shows the machine being played in the centre while to the right is the player's stack of coins, the player clicks on a coin to transfer it to the machine so that they can play. An unusual feature of this game is the way cash is paid out, if/when a player wins and collects their cash the coin stack on the right is updated immediately while the coins collected do a little dance across the bottom of the screen before eventually disappearing.

title: DoDonPachi Dai-Ou-Jou Re:Incarnation
Shadow of the Ninja Reborn
description: After 34 years in the shadows, prepare to see this legendary action adventure in a new light! Looking and playing better than ever before, Shadow of the Ninja - Reborn is Tengo Project’s remake of a cult classic, that the fans have been waiting for.

title: The Chimba's Adventure
description: Chimbinha was living peacefully in his luxurious castle when he received the news that his new lead singer had been kidnapped by a hairy villain. Now, Chimbinha will go through a lot of trouble to get his singer back!

title: Infinite Tux
description: Infinite Tux is a 2D platformer that has levels procedurally generated every time it's played.

title: Caminho Estreito
description: Caminho Estreito is a Christian role-playing game where you will need to prove your biblical knowledge and show that your faith is unshakable.

title: Minecraft: Frostburn Update
description: Minecraft: Frostburn Update is an update for Minecraft that added some new features such as skeleton/zombie variants in snowy biomes and deserts respectively, polar bears, structure blocks for saving/loading structures in worlds, and an auto-jump feature.

title: CzechBox
description: Czech Community project with all 32 maps made by Czech or Slovak authors. The maps should be playable with pistol start and also in one run. It should be fully BooM compatible and jumping/crouching is not allowed since it could spoil the gameplay of many maps. Also Voodoo dolls are used in several maps, so please use ports that support this feature.

title: Team Rocket: Blasting Off at the Speed of Mapping
description: Team Rocket comprises AD_79, Dragonfly, Jimmy and MTrop, four experienced Doom mappers who together endured a 20-hour speedmapping livestream. Their efforts were supported by kind donators and guest mappers who tagged in to let the fatigued rocketeers recuperate. We bring you 34 maps, all made within less than a day, shaped by you, our viewers.

title: Team Rocket 2: Looks Like We're Blasting Off Again!
description: Team Rocket comprises AD_79, Dragonfly, Jimmy and MTrop, four experienced Doom mappers who together will be working round the clock to reach the goal of 32+ full levels for Doom 2, averaging 8 maps each. Through their combined efforts, and the encouragement of you, the viewer, they hope to run for around 24 hours (but most likely a bit less!).

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales - Ultimate Launch Edition
description: In the latest adventure in the Marvel’s Spider-Man universe, teenager Miles Morales is adjusting to his new home while following in the footsteps of his mentor, Peter Parker, as a new Spider-Man. But when a fierce power struggle threatens to destroy his new home, the aspiring hero realizes that with great power, there must also come great responsibility. To save all of Marvel’s New York, Miles must take up the mantle of Spider-Man and own it.

title: Nuclear Chunks
description: Nuclear Chunks is a limit removing Plutonia WAD with 6 decently sized maps. There is also a Map08 containing what I had made of Map07 before I lost my way with the project (the actual Map07 in the wad is a simple "The End" bookmark style map). Each map has a distinct style from each other and was limited to using a 32 grid size for linedef and things placement, similar to my favourite Eternal mapset (though allowing myself rotation for a bit of flexibility. Map06 breaks the grid a bit and Map08 a lot). Testing is done using mostly Crispy with DelphiDoom using the voxel pack to help with thing placement.

title: 32 Inch Nails
description: 32 Inch Nails is a seven-map PWAD for Doom II and limit-removing ports created by Alexander S. (Eternal), released on September 28, 2008. It split off the Grid 32 community project and is built in a similar fashion, as the maps were created with a 32x32 grid in the map editor for all linedefs and vertexes, giving them a rather unique look, although this does not extend to thing placement.

title: Port Glacia
description: Originally a map for Jimmy's Joy Of Mapping 5, I ended up pulling it as it had gotten too large and ambitious, and its size & length would have really bogged down what was already a hefty community project. This allowed me the chance to polish the map up to a higher standard.

title: Gravediggers
description: Tackle a swarm of zombies in a creepy graveyard. Collect the heads of your fallen foes and take tem to a crypt to score points. The first player to score 50 points wins the round.

title: Fuel Devourer
description: Large fuel base full of monsters - go and kill them! Made for FDC#11.

title: Asylum of the Wretched
description: Asylum of the Wretched is a single-level PWAD for Doom II for limit removing source ports. It was designed by Ian Myers and uses the music track "". The PWAD is notable for its horror theme and atmosphere, accomplished through the use of new graphics and sounds and a DeHackEd patch.

title: Oniria
description: When the moon rises, the garden falls with it. The insects succumb to exhaustion, all except one...

title: Plasmaplant
description: Plasmaplant is a single level for ZDoom created by Sverre Kvernmo. It was the first map released by Kvernmo since the release of Eternal Doom seventeen years prior. The majority of the map focuses on a visual theme dominated by the colour blue, and heavy lighting contrast.

title: Drip Feed
description: A GSTONE fortress, a red glowing sky, silhouetted bodies writhe on spikes in the distance, fortelling your fate.

title: I.C.T.O.A.N.
description: I.C.T.O.A.N. is a single level map set in a demon-infested airship type thingy. If you're claustrophobic, don't try this level, as it's really cramped.

title: Hymn: A Heretic Community Project
description: Hymn is a Doomworld community project for Heretic. It is a 9 level episode that features custom textures. HYMN should be compatible with most modern Boom and ZDoom related ports, as well as Doomsday, but has an emphasis on 'vanilla' style mapping.

title: The Iron Forge
description:
The Iron Forge﻿ is a single map for Heretic, created by Xaser (architecture/layout) and me (thing placement). It plays in the E2M1 slot and requires ZDoom/GZDoom.

This map includes a variety of tweaks to Heretic's monsters and weapons to improve the pacing and balance of the game (especially to address that feeling you get when all the monsters are super weak but take forever to kill).

title: Brutal Complex
description: One summer day, a girl realizes the way to the dream world, a path of blood leading to a white space. What kind of world awaits beyond that? Brutal Complex has a cute, surreal, and aesthetic atmosphere.

title: Touhou Komakyou
description: Touhou Komakyou is a Famicom-style Touhou fangame by Saigomen's Boss (Yuureikurage).

title: Steel Titan
description: Take control of a powerful mech with over 40 unique weapons to fight your way through a confidential computer system and defeat the hackers inside.

title: FurryMUCK
description: One of the earliest examples of a game catered toward and made by members of the Furry fandom, 'FurryMUCK' is an online text-based roleplaying game which allows players to interact as their fursonas with others, as well as in various rooms and plazas.

title: Nancy Drew: Mystery of the Seven Keys
description: Get ready for a thrilling blend of adventure, mystery, and history in the latest installment of the award-winning Nancy Drew game series – Nancy Drew: Mystery of the Seven Keys! This all-new 3D game experience transports players to the heart of the historic city of Prague as they assume the role of famous detective Nancy Drew. Tasked with uncovering the truth behind the theft of a client’s heirloom necklace, players will navigate and sleuth through the beautiful city’s mysterious old-world environments. Encounter challenging puzzles, decode riddles, and discover clues entwined with medieval legends, alchemy, and lore. As the investigation deepens, Nancy uncovers a sinister web of cybercrime. Players must outwit devious suspects and use their detective skills to unravel a mystery threatening the city’s Bohemian heritage. Danger and intrigue at every turn add to the suspense as the criminals stop at nothing to prevent you from bringing the truth to light. Your investigative and critical thinking skills are crucial to solving the case and discovering the real mystery behind the legend of the seven keys!

title: Presentes de Natal
description:
Every year, on the date that commemorates the birth of Jesus, Santa Claus distributes presents to children to remind them of the greatest gift God has ever given us.

But this year, Santa has a little problem, and he'll need your help to fulfill his mission.

Embark on this fantastic adventure to save Christmas, full of challenges and excitement.

title: Darkness Road
description:
Darkness Road is an immersive survival horror and psychological horror game that will plunge players into a chilling and nightmarish experience. Set in the year 1996, within the foreboding town of Dar Al Hai located in the Arabian Gulf, this game offers a unique blend of suspenseful gameplay and captivating storytelling.

Playing from a third-person perspective, you assume the role of Hamdan, an ordinary 34-year-old resident of Dar Al Hai. Suddenly and inexplicably abducted, Hamdan finds himself trapped within a cursed place. With every ounce of his being, he strives to escape the clutches of this malevolent force, only to discover that his efforts seem to lead him deeper into the darkness.

title: Five Nights at Roblox 2 RePartyin
description: It’s been awhile ever since Roblox Chill Hangout was shutdown. Even after 2 shutdowns, Blox Entertainment still wants to continue making more places. With NPCs becoming smarter, Blox Entertainment want to move forward with this technology creating newer and better bots. Roblox Corp gives them one more chance. Roblox Party Area was born.

title: RobloxTale: Noob Fight
description: RobloxTale: Noob Fight is an Undertale fangame that puts the player in a custom boss battle against the Roblox noob.

title: Hentai Literature Club
description: Hentai Literature Club is an 18+ fanmade visual novel based on Doki Doki Literature Club.

title: Fort Solis: Terra Edition
description:
Fort Solis is a riveting story-driven thriller on the Red Planet.

The Terra Edition includes:
- Fort Solis the game
- Fort Solis Extras (Artbook & OST)

title: The Lost Glitches
description: The Lost Glitches is a Techno-Optimist set Trading Card Game with RPG progression. Head-to-head PvP battles require strategy, unique deck construction and clever wits to climb the ladder.

title: The Crackpet Show: Happy Tree Friends Edition
description: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot'em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear ‘em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!

title: Pirate Bloopers
description: Pirate Bloopers is an isometric action game in the style of "time survival" where you take a control of a ship in the dangerous waters of the Pirate Bay. The sea is calling!

title: Sweet Bakery Tycoon: Couch Co-op Edition
description:
This bundle includes base game, Expansion Pack #2 and Multiplayer Mode with:

• 15 new levels and 7 new achievements
• local multiplayer gameplay mode, allowing players to team up and play together. It adds a new layer of excitement and replayability to the game, while providing a fun and engaging experience for players to enjoy with friends and family.

title: Mr. Hibbl: The Lost Levels
description:
In Mr. Hibbl: Lost Levels we have released lost levels that send Mr. Hibbl on a whole new journey! Join our brave hero on an exciting adventure through mysterious worlds long forgotten.
Explore mysterious environments, face tricky challenges and overcome exciting traps as you explore the lost levels.
Immerse yourself in a unique gameplay experience that features gripping action and surprising twists.
Are you ready to face this unknown challenge and join Mr. Hibbl on his new journey?
Good luck and may your adventure begin!

title: ATV Monster Racing Simulator Rally Cross
description: Are you ready for the ultimate ATV off-road racing adventure?

title: Crime Zone
description:
Enter the Crime Zone. Move it, Move it. Catch the perps. You are drawn to a mysterious hotel. You are repeatedly drawn to this mysterious hotel. Protect And Serve. It's just another day in the Crime Zone.

Originally released August 2011 for Ludum Dare. Made in Adventure Game Studio.

title: Der Pfad des Pinguins
description:
You wake up in a snow-covered landscape and can't remember anything. You have to find out how you got to this place and survive. On your journey you meet penguins who confront you with a mysterious disease. Can you help the penguins?

This is a RPG Adventure Game!

title: Internet Cafe Creator
description: Internet Cafe Creator is a new type of gameplay in the internet cafe game series. Build, expand, buy computers, hire staff, fight off bandits - all this wait you in this great game!

title: RoboHunters
description: Top-down 3D action shooter. Fight against swarms of rogue AI machines and survive as long as you can!

title: Validus Mortis
description: Validus Mortis is a 2D platformer in fantasy style. To stop the evil wizards of taking control of the land. explore the stage with your hero knight and find items to progress forward. Slay monsters and gain experience and new spells.

title: The Queen's Quest
description: In this top-down adventure, you are a bee on a quest to find the legendary Flower of Life. Along the way, you'll befriend allies with powers who help you solve puzzles, battle fierce enemies and overcome epic challenges. Explore four unique worlds and unravel the hidden mysteries of this realm.

title: Never Ending Nightmare
description: Life has been tough for you after the tragic incident with your parents. Your way of coping has been through reliving all the good memories with them, but all the memories had a dark turn this time... will you be able to figure out why?

title: Arrow a Row
description: Arrow a row is a game in which you shoot arrows (of course) in a row! or maybe two rows! (maybe three?) Choose your power-ups and defeat the Boss.

title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk: Base & Jay
description: Two new writers, Base and Jay, are coming in from out of town to support the BRC crew.

title: Attenborough's Antarctic: An Exploration of Life in the Freezer
description:
This is a program of exploration and discovery with David Attenborough as your guide. Go wherever your fancy takes you, and experience the savageness, beauty and abundance of life in the coldest place on Earth.
Welcome to the South Pole and the surrounding area, one of the most extraordinary places on our planet. In this richly illustrated title, you can investigate the Antarctic terrain, its seasons and the animals that live there.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Trident of Power
description: The Trident of Power is a Zelda fangame developed by Pizus, under RPG Maker 2003. It offers a very complete experience with both battles and puzzles and a complete storyline taking place in both Hyrule and the neighboring country of Tylistem. The game is available in both Spanish and English

title: Notes of the Outskirts
description:
Close future. Rumors say megacorps are getting mad over a possible treasure. Bandits, mercenaries and opportunistic merchants are showing up, and of course you're too. Whatever it is, you're determined to find it and sell it to whoever will propose the best price. That's where the adventure begins.

Note of the outskirts is a classic party-based role playing game in the vein of titles such as the original Wasteland.

title: Discovering Endangered Wildlife
description: An interactive program endorsed by David Bellamy, designed to help children and parents learn about animals and wildlife in danger of becoming extinct.

title: Titan 2
description: Titan 2 is a ten-level Doom II episode mod, created by Jesper Krag Rasmussen (Ixnatifual) and released on January 21, 2009. Built for GZDoom, it is the sequel to 2004's Titan and follows the protagonist's attempts to escape Hell and return to the moonbase. It once again features several custom enemies as well as a new weapon, the minigun.

title: 15 Years a Doomer
description: 15 Years a Doomer was a mapping contest held from March 22 to March 29, 2021. The event was organized by James Paddock (Jimmy) to celebrate his 15th year anniversary in the Doom community.

title: The Walking Dead: Destinies
description: Begin your journey as Rick Grimes, waking alone in a hospital surrounded by the dead. Assemble allies and fight your way through the walker apocalypse across iconic locations from The Walking Dead, including Atlanta, the Greene family farm, the prison, and Woodbury. In crucial choice-driven moments, you’ll forever shape the destiny of your team of characters from the series. Heroes and villains, living and dead – it’s up to you to decide whether to stay the course of history or forge your own path through the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

title: Maou Shoujo Eri
description:
Created in Wolf RPG Editor by yako, this is a puzzle game where the player must navigate dungeons, evading enemies and traps in order to save a kidnapped girl from the Evil Lord. The objective is to reach the end of every map before a timer runs out. The player character can destroy any enemy just by body slamming it into oblivion at the cost of HP equal to the level of the enemy. It is also possible to restore 30 HP with the press of a button in exchange for 1 second on the timer.

The player must find the most optimal route in every map, managing health and trying to find all the secrets hidden in the game, while still reaching the exit point of the map on time.

title: CyberGroove
description: CyberGroove is one of the oldest known DDR clones released for PCs. In Taiwan, it was released as an "upgrade" to Dance 2000.

title: Arctic Outpost
description: The map was designed to be SP only, for GZDoom (works fine in 3.3.1) and so jumping, crouching and freelook is allowed, the arctic setting was originally inspired by 'The Thing', however it soon evolved into a more traditional doom map. This was a submission for the Vinesauce Mapping Contest II.

title: Spidersilk
description: A dungeon map with a strange layout. Skill 3 & 4 are linear while skill 2 (marked especially so you can immediately see there's an alternate game mode) is a mad dash for supplies. Some monster behaviour has been changed!

title: En Campaña
description: One last map before my surgery for scoliosis. This one's a small limit-removing stroll. Only 94 monsters. It should take you no more than 7 or 8 minutes to beat on your first go.

title: Stimulants
description: A small compilation consisting of 5 speedmaps, each playable from pistol start and involving challenging gameplay scenarios.

title: Sun Lotion On My Curvy Asscheeks
description:
Sun Lotion On My Curvy Asscheeks is a 5-map episode for the Supercharge gameplay mod. The maps are laidback and quick, with the episode taking no more than 30 minutes. Take a shot of that late summer heat if you didn't get enough sun somehow.
Difficulties supported. Co-op has 4 spawn points but no additional enemies or items

title: Bloodicide
description: Bloodicide is a 5 level mapset for GZDoom (4.0.0). This latest build now features @Tango's Supercharge (v1.3) gameplay mod. The mapset and mod are packaged as a single pk3, so you don't need to load the mod separately to play.

title: Moving
description:
Your name is Jay, you've had a long day, and now it's time to move.

In this WAD, you clear out an apartment while listening to somebody on the phone.
Your only task is to move objects. There is no horror element, no secret ARG, you can't even die or fail.
It's a short, relaxing experience throughout. Takes 15-20 minutes to complete.

Features excellent voice acting, custom music, and quite possibly the cutest Doomcute that you've ever seen.
Closed captions are also included, so you can play the game without sound if needed (though sound is recommended).

Inspired by the house cleaning section from "The Beginner's Guide", as well as games like "What Remains of Edith Finch" and "Gone Home". If you're a fan of Walking Simulators, you'll feel right at home. If not, there's probably little to win you over. ﻿

title: Valorant : Antivax Addition
description: Valorant is an 8(7 + 1 Bonus) map MBF21 episode based around that one other mod that a couple people played. The maps are built for high intensity with consistent flow, and are filled to the brim with custom content.

title: Baphomet's Satellite
description: Baphomet's Satellite (Important: play with complevel 11) is an adventure map in outer space. You'll have to explore and traverse some kind of space station built entirely from Hell's corrupted reality! Manage your ammo carefully and explore as much as you can. You can always turn around and look for supplies before engaging with the demons.

title: Persephone Volumes 1 to 3
description: This version of Persephone is a compilation of Volumes 1, 2 and 3. Volume 1 is an episode of 8 main maps, plus a secret level and a scripted "Cast and Crew" map, whilst Volume 2 is an episode of 10 playable maps and Volume 3 is 14 playable maps. Where necessary for compilation purposes, maps and resources have been tweaked or altered. MAP14 has had a game play overhaul from how it appeared in the Ten Community Project so that the co-op only part of it is also included in the single-player experience. Some minor fixes have been applied to the individual volumes in this compilation process.

title: Dracula Cha Cha
description: Inspired by Konami's Tomena Sanner, Dracula Cha Cha tells the festive adventures of everyone's favorite non-reflective aristocrat. Help the Count as he karate kicks snowmen, dances with Grinch Girls, plays rock-paper-scissors with reindeer, and much more!

title: The Final Pin
description:
"The Final Pin" is a full length story based game with voice acting and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
You'll need to use your investigative skills and survival instincts to navigate the treacherous world of the crow killer and uncover the truth behind the town's dark past.
Each step you take is a closer step into the darkness.

title: Playtime with Percy
description: Playtime with Percy is a traditional-styled FNaF fangame with the primary gameplay structure being revolved around The Pal Percy; a Tamagotchi-like toy. With the core gameplay loop being “Tasked Based / End at Your Own Pace” instead of the classic “Survive from 12AM to 6AM” formula.

title: Divergence
description: Explore a mysterious island with the help of a time manipulation device. Rewind and diverge from your current timeline to combat the ancient guardians and discover the secrets behind Titans.

title: Vine Mapping Contest 2016
description: The Vine Mapping Contest 2016 was an event organized by Joel "Vargskelethor" Johannson of the Vinesauce streaming team. The terms were simple: make a WAD with up to three maps, playable in ZDoom or GZDoom.

title: Doom Mapping Contest II: Hellectric Boogaloo
description: The Doom Mapping Contest II: Hellectric Boogaloo, in 2018, was the second event organized by Joel "Vargskelethor" Johannson of Vinesauce, the followup to Vine Mapping Contest 2016. The rules were to make a single map, for GZDoom, and to not use any copyrighted MP3 music that could cause DMCA issues when streamed.

title: World2D Re
description:
In this short game in a 2.5d world pass the levels and each level will face new challenges
increasingly difficult.

title: Darkness Flaw
description: This map was created to test my skills in vanilla mapping. I liked how results turned out and decided to submit it here. Map is short and quick and it shouldn't take too long to finish.

title: Cubic Worlds
description: Each map is independent and should be done from pistol start. ﻿Contains a bunch of new monsters and one new weapon (﻿all taken from various sources, nothing origin﻿﻿al yet.)

title: Greymood
description: I tried express my depressive feeling through grey, brown and white textures. Music choice was accident, which perfectly fitted in this kind of map. I recommend turn off infinite height, but it's not important.

title: MedEvil
description: Three small to medium-sized levels with a gothic castle theme. Balanced for pistol start, with difficulties implemented.

title: Deviled
description: This map was created for vinesauce mapping contest, which happened in 2018. It got renamed from "dual layered violence" to "deviled". This version is more improved and more detailed than my contest version.

title: Time Parallax: The Burial Vault
description: Originally created for Vinesauce contest 2, as it turned out later, the map was literally packed with bugs, even though it was generally passable.

title: Light Pollution
description: One big map with lots of enemies, but most of them are low health ones. Is very difficult on UV however, so maybe you will try HMP first. ﻿

title: Can't Run Frm Evil
description: These levels are the first four of them, and they are the bigger too. All maps can be finished starting with pistol only. Maps are hard, but difficult levels are implemented.

title: Next Move
description: Next Move is a VR platformer where all movement corresponds to the player's movement. Your ability to run, jump and climb will be put to the test on a journey into dreamy worlds filled with fantastic architecture. But to succeed, you must also fight off enemies and eventually even manipulate time.

title: Warlock The Bounty Hunter
description: A short byte-sized roguelike game where you play as a warlock taking bounties.

title: Rampage Agents
description: Rampage Agents is a VR game that fuses battle royale with multi-player action adventure games. Obtain powerful agents with unique powers and team up with your friends now!

title: Murder on Mainstreet
description: A commercially released port of Caper in the Castro with all LGBT content removed

title: Railroad Corporation: Competitive Spirit DLC
description: This DLC is a set of different sandbox missions featured with AI competitors. A special interactive mode is available for a relaxed and interesting long-time play.

title: Cursed Realms: Path Over The Abyss
description: Cursed Realms - Path Over The Abyss is a single-level PWAD for Doom II and the GZDoom source port. It was created by StormCatcher.77 in 2016 and uses the music track "Claustrophobia" by Vladislav Baymurzin (ClumsyDoomer) from the Plutonia MIDI Pack. It was awarded third place in the Vine Mapping Contest 2016.

title: Shovelware Adventure!
description: Welcome to Shovelware Adventure! This is a 100% vanilla compatible wad & dehacked file for DOOM II. This map is full of bloody battle arenas and slimy passageways! There are many secrets to discover and several paths to reach the exit. This map was designed with a high quality but oldschool 90's style in mind, the little gems with quirky graphic edits that you find on those old discs among 1000 random wadfiles - hence the name Shovelware Adventure. It's meant to feel like a mini-episode despite being just one lone map. The objective is to pump rockets into the core and blow the place up!

title: Ale & Aftercare
description:
Even heroes need somewhere to rest their heads. That's where the Aftercare Inn comes in! Situated between all the most dangerous areas in the realm, it serves as the common gathering place for adventurers to rest and recuperate.

Take on the role of the Innkeeper, the gender-customizable proprietor of the Aftercare Inn, as they provide sustenance and satisfaction to all kinds of adventurers. They all need a roof over their head, a hot bowl of porridge, and sometimes a little bit more... and the innkeeper is happy to help!

Enjoy an engaging, sex-positive, and LGBTQ-friendly fantasy story about polyamory, gentle domination, and the fulfilling ways sexuality can contribute to our lives.

Choose your pronouns, anatomy, and name to create an experience tailored to you. The dialogue and sex scenes all adjust to match your chosen identity!

Enjoy fully-illustrated sex scenes with five unique characters, all themed around gentle domination and affirming, caring sex. And if that's not your speed, turn explicit content off in the options to enjoy the story without the sexy parts!

title: Steep Town
description: A map for Doom 2 that was submitted to the Vinesauce Doom level contest. This version is much more fleshed out though.

title: Distribution Center
description: Distribution Center is a single-level PWAD for Doom II using the GZDoom source port. It was designed by Blake Collins (Rayzik) and uses the music track "The Imp's Song" by Robert Prince. Distribution Center was originally created in 2016 for the Vine Mapping Contest 2016, where it went on to win first place, and was publicly released in 2017.

title: 4 Seasons of Doom
description: 4 maps themed after each one of the 4 seasons.

title: Soundless Mound
description: Soundless Mound is a single-level PK7 for Doom II using the GZDoom source port. It was designed by Marisa Lago in 2018 and is inspired by the Silent Hill series of survival horror games. In the Doom Mapping Contest II: Hellectric Boogaloo, it was awarded first place, and it received further updates via the author's GitHub repository.

title: Redundancy
description: A 32 map wad made during the month of october for NaNoWADMo 2019, using only textures and monsters from doom2. Every map has at least 2 of each key that appears on it, same for weapons, also each map has 2 exits.

title: Blood and Bones: A Skeleton Scorned
description:
You were but broken bones and brawny blood. Yet your tomb stirs, and here you stand!

This was a map created for the Vinesauce Mapping Contest 2016. It has a standalone release now. It's mostly unchanged from the one submitted to the contest, the only difference is it has a titlepic this time around.

title: Oscillation
description: 9 boom compatible maps of increasing difficulty

title: Hyperforma: Lost Archives - Fragment I
description:
Embark on an immersive journey and get lost archives with a new DLC Lost Archives — Fragment I.

This DLC includes 30 additional levels. Every 10 new levels refer to specific bosses with all their associated design and mechanics.

Features:

・10 new levels in Oracle
・10 new levels in Guardian
・10 new levels in Ghost
・New mechanics to activate the skills

Secrets of the vanished civilization await to be unveiled!

title: Hyperforma: Lost Archives - Fragment II
description:
Delve deeper into the Ancient Network with a new DLC Lost Archives — Fragment II.

This DLC includes 30 additional levels. Every 10 new levels refer to specific bosses with all their associated design and mechanics.

Features:

10 new levels in Joker
10 new levels in Warrior
10 new levels in Mother

Uncover the truth of Hyperforma!

title: Luck Breaker
description: In Luck Breaker, your task is to determine the number of dice to remove using the dice.

title: Candle Fire Run!
description:
Candle Fire Run! is an exciting arcade game where players take on the role of a candle and embark on an exciting adventure, trying not to burn out and reach the finish line.

Your goal is to complete a series of levels while collecting power-ups to increase your size and extend your burning time.

title: The Nightmare: Serial Killers
description: An astute killer infiltrates the dreams of his victims, sowing mental chaos until their death. Five days, five victims and multiple alternative endings.

title: Eroblast: Passion Edition
description:
In this bundle you get content from the base game and Passion Pack which includes:
- 21 romanceable women to meet
- 120+ hot pics to unlock
- over 30 routes to go with each waifu, with between 5.000 to 10.000 words each
- 280 levels to beat
- 25+ hours of gameplay so get ready for flirting and pics!

title: Word Search Puzzle: Find the Words!
description: Word Search is a classic word puzzle to search for words! Spell the words and the word puzzles will be completed!

title: Zombie Outbreak: Survival in Ancient Egyptian
description: Immerse yourself in ancient Egypt as you've never seen it before: Ravaged by a zombie apocalypse. Your survival depends on every choice you make in this engrossing horror game.

title: Hentai World: Complete Edition
description:
Sink into the familiar anime art style of Hentai World. Progress through the story by solving all puzzles. These lovely girls will keep you company.

In this bundle, you will see student Sayuri and Rose in her new feline look.

title: Fashion Friends: Super Edition
description: This bundle includes base game and Special Levels with additional levels! New levels! New adventures! New fun!

title: Eroblast: Spicy Edition
description:
In this bundle you get content from the base game and Spicy Pack which includes:
- 21 romanceable women to meet
- 120+ hot pics to unlock
- over 30 routes to go with each waifu, with between 5.000 to 10.000 words each
- 280 levels to beat
- 25+ hours of gameplay so get ready for flirting and pics!

title: Infinity Strash: Dragon Quest - The Adventure of Dai: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Base Game
- Legendary Mage - Popp Outfit
- Legendary Priest and Legendary Martial Artist - Maam Outfits
- Legendary Swordsman and Legendary Warrior - Hyunckel Outfits

title: Stack Ball Run!
description: Stack Ball Run! is a 3D arcade game where you smash, push and jump over rotating spiral platforms to get to the end.

title: Trainz Plus: Model Trainz - UZ-Gbox
description: It is a mini model railroad with a track gauge of 1520mm. The map is highly detailed and has a good variety of scenery. Includes 2 small sessions with passenger trains.

title: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2024
description: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2023=4 puts you in the role of head coach for your favorite college football team. Recruit, gameplan and make the right calls on the field to lead your team to the top of the ranks and the college football championship.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Model Trainz - UZ-Gbox
description: It is a mini model railroad with a track gauge of 1520mm. The map is highly detailed and has a good variety of scenery. Includes 2 small sessions with passenger trains.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: Model Trainz - UZ-Gbox
description: It is a mini model railroad with a track gauge of 1520mm. The map is highly detailed and has a good variety of scenery. Includes 2 small sessions with passenger trains.

title: Gorathar
description:
Embark on an adventure like no other with Gorathar, an innovative rogue-like deckbuilder game that combines engaging gameplay and an optional fitness integration.

Step into the shoes of Hoodin, an intrepid explorer and scientist who dives into a magical cave system - the only place in the world where magic exists. Your goal? To explore, challenge the cave's mysteries, and see how far you can progress without meeting your end.

In Gorathar, strategy is key. With a starting deck of action cards, every card you play is a step closer to defeating the cave's denizens and uncovering its secrets. After each successful encounter, reap rewards to enhance your gameplay and further your journey.

title: 8bit Doves
description:
Trapped in a VR world powered by an ancient handheld device, you are forced to endlessly dream in a pixel world of just 4 colours! Doves have taken roost in your prison and though you don’t know it they are the key to your survival. The Doves subconsciously inspire dreams of flight, so take to the skies through the mazes of your imagination and find the exit.

Intuitive two button gameplay is all you need to steer your way through the sky. Fly through each stage and reach the exit. Get doves to follow you for extra bonus bragging rights on Game Center and Social Networking stuff. If walls aren’t enough challenge you may enjoy the variety of traps that get rapidly added including, moving walls, speed boost zones, growing walls and more!

title: Clue Kaguya-sama: Love is War
description: Clue style game inspired by the anime Kaguya-sama Love is War.

title: Hentai Project
description: Uncover the heroines' stories, solve puzzles, and immerse yourself in the beauty of anime images.

title: Word Dungeons
description: Word Dungeons borrows attitude from dark and gritty RPGs, and adds these elements to a word game. Solve words, collect loot, power up your runes and discover the mysteries that lay within the dungeon. Can you escape?

title: Space Interceptor
description:
Space Interceptor is an Asteroids tpye of game where you have to avoid not only asteroids but also aliens.

'Space Interceptor: Deluxe Edition' is the name for the registered version, which unlocks more levels and enemies.

title: Super Concentration
description:
Super Concentration is a memory game in which the player has to match pairs of cards in order to clear the deck and win the game.

The shareware version only includes level 1 and 2, the registered version unlocks the rest of the game.

title: Dreaming in the Mountains
description: A dream and a question The game tells the story of a climber who enters a dream The player, as an abstract subject in the dream, experiences various dream slices hope you get something out of this

title: Gnostic: Survivors
description: Gnostic: Survivors is a survivor style 3rd person co-op game where you pick your weapon, level up to unlock legendary upgrades and survive the never ending horde of enemies.

title: Room 817
description: Welcome to one of the scariest old-school horror games. Here, you're not the predator, but the prey. Any mistake will cost you your life. Hide, solve puzzles, explore, and embrace the inevitable terror. The Ancient horror lurks, awaiting you. Based on true events.

title: Nemesis: The Final Challenge
description:
Amstrad CPC port of Gradius.

You are the last hope of the gentle people of Gradius. You've just lifted off to confront the all-out attack of the amoeboid Bacterions. Your hyper-space fighter is armed with the greatest arsenal in the galaxy. Air-to-surface and double beam laser cannons for incredible firepower. Powerful force fields for protection. Time and space warps for fleeing the dimension. You'll need it all just to survive. Because at the heart of the Bacterion Empire lies the Xaerous Superfortress - the nerve center of the all-knowing, all-seeing Bacterion Bio-Computer. It's a duel to the death, while the entire galaxy watches, waits, and hopes!

title: Adventures With Oslo: World of Water
description:
Adventures with Oslo: World of Water is the follow-up to Adventures with Oslo: Tools and Gadgets and covers information about water. In comparison to its predecessor, the game features less, but more involved sections:

Winston and the Great Water Cycle Story: This is a linear novel which tells the story of Winston, the water molecule. Within the text are multiple icons which lead to supplemental scientific information, animations and videos.

Oslo's Coloring Book:A drawing program which can be used for own creations or coloring included pictures.

Oslo's WaterWorks BoardGame: A virtual board game. First the player chooses the aggregate phase of the playing stone which means either 0, 1 or 2 advances on the board. The second step is clicking the spinning button which gives two randomly generated numbers: one of them can be chosen and the number is added to the number of moves which are executed afterwards. Depending on the field the player lands on, special effects may take place: receiving clams or having the aggregate phase locked for the next move. The goal is to collect as many clamps before the first player reaches the end of the road.

In addition there are a few short animations which can be triggered in the main menu.

title: H2O: High speed Boat Racing
description:
Get ready to race the waves in H2O, a thrilling new genre of watercraft racing games! Immerse yourself in the realistic, high-speed world of aquatic racing, complete with meticulously designed physics and dynamics to simulate the real-life feel of water navigation.

Jump into your virtual watercraft and feel the adrenaline rush as you zoom across lakes, rivers, oceans, and even fantastical settings like futuristic water cities. Whether you're a fan of boats, jet skis, or other aquatic vehicles, H2O has something for everyone.

Join the exhilarating world of H2O today. Embrace the thrill of high-speed racing combined with the unique challenges of water navigation.

It's time to make a splash with H2O: High-Speed Water Racing Game!!

title: Amanda Stories
description: Amanda Stories was the one of the very first "point-and-click" programs for kids. Not only is there a strong narrative--in ten separate stories Inigo explores his house, his dream, the outside world, and Your Faithful Camel ventures as far afield as the North Pole--but where you click actually determines the course of the story. As children (ages 3 and up) move intuitively through one adventure after another, the combination of color animations, great sound effects, original music, and a variety of endings challenges and delights them.

title: Island Casino
description: Check-in to the El San Juan Hotel and Casino and hit the tables for 25 of the world's most popular casino games! Or learn to play with step-by-step, easy-to-understand instruction. Brilliant graphics and sophisticated gameplay put you right in the center of the non-stop casino action, and let you feel the thrill of hitting it big with the most complete and authentic gambling experience available on CD-ROM. It's your Virtual Vacation- and it's only a mouse-click away- Island Casino!

title: Evocation: Beyond the Dream
description: In this adventure game the player controls the magician trainee Eto who is sick of the training methods of his master Pan. So he secretly studies in his master's library and challenges Pan to a duel which Eto surprisingly wins. But his victory doesn't last long. After waking up one morning Eto finds himself on a small island which only contains two doors and a small marble ball. Behind the doors are the scenarios of the game, the first leads into the house of an astronomer interested in Far Eastern mysticism. The controls are simple: With the mouse the player moves through the rendered backgrounds. When taking a object he drag & drops the item into his inventory, visa versa for using a item in the game world. The puzzles are logic based riddles similar to Myst.

title: Evocation 2: The Dream
description: "There are two sides to go" the teacher said - "I know the right way for your thoughts." This adventure has hundreds of items and dozens of locations made with 3D modeling techniques, 22/44 kHz soundtrack, sound effects, text and instructions. An adventure through the centuries, the discovery of an enchanted world, the secret keys of a dream.

title: Valiant Rooster
description: Valiant Rooster is a JRPG wich follows the journey of a rooster, Gianni Matragrano, search of his father, going through different dangers and obstacles and discovering horizons that he had not dared to explore before.

title: Ghostrunner II: Brutal Edition
description:
Ghostrunner II is a hardcore FPP slasher set in a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world. Featuring everything fans loved about Ghostrunner plus incredible boss fights, new interactive story, thrilling motorbike levels, improved skills, and more cyber ninja action.

Ghostrunner 2 Brutal Edition Includes:
- Ghostrunner 2 Game
- Ahriman's Katana Sword and Hand Skin
- Modern Energy Sword and Hand Skin
- Molten Blade Sword and Hand Skin
- Gothic Blue Sword and Hand Skin
- Hand Hologram with Username
- Aqua Animated Sword and Hand Skin
- Design 24A Motorcycle Skin
- Ghostrunner 2 Season Pass

title: Ghostrunner II: Deluxe Edition
description:
Ghostrunner II is a hardcore FPP slasher set in a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world. Featuring everything fans loved about Ghostrunner plus incredible boss fights, new interactive story, thrilling motorbike levels, improved skills, and more cyber ninja action.

Ghostrunner II Deluxe Edition Includes:
- Ghostrunner II Base Game
- Ahriman's Katana Sword and Skin
- Modern Energy Sword and Hand Skin
- Molten Blade Sword and Hand Skin
- Gothic Blue Sword and Hand Skin
- Hand Hologram with Username

title: Star of Providence
description:
Star of Providence is a consolidated version of Monolith that integrates the DLC, Relics of the Past, into the base game.

Star of Providence is a top down action shooter with procedurally generated elements. Explore a progression of floors as you make your way into the depths of the facility, encountering increasingly deadly enemies, fantastic weapons, upgrades, choices and revelations as you venture deeper towards a great and calamitous power.

title: Chilled Chicken
description: A map made by 8 ppl thru discord. 500 monsters on UV but really it sounds longer than it is - you can probably bang it out in a half hour.

title: Forbidden Quake OST Liner Notes
description: Break into a secret, mysterious Zenimax storage facility and retrieve American McGee's and John Carmack's memories of the Quake soundtrack! They might be corporate property, but Doomguy finds a way... ﻿

title: Doggy
description: Off-beat hell levels with lots of heavy weapons usage and Spidey vs Cybie showdowns

title: Testing Pool
description:
A gothic cell with positive gameplay. You can fire the rocket launcher at stuff and pick your own route through the level.
Completionists can visit an optional extra fight which is a little tougher than the rest of the map.

Built with Eternity 4.2 in mind; If you use Eternity you get MOD music and extra text if you leave via the secret exit. but the map itself is perfectly Boom compatible.

title: The Ledge
description: Created for Doom 2, any limit removing port will do. No additional resources required, as this map (Map 20) intends to make the most of Doom 2's stock resources to create its aesthetic.

title: Jägermörder 2: Terra Nova
description: Jägermörder 2: Terra Nova is a single-level PWAD created by Derek MacDonald (Afterglow). It uses an unnamed music track by Jeremy Doyle from Requiem MAP15 and is the sequel to Jägermörder 1: Chemical Lab.

title: Demonic Libido
description: This is the first map I've ever released, it's a straight-forward blowthrough, not too difficult and it offers around 15 to 20 minutes of gameplay...maybe less for skilled players.

title: The Beginning of the End (part 1)
description: The Beginning of the End (part 1) is a two-episode PWAD for Doom. It was created by Emil Brundage (NaturalTvventy) in 1997.

title: Little Lamb
description:
You find yourself in the middle of a forest talking to someone you don't know?
A story reminiscent of Little Red Riding Hood although something has gone horribly wrong...

title: Shades of Azure
description: This is a mapset with the following traits/gimmicks/whatever; All map titles are one word and end on the letter T, except for MAP32. The maps are primarily coated in blue, using textures from 32in24-15tex & OTEX. Some maps might have a semi-speedmap feel to them, with sparse detailing. Some maps are easy, some are hard; but all except two of them can be knocked out in less than 15-20 minutes.

title: Dawn of the Dead
description: Dawn of the Dead is a modification for Men Of War: Assault Squad 2 and Call to Arms: Gates of Hell games. The main plot of the modification is based on fictional zombie apocalypse that began in the United States in the early 1990s.

title: The Darkening: Episode 1
description: The Darkening Episode 1: The Nameless Project is a Doom II megawad containing twenty-two maps, split equally between single player/coop and deathmatch.

title: The Darkening: Episode 2
description: The Darkening Episode 2 is the 2000 sequel to 1998's The Darkening. This new episode features twenty-four levels split equally between single player and deathmatch modes. It was initially released on March 8, 2000 with a soundtrack primarily composed by Peter Tomaselli (Kniggit).

title: Tarnsman's Projectile Hell
description: Tarnsman's Projectile Hell, also known as TPH 12.3: Part 1A - The Prequel to Part B Galaxy's Brink!! The Super Incredible Bulgarian Necromancer of the East!! Fight for the Combined Justice of the Planet Sphere - Earth!! is a four episode megawad released in May 2021 by Richard Frei (Tarnsman). The mod is split between four episodes set in a wide variety of locales, and includes a completely overhauled arsenal, many new enemies, and several modifications to already existing ones.

title: Project: Kate
description: Project: Kate is a three-level PK3 for GZDoom by James Paddock. The wad is a tribute to fallen Doom community member Kate Fox, who was a close friend of Jimmy's. The first two levels are birthday gift maps by Jimmy for Kate, while the third was made after her passing in tribute, originally for Abyssal Speedmapping Session 32 and revised for this PK3.

title: Suitcase of Gor
description: Suitcase of Gor is a megawad built for Doom II and Boom-compatible source ports, created by Richard Frei (Tarnsman). It is a collection of the first maps Tarnsman ever made, largely inspired by their Doom II originals (and sharing the same names) but also consisting of other influences, and with a new soundtrack. The project was originally titled Doom II Redux, and a demo was released in 2011, which received an honorable mention at the 2011 Cacowards. The last version of Suitcase of Gor released was in 2013, containing 22 maps, with the full 32-map version never materializing.

title: Goodwad
description: GOODWAD is a MBF21-compatible megawad by Emma Essex (msx2plus). It is a compilation of speedmaps of various types, including slaughter maps, platforming maps, joke maps, and more experimental pieces.

title: The Mountaineer
description: The Mountaineer is a set of 5 MBF21 (-complevel 21) maps depicting a journey to the top of an uncharted mountain. A gift to MIDI connoisseur and good friend @Jimmy, commemorating his 31st birthday.

title: Ad Mortem
description: Ad Mortem is a brutal multiplayer medieval Melee Slasher set in the corrupted world of Contrara. You play as a Vessel, a byproduct of the death of the Old Gods. Your hollow soul prevents your passage into the afterlife, binding you to this world. Through this eternal struggle, you will engage in team-based PvP combat against other Vessels upon the ravaged battlefields of the two warring factions; the Palisadean and the Hantrii. Fight with your allies, slay monsters and men, and delve into the dungeons of the Deities in a mad quest of retribution and power.

title: RPG Workshop Max 2
description: This is an updated version of RPG Max that includes a folder with over 25 great clipart images - including heros, backgrounds, friends and foes. The battle graphics have been improved, along with a cleaner layout, and several bugs have been fixed from previous versions. This is still novelty software, though, and probably could not be used to create a commercial game. This should be used as a practice tool for those starting off in game programming.

title: The Legend of Peks
description: The Legend of Peks is a game made using RPG maker MZ in under 100 hours. For the streamer IHasPeks.

title: Fi-Knight Kingdom
description: Challenge your friends in this Local Multiplayer RPG Board Game hybrid. Choose a starting class that fits your playstyle. Encounter lots of enemies, fight strong boss monsters and collect gold to buy powerful dice and pieces of equipment to get the upper hand on your opponents.

title: Myths of Rules
description: This is a text-based adventure puzzle game, where you must struggle to survive in a world filled with ghosts and urban legends. While collecting clues, you'll uncover the truth behind the world and find the way out. The game features a wealth of levels, unconventional rules, and a touch of horror.

title: DomiNoo
description: Unleash your creativity and explore endless possibilities in our immersive sandbox game! Knock down dominos, play with different toys, and customize your world. With multiplayer mode and sharing features, the fun never ends.

title: UFindo
description: Are you ready to find the difference? Then quickly run after the magnifying glass and get ready to spot the differences in an exciting puzzle game!

title: Icarus: Cactus Outpost
description: Whitewater rapids, picturesque archways and sand dunes provide an idyllic setting to build your dream Desert base.

title: Icarus: Holdfast Outpost
description: Choose one of several islands in a large archipelago lake to build your perfect island retreat by (or on) the water.

title: Icarus: Iceholm Outpost
description: High in the mountains, on terraced cliffs or a large flat frozen lake give you a range of altitudes in which to build your perfect winter retreat.

title: Icarus: Tecton Outpost
description: The large oasis, precarious cliffs or near the twin waterfalls gives you an abundance of interesting locations to build your desert refuge on this outpost map.

title: Icarus: Everbark Outpost
description: A Waterfall, underwater caves and a picturesque lake are the highlights of this lush forest environment to build your dream base surrounded by nature.

title: Solar Rally
description:
Touch the screen to cast shadows over leading rally cars and stop them from colliding.
Clouds slowing down your progress? Swipe them away.
Get as many cars to the exits as you can to show off your high score with friends!
Solar Rally is best played on iPad devices.
Take Solar Rally to the next level by downloading the Leap Motion compatible PC version from our website and cast shadows with your hands!

title: Street Fighter V: Dan Hibiki
description: This DLC adds Dan Hibiki as a fighter.

title: Super Crazy Guitar Maniac Deluxe 3
description: The super crazy guitar maniac returns with 14 new songs to master and 10 awesome guitars to choose from!

title: The Paradixion: Laboratory
