This is an Eternity Engine map with portals and some special effects.
The gameplay is classic: no new monsters or weapons, no jumping. Freelook is not needed or recommended.

title: Bifrost
description: Single map based on the idea of rainbow bridges.
Short, if a bit tricky, map with nothing but neon skyscrapers, transparent platforms and setpiece fights.

title: Enigma of Sector Sigma
description: 5-map wad. Pistol starts are the intended experience, but continuous playthroughs are supported too.

title: Bourgeois Megawad
description: Bourgeois Megawad, also known as Bourgeois Deathmatch, is a 30-map vanilla and Unity compatible megawad created in 2021 by Decay, Adam Post (Doomkid), and Razgriz. All of the maps are playable in singleplayer, co-op and deathmatch.

title: Ichinichi
description:
This is my second 32-map solo project (remember KINDa.wad?)!
The gameplay is completely vanilla, using limit-removing ports and contains only stock textures and music. The majority of maps are small to medium sized with differing themes and pace.

title: Crusader
description: Stand alone against the endless horde. In this medieval FPS roguelike, defend your princess against waves of whimsical monsters. Slay, earn coin and gems, upgrade your power with the mystery mushroom, and become a legendary Crusader. How long can you survive, brave knight?

title: Lost Civilization 2
description: 7 maps with ending scene and a secret map.The gameplay is mainly exploration with small fights here and there. More shooting in the end. You can solve some puzzles or not, those are mostly optional. Gameplay is easygoing. Nothing for Doom-veterans (easy). Has a little scarier moments to spice things up.

title: 12 pm Break
description: 12 pm Break drops players into a chaotic lunch-hour showdown known as “Toonie Tuesday.” You’re not just taking a break—you’re fighting through it. With fast-paced action across multiple maps, players battle through office-themed arenas, cafeteria shootouts, and surreal corporate environments. The game blends satire and stylized violence with a tongue-in-cheek tone.

title: Lunacy
description: Lunacy is a wild journey to the moon and back! Pineapple Under the Sea Speedmapping Series welcomes back our hero from Mapping at Warpspeed, Zorglo Blaskowicz IX, on another Skillsaw-inspired quest to defeat the enemy aliens encroaching on the cheese production facilities of Luna, and to ingest as much dairy as possible.

title: Hovercab Station
description: A bit of a spiritual successor to my 2022 wad, Herschel Spaceport. Blast your way through demons from Hell in a rundown city block. The action takes place up top on the streets, in a (hover!) train station, and in the water filtration system below.

title: Herschel Spaceport
description: Here's a short techbase map set in Herschel Crater, on Saturn's moon, Mimas. The UAC has set up a space colony overrun by demons. What could the UAC have hidden under the Miman soil to warrant such an invasion?

title: Tyrant
description: 5-map wad, Egyptian-themed. Pistol-starts are recommended, but not necessary.

title: Never
description: NEVER uses mostly vanilla assets to create an atmosphere that I think you'll find unique and oppressive (but in a fun way). There is some old-school DEHACKED nonsense to keep it fresh.

title: Doomkid's Mega!
description: A set of 8 classic style Doom II levels. There's some minor DeHackEd use and a few custom sprites, but nothing too crazy.

title: Jamal Jones: In Judgment of Evil
description: Jamal Jones Trilogy is a compilation of levels created during the Doomkid's 20 Years Mapping Contest held at the Doomworld Forums. This was a community project dedicated to Doomkid's 20th anniversary as a mapper.

title: Jamal Jones: One Man Jury!
description: Jamal Jones Trilogy is a compilation of levels created during the Doomkid's 20 Years Mapping Contest held at the Doomworld Forums. This was a community project dedicated to Doomkid's 20th anniversary as a mapper.

title: Jamal Jones: Hell's Executioner
description: "Jamal Jones: Hell's Executioner" is the third and final episode of the Jamal Jones Trilogy, a community-driven megawad for Doom II created during Doomkid’s 20 Years Mapping Contest. Featuring 20 maps plus 2 secret levels, this episode follows Jamal Jones as he battles through hellish landscapes to stop an alien scourge infecting humanity. The game includes custom monsters, upgraded weapons, and a gritty sci-fi backstory.

title: Organ of Eden
description: The tenth entry within Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N. is preceded by a report of a parasitic mind virus and a biostratigraphic diagram. A medical team surrounds the player as gore begins to pile around them.

title: Day 11
description: The 11th link in the Haunted PS1 C.H.A.I.N. is extremely anomalous and is known to cause psychosis and paranoia among the staff who play it or otherwise come in contact with it. They are typically then reported either missing or dead. There is no known way to handle this game safely.

title: Avert Your Eyes
description: Link #12 in the Haunted PS1 C.H.A.I.N. is footage from a hiking trip in west Germany. The video quality is abhorrent for what should be a modern phone and the device itself is caked in ashes.

title: Column Dodger
description: For the 13th link in Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N. is a simple dodging game. Nearby metal objects are purported to migrate by a couple inches if the game is left on for a certain duration.

title: Specimen #14
description: Yet another untitled entry in Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N., it follows an unknown protagonist hounded by mysterious, eyeball-like creatures.

title: Echochrome
description: Experience echochrome originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Symphonia
description: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.

title: Specimen 15
description: Mysterious disembodied eyes chase you in this link of Haunted PS1's C.H.A.I.N..
Appropriately titled 16, this C.H.A.I.N. link may or may not be linked to an incident of occult Welsh origin.

title: Vale
description: Fight your way to dominion over the universe in this Shoot Em Up game based on the book! On the planet Vale, known for its extreme cold and endless snowfields, the story follows young Talen Esko and his sister Salla, whose family, the Esko clan, is transferred to govern this icy world.

title: Ringleaders
description: Trust no one in this retrofuturistic, prohibition-inspired social deduction shooter.

title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
description: Study, relax, or get productive in the cozy world of Spirit City. Set the mood with lofi beats and soundscapes, customize your character and spirit pet, and use the productivity tools to help you stay on task. All while discovering cute hidden spirits and adding them to your spirit collection.

title: Donuts!
description: Drive, stunt, and deliver your way to saving your family's slowing donut business in this radical arcade driving/skateboarding adventure meets food delivery service!

title: Brocante Game: Blister Hunter
description: Brocante Game: Blister Hunter is a game based on the first two season of the french youtube serie Brocante Game. it's the first opus of a diptych followed by Brocante Game: Gabriel's Odyssey (2018).

title: Toxicity
description: Shades first ever released Quake 2 singleplayer level - only 25 years later!

title: Interception
description:
Interception is a vanilla-compatible megawad for DOOM II.
In the far distant future, you are part of a team of marines who are sent a distress signal from an archaeology site. Once you arrive, the rest of your team is killed by some nasty hell spawns. Now it's your job to stop the invasion, or die trying. Along the way, you explore ancient military bases, an underground necropolis, and Hell itself.

title: Interception II
description:
Destroy demons in 31 action-packed levels; Interception II is here.
This is a Doom II community megawad spanning three episodes with a secret level included.

title: DollHouse: Survive or Death
description: "for that child's future." "I must ...... I must to do this. The eight children who came to the mansion were waiting for a series of horrible dreams... A series of horrible nightmares... Who did this? and for what? And who did this for whom...? Only by entering the DollHouse can we find out.

title: Idle Transport Tycoon
description: Build platforms to transport people, increase your customer population by buying and merging houses. Advance through levels.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 10: Johnny
description: This allows the character "Johnny" to be used in-game.

title: Disciples of Varahces
description: Disciples of Varahces is a roguelike where you fight waves of increasingly stronger enemies, gathering items along the way to grow stronger yourself.

title: Meer's: Escape
description: Meer's: Escape is an island version of the classic city simulation. The game expands on some of the deep-rooted tropes of the city-building experience while introducing new gameplay elements to recognize the excitement and challenges of creating and maintaining a real city.

title: The Riftbreaker: Heart of the Swamp
description: Explore an entirely new area of Galatea 37 in this Story Campaign expansion for The Riftbreaker. Catalog new species. Craft new and unique weapons. Fight hordes of aliens, unlike anything you've seen before.

title: LumineNight
description: 'LumineNight' is a mystery adventure game set in the city of Summerset, USA, in the 1950s. It involves detective Kelvin Foster and his only daughter, self-proclaimed detective Selen Foster, unraveling the secrets of a series of unresolved murders over a decade.

title: The Devilry Reservation: Сhapter II
description: The second chapter of The Devilry Reservation: Behind the Shadow - Shadow. Immerse yourself in the internal affairs of the Paranormal Security Service. Be ready to see the other side of the interaction of evil spirits with our world. How people side by side with them hold the two worlds in harmony.

title: Aery: Calm Mind 4
description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself in beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

title: Zakantosh Cardgame
description: A Collectible Single Player Card Battle Game that focuses on Story Content. Your enemies are all kind of creatures, goaded by the evil influence of the mysterious crystals, that appeared out of nowhere. You will need to collect powerful cards and gems to fight your way through Zakantosh.

title: Cosmotroid
description: Escape from the asteroid X-474 which has been invaded by aliens. Take your weapons and destroy every enemy who tries to stop you in this amazing arcade style third person shooter game full of action, creatures and explosions.

title: Dark Astral
description: Dark Astral is a 2D action-adventure platform game with fast-paced combat, world exploration, multiple levels, and addictive gameplay set in an underworld filled with demons and all sorts of creatures.

title: Kinduo 2: Frostbite
description: Kinduo 2 is a local co-op game where two elemental friends with unique abilities need to help each other to overcome obstacles! Create blocks of ice, burn or melt things, and combine your skills to create plants!

title: Parry King
description: An action game to master the parry. No search, no death penalty, and a boss rush to train your skills!

title: Taking Root
description: Taking Root is a cosy game about caring for houseplants and watching them thrive. Care for your houseplants in real time in this realistic simulation game and create your own urban jungle.

title: Space Dezinsector
description: Make your way through crowds of alien bugs using surrounding objects. Clear out the rubble and overcome the obstacles. Move through the corridors of the abandoned space station where you find yourself against your will.

title: School Booster
description: In the School Booster, you will play the role of being a parent raising your girl to an adult (18). her grow-up journey will come from heaven, baby, kid, teenager, these four sages. And each stage has slightly different playing mechanics.

title: Redline Racing
description: High Pace, High Skill Time-trial Racing Game

title: World of Rune
description: World of Rune is an MMORPG game with tons of different characters and mystical cute pets. You can play as a Swordsman, Mage, Archer and Cleric.

title: Skyline Sprinters
description: Welcome to an adrenaline-pumping platform game where players embark on an exhilarating race against each other through a challenging parkour course! Prepare to test your agility, speed, and reflexes as you navigate through an immersive world filled with obstacles, traps, and exciting surprises.

title: Catniptic
description: In Catniptic, you take on the role of a dynamic feline protagonist navigating through various dream worlds, unlocking eccentric abilities with magical catnip, and reclaiming stolen furniture. This psychedelic platformer never plays the same twice.

title: Tale of Two Cranes
description: Fulfill your epic destiny in mythic ancient China! Lead armies, wield magic, and put an emperor on the throne - or become the emperor yourself!

title: Greed is Good
description: In Greed is Good, a PvPvE game, you will enter the mysterious dungeon as a Bounty Hunter. In the game, you need to cooperate with your teammates to fight against enemies and fears. Be aware of the toxic gas and be sure to escape before you are drown out.

title: Dead Alone
description: Dead Alone is an intense first-person survival shooter set in a dangerous apocalyptic cityscape. In this desolate landscape, your precision in shooting and meticulous resource management will be the key to survival.

title: Pixel Royale 3D
description: Action Packed Pixelated FPS! Run, Slide, and Wall-Jump your way through the battlefield! Play Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, Duels, or Pixel Royale, where the last one standing wins! Compete in leaderboards to win exclusive items and rise to the top of the world! No Pay-To-Win. Forever.

title: Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy
description: Welcome to "Viking Chef: Feast Frenzy", a captivating 3D cooking adventure set in the heart of the old North. Assume the role of a Viking Chef and dive headfirst into the culinary chaos of a bustling Norse kitchen. Your mission? To serve the gods a feast of legendary proportions.

title: Starship Scramble
description: Play an arena shooter roguelite where you build your own ship and survive through enemies' attack. You can even customize individual weapons, turning each one into a unique and formidable tool of destruction.

title: Lost Alien
description: Lost Alien is a 2D pixel game that combines elements of platformer, puzzles and planetary exploration. Move through the levels passing various obstacles, dodging enemies, use the jetpack.

title: The Cursed Village TD
description: The Cursed Village is a rogue-lite Tower Defense game. With six types of towers, dozens of enemies, dozens of abilities and a unique rune system, you will strategize and defend your village against an ancient curse.

title: Dragon Wings
description: Embark on an epic journey of self discovery! Set out on a thrilling adventure through treacherous landscapes and overcome exciting challenges. Will you be able to find your way home?

title: War of Wheels
description: Choose your class vehicle, customize it with deadly weapons and conquer your place in the world. War of Wheels is a frenetic car fighting game in an original “medievalpunk” setting. Ride your iron steed and become a legend.

title: From the Deep
description: A warrior finds himself on the darkest of the dungeons. He does not know how or why he came to be there. He does not know how to get out of it. To conquer his freedom, he will have his fears challenged, his will tested, and his courage tried.

title: Faded Stories: Full Moon
description: Unburied and forgotten undead gather in the city center, while the citizens of Greenberg go about their day-to-day lives.

title: Float
description: A aimless rafting trip, anything possible will be your boat. Tiny boats will be swallowed by fast-flowing rivers, but mighty boats will stand firm. When encountering danger, do you choose to avoid it or bravely overcome it? Use your ingenuity to make this journey go further!

title: The First Explorers
description: The First Explorers is a Settlers-like game, that offers the perfect mix of organic city-building and RTS in a bustling world. Set in the time of antiquity in Europe, you will play as the Romans, Carthaginians or Gauls. Are you ready to raise an army backed by a thriving economy?

title: Lunar Ascendant
description: In Lunar Ascendant, a narrative-driven political simulation RPG, you lead Artemis, humanity's first lunar colony. You have to confront different factions in their struggle for power, and address the controversial use of human brains as CPUs. Your choices will shape the future of space colonization.

title: Arcane Arena

In Dune: Imperium, you'll step into the role of one of the leaders of the Great Houses of the Imperium in a struggle to control the planet Arrakis and the invaluable Spice it provides.

The game plays out in a series of ten rounds, each of which is defined by a new Conflict on the surface of the planet; some award critical resources, and some provide Victory Points that will propel you to dominance. But choose your battles wisely: spread your forces too thin, and you'll find your enemies growing too strong to oppose.

Each round, you'll draw a hand of five cards from your deck, which will get stronger over the course of the game as you acquire new cards. Each card can be played in one of two ways: To send an Agent out into the Imperium to gather resources, or to Reveal at the end of the round to purchase new powerful cards. You must maintain a careful balance to get the most of the resources available to you. How will you find your path?

As your game progresses, you'll vie for Influence with four factions of the Imperium: The Emperor, the economically powerful Spacing Guild, the mysterious Bene Gesserit, and the ferocious Fremen of the deep deserts. Earning Influence among the various groups helps you to earn the Victory Points you need...but will you compete with your rivals for their favor, or abandon alliances to pursue other opportunities?

Many strategies are at your disposal, and many paths to victory. The cards are dealt. The choice is yours. The Imperium awaits.

description:
The first 3 maps saw you fighting against Imps, Sergeants and Demons with only the Shotgun, Chaingun and the Rocket Launcher. This time they are cranked up to 11 and you're gonna get bigger guns. But also a whole lot of beefier meat to aim them at! You are the Mean Green and you are about to bully the crap out of this strange world!
The levels are medium sized and sets the player in an abstract semi realistic hellish tech setting.

title: High/Low 2
description: High/Low 2 is a Doom Episode 2 themed level. Like High/Low 1, which was an episode 1 kinda level it is only meant to resemble the style, not to copy it.

title: The Wailing Horde
description: This one large map is Chris Hansen's interpretation of an action filled and slightly different episode 2 level. It tried to stay true to the style of eps. 2, but cranked it up a bit.

title: Gore
description: GORE is a found footage horror experience set deep in the mountains of the Pacific Northwest with Lovecraftian inspiration. Explore the wilderness and uncover the origins of the fleshy entity.

title: Millennium Mini-Episode
description: A collection of DOOM Millennium maps originally from 1998-1999 in a four-map mini-episode.

title: The Darkened Outpost
description: Yet another demon-infested, abandoned base. Fight your way through these nukage-processing industrial environments and expect surprises.

title: Plutonium Sandpit
description: A very large single map for Doom2. You are para- dropped on an abandoned industrial sand planet to investigate why the base was deserted. Sensors indicate the presence of hellspawn. Find the cause why facilities have ceased production and destroy any hellspawn you face.

title: Brotherhood of Ruin: The Lost Temple
description: A Large single map for DOOM2, taking place in an ancient temple complex swarming with hellspawn. Occasional switchhunt might occur as the map isn't very linear. Be warned and pay attention to the surroundings of the map.

title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: Knuckles Mod
description: A character mod for Super Smash Bros. Ultimate that adds in Knuckles, complete with a custom moveset ported from P+.

title: Night Freak
description: A retro style horror game with silent hill style camera, tank controls, vhs filters, and survival horror elements.

title: Selene: Apoptosis - 18+ Adult Only Patch
description: This DLC is only for those who are of legal age and wish to see such content. By downloading this DLC you are confirming you are 18 years of age or older (or your regional equivalent).

title: SeasonPark
description: In this Game you follow the story of a man that is searching his wife and his kids. They all disappeared in an abondend indoor playground. This indoor playground is themed after the four seasons with its mascots named Sally Spring, Siggi Summer, Frederick Fall and Willy Winter. You need to break in this playground and explore it to find your children and wife ( with no keycards!!!). You get the help from your friendly winter stick. With that stick, you can create ice blocks on which you can jump on.

title: Franzen
description: Franzen is a turn-based RPG set in a dystopian-steampunk world. Explore themes of empathy and politics as Franz and Lefsa Dellia work to uncover the truth of "The Scream". Meet a cast of colorful characters and fight bizarre creatures in your journey through the world of Branzen!

title: Chrono Ressurection
description:
Chrono Resurrection is an unreleased fangame developed by Resurrection Games under Nathan Lazur's direction, based on the Super NES role-playing game Chrono Trigger. The project was initially called CT64 and was meant to be a complete remake of the original game for the Nintendo 64 with both 2D and 3D playing modes, but it was eventually reworked from scratch.

On September 6, 2004, the project was publicly closed after Resurrection Games received a cease-and-desist letter from Square Enix for trademark and copyright infringement.

title: PhobosDeimos Anomaly
description: PhobosDeimos Anomaly is a 2012 mod for Doom containing two six-level episodes, totaling twelve levels, created with maps submitted to Doom the Way id Did by the late Callum Guy Oliver (phobosdeimos1) and released posthumously.

title: Warped North
description: It was a small wonder when, after a mechanical malfunction, the transport ship moving you to an isolated research facility crashed, granting you your long-overdue freedom. But the new frigid land you've arrived in swarms with jabbering, malicious little creatures, and you can't help but sense you may have caught the attention of something sinister.

title: Passpartout: The One Man Band
description: Compose your own music and perform it in front of strangers on the street! Adhere to the feedback from your listeners and bewitch them with your catchy beats and melodies!

title: Bee Garden: The Lost Queen
description: Bee Garden: The Lost Queen is a time management game with cute characters and innovative dynamic visuals. Complete 40 story levels in 4 breath-taking environments with day and night missions and special rush levels! Try your skills in 4 special challenges and beat the high scores! Be the best and collect all of the 8 trophies.

title: 3D Dinosaur Hunter
description: This 2000 edition of Eyewitness Virtual Reality Dinosaur Hunter updates some of the information and makes some minor changes, like replacing Segnosaurus with Therizinosaurus. It also adds a second disc called 3D Dinoworld, in which you can freely explore six prehistoric environments and observe dinosaurs in their daily life.

title: Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion
description:
Turok 3: Shadow of Oblivion is a faithful restoration of the classic first-person shooter originally released in 2000 for the Nintendo 64, upgraded through Nightdive Studios’ proprietary KEX Engine for play on modern gaming devices with up to a 4K resolution at 120FPS.

It joins Nightdive Studios, Universal Games, and Digital Platforms’ popular Turok and Turok 2: Seeds of Evil remasters, capping off the trilogy. Turok 3 Shadow of Oblivion Remastered features upgraded gameplay, high-resolution textures, enhanced lighting and rendering, and support for console gamepads with platform-specific features.

Finish the hunt in this epic finale to the Turok Trilogy. Pick up immediately after the events of Turok 2: Seeds of Evil, with dual protagonists Joseph and Danielle Fireseed, of the Turok family tree, as they battle the titular antagonist Oblivion and its followers, the Flesh Eaters.

title: Cyberpunk 2077: 2.0 Update
description:
Cyberpunk 2077: Update 2.0 introduces a comprehensive, free overhaul of the game's core systems. Key changes include a redesigned cyberware system, where armor stats are now linked to equipped cyberware rather than clothing, allowing for greater customization and strategic trade-offs. The update also revamps the perk system, adding abilities such as bullet deflection, mid-air dashing, and new finishing moves, along with a new skill tree tied to the Relic chip in V’s body for enhanced abilities.

The update introduces a vehicular combat system, enabling players to engage enemies while driving, including shooting and hacking nearby vehicles. This addition is accompanied by changes to the game’s “wanted” system, with escalating responses from the NCPD, culminating in confrontations with the heavily armed MaxTac Psycho Squad.

Update 2.0 also adds over 100 new items, including weapons, clothing, cyberware, and vehicles, expanding the game’s customization and combat options.

title: Starfield: Shattered Space
description: This will be the first story expansion to Starfield. This DLC is bundled with Premium Edition (digital), Premium Edition Upgrade (digital), Premium Edition Upgrade (physical), and Constellation Edition of Starfield.

title: J-Jump Arena
description: A turn based, jumping elimination game where everything happens all at once! Learn to be precise with your jumps and weapon handling, as well as in the art of outsmarting your opponents! Multiplayer for up to 10 players and single player mode available.

title: DanMachi Battle Chronicle
description:
Experience the world of Danmachi in 3D with fully voiced dialogue! Relive the story of Danmachi in 3D together with your favorite characters brought to life via anime-style 3D graphics! You can also enjoy game-exclusive movies and scenes drawn at totally different angles from the anime!

Monsters await you in the Dungeon where you can make use of a variety of methods of attacking and evading in exhilarating battles with simple controls!
Perform your favorite deadly attacks, including Firebolt and Lil Rafaga, in spectacular fashion. Go adventuring with your favorite characters!

Take on other adventurers in Magic Stone Contests, free-for-all battles where everyone is an enemy! These are battle royales fought between 8 different players.
Gather more Magic Stones than anyone else to become number 1!

title: Hell's Eventide
description: Because of three different authors the theme and style differed greatly, but with a little refining the whole thing clicked. A hellish level with a few traps, tricks and unwanted welcomes...

title: Bytesize
description: 12 small maps, each limited to 100 linedefs.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou: Outbreak
description: A remade version of Outbreak that was initially included in the PC release of Hou, with improved graphics and full voice acting.

title: Warframe: The Seven Crimes of Kullervo
description:
Return to Duviri and delve into a sprawling new island dungeon where the tragic Warframe, Kullervo, awaits your redemption. This strange, floating prison obfuscates both Kullervo’s crimes as well as the mysterious (yet familiar) Warden who binds him under lock and key. Explore the prison’s cells to uncover the story of Kullervo’s misdeeds and wield the power of treachery through his trademark daggers and thirst for vengeance.

As a mainline update It contains an exhaustive list of quality of live changes to the game. The main new content is the 53rd Warframe, Kullervo, and his signature weapons along with the chance to encounter his story missions on a new island in Duviri.
Other Duviri changes include Captain Vor's appearance in Undercroft challenge missions for a chance at new arcanes, Kaithe customization with armor and ephemera, 2 new side missions with Paragrimm's Tomes and Lost Belongings objectives, the return of Kaithe races and 15 new decrees.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou: Hinamizawa Teiryuujo
description: A remade version of Outbreak that was initially included in the PC release of Hou, with improved graphics and full voice acting.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou: Kamikashimashi-hen
description: A remade version of Outbreak that was initially included in the PC release of Hou, with improved graphics and full voice acting.

description: Save the city from demonic mutant robots attempting to take over!

title: Farming Tractor Simulator 2023: Drive Combine & Trucks
description: Start sowing the seeds of success today!

title: The Discrete Era
description: An Action-Roguelike, multiplayer coop game.

title: Memory Fragment
description: Roid, the handyman of a small town, retrieves a photo album filled with memories from an old box in the shed. As he flips through the Polaroid photos, he takes a journey back in time to revisit the memories leading up to his journey of becoming a handyman.

title: Panda Choice Mahjong
description: The panda has made her choice! Follow her into the wonderful world of the most ancient game.

title: Fractal Glide
description: Experience the mesmerizing world of fractals as you glide through meticulously repeating landscapes. Immerse yourself in a tranquil journey, finding awe in the beauty of math. Embark on an adventure where the goal is exploration and the discovery of infinite art through the wonders of fractals.

title: Hard Hero
description: Heroes are doing many things to save the world. Fight with enemy, dirve vehicles and combine to robot. Player control the vehicles and combine each other during avoid enemy's attack. Player can feel how hard to saving world. Challenge to being hero.

title: I Made this Game in 3 Days
description: Embark on a buggy adventure in "I made this Game in 3 Days"! I'm not kidding when I say this roguelike masterpiece was birthed in just 72 hours. Dive headfirst into a realm of whimsical chaos, where every bug is a feature and every glitch is a delightful surprise.

title: Chimeras: Heavenfall Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: Astrid and Greta are the best of friends, but when she goes missing during the semester break at their magical school, Astrid needs your help as a detective to find her. As you dig deeper, you'll discover she's not the only student to vanish in these hallowed halls.

title: Armored Core VI Fires of Rubicon: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full game
• Exclusive Digital Artbook & Original Soundtrack
Allows players to view concept art and listen to in-game music.

A new action game based on the core concept of the Armored Core series that utilizes the knowledge and experience gained from FromSoftware's recent action game development.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Daredevil Edition
description:
The Daredevil Edition of Guilty Gear -Strive- includes the base game, Season Pass 1, Season Pass 2, Season Pass 3, the Ultimate Edition Content Kit and the Guilty Gear 25th Anniversary: Special Additional Color Pack.

Season Pass 1 includes 5 characters, 2 stages, an exclusive story expansion and the Additional Character Color Pack which adds 5 color variations for all 20 characters announced with its release.

Season Pass 2 and 3 includes 4 characters, 2 stages and a Color Pack which unlocks 6 color variations for the 4 characters in the related pass. Season Pass 3 also has an exclusive Color Pack with 3 additional color variations for its characters that missed both 25th Anniversary Color Packs.

Ultimate Edition Contents Kit includes the Digital Soundtrack, Digital Artwork and the Ultimate Edition Special Colors which adds 1 color variant for all 20 characters available with Season Pass 1. A color variant in the Season Pass 2 and 3 Color Packs matches the Ultimate Edition color variation for their characters.

The Guilty Gear 25th Anniversary Special Additional Color Pack unlocks 2 color variations for the 24 characters available at the end of Season Pass 2.

title: Riders Republic: 360 Edition
description: With the Riders Republic 360 Edition, take your experience to the next level. Enjoy the skate and hoverboard for a unique freeriding experience across the Republic's vibrant open world. Build your legend with original sports (bike,* ski, snowboard, and wingsuit).

title: Riders Republic: Complete Edition
description: With the Riders Republic Complete Edition, face no restrictions and shred like there is no tomorrow! Enjoy the skateboard, BMX, and hoverboard for a unique urban riding experience through the Republic's vibrant open world. Build your legend with original sports (racing bike, mountain bike, ski, snowboard, and wingsuit).

title: Riders Republic: Skate Edition
description: Shred the Ridge like never before with Riders Republic Skate Edition. Hop on your board and ride across brand-new skate parks! The Skate Edition includes the base game and the Skate add-on.

title: Medieval Delivery
description: Because deliveries also existed in medieval times, this is a third-person simulation and adventure game where you'll have the task of making deliveries throughout the village according to the requests of its inhabitants, such as meat, flour, bread, and perhaps other things.

title: Meta Nanos: Rumble Race
description: Meta Nanos: Rumble Race is an exciting and action-packed game where your Nanos race against other Nanos for the top spots in the weekly leaderboards. Win awesome prices and show your opponents that your Nanos are just faster.

title: Warframe: Echoes of Duviri
description:
This update adds Wisp Prime along with her signature weapons Fulmin Prime and Gunsen Prime. These additions replace Nidus Prime, Strun Prime and Magnus Prime which have now been added to the Prime Vault.

Other additions include a new drifter melee weapon Argo & Viel, new Undercroft tiles with a Jackal assassination mission, 5 new Incarnon weapons, 4 new Warframe augment mods, 4 new Duviri decrees, and a Duviri dojo room that allows you to free roam on the Harbinger’s Pass and Courtier’s Bliss islands.

title: Comic Coloring Book: Complete Edition - Draw Extended
description:
Comic Coloring Book - Complete Edition is fun for big and small, especially for young, creative fans of comic books! Enjoy adventures, use different drawing tools and create!

This bundle lets you try out the new whiteboard set and drawings.

Features:
— Great fun for children - and an excellent way to introduce them to comics.
— 23 stories, each consists 4 graphics - making a total of 92 coloring pages!
— Best tool for children to express their creativity - while improving their motor skills and awareness of colors and shapes.

title: Warframe: Abyss of Dagath
description:
Abyss of Dagath adds the quest for the 54th Warframe, Dagath, in a new Naberus-inspired story from the Entrati Grandmother. Dagath’s appearance and kit bear some resemblance to a certain equine companion you may have met in Duviri — and comes with a brand-new blade and whip melee weapon.

This update has some big changes that aim to improve the broader gameplay experience, including a major overhaul of companions and a rework for the aquatic swashbuckler, Hydroid!
Other planned changes include Auto-melee, a focus acquisition rework and the removal of flawed mods and MK-1 Weapons.

More information about Dagath and the full update will be revealed in the September Devstream ahead of Abyss of Dagath's release this October!

title: Trip World DX
description:
Travel across four fantastic lands and Mount Dubious in Trip World DX! Our hero Yakopoo's adventure begins when the Maita flower, a symbol of world peace and happiness, is stolen, throwing Trip World into chaos!

Fly through the air, traverse over the land, and swim through the water, collecting special items to help you find the flower and restore Trip World.

Use Yakopoo's shapeshifting powers to save Trip World from darkness! Race across the ground as a ball. Grow a tail to hit enemies—or a flower to make your enemies friendly!

This new version collects the classic handheld adventure Trip World in its original form, as well as the brand new color version bringing all new life to the world of Yakopoo! Discover how the game was made and all new secrets in the museum mode including development documents and video interviews, or go listen to one of the greatest game soundtracks ever made in the music player!

title: Whitestone
description: On the 'Sunchaser's capstone voyage to the Arctic, it's smooth sailing until Jack's quarters are broken into and his friend goes missing. Unsure who to trust, Jack is forced to fight nightmares both mental and physical as he becomes the prime suspect for a terrible deed.

title: Sport & Fun: Swimming - Legendary Edition
description: Discover a new world of fun! Dive into Sport & Fun: Swimming and use your Joy-Con controllers to experience the cutest challenge in your life.

description:
Looking for action? Here’s Johnny in Johnnybee skin with Bulletstorm weapon!
Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R - Leone Abbacchio
description:
Bucciarati's team is fully reunited in All-Star Battle R with the playable character addition of Leone Abbacchio and his detective stand, Moody Jazz. Make your opponents think twice and see double with Leone Abbacchio! Available Now!

Contents:
- Leone Abbacchio as a playable character
- Additional Leone Abbacchio JoJo Glossary, Model Viewer, Sound Test, and Art Viewer
- Additional Leone Abbacchio collection items at the in-game store

title: Knights & Guns: Back To School Edition
description:
Knights & Guns: Back To School Edition is a digital bundle that contains the base game, Expansion Pack #1, Expansion Pack #2 and Armor Pack #2 for a total of 20 new levels, 12 new armors and new enemies from both expansions.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

title: Warframe: Whispers in the Walls
description:
Coming to all platforms this winter, Whispers in the Walls will drop you into a hair-raising conflict rife with shocking revelations that will shake the Origin System to its very core.

In this new story-driven cinematic quest, you'll be caught in the middle of a deadly battle between Albrecht Entrati, one of the Origin System's most brilliant minds, and the unknowable Man in the Wall. The board is set and the pieces are moving. Can you put it all together in time, Tenno?

Naturally, you won’t be fighting unarmed, either. Hold fast against the dangers littered throughout Albrecht Entrati's secret laboratory with an all-new Secondary weapon class — the otherworldly Grimoire.

Whispers in the Walls will also introduce the Murmur, a brand-new faction created by the Man in the Wall, along with a reworked and expanded Necramech enemy faction. No matter how you do battle, the forces arrayed against you have never been more fearsome.

title: Warframe: 1999
description:
Warframe: 1999 is the time-bending follow-up due for release the following year and features a distinctive, licensed track by seminal industrial rock band Nine Inch Nails: “Into the Void.” In 2024, the Tenno will return to the past in order to understand their future, and reveal the motives behind Albrecht Entrati’s perplexing research. But everything is not as it seems…

The pieces of the puzzle are falling into place, Tenno. But it will be up to you to solve it.

description: Trapped In Here With Me is a lightning fast arcade action game. Grind for the top score among your friends, or globally.

A variety of weapons and power-ups to unlock.

description: Save the world!

description: KSudoku is a free version of the popular logic game Sudoku developed by the KDE community. The game is to fill a nine by nine grid with the numbers from one to nine filling the rows, columns and three by three squares without repeating a value on them.

title: Yakuzukuri Puzzle Yumeiro Yuramu
description:
Yakuzukuri Puzzle Yumeiru Yuramu, also known simply as Yumeiro Yuramu, is a falling-blocks puzzle game by Nippon Ichi Software.

The basic gameplay consists of the player dropping dominos of two colored blocks onto the playfield. When four blocks of the same color are connected, they form a tetromino. As the player forms patterns such as multiple same-colored tetrominoes connecting or tetrominos forming a square, a score counter next to the playfield will increase. When the player has a valid points-earning board, they may either finish the round to cash in their points, or continue to build, at the expense of possibly losing points if they fail to raise the value of their board.

The game can be either played solo or in versus mode against an opponent, either a CPU-controlled or human opponent. Versus-human play can be done either locally or online, with cross-platform play available between Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 players. When playing versus, each round the player whose board is worth more points will damage the opponent's HP with an amount equal to the value of their board. The first player to deplete their opponent's HP wins.

Place your actors and props in the scene, choose actions for them to perform, and add sound effects, speech, music, and text. You can also explore the studio and theater building to find the lost pages of the Talent Book and learn the actors' stories.

You're not the nightguard, in FNaF: Simulator you play as the animatronics!
Get to experience FNaF from a variety of animatronic POV's within a multitude of locations in the beloved FNaF franchise.

title: Five Nights With 39

You have been called out, by a teal animatronic bunny with glasses, his name is 39.
He has a strange personality, something you wouldn't see in your average animatronic, he's foul, he's roudy, he's stupid, and he's coming for you! Survive his random movements, and his little pal that will surely end you if you are not quick enough, boop his nose to keep him away!

title: Evil Journey: Plan A
description: It's a five map episode, that takes place on Earth. It mixes realistic and abstract mapping, and features new sounds, textures, enemies and stuff.

title: Gensei Fukyo Den
description:
Gensei Fūkyō Den is a Japanese RPG with a somewhat "light" approach, both in story-telling and gameplay. The gameplay mostly follows the standard procedure of Japanese-style RPGs, although some features are simplified: there is no "world map", and town navigation is menu-based. Most of the gameplay consists of navigating maze-like top-down dungeons, fighting random enemies in turn-based first-person perspective combat. Characters use special points (SP) for powerful attacks and magic points (MP) for spells.

Released through Disc Station Vol. 4 in 1994 for PC-9801.

title: Gensei Kitan: Disc Saga III
description: The player navigates Smash and his friends through top-down locations, talking to people and fighting randomly appearing enemies in hostile areas. The turn-based battles are viewed from a side perspective. Characters can execute various "techniques", which deplete TP (technique points), or magic spells.

title: Gensei Kaito Den
description:
Gensei Kaitō Den is set in the same world as Gensei Kitan. Important characters from Gensei Kitan (including its protagonist, the dog Smash) appear in the game, and some of them are playable. However, the main hero is a young and very ambitious thief named Ali-Baba - who is, naturally, the leader of a band of 40 robbers. The game is divided into chapters; each one describes an episode from Ali-Baba's "career", from train robbery to treasure hunt and even discovery of the magic lamp .

The game is a humorous "light" Japanese-style RPG - there is no world map, and most of the time the hero is taken to a new location automatically. Many locations have simple puzzles to solve, and some dungeon areas are maze-like. The gameplay system is nearly identical to that of Gensei Kitan, with the same interface and overall structure. Random enemies are fought in turn-based style, on a side-view battle screen. Characters use physical attacks, special techniques, and magical spells. As in all Gensei games, HP, SP, and MP are fully restored by level up.

title: Emil Chronicle Online
description:
Emil Chronicle Online was a 3D Japanese fantasy MMORPG with anime-style graphics. Set in the land of Acronia, the game featured twelve classes spread among four races, each with a particular advantage (agility, magic, or strength). Along with a series of quests and battles, the game featured a few standout modes including its marionette system, where players could transform their characters into marionettes, which were Pokémon-like surrogates. Marionettes could live in the world even when players had logged out. There was also a standard pet system outside of this. Players could also turn their characters into weapons that other people could use, gaining both experience. PvP was in RvR format, and massive battles were scheduled regularly in advance for different level groups.

As of 2024, no servers for the game are online, with GungHo Online Entertainment announcing that the Japanese server would be shut down on August 31, 2017, citing the impossible task of keeping up with modern players’ demands.

Battle warriors of different nations, fend off greedy colonizers, and slay monstrous creatures as you voyage across this enchanted land. Change your fate, one move at a time.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Minagoroshi-hen
description: A port of the remade version of the third arc of Higurashi When They Cry Kai for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Matsuribayashi-hen
description: A port of the remade version of the fourth and final arc of Higurashi When They Cry Kai for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Saikoroshi-hen
description: A port of the epilogue to the main story of Higurashi originally included in Rei for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Taraimawashi-hen
description: A port of the extra arc originally included in Matsuri, which acts as a bad ending when the player does not make choices that would lead them to Onikakushi, Watanagashi, or Tatarigoroshi for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: The Doomsday Heist
description: This update features a new storyline, which begins with the GTA Online protagonists being reunited by Lester Crest and a new character, billionaire Avon Hertz. The protagonist, Lester, and Avon unite with government agents, including Agent 14 and Phoenicia Rackman. Avon believes that an unknown foreign entity is trying to start a war and would put San Andreas and the United States under a "doomsday scenario". The heist crew is involved in several missions that introduce new military-grade vehicles and weapons featured in the update.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Tsukiotoshi-hen
description: A port of the extra arc originally included in Matsuri that serves as an alternate version of Tatarigoroshi where Keiichi, Shion, and Rena team up to save Satoko from her uncle for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Someutsushi-hen
description: A port of the extra arc and the first in the Advanced Story saga originally included in Kizuna Volume I, partially adapted from the manga-exclusive arc Onisarashi, for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Alternative Hirukowashi-hen
description: A port of the alternative version of Hirukowashi-hen originally included in Kizuna Volume II, which contains several changes to its original version in Kai, namely the addition and removal of certain characters and the removal of references to plot details not yet revealed, for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Kageboushi-hen
description: A port of the extra arc and the second in the Advanced Story saga originally included in Kizuna Volume I, partially adapted from the manga-exclusive arc Onisarashi, for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Yoigoshi-hen
description: A port of the extra arc included in Kizuna Volume III based on the manga arc of the same name and features several changes, namely the addition of a new character, Miyuki Sorimachi, for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Tokihogushi-hen
description: A port of the extra arc and the third in the Advanced Story saga that centers on Tomoe Minai investigating a murder case with ties to Rena Ryuugu for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Kotohogushi-hen
description: An extra arc originally included in Kizuna IV that functions as a prequel to the entire series for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Qomp2
description:
An artful reimagining of Pong, qomp2 picks up the story where the delightful indie platform-puzzler qomp left off in 2021.

Control a Pong ball aching to break free of its life stuck between two paddles. Explore a dangerous, minimalist world, armed with simple two button controls: tap a button to change direction by 90 degrees, and hold down a button to unleash a cathartic dash forward. That’s all you need to solve environmental puzzles and labyrinthine levels. Around each corner is a new challenge that will test your two-button and problem-solving skills. A variety of difficult enemies and bosses help you mark your time as you navigate through 30 levels spread across four worlds.

A cerebral puzzler lies within the heart of this indie twist on Pong.

title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat : World Food Festival Update
description: Head back to the Onion Kingdom and celebrate World Food Day in this uber-delicious FREE update, OUT NOW on Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Steam!

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Miotsukushi-hen Omote
description: A port of the original alternative ending that is included in Matsuri for modern consoles in widescreen.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Miotsukushi-hen Ura
description: A port of the additional content included in Kizuna Volume 4's Miotsukushi-hen split into its chapter for modern consoles in widescreen,

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Hajisarashi-hen
description: An extra arc about Keiichi and the Club going to have fun at a pool that was initially included in Sui but later brought to Hou.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou: Batsukoishi-hen
description: An extra arc initially included as an epilogue to the original PC release of Meakashi, where Keiichi Maebara loses several club games in a row, the Soul Brothers help him regain his will to fight by imagining the other club members in perverted fantasies.

title: The Jetsons: Space Race
description: A simple, slick side-scrolling platformer starring The Jetsons, everyone's favorite space age family. George is running late and there's bumper-to-bumper traffic on the intergalactic interstate. But he still has to drop off Elroy at the Little Dipper School, Judy at Orbit City High, Astro at the Galaxy K-9 School, and Jane at the Shopping Center. All before heading to work. Will he make it to Spacely Sprockets on time?

title: The Genesis Order
description: Murder and mystery lead a young detective to investigate a cult and to cross paths with a criminal organization. With the help of an angel and a harem of beauties, take on the challenge of saving the world from a mysterious threat.

title: 01 Deadliest Zone Catch: Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator
description:
Embark on thrilling maritime adventures where you'll become a professional crab catcher and navigate the treacherous waters of Alaska. Earn a fortune while traveling on a large boat, battling dangerous natural disasters. And don't forget about those menacing crab claws!
Become a true captain. Manage your ship and utilize professional equipment to catch crabs in the vast Bering Sea. Explore the waters of Alaska, study crab migrations, and do everything possible to succeed even in the most turbulent days. Prepare yourself for exciting quests in search of wealth and glory on the open seas!
In "01 Deadliest Zone Catch — Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator" you'll have the opportunity to participate in perilous sea races for the best catch and capture crabs beyond your wildest dreams. Your task won't be easy—you'll have to contend with time constraints, weather conditions, crab migrations, and, most importantly, the unforgiving sea itself. This is your destiny on the waters of Alaska!
It will take all your courage and determination to conquer the deadly waves and build your own fortune in the world of crab catching. Take action and seize the opportunity to become a legend in "01 Deadliest Zone Catch — Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator"!

title: Betomis
description: Explore dark dungeons as a valiant knight and survive using your wits and limited resources!

title: Bomb Up
description:
Bomb Up is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly falling down. Press a button to fire a bomb and press it again to explode it. Score points by destroying all the red squares within the radius of its explosion. The explosion will bounce you up and to the side and you will turn around when you hit a wall.

The game is over when a red square hits you.

title: Capybro
description: Play as a Capybara and be a bro to your forest friends as you make your way to the spa.

title: ErIS: Z. θ-pRogram
description: ErIS: Z. θ-pRogram is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Yuumitsuki and explore a virtual world via a headset.

title: List 118
description:
When Tsunagu was about to pass through the school building—
Yoru, who was supposed to be holding his hand, suddenly disappeared, and the entrance was blocked.

title: Saikai Sotsugyou Ryokou '98
description: A PC dating sim.

title: Sotsugyou Ryokou
description: A dating sim visual novel.

title: Hymn to the Earless God
description: Turn-based RPG from the creator of Jimmy and the Pulsating Mass set on a brutal alien planet. Four unique main characters, four unforgettable stories, four inescapable calamities.

title: Shoot For Fun's Sake
description: A short solo shooter game where you shoot fixed sensors and sensor patrols without anything shooting back. Use tactical skills to destroy sensors without exceeding the detection limit.

title: Tiny Touring Cars
description: A fun arcade racing game in a low poly style. Choose from 3 cars and 9 tracks to race against your friends and the AI or try your hand at setting the fastest laps times on the Steam leaderboards.

title: Pixel Puzzles WW2 Jigsaw: Kriegsmarine
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Farm Garden Simulator
description: Farm Garden Simulator is a farm simulator game where you can grow a lot of crops and raise animals.

title: Alpine Lake
description: Kick back in the fresh mountain air and craft your ideal haven on the shores of Alpine Lake! Build, and decorate your inn to bring joy and prosperity to the community. Welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Farm, cook, and entertain them in your own unique way!

title: Pixel Puzzles WW2 Jigsaw: French Tanks
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Traitorous Trek
description: Welcome to Traitorous Trek ! Immerse yourself in a universe teeming with deception, betrayal, and nail-biting tension. As a member of an interstellar fleet, your mission is to unravel the hidden shadows lurking within, thwart the conspirators' plans, and safeguard the future of humanity.

title: On Life and Living
description: In "On Life and Living", beyond metroidvania-style exploration and challenging encounters, players will also experience an emotional story of love, grief, and consequences. You are in control, shaping the course of this journey towards regeneration.

title: Castle Empire
description: Unleash your strategic prowess

title: Ship Regulus
description: In the first year of the ephemeris, the warp engine was invented. Due to the initial engine being too large, it was installed on the space city Regulus. During engine testing, the jump signal attracted an alien fleet, and the Ship Regulus embarked on a flight path.

title: Car Mechanic: City Driving
description: Customize your own car and go on a serene ride through the city streets!

title: Eternal Vigil
description: Embark on an epic quest to defend the sacred crystal from relentless waves of monstrous invaders.Harness your unique combat skills, strategically deploy your powerful turrets and reach your full potential to push back the dark forces. Will you rise as the ultimate defender or succumb to the shadows?

title: Depthris
description: Depthris is a 3D puzzle game inspired by the classic BlockOut game for DOS. Move and rotate the pieces almost anywhere (except backwards) and aim for the highest score.

title: Humbug Tales: Keeper of the Swarm
description: Experience the world of bugs through the eyes of the humbug ant herder Eacus and his peculiar flock. Together you'll meet a quirky cast of tiny friends on a larger-than-life adventure. Explore lush wetlands and use your wits to outsmart predators and enemy humbugs. Your colony is depending on you!

title: Latmos Explorer
description: Discover the mysteries of Latmos with block coding. Learn about the cultural heritage and history of humanity while preparing for the future.

title: Block & Shot
description: Block & Shot will immerse you in the captivating world of logical puzzles, where you will have to control various weapons to overcome obstacles in your path and reach the main goal - the golden cartridge

title: Anvil of Tristheim
description: The first card-based blacksmith crafting game! Merge material cards into items - and turn your customers into dragon slayers or dragon food.

title: Ultramassive
description: Embark on a journey towards the center of the galaxy in Ultramassive, a roguelite deckbuilder! Craft a unique deck, fight hostile aliens, gamble your way out of stick situations and and find parts to upgrade your spaceship along the way.

title: Cosmos: Stella Returns
description: Cosmos: Stella Returns is a metroidvania that will bring you to the mysterious planet of Memoria. Shoot, jump, collect materials and new items in this action-platform with a vintage flavor!

title: The Left Behind
description: The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore an overgrown open world at day time and beware of enemies coming in at night. Salvage, hunt and build your way through this world to survive. How long will you survive?

title: Custom Mech Wars
description:
Take customization to the extreme with the Omega Customization System and battle with one-of-a-kind combat units in this all-new third-person shooter mecha game.

Not being restricted to bipedal builds, you can freely customize your mechs to include multiple heads, legs, and arms in whatever positions and angles you choose. Depending on the parts you use, the parameters will vary wildly, so you can build mechs with whatever abilities and fighting styles you wish!

Arm your custom mech to the teeth with every weapon imaginable and blast your way through oncoming enemies. Experience the heart-pounding mecha action that only your Omega Customized units can provide. Destroy enemy units, collect their parts, and customize your favorite mechs even more. Complete a variety of missions as you battle, customize, and then battle and customize some more!

This game supports online multiplayer. Up to four players can cooperate to complete story missions just like in single-player mode. Not only can you experience the rush of tackling missions with friends, but you can show off your favorite mechs you personally customized.

title: Garlic Builder
description: Garlic Builder is a unique building game. As the new builder of the Garlic Family, can you inherit your father's building hammer, take various orders, follow the blueprint, or use your imagination to fulfill the strange needs of your customers?

title: Cold Verdict 2
description: A direct sequel to 'Cold Verdict'. Another group of people wake up in a strange abandoned location, trying to find a way out and understand why they were put there. What is the killer's endgame in all this? A short interactive story with choices.

title: The Tale of Lumi
description: Master tight platforming sections, collect and upgrade Godly powerups, battle powerful enemies, solve intriguing puzzles and explore the riveting world of LUMI in this fast paced 2D action game

title: Shape Quiz
description: -Shape Quiz- is a knowledge game with guessing elements.

title: Soul of War: Legions
description: "SoulofWar" is a strategy deck-building game with twists. It features 8-player PvP battles where you strategically outplay your opponents. It introduces a fresh auto chess gameplay.

title: Let's Play! Oink Games: Kobayakawa
description: Simple...or is it? An easy to learn card game full of bluffing and bravery. The "Kobayakawa" card is the key to victory!

title: Parcel Packing Simulator
description: A Cozy parcel-packing game where you use your brains to Pack parcels in as small packages as possible! Pack random orders to train yourself and try to break high scores from the order list!

title: Bloody Heaven
description: In Bloody Heaven, players will challenge to use various of weapons with different features to beat enemy waves.

title: Nellie's Nonograms
description: A collection of nonograms made by friends and fans of the vtuber NellieAndGrits!

title: Backrooms: Run For Your Life!
description: This is a Backrooms game created by fans. In this game, the main experience is the "Level!" in Backroom(or "Run For Your Life").

title: Arcade Galaxy Builder
description: Welcome to Arcade Galaxy! Race with cube-animals on obstacle-filled tracks. Use skills like lightning strikes and super jumps to gain an edge. Customize your Cub's look and abilities for a unique racing. Create your own tracks with our advanced editor. Unleash your racing dreams in our galaxy!

title: Warzoom
description: Warzoom A Game Of Dynamic Strategy is a fantastic game that's easy to learn and loads of fun to play! It's a tit-for-tat with no two games ever alike. Non stop action from the beginning to the end. Prepare for battle!

title: Space Battle Royale
description: Calling all space pilots! Fight your way to the final showdown inside the mysterious Cube, unleashing havoc and leaving only the debris of the rival ships behind. Oh, did you find yourself left among the wreckage? Upgrade your attributes, modify your ship – and get back into the carnage!

title: Slime Volley
description: Step into the bouncy and exciting arcade game of Slime Volley! This isn't your typical volleyball game – it's an arcade sensation that takes the classic sport and gives it a bouncy, slimy twist. Prepare for a thrilling multiplayer showdown as you leap onto the court for some fast-paced action.

title: Legends of Savvarah: Time of Pariah
description: A fantasy interactive tale about the beast-man Hidu investigating murders in a port city.

title: Fomography
description: Fomography is a story-driven adventure photography game. Play as a boy exploring his entire lifetime to rediscover and chronicle his memories. What has been forgotten that only the photos can show? What hidden memories do even the photos refuse to share?

title: Pixel Puzzles WW2 Jigsaw: Italian Tanks
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Silent Paws: Hidden Valley
description: Embark on a tranquil journey through the mesmerizing landscapes of the Hidden Valley as you take on the role of a graceful fox in this enchanting walking simulator.

title: Project K1
description: Follow Rion Karmanz`s legend to become the first human Raja Rimba in this fast paced hack-n-slash action game that is inspired by Megaman and Devil May Cry series.

title: DoudingMan
description: This is a defensive shooter Roguelite game where enemies will be coming from the right side in an endless stream and you need to survive for a limited time to get through. If you can keep the goods on the left intact, all the better.

title: Bananarang: The Scattered Shards
description: The coolest, weirdest, wackiest and most fun 2D platforming game you'll ever play!

title: A Dragon's Tale: Fading Light
description: Embark on a journey as a small dragon across enchanting worlds, find runes with arcane powers and learn many powerful abilities. Master them to solve puzzles, defeat mighty enemies and eventually face the Black Dragon in this unique action-platformer!

title: Harrowed World: Portents In Red
description:
Step into a shadowy and dangerous world where you are the monster. You died. Tonight, you died but then someone brought you back. Not as you were but as a vampire.

Left abandoned by the one responsible, you must learn to survive the treachery of your vampiric peers and satisfy the gnawing thirst and hunger within.

A night of chaos and confusion coincides with your passage to undeath and when the dust settles you are tasked with finding out why.

The portents in red. What do they mean? Only you can find out.

Danger is everywhere, and trust is a rare commodity. Choose your allies and enemies well.

Good luck, vampire.

title: Battle Records of Rota
description: Battle Records of Rota is a straightforward action shooting RPG game, mainly for players who like anime and action shooting games. Players will play Luota, a girl warrior, to help the little prince defeat the witch and regain the throne.

title: Benefitship
description: Experience the rapidly increasing sexual tension in the blossoming "friendship" between a futanari and her new roommate. A short and fun friends-with-benefits visual novel.

title: Shapeguard
description: Shapeguard is a 2D top-down interactivity driven puzzle game where you move on a grid, inside a temple, and collect different shapes to solve puzzles. Will you manage to use the machines, walls and doors to your advantage to escape from the temple?

title: Marcella Moon: Killer at the Cove
description: Play as amateur sleuth Marcella Moon to investigate a murder in a coastal California town.

title: Spleef Game
description: Dig the blocks below the opposing player to make him fall... But don't fall yourself! As competitive as fun!

title: Sushi Soul Universe
description: Sushi eating 3D action game! An epic love story with a sushi theme! ……sushi! It's too delicious!

title: Only Straight and Up!
description: This is a fun and hardcore roguelike platformer for 1-5 players in which you have to reach the coveted reward by overcoming various traps! Only a few can make it through...

title: Mission: Space
description: After the Earth exploded, the fate of the Earth is in your hands. By creatively building your own spaceship, you'll fight your way through space against pirates. On your journey you will meet many different life forms, some with good, others with bad intentions.

title: The Keyboard
description: This is a text based game. You need to use the given keyboard to achieve the level goal.

title: Infinite Borders
description: With over 10 million downloads, Infinite Borders is a popular strategy game set in China's Three Kingdoms period. Fight alongside legendary heroes to conquer lands and defeat enemies. Build unique teams, guide your city to prosperity, and make special policies. Infinite Borders is calling you!

title: Tiny Candy Guardian
description: A cute and exciting VR shooting game. Become a wizard guarding Candy Island, use candy magic to feed various mouthy fantasy creatures and repel them all.

title: Follow the Leader
description: You live in a world where men called barons have all the power, and you were raised as a servant for one until earning enough to buy your freedom, but that freedom is jeopardized when witnessing the baron's abuse of his lab-grown harem of perfect women because they refuse to sleep with him.

title: Sun Breed
description: Life;s been tough for you as a half-vampire with your human mother and vampire father being killed when you’re still young. The tragic incident has brought you closer to your sisters, but your lives are uprooted again when vampires and humans start coming up dead. The same way your parents died.

title: Flupp the Fish
description: Play the three Adventures of Flupp, a tiny fish!

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Workplace Worries
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Relieve your stress by tearing up the workplace in these office themed tables!

title: Mistery
description:
Mistery is a multiplayer game of survival and social deduction. You work with others to collect materials, survive the dangers, and complete tasks. Beware of monsters, but more of the Alternates disguising as your teammates. They can change into supernatural monsters and attack you at any time.

The game seamlessly blends survival, top-down combat, social deduction, and new weird stories into a unique and visually striking experience, strengthed by a proximity chat system. Join forces with friends to destroy some friendships in Mistery!

title: Your Lucky Charm
description: Your Lucky Charm is a yuri comedy dating sim about finding luck (and love) in unexpected places.

title: The Good, the Bad, and the Horsey
description: Brittney hates her podunk, horse-crazy town almost as much as she hates horses themselves... but, with the town's traditional Silver Lasso Run only a month away, can she take this chance to finally grab the reins of her own destiny? Bounced between a good ol' Southern cowgal on the hunt for a dangerous criminal, a mysterious magical drifter with a dark secret, and a rogue centaur who lives by her own rules, Brittney is thrust into a fantastical alternate Wild West world... and has to choose between The Good, The Bad, and The Horsey!!

title: Evilmun Family 1.3.1 Water Update
description: Big - big water update in Evilmun! Now water is available in the Evilmun arena, which will add variety to the gameplay of the game! Drag and drop boxes in the water? See you in the online arena with water!

title: Evilmun Family 2.0
description: The game series is 3 years old, which means a global update for the entire series. New UI menu and new levels for both online and offline. Create your own levels with new tools. Good luck

title: Moonfall Voyage
description: In Moonfall Voyage, sailing is at the heart of exploration. Your goal is to free colossal guardians from a powerful curse. Each guardian you encounter offers unique sailing challenges and puzzles as you uncover the history of this world, and restore balance to the fragile realm.

title: Exit Veil
description:
In Exit Veil, players are cast in the role of Tori, a lost soul navigating her way through a beautiful and terrible world on the brink of decay.
Collect tarot cards and use them in tense MMO healer class-inspired turn-based battles, where you are always moments away from oblivion. Forever on the back foot you’ll have to test your resolve to snatch victory from the jaws of certain defeat.

title: Immune Simulator
description: Immune Simulator is a strategy-adventure game.

title: Growers
description: Growers is a chaotic platformer multiplayer PvP game in which players compete with each other to reach the light on a dark map, to transform into a monster and devour the others. Be the last standing to win!

title: Awakening
description: Put an end to the chaos in this 2D action platformer! Engage in hand-to-hand combat against the gangs of Everseam, earn upgrades, and take down bosses vying for control of the city

title: Fake Emperors
description: This game has more than 5 heroes and you switch between them. A comic story in a classic animation style. With more than 8000 hand-drawing animation frames. An adventure point & click game with many cut-scene animations. If you like cartoons nostalgia this is for you.

title: One Perfect Day
description:
One Perfect Day is a game that explores the topics of abuse and self-compassion. Encompassed in a first person puzzle adventure where players attempt to escape a time loop by solving non-linears puzzles in separate time periods with the use of chronological sequencing itself.

Explore Andy's alma matter and make use of a series of tools and memorabilia to help Andy discover the things that happened or could have happened and help him find his way to the truth of his past.

title: StickSpinner
description: "Challenging Action" meets "Party Game" for up to four players! Introducing our latest game where players navigate using rotating sticks and control their jumps based on stick angles. The unique feature that sets this game apart is the "Jump" mechanic, which also presents its greatest challenge.

title: Cards of Destiny
description: Cards of Destiny is a VR puzzle game that brings the tabletop experience to a unique interactive environment! Turn your inner child into a god as you draw one-time-use cards that can save or condemn the tiny humans on your desk – and the aliens chasing them. Adapt to different levels and situations as your randomized deck, ticking clock and looming alien threats all keep you on your feet!

title: Zombie Rollerz: The Last Ship
description: The Last Ship Take command of the last ship in a zombie-filled world and defend against endless waves of the undead. Build turrets, lead your crew, and upgrade the ship while gathering loot in this exciting "Tower Defense-on-wheels zombie survival roguelite" game.

title: Sleep: H Now
description: A game in which you can learn Linux commands while playing around.

title: Hokkaido: 4,500km
description: A train game where you set out to travel all over Hokkaido in the 1960s.

title: Day of the Toys
description:
80s horror movie mod. Find your son and escape a murderous toy holocaust.

The toys are relentless. Blast ’em, maim ’em, and set ’em ablaze!

title: Blood Rush
description: BLOOD RUSH is a fast paced, skill based FPS, mixed with roguelites elements. Upgrade yourself, buy unique guns, drain miracles from relics and destroy anyone or anything standing on your way!

title: Enraged Red Ogre
description:
In a faraway land, the yokai are suddenly rising and running out of control. A small human village is in danger, but Akaoni, a short-tempered red ogre that lives in it, is going on a rampage to defeat the yokai!

Run, jump and BASH as you travel around a mystique land based on old Japan eras with beautiful pixelart, exploring 9 different zones searching for relics that change the world around you with new paths.

title: Blood Golf
description: Blood Golf is a PVP or PVE golf-em-up where your target is the other player. Use powerups, map knowledge, and, most importantly, elegant combat-golf technique to turn your enemies into a fine mist or send them past the stratosphere. Has local multiplayer, or you can fight against the CPU.

title: Lucky Dog 1 + Bad Egg
description: Lucky Dog 1 + Bad Egg is both an "alternate reality" focusing on Gian x Bakshii and a fandisc of the original Luckydog1. The main game of Bad Egg focuses on Gian x Bakshii, whilst players can also read the after stories of Bernardo, Giulio, Ivan and Luchino that are set after their respective good endings from the first game.

title: Celebrity Kombat
description: Celebrity Kombat offers you a unique chance to fight as or against your favorite (or not) personality. With a diverse roster of characters, each with special abilities, prepare to battle in arenas filled with flair, humor, and audacity. Are you ready to settle the score? Join the ultimate showdown!

title: Project Colored Mountains
description: Project Colored Mountains is a 3D platformer game about a tiny little robot bouncing around a field (and a school, and a comically large grocery store...). Leap through a simulation and into real life while upgrading your abilities as well as defying the laws of physics. We really don't understand how this thing can bounce, stretch out and then jump again in midair. Also, you can roll around or something. Discover what those funny looking block things do, what those other funny block things do, and what those transparent funny block things do.

title: Cirno's Lost Chirumiru
description: Cirno was chilling with her Chirumiru, after drinking one, she goes to grab another and she realizes they are all gone. She takes it upon herself to get all her Chirumiru back and to find out who stole them.

title: Pauli's Adventure Island
description: Hop, dash, fly, and float your way through rolling hills, mysterious forests, dark caves, ancient temples, and more in this epic 2D side-scrolling platformer! Explore and collect all the stars in each level for extra lives, but beware of dangerous creatures: One false step, and you’ll get knocked back to square one!

title: Resident Fear: Redistribution
description: Step into the heart of fear in 'Resident Fear: Redistribution.' Survive the undead, solve puzzles, and unveil the sinister in this gripping horror adventure by Gamesoft Studio. Dare to play?

title: Oil Filling
description: Your job is to refuel and manage gas stations. One day, a zombie apocalypse happened. Zombies are coming, you have to deal with this!

title: Ocean Protector
description: Ocean Protector is a free online educational game that teaches students about the impacts of ocean acidification and how they can take action to prevent it.

title: Nemo is going to School
description: Our main character, Nemo, goes to school. He goes up and up, which is 351m above the sky. There's nothing else to do if you fall. Just to not be late, he have to go up without a break! There are dangerous things above. You have to hold back even if you're angry. Now, head to school!

title: Aatral
