description: In ancient India, King Vallaan ventures to an infected Eng Empire to rescue his queen, Alli. Evil powers and creatures control the land. Can Vallaan overcome the darkness and save his beloved, or will they both succumb to the sinister forces?

title: Agriculture Tractor Sim
description: Immerse yourself in the captivating realm of agriculture with "Agriculture Tractor Sim"

title: Fall of the Son
description: Fall Of The Son is a roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble powerful strategies to battle through hordes of enemies - with 3 playable characters and over 200 unique cards at your disposal. Do you have the grit and determination to make it to the end and face off against The Son?

title: Getting out Alive
description: A FPS modern time game.

title: Good Fruit
description: This is a simple casual game. The main content is to cut off various fruits that constantly pop up on the screen, which requires players to move quickly and accurately. Once the bomb is cut, the game ends.

title: Captain Kalani: Definitive Edition
description: Control the captain after receiving a distress call from the biggest Factory of robots of the world. Discover the utopian world that hide a big mystery, and find out who are the Robot's Syndicate behind the truoubles.

title: Juicy Ass
description: Juicy Ass is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Trainz Plus: Trainz Model Railroad - The Chuck Ewe Pharlie Railroad
description: The Chuck, Ewe & Pharlie Railroad serves a diverse range of industries and factories in the Smoke Stack industrial regions. These include a steel mill, timber wharf, dry sort yard and more. Two locomotive depots support both steam and diesel locomotives. Five sessions are included.

title: Bus Simulator 21: Next Stop - Official School Bus Extension
description: Attention all Angel Shores and Seaside Valley bus drivers! It's time to get back into the driver's seat and take on a new challenge as the new school year approaches. Transport your town's kids to their schools safely and in time for their lessons!

title: Kart Crazy Race Simulator Game
description: Fast and dynamic kart races, if you are craving it and looking for it, Kart Crazy Race Simulator will not make you bored.

title: Douyara Builder wo Yatteiru Oshi no V ni ha Watashi no Comment ga Hitsuyou-rashii-ken
description: A game in which you can play with your favorite V-tubers!

title: Memory: Unlocked
description: Memory: Unlocked is a short visual novel made for Velox Fabula 2023, a ranked jam about crafting a complete visual novel in 10 days, based on a community-determined theme.

title: Snow Angel
description:
"What if when you wished for something, someone answered?"

Snow Angel is a heart-warming love story between a human and an angel involving fluff, baking and falling snow. Pick your own pronouns and experience a charming tale within the alps.

title: Pokemon Daycare
description:
Pokémon Daycare was a submission for Relic Castle's Game Jam. Now that the Jam has officially ended, it gets posted to PokeCommunity!
Basically, you own a daycare, where trainers can drop off and pick up their Pokémon. Use the money you get to buy food for the checked in Pokémon or even upgrade the daycare itself. Sometimes you find eggs, which Trainers can adopt, but you never do find out where they come from.
Not really much of a plot to be honest. Trainers are random though, that's cool.

title: Monster Bark
description:
Bark the dog has been robbed by monsters. Monsters were always jealous about the great friends and sweet stuff Bark had, so they planned to steal it all from him in the middle of the night. Little do they know that Bark is the most courageous dog there is and he want all of his stuff back.

Help Bark regain all of his belongings and save his friends in the ultimate monster-maze puzzle adventure.

Just Have Fun!

title: Call of the Wild: The Angler - Deluxe Edition
description: Be free to fish where you choose in a unique and approachable open world fishing experience. Explore the great outdoors on your own or with friends and find the catch of a lifetime.

title: Cat Apartment
description: Cat Apartment is a 2.5D, swivel, find gameplay, dynamic cat hunt game where you need to take care of all the cats in the apartment. Find cute cats hidden in a relaxing apartment.

title: Quadroids
description: Quadroids is a mind-twisting pixel-art strategy puzzle platformer that disrupts the genre with a major twist. Players get to clear 100+ hazard-filled interconnected levels by coordinating their minions simultaneously across four screens.

title: The Third Age
description: Magical SLG Masterpiece Real Strategy & Exclusive Heroes Together into Battle.

title: Lone Fungus: Melody of Spores
description: Explore an interconnected mushroom world filled with secrets. Unite the mushroom tribes and experience the origin story of our hero Greencap that eventually leads to the events of the first game.

title: Shadows of Soldiers
description:
Shadows of Soldiers is a fast-paced online third-person tactical shooter built around intense cover-based combat, competitive PvP battles, squad teamwork, and futuristic military warfare.

Fight in action-packed multiplayer battles using advanced weapons, tactical movement, and strategic positioning to dominate the battlefield.

The game is already released, and we’re constantly working on new content, gameplay improvements, weapons, maps, and updates driven by community feedback.

If you enjoy tactical shooters, military combat games, and competitive team-based action — Shadows of Soldiers is for you.

title: World Ends Wednesday
description: Join Hazel on a quest to uncover a mysterious treasure before other like-minded adventurers reach it first. The key to your victory lies in the mastery of timing-based RPG combat!

title: Cozy Trip
description: Embark on a Cozy Trip like no other! Immerse yourself in the joy of exploration, tranquility, and discovery. Unwind and relax as you navigate the town and its enchanting forest, uncovering hidden treasures along the way. Experience the magic today!

title: Breaking Box: Walk
description: A physics puzzle game that can only walk!

title: Shine of Fullmoon
description: Shine of Fullmoon is a novel game where you interact with your friends in a peaceful Full Moon Village and continue your story by taking adventures thereafter. Let's choose what kind of stories you will continue with our unique friends and what kind of adventures you will take with them.

title: Sube
description: In this game, you will play a junior high school student who doesn't like learning, and all you have to do every day is go to school, finish school, and sleep.

title: ImpossiBowl
description: ImpossiBowl is a Chaotically Challenging Bowling Game with Platforming mechanics. Explore a variety of Weird Levels, Unlock new Balls and Powers on your journey to become the Champion!

title: Portals: Escape the Infinity
description: A transcendent point-and-click puzzle adventure. Can you escape 50 Portals?

title: Call of Sentinels
description: Call of Sentinels is an exciting action game where you will have to challenge real evil! Epic battles await you with hordes of diverse enemies and charismatic bosses that will not leave you indifferent.

title: Chez Croggy
description: Chef Croggy, AKA Croggster, AKA Croggison, is on the trip of a lifetime! Get ready for a gruesome, and rage inducing experience as you run, jump, and push your way through the wacky physics and camera angles Chez Croggy has to offer.

title: Dinobreak
description: Dinosaurs have returned in this retro survival horror crisis.

title: Stay Still 2
description: Welcome to Stay Still 2, a spine-chilling first-person survival horror game. Based of the Vietnamese culture, this game unfolds as a daring experiment in which survival seems nearly impossible. Engage in a story gameplay, where puzzles are your key to progress, while surviving various threats.

title: Hexagold
description: Turn based roguelike strategy. Explore hexagonal lands, recruit units, build defenses, grow farms to raise stable economy, loot mysterious artefacts and survive against this dangerous world.

title: The World is Drowning
description: The world is drowning, and everyone you know is gone. If you wish to survive, you'll have to climb to the moon. On your way up you’ll encounter many traps and monsters, but remember, you must never stop. The sea of blood is coming, and it will rob you of your final breath.

title: Kairai Inn
description: A score-attack action game where you aim for high scores by subduing dangerous "kairai."

title: Call of the Wild: The Angler - Launch Edition
description: Be free to fish where you choose in a unique and approachable open world fishing experience. Explore the great outdoors on your own or with friends and find the catch of a lifetime.

title: Ancient Weapon Holly
description: After tens of thousands of years, the ancient weapon Holly awakens, starting her revenge against humanity. Experience the strategy of creating pitfalls to trap enemies and the exhilaration of burying them alive. Dive into intense combat!

title: Slightly Overweight Superhero and the Seven Levels of Death
description: You're an average guy, traveling a Neon futuristic Wasteland. Survive the story between life, and the Seven levels of Death.

title: Air Fleet
description: Build your dream airline with Air Fleet! Plan routes, Expand your fleet, Organize flights around the world and Build a successful airline company!

title: 13 Playing Cards of Demon
description: This is a strategy game. Collect and use demon‘s poker skills (similar to Texas Poker rules), regular card skills, abilities, and equipment to defeat enemies.

title: Psyche60s
description: Immerse yourself in Psyche60s, an innovative experience that takes you back to San Francisco in the 1960s. Created by renowned photographer Roberto Rabanne, Psyche60s features unique artwork, original music, and rich historical insights. Experience a paradigm-shifting cultural "Youthquake"!

title: Greedy Chicken
description: Greedy Chicken is a 3D arcarde "endless-runner" type of game where you need to lead small chicken through the numerous obstacles, highway passes and collect as many coins as you can.

title: Darkless
description: Nameless embodies a mischievous ghost who after a terrible curse has been placed on him, locking him in a lamp. It will be your purpose to recover your ghostly body by traveling through all the corners of the Silent Mansion in a platform and puzzle game.

title: Jigsaw-Land
description: A relaxing puzzle game with procedurally generated puzzle of different natural biomes.

title: The Encounter
description: This game tells the story of a Chinese family who inexplicably disappeared in 1999. Afterwards, a journalist was sent by the TV station to investigate and visit this incident and the subsequent events. The final outcome will be unimaginable to you! Looking forward to your experience!

title: Half Alive
description: Half Alive is a Low Poly Multiplayer FPS Game. Survive each round of zombies after which a more difficult round begins. Enlarge your playing area and your weapons backpack to provide yourself good chances of survival!

title: Vaccine Rebirth VR
description: Enter once again into the world of Survival Horror, this time in VR.

title: Archetype Blue
description: Archetype Blue is a rogue-lite deck building game where you form your own adventure team and deck before facing the challenges this fantasy world has in store for you. With all the options in front of you and the circumstances surrounding your expedition, do you have any chance of succeeding?

title: The Great Below
description: Immerse yourself in a haunting map-based horror experience. Break free from the loop and the mansion where you find yourself while unveiling the secrets underneath it all. The Society expects something from you but are you ready to face the consequences?

title: Burden of the Blue
description: Explore, solve puzzles and fight in order to uncover the burdens of the past.

title: Jack Dragon
description: Jack Dragon is a retro love letter to 80s arcade videogaming. Collect all of the gem pieces to progress to the next level. Avoid touching the nasties. Collect the snowflake power up to freeze enemies in place (you are an ice dragon, after all!). Just jump, hover and collect! Sounds easy, right?

title: Rage of Towers
description: Rage of Towers is a modern Realistic Tower defense game. Typically, you build towers on the path to destroy enemies before they reach the end, But what if you could take control of the tower by yourself and feel the battlefield.

title: Zed Patrol
description: Zed Patrol is a co-op 3D top-down zombie shooter that puts you in the middle of a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the undead. Your squad's mission: to take out the four bosses and retrieve the keycards to save the city. But with hordes of zombies around every corner, it won't be easy!

title: Incubus Quest
description: When the succubi's ambush almost annihilates all of the incubi, a miracle happens and you're able to fight them back. It's now up to you to finally end this feud between the races and bring peace back to the land!

title: Alien Investigator
description: Alien investigator is a 4 player online co-op horror game. Join a team of investigators and use all your alien expert equipment to gather as much evidence as you can. Learn extraterrestrial facts based on photos, videos and real life eyewitness accounts.

title: Chromaticasters
description: Chromaticasters is a chaotically cute co-op dungeon crawler where you and up to 3 friends play as unique spell-slinging animals! Combine elemental magic with your friends to crush hordes of enemies, traverse dangerous environments, and strengthen your spells in this action-packed roguelike!

title: Valerosa
description: Put yourself in the role of the courageous women and discover the challenges they had to face throughout the different eras. Fight for the fundamental rights of women in Argentina, choosing your arguments wisely and responding in the best way to win the debate.

title: Just Find It 3
description: Explore hidden variations and engage with exciting new challenges in Just Find It 3!

title: Scary Loop
description: You're stuck in a scary loop, where you get scared in loop or something like that and you must escape the loop

title: Super Spy Raccoon
description: Your mission, if you choose to accept it, is to acquire all classified documents as you venture deeper and deeper into enemy territory. Hide, sneak, climb, and leap your way to victory!

title: Up N' Down
description: Up N' Down is a multiplayer racing game where you have to use items to your advantage. Race to the top, grab the crown and find a safe way down to the finish line.

title: Legacy's Allure
description: Legacy's Allure is a customizable, card-based wargame with no randomness. Command warriors, beasts, and mages on the battlefield to outplay your opponent in this chess-inspired fantasy battle.

title: Sociable Soccer 24
description: Sociable Soccer 24 is the exhilarating, cross-platform, arcade football franchise. Designed by Sensible Soccer creator Jon Hare, this former title on Apple Arcade has fast-paced, arcade-style intuitive gameplay, with multiplayer head-to-head matches and collectible player cards.

title: Cyberjump
description: Cyberjump is a fast paced 2D cyberpunk-themed platformer game where you need to jump on platforms that appear only for a short time and avoiding deadly traps, keeping track of the time of existence of the platforms and think over the movements in advance so as not to fall down.

title: Anlife: Motion-Learning Life Evolution
description: Intervene in the evolution of virtual lifeforms that learn to move in a world powered by a physics engine. This world already features built-in mechanisms like heredity and natural selection. The player acts as a creator, manipulating these natural processes to help lifeforms learn and evolve.

title: Uncult
description: 'Uncult' is a pixel RPG where the protagonist, the daughter of a cult leader, suffers from amnesia after an accident in a fanatical pseudo-religious group. Now, she must piece together her obscured past, facing numerous challenges and uncovering the truth. Your decisions will shape her destiny.

title: Fantasy Monster Clicker
description: Are you bored? Then step into the world of Fantasy Monster Clicker! Enjoy and explore a world full of upgrades, levels, monsters and bosses.

title: The Sheriff's Town
description: The Sheriff's Town is a game where you control a sheriff to exterminate hordes of zombies.

title: Dagger Directive
description: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

title: Livestream 2: Escape from Togaezuka Happy Place
description: Can you escape the horror of being hunted down...? The sequel to the survival horror game "Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami" is now available!

title: Find Up!
description: Find the differences between two images. Export images as wallpapers. Built-in game editor allows players to make their own game content. Support Steam workshop to share the ugc content.

title: Fantasy Kommander: Eukarion Wars
description: Immerse yourself in the epic battles of Fantasy Kommander, a turn-based strategy game set in a European fantasy world. Lead your armies, master the battle system, and unravel the captivating storyline across four campaigns filled with heroes, quests, and powerful enemies.

title: Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator
description: Experience the thrill of sniping in the Wild West! Realistic FPS experience awaits you with Sniper Wild West Shooting Simulator. Shoot your enemies with one shot and become the best sniper.

title: Apothecary
description: A cute story-driven zen puzzler in which you brew potions, customize your workshop, and interact with the quirky residents of the magical town of Mangrove.

title: Cellosseum
description: Cellosseum is a bullet heaven following the progress of a lone cell as it battles a variety of enemies on its quest to guide the evolutionary process of life itself. Upgrade your attacks, shields, health, and speed to understand your role in the creation of life on the planet of Ceres Prime.

title: DanceDouDoou
description: DanceDouDoou is a rhythm /Beat/Dance Simulation Game where you,and your fellow animals can practice dance move By Mouse Click and Drag.Players will witness how goofy Fellows can move theire body,and Smashing variaty of Items to make Noises. Just Dance around on Stage and,Have Fun!

title: Destroy Korcity
description: Tower shooting game with cool music and endless enemies

title: Springtime Hike
description: Experience the beauty of spring and the wonders of the forest in Springtime Hike. Explore hidden locations, uncover the secrets of nature, and complete the ultimate hike. Your journey begins now.

title: The Mythical City
description: Protect the magic crystal, to which waves of enemies are coming!

title: Egg Drop
description: Flutter around to dodge falling eggs from chickens above, and collect corn and power ups to drop eggs on the unlucky fowl below!

title: Little Wing
description: Embark on a dangerous journey through the wilderness, searching for the Little Wing, atop the Mountain - in this challenging and charming platformer. Brave levels with many dangers, with tight and precise jumping, stamina management and attacks. Can you find the Little Wing?

title: Super Gorilla Quest
description: A comedic gorilla RPG wherein you must save all life from humanity through intense combat.

title: Pool Lounge
description: Welcome to Pool Lounge! Play the game mode you want. Traditional 8-Ball, Blackball and 9-Ball!

title: Day 10,909
description: One day, a light falls from the sky! For 10909 days, everything in your life seemed completely normal, until suspicion suddenly arose. You decide to escape the set and journey to Fiji to find your first love, who said that everything is a show.

title: First Strike: Multiplayer
description: The multiplayer mode for First Strike is here! Wage nuclear war against other players from all over the world and nuke the Earth into nuclear Armageddon together. Will you be the last one remaining when the whole world blows to smithereens?

title: Rumia Throws!
description: Throw! Kick! Ride!A 2D action game where Touhou's Rumia goes wild throwing things!

title: Jack Holmes: Master of Puppets - Prologue
description: In this prologue you will step into the shoes of little Eddie, a 12 year old boy who goes to the amusement park with his parents until what would be a fun day out turns into a nightmare. Experience the terrifying atmosphere of what awaits you in Jack Holmes: Master of Puppets!

title: Logic Colors
description: Logic Colors is Indie Logic Game in which You move color tiles to solve riddles. Discover rules and relax in 225 unique levels and unlock all items in game! Will You finish them perfectly?

title: Sweet Neighbors
description: "Sweet Neighbors" is a visual novel for adults only. The main character Ethan moves to a new neighborhood and becomes involved in a love triangle with young Ava and her mother Olivia. He faces a difficult choice - who to stay with and who to lose.

title: Devil Peach Soda
description: Carve your way through a twisted and demonic manor in this fast paced roguelike. Devil Peach Soda combines quick arcade gameplay and RPG mechanics, featuring a variety of ways to build and customize your character each run.

title: ZomWick
description: Zomwick is a unique non-violent 3D tower defense game where the objective is to outlast enemies by using tactics and upgrades instead of using lethal brute force. It's addictive, challenging, and requires resourcefulness to survive.With free content updates, it's a must-play for TD fans.

title: Spaceminers
description: Welcome to the world of Spaceminers and our exclusive pre-alpha release Spaceminers: Gold Runner. This thrilling game mode serves as the first step in your journey towards becoming a skilled Spaceminer.

title: Planeticus
description: Planeticus is a 2D multiplayer space strategy game about capturing planets and allocating resources. Capture as many planets as possible to breed invaders. Conquer the whole space!

title: Crossroad of Worlds: Star Riddle - Collector's Edition
description: Continue your detective journey and stop the star thefts! There is no peace for the magical stars of the worlds. Draw out all of the secrets from a captured villain and find the true mastermind behind the vile conspiracy!

title: Kanosen: My Girlfriend is a Naughty Teacher
description: Hatori Yuu has a problem: his sex drive is so ridiculously strong it's disrupting his day to day life. Lucky for him, Kaori-sensei is determined to help him enjoy his school life! And so begins their secretive school affair...

title: Fera: The Sundered Tribes
description: Fera: The Sundered Tribes is an enthralling mixture of monster hunting action RPG with village building and tribe management in a unique post-apocalyptic fantastical world of untamed magic and ancient secrets.

title: Pirate Booty and the Bukkake Buccaneer
description: Spread your seed across the seven seas! Your first-mate staged a mutiny, taking off with your precious ship. You'll have to build up a loyal crew, one slut at a time, to take back your ship and get revenge on the wench who took it from you in the first place!

title: Helltrench
description: Delve into the Helltrench as the T.O.N, a ship that thrusts with its shots. In this shoot to move action rogue-like, conquer the depths with your slick maneuvering skills until you've reached the end.

title: Manga Maker's Mega Milkers
description: Your favorite lewd artist has a proposition for you: Show her your cock, and she'll show you her tits. Continue to collaborate with Yuko, exploring each other's fantasies to collect erotic reference material for her big manga debut!

title: Cold Shot
description: Play the role of a contract killer that must perform a job during a cold night. The target is Spencer York, an apparently ordinary man living on the outskirts of a rural town. After driving for hours, everything is settled up to end the job fast. You only have to pull the trigger one more time, like the countless times you did before.

title: Oh, Yes! Kasshoku Hitozuma no Seiyoku Kaishou ~Ero Ero Dekiru Mama-san Volley Kai~
description:
I broke the cherished glass of my mother’s. As a punishment, I was made to serve and do odd chores for a fixed period in the volleyball club, my mother does as a hobby.

But perhaps, might not there be some young married woman and elder sisters among them!
…While I carried such hope, there was no one except typical aunts.
There was not even a fragment of elder sister types among anyone I looked at.

title: Golden Idol Mysteries: The Lemurian Vampire
description: Unravel the truth of an ancient civilisation, lost in time through three brand-new scenarios, filled with death, deceit, and ancient rituals.

title: Rugrats: Adventures in Gameland
description: A baby-fresh take on retro-inspired gameplay, featuring a unique co-op design, where kids and parents need to stick together to win!

title: Undefeated: Genesis
description: The ultimate superhero experience. Fly freely and unleash your awesome powers as you battle violent mutants to save an alien planet.

title: G.I. Joe: Wrath of Cobra
description: Yo Joe! Cobra returns once again with its most fiendish plot yet and it's up to G.I. JOE to defeat them once more! Pick one of the real American heroes, gear up, and get straight into the fight in this retro side-scrolling beat 'em up - and make Cobra RETREAT yet again!

title: Geo Mythica
description: Embark on an 8-bit style JRPG quest to save Earth. Battle in unique party-based combat mixing real-time action and strategic commands. Join Gio and a team of lively characters as they unearth bizarre global events, forgotten legends, and battle mythical foes to unveil the secrets of Geo Mythica.

title: Just Crow Things
description: Play as a cute crow, fly around town, poop on people, and steal their shiny trinkets! In this sandbox-y adventure game, help your animal friends create adorable chaos and have a beak-tastic time customizing your adorable crow appearance! Why? Just caws!

title: Sei Shoujo Sentai Lakers II
description: The sequel to Sei Shōjo Sentai Lakers directly continues the story from the previous game. Akira and his team of school girls with supernatural powers have repelled Galvan's forces and protected the Laker Crystals. However, a new adversary named Rayott appears on the stage. Obtaining his power from Leticia, the former commander of the Gadram Empire, Rayott intends to use the power of the crystals in order to invade Earth.

title: Sei Shoujo Sentai Lakers III
description: In the sequel to Sei Shōjo Sentai Lakers II Akira and his team have successfully fended off Rayott's assault and are enjoying a brief peaceful time. However, an enigmatic masked enemy known as Neos Bullard appears on the stage. Aiming to capture the power of Laker crystals, Neos Bullard and his minions invade Earth, taking the Lakers by surprise.

title: Rapz
description: Rapz! is about a young girl, Rapulani, with a magical afro who must endure many great obstacles and a gauntlet of an adventure with her magical hair, just to get through the day. You must help Rapulani navigate her complicated 5 year old life and her wild hair as she tries to get through the day in order to make it to a friends’ birthday party. Good luck!

title: Yugekitai Kakuto-hen: Saikyoushin Fukkatsu no Maki
description: This is a fighting game from a doujin developer that did a number of games involving the comically-deformed gang that stars in this one. Lots of humor value.

title: The Villainess Just Wants to Eat!!
description: Life’s greatest pleasures are food and fantasy manhwa. When reading, you can drool over hot characters and delicious looking food. After a late night of reading your favorite manhwa, you fall into the land of sleep and dream of being the fiance of the prince…only it isn't a dream! You’ve been reincarnated as the villainess! Will you be able to survive and live your dream of eating delicious food, or will you suffer the deadly fate of all villainesses?

title: Takamori Puzzle
description: A puzzle-story fan game about Calli & Kiara from Hololive.

title: Cute Blocks
description: Cute Blocks.This is a simple arkanoid game. Shoot down blocks with a constantly moving ball and do not let it fly down.

title: D3L3T3.exe
description: Racing against time, a guy wanders around a graveyard on the middle of nowhere, searching for something that may break a deadly curse. Among murders and secrets, only darkness is certain.

title: Cupid Bistro!! Max
description: This rerelease of Cupid Bistro!! updates the game with additional in-game content, including the ability to build a larger and more expansive restaurant.

title: A Little to the Left: Deep Clean
description: These new food-themed Snack Pack levels come as part of the Deep Clean update, which also adds two new puzzle types into the Daily Tidy mode and a fan-requested Archive mode.

title: PowerWash Simulator: The Muckingham Files 2
description: Three new filthy maps have arrived in PowerWash Simulator in the latest instalment of The Muckingham Files; a series of free content updates expanding the game’s original universe. Whilst residents dish the dirt on your favourite town’s antics, you’ll be busy cleaning up their messes as you're tasked with de-dirtying an Excavator, a Spanish Villa and a Paintball Arena.

title: Cupid Bistro!! 2
description: Cupid Bistro!! 2 has the player returning to the world of magical cooking. Like in the last game, players manage a magical restaurant in a business simulation; to obtain ingredients, they can venture forth in the game's RPG mode. It features a new cast of romanceable women and a new battle system compared to the original game.

title: Godzilla Voxel Wars
description: Get ready to battle using your brain! A full-fledged turn-based strategy game with a difficulty level: GODZILLA! Godzilla, Mothra, King Ghidorah, and more are here to rampage across an 8x8 grid! Control Toho monsters and save the world from the Fungoid mushroom invasion!

title: He Watches Me
description:
He's watching me... I know he is. As soon as I feel his eyes on me my heartbeat quickens and I grab my chest, trying to control my breathing. This isn't good for my condition... I'm so anxious and stiff. This happens every day. I don't know what I should do to make him stop... please. I just want him to stop...

Sara only wants a simple life at school but when her classmate Tyler keeps watching her from the back of the room she just can't ignore it. She's tried, but something just, isn’t right...

title: What the Golf? A Hole New World
description: Holes? In golf? We thought they would be a nice addition to the game so we added about a thousand of them (more or less). Enjoy lots of hole-some new levels that are all about holes.

title: What the Golf? It's Snowtime
description: Complete with snowpals, moose, cars, ice cubes and pizza of course. We even added snow to make it look like golf.

title: Flowers of Starlight
description:
Aster's a simple girl, at her core. All she really wants to do is enjoy her new life at uni, join a club, and spend every possible waking moment playing Magica Fantasia Online (she's not addicted) with her online crush Starsiren.

She's gonna tell her, OK? Just... when they meet up for MagiCon. Honest.

However, a teeny tiny complication arises on her first day at uni, when Aster just so happens to bump into Maristela, the single prettiest girl she's ever seen in her entire life.

And she's not just pretty. Mari's smart, she's funny, and Aster would happily listen to her ramble for hours about whatever the heck she wants to, if only she had a little more courage to do so.

Torn between the friend she's loved forever, and the new girl who it feels like she's always known, Aster faces the toughest decision imaginable, and she's not even been here for a week!

A game about love, new experiences, and the fact that nerdy neurodivergent girls are cute and you should date them.

title: The Winter Games
description: On a cold winter night, the worst members of the naughty list find themselves abducted to the North Pole and forced to play in a series of death games run by a mysterious evil woman claiming to be Santa. Why are they here, and will they survive?

title: High School Daze: Junior Year
description:
The most stressful year of high school is also the most fun to be had if you can balance classes, extracurriculars, and the oh-so elusive social life.

You’re a high school junior starting the second quarter, who until now has made decent grades, held your own on the girls’ weightlifting team, and been through thick and thin with your supportive best friend, Billie Stevenson.

But maybe it’s time to switch things up and cross a few things off your bucket list? After all, there’s more to life than straight As, and maybe old and new friendships can blossom into something more.

title: High School Daze: Afterschool Stories
description: There's no room for lazy weekend plans when your best friend's family requests your help with their garage sale. But it's not a completely bad time!

title: Exelio
description: In "Exelio," you'll face an ever-changing environment and various threats while acquiring the knowledge and skills needed to survive in uncharted lands. Explore a world where beautiful nature and harsh realities collide, and delve into its mysteries as you carve out your own fate.

title: Useless Demon Lord
description:
Lucille is an unemployed single woman living alone in her apartment, stewing in feelings of anxiety and inadequacy... but then without warning and due to a rather strange magical mix-up, she is summoned to be the new Demon Lord in another world!

The demons aren't doing so well lately, and they're now relying on their new boss to return them to their glory days. Will Lucille be able to take this as an opportunity for a fresh start and thrive even in a world that wants her dead, or will she crumble under the pressure and return to her old shut-in ways?

title: Old Gay Cats Look at Old Photos
description: A little Visual Novel about two Old Gay Cats [Named Romeo and Juliet] looking at Old Photos!

title: Dark Auction
description: The game is a mystery adventure centering on the idea of a historical figure having surreptitiously bequeathed a fictitious estate, following the drama that plays out among the characters faced with an enigma extending all the way into their modern world.

title: I Miss When the Internet Was Chronological
description: searching the internet for traces of a long gone tumblr blog. a short bitsy game about holding on to deleted memories, the ephemeral nature of the digital landscape (and tumblr’s golden era).

title: Iceman
description: The first and only game announced by Datura Studios, was made by past Infogrames employees. Announced as a local multiplayer game for the Gamecube, PS2, original Xbox, and Windows, the game progressed to about 80% completed, but was cancelled when Datura couldn't find a publisher and went out of business.

title: 3D Monster Maze
description: A fan remake of the classic ZX Spectrum game featuring enhanced mazes, items, and full color graphics

title: Abst Clicker Farm
description: Compete with other players in the leaderboard in terms of both total clicks and clicks per second.

title: SnL
description: The essence of the game is very simple and understandable even to younger children.

title: Imemo
description: You assign the number of blocks and create a game field where you need to find paired images.

title: Robo Run
description: Robo Run - This is an adventure game on the speed of reaction.

title: This Picture
description: This picture is a puzzle game of folding parts of the image of the whole picture.

title: Fruit Mess
description: A distinctive feature is the construction of objects not only horizontally or vertically but also diagonally.

title: Sonic McOrigins
description: Sonic McOrigins is a fanmade remake collection of the Sonic Heroes McDonalds LCD games.

title: Lucha Masters StickerMania
description:
Lucha Masters StickerMania is an action and platform game, you will play with Lucho, a small axolotl with a big dream, be a Luchador.
Lucho meddles in a new problem, mistakenly releases the god of jokes Mexica, a coyote, the god Huehuecoyotl, who for fun makes a joke: Destroy reality.

You will enter a world of video games and you will visit several cities in Mexico to prevent the Coyote's plan.

You will not be alone in this adventure, you will be able to play with professional Wrestlers such as the Legend Octagon , the Son of Octagon, Coco Rojo Segundo, Dr. Karonte Jr. and many more. Rudos and Técnicos come together to stop this threat.

Face monsters like the Mummies of Guanajuato, the Witch of Catemaco, the Vampire of Guadalajara, La Llorona and many more.

Will you have enough courage to stop a god, become a Luchador and eat many chilaquiles?

Get ready to be a Lucha Master.

title: Dyatlov Canyon
description: This is a collection of seven vanilla compatible maps, with slightly more focus on story.

title: Afternoon
description: Afternoon is a boom-compatible speedmap project by Ludi and their friends. There are 15 maps in total, and one should expect a strong variety of gameplay styles and visuals going in. The difficulty generally scales from IWAD difficulty to Scythe 2, but great care has been given to pacing and making sure each map flows in a cohesive manner.

title: Hysteria in Howlsbend
description: Set in a colonial-era New England town driven to hysteria when a beloved member of the community is afflicted by a witch. The player leads the witch hunt by having typed one-on-one conversations with a cast of characters powered by GPT-3.

title: Serenade
description: A vanilla Doom 2 megawad consisting of 32 maps. Following the same basic premise as Silence, I intend to replace the original game in the style of Doom 2 the Way Id Did, but with that in mind I think it's still important to note that this gets a fair bit harder than Silence and Doom 2.

title: Princess of Nothing
description: Simple little F/F fantasy I made in a day to test out RPG Maker MV. Might expand on it, might not. Have fun.

title: Pillow Talk at the End of All Things.
description:
A calm and quiet night in Rio de Janeiro.

That is until you hear a shot. And another. And yet another one. The timing gets faster, with more shots, shots with different sounds. You wake up and realize something is happening in the favela nearby. Either gang violence or state violence, you never really know.

That's the same situation where Lenon finds herself for the first time, and now it's up for her "friend" Graves to help her not to panic. It's just another night in Rio, and you know things will move on as always after that.

Pillow Talk at the end of all things is a small yuri visual novel about trying to get calm during a time when violence is commonplace, and expected. Follow Lenon and Graves during what is just another night in the Cidade Maravilhosa.

title: You're Cookin', Good Lookin'!
description:
You're Cookin', Good Lookin' is a 2D fighting game!

This game was created for Yuri Jam 2022. Mio and Beatriz are a married couple who, despite both being professionals in the cullinary industry, are fighting to decide who's cooking dinner tonight!

title: I Became a Proper Member and Got a Girlfriend
description:
Hikigaya Komori grew up in the middle of nowhere and learned everything she knows about human behavior and social dynamics from reading books and playing dating sims. Once, she went to a restaurant with her parents and said 'Thanks, you too!' to a waiter who told her to enjoy her meal. ...She hasn't had the courage to show her face there since. But fortune is a fickle mistress, and much to the chagrin of her and her classmates, she's found herself in the window seat at the back of the classroom normally set aside for the main character. And when one misunderstanding leads to another, she briefly considers writing an autobiography and titling it 'A Series of Unfortunate Events,' copyright be damned.

Kohinata Koharu is the former student council president and resident popular girl, considered mysterious by some and out of reach to all. It was by sheer happenstance she passed by Komori's classroom when she did, inadvertently saving her from the wonton wrath of her peers. But an accident is just fate by another name, and on a whim, she takes a blossoming interest in the other... with no ulterior motives whatsoever. Setting aside the fact that Komori doesn't believe in genuine altruism, she can't figure out why someone at the top of the pecking order would rub shoulders with a lowly ant like her... But for the longest time, she has wanted to change... if only she could. Now that she can, the opportunity is paired with the harrowing realization that rest of her youth depends on Koharu's opinion of her. When she said "this couldn't possibly get any worse!!", that wasn't a challenge, you know!!! So it's easier said than done... but that doesn't mean she doesn't want to try! After all, this is the kind of once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that someone like her could only dream of!!

Will Komori be able to grow out of her shell, or will her life turn into a tragedy worthy of Shakespeare himself? Can she really get through all the items on her 'how to properly enjoy my youth! ♡' checklist when it's been untouched for over a year?? A thriving social life might be a bit of a stretch, but surely, she can manage to make a few friends, right?

...Right??

title: Blasé Ace
description:
Anime clichés just don't hit the same when you're sex-averse. Maybe you're not bawling over how this guy slipped face-first into your crotch. You might not even be disturbed, just...like...confused?

Join NB student Beverly Nicks on a short, funny, positive, be-yourselfy kind of a journey.

title: Gordy and the Monster Moon
description: Gordy and the Monster Moon is a bite-sized exploration-driven game about a pumpkin astronaut going on spooky adventures.

title: Mouthwashing
description: The five crew members of The Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

title: EA Sports WRC
description:
EA Sports WRC boasts 10 current WRC, WRC2, and Junior WRC vehicles and 68 of the most iconic rally cars spanning 60 years of the sport.

Working together with official WRC teams and manufacturers, such as Ford, Toyota, and Hyundai, each vehicle is built to tackle every challenge they'll face throughout the season. The hybrid-powered 4WD Rally1 cars are some of the fastest in the sport's history, capable of incredible speeds while tackling gravity-defying jumps, deteriorating surfaces, and adverse weather.

title: Tempest Enterprise
description: Tempest Enterprise is a new episode for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports made by various members of Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz.

title: Art of Speed
description: A game made for the speedrunning community. Fight through the enemies and parkour on platforms to finish the maps as soon as possible.​

title: Cory in the Ded 3.5
description: Cory in the Ded 3.5 is the next evolution in gaming, featuring a whopping nine playable characters with the most revolutionary gameplay of all time.

title: Minecraft Lockout
description: Minecraft Lockout is a minigame mod for Minecraft. 2 teams are given a set of 25 randomized tasks to do in a world and they have to race each other until one team completes 13 goals.

title: Kisou Shinden: Gen-Kaiser
description:
A scientist named Zen Shiratori was investigating the ruins of an ancient Mayan temple, convinced that the proof of the existence of a parallel world lies there. He found a strange glowing orb, which was later accidentally discover by his fourteen-year-old son Gen, who was rummaging through Dad's collection. As a result, Gen was indeed teleported into a parallel world. There, he meets a young girl named Rinna, who tells him that he is, in fact, "Gen-Kaiser", the much-expected savior of their world. Piloting giant combat robots, the two must protect the innocents of that world and defeat evil.

Kisō Shinden: Gen-Kaiser is a turn-based strategy/RPG hybrid (what is commonly called in Japan a "tactical RPG"). There is overworld navigation, and the player can also visit and explore cities; however, these features are rather rudimentary, and hostile areas cannot be explored in real time and are presented as large-scale strategic battles. The characters move in turns over the top-down battlefield and attack when enemies are in range. Animations are displayed for each attack, and experience points are awarded for successful elimination of an enemy.

title: XF Extreme Formula
description: Race at the speed of sound and beyond in the great XF Extreme Formula championship!

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed: Spongebob Racing Season
Hot Wheels Unleashed: Street Fighter Ryu
For a Reason
description:
For A Reason is a sapphic visual novel set in a witch's academy setting featuring two playable characters and one route for each character. Talk to your crush, solve a mystery, and... drink some juice?

Play as Jane Laguerre, a member of arts and performance club who doesn't have the guts to even walk on the stage, and help navigate her way to confess to her idol. Or play as Lora Wiley and have a cute totally-not-date with her 'friend' who is better than her in every way!

title: Insanity Edged
description: Insanity Edged is a GZDoom mod for Doom 2 with 3 playable maps, a new set of weapons, and a cinematic story line. It takes place in the same universe as Winter's Fury.

title: Aster
description: Aster is a classic arcade style shooter, with fast action, aliens, (and sex). Earth is fighting a losing battle against aliens from another galaxy, and things are looking bleak. In a desperate gambit, Earth's military calls upon a hired gun to turn the tide.

title: Even More Bloons
description: Play Even More Bloons now! While away the time popping another 50 levels of Ninja Kiwis Bloons game. Enjoy the new helium bloons, as well as the angled rubber blocks for crazy bounce fun!

title: Desktop Agents: Covid-999
description: Consider wearing a mask to play. A virtual alien virus COV1D-999 uses dramatic scenes from movies and series in order to conquer your PC. Interact with your desktop while playing, watch Youtube videos, chat with your friends and more! Wash your hands after playing.

title: Three Minutes With Your Dog
description: Play with your trusty dog today! The sky is clear, the sun is shining and oh cool, theres a dog walking his huma-

title: Thinkin' Things: All Around Frippletown
description: Thinkin' Things Frippletown offers age-appropriate activities that allow students to explore and practice various thinking strategies, including analyzing attributes, using logic, working backwards, identifying multiple solutions, and practicing creativity.

title: Aries
description:
A fallen angel studying in a "special angel school" to become independent has to go to earth to study the behavior of regular humans.

This particular angel doesn't understand love well, and comes to live a happy campus life with the protagonist to better her understanding of it.

title: Hugo: Jungle Island 1
description: The friendly troll Hugo's arch-enemy, the evil witch Scylla, has moved to a jungle island, where she teamed up with the local tyrant Don Croco. Scylla then once again kidnapped Hugo's wife Hugolina and the children, but this time she keeps them captive in a cage in her new lair, located at a top of volcano in the center of the island. Control Hugo, aided by the monkey Jean Paul and the toucan Ferdinand, as you need to complete a series of minigames to reach and defeat the witch and free Hugo's family.

title: Shrink Assault
description: Shrink Assault is a Sci-Fi game featuring a mix of Infinite Runners and Rail Shooter games. Skilfully control your spaceship to dodge obstacles and shoot enemies.

title: Another Happiness
description: Minimalist RPG Maker conversational game

title: Villa de la Muerte
description: This was a map originally made for a vaguely spain/syringe inspired project but, decided after some time to release on its own.

title: The Noose
description:
"My older sister killed me.
My younger sister hung me.
I killed my older sister."

This was... everything her dead brother wrote in his diary.
He'd said he'd be right back, but he never returned.
Shortly after, they found his bloody hat.

title: Borderlands Collection: Pandora's Box
description:
For the first time ever, get all six Borderlands adventures together in one mayhem-fueled package, all at an incredible value!

Includes all six acclaimed base games from the Borderlands franchise: Borderlands, Borderlands 2, Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel, Tales from the Borderlands, Borderlands 3, and New Tales from the Borderlands, as well as all of their add-on content, in one giant bundle.

title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden - Red Echoes Edition
description: The Red Echoes Edition of Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden contains: an ancient, leather-effect notebook illustrated with Red's memories, an ink writing set, the game on the platform of your choice and the Wanderer Set DLC!

title: Street Fighter V: Lucia
description: This DLC adds Lucia as a fighter.

title: Street Fighter V: Poison
description: This DLC adds Poison as a fighter.

title: Mutant Express
description: This is a platform jumping game for delivering goods in a limited time category. Players need to avoid obstacles, mechanisms, and monsters along the way, and can kill them. Completing challenging levels within a limited time will earn rewards, but there will be no rewards beyond that time.

title: Terminal Theatre Soft
description: Probably as long as a place buries a corpse, it will really bind a living person.I would look back without hesitation, because when we walked together through the cold and wet mansion, I saw all the lives we spent together, and in the last moment, I chose to remember.

title: Misty Islands
description: A mysterious shipwreck, an uninhabited island, a box of mysterious goods, and a survival adventure

title: Street Fighter V: E.Honda
description: This DLC adds Honda as a fighter.

title: Descriptionary
description:
Descriptionary is like a classic drawing board game, but the roles are reversed; instead of drawing something based on a prompt while others guess what you’re drawing, you’re given a vague description of something and then you have to guess what you were supposed to be drawing!

Join our bunny-themed cast featuring a wide variety of characters who all need your help! Try to navigate their individual mannerisms in order to depict what they’re trying to describe, all under a time limit.

title: Arcade Archives: Cadash
description:
"CADASH" is an action RPG game released by TAITO in 1989.
The player chooses one of four heroes and sets out on a journey to rescue Princess Sarasa, who has been taken by the evil Barrog.
Buy key items and equipment at the shops along the way, and don’t forget to explore: NPCs are on hand to offer useful hints along the way!

title: Troopers
description: A singleplayer first-person shooter in a low poly art! Play epic matches in different game modes, rank up and unlock new weaponskins, attachments and weapons.

title: River Pirates
description:
Easy to play Tower Defense game with a pirates setting.

River Pirates has an invading horde of pirates sailing up river to attack your stronghold. You defend your keep by placing a variety of defenses along the river's banks to prevent the pirates from navigating the river from one side of the screen to the other.

title: Overpass 2
description: Identify the best routes and balance of power, speed and precision to overcome obstacles at the controls of a UTV, ATV or Rock Bouncer. In both solo and multiplayer mode, your talent and choices of technique will make the difference.

title: 0 Rally Desert Race: Offroad Dirt Simulator
description: 0 Rally Desert Race: Offroad Dirt Simulator will take you on an adrenaline-fueled journey into the heart of rally racing. Get ready to experience the thrill of high-speed off-road competitions in this dynamic game!

title: Hapy-y
description: The world's first "attuned" superhuman gets stuck in a quest room about his own life. The puzzles seem easy, but at one point his way out turns into a nightmare...

title: Zero End: Chapter One
description: Zero End is a paranormal mystery adult Visual Novel with horror elements where you try to find the truth behind the sinister happenings at Altham Academy.

title: Waking Up: Way Back Home
description: A child infiltrates a spaceship to carry out a secret rescue mission. His objective is compromised when they must make a forced landing on a strange planet. Explore this mysterious place, overcome obstacles, and find the way back home!

title: Wasard
description: Wasard is a wacky, rogue-lite, single stick shooter. Maneuver your auto-casting wizard between dangerous enemies and hundreds of projectiles. Purchase passive charms, unlock permanent wards, and use powerful relics to give yourself an edge in each new randomly generated dungeon.

title: We Could Be Heroes
description: We Could Be Heroes is a retro style, action packed beat ‘em up in the style of classic 90s brawler arcade titles. Featuring a huge array of attacks, destructible environments and brutal deaths. Become a hero and fight bad guys while stopping crimes and rescuing innocent civilians along the way.

title: X-Plane 12: Aerosoft - Seychelles XP
description: The Seychelles are a group of islands in the Indian Ocean - but what comes into most people’s minds when they think about the name is a tropical paradise, luxurious holidays, excellent diving spots and breathtakingly beautiful nature.

title: You're Not Family
description: A (really short) free narrative rhythm game by Atiya Nova. Attend a family dinner and time your key presses to the flow of conversation. Features lots of familial tension with a dash of misery. And cute bunnies!

title: Xerme
description: Enter Xerme, a mysterious world full of challenging puzzles and unique discoveries on a journey of evolution and exploration.

title: Woodland Town
description: Embark on a cozy journey of discovery and wonder in this enchanting exploration game. Immerse yourself in the lush embrace of a mystical town and the adjacent forest, where hidden objectives await your keen eye!

title: Wildwood Down
description: Step into the hilariously twisted world of Wildwood Down, a side-splitting comedy horror point-and-click adventure set in the charming heart of Wildwood, NJ, where every corner hides a blend of mystery and laughter, perfect for fans of the genre and new comers looking for a wild ride!

title: Wild Alone
description: Powered by Unreal Engine 4. As you find yourself stranded on an island overrun by vicious dinosaurs and mutants, you must fight to survive and make your escape. Explore the island's dangerous landscapes, capture and raise dinosaurs to aid your journey, and outsmart the deadly creatures.

title: Wedding Witch
description: There is a witch here preparing to marry you. She embarks on an adventure to find the succubus's potion to seduce you. But a forest filled with demons stands in her way... Will she be able to find the succubus's potion and have a happy wedding?

title: Winter Valley Hike
description: Embark on a serene journey through the enchanting Winter Valley, a place of tranquility and discovery. Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature as you roam freely, seeking out hidden treasures and unique locations that will leave you breathless.

title: Vasilisas Torment
description: Pass all the tests to free the soul of Vasilisa. But will you be able to do it and will you have enough skills to overcome the ingenious traps that the evil spirits set up.

title: Visions of Evil
description: Enter a haunted world in Visions of Evil, a 4v1 asymmetrical PvP Horror game. Explore abandoned areas with your team, battle hellish entities, and use ancient weapons and artifacts to survive and banish the evil. Are you ready to face your fears?

title: VonGarland Castle: Sacrilege of the Night
description: VonGarland Castle : Sacrilege of the Night a love letter to action platformer classics like Castlevania, Super Metroid and Mega Man X.

title: Virago: Reality New
description: Virago: Reality New invites you to a chilling adventure where you guide Willow, a survivor escaping abuse, through a world of terror. Master the torchlight, outwit relentless stalkers, and navigate between reality and nightmare. Can you ensure Willow's survival in this heart-pounding pursuit?

title: Vault Apocalypsis
description: Vault Apocalypsis is a top-down roguelite arena shooter where you fight off hordes of monsters on your quest to stay the apocalypse. Power up your character, create outrageous synergies and take your build as far as you can. Invite your friends for up to 4 player online co-op.

title: Varkij: Dream and Nightmare
description: A turn-based RPG with tons of Dragon characters who unite to either end, embrace or save the Nightmare Dragon.

title: Valdamour
description: Valdamour is a multiplayer asymmetric PvP where the exorcist player performs rituals in a haunted mansion, while the ghost player tries to stop him by using his arsenal of spooky abilities. Avoid the ghost's attempts at killing you before you can complete the final ritual and exorcise it for good.

title: Untrusted: Hackers at Large
description: A single player hacking adventure set in the Untrusted world where you'll be playing as various hackers getting into computer systems to hack, steal and sabotage. Manage your crew, manage your risks, threaten or kill your targets. Investigate. Hack. Don't Die.

title: Unreal Lust Theory
description: Dive into the seductive world of Unreal Lust Theory, a 3D adult game packed with quests and steamy encounters. Live out your fantasies as a 20-year-old, navigating interactions with a variety of alluring female characters. Embark on a journey where choices lead to thrilling outcomes.

title: Tyrone Soulz
description: It was supposed to be an uneventful arrest, but after the suspect made a blood pact with Moloch, this rookie cop is in for much more than he bargained for. Can he defeat Tyrone and return home to his family?

title: Twisty Puzzle World
description: Twisty Puzzle World: 400+ twisty / magic puzzles, and an editor to make your own puzzles.

title: Turbo Tails
description: Animals are flocking to see the annual Turbo Tails Tournament! Pick your animal racer, navigate diverse locations, devour treats to unleash turbo power, outwit rivals and savor the thrill of a racing adventure like no other!

title: True Abstraction: Rewind
description: You'll need to solve chambers in the secret moon facility. But be careful because something is trying to kill you without thinking. Nobody will cry about your death.

title: Traveler's Tavern
description: "Traveler's Tavern" is a business simulation game. Your goal is to build a prosperous tavern and attract more customers by providing high-quality service, cooking food, unlocking new recipes and improving the reputation of the tavern.

title: Arch Rivals
description: Arch Rivals is a one-in-the-chamber platform fighter where you duel your friends with your bow and arrow. Aim carefully and hope that you can pick your arrow back up!

title: Beat Survival
description: Beat Survival is 2D pixel action-adventure survival game where you can play as single or in 2 players local co-op where you start driving around, looting, scavenging, crafting, fishing, dismantling and do more missions. Not only you fight the bad guy and zombies, but you also interact with others.

title: Absolute Doppelkopf for Windows 11
description: This new version of "Absolute Doppelkopf for Windows 11" contains an extended set of rules with an extensive compilation of different variants and settings.

title: 808s&Genetics
description: A puzzle game that combines nonogram and genetics rules.

title: Absolute Schafkopf for Windows 11
description: Schafkopf is a popular German card game and is played by young and old with great enthusiasm. "Absolute Schafkopf for Windows 11" is suitable for beginners and advanced players alike.

title: Train Simulator: Glasgow to Dunblane and Alloa Route
description: Experience the charm of Scotland and scenic diverse landscapes as you explore Glasgow to Dunblane and Alloa for Train Simulator from Thomson Interactive.

title: Girl Up
description: Embark on an exciting adventure in the heights, preventing the villain Vill from accomplishing his goal. Confront him, overcoming the condemnation of humanity. Don't stop, keep climbing, girl!

title: I Commissioned Some Cats 2
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Leafy Trails: Magic Tree
description: Immerse yourself in a world of enchantment and renewal as you guide the fox on its quest to rescue the ancient Great Tree. Unearth the magic of the forest, uncover its hidden gems, and weave your own story amidst the Leafy Trails.

title: TY the Tasmanian Tiger 4: Bush Rescue Returns
description: Explore a ripper new side of TY the Tasmanian Tiger with this fair dinkum, comic-style side scrolling adventure!

title: Mermaid Castle 2
description: Join the mermaid sisters in their new, underwater adventure!

title: Redeemer's Run
description: Fight. Conquer. Reunite.

title: Aireo FlightSimulator
description: Are you ready for takeoff? Fasten your seatbelt and experience what it's like to be a pilot as you dive into the most breathtaking landscapes of this planet.

title: Roids
description: Explore a unique, procedurally generated galaxy filled with alien artifacts and resources to extract and exploit. Mine asteroids, harvest nebula, pilot unique ships and find new and strange things in the void between stars as you struggle to survive long enough to find another home.

title: Train Simulator Classic: ÖBB 5081 Schienenbus
description: Climb into the cab of an Austrian rail legend with the ÖBB 5081 Schienenbus ‘railbus' from RSSLO.

title: Chain Reaction
description: Create your own custom chain reactions from scratch or try and explore a variety of set challenges.

title: First Up
description: Race to the summit with friends in "First Up" – the ultimate climbing showdown! Show off your skills, outsmart rivals, and use unique character abilities in this strategic, multiplayer adventure. Whether you're a pro climber or a newbie, it's time to conquer the heights and be "First Up"!

title: Ammo and Oxygen
description: Adrenaline shooter-roguelike with survival elements and suspense atmosphere. Try to unravel the mysteries, exploring stations, dungeons, canyons, swamps and permafrost, fighting alien creatures.

title: Posthaste
description: An arcade rally game.

title: Fusillade
description: Use your infinite deck of cards in real time to push back the never ending waves of pirates. Fly through a Roguelike, Arcade, Space Shoot em' up, and Destroy the Cosmos with unparalleled firepower, ingenuity, and a little bit of luck!

title: Halchemist
description: Tag-changing exploration action game in which two characters are operated alternately.

title: The Fairway Club
description: Grab your clubs and get to The Fairway Club now! We offer a relaxing golfing experience for any type of golfer. Hit one of our courses or driving ranges, located all around the world, in the morning, evening or night!

title: To The Mars
description: Are you ready to climb Mars just for fun? This is a concise game, nothing more. You can always repeat it, you learn from mistakes. It should be simple enough, good luck to everyone.

title: This is My Place
description: This is my place - This is a fantasy war game with simple gameplay but difficult survival. Players need to upgrade facilities to obtain more resources to defend their territory. In addition to wars, players can also gain more resources or morale by playing mini-games. So how many days can you last?

title: The Spectral Web: Hitodama
description: Explore a Labyrinth full of magic, monsters, and mystery in this dungeon crawler inspired by retro classics. Wield unique spells to battle enemies, break blocks, and uncover hundreds of secrets hidden within the Labyrinth's walls.

title: The Princess's Dragon
description: Traverse the winding dungeon of the dragon as you attempt to reverse the curse that has been set upon you by the cursed sword.

title: Total Vengeance
description: Fueling the desire for vengeance, players must survive against ghastly creatures, uncover the truth behind the gas station's abandonment, and confront their own inner demons. The choices made throughout the journey will shape their destiny, blurring the lines between redemption and revenge.

title: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Dive into a world of Victorian elegance and mechanical marvels. Discover steam-powered wonders while testing the limits of your puzzle-solving skills.

title: Hand Simulator: Aliens
description: Hand Simulator: Aliens is a multiplayer game where your mission is team survival. You either battle infected colleagues, saving the ship and crew, or sow chaos and death as an infected member.

title: Mazepocalypse
description: Choose your character and shoot through zombies in this retro dot-collecting maze arcade game for 1-4 players! Featuring multiple ways to play, tackle one of the game's 6 unique scenarios in Campaign mode, or shoot for the hi-score in Arcade mode!

title: Sniper Hunter Shooter
description: For game lovers seeking realism, Sniper Hunter Shooter is an experience not to be missed! Fight as a sniper in a post-apocalyptic world, create your strategy, and test your shooting skills.

title: Rainman
description: When the rain falls, evil lurks. The storm is just the beginning. Can you survive the night and rescue your child from the clutches of Rainman? Prepare for the most intense survival horror.

title: Multiplayer Platform Golf
description: A 3D golf game with platforming and online multiplayer.

title: The Paper Trials
description: A first-person horror maze game. Hiding & Standing still is Death. Run or you are dead. Trapped in a realm of nightmarish mazes with your only hope of survival is to find all of the pages to the mysterious book and escape!

title: The Nascent Necromancer
description: When you're falsely accused of sorcery, corrupt inquisitors make you the object of a witch hunt. Now, sorcery might be the only way for you to survive.

title: Pixel Descent
description: Pixel Descent is an action rogue-lite in which you navigate a series of complex dungeons packed to the brim with monsters that want you dead. Sign the contract and descend into the deepest depths of the abyss knowing full well that you will definitely die there, it's just a matter of when.

title: Copperfields
description: Escape to the outside world! In this 2D precision platformer, you play as a potted plant controlling a robot, that you use as a vehicle, to find water. Explore the post-apocalyptic world of Copperfields, discover what happened to the human and robot civilizations, and find your new home.

title: The Impossible Tower
description: In Impossible Tower, a young boy with no particular skill has been transported back to the Medieval Times by a clumsy wizard. There he will find lots of adventures and fun while trying to reach the tower top in order to escape this zombie-infested and full-of-magic world!

title: Mechanization
description: Mechanization is a factory building game. Build huge production lines, utilizing an array of droppers, conveyor belts, smelters, upgraders & more! Upgrade the size of your factory & use factory modules to enhance your factory's efficiency.

title: Hive Jump 2: Survivors
description: Become an agent of vengeance in this bullet-heaven action roguelite! You are the lone survivor of your squad, on an alien planet with just your weapon, a jetpack, and the courage to keep fighting. Kill off alien swarms and transform their valuable guts into explosive upgrades and vital utilities.

title: Magical Hike
description: Welcome to the enchanting world of Magical Hike, a soothing and immersive walking simulator that invites you to embark on a tranquil journey through picturesque landscapes and captivating environments. Leave your worries behind as you explore breathtaking locations.

title: Miss Peach
description:
"Miss Peach" is a pixel stealth strategy puzzle game.
You will play the role of a police officer - Jing Shu, searching for your missing son. During the search process, you are caught up in a strange incident: you are trapped in the house of Duo. Here, investigate more truth while protecting yourself.

title: Keep Flip
description: Technical game that make you use your mind and skills by taking control of a vehicle named Tweely that flips with ease. Drive across a large number of challenges. Climb perilous obstacles, navigate water hazards, and play with bottles. Don't let the challenges dissuade you, by mastering Tweely, you can become an unstoppable driver and conquer every challenge.

title: Railgun 500
description: Only five hundred remain. Eradicate them. Railgun 500 is a first person bunker shooter where you take your last stand against an invading force with nothing but your chargeable railgun. Use the weapon well. It's all you've got.

title: S.A.B.A.H. (Sun As Biased As Harmony)
description: The bias between the sun and harmony will be shattered by the chosen one...

title: Clanswoman
description: It is a story about the adventure of two sisters who leave their quiet lives behind and embark on a journey of revenge due to some unfortunate events. Turn based adventure game.

title: Dominoes Colors
description: Dominoes Colors It is a puzzle relaxing game where you need to mix colors when put each piece on board. The mix result is the next step to solve the puzzle. The piece with a chequered flag is the last piece, your last mix of colors needs to be equal of it.

title: Eldritch Exterminators
description: Face the Eldritch hordes. You are a possessed gun, feeding on the souls of the dead. Grow your power and challenge the Eldritch Gods for Dominion over the Void. Slay the Forgotten Ones and harness Unspeakables in this Bullet Heaven, and escape the ties that bind.

title: Fishman's Last Stand
description: Brace yourself for a fight ahead, as humans set their sights on your land. Their unwavering determination fuels their pursuit, and they'll stop at nothing to claim it. Stand your ground with unwavering resolve, knowing that your defense holds the key to safeguarding your territory

title: Killa
description: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

title: Test Lab Inc.
description: Customize your skills and rain hell upon the endless hordes of robots. Test Lab Inc. is a fast-paced game where you'll be constantly tweaking your abilities until you become the ultimate weapon of mass destruction and crush all the puny robots that dare cross your path.

title: The Elder Tales
description: Prepare for a challenging adventure in this oldschool 2D action-RPG. Experience the nostalgic charm of retro graphics combined with modern gameplay solutions. With low computer requirements, immerse yourself in an intriguing story and explore a world filled with endless activities.

title: The Fall of Elements
description: The Fall of Elements is an action-adventure game set in an ancient dungeon. You are chosen by the Elements to find an evil enemy. Solve puzzles, explore a vast dungeon, overcome obstacles in your way and fight forbidden magic.

title: The Hallway: Escape Room
description: “The Hallway - Escape Room” is a story-based single player puzzle adventure game that will take you on a mind-bending journey to uncover the mysteries of a long-forgotten civilization and their gods discovered during an expedition. Will you face them?

title: The Hangman
description: After weeks of relentless searching, the Detective finally uncovers a critical clue that leads to an isolated location, unveiling the fate of the Hangman's victims. Can you make a getaway with your findings before it's too late?

title: Tensei
description: Experience facing the mind along with the peaceful Zen landscape.

title: Sunset of Ate
description: An open world TPS science fiction game

title: Sun-Rise.exe
description: Adventure through bizarre and intricately made levels in this 2D platformer game.

title: Sunland Hike
description: Unveil the tranquility of nature in this captivating walking simulator. Immerse yourself in the picturesque landscapes of Sunland, where every step leads to a new discovery. Your ultimate goal? Find hidden gems scattered throughout the terrain, each more breathtaking than the last. ️

title: Stimmings
description: Stimmings is a rogue like and real time strategy experience where units must be coerced into performing activities to snowball your colony into a winning state.

title: Stick Slasher
description: Stick Slasher is an epic 2D fighting game where you combat relentless waves of adversaries armed with shields, swords, or guns. Confront a range of enemy types, secure the highest scores, and ascend to the title of the ultimate warrior!

title: Simple Snooker
description: This is a two-player Snooker game, that runs on computer desktop or virtual reality device.

title: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
description: You are the CEO of a private military company. Recruit capable mercenaries, purchase weapons, and develop your mercenaries according to their roles and characteristics. Observe how your mercenaries perform in combat and plan your tactics to ensure mission success.

title: Stab!
description: STAB! is a competitive 2–4 player card game where the only rule that matters is simple: trust no one. Build temporary alliances and betray them at the exact moment it hurts the most! In this game, loyalty is an illusion and survival depends on how well you can deceive everyone at the table.

title: StanÇact: Sexy Tenacious Girls
description: 『StanÇact』is a cute and sexy girl-on-girl Shoot'em up. Mai, a military officer, is on her way to quell a riot, but the rioters and the military have teamed up and are on the rampage and the head of the military was the ringleader.Witness one woman's struggle to complete her mission amidst the chaos!

title: Snaky Survivor
description: Navigate the stark world of Snaky Survivor, an arcade game that pits you against starvation and challenges your survival instincts. Guide a snake-like character as it gathers soul fragments to stave off hunger, weaving through hazardous obstacles in a race against time.

title: Sneaky Peeky
description: Time for being stealthy! Dive into the shadows of Sneaky Peeky and experience real multiplayer stealth action. Use the environment to conceal your presence and avoid getting caught. Find ways to disrupt enemy team. Discuss your strategy and be sneaky!

title: Son of Perun Kharkiv
description: Son of Perun: Kharkiv is a first-person shooter in the setting of Kharkiv of the future and retrowawe.

title: Sorrow Asylum 2
description: Sorrow Asylum 2 is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison, as well as a sequel to Sorrow Asylum.

title: Space Dogo
description: Space Dogo is a platform/adventure game. Moro is an old trained dog searching across the galaxy for her owner who has been kidnapped after some enemy attack to the Human Colony.

title: Spectator 2
description: Welcome to the world of Spectator 2 – the sequel to the gripping horror game Spectator! Brace yourself for new levels of atmospheric terror and captivating surveillance, you'll face even more chilling events and dangers as you carefully monitor cameras and report any suspicious occurrences.

title: Race Manager
description: Become a race manager

title: Rescue Team: Mineral of Miracles
description: The extraordinary discovery of a mineral named "Immortalite" has sent shockwaves across the globe. Now you are tasked with uncovering the secrets of this powerful mineral and ensuring it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

title: Sexy Ladies
description: Sexy Ladies is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Seybul Tech
description: Seybul Tech is a walking simulator. Navigate as an office employee, confronting peculiar encounters while in search of an exit from this enigmatic abyss.

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 5
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki at the office getting cornered by her asshole of a Boss, then seduced into a wild quickie while her husband is on the other side of a glass wall.

title: Sex Play: The Sauna
description: A quick and dirty game made especially for your pleasure. Contains visual novel elements and a sex simulation part. You play the role of a man who goes to the sauna and receives a special treatment.

title: SCP-479: Shadows of the Mind
description: You are a Class D personnel on an experimental mission for the Foundation to investigate SCP-479. The facility is linked to anomalies affecting the human psyche, gradually driving them insane. Please remember to take your pills.

title: Ronshade
description: "Ronshade" is a turn-based roguelike game. Players collect items and challenge the depths. The turn system displays action results, with intuitive and quick controls. Over 100 unique items greatly influence combat outcomes.

title: Scarred
description: Scarred is a first-person atmospheric horror puzzle game where you must uncover the truth about one of your schoolmates before it’s too late. Traverse a world of nightmares inspired by nostalgic Singaporean architecture as you fight to survive.

title: Jewel BEM Hunter Lime
description:
A twelve episode series of short, low-interaction semi-animated episodic games by Silence. The series tell the story of Bass and Lime, two demonic creatures who assume human form and travel to Earth in order to retrieve stolen jewels from "big-eyed monsters" (BEMs). The anime Jewel BEM Hunter Lime is based on these games.

Once upon a month, a door behind the full moon opens. This door is between the human world and magical world. Now it just so happens that on one such night, Lime and Bass are in hot pursuit of a demon who had stolen six power gems from the magical world. The demon escapes to the human world through the open door, and the two follow. Now they must search for the six power gems, all of which have been scattered all over Tokyo. It's up to Lime and Bass to blend into with humans and find the gems.

title: Dough: A Crime Strategy RPG
